paper.title: Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention
paper.abstract: Language models spend most of their attention on a small fraction of context, yet they read the entire KV cache to find the few tokens that matter. If the user asks about a previous detail in a 1M-token conversation, global attention layers must scan the full context to generate each token of the reply. A prominent approach mitigates this cost by pre-selecting relevant tokens via lightweight proxy scores, but this extrinsic scoring still incurs O(N) per step. We take an intrinsic approach motiva

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是长上下文解码时一个很现实的瓶颈：模型每生成一个 token，都要从 KV cache 里扫描几乎整个历史上下文，哪怕真正有用的只是一小部分位置。现有做法通常用外部代理分数去预选重要 token，但这类方法每步仍要做 O(N) 级别的 cache 读取或扫描。作者提出的问题更直接：既然模型自己在推理时已经隐含知道“接下来该看哪里”，能不能把这个信息显式说出来，并直接驱动稀疏注意力，而不是再用一个外部机制去猜？
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义有两层。第一层是 serving 和推理效率：这项工作给出了一条不同于 proxy scoring 的路线，把注意力选择从“外部估计”改成“模型自声明”，目标是把每步 O(N) 的选择成本降掉。第二层更有研究味道：它说明现代 LLM 的 chain-of-thought 不只是承载‘想什么’，还可以承载‘看哪里’，也就是把隐式控制信号文本化、协议化。这对预训练和后训练接口很重要，因为它暗示模型内部已经有可外显的 attention planning 能力，只是过去没有被统一协议激活。若未来在 post-training 或 mid-training 中显式训练这类协议，可能会把长上下文推理和稀疏解码更紧地结合起来。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Declarative Attention，简称 DA。核心思想是让模型在 CoT 中插入可解析的控制标记，声明当前所需的注意力范围，并由推理引擎据此动态构造 attention mask。协议把生成过程分成三种模式。<global> 表示需要浏览全局上下文，允许访问完整历史；<focus> 表示模型已经锁定某个上下文区域，后续只需看该区域；<local> 表示只看最近输出，不再读取长上下文。推理引擎旁路运行一个状态机，实时解析这些标签，并在每个 decoding step 更新 mask。这样，完整上下文读取只发生在模型自己声明的 global 阶段，而不是每一步都扫一遍。与已有 sparse attention / retrieval-style 方法相比，这里的关键区别是 selection signal 来自模型生成的 reasoning trace，而不是来自隐藏状态上的轻量打分器、历史注意力启发式、recency 规则或额外扫描模块。论文还实现了与 vLLM 兼容的工程版本，采用 block-aligned、in-place 的 KV cache masking，并兼容 FlashAttention。方法的一个重要特点是零样本可用：作者没有针对每个任务单独微调，也没有依赖手工设计的任务特定分区，而是用一个统一协议在现成模型上直接 elicitation。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个长上下文任务，主要在 Gemma-4-31B 和 Qwen-3.6-27B 上报告。主结果是成本-精度折中：DA 在 Gemma-4-31B 上平均降低 52.0% 的 decoding attention cost，准确率仅下降 1.27 个百分点；在 Qwen-3.6-27B 上平均降低 31.1%，准确率下降 2.75 个百分点。论文还展示了明显的尺度效应：从 4B 到 31B，模型越强，DA 与普通全注意力之间的精度差距越小，说明“自声明注意力”依赖模型已有的推理与规划能力。随着上下文变长，绝对节省的 attended tokens 快速增长，单次响应最多可节省 21M tokens。消融实验也比较关键：相对于不使用动态 mask 的 ablation，DA 的 mask 最多可减少 71.1% 的 attended tokens，说明节省主要来自动态稀疏化本身，而不是 prompt 格式变化。工程上，作者基于 roofline 分析估算，在优化良好的 serving 栈上，DA 可把 decode wall-clock cost 降到 vanilla 的 0.71×（Gemma-4-31B）和 0.77×（Qwen-3.6-27B）。这里作者比较谨慎，没有把理论 token 节省直接等同于端到端加速，而是通过带宽主导的分析给出更可信的时间收益估计。
summary.reading_guide: 先读 Introduction，重点看作者如何界定问题：长上下文解码的主瓶颈不是算 attention score 的 FLOPs，而是反复从 HBM 读取大体量 KV cache。然后直接看 Declarative Attention 的协议定义和示例，弄清 <global>/<focus>/<local> 三种模式分别解决什么问题，以及状态机如何把文本标签转成 mask。实验部分建议先看 15 个任务上的主表，再看 scaling 结果，因为这决定了方法是不是只对少数模型有效。之后看 ablation，尤其是 maskless ablation 和不同模式设计的对比，这能帮助判断收益来自协议本身还是来自额外 CoT。最后看 vLLM 实现与 roofline 分析，那里能看出这项工作是否真的考虑了系统层约束。值得深挖的点有三处：第一，模型声明的 focus 区域与真实高权重 attention 的一致性；第二，协议是否会诱导新的推理偏差，比如过早收缩注意范围；第三，如果用 post-training 专门训练 DA，零样本结果还能提升多少。认真阅读核心内容大约需要 50-70 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in long-context decoding: at every generation step, the model typically reads the entire KV cache even though only a small subset of prior tokens matters. Existing sparse-attention approaches usually rely on external proxy scores to preselect relevant tokens, but those methods still incur an O(N) scan or read over context at each step. The paper asks a sharper question: if the model already knows, during reasoning, which parts of the context it needs next, can that internal signal be surfaced explicitly and used to control attention directly?
summary_en.importance: Its value is partly systems-oriented and partly conceptual. On the systems side, it offers an alternative to proxy-scoring pipelines for long-context serving, aiming to remove the per-step O(N) token-selection overhead rather than merely shrinking its constant factor. On the modeling side, it suggests that chain-of-thought can expose not only what the model is reasoning about, but also where it intends to look. That is an important interface idea for pretraining and post-training: the model may already contain latent attention-planning capability, and a simple protocol can make it operational. If this behavior is later trained explicitly, sparse decoding and reasoning could become much more tightly integrated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is called Declarative Attention (DA). The model is prompted to emit parseable control tags inside its chain-of-thought, declaring the attention scope it needs at each phase of generation. An inference-side state machine reads these tags online and constructs the attention mask dynamically. DA defines three modes. <global> allows access to the full context and is used when the model needs to survey or search broadly. <focus> commits the model to a specific region of the context, restricting attention to that region. <local> limits attention to recent generated tokens, avoiding long-context reads altogether. This is the key departure from prior sparse-attention methods: the selection signal comes from the model’s own generated reasoning trace, not from hidden-state proxy scorers, recency heuristics, historical attention statistics, or an auxiliary scan over the cache. The paper also includes a practical implementation in vLLM using block-aligned, in-place KV-cache masking compatible with FlashAttention. Another notable point is that the protocol works zero-shot on off-the-shelf models, without task-specific fine-tuning or hand-designed partitions for each benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 15 long-context tasks, with main results reported on Gemma-4-31B and Qwen-3.6-27B. The central finding is a favorable cost-accuracy trade-off. DA reduces average decoding attention cost by 52.0% on Gemma-4-31B with only a 1.27 percentage-point accuracy drop, and by 31.1% on Qwen-3.6-27B with a 2.75-point drop. The paper also shows positive scaling behavior: as model size increases from 4B to 31B, the accuracy gap between DA and full attention narrows, suggesting that self-declared attention depends on model capability. Absolute savings grow with context length, reaching up to 21 million attended tokens saved per response. The ablations are important. Relative to a maskless ablation, the DA-induced dynamic mask cuts attended tokens by as much as 71.1%, indicating that the savings are driven by the masking mechanism itself rather than by prompt formatting alone. On the systems side, a roofline-style analysis estimates decode wall-clock cost reductions to 0.71× of vanilla for Gemma-4-31B and 0.77× for Qwen-3.6-27B on a well-optimized serving stack. The paper is careful not to equate token savings with end-to-end speedup directly; it grounds the estimate in memory-bandwidth considerations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Begin with the introduction, especially the discussion of why long-context decoding is bandwidth-bound due to repeated KV-cache reads. Then read the DA protocol section closely to understand the semantics of <global>, <focus>, and <local>, and how the inference-side state machine turns generated tags into masks. In the experiments, start with the main 15-task results to get the overall cost-accuracy picture, then read the scaling section because it reveals whether the protocol improves with model capability. After that, focus on the ablations, especially the maskless comparison and any analyses of mode transitions, since those are the best tests of whether the gains come from dynamic masking rather than just extra CoT structure. Finally, read the vLLM implementation and roofline analysis to judge practical viability. Three questions are worth tracking while reading: how well declared focus regions align with actual useful context; whether the protocol can induce premature narrowing of attention; and how much additional gain might be unlocked by explicit post-training for DA. A careful pass through the core sections should take around 50 to 70 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“长上下文必须靠外部检索/代理打分裁剪”的 prior；先看方法接口和消融，若结果站得住，内部应立刻复现这种 model-runtime 协议。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior that long-context efficiency must come from external scoring or retrieval; read the interface and ablations first, and if the setup is clean, this model-runtime protocol is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding is a critical capability for real-world applications, including embodied intelligence, autonomous driving, industrial monitoring, surveillance and early warning, and wearable assistants. However, processing continuous video streams with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is computationally expensive. Existing efforts have explored reducing streaming overhead through visual token pruning, token merging, quantization, on-demand frame retrieval, and context offlo

summary.core_problem: 解决流式视频理解中，MLLM 对每批新帧都做全深度 prefill 导致计算和 KV cache 线性膨胀的问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态推理效率工作，不是基座预训练工作。少量相关性来自它提出了按层深度分工的推理范式：浅层做索引与编码，深层只在回答时激活，这对思考多模态统一模型的分层计算有一点启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ShallowStream：先用 MLLM 浅层同时完成帧编码和检索索引构建，在流式阶段避免反复跑全深度 prefill；回答阶段再基于索引选取相关帧，并调用深层网络做更重的推理。核心不是 token pruning，而是 depth-aware 的 streaming 计算拆分，顺带减缓 KV cache 随深度增长。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据集数字，但对比对象包括视觉 token pruning、token merging、quantization、按需帧检索、context offloading 等流式视频理解加速方法。预期指标是吞吐、延迟、KV cache 占用与问答精度的折中，而不是预训练质量。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the cost of repeatedly running full-depth MLLM prefills on incoming video frames, which causes both compute and KV-cache growth to scale poorly in streaming video understanding.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper for multimodal systems, not a foundation pretraining paper. Its limited relevance comes from a depth-partitioned computation idea: shallow layers handle indexing/encoding, while deeper layers are activated only for answering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ShallowStream: shallow MLLM layers are used during streaming to encode frames and build a retrieval index, avoiding repeated full-depth prefills; at answer time, the system retrieves relevant frames from the index and invokes deeper layers for heavier reasoning. The key idea is depth-aware decomposition rather than token pruning alone, with the side benefit of slowing KV-cache growth.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes or dataset numbers, but the baselines include visual token pruning, token merging, quantization, on-demand frame retrieval, and context offloading. The main tradeoff is likely throughput/latency/KV-cache versus QA accuracy, rather than any pretraining-related metric.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系偏弱，但“浅层建索引、深层只在需要时激活”这个分层计算想法可借来想 unified model 的推理路径；正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Weakly related to pretraining, but the shallow-index/deep-answer split is a useful systems idea for unified models; know the idea, don’t spend time on the full paper.

paper.title: CacheBridge: Efficient Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer
paper.abstract: Sharing context between LLMs in a multi-model system requires the receiving model to prefill the shared prefix because KV caches are model-specific. Recent closed-form cross-model KV transfer, hereafter Full-Head Mapping, avoids this replay by fitting a training-free affine mapper from source to target caches. However, its full-head design maps each target KV head from every source KV head in the selected layers, making transfer quality sensitive to architectural differences and causing mapper s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模型系统里一个越来越实际的问题：当请求从一个 LLM 切换到另一个 LLM 时，接收模型无法直接复用发送模型的 KV cache，因为 cache 是模型内部表示，和架构、层、头、维度都绑定。于是目标模型必须对共享前缀重新 prefill，长上下文下这会带来明显延迟。已有的 closed-form 方法 Full-Head Mapping 试图用离线拟合的仿射映射把源模型 cache 直接转成目标模型 cache，但它默认每个目标头都从所有源头做全连接回归，导致三个问题：对架构差异很敏感、KV 重建误差和真实续写质量不一致、映射器存储和应用成本随支持层数快速增长。CacheBridge 要解决的就是如何在保持“训练自由、在线仍是仿射映射”的前提下，把跨模型 KV 转移做得更准、更便宜、更稳定。
summary.importance: 它不属于预训练核心，但对 serving 和系统侧研究有直接价值，也对架构分析有启发。原因在于，KV cache transfer 其实在逼问一个更基础的问题：不同模型内部注意力状态到底有多少可对齐结构。Full-Head Mapping 说明存在一定线性可转移性，CacheBridge 则进一步说明这种可转移性不是“所有头对所有头”的均匀对应，而是带有明显架构局部性的。对基座研究员来说，这篇工作的价值主要有三层。第一，它给出了跨模型内部表示可对齐性的更细粒度证据。第二，它把优化目标从坐标级 cache 拟合推进到 attention 误差，更贴近真实生成行为。第三，它展示了一个很工程但很重要的事实：如果离线拟合过程不利用静态结构，构建成本本身会成为部署瓶颈。整体看，这是偏系统与表示映射的工作，不是范式级创新，但完成度高，问题定义也清楚。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个互相配合的组件组成，核心思想是同时重做 support 设计、拟合目标和构建路径，但不改变在线接口仍为闭式仿射映射。

第一部分是 Head-Local。Full-Head Mapping 的做法是：对每个目标层、目标 KV 头，从选定源层的所有源 KV 头拼接后做回归。作者认为这隐含了一个过强假设，即不同模型之间头的对应关系是全局稠密的。CacheBridge 改成 architecture-indexed 的局部支持：每个目标头只从一个源头块接收输入，但仍允许跨层聚合。这样做的直接效果是把每个目标头的 fan-in 从“所有源头”缩到“一个局部块”，系数数量按源头数成倍下降，文中是 8× 缩减。更重要的是，这个约束把映射偏置到更符合架构对应关系的子空间，减少了在架构差异较大时的错误耦合。

第二部分是 Attn-Repair。作者指出，传统 held-out R² 只衡量 cache 坐标重建，而生成质量取决于这些误差经过目标模型 query 与 attention 组合后的放大或抵消。因此相同的 KV 拟合误差，可能对应完全不同的续写漂移。Attn-Repair 的做法是按残差对接收模型 attention 输出的一阶影响来重加权，相当于让拟合更关注那些会真正改变后续注意力计算的方向，而不是平均对待所有 cache 坐标。为了避免权重过度集中到极少数样本，作者加入 effective-sample-size floor 来限制退化，但不改变在线映射形式。

第三部分是 Fused-Fit。由于不同目标层会选择不同源层支持，top-k layer 选择会造成碎片化 gather，通用拟合器在构建加权充分统计量时会反复做 scattered materialization、centering 和 weighting，内存流量很大。Fused-Fit 用新的 fused GPU kernel 在有界 panel 内直接构建 head-batched 矩阵乘法所需统计量，保持同样的 ridge solver 和同样的最终 mapper artifact，只是把离线构建过程做成结构感知的高效实现。这个部分没有改变数学目标，但大幅改善了 mapper construction 的时间和内存行为。

整体上，CacheBridge 不是提出新的在线推理协议，而是在“离线拟合、在线仿射应用”这个框架内，把支持结构、目标函数和实现路径都改得更贴近真实 continuation quality。
summary.experiments:
实验主要覆盖三个 source→target 转移方向，其中最关键的是两个 Ministral 3 方向和一个 Qwen3 方向。作者先用 Full-Head Mapping 做对照，展示它的模型敏感性：在相同 500-sequence 校准协议、相同 8×128 KV 接口下，Qwen3 32B 目标上几乎能保留原模型性能，79.2% 对 80.2%；但在两个 Ministral 3 指向 14B 的方向上，准确率分别掉到 52.2% 和 44.4%。这说明“存在线性映射”不等于“全头全连接映射就足够”。

CacheBridge 在这两个困难方向上分别恢复了 20.4 和 31.6 个 HellaSwag 点，而在 Qwen3 14B→32B 上保持 99.83% 的平均 target retention，说明它不是靠偏向某一类架构换来的收益。效率方面，Qwen3 上 mapper storage 从 4.296 GB 降到 0.538 GB，约为 8× 压缩；在线应用速度最高提升 3.0×。离线构建方面，在评测设置下，500 条序列的 Qwen3 mapper 构建中位时间为 8.63 秒。

论文还专门分析了三个现象。第一，application latency 随支持层数 k 近线性增长，在 Ministral 3B→14B 上，k=16 时已接近目标模型重新 prefill，k≥20 时甚至超过 re-prefill，这说明如果 support 设计不受控，cache transfer 可能失去系统意义。第二，KV fit 与 continuation quality 不一致，图中展示了相近的 R² 可能对应不同的 attention drift。第三，top-k 支持导致构建碎片化，Fused-Fit 主要解决的是这一离线瓶颈。若从结果解读，最有价值的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是作者把“质量、在线成本、离线构建成本”三者放在同一个设计里一起优化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。Figure 1 基本把问题讲清楚了：Full-Head Mapping 在不同模型对上的质量差异、R² 与续写质量脱钩、支持层数带来的延迟增长、以及构建阶段的碎片化。然后读 Background and Motivation，明确 source/target layer、head、support set 的定义。

方法部分重点看三个模块各自解决什么失配：Head-Local 解决架构局部对应，Attn-Repair 解决优化目标错位，Fused-Fit 解决离线构建低效。实验部分优先看 transfer quality、target retention、storage/application latency、construction time 这几组结果。若只做技术跟踪，25–35 分钟足够；若想把它用于多模型 serving 设计，需要细读 mapper support 的定义、加权统计量构建方式，以及不同架构对之间失败和成功的边界条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical systems problem in multi-LLM deployments: when control is handed from one model to another, the receiver cannot directly reuse the sender’s KV cache because caches are model-specific internal states tied to architecture, layers, heads, and dimensions. The target model therefore has to re-prefill the shared prefix, which becomes expensive for long contexts. A recent closed-form baseline, Full-Head Mapping, fits an offline affine map from source KV states to target KV states, but it assumes every target head should regress on all source heads. That creates three issues: sensitivity to architectural mismatch, a gap between cache reconstruction quality and actual continuation quality, and rapidly growing storage and application cost as support expands. CacheBridge aims to keep the same training-free, affine online interface while making cross-model KV transfer more accurate, cheaper, and more robust.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it matters for serving and for understanding internal representation alignment across models. Full-Head Mapping already suggested that some linear transferability exists between models’ attention states. CacheBridge sharpens that observation: the transferable structure is not uniformly dense across all heads, but has architecture-local regularities. That is useful for foundation-model researchers for three reasons. First, it provides a more fine-grained view of how much internal attention state is shared across related models. Second, it moves the fitting objective away from coordinate-level cache regression toward attention-level functional fidelity, which is closer to what actually matters for generation. Third, it shows that offline fitting cost can itself become a deployment bottleneck if static structure is ignored. Overall, this is a strong systems-and-representation paper rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CacheBridge combines three components and keeps the online deployment interface unchanged: an offline-fitted affine mapper that can be applied directly at handoff time.

The first component is Head-Local. Full-Head Mapping regresses each target KV head on the concatenation of all source KV heads from selected source layers. CacheBridge argues that this assumes an overly dense correspondence between models. Instead, each target head is restricted to a single architecture-indexed source-head block, while still allowing cross-layer aggregation. This reduces fan-in dramatically and cuts the coefficient count by the number of source heads, 8× in the reported setup. More importantly, it biases the mapping toward a subspace that better matches architectural locality, reducing harmful cross-head coupling when the source and target architectures differ.

The second component is Attn-Repair. The paper points out that held-out R² only measures coordinate-wise cache reconstruction, while continuation quality depends on how those errors propagate through the target model’s queries and attention computation. Two mappings with similar cache fit can therefore produce very different continuation drift. Attn-Repair reweights residuals according to their first-order effect on the receiver’s attention output. In other words, it emphasizes errors that actually matter for downstream attention behavior rather than treating all cache coordinates equally. An effective-sample-size floor prevents the weighting from collapsing onto a tiny subset of examples, while preserving the same online affine form.

The third component is Fused-Fit. Because different target layers may choose different source-layer supports, top-k support selection creates fragmented gather patterns. A generic fitter repeatedly materializes scattered tensors, centers them, and applies weights, so memory traffic becomes a major cost. Fused-Fit introduces a fused GPU kernel that constructs the weighted sufficient statistics directly in bounded panels for head-batched matrix multiplication. It does not change the ridge objective, the solver, or the deployed mapper artifact; it simply makes offline construction structure-aware and much more efficient.

Taken together, CacheBridge does not propose a new online protocol. It refines the existing offline-fit / online-affine-transfer framework by redesigning support structure, fitting objective, and construction path around actual continuation quality.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers three transfer directions, with two difficult Ministral 3 directions and one Qwen3 direction being the most informative. The paper first uses Full-Head Mapping to expose model sensitivity. Under the same 500-sequence calibration protocol and the same 8×128 KV interface, transfer to Qwen3 32B remains close to the target baseline, 79.2% versus 80.2%. But the two Ministral 3 directions targeting 14B drop sharply to 52.2% and 44.4%. This shows that the existence of a linear transfer path does not mean dense all-head mapping is the right inductive bias.

CacheBridge recovers 20.4 and 31.6 HellaSwag points on those two difficult directions, while preserving 99.83% mean target retention on Qwen3 14B→32B. So the gain is not coming from overfitting to one architecture family. On efficiency, mapper storage on Qwen3 drops from 4.296 GB to 0.538 GB, roughly an 8× reduction, and online application is up to 3.0× faster. For offline construction, the median time to build the 500-sequence Qwen3 mapper is 8.63 seconds in the reported setup.

The paper also analyzes three important phenomena. First, application latency grows almost linearly with the number of supported source layers k; on Ministral 3B→14B, transfer approaches target-side re-prefill by k=16 and exceeds it from k=20 onward. That means uncontrolled support growth can erase the systems benefit of cache transfer. Second, KV fit and continuation quality are misaligned: similar R² can correspond to very different attention drift. Third, top-k support causes fragmented construction, which is exactly the bottleneck Fused-Fit addresses. The most useful aspect of the experiments is that they optimize quality, online cost, and offline construction cost together rather than reporting only transfer accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and Figure 1. Figure 1 already captures the core story: model sensitivity of Full-Head Mapping, the mismatch between R² and continuation quality, latency growth with support size, and construction fragmentation. Then read the background section to pin down the notation for source and target layers, heads, and support sets.

In the method section, focus on what mismatch each module fixes: Head-Local for architectural locality, Attn-Repair for objective mismatch, and Fused-Fit for offline inefficiency. In the experiments, prioritize transfer quality, target retention, storage and application latency, and construction time. For tracking the idea, 25–35 minutes is enough. For actual deployment or research reuse, the support definition, weighted-statistics construction, and the boundary between successful and failed architecture pairs deserve closer attention.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但问题很真；若你关心多模型 serving，只看它如何把 full-head 映射收缩成架构对齐版本，别被系统包装分散注意力。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the problem is real; if you care about multi-model serving, focus on how it shrinks full-head mapping into an architecture-aligned transfer.

paper.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving
paper.abstract: Hybrid linear-attention architectures have recently scaled to large open-weight models, offering quality competitive with full attention while substantially reducing key/value (KV) cache growth. However, their in-place recurrent-state updates complicate cache management: prefix reuse requires state checkpoints alongside full-attention KV, while storing state checkpoints in full increases memory pressure, leading to more evictions and repeated prefill. By analyzing the decay structure of Gated De

summary.core_problem: 混合线性注意力（full-attn + 线性/递归状态）模型在 serving 时做 prefix reuse 需要保存“递归状态 checkpoint”，但全量存储会造成内存压力与 prefill 重算；如何在不明显掉质的前提下压缩这些状态。
summary.importance: 面向新一代 hybrid linear-attention 大模型的关键系统问题：把“状态衰减/保留时间尺度”显式建模成可压缩结构，直接影响长上下文与多轮对话的吞吐/成本。
summary.technical_approach: 分析 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 与 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) 的衰减结构，提出 retention horizon：不同 head/channel 的前缀信息保留时间差异很大；据此从模型权重推导各单元的 retention horizon，选择长-horizon 单元保留、短-horizon 单元丢弃/更强压缩，并用 ragged（不等长）状态 checkpoint 打包；目标是在 prefix reuse 时减少状态存储与 eviction，从而减少重复 prefill。
summary.experiments: 在 hybrid linear-attention serving 场景评估：对比不压缩/朴素压缩的状态 checkpoint 内存占用、eviction 频率、重复 prefill 开销与端到端吞吐/延迟（摘要未给出具体数字与模型规模，但问题设定与方法路径清晰）。

summary_en.core_problem: Hybrid linear-attention models need recurrent-state checkpoints for prefix reuse during serving, but storing full checkpoints increases memory pressure and triggers evictions and repeated prefills; how to compress states without hurting quality.
summary_en.importance: A practical serving bottleneck for emerging hybrid linear-attention LLMs: making state decay/retention explicit enables principled compression that can materially reduce long-context and multi-turn costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyze decay structures in Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and define retention horizons showing large per-head/channel timescale variation. Derive horizons from model weights, keep long-horizon state units, aggressively compress/drop short-horizon ones, and pack them into ragged (variable-length) state checkpoints to reduce memory and avoid repeated prefills under prefix reuse.
summary_en.experiments: Serving-focused evaluation for hybrid linear-attention: compares full vs compressed checkpoints on memory footprint, eviction/re-prefill overhead, and end-to-end throughput/latency (abstract omits exact scales/numbers).

recommendation.zh: 这篇把“状态衰减=可压缩结构”讲得很工程化，适合立刻对自家 hybrid/SSM-like 模型做 retention 分布统计并复现压缩收益；重点看 retention horizon 的推导与 serving 指标。
recommendation.en: It operationalizes “state decay as compressible structure” in a way you can quickly replicate on your hybrid/SSM-like models; focus on how retention horizons are derived and the serving-side metrics.

paper.title: Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects
paper.abstract: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reduc

summary.core_problem: 单卡部署 70B LLM 时，显存、长上下文吞吐和工程复杂度三者互相牵制，现有压缩方法往往单点优化，缺少联合设计规则。
summary.importance: 这是偏系统与推理效率的工作，价值不在新算法本身，而在把剪枝、量化、KV-cache 压缩放到同一预算框架下研究耦合效应，并给出可复现的设计准则。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把单 GPU 推理建模为三维预算优化问题：内存、吞吐、集成成本。核心做法是做受控消融，分析 layer-wise pruning、权重量化、KV-cache 稀疏化与 INT8 KV 量化之间的相容性与冲突，再据此拼装一条压缩流水线。主要发现包括：分层剪枝会让权重量化更稳；KV-cache 稀疏化与 INT8 KV 量化互补；静态向量量化器与动态缓存策略存在冲突。
summary.experiments: 在单张 NVIDIA A40 上，把 70B 模型压到约 33GB，在 10k token prompt 上达到约 57 tok/s，并把常见基准和推理基准上的绝对精度损失控制在 5% 以内。摘要未说明具体底座模型与完整 benchmark 列表，但实验目标明确，偏真实部署场景。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Lenovo Research 和 University of Washington。不是典型预训练论文，但对 serving 约束如何反向影响模型设计有现实参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-GPU deployment of 70B LLMs is constrained simultaneously by memory, long-context throughput, and engineering complexity, while most compression methods optimize only one axis at a time.
summary_en.importance: This is a systems-and-inference paper. Its value is not a brand-new compression primitive, but a joint budget-aware study of how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic deployment constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates single-GPU inference as a three-axis budget problem over memory, throughput, and integration cost. It runs controlled ablations on layer-wise pruning, weight quantization, KV-cache sparsification, and INT8 KV quantization to identify compatibility and coupling effects, then assembles a practical compression pipeline from those findings. Key observations include pruning improving quantization robustness, KV sparsification complementing INT8 KV quantization, and static vector quantizers conflicting with dynamic caching.
summary_en.experiments: On a single NVIDIA A40, the pipeline compresses a 70B model to about 33GB, sustains roughly 57 tokens/s on 10k-token prompts, and keeps absolute accuracy loss within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. The abstract does not specify the exact base model or full benchmark suite, but the setup is clearly deployment-oriented.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Lenovo Research and the University of Washington. This is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding how serving constraints can feed back into model and system design.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但耦合效应做得比常见压缩文干净；只看 ablation 和设计规则，能少走不少部署弯路。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the coupling study is cleaner than most compression work; read the ablations and design rules, skip the rest.

paper.title: PowerSlider: Exploiting Phase Asymmetry for LLM Serving under Demand Response
paper.abstract: AI inference clusters are increasingly constrained by instantaneous power, not just energy: grid operators condition new capacity on demand response, imposing time-varying power caps. Existing LLM serving systems optimize a static energy objective or shed fixed priority tiers under load; either way, goodput collapses when the power envelope moves. An LLM pipeline is not a uniform load: compute-bound prefill loses throughput almost linearly with GPU frequency, memory-bound answer decode sustains

summary.core_problem: 解决电网 demand response 导致推理集群瞬时功率上限动态变化时，LLM serving 吞吐和 SLO 容易塌陷的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统方向，但对基座研究员也有价值，因为它把 prefill、thinking、decode 三阶段的算力/带宽/KV 占用差异显式建模，说明同一个 LLM 请求在不同阶段对功率约束的敏感性并不一样。贡献类型主要是系统创新与资源分配建模。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PowerSlider。核心有三点：一是 Flex SLO，把用户可接受的有限延迟松弛转成优化约束；二是把请求拆成 prefill、think、answer 三阶段，分别暴露频率控制和 KV-cache 控制接口；三是用 KKT 在线求解器在功率 cap 变化时快速重算调度与频率分配。论文的关键观察是 prefill 更 compute-bound，吞吐随 GPU 频率近线性下降；decode 更 memory-bound，在降到 0.57× 额定频率前吞吐损失较小；reasoning 阶段还与 KV 容量和调度耦合。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是在线求解延迟约 7.7ms，可在每次功率上限变化后快速重配置。实验重点应是动态 power cap 下的 goodput、SLO 满足率和与静态节能/固定优先级 shedding 策略的对比。未见模型规模与具体 baseline 细节，但从问题设定看，价值主要在阶段异构负载建模而非模型本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Rodrigo Fonseca、Udit Gupta，偏系统与基础设施研究背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to keep LLM serving stable when inference clusters face time-varying instantaneous power caps from demand-response constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving paper, but it matters to foundation-model researchers because it makes the phase asymmetry of LLM inference explicit: prefill, thinking, and decode respond very differently to power throttling. The contribution is mainly a systems/resource-allocation innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: PowerSlider combines three ideas: a Flex SLO contract that converts bounded user slack into optimization constraints; prefill/think/answer disaggregation with per-stage frequency and KV-cache control; and an online KKT-based solver that re-optimizes after each cap change. The key empirical observation is that prefill is compute-bound and degrades almost linearly with GPU frequency, while decode is memory-bound and retains throughput down to about 0.57× nominal frequency; reasoning also couples KV capacity with scheduling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 7.7 ms online re-solve latency after each power-cap change. The likely main evaluations are goodput and SLO retention under dynamic caps versus static energy optimization or fixed-priority shedding. Model size and exact baselines are not visible from the abstract; the main value is the clean phase-level characterization rather than model-scale claims.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Rodrigo Fonseca and Udit Gupta, both associated with systems and infrastructure research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把 prefill/decode 的功率敏感性差异量化得很干净；只看阶段拆分和频率曲线，就足够指导你理解 serving 约束会怎样反向塑造模型设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the phase-level power asymmetry is measured cleanly; read the prefill/decode breakdown and frequency curves to see how serving constraints can feed back into model design.

paper.title: CateKV: On Sequential Consistency for Long-Context LLM Inference Acceleration
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in handling long-context tasks, but processing such long contexts remains challenging due to the substantial memory requirements and inference latency. In this work, we discover that certain attention heads exhibit sequential consistency in their attention patterns, which can be persistently identified using a coefficient-of-variation-based algorithm. Inspired by this observation, we propose CateKV, a hybrid KV cache method that

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 占用过大、延迟过高的问题，同时尽量不损失模型精度。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向里比较像“有新观察再做方法”的工作。价值不只在压 cache，而在于提出 attention head 的 sequential consistency 这一可利用结构，对长上下文 serving 和架构分析都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先观察到部分注意力头在序列上的注意模式具有稳定的一致性，并用基于变异系数的算法持续识别这类 consistent heads。随后提出 CateKV：对 consistent heads 只保留关键 token 的 KV，以压缩缓存；对 adaptive heads 仍保留大部分 KV，避免精度损失。方法是 hybrid KV cache，可与其他加速方法叠加。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文 benchmark 上评测，目标是在接近 full attention 精度下提升效率。摘要报告最高可减少 2.72× 内存占用，并带来解码加速；但未在摘要中给出具体模型族、上下文长度、与 SnapKV/H2O/StreamingLLM 类基线的逐项对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者中有 Junyang Lin，来自通义千问核心团队；这类工作通常更接近真实长上下文部署约束，而不只是离线算法对比。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the large KV-cache footprint and latency of long-context LLM inference while trying to preserve full-attention accuracy.
summary_en.importance: This is a stronger efficiency paper because it starts from a structural observation rather than a pure heuristic. The notion of sequential consistency in attention heads may also be useful beyond cache compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper identifies attention heads whose attention patterns exhibit sequential consistency, using a coefficient-of-variation-based procedure to detect them persistently. CateKV then applies a hybrid cache policy: keep only critical-token KV pairs for consistent heads, while retaining most KV pairs for adaptive heads to avoid quality loss. The method is designed to compose with existing acceleration techniques.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on long-context benchmarks with the goal of matching full-attention accuracy at lower cost. The abstract reports up to 2.72× memory reduction and decoding speedup, though it does not specify model families, context lengths, or detailed comparisons against prior KV-cache baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Junyang Lin is among the authors and is closely associated with the Qwen core team; this usually signals a setup informed by real long-context deployment constraints.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“哪些头可被长期压缩”这个观察，不只是又一个 KV trick；先读 head 分型和与现有方法可叠加那部分。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the head-level structural observation, not just another KV trick; read the head taxonomy and the composability section first.

paper.title: A Universal Context-Reuse Layer for Cross-Model KV Sharing
paper.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) serving systems increasingly operate over repeated or shared context, yet each model typically performs its own prefill computation even when another model has already processed the same input. Existing KV-cache reuse mechanisms substantially reduce redundant computation within a single model, but generally assume that the producer and consumer of a cache are identical. We study \emph{cross-model KV sharing}, which translates the KV state produced by a source mo

summary.core_problem: 解决多模型服务中重复上下文 prefill 不能跨模型复用的问题：一个模型算出的 KV cache 通常不能被另一个模型直接消费。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统和表示对齐交界处的系统创新。它把 KV cache 从单模型内部缓存扩展为可翻译的跨模型上下文状态，对多模型路由、大小模型协作、级联推理和 shared-context serving 都有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 universal context-reuse layer，将 source model 产生的 KV state 翻译成 target model 可用的 KV 表示。论文声称覆盖不同规模、架构、attention 配置、tokenizer 和模型家族的情况，并在同族和跨族设置中评估。核心不是重新 prefill 目标模型，而是学习或构造 KV 状态变换来降低 handoff 成本。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 到 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的设置中，翻译后的 KV state 使 LongBench2 accuracy 从原生 1.5B baseline 的 27.59% 提升到 34.48%，增加 6.89 个百分点，同时相对目标模型原生 prefill 降低 handoff 成本。摘要还提到评估了 within-family 和 cross-family 设置，但未列出更多数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fact that KV caches computed by one model are normally unusable by another model, forcing repeated prefill over shared contexts.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-system idea with a representation-alignment angle. It generalizes KV reuse from within-model caching to cross-model context transfer, which matters for model cascades, routing, small-large model collaboration, and shared-context serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces a universal context-reuse layer that translates KV states produced by a source model into KV states consumable by a target model. The claimed scope includes differences in scale, architecture, attention layout, tokenizer, and model family, evaluated in both within-family and cross-family settings.
summary_en.experiments: For Qwen2.5-7B to Qwen2.5-1.5B, translated KV states improve LongBench2 accuracy from the native 1.5B baseline of 27.59% to 34.48%, a 6.89-point gain, while reducing handoff cost relative to native target-model prefill. The abstract also reports evaluation beyond this pair but does not provide additional numbers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法细节；若 KV 可跨 tokenizer/架构翻译，大小模型协作的 serving prior 要更新。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the method; if KV translation survives tokenizer and architecture mismatch, the serving prior for model cascades changes.

paper.title: SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck of long-context large language model (LLM) inference, growing linearly with context length. We show that uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid does not degrade gracefully: under a prespecified multi-seed statistical protocol, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with an affine quantizer is statistically indistinguishable from FP16 KV down to 2.322 code bits/value and collapses at 2.0 bits - a quality cliff in (2.0, 2.322] that reappears in g

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 随上下文线性增长，成为显存瓶颈；论文研究低比特 KV 量化何时会发生质量崩塌，以及如何利用这一现象做混合精度分配。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与量化分析。它不是只给一个新量化器，而是用多 seed 统计协议指出 KV 量化存在质量悬崖，并据此重新解释 importance-aware mixed precision 的收益来源。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先在 fractional-bit grid 上系统扫描 uniform KV quantization，发现 affine quantizer 在 2.322 code bits/value 之前与 FP16 统计不可区分，但到 2.0 bits 崩塌。SemKV 保留所有 token，用模型内部语义/重要性分数给 token 排序，然后只在质量悬崖以上的两个相邻精度之间分配，实现 uniform quantization 无法表达的平均比特率。
summary.experiments: 主要实验包括 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，并验证 generation-time quantization、多轮对话，以及向 Mistral-7B 的迁移。摘要报告在 affine quantizer 下 2.322 bits/value 仍与 FP16 统计不可区分，2.0 bits 崩塌；SemKV 达到实测 6.0x KV 存储减少。摘要未完整列出所有任务、baseline 名称和逐项指标。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with context length and dominates memory in long-context LLM inference; the paper studies where low-bit KV quantization collapses and how to exploit that boundary for mixed precision.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-systems and quantization analysis. Rather than only proposing a quantizer, it identifies a statistically measured quality cliff and uses it to reinterpret the benefit of importance-aware mixed precision.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first scans uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid and finds that an affine quantizer remains statistically indistinguishable from FP16 down to 2.322 code bits per value, but collapses at 2.0 bits. SemKV keeps every token, ranks tokens with model-internal semantic or importance scores, and assigns two adjacent above-cliff precisions to realize average bit rates unavailable to uniform quantization.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments center on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, with checks for generation-time quantization, multi-turn dialogue, and transfer to Mistral-7B. The abstract reports no statistically significant degradation versus FP16 at 2.322 bits/value and collapse at 2.0 bits, while SemKV achieves a measured 6.0x storage reduction. Full task coverage, baselines, and per-metric numbers are not available in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 读质量悬崖的统计协议和 mixed precision 解释即可；方法本身像工程拼接，但现象值得复测。
recommendation.en: Read the quality-cliff protocol and the mixed-precision interpretation; the method is engineering-heavy, but the cliff is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Strong Drafts Need Compact Memories: Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Compressed KV Cache
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM applications such as document summarization and multi-turn agents require generation from prefixes spanning tens of thousands of tokens, making decoding latency a major bottleneck. Speculative decoding (SD) reduces latency without changing model outputs, but its speedup depends on both accepted draft tokens and draft-step latency: Lightweight drafts are fast but lack the capacity to capture long-range dependencies, whereas strong independent drafts recover acceptance but incur g

summary.core_problem: 长上下文生成时，speculative decoding 的 draft 模型要么太弱导致接受率低，要么足够强但在长前缀下 KV 访问成本随上下文增长，抵消加速收益。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长上下文推理系统优化。它不改变目标模型输出，仍保留 speculative decoding 的 lossless 验证机制，但把问题从“draft 模型多小”转向“强 draft 如何拥有紧凑记忆”。这对长文档、长对话、agent 场景的 serving latency 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 memory-augmented drafting：给强独立 draft 配一个压缩的 draft-side KV memory。轻量 adaptor 构造并增量更新这份记忆，用压缩表示保留远距离信息，同时保留精确的近端上下文。target verifier 仍使用完整 KV cache，并执行标准 accept/reject，因此输出分布不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 Llama 3.1-8B 与 70B target 上测试，前缀长度最高到 32K。实验重点是长上下文下 draft 接受率、draft-step latency、整体 speculative decoding speedup 的权衡。具体提升幅度和消融细节需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context speculative decoding suffers from a draft-model tradeoff: small drafts are fast but miss long-range dependencies, while strong independent drafts recover acceptance rates but pay growing KV-access cost as prefixes become long.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution for long-context LLM serving. It preserves the lossless accept/reject guarantee of speculative decoding, but shifts the design axis from merely shrinking the draft model to giving a strong draft a compact memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces memory-augmented drafting. A lightweight adaptor builds and incrementally updates a compressed draft-side KV memory, keeping distant information in compressed form and recent context exactly. The target model keeps its full KV cache and runs the standard speculative verification rule.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments with Llama 3.1-8B and 70B target models at prefix lengths up to 32K. The key measurements are acceptance rate, draft-step latency, and end-to-end speculative decoding speedup under long prefixes; exact gains require reading the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和长前缀消融即可；真正有用的是把 draft 侧 KV 压缩，而不是再堆一个更小 draft。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and long-prefix ablations; the useful idea is compressing draft-side KV memory rather than chasing yet another tiny draft.

paper.title: A Probabilistic Interpretation of KV Cache Eviction
paper.abstract: The premise and promise of KV (cache) eviction is simple: higher throughput can be achieved by evicting some entries from the KV cache, at a negligible cost to quality. This holds empirically for many existing methods, though most rely on creative heuristics for selecting which entries to drop. Despite recent advances, the problem of KV eviction has remained informal in the literature. This paper aims to properly formalize this problem through the lens of probabilistic reasoning and reveal what

summary.core_problem: 给 KV cache eviction 一个严格的概率学定义，解释为什么现有方法常靠启发式却仍能工作，以及如何在丢弃缓存后做解码校正。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在又提一个 eviction heuristic，而在于把问题形式化：先证明最优驱逐是计算困难的，再把它转成期望估计问题。对长上下文推理、cache 压缩和训练时 attention 近似都有方法论启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从概率推断视角定义 KV 驱逐，证明最优选择是困难问题；随后把驱逐后的近似误差写成期望估计，可用采样近似。基于这一解释，论文进一步提出对已驱逐条目在 decoding 时进行校正的思路，并用该框架重新理解现有方法为何有效、何时失效。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验应围绕多种现有 KV eviction 方法进行理论与经验对照，重点比较吞吐提升、质量损失，以及加入校正项后的恢复效果。相较纯经验启发式，这里的主要增量是 formalism 和 correction 机制，而不是单点 benchmark 刷分。
summary.authors_note: University of California；Aditya Grover、Guy Van den Broeck 都是较知名的机器学习研究者，前者在生成模型与表示学习，后者在概率推断与神经符号方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper gives KV-cache eviction a principled probabilistic formulation, explaining why heuristic methods often work and how to correct decoding after cache entries are dropped.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not another eviction heuristic but a cleaner problem statement: optimal eviction is shown to be computationally hard, and the approximation error is reframed as an expectation-estimation problem. That is useful for long-context inference, cache compression, and even training-time attention approximations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize KV eviction through probabilistic reasoning, prove hardness of the exact problem, and then reduce the approximation induced by eviction to expectation estimation that can be approximated by sampling. This view also enables a decoding-time correction for evicted entries and provides a lens to reinterpret existing methods.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the empirical section likely compares several existing KV-eviction methods in terms of throughput, quality degradation, and the benefit of the proposed correction. The main contribution is the formalism and correction mechanism rather than leaderboard gains.
summary_en.authors_note: University of California; Aditya Grover and Guy Van den Broeck are well-known ML researchers, with prior work in generative modeling/representation learning and probabilistic reasoning/neuro-symbolic methods, respectively.

recommendation.zh: 不是只会调启发式的那类 cache 论文；先看形式化和 correction 部分，若你在做长上下文或近似注意力，这篇会改变你定义误差的方式。
recommendation.en: This is not another heuristic cache paper; read the formalization and correction sections first—if you work on long context or approximate attention, it changes how you should define the error.

paper.title: Affix Cache for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) enable non-autoregressive decoding and bidirectional context modeling, but efficient inference remains challenging. Unlike autoregressive systems, whose key-value (KV) cache can be reused for shared prefixes, DLLMs couple the KV states of shared context tokens with evolving generated tokens through bidirectional attention, making naive cache reuse stale while full recomputation is expensive. We present ACache, an affix-oriented cache reuse mechanism for sh

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的一个具体瓶颈：如何像 AR 模型那样复用缓存，但又不被双向注意力带来的 stale KV 问题拖垮。AR 模型的 prefix cache 之所以好用，是因为历史 token 的表示不会被未来生成 token 反向影响；而 DLLM 在每一步去噪时做全局双向注意力，连共享 prompt 或中间固定片段的 KV 都会随着待生成 token 的变化而变化。直接复用会掉质量，完全重算又太贵。ACache 的问题定义很清楚：在保证生成质量的前提下，只重算真正关键的 affix tokens，其余共享 span 的 cache 尽量复用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，对新型语言建模范式的落地影响更大。Diffusion LM 近两年开始从小模型和概念验证走向 billion-scale，但推理效率一直是它和 AR 竞争时最现实的短板之一。很多人讨论 DLLM 时只看并行解码潜力，忽略了每步全序列重算带来的系统成本。ACache 的价值在于把这个问题拆细：不是“能不能缓存”，而是“哪些 token 的缓存必须更新”。如果这个思路成立，说明 DLLM 的系统优化空间并不只在 schedule、步数压缩或 speculative denoising，也在更细粒度的上下文状态管理。对做建模的人，这会反过来影响训练时是否要鼓励更局部、可缓存的依赖结构。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是 affix-oriented cache reuse。作者不把共享上下文限制为 prefix，而是推广到任意共享连续片段 affix，可以在开头、中间或结尾。这个设定利用了 DLLM 的双向注意力特性：既然模型天然能看两边，上下文复用也不必像 AR 那样只围绕左前缀设计。

难点在于，哪些 affix token 的 KV 会因为当前 masked generation tokens 的变化而显著失效。ACache 的答案是引入 Anchor Tokens。作者通过测量 masked generation tokens 到 affix tokens 的 cross-attention importance，找出对当前生成最敏感的一小部分 affix token，只对这些 token 重算 KV；其余 affix token 继续复用旧 cache。这样做等于把“整段共享上下文是否需要刷新”变成“少量关键位置是否需要刷新”。

从系统实现看，ACache 建在 Fast-dLLM 之上，用 selective Anchor recomputation 替代 periodic full-cache recomputation。也就是说，它不是完全推翻现有 DLLM cache 框架，而是在已有近似缓存策略上进一步细化重算粒度。作者还在 Nano-vLLM 上做了 shared-prefix 原型，验证在更接近真实 serving 的 paged memory management 和 continuous batching 场景下，选择性重算仍然有收益。

和已有方法相比，差异点比较明确。dLLM-Cache 更偏向不对称更新 prompt / response，并用特征相似度决定部分 response token 是否重算；dKV-Cache 更关注 decoded tokens 的块级延迟重算；Fast-dLLM 通过更高效的推理框架和周期性刷新降低成本。ACache 的新意在于把“共享上下文”本身作为优化对象，并且把重算单位从整段 cache 缩到 request-specific 的 token 子集。
summary.experiments:
从正文可见的关键结果有三层。第一，质量恢复：相对直接复用 affix cache 带来的明显精度下降，ACache 在多个 benchmark 上能把质量拉回，同时只需重算大约 20% 的 affix tokens。这个比例很关键，说明重要性分布是稀疏的，至少在作者测试的设置里，不需要大面积刷新共享上下文。第二，系统收益：在 Nano-vLLM 的 shared-prefix 原型中，ACache 将 recompute latency 最多降低 55.7%，端到端吞吐最高提升 1.68×。这说明收益不只存在于理论 FLOPs，而能穿透到带分页内存和连续批处理的实际推理栈。第三，适用范围：作者强调它适用于 shared spans beyond prefixes，这一点比单纯 prefix cache 更贴近实际多请求服务，因为模板、检索片段、工具返回文本、对话历史摘要都可能以中间片段形式复用。

从研究者角度，更值得注意的是消融逻辑而不是单个数字：Anchor Token 选择策略是否稳定、重算比例和质量之间的曲线是否平滑、不同 affix 位置是否影响收益、以及在不同 denoising steps 上 stale cache 的伤害是否累积。如果正文里有这些图，建议重点看，因为它们决定这个方法是“工程技巧”还是“可推广机制”。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你在跟 diffusion LM，可以比普通 skim 多花一点时间。先看 Background，把作者放在 D3PM、SEDD、MDLM、LLaDA、Dream 这条线上的定位弄清楚。然后直接看 Figure 1 和方法部分，理解为什么 DLLM 的 cache stale 问题和 AR 完全不同。接着看 Anchor Token 的定义与选择方式，这是整篇最核心的机制。实验部分优先看三类图表：质量-重算比例曲线、不同 affix 位置的结果、以及 Nano-vLLM 原型下的 latency / throughput 数据。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主要内容。若要深挖，建议思考两个问题：一是 Anchor 重要性是否能在训练时被显式建模；二是这种稀疏重算是否能和更少 denoising steps、speculative decoding 或 hybrid AR+diffusion 框架结合。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a concrete inference bottleneck in diffusion LLMs: how to reuse cache without suffering from stale KV states under bidirectional attention. In autoregressive models, prefix caching works because past token states do not depend on future generated tokens. In DLLMs, each denoising step uses full bidirectional attention, so even the KV states of shared prompt or context tokens become coupled to the evolving masked response. Naive reuse hurts quality, while full recomputation is expensive. ACache asks a narrower and more useful question: can we recompute only the truly critical shared tokens and reuse the rest?
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is limited, but its importance for alternative language-modeling paradigms is real. Diffusion LMs are becoming more credible at scale, yet inference efficiency remains one of their main practical weaknesses relative to AR models. Much of the discussion around DLLMs focuses on parallel decoding, but that misses the cost of repeated full-sequence recomputation. ACache is useful because it reframes the systems problem from “can DLLMs cache at all?” to “which shared tokens actually need refreshing?” If that framing holds, it suggests that DLLM efficiency is not only about reducing denoising steps or improving schedules, but also about finer-grained state management. That can eventually feed back into model design and training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is affix-oriented cache reuse. Instead of restricting reuse to shared prefixes, the paper generalizes it to any shared contiguous span, or affix, which may appear at the beginning, middle, or end of the context. This is a natural systems opportunity created by bidirectional attention: unlike AR models, DLLMs are not inherently prefix-centric.

The key challenge is deciding which affix-token KV states become meaningfully stale as the masked generation tokens evolve. ACache introduces Anchor Tokens for this purpose. It measures the cross-attention importance from masked generation tokens to affix tokens, identifies a small request-specific subset of influential affix tokens, and recomputes KV states only for those anchors. The remaining affix-token cache is reused. In effect, the method turns a coarse full-span refresh decision into a sparse token-level refresh decision.

Implementation-wise, ACache is built on top of Fast-dLLM. It replaces periodic full-cache recomputation with selective anchor-token recomputation, so it is an incremental but targeted improvement over existing approximate caching frameworks rather than a completely new inference stack. The authors also implement a shared-prefix prototype in Nano-vLLM to test whether the gains survive under a more realistic serving environment with paged memory management and continuous batching.

Relative to prior work, the distinction is clear. dLLM-Cache uses asymmetric prompt/response refresh and feature-similarity-based partial recomputation for response tokens. dKV-Cache focuses more on decoded-token reuse with delayed block recomputation. Fast-dLLM improves the overall inference framework but still relies on periodic refresh. ACache is novel in treating shared context itself as the optimization target and shrinking the recomputation unit from an entire shared span to a request-specific token subset.
summary_en.experiments:
The main results operate at three levels. First, quality recovery: compared with direct affix-cache reuse, which causes noticeable degradation, ACache recovers most of the lost accuracy across multiple benchmarks while recomputing only around 20% of affix tokens. That number matters because it suggests the stale-cache problem is sparse enough to be exploitable. Second, system gains: in the Nano-vLLM shared-prefix prototype, ACache reduces recomputation latency by up to 55.7% and improves end-to-end throughput by up to 1.68x. This indicates that the benefit is not just a FLOP-level argument but can survive a realistic serving stack. Third, scope: the method applies to shared spans beyond prefixes, which is practically relevant because reusable text in production often appears as retrieved snippets, tool outputs, templates, or summarized dialogue history rather than only as a left prefix.

For a researcher, the most informative part is likely the ablation structure rather than any single headline number: how stable the anchor-selection rule is, how quality changes as the recomputation ratio varies, whether affix position matters, and how stale-cache error accumulates across denoising steps. If the paper includes those plots, they are the ones worth studying closely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Although marked as skim, this deserves a bit more attention if you follow diffusion LMs. Start with the background to place the work in the D3PM/SEDD/MDLM/LLaDA/Dream line. Then go straight to Figure 1 and the method section to understand why DLLM cache staleness is fundamentally different from AR caching. After that, focus on the definition and selection of Anchor Tokens; that is the core mechanism. In experiments, prioritize three things: quality-versus-recompute curves, results by affix position, and the Nano-vLLM latency/throughput measurements. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. Two deeper follow-up questions are especially interesting: whether anchor importance can be modeled during training, and whether sparse recomputation can be combined with fewer denoising steps, speculative decoding, or hybrid AR-diffusion systems.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 真正落地卡在“缓存不可复用”，这篇给了一个可操作的近似：只重算影响最大的 20% affix；重点看 Anchor 选择准不准、以及真实吞吐提升。
recommendation.en: Diffusion LMs often fail in practice due to non-reusable caches; this offers an actionable approximation—recompute only the most influential ~20% affix tokens. Check how anchors are selected and whether throughput gains hold in real serving.

paper.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is bottlenecked by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, especially for small models under tight resource budgets. Existing KV cache eviction methods score tokens using the model's attention distribution or, in attention-free variants, each key's distance from a global reference point. Using a controlled leave-one-out probe, we find that attention magnitude is unrelated to a token's causal contribution to the answer (Spearman $\rho=-0.004$), challenging the pre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个老问题：KV cache 太大，必须做 eviction，但现有方法大多默认“被高注意力看到的 token 更重要”，或者用“离全局 key 均值更远”来近似重要性。论文先用 leave-one-out 因果探针直接检验这个前提，发现 attention magnitude 与 token 对最终答案的真实边际贡献几乎不相关，在其长文问答设定上 Spearman ρ = -0.004，p = 0.96。也就是说，很多 eviction 方法依赖的打分信号并不对应真正的因果必要性。作者因此把问题改写为：在固定预算下，怎样识别“删掉后还能被上下文中其他位置恢复”的冗余 token，并用这个结构性信号修补已有 eviction 决策。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于提出了一个全新的压缩器，而在于它给 KV eviction 研究补了一块很关键的诊断：attention 不是可靠的因果重要性代理。这个结论对推理优化和训练后分析都有价值。前者体现在，很多 cache 压缩方法可能是在利用 attention 的经验相关性，而不是抓住真正的信息保留条件；后者体现在，它提示我们在分析 transformer 内部记忆时，要区分“被访问”与“不可替代”这两件事。TwinKV 本身是 training-free、attention-free、可组合的 repair pass，不要求替换现有系统，只需在已有策略选完保留集合后做一次交换修补。这种设计很工程化，适合直接插到现有 serving 栈里。论文的贡献量级偏中等：不是范式变化，但对小模型、边缘设备、严格显存预算场景有现实价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很简单，但抓得比较准。作者把 token 的重要性定义成“唯一性”的反面：如果某个 token 的 key 在上下文其他非相邻位置存在近重复，那么删掉它后，模型仍可能通过保留下来的近重复项恢复这部分信息；如果没有重复，它更可能是不可替代的。具体做法是：对每个 token 的 key，统计有多少其他非相邻 token 与它的 key cosine similarity 超过阈值，这个 twin count 越高，说明冗余越强，重要性越低。这里有两个设计点值得注意。第一，使用 key 而不是 value 或 hidden state，是因为 eviction 决策发生在 attention 检索层面，key 更直接反映“可被匹配到的记忆地址”；第二，排除相邻 token，是为了避免把局部连续文本的平凡相似性误判成真正的语义冗余。

更有意思的是它不是 standalone policy，而是 repair pass。给定任意已有 eviction 方法输出的 retained set 和 evicted set，TwinKV 检查两类错误：一类是某个被删 token 在 retained set 中没有近重复，属于 unrecoverable eviction；另一类是某个被留 token 在 retained set 内有冗余副本，属于 wasted retention。然后在不改变总预算的前提下做 swap：把前者换回，把后者换出。这样做的好处是，它不需要知道被包装方法内部如何打分，也不需要重新排序全体 token，只利用最终保留结果做局部修正。论文还专门把这种 pairwise redundancy 与 anchor-based 方法区分开：后者用单一全局参考点衡量“离群程度”，更像异常检测；TwinKV 判断的是“是否有替身”，是局部关系而不是全局几何位置，因此两者的归纳偏置不同。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕两个问题展开。第一，attention 是否真能反映因果贡献。作者在真实长上下文 QA 上做 chunk-level leave-one-out：移除一个上下文块，看正确答案 log-prob 降多少，把这个边际损失与原始前向中的 attention 质量做相关性比较。结果几乎零相关，直接动摇了 attention-based eviction 的核心假设。

第二，TwinKV 作为 repair pass 是否能稳定改进现有方法。作者在 Qwen3-4B 上，把 TwinKV 叠加到四种近期 eviction 策略上：StreamingLLM、PyramidKV、SnapKV、ExpectedAttention；评测覆盖 LongBench、LooGLE、RULER，以及一个短上下文控制集 MMLU-Pro；压缩率测试 {0.3, 0.5, 0.7}。结果不是“全面提升”，而是很有条件性：对 StreamingLLM，最多 64% 的评测单元得到改善；对 PyramidKV 是 57%；对 SnapKV 是 41%；对 ExpectedAttention 只有 16%。作者把 ExpectedAttention 改进有限解释为其本身已接近若干 benchmark 的上限，repair pass 更容易打扰好决策而不是修正坏决策。另一个稳定现象是，TwinKV 在更紧的预算下更有帮助，在最宽松压缩率时平均增益最小。这和论文的因果叙事一致：预算越紧，每一次误删越致命，结构性“唯一性”信号的价值越高。

从全文表述看，这篇论文更强调 win-rate 和配置覆盖面，而不是单个 benchmark 上的大幅绝对分数提升。它的卖点是低侵入、零训练、对多种基线可组合，而不是在某一条曲线上把最优点抬得很高。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。关键不是 TwinKV 的公式，而是作者先做了一个很直接的因果检验，把 attention-as-importance 这个常见前提拆掉。这个诊断比方法本身更值得记住。

然后看 Section 2 的 leave-one-out probe 设计，确认它的因果贡献定义、chunk 粒度、相关性统计方式。这里决定了论文论证是否站得住。

Section 3 看 repair pass 机制，重点理解为什么它做 swap 而不是重新打分全局排序，以及 pairwise redundancy 与 centroid distance 的区别。若只想掌握方法，读到这里基本够了。

实验部分建议重点看：1）不同 baseline 上的 win-rate 分布；2）不同压缩率下的变化；3）短上下文控制集 MMLU-Pro 的结果，用来判断 TwinKV 是否只是在长上下文里修补记忆冗余，而不是普遍提升模型能力。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。若要深挖，可以继续看阈值选择、非相邻约束、不同层或不同头的敏感性分析；这些细节决定它能否迁移到别的模型和 serving 实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies KV-cache eviction under long-context inference, where memory grows linearly with sequence length and quickly becomes the dominant bottleneck, especially for small models under tight deployment budgets. The key claim is diagnostic before it is algorithmic: most prior eviction methods assume that attention mass is a useful proxy for token importance, or use distance from a global key centroid as a surrogate. The authors test this premise with a leave-one-out causal probe and find that attention received by a context chunk is essentially uncorrelated with its true marginal contribution to the correct answer on long-context QA (Spearman rho = -0.004, p = 0.96). The problem is then reframed as identifying tokens whose information would survive eviction because a near-equivalent copy remains elsewhere in context.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not that it introduces a new end-to-end compressor, but that it challenges a widely used scoring assumption in KV eviction: being attended to is not the same as being causally necessary. That matters for inference research, because many cache-compression heuristics may be exploiting weak empirical regularities rather than preserving irreplaceable information. It also matters for mechanistic analysis of transformer memory, since the paper separates access frequency from recoverability. TwinKV itself is lightweight: training-free, attention-free, and composable as a repair pass on top of existing policies. This makes it practical for serving systems. The contribution is moderate in scope but concrete, with the clearest relevance in memory-constrained long-context deployment rather than in core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TwinKV defines importance through pairwise redundancy in key space. For each token, it counts how many non-adjacent tokens have a key vector with cosine similarity above a fixed threshold. A high twin count means the token is redundant; a low count means it is likely unique and harder to recover if evicted. Two design choices matter. First, the method operates on keys rather than values or hidden states, because eviction affects what can later be retrieved through attention, and keys are the retrieval addresses. Second, it excludes adjacent tokens to avoid trivial local similarity from contiguous text.

The more interesting systems idea is to use TwinKV as a repair pass rather than a standalone eviction policy. Given any existing method’s retained and evicted sets under a fixed budget, TwinKV looks for two types of mismatch: an evicted token with no surviving near-duplicate, and a retained token whose information is already duplicated among retained tokens. It then swaps them while keeping the budget unchanged. This is a low-intrusion design: it does not need the wrapped method’s internal scores, only its final keep set. The paper also distinguishes this from anchor-based approaches that score keys by distance from a single global reference point. Those methods measure outlierness relative to a centroid; TwinKV measures substitutability through local pairwise relations. That is a different inductive bias.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments answer two questions. First, does attention track causal utility? Using chunk-level leave-one-out on real long-context QA, the authors measure how much removing a chunk hurts the log-probability of the correct answer and compare that with the chunk’s attention mass in the original forward pass. The correlation is effectively zero, which directly weakens the premise behind attention-based eviction.

Second, does TwinKV improve existing policies as a post-hoc repair? On Qwen3-4B, the method is composed with four recent eviction baselines: StreamingLLM, PyramidKV, SnapKV, and ExpectedAttention. Evaluation covers LongBench, LooGLE, RULER, and a short-context MMLU-Pro control set, at compression ratios 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7. The gains are conditional rather than universal: TwinKV improves a majority of evaluated cells for StreamingLLM (up to 64% of cells) and PyramidKV (57%), is closer to neutral for SnapKV (41%), and helps only a minority for ExpectedAttention (16%). The paper argues that ExpectedAttention is already near ceiling on several settings, leaving more room for harmful perturbation than for correction. Another consistent pattern is that TwinKV helps more under tighter budgets; at the loosest compression ratio, average gains are smallest. That fits the paper’s causal story: when every retained slot matters, preserving unique information becomes more valuable.

The empirical emphasis is on breadth of positive configurations and compatibility with multiple baselines, not on a single large absolute score jump on one benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figure 1. The most important takeaway is the causal probe against the attention-as-importance assumption; that diagnostic is more memorable than the repair rule itself.

Then read the leave-one-out setup in Section 2 carefully. The paper’s argument depends on how marginal utility is defined, at what chunk granularity, and how the correlation is computed.

Section 3 is the method core. Focus on why the authors choose a swap-based repair pass instead of rescoring all tokens globally, and why pairwise redundancy differs from centroid-distance scoring. If the goal is only to understand the method, this section is enough.

In the experiments, prioritize: the per-baseline win-rate pattern, the dependence on compression ratio, and the MMLU-Pro short-context control. Those results clarify that TwinKV is mainly a long-context memory repair mechanism rather than a general capability booster. A careful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. For deeper reading, inspect threshold sensitivity, the non-adjacency constraint, and any layer/head sensitivity analysis, since those details determine portability to other models and serving stacks.

recommendation.zh: 只看 leave-one-out probe 和 TwinKV swap 规则；attention 分数近似无因果信号这个数值得在内部长上下文压缩里复验。
recommendation.en: Read the leave-one-out probe and the TwinKV swap rule; the near-zero causal signal in attention scores is worth reproducing for internal long-context compression.

paper.title: RECAP-Forcing: Retaining Content Appearances for Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Long autoregressive video generation faces a fundamental memory challenge: with a finite attention window, a model must decide which information from an ever-expanding history to retain. Existing methods organize memory temporally, preserving recent frames while compressing or discarding older ones. We instead propose RECAP-Forcing, organizing memory by appearance novelty. A long video is not merely a sequence of frames, but an evolving cast of subjects, objects, and scenes whose identities must

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频自回归生成中有限 attention window 下，历史信息该如何保留才能维持长期内容一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于长序列生成的记忆组织与 KV-cache 策略创新。虽然对象是视频生成，不是 LLM，但“按新颖内容而非按时间保留记忆”这个设计对长上下文推理和多模态统一生成有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RECAP-Forcing，把记忆从时间索引改为外观新颖性索引：当新主体、场景或遮挡后重新出现的区域首次可见时，保留对应 KV cache；内存规模随新内容量而不是视频长度增长。方法统一了内容保留与长期一致性的机制设计。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据集，但核心比较对象应是按时间保留/压缩历史的长视频 AR 基线。论文声称三阶段完整记忆组织优于仅保留近期帧的方案，重点看长期身份一致性与内存增长曲线。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Zhuowen Tu。若属其团队，通常在视觉生成与结构建模上有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles how to retain historical information under a finite attention window in long autoregressive video generation while preserving long-range content consistency.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a memory-organization and KV-cache strategy for long-sequence generation. Although the target is video generation rather than LLMs, the idea of retaining memory by novelty instead of recency is transferable to long-context reasoning and unified multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: RECAP-Forcing reorganizes memory around appearance novelty rather than time. It keeps the KV cache when newly appearing subjects, scenes, or disoccluded regions first become visible, so memory scales with introduced content rather than raw video length.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size or datasets, but the key comparison is likely against temporally organized long-video AR baselines. The main signals to inspect are long-range identity consistency and memory-growth behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Zhuowen Tu; if this is from his group, it likely reflects ongoing work in visual generation and structured modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“novelty-over-recency”的 cache 策略值得借到长上下文；只看方法图和内存增长实验，别深读视觉细节。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the novelty-over-recency cache policy is worth stealing for long-context work; read the method figure and memory-growth plots, skip the vision-specific details.

paper.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models
paper.abstract: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论 latent chain-of-thought 模型里一个更偏机制的问题：当模型不再把中间推理写成显式文本，而是把推理压进连续隐状态或 latent rollout 时，真正承载“反事实推理结果”的 transformer 对象到底是什么。是当前 hidden state、key cache、value cache、某个单 token 槽位，还是更宽泛的整段缓存历史？现有分析往往只能说明 latent step 有因果作用，但分不清因果效应是由哪类内部对象携带。SCIT 要解决的就是这个识别问题：构造严格的 source-recipient 反事实配对，在 latent rollout 中替换声明好的 cache 片段，判断哪一类缓存对象足以把接收样本推向源样本定义的反事实答案。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接 recipe 贡献，但对新型语言建模范式，尤其 latent reasoning / latent CoT 的可解释性和可控性，有比较扎实的方法学价值。很多人讨论 latent CoT 时，容易把“latent step 有用”与“某个内部表示就是 reasoning carrier”混在一起。SCIT 的贡献是把这个问题拆开，给出一个带控制组的因果协议，要求同时做 sufficiency、necessity、K/V 分解、hidden-state 对照、语义源对照、decoded validation 和 matched corruption，避免把模糊的 patching 成功误判成机制结论。对做基座研究的人，这篇论文的启发在于：如果未来 latent reasoning 成为更常见的训练接口，cache-level object 而不是 token-level rationale 可能会成为新的分析单位。它的量级偏方法诊断，不是通用结论论文，因为作者自己也很克制，只对特定 checkpoint 做强机制声明。
summary.technical_approach:
SCIT，Suffix Cache Interchange Test，本质上是一个 cache-level counterfactual intervention protocol。给定 recipient 问题 r 和 source 问题 s，先构造一个精确可验证的反事实：source 提供某个中间变量的替代值，把它与 recipient 其余变量组合后，得到已知正确的 counterfactual answer。然后让 latent-CoT 模型分别在 r 和 s 上 rollout 到某个 latent step t，在这个 patch 点把 source 的某个缓存切片插入 recipient，对比 recipient 的答案是否朝 source 定义的反事实移动。

方法不是只做一次 patch，而是做一整套 intervention grid。维度包括：patch 哪个 cache segment；只换 K、只换 V、还是 K/V 一起换；是否同时复制当前 hidden state；是否使用语义相近但答案相同的 source control；是否做 decoded validation，确认被 patch 的 latent 轨迹确实对应可读出的反事实行为；以及 matched corruption，用同一区域做破坏性干预来测试 necessity。作者据此定义三个状态：active carrier，指最小且 gated 的 cache segment，在 oracle interchange 下足够，并且主要竞争解释无法匹配；carrier shift，指存在可转移效应，但活跃片段与主结论模型不同；no-call，指由于能力、支持度、decoded 行为或控制检查不过关，不能下机制判断。

从全文看，论文最重要的技术细节有三点。第一，它强调 exact source-recipient counterfactual，而不是开放式 prompt patching，这样可以避免目标答案不明确。第二，它把 sufficiency 和 necessity 分开，且 necessity 通过 matched corruption 而不是随意噪声注入来做，减少“哪里都能破坏”的伪结论。第三，它把 hidden state 与 cache object 明确区分：h_t 不是 cache 的一部分，只有显式复制时才算干预对象。这让“是当前状态在算，还是历史 value 轨迹在承载”这个问题可以被单独检验。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在受控算术环境中进行，因为这里可以精确构造反事实答案和负对照。核心结果是：在 CODI-GPT2 arithmetic checkpoint 上，反事实答案的转移主要由 value-cache suffix trajectory 承载，尤其是中后段 value 片段；这个区域不仅在 oracle interchange 下表现出最强 sufficiency，而且在 matched corruption 下也显示 necessity，因此作者愿意对这个 checkpoint 做“late-value-suffix mechanism” 的完整机制声明。相比之下，hidden-only、key-only、单 token trigger、same-answer semantic source、以及部分变量控制都明显更弱，不能解释同样的转移效果。

在 Sim-CoT-style GPT-2 reproduction 上，结果方向相似：也能看到 value suffix 的 sufficiency 和 decoded transfer，但 matched-corruption 的 necessity 证据不够强，因此作者只给出 sufficiency-level corroboration，不做完整 necessity 结论。这一点写得比较克制。

更大范围的 checkpoint 扫描显示，机制并不统一。部分 arithmetic-like GPT-2/1B 单元保留 latent-tail value/KV transfer；一些能力不错的 8B 或经过修复的非 arithmetic 单元则把 carrier 转移到 prompt-prefix 或 full-cache K/V。作者把这称为 carrier shift，而不是把 CODI-GPT2 的结论外推成普遍规律。也有一些 cell 因为 competence gating 或控制检查不过关，被标成 no-call。论文的实验价值就在这里：它不是证明“latent CoT 都靠 V cache suffix”，而是给出一个能区分局部机制、机制迁移和无法判定边界的测试框架。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先抓协议，再看结论。Introduction 已经把论文的边界说得很清楚：它不是在证明 latent CoT 普遍机制，而是在建立 carrier test contract。先看 Figure 1 和 Method 部分，理解四步流程：定义 patch object、设定 intervention grid、验证 readout、应用 carrier decision rule。

随后重点看作者如何构造 arithmetic counterfactual。这里决定了为什么它能做“精确 source-recipient 配对”，也决定了为什么开放域任务暂时不适合直接套这个协议。

实验部分优先看 CODI-GPT2 主结果，因为只有这里作者给出了完整 sufficiency + necessity 证据链。接着看 Sim-CoT-style checkpoint，理解为什么它只能算部分复现。最后看 carrier-regime map，注意作者如何区分 active carrier、carrier shift、no-call，这些标签背后都有 gating 条件，不是随手命名。

如果只想知道论文讲了什么，30 分钟左右足够。若要精读，建议把 appendix 里的 intervention table、prompt template、battery 细节一起看，因为这篇论文的可信度主要来自控制实验是否做得严。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanistic question about latent chain-of-thought models: when intermediate reasoning is moved from emitted text into continuous latent rollouts, which transformer object actually carries the counterfactual computation? Prior analyses often show that a latent step matters causally, but they do not identify whether the effect is carried by the current hidden state, key cache, value cache, a reusable answer slot, a single trigger token, or a broader cache trajectory. SCIT is designed to turn that ambiguity into a structured carrier-identification problem using exact source-recipient counterfactuals and cache-level interventions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining recipe paper, but it is relevant to emerging non-standard language modeling interfaces, especially latent reasoning and latent CoT. Its main contribution is methodological discipline. It separates the claim “latent computation matters” from the stronger claim “this specific internal object is the carrier of that computation.” For researchers working on latent reasoning as a training or inference interface, that distinction matters: if reasoning is no longer exposed as text, cache-level objects may become the right unit of analysis and control. The paper is careful about scope. It makes a strong mechanism claim only for a specific checkpoint and treats broader results as diagnostic regime mapping rather than universal law.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, is a cache-level counterfactual intervention protocol. For a recipient problem r and a source problem s, the method first constructs an exact, verifiable counterfactual: the source supplies a changed intermediate quantity, which is then combined with the recipient’s remaining variables to define a known counterfactual answer. Both source and recipient are rolled out to a latent step t. At that patch point, a selected cache slice from the source is transplanted into the recipient, optionally together with the current hidden state, and the test checks whether the recipient moves toward the source-defined counterfactual answer.

The protocol is deliberately grid-like rather than a single patch experiment. It varies: which cache segment is patched; whether only K, only V, or both are copied; whether the hidden state is also copied; whether semantic source controls with the same answer are used; whether decoded validation confirms that the patched latent trajectory corresponds to the intended counterfactual behavior; and whether matched corruption on the same region supports necessity. Based on this battery, the paper defines three outcomes: active carrier, carrier shift, and no-call.

Three technical choices are especially important. First, the paper uses exact source-recipient counterfactuals rather than open-ended prompt patching, which keeps the target answer unambiguous. Second, it separates sufficiency from necessity, and tests necessity with matched corruption rather than arbitrary noise, reducing the risk of overcalling mechanisms. Third, it explicitly distinguishes the current hidden state from the cache object: h_t is not part of the cache unless copied by intervention. That makes it possible to ask whether the computation is carried by the present state or by a historical value trajectory.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are centered on controlled arithmetic settings, chosen because they allow exact counterfactual labels and clean negative controls. The main result is checkpoint-specific but strong: on the CODI-GPT2 arithmetic checkpoint, counterfactual answer transfer occurs primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories, with the strongest restricted effect in middle-to-late value segments. This region is not only sufficient under oracle interchange, but also supported by matched-corruption necessity, which is why the authors make a full mechanism call for a late-value-suffix carrier. In contrast, hidden-only transfer, key-only transfer, single-token triggers, same-answer semantic source controls, and partial-variable controls are all much weaker and do not explain the same effect.

On a Sim-CoT-style GPT-2 reproduction, the pattern is directionally similar: value-suffix sufficiency and decoded transfer are present, but matched-corruption necessity is not strong enough for a full necessity claim. The paper is explicit about that limitation.

A broader checkpoint sweep shows that the mechanism is not uniform. Some arithmetic-like GPT-2/1B cells preserve latent-tail value/KV transfer, while several competent 8B or repaired non-arithmetic cells shift the carrier to prompt-prefix or full-cache K/V. The authors call this a carrier shift rather than a replication of the CODI-GPT2 mechanism. Some cells are labeled no-call because competence gating, decoded behavior, support, or source-control checks fail. This is one of the paper’s strengths: it does not argue that latent CoT universally lives in value-cache suffixes; it provides a framework that can separate local mechanism evidence, regime shifts, and cases where no mechanism claim is justified.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on the protocol before the results. The introduction already states the scope clearly: the goal is not to prove a universal latent-CoT mechanism, but to define a carrier-test contract. Start with Figure 1 and the method section to understand the four-step flow: define the patch object, specify the intervention grid, validate the readout, and apply the carrier decision rule.

Then read how the arithmetic counterfactuals are constructed. That part explains why the source-recipient pairing is exact and why the protocol is not yet directly portable to open-domain reasoning tasks.

In the experiments, prioritize the CODI-GPT2 main result, because that is the only place where the paper claims a full sufficiency-plus-necessity mechanism. Then read the Sim-CoT-style checkpoint to see why it is treated as partial corroboration rather than full replication. Finally, inspect the carrier-regime map and pay attention to the gating logic behind active carrier, carrier shift, and no-call.

A 30-minute read is enough to capture the main idea. For a deeper pass, the appendix matters: intervention tables, prompt templates, and the full evaluation battery are where the paper earns its credibility.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对 latent CoT“藏在哪”的直觉：先看 SCIT protocol 和 value-vs-hidden 对照，若你在做 latent reasoning，应立刻复现它的 patching 设计。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on where latent CoT actually lives: read the SCIT protocol and the value-vs-hidden controls, then replicate the patching setup if you work on latent reasoning.

paper.title: TOPAS: Workflow-Aware Prefix-State Scheduling for Multi-Agent LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Prefix caching introduces a fundamental tradeoff in multi-agent large language model (LLM) serving: retaining a long system-prompt key-value (KV) cache for an agent accelerates future calls, yet it reduces the GPU memory available for batching concurrent requests. In multi-stage workflows, existing schedulers tend to prioritize either immediate prefix locality or overall workflow progress. However, under a shared KV cache budget, optimizing either objective in isolation can prolong tasklevel job

summary.core_problem: 多 agent LLM serving 中，长 system prompt 的 prefix cache 能减少重复 prefill，但会挤占 GPU 显存、降低并发 batching；现有调度器通常只顾 prefix locality 或 workflow progress，导致任务级完成时间变差。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统侧的 clean 问题定义：把 prefix caching 从单请求优化提升到多阶段 workflow 的联合调度。对做 serving、长 prompt agent、KV 预算管理的人有直接参考，也能反向影响对 agent-friendly pretrain/interface 设计的理解。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 TOPAS（Task-Oriented Prefix-Aware Scheduler），在共享 KV cache 预算下联合决定两件事：哪些 agent prefix 保留在 cache 中，哪些请求先执行。其核心是对候选 post-decision state 打分，同时权衡任务剩余最长服务路径的缩短，以及下游 prefix 复用的近期收益，并显式考虑 prefix 搬移与替换成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体集群规模或基线名称，但实验目标是优化 task-level JCT，而不是单步吞吐。对比对象应是偏 prefix-locality 或偏 workflow-progress 的调度策略。若实验做得干净，关键看在固定 KV 预算下 JCT、cache hit、prefix replacement 次数三者的 trade-off 曲线。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学技术大学、合肥工业大学等，属于系统与调度方向的学术工作。
