实验结论很明确：RuleWorld 对现有强模型是困难的，尤其在大规则库和多步场景下。文中给出的关键数字包括：DynaRule 在多种规则注入设置下，平均 QA accuracy 最多提升 19 个点；在某些具体子任务上，提升可达 48 个点。检索指标上，在 10K rules 规模下，Recall@10 超过 90%，Recall@1 超过 85%，比最强基线高 60 多个点。这说明它不仅最终答案更好，前端规则定位本身也更稳。

更值得注意的是实验结构，而不只是 headline 数字。作者比较了 RAG 类方法、内部注入类方法以及自己的动态更新方案。结果显示，当规则是抽象模板、与问题表面词汇弱匹配时，文本检索很脆弱；而当任务进入 parallel aggregation 或 multi-hop state tracking 时，一次性注入会明显退化，因为不同步骤需要的规则集合在变化。消融里，confidence layer 的选择、<search> token 的引入、以及 step-level attention training 都是有效组件。若去掉动态重注意或不做分步训练，性能会明显下降。另一个重要观察是，随着规则库规模增大，基线方法退化更快，而 DynaRule 的退化更缓，说明它的优势主要来自“在大候选集里稳定缩小注意范围”，而不只是多加了一个外部 memory。

不过也要看到边界。文中最强结果主要建立在合成规则世界上，规则语义是可控的、形式化程度较高。它证明了方法在程序性知识调用上的可行性，但离真实企业 policy、复杂文档规章、跨文档冲突规则还有距离。另一个潜在问题是，规则编码器和 adapter 的质量会成为瓶颈；如果规则表达更长、更噪声、更依赖上下文，当前方案未必还能维持这么高的检索精度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 里对 benchmark 设计缺口的界定，再看 Figure 1 理解 RuleWorld 的任务结构，随后直接看方法图和训练流程。最值得看的部分有四处。第一，RuleWorld 的规则组织方式，以及为什么“共享规则库 + 抽象占位符 + 可组合结论”比传统 premise-given benchmark 更难。第二，confidence layer 的定义和选择依据，这关系到作者对“哪一层最适合做外部规则选择”的判断。第三，<search> token 如何触发 re-attention 与 KV replacement，这是方法真正的核心。第四，主结果表和检索结果表，要把 QA accuracy 和 Recall 指标一起看，才能分清是检索错了，还是检索对了但推理没用好。

如果时间有限，预计 20 到 30 分钟可以完成有效泛读：看引言、方法总览图、主表、关键消融。若要深挖，建议重点追问两个问题：一是 <search> 的监督信号如何构造，是否会引入 teacher forcing 式偏差；二是 KV replacement 的实现细节，是否存在覆盖掉仍然有用规则、导致长程依赖丢失的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap that most rule-reasoning evaluations avoid: whether an LLM can localize the right rules from a large shared repository and then apply them reliably across reasoning steps. Prior benchmarks usually attach the relevant rules directly to each instance, so the model mostly performs conditional reasoning over provided premises. That setup does not test reusable procedural knowledge. RuleWorld changes this by making rules abstract, entity-independent, and globally shared across examples. It also makes rule conclusions feed into later rules, so the model must handle both weak surface matching and step-dependent rule selection as intermediate states evolve.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about the task label and more about the interface it exposes between external memory and generation. The benchmark is a clean testbed for studying why standard RAG, static memory injection, and plain chain-of-thought break when the external knowledge is procedural rather than factual. This matters for pretraining-adjacent research because future systems will likely rely on external memory that must be queried during decoding, not only on parametric knowledge. DynaRule is interesting because it turns retrieval into an internal learned process: rules are injected into KV cache, and a special token triggers step-wise re-attention and memory refresh. That is relevant to test-time memory, retrieval-trigger tokens, and training schemes that teach models to call external knowledge incrementally. The benchmark contribution feels more durable than the method itself; the method shows a clear gain, but still reads more like a strong research prototype than a settled general recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There are two parts: the benchmark and the model. RuleWorld contains 4.94M rules spanning four major types and seven subtypes, with both first-order logic and natural-language forms. It defines Single-Rule QA, Parallel Multi-Rule QA, and Multi-Hop Rule QA, yielding 11 sub-tasks. The benchmark design matters for three reasons. First, rules are abstract templates with placeholders, so the model must ground them before use. Second, the rule repository is shared globally rather than attached per question. Third, rules are compositional, so earlier conclusions alter what becomes relevant later.

DynaRule injects encoded external rules directly into the LLM’s KV cache and makes re-retrieval part of decoding. Rules are first embedded by a pretrained sentence encoder, then mapped into the LLM space with a lightweight adapter, and finally exposed as external memory in the KV cache. Training has two stages. In stage one, the method identifies a confidence layer, defined as the layer where attention entropy over injected rules is minimized. The intuition is that this layer exhibits the sharpest and most decisive rule selection. In stage two, the model performs Stacked Step-Level Attention Training on that layer using a special <search> token. Emitting <search> triggers re-attention over the rule memory, selects a new subset of relevant rules, and replaces outdated entries in the KV cache.

This differs from standard RAG, where retrieval is front-loaded and retrieval errors propagate through the whole generation, and from static memory injection, where the model can get stuck with early-selected rules even when later reasoning steps require different ones. Mechanistically, <search> acts like an explicit latent action: it externalizes the decision that the model needs fresh procedural support, and supervision shapes the attention pattern associated with that action. That is more interesting than adding a separate retrieval head, because it is integrated into the token-level generation trajectory.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical message is clear: RuleWorld is hard for current strong models, especially with large rule sets and multi-step reasoning. The headline numbers reported in the paper are substantial. DynaRule improves average QA accuracy by up to 19 points across rule-injection settings, and by as much as 48 points on some sub-tasks. On retrieval, at 10K rules it achieves over 90% Recall@10 and over 85% Recall@1, beating the strongest baseline by more than 60 points.

The more important part is how the experiments are structured. The paper compares RAG-style baselines, internal injection baselines, and the proposed dynamic update mechanism. When rules are abstract and only weakly aligned with the query surface form, text retrieval becomes brittle. When tasks require parallel aggregation or multi-hop state tracking, one-shot injection degrades sharply because the relevant rule set changes across steps. Ablations show that the confidence-layer choice, the <search> token, and step-level attention training all matter. Removing dynamic re-attention or skipping step-wise supervision causes clear drops. Another useful observation is scaling behavior: as the rule repository grows, baseline performance degrades faster, while DynaRule degrades more gracefully. That suggests the gain comes from stable narrowing of attention over a large candidate set, not merely from adding extra memory.

There are also limits. The strongest results are obtained in a synthetic rule world with controlled semantics and relatively formal structure. This is enough to demonstrate feasibility for procedural knowledge use, but it is still some distance from real policy documents, noisy enterprise rules, or conflicting cross-document regulations. A second likely bottleneck is the rule encoder plus adapter. If rules become longer, noisier, or more context-dependent, the current setup may not preserve the same retrieval quality.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim pass, start with the introduction and Figure 1 to understand why the benchmark is harder than premise-given rule QA. Then jump to the method overview and the training pipeline. Four parts deserve attention. First, the benchmark construction: shared repository, abstract placeholders, and compositional rules are the real source of difficulty. Second, the definition of the confidence layer, because it reveals the authors’ view of where external rule selection should happen inside the network. Third, the exact role of the <search> token in re-attention and KV replacement; that is the core mechanism. Fourth, read the QA tables together with the retrieval tables, otherwise it is hard to separate retrieval failure from reasoning failure.

A useful skim should take around 20 to 30 minutes: introduction, method figure, main tables, and key ablations. If reading more carefully, two questions are worth tracking. How is supervision for <search> constructed, and does it introduce teacher-forcing bias? And how exactly is KV replacement implemented, especially when previously selected rules may still be useful later?

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 设定和 <search> 训练即可；若数字扎实，它是研究规则进 KV 状态的好 ablation 起点。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark setup and the <search>-based training; if the numbers hold, it is a useful ablation seed for rules-as-KV-state.

paper.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
paper.abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; r

summary.core_problem: 交互式世界模型在训练时面临控制（需要短上下文）和记忆（需要长上下文）的结构性冲突，导致难以在推理时同时实现实时响应和长期记忆。
summary.importance: 提出了一种解耦控制与记忆训练的范式，通过注意力窗口的混合与路由，在不增加参数和损失函数的情况下，解决了世界模型中长程记忆与实时控制的矛盾，对流式生成和长上下文建模有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 混合注意力窗口与随机路由：训练时，大部分注意力头使用局部短窗口（负责控制），少数头使用全局长窗口（负责记忆），并在每步随机切换全局头，使所有头都能适应两种窗口。2. 块丢弃训练与合并推理：训练时随机丢弃历史块，使模型适应稀疏历史；推理时采用固定大小的 KV Cache，包含最近窗口和基于位姿检索的“地标”库，实现无界生成的内存控制。3. 统一物理动作尺度：将合成、真实和游戏视频对齐到统一的物理动作尺度，并使用回文轨迹增强提供重访监督。4. LoRA 蒸馏：通过自强制展开的分布匹配蒸馏，在 LoRA 适配器中实现少步去噪，支持实时交互。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，ReWorld 在保持控制误差不变的情况下，显著提升了重访保真度。与直接注入动作信号相比，ReWorld 避免了记忆能力的下降。在推理时，固定 KV 预算下的地标检索机制有效维持了空间记忆。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Sec 2.2 的混合窗口与随机路由机制，以及 Sec 2.3 的块丢弃训练与地标合并推理。这部分展示了如何通过训练策略解决长短上下文的冲突。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Interactive world models face a structural tension during training between control (requiring short context) and memory (requiring long context), making it difficult to achieve both real-time response and long-term memory during inference.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a paradigm that decouples the training of control and memory. By mixing and routing attention windows, it resolves the conflict between long-term memory and real-time control in world models without adding parameters or loss functions, offering insights for streaming generation and long-context modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Mixed Attention Windows and Random Routing: During training, most attention heads use a local short window (for control), while a few use a global long window (for memory). The global heads are randomly switched at each step, allowing all heads to adapt to both windows. 2. Chunk-Drop Training and Consolidation Inference: Randomly drops historical chunks during training to adapt the model to sparse history. During inference, uses a fixed-size KV cache containing a recent window and a pose-retrieved 'landmark' bank, enabling memory control for unbounded generation. 3. Unified Physical Action Scale: Aligns synthetic, real, and game video to a unified physical action scale, and uses palindrome trajectory augmentation to provide revisit supervision. 4. LoRA Distillation: Achieves few-step denoising in a LoRA adapter via distribution-matching distillation with self-forcing rollouts, supporting real-time interaction.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that ReWorld significantly improves revisit fidelity while maintaining control error. Compared to direct action injection, ReWorld avoids the degradation of memory capability. During inference, the landmark retrieval mechanism under a fixed KV budget effectively maintains spatial memory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Sec 2.2 for the mixed window and random routing mechanism, and Sec 2.3 for chunk-drop training and landmark consolidation inference. These sections demonstrate how to resolve the conflict between long and short contexts through training strategies. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和消融：把长记忆做成位姿索引检索，而不是继续堆上下文，是可迁移的系统判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: pose-indexed retrieval instead of ever-longer context is the transferable systems idea.

paper.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation
paper.abstract: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是跨模型 latent guidance 在长文本生成中的“过期”问题。已有做法让大模型 mentor 对输入做一次编码，然后小模型 student 在整个解码过程中反复读取这份固定信号。短输出里这个假设通常还可以成立；长输出里，生成前缀不断改变当前决策所需的信息，prompt-only 的 mentor memory 会逐步偏离实际上下文，甚至让 student 低于不使用 guidance 的基线。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于，它把 latent guidance 的失败原因从“student 能力不足”里拆出来，单独识别为“guidance freshness”问题。对预训练和模型压缩研究有两个具体价值：第一，说明大模型到小模型的 latent transfer 不是一次性 prefill 就能覆盖长程生成，接口需要随生成状态更新；第二，它把 prefill-decode 分离扩展到跨模型服务场景，大模型承担低频更新，小模型承担高频解码，这对长文本低成本生成有实际参考意义。贡献更偏系统化方法和诊断，不是新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。先用训练无关的 OracleSwap 诊断 staleness：每隔固定 token 数，让 mentor 重新 prefill 输入加已生成前缀，重建并替换 memory；student 权重、已生成文本和 KV cache 都不变。这样能只改变 guidance 内容的新鲜度，避免把收益误归因到额外训练或解码重启。正式方法 MentorPulse 使用一个有容量上限、带位置信息的 slot memory 压缩 mentor states，student 通过 gated cross-attention 读取。refresh 时复用 mentor KV cache，只处理新增 token，然后替换 memory，不使 student 的历史 KV 失效。训练上引入 Windowed Refresh Training：对采样到的 memory 版本，只优化对应输出窗口，让 bridge 学会在不同 freshness 状态下读取信息。refresh interval R 控制质量和成本，R 趋于无穷时退化为 one-shot guidance。
summary.experiments: 诊断实验使用 Qwen3.5-27B mentor 和 Qwen3.5-4B student。Multi-IF 上，直接读 mentor states 的 probe 显示 staleness 很明显：A_stale 从 t=0 的 0.79 降到 t=512 的 0.47，而 A_fresh 维持在 0.76 到 0.80。行为层面，静态 guidance 在多轮指令跟随中使 4B student 的约束满足率比无 guidance 基线低 2.5 分；每 16 token 刷新一次 memory 后，变成比无 guidance 基线高 2.0 分。fresh 但不匹配的 memory 不带来收益，支持问题来自内容是否匹配当前前缀。正式评测覆盖 13 个数据集，主模型对上 MentorPulse 恢复了 mentor-student gap 的 52.2%，约为最强 prior alternative 的两倍。优势主要出现在长输出任务；短输出往往还没到第一次 refresh，收益有限。能力差距过大的 mentor-student pair 上收益会收窄，论文用 64-step read-distribution variance V64 作为部署前筛选信号。吞吐测量中，默认 R=16 在 R=8、16、32 里处于较好的质量-成本折中，并在长输出任务上相对文本 guidance 更有成本优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。优先看第 3 节的 staleness 诊断和 Figure 1、Figure 2，那里是论文最有信息量的部分：它证明固定 latent memory 在长生成中会从帮助变成干扰。随后看方法部分关于 versioned slot memory、incremental mentor prefill、Windowed Refresh Training 的设计，重点理解为什么 refresh memory 不需要重置 student KV cache。实验部分重点看长输出任务、不同 refresh interval 的质量-成本曲线，以及 V64 如何预测 pair 是否适合部署。附录里 probe 设置和 byte-level refresh accounting 值得快速检查，它们决定诊断是否站得住。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode of cross-model latent guidance for long-form generation. Prior methods encode the prompt once with a large frozen mentor and let a smaller frozen student read the resulting latent signal throughout decoding. That static signal can become stale as the generated prefix grows. In long outputs, the student’s next decision depends on the prompt plus its own generated history, while the mentor memory still describes only the initial prompt.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the clean separation between capability limits and guidance freshness. The work shows that latent transfer from a large model to a small model is not simply a one-shot prefill problem when generation is long. The interface must track the evolving prefix. This matters for model compression and serving: a large model can provide low-frequency latent updates, while a small model performs most decoding steps. The contribution is mainly a diagnostic and serving-oriented method rather than a new pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first uses a training-free intervention called OracleSwap. Every fixed number of generated tokens, the mentor re-prefills the prompt plus current generated prefix, rebuilds the memory, and swaps it in. The student weights, generated text, and student KV cache are left unchanged, so the intervention isolates the effect of memory freshness. MentorPulse then makes this practical. Mentor states are compressed into a capped, position-aware slot memory. The student reads this memory through a gated cross-attention bridge. Refreshing is versioned and incremental: the mentor reuses its KV cache and processes only newly generated tokens, then replaces the memory without invalidating the student’s decoding state. Windowed Refresh Training trains the bridge on output windows associated with sampled memory versions. The refresh interval R sets the quality-cost trade-off; one-shot guidance is recovered as R goes to infinity.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic pair is a Qwen3.5-27B mentor and a Qwen3.5-4B student. On Multi-IF, linear probes on mentor states show a large freshness gap: stale-state accuracy falls from 0.79 at t=0 to 0.47 at t=512, while fresh-state accuracy stays between 0.76 and 0.80. This drift also affects behavior. Static guidance reduces the 4B student’s constraint satisfaction by 2.5 points below the no-guidance baseline, while refreshing every 16 tokens turns it into a 2.0-point gain over that baseline. Fresh but mismatched memory does not help, which supports the content-freshness explanation. Across 13 datasets, MentorPulse closes 52.2% of the mentor-student gap on the main pair, roughly twice the recovery of the strongest prior alternative. Gains concentrate on long-output tasks. Short outputs often finish before refresh matters, and very large mentor-student capability gaps reduce the margin. The proposed V64 read-distribution indicator helps screen pairs before deployment. Throughput measurements place R=16 among the efficient settings tested against text-to-text guidance on long-output tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the staleness diagnosis in Section 3 and the first two figures; that is where the paper makes its strongest empirical point. Then read the method pieces on versioned slot memory, incremental mentor prefill, and Windowed Refresh Training, paying attention to why the student KV cache is not reset. In the experiments, focus on long-output tasks, refresh-interval trade-offs, and the V64 predictor. The appendices on probe construction and byte-level refresh accounting are worth checking if the deployment claim matters.

recommendation.zh: 这类 frozen mentor 引导常被默认可一次编码到底，这篇把“指导信号会过期”说清了；先看刷新频率消融和额外 mentor compute 账，若收益不只是算力换分，就值得在长输出蒸馏里复现。
recommendation.en: People often assume frozen mentor guidance can be encoded once and reused forever; this paper makes the staleness failure mode explicit. Read the refresh-frequency ablation and the extra mentor-compute accounting first—if gains are not just compute-for-quality, it is worth reproducing for long-output distillation.

paper.title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems split work across models, so answering often requires knowledge that sits in another agent's context: a Sharer has encoded information that a Receiver needs to complete its task. They usually communicate by exchanging text, which puts autoregressive decoding on the critical path and reduces the exchange to a discrete message written without sight of the receiver's state. Recent latent protocols instead translate the sharer's key-value (KV) cache into the receiver's: C2C s

summary.core_problem: 如何在多智能体系统中，实现异构大语言模型间高效、无损的隐空间（KV Cache）通信，打破现有方法对共享上下文和相同模型架构的限制？
summary.importance: 提出了一种新型的跨模型隐空间通信协议 XKV，解决了现有方法（如 C2C、LCF-X）在异构模型间传输 KV Cache 时面临的共享上下文要求、层级对齐假设和局部摘要限制等问题，为多智能体协作提供了更高效的底层通信机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 XKV 协议：1) 引入 learned-query attention 对发送方和接收方的 KV Cache 进行池化；2) 接收方通过自注意力机制跨层检索发送方的池化记忆；3) 采用基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的对齐方法，将发送方的隐空间表示映射到接收方的隐空间，从而支持不同层数和 KV 维度的异构模型。
summary.experiments: 在多个异构模型组合上进行了实验，验证了 XKV 在跨模型信息传递任务中的有效性，相比基于文本的通信和现有的隐空间通信方法，在保持性能的同时降低了通信开销。
summary.authors_note: 来自 UCF 的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve efficient and lossless latent space (KV Cache) communication between heterogeneous large language models in multi-agent systems, breaking the limitations of existing methods on shared context and identical model architectures?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel cross-model latent space communication protocol, XKV, which solves the problems faced by existing methods (such as C2C, LCF-X) when transmitting KV Cache between heterogeneous models, such as shared context requirements, layer alignment assumptions, and local summary limitations, providing a more efficient underlying communication mechanism for multi-agent collaboration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the XKV protocol: 1) introduces learned-query attention to pool the KV Caches of both the sender and receiver; 2) the receiver retrieves the sender's pooled memory across layers through a self-attention mechanism; 3) employs a Flow Matching-based alignment method to map the sender's latent space representation to the receiver's latent space, thereby supporting heterogeneous models with different numbers of layers and KV dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments were conducted on multiple combinations of heterogeneous models, verifying the effectiveness of XKV in cross-model information transfer tasks. Compared with text-based communication and existing latent space communication methods, it reduces communication overhead while maintaining performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from UCF.

recommendation.zh: 关注多模型协作和 KV Cache 压缩/传输的研究员可以看看其 Flow Matching 对齐异构隐空间的做法，对理解模型间表示的 mapping 有启发。
recommendation.en: Researchers focusing on multi-model collaboration and KV Cache compression/transmission can look at its Flow Matching alignment of heterogeneous latent spaces, which is inspiring for understanding the mapping of representations between models.

paper.title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory
paper.abstract: Agentic large language models (LLMs) on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) re-encode verbose tool schemas every turn, so prefill - quadratic in sequence length - dominates time-to-first-token (TTFT) as the tool registry grows. Nexus's primary lever is to decouple routing from the schema-prefill cost: an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer (SLB) with a calibrated cross-encoder margin gate selects tools by retrieval, and arguments are generated over a compressed textual signature (median 19 tokens) rathe

summary.core_problem: 解决 MCP 风格 agentic LLM 在每轮都重编码冗长工具 schema，导致 prefill 成本和 TTFT 随工具数快速恶化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理侧系统优化工作，核心价值在于把工具路由与 schema-prefill 解耦。对做 serving、长上下文工具调用和 agent 系统的人有参考，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Nexus，两条路径：主路径用 INT8 semantic lookaside buffer 做语义检索，再用 cross-encoder margin gate 选工具，并在压缩 textual signature 上生成参数，避免把完整 schema 拼进上下文；次路径尝试直接拼接预编译 schema 的 KV-cache，但作者指出该路径受 RoPE 位置依赖限制，只能作为有界优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 250 个工具时，检索路由准确率接近 89%，完整 schema 拼接基线已溢出上下文；首个参数 token 生成速度比 full-schema re-prefill 快 1.66 倍，主上下文 token 节省约 80%。但从摘要看，评测更偏系统指标，缺少更广泛模型、任务和误路由代价分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the growing prefill and TTFT cost in MCP-style agentic LLMs, where verbose tool schemas are re-encoded every turn.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper. Its main value is in decoupling tool routing from schema-prefill cost. Useful for serving and tool-use systems, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Nexus uses two levers. The main path employs an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer plus a cross-encoder margin gate to retrieve tools, then generates arguments over a compressed textual signature instead of full schemas. A secondary path splices a compiled schema KV block into the live context, but the paper notes this is fundamentally bounded by RoPE positional dependence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports near-89% routing accuracy up to 250 tools, where concatenating all schemas already overflows context. It also claims 1.66x faster time to first argument token than full-schema re-prefill with about 80% main-context token savings. The evidence appears system-centric, with limited detail on broader task coverage or failure costs.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练帮助有限，但它把“工具 schema 是推理时重复前缀负担”讲得很清楚；只看摘要里 retrieval-decoupled routing 和 KV splice 的边界即可。
recommendation.en: Limited pretraining value, but it cleanly frames tool schemas as repeated inference-time prefix tax; the useful bit is the retrieval-decoupled routing idea and the stated boundary of KV splicing.

institutions: with a registry of callable tools, each described by a verbose
number and verbosity of available tools

paper.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Agentic language models repeatedly encode tool and skill schemas that recur across requests in different combinations and orders, preventing standard prefix caching from reusing their key--value (KV) states. We introduce \textbf{ReCache}, a framework for independently caching resource representations while reducing their inference-time computational and memory overhead. Resource-wise attention removes cross-resource interactions and assigns resource-local positions, producing composition-invaria

summary.core_problem: ReCache 解决的是工具增强 LLM Agent 中重复编码工具和技能 schema 的开销问题：同一个 resource 会以不同组合、不同顺序出现在请求中，标准 prefix KV cache 很难复用。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练方向的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在长上下文与 Agent serving 的接口设计。它给出一个清晰信号：工具 schema 这类结构化上下文不一定需要按普通文本做全局 dense attention；如果资源之间的交互弱，可以把它们建成可组合、可缓存的独立块。这对后续设计 tool-aware prefill、资源 tokenizer、agent context layout 以及训练时的注意力约束都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步是 resource-wise attention：不同资源块之间不互相注意，每个资源内部重置位置索引，因此某个工具 schema 的 KV 表示不依赖它前后出现了哪些资源，也不依赖全局绝对位置。这样每个 resource 可以独立预计算和复用。代价是它偏离了标准 full-context prefill，所以作者用轻量微调让模型适应这种注意力和位置模式。第二步是结构压缩：不是所有层、所有 KV head group 都同等需要看到 resource KV。作者用对预测 loss 的边际贡献来排序层和 KV head group，只保留贡献高的 layer–head-group route。这个准则比按 attention mass 选更稳，因为注意力权重不总等于对输出的因果贡献。第三步是语义压缩：工具 schema 不能像普通文本那样随意摘要，因为 resource 名、参数名、约束字段一旦丢失会直接导致调用失败。ReCache 保留这些 invocation-critical fields，同时保留 suffix token 作为聚合语义的锚点。
summary.experiments: 作者从 7 个公开工具/技能使用数据集构造统一 benchmark，先做 diversity-first sampling 增加 resource 覆盖，再过滤含幻觉调用的无效轨迹，并划分 in-distribution 与 resource-disjoint OOD，用于测试已见和未见资源。Qwen3 系列实验显示，单独使用 resource-wise attention 时，相比标准 dense attention，各项调用有效性指标差距不超过 0.2%，同时 TTFT 提升 3.655×。加入结构和语义剪枝后，allocated KV-tensor memory 降低 92.43%，attention 加速 1.423×。在相同结构预算下，基于 loss contribution 的选择优于 attention-based 和 layer-asymmetric 方案，未见资源上差距更明显。field-aware semantic pruning 也比通用文本压缩 baseline 更能保持工具调用正确性。随着 resource 长度增加，ReCache 的 TTFT、TPOT 和 attention latency 基本保持稳定，allocated KV-tensor memory 被限制在 0.03 GiB。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、ReCache 方法部分和实验主表，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1：它解释了为什么资源内部注意力强、跨资源注意力弱，以及 suffix token 为什么可以作为语义锚。方法部分重点看 resource-wise attention 的位置重置和 mask 设计，以及 contribution-based structural pruning 的打分方式。实验部分重点看 OOD resource split，因为它比普通工具调用准确率更能检验缓存块是否真的可组合。若关心 serving，可细看 TTFT、TPOT、attention latency 和 KV memory 的分解结果。

summary_en.core_problem: ReCache targets the repeated prefill cost in tool-augmented LLM agents: the same tool or skill schema reappears across requests, but in different orders and combinations, so standard prefix KV caching cannot reuse it.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is inference and agent-context design rather than pretraining itself. The useful signal is that structured tool schemas need not always be encoded as ordinary dense text. If cross-resource interactions are weak, each schema can be represented as a composable KV block. This has implications for tool-aware context layouts, resource tokenization, prefill caching, and possibly training-time attention constraints for agentic models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three components. First, resource-wise attention removes attention across different resource blocks and resets positions within each block. This makes the KV state of a resource independent of neighboring resources and global order, enabling independent construction and reuse. Because this differs from full-context prefill, the model is lightly fine-tuned to adapt to the new attention and positional pattern. Second, structural pruning keeps resource visibility only on selected layer and KV-head-group routes. The routes are ranked by marginal contribution to prediction loss, rather than by attention mass, which is a better proxy for output utility. Third, semantic pruning keeps invocation-critical fields such as resource identifiers, argument names, and constraints, together with a suffix token that acts as a compact semantic anchor.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation benchmark is built from seven public tool- and skill-use datasets. The authors use diversity-first sampling to increase resource coverage, filter invalid traces with hallucinated resource calls, and create both in-distribution and resource-disjoint out-of-distribution splits. On Qwen3 backbones, resource-wise attention stays within 0.2% of the dense-attention baseline on effectiveness metrics while improving time to first token by 3.655×. With structural and semantic pruning, allocated KV-tensor memory drops by 92.43% and attention becomes 1.423× faster. Under matched structural budgets, contribution-based route selection preserves invocation quality better than attention-based and layer-asymmetric alternatives, especially on unseen resources. Field-aware semantic pruning also outperforms generic text-compression baselines in the tested settings. As resource length grows, TTFT, TPOT, and attention latency remain nearly constant, with allocated KV-tensor memory capped at 0.03 GiB.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction and the ReCache method section, then go directly to the main efficiency and invocation-quality tables. Figure 1 is useful because it motivates both the weak cross-resource attention assumption and the suffix-token aggregation idea. In the method section, focus on the exact masking and position-reset scheme for resource-wise attention, and on how marginal contribution is computed for layer and KV-head-group pruning. The resource-disjoint OOD split is the most informative part of the evaluation because it tests whether the cached resource blocks remain reusable for unseen schemas.

recommendation.zh: 只看 resource-wise attention 的 ablation；若结果稳，内部工具 Agent 的 schema cache 应该立刻复现。
recommendation.en: Read the resource-wise attention ablation; if it holds, schema-level KV reuse is worth reproducing in internal tool-agent serving.

paper.title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: A lot of prior work addressed key-value (KV) cache selection and compression by sparse attention to enable long-context inference for transformer language models without excessive hardware budgets. We provide a new method for fine-tuning models with sparse attention. It works for any KV cache policy, runs on a moderate hardware budget (e.g., a single Nvidia A100 GPU with 40 GB RAM), and allows the model to co-adapt with the policy, often outperforming models trained with exact attention (sequenc

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 选择和稀疏注意力策略与模型参数不匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是高效推理与训练系统方法。关键点不是再提出一个 KV 压缩规则，而是让模型在 fine-tuning 阶段适应给定的 sparse attention policy，从而减少训练-推理不一致。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出一种适用于任意 KV cache policy 的 sparse-attention fine-tuning 方法，让模型与缓存选择策略共同适配。实现侧提供 H2O sparse attention 的高效版本，并加入 dedicated scaled dot product attention kernel 支持。作者还开源 KeysAndValues 库，覆盖长上下文推理和 fine-tuning 的相关方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法可在中等硬件预算下运行，例如单张 40GB Nvidia A100。实验中 H2O 是领先 policy；经过 sparse-attention fine-tuning 的模型经常超过使用 exact attention 训练、依赖 sequence parallelism 的模型。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和绝对指标。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Amazon Web Services、Amazon、University of Amsterdam 和 Technical University Berlin。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between long-context KV-cache selection policies and models trained under dense attention.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is in efficient long-context inference and fine-tuning. The useful idea is not another cache heuristic, but adapting the model to the sparse-attention policy used at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method fine-tunes language models under a chosen sparse-attention KV policy so the model can co-adapt with that policy. It is policy-agnostic, includes an efficient H2O sparse-attention implementation with dedicated scaled dot-product attention kernel support, and is released in the KeysAndValues library.
summary_en.experiments: The approach is reported to run on moderate hardware, such as a single 40GB Nvidia A100. H2O is the strongest policy in their experiments, and sparse-attention fine-tuned models often outperform models trained with exact attention using sequence parallelism. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Amazon Web Services, Amazon, University of Amsterdam, and Technical University Berlin.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 kernel 部分即可；它提醒长上下文稀疏策略不能只在推理端硬切，训练适配可能更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the method and kernel sections; the useful prior shift is that sparse long-context policies should be trained into the model, not only patched at inference.

paper.title: CacheRoute: Planned Prefix-Affinity Routing for Large-Scale LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Prefix caching avoids prefill only when a repeated request returns to a server that still holds the prefix KV. Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server. CacheRoute resolves this tradeoff with a periodic routing plan. It admits high-rate keys to a stable warm set and places their assignments by expected load. Hot keys may use more than one destination, although every key in our primary semi-synthetic aggregate uses exactly one. On Llama-3.3

summary.core_problem: 在大规模 LLM serving 中，prefix KV-cache 只有在“相同前缀的请求回到仍持有该前缀的同一目的地”时才省掉 prefill。常规的 cache-blind 负载均衡会把同一前缀打散到多台机器，导致回访间隔变长、前缀变冷；而固定 affinity（例如一致性哈希）虽然保住局部性，却把 key 的流量偏斜直接映射成单机排队，p99 被最热目的地拖垮。论文要解决的是：在多租户、强 key-skew、且每个 key 有可复用上下文的真实工作负载下，如何同时获得高 KV 命中率与可控的尾延迟/容量。
summary.importance:
这不是预训练方法论文，但对“训练-推理闭环”里的推理侧成本结构很关键：它把 prefix 复用从“缓存实现细节”提升为“路由与容量规划问题”，并给出可操作的规划式（planned）路由策略与大规模硬件实测边界。对做大模型训练的人，直接启发在于：
1) 真实线上 prompt 的可复用部分往往只占一小段（文中约 180 tokens、约 15%），但在高 QPS 下仍能显著改变吞吐与 SLO；这会反过来影响你在 pretrain/posttrain 里对上下文模板、系统提示、检索块稳定性的设计取舍。
2) 评估 serving 策略不能只看 hit rate，还要看“hit rate 提升是否抵消了负载不均带来的排队尾部”；文中给出了可复现的测量方法（knee 点、paired runs、burst 测试、shadow replay）。
整体贡献量级偏工程系统，但实验规模（70B、60 H100）和对 tradeoff 的刻画比较扎实。
summary.technical_approach:
CacheRoute 的核心是“周期性规划的 prefix-affinity 路由表”，用稳定性换取缓存驻留与可预测负载：
- 观测与建模对象：按业务 key（多租户场景中的 business）统计到达率 λ_b，并把一个 serving fleet 抽象为 R 个可路由目的地（destination；70B 实验里一个 destination 是 TP=2 的一组）。
- 两阶段决策：先决定哪些 key 进入 warm set（被显式做 affinity），再决定每个 key 分配到哪些目的地、以及这些分配如何在全局上摆放。
- Admission（top-rate admission）：在有限 warm-prefix slot 预算下，优先接纳高到达率 key，使其前缀更可能在 eviction 前回访命中。未接纳流量回退到 cache-blind 的 power-of-two choices。
- Load control（按 knee 点设 q_cap）：从单个目的地的 latency/load knee 校准一个容量阈值 q_cap。对每个 key，给它分配足够多的目的地副本数，使得该 key 分摊到每个目的地的期望负载不超过 q_cap。这里的“复制”是为削峰，不是为提高命中率本身。
- Placement（LPT 列表调度）：把（key, 副本数）形成的负载块用 longest-processing-time-first 做列表调度，尽量均衡各目的地的期望负载，从而避免纯 affinity 的最热桶效应。
- 控制平面：路由表在一个 control interval 内固定不变，避免每请求的反应式重映射导致的‘刚热就被挪走’。
- 论文也明确边界：top-rate admission 与 LPT 都不是新算法点，创新在于把“缓存局部性 + 负载上界 + 稳定路由表”组合成可落地的路由设计，并用大规模测量证明在哪些工作负载区间值得开启、哪些区间应保持普通负载均衡。
summary.experiments:
主实验：Llama-3.3-70B，fp8，60×H100，30 个 TP2 destinations。
- 在 p99 ≤ 3.5s 的 SLO 下，CacheRoute 可持续吞吐 1176±11 QPS；最强 baseline（Preble）为 511±11 QPS，约 2.3×。
- 在 offered load=100 QPS 时，CacheRoute p99=1.8s；五个 baseline 的 p99 为 3.8–8.5s。
- KV-cache hit rate：cache-blind balancing 为 64.1±1.3%，CacheRoute 为 93.2±0.5%。
- 第二个半合成 aggregate：在更宽 active set 下优势约 1.6×。
机制/消融（8B 控制实验，用于制造更极端热 key 以测试复制）：
- affinity 提升 hit rate；LPT placement 把负载不均从 3.46× 降到 1.24×，并把 SLO knee 从 240 QPS 推到 ≥500 QPS。
工作负载刻画（重要，因为解释了为什么“只做缓存”不够）：
- 128,824 个业务 key，Gini=0.756；约 4% key 贡献 47% 请求；单个 key 最大占比 <0.3%。
- 平均输入 1.2K tokens，其中约 90% 在当前 turn 之前；可路由带来复用的 key-specific 段约 180 tokens（约 15%）。
- few-shot 检索块变化导致 67% 的连续请求对不共享精确前缀，进一步强调“可复用前缀很短但很关键”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“失败模式 → 规划器 → 大规模实测 → 机制解释”的顺序读：
1) Workload and Failure Mode：看清楚为什么 fleet 变大反而让 prefix 变冷（回访间隔 ~ R/λ_b）以及为什么纯 affinity 会把 skew 变成尾延迟。
2) CacheRoute 设计细节：重点抓三个旋钮——top-rate admission、q_cap 的校准方式（knee 点）、LPT placement；理解“复制用于限载而非命中率”的分工。
3) 70B/60 H100 的 paired runs 与 SLO knee 图：这是论文最有说服力的部分，注意它如何同时报告 hit rate、吞吐、p99，并展示 tie/overload 区间。
4) 8B ablation：用来验证机制（affinity vs placement vs replication），尤其是 3.46×→1.24× 的不均衡改善如何对应到 knee 的右移。
预计泛读 30–45 分钟能抓住主线；想复现/落地需要更细看控制周期、warm set 预算与 shadow replay 的测量方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Prefix KV caching only saves prefill when repeated requests land on a destination that still retains the prefix KV. Cache-blind load balancing disperses repeated prefixes across the fleet, increasing revisit time and causing eviction; strict affinity (e.g., consistent hashing) restores locality but turns key popularity skew into queue skew, letting the hottest destination dominate p99 latency. The paper targets a practical question in multi-tenant, skewed, prefix-reusing workloads: how to jointly maximize KV hit rate and keep tail latency/capacity under control at large scale.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-systems paper rather than pretraining, but it matters for the cost envelope that pretraining teams ultimately optimize against. It reframes prefix reuse as a routing/planning problem and provides a measured operating regime on a large setup (70B on 60 H100s). Two concrete takeaways for foundation-model researchers: (1) the reusable portion of real prompts can be small (≈180 tokens, ~15% here) yet still materially shift throughput and SLO, which feeds back into how stable you keep system templates / retrieved blocks; (2) evaluating caching strategies requires coupling hit rate with queueing imbalance—higher hit rate can still reduce capacity if it increases skew. The paper’s value is in the design that enforces stability plus load caps, and in the scale/rigor of the measurements (paired runs, knee-point calibration, burst tests, shadow replay).
summary_en.technical_approach:
CacheRoute builds a periodically refreshed routing table that plans prefix affinity and expected load together, prioritizing cache stability over per-request reactive remapping.
- Inputs/abstraction: per-key arrival rates λ_b for business keys; R routable destinations (a destination is a model-server group; in the 70B setup, TP=2).
- Admission (warm set): admit the highest-rate keys into an affinity-managed warm set under a warm-prefix slot budget; non-admitted traffic falls back to cache-blind power-of-two choices.
- Load cap via replication: calibrate q_cap from a single destination’s latency/load knee. For each key, allocate enough destinations so the expected per-destination load contributed by that key is ≤ q_cap. Replication is primarily for load control (capping per-destination contribution), not for improving hit rate per se.
- Placement: assign admitted keys (and their replica counts) to destinations using LPT (longest-processing-time-first) list scheduling to reduce expected load imbalance.
- Control interval: keep the table fixed for a period to preserve cache warmth; avoid reactive spilling that would send the next request to a cold destination once a cap binds.
The novelty is not LPT or top-k admission individually, but the combined routing design and the empirical characterization of when planned affinity beats both cache-blind balancing and reactive cache-aware routing.
summary_en.experiments:
Main hardware evaluation: Llama-3.3-70B, fp8, 60×H100, 30 TP2 destinations.
- Sustained throughput under p99 ≤ 3.5s: 1176±11 QPS for CacheRoute vs 511±11 QPS for the strongest baseline (Preble), ~2.3×.
- At 100 offered QPS: p99 is 1.8s for CacheRoute vs 3.8–8.5s across five baselines.
- Served KV-cache hit rate: 64.1±1.3% (cache-blind) → 93.2±0.5% (CacheRoute).
- Second semi-synthetic aggregate: ~1.6× advantage with a broader active set.
Mechanism/ablation on an 8B setup (to force extremely hot keys and exercise replication): affinity increases hit rate; LPT reduces imbalance from 3.46× to 1.24×, shifting the measured SLO knee from 240 QPS to at least 500 QPS.
Workload characterization (key to interpreting results): 128,824 keys, Gini 0.756; ~4% keys generate 47% of requests; average prompt ~1.2K tokens with a key-specific reusable segment ~180 tokens (~15%); retrieved few-shot blocks break exact-prefix reuse in 67% of consecutive pairs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
1) Workload/Failure Mode: understand why revisit time scales as R/λ_b (bigger fleets can make prefixes colder) and why pure affinity makes skew dominate tail latency.
2) CacheRoute design: focus on three knobs—top-rate admission, q_cap knee calibration, and LPT placement; note the separation of roles between replication (load capping) and affinity (locality).
3) 70B/60 H100 results: pay attention to paired-run methodology and plots that jointly report hit rate, throughput, and p99 across the knee/tie/overload regimes.
4) 8B ablations: the cleanest evidence for the mechanism (affinity vs placement vs replication).
Skimming for the main idea takes ~30–45 minutes; implementing it requires careful attention to control-interval choices, warm-set budgeting, and the shadow-replay measurement approach.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“KV 命中率高就一定更快”这个直觉讲得更干净；看反例 workload 和何时关闭 affinity 的判据，比主结果更值钱。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly shows that higher KV hit rate does not automatically mean better serving; the counterexample workloads and the disable-affinity criterion are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
paper.abstract: In a Transformer, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV produced at its own depth, despite the presence of deeper representations during autoregressive decoding. Feedback architectures allow shallow consumer layers to attend to KV produced by deeper past-token representations, but give all consumer layers the same fixed connection patterns to source layers. We propose WhiteMatter, which connects every attention layer to the representations from all layers of each past token, with con

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Transformer 解码时的一个结构限制：当前 token 的每一层只能读取过去 token 在同一深度产生的 KV，无法直接使用过去 token 的更深层表示。已有 feedback 或 cross-layer 方法要么连接模式固定，要么不能提供浅层读取深层过去状态的路径。WhiteMatter 试图让每个注意力层都能通过共享 KV channel 访问过去 token 的全层表示，并且连接权重随 token 内容变化。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构类工作，对预训练研究的价值在于重新审视“层深”和“时间步”之间的信息流。常规 decoder 在一个 token 内完成深层计算，但这些深层状态对后续 token 的浅层不可见；WhiteMatter 让深层过去状态进入 KV cache，等于增加了跨 token 的有效计算深度。它还把 cross-layer access 和 KV-cache 压缩放在同一个设计里：当 channel 数 k 小于层数 L 时，cache 规模变为标准 Transformer 的 k/L。当前实验规模是 8B token 的从零预训练，结果有参考意义，但还不能直接说明在百亿到千亿参数、长上下文和大规模混合数据上的收益。
summary.technical_approach: WhiteMatter 保留标准 decoder block，但替换每层独立的 KV 生成方式。对每个 token，模型收集 L 层 hidden states，先做 RMSNorm，让不同层处在相近尺度；然后由 router 为 K 分支和 V 分支分别产生 k×L 的混合权重。每个 KV channel 是所有源层状态的内容相关加权混合，再经过共享的 K/V projection 得到可缓存的 key 和 value。每个 consumer layer 固定选择一个 channel，因此不同层可以读取不同的跨层混合表示。这个设计同时具备三点：过去 token 的深层状态可以被当前浅层读取，连接模式对不同 consumer layer 不同，混合权重还依赖源 token 内容。难点在训练和 prefill：每个 token 的 KV 依赖该 token 完成后的全层状态，而这些状态又依赖之前 token 的 KV，直接求解会产生序列方向的循环依赖。论文用 cyclic Gauss-Seidel 迭代调度来近似求解，使训练和 prefill 仍能保持 token-parallel，并比 Jacobi 迭代收敛更快。
summary.experiments: 所有模型都从零开始在 8B tokens FineWeb-Edu 上训练，数据、token budget 和优化设置保持一致。16 层、满 KV cache 配置 k=16 的 WhiteMatter held-out perplexity 为 19.968，比同深度 vanilla Transformer 的 21.747 低 8.2%，也略低于 24 层 vanilla 模型的 20.181。半 cache 配置 k=8 的 perplexity 为 20.377，比相同 cache 大小的 LCKV baseline 低 5.0%，并保留了大部分增益。论文还报告 16 层 WhiteMatter 在 LAMBADA 和 WikiText 上优于其他 16 层对照模型。对 cyclic Gauss-Seidel 的控制实验显示，在精确 autoregressive execution 可比设置下，g=16 时 4 次 pass 内 perplexity 距离精确 autoregressive 结果不到 1%；收敛后的 prefill 比精确 autoregressive evaluation 快 13.9 倍，比 Jacobi iteration 快 11.2 倍。代价是 16 层实验中 cyclic training 约为 vanilla 的 1.5 倍计算开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Method 3.1，确认 cross-layer KV pool、router、channel selection 的数据流；再看 cyclic Gauss-Seidel schedule，理解它为什么能处理训练阶段的循环依赖。实验部分重点看主 perplexity 表、k=16 与 k=8 的 cache/性能取舍、与 LCKV 和 24 层 vanilla 的对比，以及迭代次数和分组参数的消融。值得留意的风险点是训练开销、router 稳定性、cache channel 与层选择的可扩展性，以及这种结构在更大模型上是否仍然优于简单加深网络。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural limitation of autoregressive Transformers: during decoding, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV states produced at the same depth. Deeper representations of past tokens have already been computed, but shallow layers of later tokens cannot directly use them. WhiteMatter introduces content-dependent all-to-all cross-layer access to past-token representations through a shared KV-channel mechanism.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture paper with direct relevance to pretraining. It changes the information flow between depth and time: computation performed at deeper layers for earlier tokens becomes available to later tokens, including their shallow layers. The design also connects cross-layer feedback with KV-cache control, since using k channels for L layers reduces the KV cache to k/L of the standard size when k < L. The evidence is based on 8B-token training runs, so the result is useful but still early for large-scale LLM settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: WhiteMatter keeps the standard decoder blocks but replaces per-layer KV production with a cross-layer KV pool. For each token, the model gathers hidden states from all L layers, RMS-normalizes them, and uses a router to produce k-by-L mixing weights. Separate routers or parameters are used for keys and values. Each KV channel is a content-dependent signed mixture of all source-layer states, followed by shared K and V projections. Each consumer layer reads a fixed channel, allowing different layers to receive different mixtures of source depths. This gives the model deep-to-shallow feedback across tokens, consumer-specific connectivity, and token-dependent routing. The main training complication is circular dependency: a token's KV depends on its completed layer states, while those states depend on previous tokens' KV. The paper uses a cyclic Gauss-Seidel schedule to solve this iteratively while retaining token-parallel training and prefill, with faster convergence than Jacobi-style iteration.
summary_en.experiments: All models are pretrained from scratch on 8B tokens of FineWeb-Edu under matched data, token budget, and optimizer settings. A 16-layer WhiteMatter model with full cache, k=16, reaches 19.968 held-out perplexity, compared with 21.747 for a same-depth vanilla Transformer, an 8.2% reduction. It also slightly beats a 24-layer vanilla model at 20.181 perplexity. With half cache, k=8, WhiteMatter reaches 20.377 perplexity and is 5.0% better than an LCKV baseline with the same cache size. The 16-layer variants also outperform other 16-layer models on LAMBADA and WikiText. In a controlled exact-autoregressive setting, cyclic Gauss-Seidel with g=16 comes within 1% of autoregressive perplexity in 4 passes. Converged prefill is 13.9x faster than exact autoregressive evaluation and 11.2x faster than Jacobi iteration. The reported cost is that cyclic training for the 16-layer experiments is about 1.5x more expensive than vanilla training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 30–40 minute skim. Start with Figure 1 and the method section describing the cross-layer KV pool, router, and channel selection. Then read the cyclic Gauss-Seidel schedule, since it is the part that makes the feedback architecture trainable and usable for prefill. In the results, focus on the main perplexity table, the k=16 versus k=8 cache tradeoff, comparisons to LCKV and a deeper vanilla model, and the iteration ablations. The main open questions are scaling behavior, training overhead, routing stability, and whether the same gains persist when model depth, context length, and data mixture become closer to production LLM pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和消融；若 setup 干净，它会改变“KV cache 必须逐层独立”的默认设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the setup is clean, it weakens the default assumption that KV caches should remain layer-local.

paper.title: Fractional Decay KV-Cache: Ownership-Aware Memory Management for Improved Inference Relevancy in Dialog Systems
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is essential for efficient autoregressive inference in transformer based dialog systems, yet existing strategies treat all cached entries uniformly or apply coarse eviction heuristics that fail to adapt as dialog topics evolve. We propose Fractional Decay KV-Cache (FD-KVC), a novel algorithm that maintains a dual-channel scoring mechanism for each cached KV pair: a cumulative attention channel that tracks aggregate importance (akin to H2O), and a recency-weighted relevance

summary.core_problem: 在多轮对话推理中，KV-cache 需要在有限内存下同时保留“历史关键 token”和“近期话题相关 token”，避免粗糙淘汰导致相关性下降。
summary.importance: 属于推理侧缓存管理；对预训练本身不直接，但对长对话/长上下文服务与“注意力重权重 token”现象有工程启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FD-KVC：对每个 KV 条目维护双通道分数——累计注意力重要性（类似 heavy-hitter/H2O）与带时间衰减的近期相关性；用“reinforcement-inspired”更新与自适应学习率（由 ownership loss 驱动）避免振荡；声称可在 CPU 上运行且开销很小。
summary.experiments: 在 5 类多轮对话场景、每类 600 dialogs 上对比 H2O 等基线；摘要声称相对 H2O 提升约 +6（指标未在摘要中完整给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache in multi-turn dialogue must preserve historically important tokens while adapting quickly to topic shifts under memory constraints.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time cache management; not pretraining, but relevant to long-context serving and token-importance dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: FD-KVC assigns each KV entry two scores: cumulative attention importance (heavy-hitter style) and a temporally decayed recency relevance score; uses reinforcement-inspired updates and an adaptive LR driven by an ownership loss to avoid oscillation; designed to run on CPU with low overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Across five multi-turn dialogue scenarios (600 dialogs each), it reports ~+6 improvement over H2O in the abstract (full metric details not present in the snippet).

recommendation.zh: 当作 H2O/重权重 token 缓存的一个“加衰减+双通道”变体看即可；先核对指标定义与开销曲线，摘要里的 +6 可信度需看设置是否公平。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a dual-score, decay-augmented variant of heavy-hitter KV caching; verify metric definitions and overhead—“+6 over H2O” is weak evidence without a clean, fair setup.

paper.title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents
paper.abstract: Stateful language agents assume a rejected branch can be taken back by clearing it from the application transcript. We show this breaks when the serving session retains key/value (KV) state across the logical abort: the model can continue attending to content the application believes it discarded. We formalize the missing guarantee as rollback consistency: a complete abort must restore the state the model attends, not just the transcript. The key failure is cross-layer: a correct logical rollbac

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论的是有状态 LLM Agent 中一个容易被忽略的服务层一致性问题：应用层认为某个分支已经 rollback 或 abort，清除了 transcript，但推理服务仍复用旧的 KV cache。结果是模型实际 attention 到的状态和应用层记录的状态不一致，已被拒绝的内容仍可能影响后续决策。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文服务、Agent runtime、KV cache 语义和安全评测有启发。它把“删除 transcript”与“删除模型可见状态”区分开，提出 rollback consistency 作为跨层接口约束。对做 serving、agent memory、continued generation API、prefix/session cache 的系统尤其有参考价值。它也提醒预训练研究员：模型行为评测不能只看输入 token，还要看推理状态是否被严格控制。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是把问题形式化为两层属性：第一层是 attended-state rollback integrity，即应用认为 rollback 完成后，模型实际可 attend 的状态也必须回到对应状态；第二层是 observational effect，即这种状态残留是否会改变后续受保护动作。论文设计了 same-token / different-cache audit：两组实验在决策步骤喂给模型的 token 完全相同，区别只在 KV cache。stale-cache 组保留被 abort 分支的 KV；fresh-cache 组从已提交 transcript 重新构建 KV。这样可以排除普通 prompt injection 或文本残留的解释，把差异归因到 KV retention。作者还区分了不同注入载体和 residue strength，避免把中性残留和显式命令混在一起。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个开源模型家族，参数规模从 3.8B 到 36B。主实验是 3×3 网格：3 类注入载体乘以 3 类残留强度，共 63 个 paired attack cells。结果显示，仅由 retained KV 导致的 protected decision flip 出现在 25/63 个 cells；同样条件下，fresh-cache rebuild 和 full cold restart 都是 0/63。端到端 session app 在 API 边界复现了相同的 per-model flip count。使用 LangGraph time-travel 这类一等 rollback API 时，逻辑 rollback 已验证完成，但 KV 仍旧 stale，结果为 25/45。模型敏感性差异较大，有的模型 9/9 cells 被影响，有的模型 0/9；Phi-4 和 Seed-OSS-36B 被报告为相对 resistant。论文还用 length/position-matched control 排除了长度或位置因素，指向被删除攻击语义本身。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 和 rollback consistency 的问题设定，确认它不是普通 prompt injection。再看实验设计部分，重点是 same-token / different-cache audit，这是全文最关键的因果识别设计。结果部分关注 Table 1、3×3 attack grid、fresh-cache/cold-restart 对照，以及 LangGraph rollback API 的复现。Appendix A 可看形式化定义；Appendix D 看 residue strength 的拆分；Appendix J/K 看 position control、不同 protected effects 和 MoE 场景。若只关心 serving 实践，重点结论是：只要使用 session handle 或 past_key_values 跨 abort 复用，就需要显式 cache invalidation、snapshot/restore 或按 committed transcript 重建 KV；content-addressed prefix cache 通常不属于同一风险，因为它只复用请求中真实存在的前缀。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a consistency bug in stateful LLM agents: an application may abort or roll back a branch and remove it from the transcript, while the serving layer keeps reusing the old KV cache. The model then attends to state that the application believes has been discarded.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to LLM systems research around long-context serving, agent runtimes, KV-cache semantics, and safety evaluation. Its main contribution is the rollback consistency contract: logical transcript rollback must compose with the inference state actually attended by the model. It is also a useful reminder for evaluation work: controlling the visible input tokens is not enough if hidden serving state is retained.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper separates two layers. The first is attended-state rollback integrity: after a believed-complete abort, the model-visible serving state should match the committed history. The second is an observational effect: whether stale state changes a later protected action. The key causal design is a same-token / different-cache audit. Both arms feed token-identical decision-step inputs. The stale arm retains KV entries from the aborted branch; the fresh arm rebuilds KV from the committed transcript. Any behavioral difference is therefore attributable to retained KV rather than to ordinary in-context text. The study also varies the vehicle of the residual content and its strength, keeping neutral residue separate from imperative instructions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover seven open-weight model families from 3.8B to 36B. The main grid has 3 injection vehicles and 3 residue strengths, giving 63 paired attack cells. Retained KV alone flips the protected decision in 25/63 cells. Fresh-cache rebuild and full cold restart close the channel, with 0/63 flips. An end-to-end session application reproduces the same per-model flip counts at the API boundary. With LangGraph time-travel rollback, a verified logical rollback still leaves stale KV effects in 25/45 cells. Susceptibility is model-dependent: some models flip in 9/9 cells, while others flip in 0/9; Phi-4 and Seed-OSS-36B are reported as resistant in this setup. Length- and position-matched controls point to the deleted attacker semantics rather than cache position.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 1 and the rollback consistency framing in the introduction. Then read the same-token / different-cache audit carefully; it is the main methodological contribution. In the results, focus on Table 1, the 3×3 attack grid, the fresh-cache and cold-restart controls, and the LangGraph rollback experiment. Appendix A is useful for the formal property. Appendix D separates residue strengths. Appendices J and K cover position controls, additional protected effects, and a cache-isolated MoE setting. For serving practice, the actionable point is simple: session handles or past_key_values reused across aborts need explicit invalidation, snapshot/restore, or KV reconstruction from the committed transcript. Content-addressed prefix caches are scoped out because they only reuse prefixes present in the request.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但会直接改你对 stateful serving 的默认假设；只看 rollback consistency 定义和 same-token/different-cache audit 就值回时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it should update your default assumptions about stateful serving; the rollback-consistency definition and the same-token/different-cache audit are the key takeaways.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems have emerged as an important deployment paradigm for AI services, where each user request is decomposed into a sequence of specialized agents. Across these workflows, every agent repeatedly executes a fixed context consisting of system prompts, tool definitions, and few-shot examples, creating substantial opportunities for KV-cache reuse. Existing LLM serving systems, however, manage KV-cache reactively using prefix caching and recency-based replacement, causing reusable

summary.core_problem: 多 agent 服务中存在大量可复用的固定上下文，但现有 KV-cache 管理主要依赖 prefix caching 和 recency 策略，无法根据 agent 执行语义保留真正会再次命中的 cache，导致重复预填充计算。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统侧的工作，贡献在于把 cache 管理从被动的 recency 策略改成基于 agent 执行转移的在线预测。对 serving、长工作流和统一系统设计有现实价值，也能反过来影响训练时对 agentic workload 的建模假设。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CacheScout，一个 agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer。核心做法是在线学习 agent 执行转移，而不是依赖预定义 workflow graph 或离线训练；再利用学到的执行模型指导 cache 保留与驱逐，从而优先保留未来更可能被复用的 agent 上下文。方法重点不在模型参数更新，而在运行时对工作流语义的轻量建模。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据集，但实验比较对象应包括现有 prefix caching 与基于 recency 的替换策略，并在多 agent workflow 场景下评估 cache hit、重计算开销、延迟或吞吐。核心结果应是在线学习执行语义优于纯 recency 策略，尤其在重复调用固定 agent context 的场景中更明显。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent serving, many fixed contexts are reusable, but existing KV-cache management relies on prefix caching and recency-based policies, which fail to preserve the caches that are actually likely to be reused and thus incur repeated prefilling cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper. Its main contribution is shifting cache management from passive recency heuristics to online prediction based on agent execution transitions. It matters for serving, long workflows, and system design, and can indirectly inform how we think about agentic workloads during training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer. The key idea is to learn agent execution transitions online, without predefined workflow graphs or offline training, and then use the learned execution model to guide cache retention and eviction so that contexts with higher future reuse probability are kept in memory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or datasets, but the evaluation likely compares against prefix caching and recency-based replacement under multi-agent workflows, measuring cache hit rate, recomputation cost, latency, or throughput. The main expected result is that online execution-semantic modeling outperforms pure recency heuristics, especially when fixed agent contexts recur.

recommendation.zh: 这是 serving 论文，不改 pretrain prior；但把 cache policy 从 recency 改成 execution semantics 很干净，做 agentic inference 的人应先看方法和系统指标表。
recommendation.en: This will not change your pretraining prior, but the shift from recency-based cache policy to execution-semantics-aware management is clean and worth reading if you care about agentic inference.

paper.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
paper.abstract: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.   We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend a

summary.core_problem: 生产级分页 Serving 引擎对 KV Cache 使用统一分页粒度，但多 Agent 负载中长共享前缀需要连续性、每请求后缀需要细粒度分配，两者需求相反。
summary.importance: 系统创新，首次将非对称分页粒度应用于生产级分页 Serving 引擎的 KV Cache，针对多 Agent 长共享前缀场景给出直接可用的吞吐优化。
summary.technical_approach: GraniKV 将共享前缀分配在连续 HOT 池、后缀分配在 token 级 COLD 池；配合 per-step dispatcher 在双后端间按 compute/memory/communication bound 选择后端。
summary.experiments: Lp=16K 共享 token 时，Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2、Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 上输出 token 吞吐分别达生产基线的 2.16×、1.98×、1.57×。

summary_en.core_problem: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to KV cache, but multi-agent workloads have opposite storage needs: long shared prefixes demand contiguity while per-request suffixes demand fine-grained allocation.
summary_en.importance: Systems innovation; first work to apply asymmetric paging granularity to KV cache in a production paged-serving engine, yielding directly usable throughput gains for multi-agent long-shared-prefix scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: GraniKV allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher that selects among dual backends based on compute/memory/communication boundedness.
summary_en.experiments: At Lp=16K shared tokens, achieves 2.16×, 1.98×, and 1.57× output-token throughput over production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4 respectively.

recommendation.zh: 非对称分页粒度的洞察干净直接，多 Agent 长前缀场景下 2× 吞吐有实际部署价值；看 §3 设计和 §5 分解实验即可。
recommendation.en: The asymmetric granularity insight is clean and direct; 2× throughput for multi-agent long-prefix serving is deployable—read §3 design and §5 breakdown.

paper.title: Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN
paper.abstract: AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputat

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI-RAN 场景下用户切换基站时，LLM 推理请求与其 KV cache 分离导致的服务中断时间和 token 延迟上升问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向移动边缘部署的 LLM serving 系统工作，贡献在主动式 KV cache 迁移框架。对预训练本身帮助有限，但对理解 KV 状态管理、前缀重建与 serving 约束有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pallas：在 handover 发生前预测目标 gNB，并并行准备推理状态；将序列划分为稳定历史前缀和持续增长后缀，在目标侧通过本地前缀重建、增量同步和迁移策略组合，减少切换后的 SIT 与 ITL。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据集，重点是系统指标：比较保留源站推理、切换后再迁移等策略，目标是在 AI-RAN 场景下降低 service interruption time 和 inter-token latency。更像网络系统 paper，而非通用 LLM 推理框架。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the problem that, in AI-RAN deployments, user handover can separate an active LLM request from its KV cache, causing longer service interruption time and inter-token latency.
summary_en.importance: This is an LLM serving systems paper for mobile edge settings. The contribution is a proactive KV-cache migration framework. It is only indirectly useful for pretraining researchers, but it does offer some signal on KV-state management and prefix reconstruction under deployment constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pallas predicts the target gNB before handover and prepares inference state in parallel. It splits the sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix, then combines local prefix reconstruction, incremental synchronization, and migration policies to reduce post-handover disruption.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or datasets. The evaluation is framed around system metrics—service interruption time and inter-token latency—against baselines such as staying on the source node or migrating only after handover. This is more of a networking/systems paper than a general LLM inference framework.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你关心 KV 状态在分布式 serving 里的真实代价，只看问题建模和前缀/后缀拆分思路就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about the real systems cost of KV state, the problem formulation and prefix/suffix split are the only parts worth taking away.

paper.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache stores information from past tokens and is a major memory bottleneck in long-context inference. Existing quantization methods address this bottleneck by representing the KV cache uniformly with lower-precision data types and designing quantization schemes to minimize reconstruction error in the cache itself, without accounting for how that error propagates through attention mechanisms. We prove that, under a white-noise quantization model, the expected attention-aware di

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决长上下文推理中的 KV cache 内存问题：如何在较高压缩率下压缩 KV cache，同时尽量不破坏 attention 输出，而不是只最小化 cache 张量的重构误差。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文模型的 serving 和评测有参考价值。核心启发是：KV cache 压缩不应只看每个维度的方差或量化误差，还应看这些误差经过 query、attention 和 output projection 后对最终输出的影响。这个视角也有助于理解不同模型架构、GQA 配置和长上下文任务对 cache 噪声的敏感性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 KV cache 压缩表述为 transform coding 问题。AATC 先对每层 cache 特征做 whitening-based decorrelation，再在变换域做 bit allocation。与只按重构误差分配 bit 的方法不同，AATC 的分配准则引入 attention-aware 权重，包括 query 相关项 q_c^2 和 output projection 相关项 W_Oc，用来近似量化误差对 attention 输出的影响。实现上保留最前 s=4 个 token 和最近 w=128 个 token 为全精度；recent window 满后，每次量化最旧的 16 个 token。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 使用 G=2 个 head groups，Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 使用 G=1。变换矩阵用 WikiText-2 校准，rate-distortion 校准使用 256 条长度 2048 的序列，FineWeb 和 OpenR1-Math-220k 各占一半。AATC var-only 去掉 attention-aware 权重，只按量化误差方差分配，可视作 per-layer 版本的 KVTC 重构准则。
summary.experiments: 主实验在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 上比较 KIVI、PALU、KVQuant、AATC var-only 和 AATC。AATC 在 5.82× 压缩率下，18 个评测单元均与 FP16 baseline 在 2σ 统计误差内不可区分。Llama 的 KV cache 从 FP16 的 1.07GB 降到 184MB。Qwen 更难压缩：KIVI 在 LongBench 降到 0.351，RULER 多个长度低于 0.28；AATC 在 Qwen 上保持 LongBench 0.567，对比 FP16 0.574，并在 RULER-32k 达到 0.715，对比 FP16 0.720。Qwen 的 MMLU-Pro math 上 AATC 为 0.710，明显高于 AATC var-only 的 0.674 和 KVQuant 的 0.478。更激进的约 7×、2-bit 设置下，attention-aware 分配的作用更明显：full AATC 在长上下文 RULER 上接近 baseline，而 var-only 随上下文变长明显退化。限制也比较清楚：没有专用 CUDA 实现，只测了两个模型族，理论分析中使用了 token 独立性假设。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。优先看 Theorem 1 及其对应的 distortion 形式，重点理解为什么 q_c^2 和 W_Oc 会进入 bit allocation。然后看方法部分的 per-layer transform、reverse-waterfilling allocation、full-precision prefix/recent window 设计。实验部分重点看 Table II 和 Figure 1：Table II 展示 5.82× 下的主结果，Figure 1 展示 2-bit 时 attention-aware 分配相对 var-only 的优势。系统落地前还需要看 Appendix E 的实现细节和 CUDA 缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV cache memory pressure in long-context inference. The key question is how to compress the cache at high compression ratios while preserving the attention output, rather than merely minimizing reconstruction error on the cached tensors.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency contribution, but it is relevant to long-context LLM research. The useful idea is that KV cache compression should be output-aware: an error is harmful only to the extent that it propagates through queries, attention, and the output projection. This gives a cleaner way to reason about why some model families and GQA configurations are more sensitive to cache compression than others.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates KV cache compression as transform coding. AATC applies a whitening-based per-layer transform to decorrelate cache features, then performs bit allocation in the transform domain. Unlike variance-only or reconstruction-error criteria, AATC weights distortion by attention-aware terms, including query-related q_c^2 factors and output-projection-related W_Oc factors, derived from an output-error analysis. The implementation keeps the first s=4 tokens and the most recent w=128 tokens in full precision. Once the recent-token window is full, it quantizes the oldest 16 tokens and refills the window. Calibration uses WikiText-2 for the transform, and 256 sequences of length 2048 for rate-distortion calibration, split evenly between FineWeb and OpenR1-Math-220k. The var-only ablation removes the attention-aware terms and allocates bits based only on quantization-error variance, making it a per-layer analogue of a KVTC-style reconstruction criterion.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation covers Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, with comparisons to KIVI, PALU, KVQuant, AATC var-only, and full AATC. At 5.82× compression, AATC is statistically indistinguishable from the FP16 baseline within 2 standard errors across all 18 reported cells. For Llama, the KV cache memory drops from 1.07 GB in FP16 to 184 MB. Qwen is much harder to compress: KIVI falls to 0.351 on LongBench and below 0.28 on several RULER settings, while AATC reaches 0.567 on LongBench versus 0.574 for FP16, and 0.715 on RULER-32k versus 0.720 for FP16. On Qwen MMLU-Pro math, AATC scores 0.710, compared with 0.674 for AATC var-only and 0.478 for KVQuant. At the more aggressive 2-bit, roughly 7× setting, the attention-aware allocation becomes more important: full AATC remains close to baseline on long-context RULER, while the var-only variant degrades as context length increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20 minutes. Start with Theorem 1 and the resulting distortion expression, since that is where the output-aware weighting enters the compression objective. Then read the method details on per-layer transforms, reverse-waterfilling allocation, and the full-precision prefix/recent-window policy. For results, Table II gives the main 5.82× comparison, and Figure 1 is the clearest evidence for the benefit of attention-aware allocation under aggressive 2-bit compression. Appendix E is useful if implementation feasibility matters, especially because the current version does not include a dedicated CUDA kernel.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是目标函数，不是压缩技巧本身：把 KV 量化从“重建 cache”改成“重建 attention 行为”，先读理论分解和 bit allocation。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the objective, not the compression trick: it reframes KV quantization from cache reconstruction to attention-behavior reconstruction; read the distortion decomposition and bit-allocation parts first.

paper.title: VoiceChat-TTS: A Low-Latency Continuous Speech Synthesis Model for Interactive Agents
paper.abstract: Spoken dialogue is a natural form of human--computer interaction, yet most speech language models remain limited to turn-based operation and lack real-time adaptability, such as user barge-in. Recent duplex speech-to-speech and speech-to-text models reduce latency by replacing multi-stage pipelines, but often compromise speech quality because accurate ASR, interruption handling, and high-fidelity synthesis must be optimized jointly. We propose VoiceChat-TTS, a low-latency, continuous, and stream

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式语音代理中 TTS 难以低延迟、连续流式生成，并支持用户打断的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是语音生成系统创新。它不试图把 ASR、对话和合成全部端到端融合，而是保留模块化 TTS，同时适配 LLM 文本 token 流和实时交互控制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VoiceChat-TTS，一个由 LLM text-token stream 直接驱动的流式 TTS 模型。模型通过控制 token 显式处理 interruption，在无文本输入时生成 silence，并支持 mid-utterance interruption，同时不重置 KV cache。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调低延迟、continuous、streamable、高语音质量和打断处理能力，但未给出模型规模、训练语音数据量、MOS、RTF、延迟分解或与现有 TTS/duplex speech model 的定量对比。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA Corporation。作者列表包含 Edresson Casanova、Piotr Zelasko 等语音建模与语音系统方向研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses low-latency, continuous, streamable TTS for interactive speech agents, especially user barge-in during generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a speech-generation system design. Rather than merging ASR, dialogue, and synthesis into a single end-to-end duplex model, it keeps TTS modular while making it compatible with LLM token streams and real-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach: VoiceChat-TTS is driven directly by LLM text-token streams. It uses explicit control tokens for interruptions, emits silence when no text input is available, and supports mid-utterance interruption without resetting the KV cache.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims low latency, continuous streaming, high speech quality, and interruption handling, but does not provide model size, training data scale, MOS, real-time factor, latency breakdown, or quantitative comparison against prior TTS or duplex speech systems.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA Corporation. The author list includes Edresson Casanova and Piotr Zelasko, both associated with speech modeling and speech systems work.

recommendation.zh: 作为语音 agent 系统接口备查即可；预训练侧主要看 control token 和 KV-cache 连续性的设计。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a speech-agent systems reference; for pretraining work, only the control-token and KV-cache continuity design matters.

paper.title: Thought-Aware KV Cache Compaction for Reasoning via Adaptive Attention Matching
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models generate lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) sequences whose key-value (KV) cache grows linearly and becomes a memory bottleneck during decoding. Existing compaction methods treat reasoning trajectories as flat token sequences and apply uniform compression, ignoring the hierarchical structure of CoT reasoning where different steps vary drastically in importance. We propose \textbf{Thought-Aware Attention Matching (TAM)}, which exploits this structure through three mechanisms

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是推理模型长 CoT 解码时的 KV cache 内存瓶颈。现有压缩方法通常把生成轨迹当作平坦 token 序列处理，统一分配压缩预算；作者认为 CoT 有步骤结构，不同 reasoning block 对未来生成的重要性差异很大，因此压缩预算也应按结构和重要性分配。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更偏推理效率和 serving，但对预训练研究也有间接启发。长推理能力如果依赖大量中间 token，训练和部署都会遇到 memory-time tradeoff。TAM 的结论说明，推理轨迹中的 token 并不等价；问题定义、中间结论和关键计算锚点比探索性或废弃路径更应保留。这对后续研究有两个影响：一是可以把 reasoning trace 看成可压缩的分层状态，而不是必须完整保留的文本；二是训练阶段可能需要让模型生成更可分段、更可压缩的推理轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: TAM 建在 Attention Matching 之上。Attention Matching 的目标不是简单丢 token，而是构造更短的 compact KV，使其在参考 query 上同时匹配局部 attention output 和 attention mass。TAM 加了三个结构化机制。第一，thought segmentation，把已经生成的推理轨迹切成若干 reasoning blocks。第二，adaptive budget allocation，根据每个 block 的重要性权重和长度分配 compact token 数，理论上给出 t_i ∝ sqrt(w_i n_i) 的分配规则；这比统一压缩更适合误差随预算递减的场景。第三，pivotal token protection，保留高 attention 的关键 token，避免被压缩过程抹掉。参考 query 来自最近 selector window，使方法适合 mid-trajectory compaction，而不是只在 prefill 阶段处理静态上下文。底层拟合仍使用 AM 的闭式或轻量求解流程，包括 attention mass 的非负最小二乘和 value 的普通最小二乘。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B，在 AIME 2024 和 MATH-500 上评估长推理场景下的压缩效果。作者报告 TAM 在相同 memory budget 下相比 uniform compaction 有更稳定的准确率收益；周期性 compaction 最高可降低约 65% peak memory。消融设计围绕三个部件展开：分段、按重要性分配预算、保护 pivotal tokens。核心结果是，单纯 uniform compression 在高压缩率下更容易损失关键 reasoning anchor，而 TAM 通过把预算集中在高权重 block 和关键 token 上，能在较低 KV 内存下保留更多解题性能。文中还给出理论支撑：预算分配规则在凸误差模型下最优，保护 pivotal token 可降低近似误差，连续多次压缩的累计误差有界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 AM、RPC 和 TAM 三者差异的定位：compaction primitive、query source、structure-aware budget allocation。然后看 Preliminaries 里 attention mass matching 的分解，这是理解为什么 AM 不等于 token eviction 的关键。方法部分重点读 segmentation、importance score、t_i ∝ sqrt(w_i n_i) 分配规则，以及 pivotal token 的定义。实验部分主要看不同压缩率下的 accuracy-memory 曲线和 ablation。若只关心 serving，可重点看 peak-memory reduction 和 compaction 周期；若关心预训练或推理建模，可重点看推理轨迹的分层结构假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache growth during long chain-of-thought decoding. Existing cache compaction methods usually treat the generated reasoning trace as a flat token sequence and apply a uniform compression policy. TAM argues that reasoning traces have block structure, and that different blocks should receive different cache budgets because their relevance to future generation varies substantially.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about inference efficiency, but it has useful implications for reasoning-model training. Long reasoning is not only a capability problem; it also creates a memory and bandwidth problem. TAM shows that generated reasoning tokens are not equally useful: problem statements, intermediate results, and conclusion anchors deserve more preservation than abandoned explorations. This supports a view of reasoning traces as compressible hierarchical state, which may influence how models are trained to produce structured, reusable, and cache-friendly reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAM extends Attention Matching rather than relying on simple token eviction. Attention Matching constructs a shorter set of compact keys and values that match both local attention outputs and attention mass under a set of reference queries. TAM adds three mechanisms. First, it segments the generated trajectory into thought blocks. Second, it allocates the compression budget adaptively using each block’s importance and length, with an allocation rule of the form t_i proportional to sqrt(w_i n_i). Third, it protects pivotal tokens, identified as high-attention anchors, so that important reasoning states are not removed by the compaction step. Reference queries are drawn from a recent selector window, making the method suitable for mid-trajectory compaction during decoding. The underlying fitting still follows the AM pipeline, including nonnegative least squares for attention-mass matching and ordinary least squares for value fitting.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3-4B on AIME 2024 and MATH-500. TAM improves accuracy over uniform compaction at the same memory budget, and periodic compaction reduces peak memory by up to about 65%. The ablations are organized around the three main components: thought segmentation, adaptive budget allocation, and pivotal-token protection. The reported pattern is consistent with the method’s premise: uniform compression loses important reasoning anchors at high compression ratios, while TAM spends more budget on high-importance blocks and preserves key tokens. The paper also provides theoretical support: the allocation rule is optimal under a convex error model, pivotal-token protection reduces approximation error, and sequential compaction has bounded cumulative error.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the introduction’s comparison among Attention Matching, Reasoning Path Compression, and TAM, especially the distinction between the compaction primitive, the query source, and structure-aware budget allocation. Then read the preliminaries on attention-mass decomposition, since this explains why AM-style compaction differs from eviction. In the method section, focus on thought segmentation, the importance score, the sqrt(w_i n_i) budget rule, and pivotal-token protection. In the experiments, prioritize the accuracy-memory curves and the ablations.
