For serving work, the peak-memory and compaction-period results are the main pieces; for reasoning-model research, the more interesting part is the assumption that CoT traces form a compressible hierarchy.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“CoT 不是均匀 token 流”讲成了可操作的 cache 策略；先看方法图和误差界，再核对 memory budget 是否算干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it operationalizes the idea that CoT is not a uniform token stream; read the method figure and error-bound section first, then verify whether the memory-budget accounting is actually clean.

paper.title: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
paper.abstract: As large language models serve more requests, cumulative inference cost is becoming increasingly important relative to one-time training cost. The two inference phases stress hardware differently: prompt prefill is parallel and typically compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and often memory-bandwidth-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling increases both costs together because every added layer is evaluated in both phases. We ask whether additional learned computation ca

summary.core_problem: LLM推理的prefill（并行处理prompt，受计算吞吐量约束）和decode（逐token生成，受内存带宽约束）两个阶段硬件瓶颈差异显著。传统的宽度/深度缩放会同步提升两个阶段的成本，现有测试时计算缩放方法（如思维链、暂停token）要么增加序列长度开销，要么需要修改持久化状态，无法在保持标准prefill主路径和KV cache结构不变的前提下独立扩展decode侧的计算量。
summary.importance: 为推理侧计算缩放提供了新的架构路径，对预训练研究的具体启发包括：1）共享权重的主辅流设计可在不改变基础模型prefill路径和KV cache接口的前提下，通过decode侧额外计算提升预测质量，为部署感知的架构设计提供参考；2）MoE模型中主辅流独立配置专家激活数的思路，让同一预训练模型可适配不同prefill/decode负载的部署场景；3）混合似然训练目标为多路径模型的监督信号设计提供了可复用的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双流Transformer架构，采用非对称的共享KV设计：主路径是完整的标准因果Transformer，独立处理全量prompt，产生唯一的持久化KV cache，不依赖辅助流；辅助流仅读取主路径的状态和KV cache，不写入持久状态，也不反馈到主路径。两个流共享所有注意力、MLP、输出矩阵，仅使用独立的token embedding和轻量可学习耦合向量。辅助流不参与全prompt的prefill计算，仅在最后一个prompt token位置和后续每个生成token位置执行，因此prefill阶段的计算量和KV cache大小与标准Transformer基本一致。训练时采用两个流next-token分布的混合似然作为监督信号。针对MoE模型，辅助流复用主路径选中的专家并使用自身的混合权重，主辅流的专家激活数可独立配置，形成prefill成本、decode成本、预测质量的三方权衡空间。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类设置：NanoGPT受控数据缩放、LLaMA风格稠密模型尺寸缩放、稀疏MoE基础配置。在相同训练token预算下，双流Transformer持续降低验证集损失；消融实验验证了跨流耦合和混合输出头的独立贡献。MoE变体的实验验证了两种配置模式：固定prefill计算量时增加decode计算可提升性能，固定decode计算量时可在两阶段间重分配计算以适配不同负载，均符合预期的成本-性能权衡规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注架构设计中主辅流的解耦机制、共享KV的实现逻辑、MoE场景下的专家分配方案，以及消融实验结果。可跳过底层实现细节。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM inference has two phases with distinct hardware bottlenecks: prompt prefill processes all tokens in parallel and is compute-throughput bound, while autoregressive decode generates tokens sequentially and is memory-bandwidth bound due to repeated weight and KV cache reads. Conventional width or depth scaling raises costs for both phases proportionally. Existing test-time compute scaling methods (e.g. chain-of-thought, pause tokens) either add sequence length overhead or require modified persistent state, and cannot independently scale decode-side computation while preserving the standard prefill path and KV cache structure.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a new architectural path for test-time compute scaling, with concrete implications for pretraining research: first, the shared-weight primary/auxiliary flow design provides a reference for deployment-aware architecture design, as it improves prediction quality via extra decode compute without changing the base model's prefill path or KV cache interface. Second, independent expert fan-out configuration for primary and auxiliary flows in MoE models allows a single pretrained checkpoint to adapt to deployment workloads with different prefill/decode ratios. Third, the mixture likelihood training objective is a reusable design for supervising multi-path models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-Flow Transformer uses an asymmetric shared-KV design. The primary flow is a full standard causal Transformer that processes the entire prompt independently and produces the only persistent KV cache, with no dependency on the auxiliary flow. The auxiliary flow only reads the primary flow's states and KV cache, never writes persistent state, and never feeds back into the primary flow. The two flows share all attention, MLP, and output matrices, with only separate token embeddings and lightweight learned coupling vectors. The auxiliary flow is not evaluated across the full prompt during prefill — it only runs at the final prompt token position and each subsequent generated token, so prefill compute cost and KV cache size are nearly identical to a standard Transformer. Training uses a mixture likelihood over the two flows' next-token distributions as the supervision signal. For MoE variants, the auxiliary flow reuses the primary flow's selected experts with its own mixture weights, and the expert fan-outs of the two flows can be configured independently to create a three-way trade-off between prefill cost, decode cost, and prediction quality.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover three settings: controlled NanoGPT data scaling, dense LLaMA-style model size scaling, and sparse MoE base configurations. Under matched training token budgets, Dual-Flow consistently reduces validation loss. Ablation studies isolate the individual contributions of cross-flow coupling and the mixture readout head. For MoE variants, experiments verify two allocation regimes: increasing decode compute while holding prefill compute fixed improves performance, and reallocating compute between the two phases while holding decode compute fixed adapts to different workloads, both matching the expected cost-performance trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the architecture section (focus on primary/auxiliary flow decoupling, shared KV mechanism), the MoE expert allocation design, and ablation experiment results. Skip low-level implementation details. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这个想法值得看，因为它直接挑战“模型容量必须同时付 prefill 税”的默认设计；先盯住质量-延迟曲线和 KV 状态是否真干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it challenges the default assumption that extra capacity must always pay the prefill tax; focus on the quality-latency tradeoff and whether the KV-state story is actually clean.

paper.title: vToken: Token-Level Virtualization for Reclaimable KV Caches
paper.abstract: Large language model serving faces a critical memory bottleneck: the KV cache grows with sequence length and batch size. PagedAttention uses fixed-size memory blocks to reduce allocator-level fragmentation, but recent KV eviction algorithms operate at a token granularity finer than block-level management. This mismatch causes intra-block fragmentation, leaving a large fraction of allocated KV memory unreclaimable. We present vToken, a lightweight token-level virtualization layer that decouples l

summary.core_problem: PagedAttention 以固定大小块管理 KV 缓存，而 H2O、StreamingLLM、Scissorhands 等 KV 驱逐算法工作在 token 粒度，两者粒度不匹配导致块内碎片化：当一个块同时包含被驱逐和被保留的 token 时，该块无法释放，大量已分配但利用率低的内存无法被其他请求复用。
summary.importance: 在 token 级驱逐策略与块级 KV 管理之间补上了缺失的运行时抽象层，既保留了 PagedAttention 的内核效率与 CUDA Graph 兼容性，又让任意 token 级驱逐策略能真正转化为可回收的物理内存，对长上下文高并发 serving 系统的容量与工程迭代效率都有直接提升。
summary.technical_approach: 在驱逐策略与 PagedAttention 之间插入 vToken 轻量级 token 级虚拟化层。向上暴露稳定的 per-sequence 逻辑 token 视图，驱逐策略只需指定保留哪些 token，无需感知物理块布局；向下维护逻辑 token 到物理槽位的映射表（token-table indirection），当块内碎片化达到可操作阈值时，异步将存活 token 重打包（repack / lazy compaction）到更少的物理块中，释放空闲块。整个设计不修改 attention kernel，兼容现有 PagedAttention 实现与 CUDA Graph。
summary.experiments: 在 vLLM 中实现 vToken，跨多个模型与 H2O、StreamingLLM、Scissorhands 三种驱逐策略评测。核心结果：相比朴素将驱逐策略直接接到 vLLM 的 Naive-Evict，vToken 减少 16%–85% 的保留 KV 块数；在 SLA 约束下吞吐最高提升 1.37×；在活跃 KV 预算受限场景下，最大可行并发数最高扩展 2×；工程上，新驱逐策略的集成代码量从 500+ 行降到 50 行以内。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 20 分钟。重点看 §2.3 对粒度不匹配导致块内碎片化的量化分析，§3 中 token-table indirection 与异步 repack 的具体设计，以及 §4 中不同驱逐策略下的内存回收与吞吐收益。

summary_en.core_problem: PagedAttention manages KV caches in fixed-size blocks, while KV eviction algorithms such as H2O, StreamingLLM, and Scissorhands operate at token granularity. This granularity mismatch causes intra-block fragmentation: when a block contains both evicted and retained tokens, the block cannot be freed, leaving a large fraction of allocated but underutilized memory unreclaimable by other requests.
summary_en.importance: vToken fills the missing runtime abstraction layer between token-level eviction policies and block-level KV management. It preserves the kernel efficiency and CUDA Graph compatibility of PagedAttention, while enabling arbitrary token-level eviction policies to actually translate into reclaimable physical memory. It directly improves both capacity and engineering iteration velocity for long-context, high-concurrency LLM serving systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: vToken inserts a lightweight token-level virtualization layer between eviction policies and the PagedAttention substrate. Upward, it exposes a stable per-sequence logical token view so eviction policies only specify which tokens to retain, without reasoning about physical block layout. Downward, it maintains a logical-to-physical mapping via token-table indirection; when intra-block fragmentation reaches an actionable threshold, it asynchronously repacks (lazy compacts) live tokens into fewer physical blocks and releases the freed ones. The design requires no attention-kernel modifications and is compatible with existing PagedAttention implementations and CUDA Graph.
summary_en.experiments: vToken is implemented in vLLM and evaluated across multiple models and three eviction policies: H2O, StreamingLLM, and Scissorhands. Key results: compared with Naive-Evict (directly attaching eviction policies to vanilla vLLM), vToken reduces retained KV blocks by 16%–85%; it improves SLA-constrained throughput by up to 1.37×; under a constrained active-KV budget, it extends maximum feasible concurrency by up to 2×; on the engineering side, integration code for a new eviction policy drops from 500+ lines to under 50 lines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 20 minutes. Focus on §2.3 for the quantified analysis of intra-block fragmentation caused by the granularity mismatch, §3 for the token-table indirection and asynchronous repack design, and §4 for memory reclamation and throughput gains across different eviction policies.

recommendation.zh: KV缓存优化的实用系统工作，token级虚拟化解决块内碎片问题，做长上下文架构或推理系统的可参考。
recommendation.en: Practical KV cache optimization work; token-level virtualization solves intra-block fragmentation, useful for long-context architecture or inference system research.

paper.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise to bring end-to-end reasoning to autonomous driving, but their computational cost remains far too high for real-time control. The core challenge is structural: VLA inference is not a single bottleneck but a cascade of four. Visual encoding wastes compute on overlapping video frames; language-model prefill recomputes context that could be carried over from the previous timestep; reasoning tokens are generated serially despite low entropy; and flow-match

summary.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action 模型用于自动驾驶时推理成本过高，且瓶颈不是单点，而是视觉编码、语言模型 prefill、推理 token 生成和 flow-matching 去噪四级串联。
summary.importance: 提出算法-系统协同设计框架，同时处理四个推理瓶颈，展示面向实时控制的 VLA 推理优化思路。
summary.technical_approach: FlashDrive 分别用时间重叠实现跨帧流式 KV-cache 复用；跨时间步携带上下文避免重复 prefill；利用驾驶域推理 token 的低熵和强块内相关性降低串行生成开销；对 flow-matching 速度场非均匀区域施加非均匀计算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名、延迟、加速比或基线数值，仅描述四类瓶颈和对应 shortcut。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action inference for autonomous driving is too expensive for real-time control because it has a cascade of four bottlenecks rather than one.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an algorithm-system co-design framework that addresses all four stages together, offering an engineering template for real-time VLA inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlashDrive uses temporal overlap for streaming KV-cache reuse across frames, carries over context to avoid recomputing LM prefill, exploits low entropy and strong intra-block correlations in driving-domain reasoning tokens, and allocates non-uniform compute to the non-uniform flow-matching velocity field.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model names, latency, speedups, or baseline numbers; it describes the four bottlenecks and corresponding shortcuts.

recommendation.zh: 把 VLA 推理拆成四个瓶颈并分别找 shortcut 的工程框架值得看，但自驾 domain 太重；只借思路，不必细读实验。
recommendation.en: The four-bottleneck decomposition of VLA inference is a useful engineering frame, but the autonomous-driving setup is too domain-specific; borrow the ideas, skip the detailed experiments.

paper.title: MaSRead: Content-Addressed Reading of Replicated Latent Stores
paper.abstract: Independent agents that reason in latent space can share computed state as key-value cache fragments rather than text. Merged by a conflict-free replicated data type, these fragments form a store that converges under any delivery order or duplication. Yet a later query, unknown at encode time, cannot reliably read the merged cache: colocated fragments interfere, so colocation is not addressability. MaSRead addresses the read to content. It routes through opaque keyed tag sets derived from fragme

summary.core_problem: 解决多个在 latent space 中工作的 agent 共享中间表示后，后续查询无法按内容可靠读取所需片段的问题；共享了 cache 不等于可寻址。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不属于主流 LLM 预训练，但它触到一个值得基座研究员注意的点：如果未来 agent 或多阶段推理直接交换 latent/KV 片段，读出机制会成为新的建模瓶颈。贡献更像一种新型记忆寻址与读取机制。
summary.technical_approach: MaSRead 把各 agent 产生的 latent cache 片段存入一个可复制、可合并的 CRDT store；读取时不依赖片段物理共置，而是通过由 fragment words 派生的 opaque keyed tag sets 做内容路由，再对选中的片段施加 hard attention mask 单独解码，避免无关片段干扰。对多跳查询则在 lexical connectivity 图上做 graph walk 逐步检索相关片段。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 chain、pipeline、symmetric、hub 和 natural-language stores，并测试随着无关片段累积时的鲁棒性以及跨模型家族迁移。摘要声称可隔离恢复访问过的片段，且路由后解码成本依赖 fragment length 而非总 store 大小，但没有给出与标准 RAG、memory transformer 或 KV retrieval 的定量对比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a latent-memory retrieval problem: once multiple agents share intermediate latent/cache fragments, later queries cannot reliably read the needed content just because the fragments are colocated.
summary_en.importance: This is not mainstream LLM pretraining, but it touches a real foundation-model concern: if future agents exchange latent or KV fragments directly, the readout mechanism becomes a new modeling bottleneck. The contribution is best viewed as a memory addressing and retrieval design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MaSRead stores latent cache fragments in a replicated CRDT-based store. At read time, it routes by opaque keyed tag sets derived from fragment words rather than physical colocation, then decodes selected fragments under a hard attention mask that hides all others. Multi-hop queries are handled by graph walks over lexical connectivity.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span chain, pipeline, symmetric, hub, and natural-language stores, testing isolation, robustness as unrelated fragments accumulate, and transfer across model families. The abstract claims retrieval quality remains stable and post-routing decoding scales with fragment length rather than total store size, but quantitative comparisons to standard RAG or KV retrieval are not visible in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是主线 pretrain，但它认真碰了“latent 共享后怎么读”这个少有人做的硬问题；先看读取机制和干扰隔离实验，若 baseline 不强就当方向信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it tackles the underexplored question of how to read shared latent memory; inspect the retrieval mechanism and interference-isolation results, while treating conclusions cautiously if baselines are weak.

paper.title: LinearKV: One Cached State Suffices for Position-Independent Caching in Hybrid LLMs
paper.abstract: LLM serving is increasingly accelerated by position-independent caching (PIC). Existing PIC methods, however, are built for full-attention models, where a token-indexed KV cache underlies its core operations: matching reusable token chunks, concatenating their KV entries, and selectively recomputing a few tokens to restore cross-chunk context. Hybrid LLMs break these primitives---they replace most attention layers with linear recurrences that expose only a fixed-size state, leaving no token-inde

summary.core_problem: 现有位置无关缓存（PIC）方法均为全注意力模型设计，依赖token级KV缓存完成拼接和选择性重计算；而混合架构LLM以线性循环层（如Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet）为主、仅含少量全注意力层，循环层仅输出固定大小状态、无token级KV条目，导致PIC的核心操作无法直接复用。论文解决混合架构下无需训练的位置无关缓存实现问题。
summary.importance: 混合架构是长上下文基座模型的重要发展方向，LinearKV提供了一条无需训练即可为混合模型接入PIC加速的路径。其核心发现——单个缓存的循环状态即可完成初始化、无需精确组合所有匹配块的状态——对混合模型的推理系统设计、以及循环层状态可复用性的架构选型都有参考价值，属于混合LLM推理效率方向的实用进展。
summary.technical_approach: LinearKV采用解耦初始化的训练-free框架：全注意力层沿用标准PIC的方式拼接缓存KV；线性循环层无token级KV可拼接，因此将匹配到的K个本地块状态映射为一个初始状态。关键洞察是仅用单个块的缓存状态（如最后一个匹配块）作为初始化就足够鲁棒：在GDN架构模型上与精确组合所有状态的方法效果相当，而精确组合方法在Mamba-2上会完全失效。LinearKV可直接复用现有PIC的token选择器（CacheBlend、EPIC、ProphetKV）来确定重计算位置，重计算时按上下文顺序同时更新全注意力层KV和循环层状态。
summary.experiments: 在三个覆盖两种循环架构、不同循环/注意力比例的混合模型上评测：Granite（Mamba-2）、OLMo（GDN）、Qwen（GDN），搭配三种PIC选择器，在LongBench QA和RULER基准的8K-32K上下文长度下测试。结果显示：精确状态组合方法在Mamba-2上所有选择器下均失效，而单状态初始化方案跨架构均保持鲁棒；所有测试设置下，LinearKV均比全预填充降低了首token延迟（TTFT）。消融实验显示随机选择单个块的效果与选最后一个块相当，说明起作用的是单源构造本身，而非具体块的选择。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看Introduction部分，理解混合架构与标准PIC的核心不匹配点；再关注解耦初始化的设计思路，以及精确状态组合在Mamba-2上失效、单缓存状态即可工作的关键实验结论；附录A的随机块消融可快速浏览。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing position-independent caching (PIC) methods are built exclusively for full-attention LLMs, relying on token-indexed KV caches for concatenation and selective recomputation. Hybrid LLMs, which interleave a small number of full-attention layers with mostly linear recurrent layers (e.g., Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet) that only expose a fixed-size state, lack token-level KV entries to support these PIC primitives. The paper addresses how to enable position-independent caching for hybrid architectures without retraining.
summary_en.importance: Hybrid architectures are a promising direction for long-context foundation models. LinearKV provides a training-free path to add PIC acceleration to hybrid models, and its core finding — that a single cached recurrent state suffices for initialization, rather than exact composition of all matched states — informs both inference system design for hybrid models and potential architectural choices around recurrent state reusability. It is a practical advance in inference efficiency for hybrid LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: LinearKV uses a decoupled initialization framework. For full-attention layers, cached KV entries are concatenated exactly as in standard PIC. For linear recurrent layers, instead of concatenating non-existent token-level entries, the method maps K matched local chunk states to a single initial state. The key insight is that a single cached chunk state (e.g., from the last matched chunk) is sufficient as the initializer: it matches the performance of exact state composition on GDN-based models, while exact composition fails entirely on Mamba-2. LinearKV reuses existing PIC token selectors (CacheBlend, EPIC, ProphetKV) unchanged to choose which positions to recompute, with recomputation updating both full-attention KV and recurrent layer states in context order.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three hybrid models spanning two recurrent families and different recurrent-to-attention ratios: Granite (Mamba-2), OLMo (GDN), and Qwen (GDN). Tests use three PIC selectors on LongBench QA and RULER benchmarks at 8K–32K context length. Exact state composition fails on Mamba-2 across all selectors, while the single-state initializer is robust across all architectures. LinearKV reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) relative to full prefill in all tested settings. Ablation shows a randomly selected single chunk works equally well, confirming the single-source construction is the operative factor rather than specific chunk choice.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the Introduction to understand the mismatch between hybrid architectures and standard PIC. Then focus on the decoupled initialization design and the key experimental finding that exact state composition collapses on Mamba-2 while a single cached state works. Skim the random-chunk ablation in Appendix A. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Hybrid模型做Serving常被“没KV就没法复用”卡死，LinearKV给了一个干净接口；先读方法图和state合成那段，数字再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Hybrid serving often gets stuck on “no KV, no reuse”; LinearKV offers a clean interface—read the method/diagram and the state-composition part, then decide whether to reproduce.

paper.title: QV-PIC: Query-Aware Visual Position-Independent Caching for Efficient RAG Serving
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) repeatedly prefills identical text chunks across queries, incurring redundant computations. Position-Independent Caching (PIC) mitigates it by reusing precomputed Key-Value (KV) across positions, but its efficiency is constrained by the large volume of text tokens. Rendering text chunks as images can compress the text into fewer visual tokens, but the rendered-image PIC suffers more severe quality degradation than the text PIC. This representation-specific ga

summary.core_problem: RAG serving 中相同文档块会在不同查询下反复 prefill，如何复用 KV cache 同时避免 position-independent caching 的质量损失。
summary.importance: 这是推理服务侧的系统优化工作。它把文本块渲染成图像以减少 token 数，并讨论视觉表示下 PIC 质量下降的原因，对长上下文 RAG serving 和多模态缓存设计有参考价值，但不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 QV-PIC，即 query-aware dual-resolution visual PIC reuse。离线阶段按模型原生 chat template 编译视觉缓存，减少模板和上下文不匹配；在线阶段根据查询选择或组合双分辨率视觉证据，以兼顾压缩率和细粒度文本证据保留。方法针对视觉 PIC 相比文本 PIC 更容易退化的问题，补充了表示级修复，而不只做选择性重算。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明 QV-PIC 面向 RAG serving，比较对象包括文本 PIC、渲染图像 PIC 和现有 PIC repair 方法；但截断摘要未提供具体模型、数据集、吞吐/延迟收益、质量保持幅度或显存节省数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Zhejiang University、Beijing Normal-Hong Kong Baptist University、Sun Yat-sen University 和 Tongji University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets redundant prefill computation in RAG serving, where identical retrieved chunks are repeatedly encoded across queries, and studies how to reuse position-independent KV caches without hurting answer quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-serving optimization rather than a pretraining contribution. Its useful angle is the interaction between visual token compression, KV-cache reuse, and evidence fidelity in RAG systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes QV-PIC, a query-aware dual-resolution visual PIC framework. Offline, caches are compiled under the model-native chat template to reduce contextual mismatch. At query time, query-aware reuse of visual caches and dual-resolution evidence aims to recover fine-grained textual details that are lost when rendered documents are compressed into visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates comparisons against text PIC, rendered-image PIC, and existing PIC repair methods, but the truncated text does not provide model size, benchmarks, latency gains, quality deltas, or memory savings.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, Beijing Normal-Hong Kong Baptist University, Sun Yat-sen University, and Tongji University.

recommendation.zh: 服务侧小众但有意思；只看缓存编译和质量退化分析，别把它当通用 RAG 方案。
recommendation.en: Interesting as a serving trick; read the cache-compilation and degradation analysis, not the paper as a general RAG solution.

paper.title: Detecting a Route Flip Is Easier Than Knowing Whether to Fix It: Causal Route-Mediated Damage in Quantized Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Top-k Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing is discontinuous, so a deployment-motivated numerical disturbance -- simulated 4-bit KV-cache quantization read by a protected BF16 gate -- pushes tokens across decision boundaries and flips which experts fire. This paper proposes no new mitigation; it supplies a causal apparatus, empirical findings, and a detection-limit result. A four-run apparatus prices the route-mediated fraction (RMF) of quantization damage, a token-level attribution decomposes it by

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但对部署中的 MoE 很关键的问题：当上游 hidden state 因 4-bit KV-cache 量化发生小幅数值扰动时，硬 top-k 路由会不会跨过决策边界，导致 expert 集合翻转；如果会，这部分损伤到底有多少是“经由路由变化”传导出来的，以及能否仅靠推理时可见的局部信号判断某次 route flip 值不值得修。作者不做缓解方法，而是先把因果分解和可检测性边界讲清楚。核心不是“量化会伤性能”这种常识，而是把量化损伤拆成 compute path 与 route-mediated path，并进一步问：检测到 flip，是否等于知道它有害、且值得干预。全文给出的答案是否定的后半句：flip 可以有一定可检测性，但 flip 的损伤符号几乎不可由局部可观测特征预测。
summary.importance: 对预训练和部署研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 MoE 在低比特部署下的一个常被笼统归因的问题，变成了可测量的中介变量分析问题。对于做 MoE 训练、量化感知训练、router 稳定性正则的人，这个分解很有用，因为它说明损伤不只是 FFN/attention 数值误差，还包含一个离散路由通道。第二，它提醒一个常见误区：route robustness 不能只看 flip rate。作者发现“能检测 flip”与“能判断修复是否有益”是两件不同的事，后者在他们测试的 inference-observable 特征族上接近随机。这对任何想做 selective repair、test-time route correction、router confidence gating 的工作都是直接约束。第三，这篇文章虽然是 pilot scale，但方法论上比较扎实：四运行干预、预注册 held-out endpoint、显式测 interaction，而不是默认加性。对后续研究如何严谨分析训练/部署噪声经由离散决策放大的机制，有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
技术核心是一个四运行的因果 apparatus，用来给“路由中介损伤”定价。四个运行分别是：Y_CC，clean compute + free route，作为基线；Y_QP，quantized compute + clean route pinned，用来测纯 compute path；Y_QF，quantized compute + free route，是实际受扰系统；Y_CT，clean compute + quantized route transplanted，用来测 clean-context 下的 route path，并检查 interaction。这里最关键的设计是 pinning 不是简单 ablation，而是把 clean run 中选出的 expert set 和对应权重原样移植到 quantized hidden state 上，且不重新归一化，以匹配特定实现中的 norm_topk_prob=False。作者明确说明这不是 natural indirect effect，而是一个受控中介干预下的 interventional controlled-route contribution，因此 RMF 的解释依赖这个干预语义。

RMF 的定义也比较讲究。作者不用逐样本 ratio 再取中位数，而是用 ratio of sums：先算 excess_total = L(Y_QF)-L(Y_CC)，再算 excess_compute = L(Y_QP)-L(Y_CC)，两者之差是 excess_route，最后 RMF = sum(excess_route)/sum(excess_total)。这样避免了分母接近 0 时的高方差问题。置信区间用 sequence-cluster bootstrap，而不是 token bootstrap，和自回归序列相关性相匹配。

在 token 级别，作者又做了 attribution partition。对每个 decode token，记录所有层 clean/quantized 下的 top-k route set。若当前 scoring layer 的 route set 变了，记为 jump；若当前层没变但任一上游层变了，记为 nonlocal；若都没变但仍有 route-mediated harm，则记为 pure flux。这个划分的价值在于，它把“路由损伤”进一步拆成局部翻转、上游翻转传导、以及权重/概率流动但不改集合的影响。全文一个很有信息量的发现是，净 signed route-mediated contribution 的 99.8% 与 route-set change 相关，而且多数来自 nonlocal，而不是当前层 jump。这说明很多伤害不是在出问题的 token 当层直接发生，而是上游层 route 改写了后续表征。

检测部分，作者系统测试了 inference-time 可见特征族，尤其是 router margin。margin 对“是否发生 flip”有一定判别力，但对“这个 flip 的损伤符号是正还是负、修了是否有益”几乎无力。即便加入跨 16 层 router vector 等更丰富局部特征，benefit prediction 仍接近 rate-matched random selector。这个结果不是理论不可能性证明，而是对这类局部特征协议下 selective repair 的经验上界。

最后，作者还用 clean-route pinning 测了 reference-fidelity ceiling，并通过同 checkpoint 的 flag swap 分析 gate normalization convention 的作用。结论是某些实现差异更像 damage magnitude moderator，而不是决定 route recoverability 的根因。
summary.experiments:
实验主体围绕三类结果展开。第一类是 route-mediated fraction 的测量。在 OLMoE-1B-7B、4-bit KV 的 pilot 设置下，作者报告 RMF 约 0.31。更具体地，五个 process 的均值是 0.313 ± 0.020；discovery anchor 给出 0.31，区间约 [0.20, 0.41]；预注册重执行得到 0.231。作者没有把单次数字包装成稳定常数，而是反复强调 RMF 依赖架构、量化剂量和 damage domain。另一个重要点是 compute × route interaction 非零，因此不能把总损伤简单看成两条独立路径线性相加。

第二类是 token-level attribution。作者发现净 signed route-mediated contribution 中 99.8% 与 route-set change 相关，而其中多数是 nonlocal，不是当前 scoring layer 的 jump。这说明如果只盯当前层 flip，会漏掉主要伤害来源。这个观察对做 router stabilization 或 route-aware quantization 很重要，因为优化目标可能需要跨层而不是逐层局部化。

第三类是检测与修复上界。router margin 对 flip occurrence 的 AUC 为 0.772，说明“会不会翻”并非完全不可见；但对 flip harm 的 AUC 只有 0.490，基本等于随机。作者还测试了多种局部特征族，没有任何方法能在损伤符号预测上稳定超过 rate-matched random selector。也就是说，若 selective repair 只能依赖这些推理时可见信号，那么收益判断几乎做不到。与此同时，强行 pin clean route 只能回收 routed ceiling 的一部分，幅度约 +0.23 到 +0.46，且不同架构差异明显。这进一步说明 route repair 即便有 oracle，也只能修复总损伤中的有限切片。

从实验设计看，作者比较重视证据等级控制：三架构预注册 probe、held-out split 只读一次、三个预注册 endpoint 中一个 miss 也如实报告。这些细节让结论的边界更清楚：它是 pilot 规模上的经验事实，不是普适定律。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 里的 three claims 和 claim perimeter，弄清作者到底证明了什么、没证明什么。第二，看“四运行 apparatus + RMF 定义”那一节，这是全文最值得读的部分，尤其是为什么 pinning 被定义成中介干预而不是自然间接效应，以及为什么 RMF 用 ratio of sums。第三，看检测实验和 Table 5 一类的特征比较，理解“flip 可检测但 benefit 不可检测”这个负结果是怎么建立起来的。

如果时间有限，优先读：方法定义、RMF/interaction 结果图表、token attribution 的 jump/nonlocal/pure-flux 分解、以及 AUC 结果。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线。若想深挖，重点看作者如何处理干预语义、bootstrap 单位、预注册 protocol，以及 clean-route pinning 的实现细节。这些地方决定了结论能否被后续工作复用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a deployment-relevant failure mode in sparse MoE models: small numerical perturbations from 4-bit KV-cache quantization can push router inputs across hard top-k decision boundaries, changing which experts fire. The central question is not merely whether quantization hurts, but how much of that damage is mediated by routing changes rather than by the ordinary compute path, and whether inference-time observable signals are sufficient to tell when a route flip is worth fixing. The paper does not propose a mitigation. It builds a causal measurement setup and shows a sharper point: detecting that a flip occurred is materially easier than predicting whether that flip is harmful.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and deployment work on MoE, the main contribution is methodological. It turns a vague robustness issue into a measurable mediator-analysis problem. That matters for anyone working on router regularization, quantization-aware training, or MoE stability, because the damage channel is not only numerical degradation inside attention/FFN; there is also a discrete routing channel with its own behavior. A second contribution is the negative result on selective repair: flip detection and benefit prediction are different problems, and the latter appears close to random under the tested inference-observable feature families. That places a practical constraint on test-time route correction schemes that rely on router confidence or local diagnostics. A third contribution is experimental discipline: four-run interventions, explicit interaction measurement, and preregistered held-out endpoints. Even at pilot scale, that makes the conclusions more useful than a simple correlation study.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is a four-run causal apparatus that prices the route-mediated component of quantization damage. The four runs are: Y_CC, clean compute with free routing; Y_QP, quantized compute with the clean route pinned; Y_QF, quantized compute with free routing; and Y_CT, clean compute with the quantized route transplanted. The key intervention is route pinning: the clean expert set and clean routing weights are imposed verbatim under quantized hidden states, without renormalization, matching the implementation convention with norm_topk_prob=False. The authors are careful about semantics: this is not a natural indirect effect, but an interventional controlled-route contribution under a cross-context mediator intervention.

The route-mediated fraction, RMF, is defined as a ratio of sums rather than an average of per-sequence ratios. Specifically, excess_total = L(Y_QF) - L(Y_CC), excess_compute = L(Y_QP) - L(Y_CC), excess_route = excess_total - excess_compute, and RMF = sum(excess_route) / sum(excess_total). This avoids unstable behavior when per-example denominators are near zero. Confidence intervals are computed with sequence-cluster bootstrap, which is the right unit for autoregressive dependence.

The token-level attribution is also well designed. For each decoded token, the top-k route set is recorded at every layer under clean and quantized compute. If the scoring layer’s route set changes, the token is labeled jump. If the scoring layer is unchanged but some upstream layer changed, it is labeled nonlocal. Otherwise it is pure flux. This partition lets the authors separate direct local route flips from upstream route perturbations that propagate through later representations, and from route-weight changes that do not alter the selected set.

A notable empirical result is that 99.8% of the net signed route-mediated contribution is associated with route-set changes, and most of that is nonlocal rather than local jump. That is an important mechanistic clue: much of the damage is not a same-layer routing event on the harmed token, but a consequence of earlier route changes.

For detectability, the paper evaluates inference-time observable feature families, especially router margin. Margin has some power for predicting whether a flip occurred, but essentially no power for predicting the sign of the flip’s harm. Even richer local features, including cross-layer router vectors over all 16 layers, remain near chance for benefit prediction. This is not a theorem of impossibility, but it is a meaningful empirical bound for selective repair protocols restricted to such signals.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline quantitative result is an RMF around 0.31 on OLMoE under 4-bit KV quantization in the pilot setting. The five-process mean is reported as 0.313 ± 0.020; the discovery anchor is 0.31 with an interval around [0.20, 0.41]; a preregistered re-execution gives 0.231. The paper explicitly avoids treating this as a universal constant and stresses that the partition depends on architecture, quantization dose, and damage domain. Another important result is that the compute × route interaction is nonzero, so additive decomposition is not justified.

At token level, 99.8% of the net signed route-mediated contribution is tied to route-set changes, with the majority coming from nonlocal rather than same-layer jump events. That suggests that route robustness analyses focused only on local flips will miss most of the signed effect.

On detectability, router margin reaches AUC 0.772 for flip occurrence, which means flips are not invisible. But for flip harm, the AUC is 0.490, effectively chance. Across the tested local feature families, no predictor of the loss sign beats a rate-matched random selector. In other words, under the tested protocol, selective repair cannot reliably identify which flips are worth fixing. Clean-route pinning recovers only a bounded slice of the routed ceiling, roughly +0.23 to +0.46 depending on architecture, again indicating that even an oracle route intervention would only repair part of the total damage.

The experimental protocol is also worth noting: preregistered probes across three architectures, a reserved held-out split read once, and explicit reporting of one preregistered miss. That makes the scope of the claims clearer: these are pilot-scale empirical findings, not universal laws.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the claim perimeter. The paper is careful about what it does and does not establish, and that framing matters. Then read the section defining the four-run apparatus and RMF. That is the conceptual center of the work, especially the intervention semantics and the reason for using a ratio of sums. After that, go to the token-level attribution results and the detectability tables, particularly the comparison between flip detection and harm prediction.

If reading time is limited, focus on: the four-run setup, the RMF and interaction results, the jump/nonlocal/pure-flux decomposition, and the AUC results for router margin and other local features. That should take about 25 to 35 minutes. For a deeper read, pay attention to the intervention semantics, bootstrap unit choice, preregistration protocol, and the exact implementation of route pinning. Those details determine how reusable the methodology is.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但很适合做 MoE 部署的人看：结论不花哨，胜在把“量化伤害到底伤在哪”拆开了；重点看 RMF 定义和 harmful-vs-helpful flip 的负结果。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but useful if you care about MoE deployment: it cleanly decomposes where quantization damage comes from; focus on the RMF setup and the negative result on harmful-vs-helpful flip detection.

paper.title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
paper.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple future visual prediction with robot action generation, enabling policies to model how the physical world evolves during interaction. Existing WAMs differ in how predictive dynamics are exposed to the action pathway. Explicit-future WAMs provide direct access to predicted scene evolution, but incur substantial inference costs from iterative video denoising. In contrast, direct-policy WAMs efficiently predict actions from the current observation but lack an explic

summary.core_problem: 显式未来World Action Model推理成本高（迭代视频去噪），直接策略WAM缺乏将预测动态暴露给动作生成的接口
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM，不解码未来视频即可为动作生成提供预测上下文
summary.technical_approach: Future-KV对当前视觉latent和随机未来slot做单次Video DiT prefill，复用层KV状态贯穿动作去噪；引入dynamics registers监督预测动态
summary.experiments: 在机器人操作任务上验证，Future-KV单次prefill后复用KV状态，避免迭代视频去噪的高推理成本

summary_en.core_problem: Explicit-future World Action Models incur high inference cost from iterative video denoising, while direct-policy WAMs lack an interface to expose predictive dynamics to action generation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM that provides predictive context for action generation without decoding future videos
summary_en.technical_approach: Future-KV performs a single Video DiT prefill over current visual latent and stochastic future slots, reusing layer-wise KV states throughout action denoising; dynamics registers supervise predictive dynamics
summary_en.experiments: Validated on robot manipulation tasks; Future-KV reuses KV from a single prefill, avoiding the high inference cost of iterative video denoising

recommendation.zh: Future-KV单次prefill复用KV的思路对diffusion LM推理效率有迁移价值，但整体是机器人工作，看方法节即可
recommendation.en: The Future-KV single-prefill KV-reuse idea transfers to diffusion LM inference efficiency, but this is a robotics paper—read the method section only.

paper.title: When Vision Becomes Text: Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Residual Guidance in VLMs
paper.abstract: Abundant visual information strengthens vision-language model (VLM) perception, yet massive visual tokens raise inference costs. Existing visual token pruning methods rely on similarity-based guidance, which exploits pairwise text-vision and vision-vision token correlations for compression. However, such methods only capture local layer-level signals and overlook the whole inference process in VLM. In this paper, we revisit VLM inference and present a new efficient guidance scheme that complemen

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 VLM 推理中的视觉 token 冗余问题：现有剪枝方法多依赖单层 attention 或相似度，缺少对文本 token 在深层逐步吸收视觉信息这一过程的刻画。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在多模态表示动态分析和推理效率。论文给出一个清晰观察：随着 LLM 层数加深，一部分视觉 token 信息会被文本表示吸收，因此继续保留所有视觉 token 的边际收益下降。这对 native multimodal pretrain、视觉 token budget、跨模态 token routing 都有启发。训练阶段可以考虑让视觉信息在合适层被压缩到文本或共享 latent 中；推理阶段则可以用残差信息而不是原始相似度判断哪些视觉 token 仍有保留价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是分析指标 Cross Modal Absorption，简称 CMA。它在每一层把中心化后的视觉 token 矩阵投影到文本 token 张成的子空间中，用投影可解释的 Frobenius norm 比例衡量视觉信息被文本子空间吸收的程度。CMA 是层级指标，用来描述随层深变化的整体趋势。第二步是 token 级剪枝指标 Cross Modal Residual，简称 CMR。对每个视觉 token，用 Tikhonov regularization 做正则化最小二乘投影，计算它在文本子空间之外的残差；残差越大，说明该 token 仍包含文本表示尚未解释的视觉信息。最终方法 SIEVE 把三类信号结合起来：CMR 衡量视觉独特性，text-to-visual attention 衡量任务相关性，残差空间中的 diversity selection 去除冗余。与只看原特征相似度的剪枝相比，残差空间先剥离了已被文本解释的成分，因此更适合找互补视觉信息。方法不训练模型，可插入已有 VLM。
summary.experiments: 分析部分在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的 32 层上进行，覆盖 TextVQA、POPE、MME 三个 benchmark，共 16,284 个样本。CMA 随层数单调增加：POPE 从 0.008 到 0.209，MME 从 0.009 到 0.217，TextVQA 从 0.017 到 0.396；三者与层深的 Spearman 相关系数均为 +0.99。这说明视觉表征确实逐层变得更容易由文本子空间解释。方法实验覆盖三种 VLM 架构和八个 benchmark，报告在降低计算和显存开销的同时保持任务表现，并带来实际推理加速。给定正文没有完整提供各压缩率、延迟、显存和精度表，因此具体收益需要读实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Analysis 中 CMA 的定义和 Figure 2，因为这是方法成立的核心证据。再看 Method 中 CMR 的正则化投影公式、SIEVE 如何融合 CMR、attention relevance 和 residual-space diversity。实验部分重点看不同保留率下的 accuracy-latency 曲线、跨 LLaVA / InternVL / Qwen-VL 等架构的稳定性，以及 OCR、幻觉检测、多图或高分辨率场景是否掉点。消融部分要确认 CMR 单独使用、attention 单独使用、diversity 单独使用的贡献，避免把收益误认为只是常规 attention pruning 的变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets visual-token redundancy in VLM inference. Existing pruning methods mostly use single-layer attention or feature similarity, while this work models a process that happens across depth: text tokens gradually absorb part of the visual information.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal representation dynamics and efficient inference, rather than pretraining objectives. The key observation is that visual information does not remain fully isolated in visual tokens; deeper text states can explain an increasing portion of it. This has implications for native multimodal pretraining, visual token budgets, and cross-modal routing. During training, one may encourage visual information to move into shared or textual latent states at the right depth. During inference, pruning can focus on visual residuals that have not yet been explained by text.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first defines Cross Modal Absorption, or CMA. At each layer, centered visual-token representations are projected onto the subspace spanned by text-token representations, and the explainable Frobenius-norm ratio measures how much visual information has been absorbed by the text subspace. CMA is a layer-level diagnostic. For pruning, the paper introduces Cross Modal Residual, or CMR, at the token level. Each visual token is projected onto the text subspace using Tikhonov-regularized least squares, and the residual measures the visual information not explained by text. A larger residual means the token still carries complementary visual content. The final method, SIEVE, combines CMR for visual distinctiveness, text-to-visual attention for task relevance, and diversity selection in the residual space to reduce redundancy. It is training-free and can be applied to existing VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The representation analysis uses all 32 layers of LLaVA-1.5-7B on TextVQA, POPE, and MME, with 16,284 samples in total. CMA increases monotonically with depth: from 0.008 to 0.209 on POPE, from 0.009 to 0.217 on MME, and from 0.017 to 0.396 on TextVQA. The Spearman correlation with layer depth is +0.99 for all three benchmarks. This provides direct evidence that deeper text representations explain more visual-token content. The pruning experiments cover three VLM architectures and eight benchmarks, reporting reduced compute and memory with practical inference acceleration while maintaining task performance. The provided text does not include the full accuracy, latency, memory, or pruning-ratio tables, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the CMA definition and Figure 2, since they motivate the whole method. Then read the CMR derivation, especially the regularized projection onto the text subspace, and how SIEVE combines CMR, attention relevance, and residual-space diversity. In the experiments, focus on accuracy-latency trade-off curves, robustness across different VLM backbones, and behavior on OCR-heavy, hallucination-sensitive, high-resolution, or multi-image inputs. The ablations should be checked carefully: CMR alone, attention alone, diversity alone, and their combinations determine whether the method is more than a variant of standard attention-based pruning.

recommendation.zh: CMA 这个度量可借鉴到 VLM KV-cache 压缩，看方法和图即可，不必复现。
recommendation.en: The CMA metric is a useful angle for VLM KV-cache compression; read the method and figures, no need to reproduce.

paper.title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models map camera images and language instructions directly to motor commands through a single autoregressive transformer. In real-time control, they still spend substantial compute recomputing key-value(KV) representations for visual tokens that barely change across neighboring frames. Recent work such as VLA-Cache reduces that cost by reusing KV states for visually static patches, but its policy relies only on observation-space heuristics and does not account for th

summary.core_problem: 在视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的实时控制中，如何更高效、自适应地重用视觉 token 的 KV Cache，以减少计算开销？
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需训练的门控机制，利用模型自身的置信度信号来决定是否重用 KV Cache，改进了仅依赖观察空间启发式规则的现有方法，对 VLM 的高效推理有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gated VLA-Cache，通过监控解码期间预测的前两个动作 token 之间的 logit margin（零成本的置信度信号）来实现神经内省。当 margin 低于阈值时，缓存失效并触发完全重新计算。
summary.experiments: 在四个 LIBERO 基准测试套件上使用 OpenVLA 和 OpenVLA-OFT 进行了评估，证明了该方法能有效提升推理效率。

summary_en.core_problem: How to more efficiently and adaptively reuse the KV Cache of visual tokens in real-time control of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to reduce computational overhead?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free gating mechanism that uses the model's own confidence signal to decide whether to reuse the KV Cache, improving upon existing methods that rely solely on observation-space heuristics, offering insights for efficient VLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gated VLA-Cache, which achieves neural introspection by monitoring the logit margin between the top two predicted action tokens (a zero-cost confidence signal) during decoding. When the margin drops below a threshold, the cache is invalidated and a full recompute is triggered.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four LIBERO benchmark suites with OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in improving inference efficiency.

recommendation.zh: 利用 logit margin 作为置信度信号来控制 KV Cache 重用，思路简单有效，可作为 VLM 推理优化的参考，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Using logit margin as a confidence signal to control KV Cache reuse is simple and effective, serving as a reference for VLM inference optimization; no need to read the full text.

paper.title: ImpactHO: Importance-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Multi-User Edge LLM Handover
paper.abstract: Edge LLMs must preserve inference continuity when a user hands over between edge nodes, requiring key-value (KV) cache transfer to the target node. However, simultaneous handovers saturate the backhaul, preventing full cache delivery within the mobility-imposed transfer window. Rather than allocating bandwidth as if all cache entries were equally valuable, we order each user's KV cache by importance and transmit only its most informative fraction, turning token-level sparsity into communication

summary.core_problem: 解决边缘 LLM 服务中用户跨边缘节点切换时 KV cache 需要迁移、但多用户同时切换会让回传带宽不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理服务系统优化。它不是预训练方法，但对长上下文服务、KV cache 价值分布、部分 cache 保留后的精度退化建模有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ImpactHO：先按重要性对每个用户的 KV cache entry 排序，只传输信息量最高的一部分；再把多用户 cache 迁移建模成回传带宽分配问题，以平均准确率最大化为目标。每个用户的 partial-cache accuracy 被拟合成 sigmoid utility，并利用重要性排序带来的前段高收益进行资源分配。
summary.experiments: 实验在 RULER benchmark 上测量不同模型和上下文长度下的部分 KV cache 精度曲线，sigmoid 拟合达到 R²>0.99。摘要称重要性排序让准确率曲线的凹区几乎覆盖整个 cache，使分配器能把用户保持在高边际收益区间；未给出具体 LLM 参数量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache transfer during edge-LLM handover, where simultaneous user mobility can exceed the available backhaul bandwidth.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-serving optimization. It does not change pretraining, but it is relevant to long-context serving, KV-cache value distribution, and accuracy degradation under partial cache retention.
summary_en.technical_approach: ImpactHO ranks each user's KV-cache entries by importance and transfers only the most informative fraction. It then formulates multi-user cache transfer as a backhaul allocation problem that maximizes average accuracy. Each user's partial-cache accuracy is modeled as a sigmoid utility curve, exploiting the high-value prefix created by importance ordering.
summary_en.experiments: The paper measures partial-cache accuracy on the RULER benchmark across models and context lengths, fitting the utility curves with R² above 0.99. The abstract claims importance ordering makes the concave region span nearly the whole cache, enabling the allocator to keep users in a high-marginal-gain region. Model sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 partial KV accuracy 的 sigmoid 拟合和排序策略；对训练无直接作用，但能补 KV cache 价值分布的直觉。
recommendation.en: Skim the sigmoid fit for partial-KV accuracy and the ranking policy; not a training paper, but useful intuition on KV-cache value distribution.

paper.title: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
paper.abstract: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) post-training pipelines for large language models (LLMs) increasingly combine rollout workloads across multiple domains and feedback paradigms. Prefix-aware routing improves inference efficiency through cache reuse and load balancing, but it does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity. When reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and agentic rollouts share an

summary.core_problem: RL 后训练中 RLVR、RLHF、agentic rollout 共享异步推理服务时，异构 workload 对 KV-cache 的竞争未被现有 prefix-aware 路由控制，且不能扭曲 trainer 指定的 workload 混合比例。
summary.importance: 系统工作：针对混合 RL rollout 场景的 KV-cache 调度，解决 prefix-aware 路由只关注 cache 复用和负载均衡、不处理异构 session 对 KV 容量竞争的问题。
summary.technical_approach: MISA-T 是路由层的准入策略，结合三部分：自适应 session 准入、workload 感知的 KV 容量分配、驻留时间感知的 KV 计费。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或 baseline 对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Zetao Hong、Song Yuan、Yuanhao Ding、Yibo Zhu、Daxin Jiang、Zhibin Wang、Chen Tian；机构未在摘要中明确。

summary_en.core_problem: When RLVR, RLHF, and agentic rollouts share an asynchronous inference service, existing prefix-aware routing does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity, and must not distort the workload mixture specified by the trainer.
summary_en.importance: System work on KV-cache scheduling for mixed RL rollout serving, addressing the gap that prefix-aware routing only optimizes cache reuse and load balancing without handling KV-capacity competition across heterogeneous sessions.
summary_en.technical_approach: MISA-T is a routing-layer admission policy combining adaptive session admission, workload-aware KV-capacity allocation, and residency-time-aware KV accounting.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental results or baselines are provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Zetao Hong, Song Yuan, Yuanhao Ding, Yibo Zhu, Daxin Jiang, Zhibin Wang, Chen Tian; institution not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 RL 后训练 serving 的人可看，核心是 KV-cache 按 workload 异构性分配容量；对纯预训练研究员参考价值有限。
recommendation.en: Useful for RL post-training serving teams; the core idea is workload-aware KV-cache allocation. Limited direct value for pure pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time compute scaling is a primary driver of performance in large reasoning models (LRMs), but extreme inefficiency bounds current approaches, shifting the critical question from \emph{how much} compute to spend, to \emph{where} to allocate it. We formalize test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem over partial trajectories. Under a fixed hardware budget, existing paradigms fail to actively allocate the compute to the most promising partial progress: traditional paralle

summary.core_problem: 在固定硬件预算下，如何把 test-time compute 主动分配到最有希望的推理轨迹上，而不是并行采样或简单剪枝。
summary.importance: 属于 test-time scaling 与推理分配的方法创新，触及 best-of-N、tree/beam search 与 GPU 利用率之间的根本权衡，对推理模型训练与 serving 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gambit，做 thought-level beam search：周期性剪枝无希望轨迹，并立即从高质量前缀分叉新轨迹，动态把算力集中到 promising prefixes；通过 KV-cache 复用与调度避免剪枝导致的 GPU 饥饿。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体数字，但声称在固定硬件预算下相对并行采样和剪枝式方法有显著收益；作者包含 Tri Dao，系统实现可信度较高。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Tri Dao（Stanford，FlashAttention/FlashDecoding/Mamba 等）和 Ravi Netravali（Princeton/Stanford 系统方向），系统侧实现功底强。

summary_en.core_problem: How to actively allocate a fixed hardware budget to the most promising reasoning trajectories, rather than relying on independent parallel sampling or subtractive pruning.
summary_en.importance: A test-time scaling / compute-allocation method that addresses the core trade-off between best-of-N, tree/beam search, and GPU utilization; relevant to both reasoning-model training and serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gambit performs thought-level beam search: it periodically prunes unpromising traces and immediately branches new ones from high-quality prefixes, concentrating compute on promising prefixes while using KV-cache reuse and scheduling to avoid GPU starvation from pruning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no concrete numbers but claims substantial gains over parallel sampling and pruning baselines under a fixed hardware budget; Tri Dao's involvement lends credibility to the systems implementation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Tri Dao (Stanford; FlashAttention, FlashDecoding, Mamba) and Ravi Netravali (systems), suggesting strong implementation quality.

recommendation.zh: 把 beam search 从 token 级抬到 thought 级并解决剪枝导致的 GPU 饥饿，是 test-time 算力分配的干净 formulation；重点看算法与 KV-cache 调度那节。
recommendation.en: Lifts beam search to the thought level and fixes GPU starvation from pruning; read the algorithm and KV-cache scheduling sections for a clean test-time compute allocation framing.

paper.title: Deferred Audio Pruning with Local Audio-Visual Dynamics for Omni-LLMs
paper.abstract: Omni-modal LLMs jointly process audio, video, and text, but long multimodal sequences incur substantial prefill and KV-cache costs. Existing omni-modal compression methods primarily focus on pre-LLM token reduction, leaving modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary underexplored. We propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework that defers audio pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge. Our analysis shows that audio exhibits higher task-relevant information density and

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 omni-LLM 在长音视频输入下 prefill 和 KV-cache 成本过高的问题，尤其关注跨 LLM 边界的模态特定压缩策略。
summary.importance: 它不是基座预训练论文，但对统一多模态模型的系统设计很有参考价值。贡献点在于：不是一味在 LLM 前做 token reduction，而是把压缩延后到 query-conditioned 跨模态交互出现之后，再做模态差异化裁剪，这对未来 native multimodal pretrain 和 serving 一体化设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 A-PACK，两阶段压缩框架。第一阶段在进入 LLM 前保留音频、利用局部音视频动态信息压缩视频；第二阶段在 LLM 内部根据相关性逐步裁剪音频和视觉 token 及其 KV-cache。论文的关键观察是：音频 token 的任务相关信息密度和表示多样性高于视频，因此不应像现有方法那样过早压缩音频；同时，局部 audio-visual dynamics 比 token-wise matching 更适合作为视觉选择信号。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 和 3B 上、四个 benchmark 上评测。摘要称 A-PACK 在所比较方法中取得最强平均性能，同时显著降低 prefill 与 KV-cache 开销，但未给出具体压缩率和精度损失。若正文 ablation 充分，这篇的价值主要在“何时压缩、压哪种模态、是否连 KV 一起裁”这三个设计判断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high prefill and KV-cache cost of omni-LLMs on long audio-video inputs, with a focus on modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper, but it is relevant to system design for unified multimodal models. The key contribution is to avoid compressing everything before the LLM; instead, it defers pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge, which is a useful design idea for future native multimodal pretraining and serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework. Before the LLM, it preserves audio and compresses video using local audio-visual dynamics. Inside the LLM, it progressively prunes low-relevance audio and visual tokens together with their KV-cache entries. The central empirical observations are that audio has higher task-relevant information density and representational diversity per token than video, and that local audio-visual dynamics are a better cue for visual selection than token-wise matching.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B and 3B across four benchmarks. The abstract claims the best average performance among prior methods while reducing prefill and KV-cache costs, but does not report exact trade-offs. The main value likely lies in the ablations around when to compress, which modality to preserve, and whether KV entries should be pruned jointly.

recommendation.zh: 多模态长序列系统里“先压视频、晚压音频”这个判断值得记住；读实验部分和 ablation 就够，方法本身偏工程但 prior 改得还算干净。
recommendation.en: The useful takeaway is the design prior: compress video early, defer audio pruning; read the experiments and ablations, since the method is mostly systems work but the modality asymmetry is worth internalizing.

paper.title: KVDiagnosis: A Diagnostic Benchmark for KV-Cache Compression in Long-Context Language Models
paper.abstract: KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory, but aggregate task scores reveal neither which correct executions fail nor why. We present KVDiagnosis, a diagnostic dataset and benchmark with three contributions. First, a 25-method taxonomy groups methods into five mechanism families and links them to eight verified implementations and their valid diagnostic measurements. Second, for every supported method setting, we evaluate all sources in each fixed split against a per-source FullCache cont

summary.core_problem: 现有KV-cache压缩评估仅使用聚合任务分数，无法揭示哪些正确执行失败以及具体失败原因的问题
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，提出首个KV-cache压缩细粒度诊断基准，建立了方法分类学和统一测量格式
summary.technical_approach: 将25种KV-cache压缩方法划分为5个机制家族，对应8种已验证实现；对每个方法设置，在固定数据划分上与全缓存基线逐源对比，筛选出全缓存正确、压缩后错误的C-to-W样本；设计统一记录格式关联输出、运行元数据与缓存、似然、注意力、解码等多维度测量指标
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-8B上测试4种证据感知工作负载，生成59800次压缩运行，覆盖2600个源，得到12520个C-to-W样本；固定诊断规则下63.2%的样本可测量性低或部分可测

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache compression evaluations only use aggregate task scores, which cannot reveal which correct executions fail or why
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: presents the first fine-grained diagnostic benchmark for KV-cache compression, with a method taxonomy and unified measurement format
summary_en.technical_approach: Groups 25 KV-cache compression methods into 5 mechanism families with 8 verified implementations; for each method setting, compares against per-source FullCache baseline on fixed splits to select C-to-W (correct-to-wrong) samples separately; designs a common record format linking outputs, run metadata to cache, likelihood, attention and decoding measurements
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Qwen3-8B with 4 evidence-aware workloads, yielding 59,800 compressed runs across 2,600 sources and 12,520 C-to-W rows; 63.2% of samples have low or partial measurability under fixed diagnostic rules

recommendation.zh: KV-cache压缩的诊断基准设计精细，C-to-W样本筛选方法值得做长上下文推理的研究者参考，重点看方法部分的分类学和测量格式
recommendation.en: A well-designed diagnostic benchmark for KV-cache compression; the C-to-W sample selection method is worth referencing for long-context inference work, focus on the taxonomy and measurement format in methods

paper.title: RotaryQuant: Fitting 120B MoE Models on Consumer Hardware via Fused Compressed-Space Attention
paper.abstract: Large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models with 26--120 billion parameters exceed the memory capacity of consumer devices through three simultaneous pressures: resident weight matrices, key-value (KV) cache state that grows linearly with context, and dozens of expert sublayers that must be paged on demand. We present RotaryQuant, a three-axis compression system that addresses all three. Mixed-precision weight quantization assigns bit-widths by architectural role: 4-bit for dense layers, 2-bi

summary.core_problem: 26B–120B MoE语言模型在消费级硬件上同时面临权重驻留、KV缓存随上下文线性增长、专家子层按需分页三重内存压力，如何三轴压缩使其可运行。
summary.importance: 工程系统创新，针对MoE serving的真实瓶颈给出按架构角色区分位宽的量化方案，并提出新的KV缓存压缩方法IsoQuant；对MoE部署与KV量化有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 三轴压缩：(1) 混合精度权重量化——dense层4-bit、routed experts 2-bit、shared expert因激活高峰度（kurtosis）抗压缩差而用8-bit；(2) LRU专家卸载到磁盘；(3) IsoQuant——先做Walsh-Hadamard变换再用块对角SO(4)旋转使激活分布各向同性，然后3-bit标量量化，每头仅存256个参数、O(d log d)开销。
summary.experiments: 面向26B–120B MoE模型在消费级硬件上的部署；摘要未给出与vLLM/同类量化方案的具体端到端吞吐与精度对比数字，需读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: How to fit 26B–120B MoE language models on consumer hardware under three simultaneous memory pressures: resident weights, linearly growing KV cache, and on-demand expert paging.
summary_en.importance: A systems contribution targeting real MoE serving bottlenecks, with role-aware mixed-precision quantization and a novel KV-cache compression scheme (IsoQuant); directly relevant to MoE deployment and KV quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-axis compression: (1) mixed-precision weight quantization—4-bit dense, 2-bit routed experts, and 8-bit for the shared expert whose high activation kurtosis resists aggressive quantization; (2) LRU expert offloading to disk; (3) IsoQuant—Walsh-Hadamard transform followed by block-diagonal SO(4) rotations to isotropize activations before 3-bit scalar quantization, with 256 stored parameters per head and O(d log d) cost.
summary_en.experiments: Targets 26B–120B MoE models on consumer hardware; the abstract gives no concrete end-to-end throughput/accuracy numbers against vLLM or comparable quantization methods, so the body must be checked.

recommendation.zh: MoE按角色分配位宽的观察（shared expert需8-bit、routed可2-bit）值得在内部量化ablation复现；IsoQuant的WHT+SO(4)各向同性化看§方法即可。
recommendation.en: The role-aware bit-width observation (8-bit shared expert, 2-bit routed) is worth reproducing in internal quantization ablations; read the IsoQuant WHT+SO(4) section for the KV trick.

paper.title: VoxZip: Semantic-Anchored Temporal KV Cache Compression for Long-Context Audio Inference
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Speech Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding complex audio tasks. Despite this progress, their long-context inference remains severely bottlenecked by prohibitive KV cache memory demands. Existing text-centric compression methods struggle here, often disrupting speech continuity or discarding crucial semantic cues. To address this, we propose VoxZip, a train-free, two-stage semantic-anchored KV cache compression framework. The fir

summary.core_problem: 解决 Speech LLM 在长音频上下文推理时 KV cache 占用过高、直接套用文本压缩方法会破坏语音连续性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法，重点在音频长上下文场景。它不是预训练方法，但对语音 LM 的 token 冗余、语义锚点和缓存保留策略有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VoxZip，一个免训练的两阶段 KV cache 压缩框架。第一阶段用 ASR 转写作为显式语义锚点，对音频 token 做时间对齐、压缩和融合，以降低初始 KV cache 并提高 token 信息密度；第二阶段使用带时间衰减的累积 attention 动态过滤低价值 token，同时缓解早期 token 偏置。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 Qwen3-Omni 上覆盖六类音频任务做综合评测。具体压缩率、准确率变化和延迟收益未在给定摘要中完整呈现，因此需要读实验表确认质量-压缩曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: VoxZip addresses the excessive KV-cache memory cost of long-context inference in Speech LLMs, where text-oriented compression can damage speech continuity and remove semantic cues.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency method for audio LLMs. It is not a pretraining paper, but it gives useful evidence about redundancy, semantic anchoring, and cache retention in speech-token sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free two-stage KV-cache compression framework. Stage one uses ASR transcripts as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, reducing the initial cache while increasing token information density. Stage two applies dynamic filtering with temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict less useful tokens and reduce early-token bias.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six audio task categories. The provided text does not expose exact compression ratios, accuracy deltas, or latency numbers, so the quality-compression tradeoff needs to be checked in the experimental tables.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和压缩率-质量曲线；ASR anchor 若有效，说明语音 token cache 不能照搬文本启发式。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and compression-quality curves; if ASR anchoring holds, audio-token caches should not reuse text heuristics blindly.

paper.title: RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated. To address this issue, we propose RippleKV, which allocates cache across

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 总预算有限时，如何在不同层之间分配缓存的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理内存优化方法。它把层级 KV 分配从启发式代理指标，转向直接测量某层 value cache 扰动对最终预测分布的影响，对长上下文 serving 和 cache compression 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RippleKV：在小校准集上，对每一层的 value cache 独立注入范数自适应扰动，测量输出分布的 KL divergence；把多样本平均后的响应作为层敏感度，再归一化为各层缓存预算 multiplier。方法不是按深度单调分配，也不直接依赖 attention statistic 或 hidden-state change。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、校准集规模、压缩比例或吞吐/困惑度提升。可确认的实验信号是方法围绕有限 KV cache budget 下的跨层分配，与基于层深、注意力统计、表示变化等代理方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to allocate a fixed KV-cache budget across transformer layers during long-context LLM inference.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-memory optimization contribution. The useful shift is from heuristic layer proxies to a direct estimate of how perturbing a layer’s value cache changes the final predictive distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: RippleKV injects norm-adaptive perturbations into each layer’s value cache independently on a small calibration set, measures the induced output KL divergence, averages the responses into a model-specific sensitivity profile, and converts that profile into layer-wise budget multipliers. The allocation is not assumed to be monotonic with depth.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, calibration-set size, compression ratios, or latency/quality numbers. The stated comparisons are against allocation rules based on layer depth, attention statistics, and representation-change proxies.

recommendation.zh: 只看扰动校准的定义和层敏感度曲线；若曲线稳定，内部 KV 压缩 ablation 可以复现。
recommendation.en: Read the perturbation calibration and layer-sensitivity plots; if the profiles are stable, this is worth reproducing in internal KV-compression ablations.

paper.title: DistillCache: KL-Guided Adaptive KV-Cache Eviction for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks, but their Key-Value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing heuristic eviction methods (e.g., H$_2$O and SnapKV) rely on static attention or positional signals that often fail to capture a token's future predictive influence. We propose DistillCache, a reinforcement learning framework that formulates KV-cache eviction as a s

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理时 KV cache 随序列长度线性增长，现有静态驱逐规则难以判断哪些历史 token 会影响未来输出分布。
summary.importance: 这是推理内存优化方法贡献。它把 KV-cache 驱逐从手工启发式改写为序列决策问题，并用 full-cache 与 compressed-cache 输出分布的 KL 差异作为训练信号；对长上下文 serving 和训练时长上下文设计都有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DistillCache：训练一个轻量策略网络，根据 attention statistics、value norm、entropy、position 等内部信号决定逐步驱逐哪些 KV 条目。训练使用 REINFORCE，reward 来自每步 KL divergence，目标是让压缩缓存下的输出分布贴近 full-cache 模型。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 上进行，评测 LongBench。摘要报告在 25% cache budget 下保留 full-cache accuracy 的 94.2%，优于 H2O、SnapKV 等静态或启发式驱逐基线；但只看到 7B 指令模型结果，未确认多模型、多上下文长度和策略训练开销的完整覆盖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the linear growth of the KV cache in long-context LLM inference and the difficulty of deciding which cached tokens will matter for future predictions.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-efficiency contribution. The main shift is to treat cache eviction as a learned sequential decision problem, with KL divergence to the full-cache output distribution as the preservation objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: DistillCache trains a lightweight policy network using internal model signals such as attention statistics, value norms, entropy, and position. The policy is optimized with REINFORCE, using a per-step KL reward to keep compressed-cache outputs close to full-cache outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments use Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and LongBench. At a 25% cache budget, DistillCache retains 94.2% of full-cache accuracy and outperforms H2O and SnapKV according to the abstract. The provided information does not establish robustness across model families, longer contexts, or policy-training overhead.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 LongBench 表即可；KL 蒸馏信号合理，但单 7B setup 不足以改 KV 驱逐 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LongBench table; the KL signal is sensible, but a single 7B setup is not enough to reset priors on KV eviction.

paper.title: Aero Realtime: Fully Aligned Input-Output Streams for Low-Latency Streaming Multimodal Generation
paper.abstract: Existing streaming multimodal models process observations incrementally but still follow a turn-based prefill-then-decode pattern, making them non-duplex: new observations cannot naturally enter an active generation stream. Proactive alternatives use micro-turn polling or external response gates, which fragment continuous interaction, decouple response timing from language generation, and complicate KV-cache-friendly serving. We introduce Aero Realtime, a 4B streaming multimodal model with a dup

summary.core_problem: 解决实时多模态生成中输入流和输出流无法真正并行推进的问题，尤其是传统 prefill-then-decode 模式导致的非双工交互和高延迟。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态统一建模和实时推理架构创新。它把视频、音频和文本输出对齐到共享时间网格，用一个自回归目标同时学习“何时回应”和“回应什么”，对语音/视频原生 LM 的预训练形式有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Aero Realtime，一个 4B streaming multimodal model。模型把输入视频、输入音频和文本输出放在约 80ms 的 audio slot 时间格上；每个 slot 预测词汇 token 或 silence token。推理时只追加最新多模态 slot，保留前一输出状态，并复用 KV cache，因此新观测可以进入正在进行的生成流，而不需要外部 response gate 或 micro-turn polling。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确给出模型规模为 4B，并强调面向低延迟流式多模态生成。摘要未提供训练数据规模、baseline、延迟指标、质量指标或具体提升幅度；需要正文确认 duplex 设计在真实视频音频交互中的延迟-质量折中。
summary.authors_note: Xiaojuan Qi 是视觉与多模态方向研究者，常见关联机构为香港大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of true duplex interaction in real-time multimodal generation, where conventional prefill-then-decode pipelines prevent new observations from entering an active generation stream.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a unified multimodal modeling and serving architecture. By aligning video, audio, and textual outputs on a shared temporal grid, it trains one autoregressive objective to learn both response timing and response content, which is directly relevant to native speech/video language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Aero Realtime is a 4B streaming multimodal model. It places video, audio, and textual output on roughly 80-ms audio slots, where each slot predicts either a lexical token or a silence token. At inference time, it appends only the newest multimodal slot, carries forward the previous output state, and reuses the KV cache, avoiding external response gates or micro-turn polling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract specifies a 4B model and a low-latency streaming multimodal generation setting. It does not provide training data scale, baselines, latency numbers, quality metrics, or exact gains, so the full paper is needed to judge the latency-quality tradeoff.
summary_en.authors_note: Xiaojuan Qi is a researcher in vision and multimodal learning, commonly associated with the University of Hong Kong.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看建模形式：80ms slot + silence token 可能比外部 VAD/gate 更适合原生实时多模态预训练。
recommendation.en: Read the modeling formulation first: 80-ms slots plus silence tokens may be a cleaner native pretraining target than external VAD or response gates.

paper.title: Autonomy-of-Heads: Data-Free Sparse Attention from Frozen Query-Key Geometry
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by quadratic attention computation and growing KV-cache costs. Existing sparse attention and KV-compression methods typically decide which tokens or heads to preserve from runtime attention scores, observation windows, calibration prompts, or learned gates, making head diagnosis input-dependent and costly to deploy. We propose Autonomy-of-Heads (AoH), a data-free method that identifies retrieval and streaming heads from the spectral geometry of query-ke

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文推理中的 attention head 选择问题：现有稀疏注意力或 KV 压缩方法通常依赖运行时 attention score、校准 prompt、观察窗口或学习 gate，部署成本高，也难以在 prefill 一开始就确定哪些 head 需要全局上下文。论文提出只从冻结权重的 query-key 几何判断 head 的功能。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献偏推理效率，但它对理解长上下文模型的 head specialization 有启发。论文把 attention head 的 retrieval/streaming 分工和权重空间里的谱结构联系起来，而不是只看输入相关的 attention map。这个视角可用于分析长上下文能力如何在预训练中形成，也可能反过来指导 head-level regularization、长上下文继续训练和稀疏 attention 架构设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Autonomy-of-Heads。对每个 attention head，定义 kernel attention operator：M_h = W_K^{h⊤} W_Q^h。该矩阵刻画 query 与 key 在该 head 中的匹配方向。论文用 M_h 的 effective rank 作为 head 功能指标：低 effective-rank 表示谱集中，少数主方向主导匹配，更像 retrieval head，需要保留全局 KV；高 effective-rank 表示匹配方向分散，更接近 streaming head，可以只保留 sink tokens 和 recent window。为了部署，作者不显式构造 d_model × d_model 的 M_h，而是利用 d_head × d_head 的 proxy 计算非零奇异值。最终策略很简单：低 ER head 用 full attention，高 ER head 用 sink-plus-recent attention。整个过程不需要训练数据、校准样本或额外 gate。
summary.experiments: 论文先给出两个观察。第一，在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，不同 head 的平均 attention distance 在 4K 到 100K context 下结构稳定，且 effective rank 与长距离 attention 行为呈负相关：低 ER head 更倾向远距离检索，高 ER head 更局部。第二，在 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 32K passkey retrieval 测试中，把高 ER head 逐步改成 streaming attention 对准确率影响较小；先改低 ER head 会使检索准确率快速下降，说明低 ER head 对远程信息访问更关键。LongBench 实验覆盖三个长上下文 LLM。在 50% sparsity 下，AoH 接近 full attention，并稳定优于 random 和 reversed head selection。效率实验显示，在长上下文下它能降低 prefill/decode latency 和 KV-cache memory；文中 streaming head 使用 128 个 sink tokens 加 256 个 recent tokens，因此在 32K、64K、128K 这类长度下 KV budget 近似等于 full-attention head 的比例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。重点看 Observations 部分的两组证据：effective rank 与 average attention distance 的关系，以及 passkey retrieval 中 low-ER-first/high-ER-first 的对照。方法部分关注 M_h = W_K^{⊤}W_Q 的定义、effective rank 的计算，以及 d_head 级别谱计算为什么等价于关注非零奇异值。实验部分看 LongBench 50% sparsity 的主表和 latency/KV memory 曲线即可。需要留意的限制是：AoH 的 head 标签是输入无关的，因此适合稳定 head 分工明显的模型；如果某些模型大量依赖动态 routing 或 layer-wise adaptive behavior，固定分类可能不够细。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context attention heads can be classified without prompts, runtime attention statistics, calibration data, or learned gates. The target problem is sparse long-context inference: deciding which heads must keep global KV access and which heads can be restricted to sink-plus-recent attention from the start of prefill.
summary_en.importance: The work is primarily an inference-efficiency paper, but it is also useful for pretraining analysis. It links retrieval versus streaming behavior to spectral structure in frozen query-key weights, rather than to input-specific attention maps. This gives a weight-space diagnostic for head specialization in long-context LLMs. Such diagnostics can inform how long-range retrieval capabilities emerge during pretraining or continued long-context training, and may be useful when designing head-level sparsity or regularization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Autonomy-of-Heads defines a head-specific kernel attention operator M_h = W_K^{h⊤} W_Q^h. This operator captures the query-key matching directions available to a head. The classifier uses the effective rank of M_h. A low effective rank means the spectrum is concentrated in a few dominant matching directions; these heads are treated as retrieval heads and keep full-context attention. A high effective rank means the spectrum is more diffuse; these heads are treated as streaming heads and keep only a small sink cache plus a recent window. For efficiency, the nonzero singular values are computed through a d_head by d_head proxy rather than by materializing the full d_model by d_model matrix. The resulting sparse policy is training-free, data-free, compatible with GQA-style settings, and simple enough to be applied before any prompt is processed.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first reports two supporting observations. On Qwen2.5-7B, per-head average attention distance remains structurally stable from 4K to 100K context lengths, and lower-effective-rank heads tend to attend farther back in the context. On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct at 32K context length, a passkey retrieval study shows a clear separation: converting high-ER heads to streaming attention has limited impact, while converting low-ER heads first causes retrieval accuracy to collapse quickly. The main LongBench evaluation spans three long-context LLMs. At 50% sparsity, AoH remains close to full attention and outperforms random and reversed head-selection baselines. The efficiency results show reductions in prefill and decode latency as well as KV-cache memory at long sequence lengths. Streaming heads use a small 128-token sink cache and a 256-token recent window, so at 32K and beyond the KV budget is dominated by the fraction of heads kept in full attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 20 minutes. Start with the observation figures connecting effective rank to average attention distance and passkey retrieval degradation. Then read the method section for the definition of M_h, the effective-rank criterion, and the d_head-dimensional spectral computation. For results, focus on the 50% sparsity LongBench tables and the latency/KV-cache plots. The main limitation to keep in mind is that AoH assigns fixed, input-independent head roles. This is attractive for deployment, but may be less precise for models whose attention functions are highly prompt-dependent or shaped by dynamic routing mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 只看谱几何定义和 head 分类实验；若稳定成立，应加入内部长上下文压缩诊断工具链。
recommendation.en: Read the spectral-geometry definition and head-classification results; if it holds up, it belongs in an internal long-context compression diagnostic stack.
