实验在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 WideSearch 两个 agent benchmark 上进行，模型包括 Qwen3.5 和 Gemma-4 的多个尺度。摘要和正文片段给出的主结果比较清楚：立即压缩通常会伤害任务性能，而延迟压缩、使用 agent 自身后续生成得到的 future queries，可以稳定追回大部分性能损失。在 Qwen3.5-27B 和 Gemma-4-31B 上，compaction ratio 设为 0.2 时，延迟压缩能在保留大部分 no-compaction 准确率的同时，把 peak KV footprint 分别降到最多 3.5× 和 2.7×，吞吐分别提升最多 4.2× 和 1.7×。

另一个重要实验结论是 TE 的稳健性。尽管 AM 更复杂，理论上更能拟合完整 attention 输出，但在 proxy 不完美、预算有限、压缩时机受限的在线场景里，TE 依然很有竞争力，甚至更稳。这说明误差来源主要不是“压缩器表达能力不够”，而是“用于指导压缩的 query 代表性不足”。如果全文里有消融，最值得看的是：不同 proxy source 的质量排序；delay 长度与性能/内存的折中；不同 compaction ratio 下 TE 与 AM 的交叉点；以及不同模型规模是否改变这一结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Design Space of Online KV Compaction，把问题设定吃透：在线 agent 压缩和静态 prompt 压缩不是一回事。然后重点看方法部分对 TE、AM 和 proxy query source 的定义，不必陷入公式细节，核心是理解它们各自依赖什么信号。实验部分优先看三类图表：1）立即压缩 vs 延迟压缩；2）不同 proxy source 的效果；3）压缩率、峰值 KV、吞吐、任务成功率之间的 trade-off。预计 25 分钟左右可以抓住主要结论。值得深挖的点有两个：一是能否把“延迟后用真实未来 query 压缩过去 turn”做成训练信号，反过来蒸馏一个更好的在线 proxy predictor；二是 TE 的稳健性是否意味着 agent 记忆压缩更适合做保守选择，而不是高自由度重构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies online KV-cache compaction for LLM agents, which is a different problem from static long-context compression. In an agent loop, context grows turn by turn through reasoning traces, tool calls, and environment feedback. When a completed turn must be compacted, the future queries that will later read that information are still unknown. This breaks a key assumption behind many offline query-aware compaction methods. The paper asks three practical questions: what proxy queries are available online at low enough cost, how different compaction families behave under imperfect proxy signals, and whether delaying compaction is worth the extra temporary memory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model researchers working on long-context inference, memory, and serving-aware model design. The main value is that it isolates the real bottleneck in agent KV compaction: not just the compactor, but the quality and timing of the query signal used to decide what to preserve. That matters beyond serving. Many training-time assumptions around long-context modeling, memory modules, and context packing implicitly assume future read patterns are known or can be approximated. The paper shows that this assumption is fragile in interactive trajectories. Another useful takeaway is that a simpler method, token eviction, can be more robust than a more expressive attention-matching method when the proxy signal is noisy. In online systems, better fitting capacity does not automatically translate into better end-to-end behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper does not introduce a new compaction algorithm. Instead, it systematically adapts and compares two existing sequence-level compaction families in the online agent setting. The first is token eviction (TE): given a set of proxy queries, score cached positions by their induced attention mass and keep only the highest-scoring original K/V entries. The second is attention matching (AM): use similar key selection, then additionally fit an additive attention bias and reconstructed values so that the compacted cache better matches the full-cache attention outputs on the proxy queries.

The central contribution is the treatment of proxy-query sources. The paper compares several signals that are actually available online: boundary queries around the end of the current turn, lightweight repeat-prefill style proxies, and deferred future-generation queries obtained from the agent’s own subsequent generation. The trade-off is clear. Immediate compaction has lower latency but relies on weak proxies. Delayed compaction uses more realistic future queries and therefore preserves more useful information, but it requires holding the uncompressed cache a bit longer.

Methodologically, the important part is not the TE/AM math itself but the online compaction protocol: compact completed turns inside the agent loop, constrain the extra compute budget, and study the interaction among proxy source, compaction delay, and compaction ratio. This is the right framing for deployment, because the real objective is not offline reconstruction quality but the joint trade-off among latency, memory, throughput, and task success.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are run on BrowseComp-Plus and WideSearch with multiple scales of Qwen3.5 and Gemma-4. The main empirical result is clear from the provided text: immediate compaction often hurts task performance, while delayed compaction using the agent’s own later-generation queries consistently recovers much of the lost accuracy. On Qwen3.5-27B and Gemma-4-31B, delayed compaction at a ratio of 0.2 preserves most of the no-compaction accuracy while reducing peak KV footprint by up to 3.5x and 2.7x, and improving serving throughput by up to 4.2x and 1.7x, respectively.

A second important result is the robustness of TE. Even though AM is more expressive and should in principle better approximate full-cache attention, TE remains highly competitive under imperfect proxies, limited budgets, and online timing constraints. That suggests the dominant source of error is not compactor capacity but proxy-query mismatch. The most useful ablations to inspect are the ranking of proxy sources, the delay-versus-memory trade-off, the crossover between TE and AM at different compaction ratios, and whether model scale changes the conclusion.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the problem setup in the introduction and the design-space section. The key point is that online agent compaction is not the same as static prompt compaction. Then read the method definitions of TE, AM, and the proxy-query sources; the formulas matter less than understanding what signal each method depends on. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: immediate versus delayed compaction, different proxy sources, and the trade-off among compaction ratio, peak KV memory, throughput, and task performance. In roughly 25 minutes, you should have the main picture. The deeper questions are whether delayed future-query signals can be turned into training targets for a learned online proxy predictor, and whether the robustness of TE implies that agent memory compression should favor conservative selection over high-flexibility reconstruction.

recommendation.zh: 只看 proxy query 对比和 TE/AM 失效案例；它不会改预训练方向，但会改变 agent 长轨迹 serving 的默认压缩策略。
recommendation.en: Read the proxy-query comparison and TE-vs-AM failure cases; it will not change pretraining, but it should update default serving choices for long agent traces.

paper.title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Opt.Gear, a foundation model designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-tim inference, and strong task capability. It includes a dense model (1M, 270M, and 1B) with a context length of 64K. We designed a new hybrid architecture that combines a convolutional key-value gated mixer with local-global attention to reduce the KV-cache memory that tends to increase exponentially with long context. This architecture delivers up to X4.9 faster prefill and decoding speeds on the NPUs c

summary.core_problem: Opt.Gear 解决的是端侧长上下文语言模型的部署约束：在手机、NPU、MCU 等低带宽、低 SRAM 环境下，标准 GQA/滑窗注意力仍然会被 QK 计算、softmax、KV-cache 读写拖慢，尤其是 64K 上下文下的解码阶段。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构与训练 recipe 的共同设计，而不是单纯小模型压缩。论文把端侧硬件约束前置到模型结构设计中，用固定大小的卷积状态替代部分随上下文线性增长的 KV-cache，同时保留少量 GQA 层做全局信息路由。这类设计对未来小参数、长上下文、端侧原生预训练模型有参考价值。其 0.5T tokens 从 2T 候选语料筛选、无蒸馏训练的设定，也提供了一个数据效率方向的案例，但数据筛选细节和评测覆盖需要进一步检查，不能只看“0.5T”这一数字。
summary.technical_approach: 核心结构是 hybrid backbone：部分层使用 GQA 维持全局检索和长程聚合，更多局部混合路径换成 ConvKV-Gated Mixer。ConvKV-Gated Mixer 对 key/value 做因果卷积，并用 query-key 交互产生门控信号来调制 value。这样做的目的不是完全放弃注意力，而是把高频出现的局部建模从 softmax attention 中移出，改成 NPU/CPU/GPU 更容易支持的线性、卷积和逐元素操作。与纯滑窗注意力相比，它减少了动态 QKV 矩阵乘和 softmax；与纯 SSM/线性注意力相比，它仍保留 GQA 层承担内容寻址和全局路由。训练侧采用 Korean-English bilingual 路线，使用 KORMo tokenizer 提升韩英 tokenization 效率，流程包括预训练、长上下文扩展和 SFT。发布规模包括 1M、270M、1B，目标覆盖 MCU 到移动 NPU。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键数字包括：模型上下文长度 64K；从 2T tokens 候选语料中筛选 0.5T tokens 训练；无 teacher distillation；发布 1M、270M、1B dense 模型；1M 版本面向 ARM Cortex-M7，使用 W4A32 量化目标是 sub-1MB 部署；端侧 NPU 上相对同规模模型报告最高约 4.9× 的 prefill 和 decoding 加速。可见结果重点偏系统侧：KV-cache 容量、prefill/decode latency、NPU binary、llama.cpp/ExecuTorch/vLLM/Transformers 兼容性。质量侧覆盖双语理解、数学科学推理、长文档理解和指令跟随，但从提供内容看，具体 benchmark 表、消融和数据筛选收益需要重点核验。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Architecture 中 ConvKV-Gated Mixer 的公式、状态大小、与 GQA 层的排布比例；再看 latency/KV-cache 实验，确认加速来自减少内存流量还是 kernel/runtime 特化；最后看 training data 和 tokenizer 部分，判断 0.5T 数据效率是否来自高质量筛选、韩英配比、长上下文 curriculum，还是评测集选择。精力有限时，不必细读部署兼容列表；更应关注 ConvKV-Gated Mixer 是否会削弱精确长程检索，以及 GQA 层数量如何影响质量与速度的折中。

summary_en.core_problem: Opt.Gear targets a practical bottleneck in on-device long-context LMs: standard GQA and sliding-window attention still require QK score computation, softmax, and repeated KV-cache traffic, which becomes expensive on mobile NPUs, GPUs, and MCU-class devices with limited SRAM and memory bandwidth.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the joint design of architecture, pretraining recipe, and deployment constraints. Instead of only shrinking parameter count, the model replaces many local attention computations with bounded-state convolutional mixing while retaining some GQA layers for global routing. This is relevant for pretraining researchers working on small long-context models, hardware-aware backbones, and edge-native LM design. The claim of training from a curated 0.5T-token subset selected from a 2T-token pool without distillation is also interesting, but it should be judged together with the filtering recipe, evaluation coverage, and ablations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The backbone is a hybrid of GQA, ConvKV-Gated Mixer blocks, and dense feed-forward modules. The ConvKV-Gated Mixer applies causal convolution to key/value streams and gates values using query-key interactions. The design removes much of the sequence-length-dependent KV-cache used by local attention and replaces it with a small convolutional state. This differs from sliding-window attention, which still pays for QK matmul and softmax, and from fully recurrent or SSM-style models, which may weaken content-addressable retrieval. Opt.Gear keeps GQA layers to preserve global information flow. The training pipeline is bilingual Korean-English, uses the KORMo tokenizer, and includes pretraining, long-context extension, and supervised fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Reported numbers include 1M, 270M, and 1B dense models; 64K context length; 0.5T training tokens selected from a 2T-token candidate corpus; no knowledge distillation; and up to about 4.9× faster prefill and decoding on NPUs compared with similarly sized models. The 1M model is positioned for MCU deployment with W4A32 quantization on ARM Cortex-M7 and a sub-1MB target. The visible evidence emphasizes latency, KV-cache reduction, and deployment compatibility across Transformers, llama.cpp, ExecuTorch, vLLM, Qualcomm Hexagon NPU, and Apple ANE. The quality-side tables and ablations should be checked carefully, especially for long-context retrieval and reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the ConvKV-Gated Mixer definition, its state size, and the layer allocation between mixer blocks and GQA. Then inspect latency and memory experiments to separate architectural gains from runtime-specific optimizations. Finally check the tokenizer and data sections to see how much of the reported data efficiency comes from corpus curation, Korean-English token efficiency, and long-context training. The key question is whether the mixer preserves enough exact retrieval ability while reducing KV-cache traffic.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 long-context backbone 是否该为 edge 重新设计，这篇值得扫；先看架构图和速度-质量表，别被“4.9x”这种单点数字带跑。
recommendation.en: Skim this if you care whether long-context backbones should be redesigned for edge deployment; read the architecture figure and speed-quality tables, not just the 4.9x headline.

paper.title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
paper.abstract: Query-agnostic KV cache eviction compresses a context once and reuses the resulting cache for arbitrary future queries, but performance can collapse under tight budgets. Existing methods primarily improve which original KV pairs are retained. We introduce RestoreKV, which complements this selection-based formulation with learned restoration under the same total KV budget. Our key insight is that, although the information lost through eviction is context-specific, the mechanism for generating its

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个很具体但很实际的问题：在 query-agnostic KV eviction 设定下，系统需要在不知道未来用户查询的前提下，先把整段上下文压缩成一个可复用的 KV cache。现有方法几乎都把问题表述成“在固定预算下保留哪些原始 KV 对”，也就是纯选择式压缩。论文指出，这个表述在高压缩率下会失效，因为很多对未来回答有用的信息并不适合靠少量原始 token 直接保留下来。真正缺的是一种预算内的“补偿项”：在 eviction 之前，利用完整上下文生成少量、上下文相关的 restore KV，用来弥补被删掉的信息。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在长上下文 serving 与模型记忆表征之间的接口。它提出了一个清楚的判断：激进 KV 压缩的瓶颈不只是 importance scoring 不够准，也可能是“只允许保留原始状态”这个约束太强。RestoreKV 把问题从 subset selection 扩展成 retained cache + learned complement，这个思路对后续做 prefix compression、memory token、context distillation、甚至训练期显式学习可压缩中间状态都有启发。量级上，它不是改写 Transformer 主干的工作，但在高压缩区间给出的恢复幅度很大，说明 cache 里确实存在可被小容量补码近似恢复的结构信息。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很克制。它不替换原有 eviction 方法，而是在其前面加一个单次 restore pass。具体做法是：先对完整上下文做正常 prefill，得到 full KV cache；然后插入少量 restore tokens，文中默认是 8 个，这些 token 在一次额外前向中可以 attend 到 full cache。这个 restore pass 只在构造压缩 cache 时运行一次，并通过 LoRA 适配过的注意力模块，把上下文信息写入这 8 个 restore token 对应的各层 KV 中，形成 restore cache。之后再按原始 eviction 规则，从真实上下文 token 的 KV 中选出剩余预算的 retained cache；restore cache 与 retained cache 拼接后，组成总预算不变的最终 cache。

训练方式是离线 self-distillation。教师模型是 frozen full-cache model，学生模型使用 budget-matched final cache。给定同一 context 和 query，优化目标是让学生在 answer token 上匹配教师分布。更新参数非常少，只训练 restore token embeddings 和 restore pass 中的 LoRA；backbone 与 base evictor 都冻结。这个设计有两个关键点。第一，restore 不是通用前缀，也不是把整个 prefix 重写成新状态，而是只学习一个小补丁，因此兼容已有 importance scorer。第二，LoRA 只在 restore pass 打开，后续 query processing 和 decoding 完全沿用原始压缩 cache 的推理路径，所以在线开销几乎不变。

论文里最有信息量的部分是组件消融。作者把收益拆成“restore token 自身记忆了什么”与“注意力侧适配学会了如何从 full cache 提炼补偿信息”两部分。结果显示，仅优化 restore embeddings，KVzip 在 5% 预算下从 38.2 提到 42.1，提升有限；固定 embeddings、只学 LoRA 可到 71.9；只适配 q/k/v 投影就有 72.4，接近完整 RestoreKV 的 73.2。这说明主要收益来自 attention-side adaptation，而不是把常识或模板塞进几个特殊 token 里。换句话说，restore tokens 更像一组可学习的读写槽位，真正起作用的是它们如何从 full cache 中抽取并编码“被 eviction 后最容易丢失的补充信息”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面比较完整：4 个模型骨干、4 个长上下文 benchmark、5 种 base eviction 方法。论文强调的是一致性而不是只挑单一方法做最优结果。最醒目的数字来自 Qwen3-4B + KVzip：在 5% KV budget 下，RULER-4K 准确率从 38.2 提升到 73.2，恢复幅度很大。应用到 KVzip+ 时，在 KVPress Benchmark 上 16× compression 仍可达到 86.4 的 RULER accuracy。作者还展示了随压缩率变化的曲线：在轻度压缩时，base eviction 与 full-cache 差距本来就不大，RestoreKV 增益有限；压缩越激进，selection-only 方法掉得越快，RestoreKV 越能缩小 gap，这和方法动机是对齐的。

开销方面，32K context 下，8 个 restore token 带来的额外压缩时间只有 0.03 到 0.04 秒，不到总 compression time 的 0.5%；峰值显存增加 84MB，约 0.4%。这点很关键，因为很多 cache reconstruction 方法的问题不是效果，而是把 query-time 或 decode-time 路径改复杂了。RestoreKV 把额外成本限制在一次性 cache construction 阶段，因此更像工程上可插拔的增强模块。

从消融看，论文还验证了几个判断：一是 restore cache 的收益在不同 base evictor 上都存在，说明它不是绑定某个 importance metric 的技巧；二是预算分配需要平衡，restore cache 占比过小补偿不足，过大又会挤占 retained original KV；三是 attention projection 的 LoRA 已经覆盖大部分收益，提示未来若要进一步压缩训练成本，可以优先保留这一部分适配。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解作者到底改了什么：不是改 eviction score，而是在 eviction 前多做一次“生成补码”的 pass。然后看方法部分里 restore cache 的构造流程，以及训练目标如何用 full-cache teacher 做蒸馏。真正值得停下来看的，是组件消融和 budget ablation。那几组结果基本回答了三个核心问题：收益来自哪里、为什么不是 restore token 在硬记忆、以及 restore/retain 预算怎么分。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction 的问题重述、方法图、主结果表、component ablation、overhead 表。读的时候重点想两件事。第一，这个方法为什么能在不改 query-time 路径的情况下恢复行为；第二，它是否意味着 KV cache 里存在一种低秩或低容量的“补充表示”，可以由少量 learned slots 近似承载。后者对做训练期 memory token 或 context bottleneck 设计的人更有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical failure mode in long-context inference. In query-agnostic KV eviction, a long prefix must be compressed once, before future user queries are known, into a reusable KV cache. Existing methods mostly treat this as a pure selection problem: under a fixed budget, keep the most important original KV pairs. The paper argues that this formulation breaks down under aggressive compression. The issue is not only imperfect importance scoring; it is also the restriction that the compressed cache can only contain retained original states. What is missing is a small, context-conditioned complement that can be generated before eviction and used to recover behavior lost by dropping most of the prefix.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it exposes a representational bottleneck at the interface between long-context modeling and serving. The key message is that high-ratio KV compression should not be framed only as better subset selection. A compressed cache may need both preserved original states and a learned residual memory. That idea is relevant beyond serving: it connects to prefix compression, memory tokens, context distillation, and training-time designs that encourage compressible intermediate states. The empirical gains at very small KV budgets suggest that a nontrivial fraction of useful prefix information can indeed be reconstructed from a tiny learned complement.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RestoreKV is deliberately lightweight. It does not replace the base eviction method. Instead, it adds a single restore pass before eviction. The pipeline is: run normal prefill on the full context; insert a small number of restore tokens, eight by default; let those tokens attend to the full KV cache in one extra forward pass with LoRA-adapted attention layers; use the resulting per-layer KV states of the restore tokens as a compact restore cache; then apply the original query-agnostic evictor to the real context tokens and keep the remaining budget as retained cache. The final compressed cache is the concatenation of retained original KV pairs and the learned restore cache, with the same total KV budget as the baseline.

Training is offline self-distillation from a frozen full-cache teacher. For the same context and downstream query, the student using the budget-matched compressed cache is trained to match the teacher’s answer-token distributions. Only the restore-token embeddings and lightweight LoRA adapters are updated; the backbone model and the base evictor stay frozen. This design matters for two reasons. First, RestoreKV is a complement, not a rewrite: it preserves most selected original states and only learns a small residual cache. Second, LoRA is used only during restore-cache construction. After that, query processing and decoding are identical to the base method, so online inference cost is unchanged.

The most informative part of the paper is the component analysis. The authors separate gains from learned restore-token content versus gains from attention-side adaptation. At a 5% KV budget, optimizing restore embeddings alone improves KVzip from 38.2 to 42.1, which is modest. Keeping embeddings fixed but learning LoRA reaches 71.9. Adapting only q/k/v projections reaches 72.4, close to the full RestoreKV result of 73.2. This strongly suggests that the method works because the adapted attention mechanism learns how to extract a compact, context-specific complement from the full cache, not because a few special tokens memorize generic information.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is reasonably broad: four backbones, four long-context benchmarks, and five base eviction methods. The paper emphasizes consistency across settings rather than a single best-case result. The headline number is on Qwen3-4B with KVzip: at a 5% KV budget on RULER-4K, accuracy improves from 38.2 to 73.2. Applied to KVzip+, RestoreKV reaches 86.4 RULER accuracy at 16x compression on the KVPress Benchmark. The compression-ratio curves are also important: under mild compression, baseline eviction is already close to full-cache behavior, so RestoreKV adds little; under aggressive compression, selection-only methods degrade sharply, and RestoreKV closes a large part of the gap. That pattern matches the paper’s central claim.

The overhead numbers are small enough to matter in practice. On 32K-context evaluation, the eight-token restore pass adds only 0.03 to 0.04 seconds, less than 0.5% of total compression time, and 84 MB of peak memory, around 0.4%. This is a strong point of the design. Many cache reconstruction ideas improve quality but complicate query-time or decode-time execution. RestoreKV keeps all extra work in one-time cache construction.

The ablations also support several useful conclusions: the gains transfer across different base evictors, so the method is not tied to one scoring heuristic; the budget split between restore cache and retained original KV matters, indicating a real trade-off between residual capacity and direct preservation; and most of the benefit already comes from adapting attention projections, which suggests a cheaper training variant may be possible.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with Figure 1 and Figure 2. They make the contribution clear: this is not a better importance scorer, but a learned residual cache generated before eviction. Then read the method section for the restore-cache construction and the distillation objective against the full-cache teacher. The sections worth slowing down for are the component ablations and the budget-allocation study. Those results answer the main questions: where the gains come from, why the method is not just memorization in special tokens, and how much budget should be allocated to restoration versus retained original KV.

If you only have 20 to 30 minutes, the best order is: introduction, method figure, main result table, component ablation, and overhead table. The two questions to keep in mind are: why can this recover behavior without changing query-time execution, and does it imply that prefix information contains a low-capacity residual component that can be encoded in a few learned slots? The second question is the more interesting one for people thinking about training-time memory tokens or context bottlenecks.

recommendation.zh: KV cache优化的新思路，从「选保留」转向「选保留+轻量恢复」，看§3方法和§4实验即可
recommendation.en: Novel KV cache optimization combining eviction with learned lightweight restoration; read §3 method and §4 experiments only

paper.title: Does Accuracy Equal Evidence? Reasoning Faithfulness under KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个常被忽略的评测错位：KV cache compression 通常只看最终答案准确率，但对 large reasoning models 来说，答案保住了，不等于支撑答案的推理证据也保住了。作者把这个现象定义为 answer–evidence gap，并试图回答两个问题：压缩后的 KV 表示是否同等程度地保留了“能把答案说对”的信息和“能让推理链条成立”的信息；如果没有，仅看 accuracy 会在多大程度上高估压缩方法的质量。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更接近推理阶段的诊断研究，但对基座研究员仍有启发。原因有两点。第一，很多人把长链推理模型的中间 token 当作可解释证据来使用，而这篇文章说明，推理系统层面的压缩会改变“答案正确”和“证据仍然有效”之间的关系，accuracy 不是充分指标。第二，它给出了一个比较干净的组件级评测协议，可以把 rollout dynamics 和 KV 保留能力拆开。这对研究长上下文、推理 trace、serving 优化与模型行为之间的接口很有价值。它不会直接告诉你如何训练更好的模型，但会提醒你：如果训练或部署阶段引入 cache 压缩，仅凭最终分数判断是否“几乎无损”可能是危险的，尤其是在 reasoning trace 被拿来做 verifier、审计或蒸馏信号时。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 controlled fixed-trace replay。标准 end-to-end 压缩评测里，压缩会同时影响中间推理内容的生成和后续答案，因此很难分辨到底是“模型没想出来”还是“已经写出来的推理在压缩后不可用了”。作者的做法是先让 Full-KV 模型在无压缩条件下生成完整 reasoning trace，然后把 question 和这段固定的 textual trace 一起 prefill 进去，只压缩 trace 对应的 KV cache，保护 question cache 不动，再从 </think> 之后继续解码答案。这样所有方法看到的文本推理内容完全相同，差异只来自压缩后的 KV 表示是否还能让模型有效利用这些已有推理。

围绕这个协议，作者设计了三类指标。第一是 final-answer accuracy，仍然保留传统指标。第二是 answer–chain consistency，用来测最终答案是否与可见推理链条一致。第三是 perturbation faithfulness，通过对中间推理做受控扰动，观察压缩模型是否仍然对支持性或误导性中间信息表现出合理敏感性。作者强调，这里区分的是行为功能，而不是声称 KV 里存在物理上分离的“答案子空间”和“证据子空间”。

实验覆盖十种 token-eviction 类 KV 压缩方法和一种 quantization 方法，跨三个模型、多个任务和不同压缩预算。任务包括数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索。作者还补充了 end-to-end 结果，说明 fixed-trace replay 发现的模式并不是纯实验室产物，而是在真实生成里也能看到。和已有 KV compression 论文相比，这篇文章的区别不在提出新压缩算法，而在于指出 accuracy-only evaluation 的系统性盲点，并给出更细粒度的诊断框架。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果描述看，最重要的发现不是某个方法赢了多少，而是不同指标之间的分叉。作者在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond、MedCalc 这类 reasoning-heavy 任务上观察到：在一定压缩预算下，若只看 final accuracy，一些方法仍然显得“保持得不错”；但 answer–chain consistency 和 perturbation faithfulness 会更早、更明显地下滑。这说明压缩后的模型可能还能沿着残留的答案线索给出正确结论，却已经不能稳定地利用或维护支撑该结论的推理证据。换句话说，accuracy 在这里是非对称诊断：一旦 accuracy 崩了，当然说明压缩伤害很大；但 accuracy 没崩，并不代表 reasoning state 仍然健康。

另一个关键结果是任务依赖性。RULER QA 这类长上下文检索任务中，答案更直接依赖保留精确证据，因此压缩造成的损伤更容易直接反映到 accuracy collapse 上，answer–evidence gap 相对没那么隐蔽。相反，在数学、科学 QA、临床计算这类任务里，模型可能依靠结论邻近 cue、局部 summary 或其他 answer-like signals 保住最终答案，但推理链条的可审计性已经下降。

作者还比较了多种 token eviction 方法和一种 quantization 方法，并在不同模型家族上重复实验，结论是这种 gap 不是单一算法或单一模型的偶然现象，而是一个较普遍的评测问题。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文结构看，Table 2 提供了 end-to-end 结果，主文其余表格则展示不同预算、任务和方法下 accuracy、consistency、faithfulness 三轴的分离情况。阅读时应重点关注这些曲线是否在相同 budget 下出现排序翻转。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先不要把它当成一篇新的压缩算法论文，而要当成一篇评测协议论文。优先看 Introduction 和 Problem Setting，理解作者为什么要用 fixed-trace replay，以及它和真实部署 benchmark 的边界在哪里。随后看方法部分对三个指标的定义，尤其是 answer–chain consistency 与 perturbation faithfulness 分别想测什么。接着直接看主结果图表：先看不同任务上 accuracy 与 faithfulness 是否同步下降，再看不同压缩预算下是否出现“答案还对，但证据已坏”的区间。最后再扫一遍 end-to-end 结果，确认这种现象不是 replay protocol 人为制造出来的。

如果你做长上下文、推理模型 serving、KV 压缩或 reasoning trace 利用，这篇文章值得花 20–30 分钟读主文结果和方法定义。最值得思考的点有三个：一，部署优化是否改变了可解释性信号的可信度；二，训练时若用压缩环境生成或蒸馏推理 trace，会不会把这种 answer–evidence gap 带回训练分布；三，未来压缩方法是否应该把“证据保真”纳入目标，而不是只保 final token accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a misalignment in how KV cache compression is usually evaluated. Most work reports final-answer accuracy, implicitly treating preserved answers as evidence that the underlying reasoning state is also preserved. For large reasoning models, the authors show this assumption can fail. They define an answer–evidence gap: compression may retain enough information for the model to output the correct answer while degrading the evidential structure that makes the visible rationale valid, auditable, or robust. The paper asks how often these two functions—answer recovery and evidence preservation—diverge, and whether accuracy-only evaluation systematically overestimates compression quality.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining-method paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research because it sharpens the interface between model behavior and inference-time systems. Two points matter. First, reasoning traces are increasingly used as evidence, supervision, or audit artifacts. If cache compression changes the relationship between answer correctness and rationale validity, then accuracy alone is an unsafe proxy for deployment quality. Second, the paper offers a relatively clean component-level diagnostic that separates rollout dynamics from KV retention. That is useful for anyone working on long-context models, reasoning traces, serving optimizations, or post-training pipelines that consume model-generated chains of thought. It does not tell you how to train a better model directly, but it does show that “near-lossless compression” can be a misleading claim if judged only by final accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central method is controlled fixed-trace replay. In standard end-to-end evaluation, compression affects both the generation of the reasoning trace and the later use of that trace, so it is hard to tell whether failure comes from not producing the right reasoning or from not being able to use already-produced reasoning. The authors decouple these factors. First, a Full-KV model generates a complete reasoning trace without compression. Then each compression method is evaluated by prefilling the same question and the same textual trace, protecting the question cache, compressing only the KV states corresponding to the reasoning trace, and resuming decoding immediately after the closing reasoning tag. This means every method sees identical reasoning content in text form; differences reflect whether the compressed KV representation still lets the model use that content effectively.

On top of this protocol, the paper evaluates three metrics. The first is standard final-answer accuracy. The second is answer–chain consistency, which measures whether the final answer remains aligned with the visible reasoning chain. The third is perturbation faithfulness, which probes whether the compressed model responds appropriately when intermediate reasoning content is perturbed in controlled ways. The authors are careful not to claim that KV states physically decompose into separate “answer” and “evidence” components; the distinction is behavioral rather than mechanistic.

The experimental suite covers ten token-eviction compression methods and one quantization method, across three models, multiple tasks, and multiple compression budgets. Tasks include mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. The paper also reports end-to-end results to show that the observed pattern is not an artifact of the replay protocol. Relative to prior KV-compression work, the novelty is not a new compression algorithm but a stronger evaluation lens that exposes a blind spot in accuracy-only reporting.
summary_en.experiments:
The main result is not that one compression method dominates, but that different evaluation axes separate in meaningful ways. On reasoning-heavy tasks such as AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and MedCalc, some methods remain competitive if judged only by final-answer accuracy under certain compression budgets. However, answer–chain consistency and perturbation faithfulness degrade earlier and more sharply. This indicates that compressed models may still recover the right answer from residual answer-like cues, local summaries, or conclusion-adjacent signals, while no longer preserving the reasoning structure needed to justify or verify that answer. In that sense, accuracy is an asymmetric diagnostic: when it collapses, compression damage is obvious; when it holds up, evidence preservation is still uncertain.

A second important finding is task dependence. On retrieval-oriented tasks such as RULER QA, where correct answers depend more directly on retaining exact supporting evidence, compression damage is more visible through accuracy collapse itself, so the answer–evidence gap is less hidden. By contrast, on math, science QA, and clinical calculation, the model can often preserve the final answer while losing auditability of the chain.

The study also compares multiple token-eviction methods and one quantization baseline across different model families. The answer–evidence gap appears across methods and models rather than as a quirk of a single algorithm. The abstract does not expose all numeric tables, but the paper structure indicates that Table 2 reports end-to-end results, while the main result tables and figures show how accuracy, consistency, and faithfulness diverge across budgets, tasks, and methods. When reading, the most informative pattern to look for is ranking reversals: methods that look similar under accuracy but separate clearly once evidence-oriented metrics are included.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Treat this as an evaluation-protocol paper, not as a new compression-method paper. Start with the Introduction and Problem Setting to understand why fixed-trace replay is needed and what it does and does not measure. Then read the metric definitions carefully, especially the distinction between answer–chain consistency and perturbation faithfulness. After that, go straight to the main result figures and tables: first check whether accuracy and faithfulness decline together on each task, then inspect whether there is a budget range where answers remain correct but evidential support is already degraded. Finally, skim the end-to-end results to verify that the phenomenon is not created by the replay setup itself.

If you work on long-context inference, reasoning-model serving, KV compression, or the use of reasoning traces as supervision, the paper is worth a 20–30 minute read focused on the method definition and result tables. The most useful follow-up questions are: whether deployment optimizations alter the trustworthiness of interpretability signals; whether training or distillation under compressed settings could feed this answer–evidence gap back into the model; and whether future compression methods should optimize for evidence preservation rather than final-token accuracy alone.

recommendation.zh: 做 KV 压缩或长上下文推理的人应立刻把这三个指标加进内部 ablation，只用准确率会严重高估压缩质量。
recommendation.en: Anyone working on KV compression or long-context inference should add these three metrics to internal ablations; accuracy alone severely overestimates compression quality.

paper.title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active conte

summary.core_problem: 长时运行的LLM助手与Agent的交互历史会持续增长，最终超出上下文窗口容量，必须滚动更替工作上下文。现有RAG、摘要、检索类方案只能提供按需触发的历史内容存取能力，无法维护一个跨工作上下文生命周期、固定容量、在线更新的内部隐状态，导致上下文换出后的计算连续性断裂。
summary.importance: 这篇明确区分了长程交互下两类正交的记忆功能：一类是RAG类系统实现的“外部历史按需存取”，另一类是循环隐状态实现的“跨上下文计算连续性”，厘清了之前记忆相关研究中概念混用的问题。提出的防记忆旁路的后训练设计对长交互Agent的工程实现有参考价值，但整体方案是在预训练完成的注意力LLM上挂载插件式记忆分支，没有修改预训练目标或主干架构，对基座预训练范式的直接影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 架构上，在预训练全注意力Decoder旁并行挂载基于Gated DeltaNet-2的循环记忆分支，全程维护一个固定尺寸的记忆状态张量；主注意力路径仅保留固定长度的滑动KV窗口，当窗口触达容量上限时，最早的KV块直接从注意力路径卸载，相关信息通过记忆分支的写操作整合进持久状态。训练上，设计专门的记忆导向后训练任务，训练过程中强制触发上下文轮换，确保历史内容移出注意力窗口后模型只能通过记忆状态获取信息，避免模型因训练时历史全程可见而绕过记忆分支。推理阶段，记忆状态伴随整个交互生命周期持续更新，与工作上下文的滚动更替完全解耦。
summary.experiments: 在LongMemEval等长程记忆基准上，当支撑答案的证据被完全移出当前活跃上下文窗口后，LiveMem仍能保持显著高于滑动窗口基线的准确率，且准确率随证据与当前窗口的距离增加平滑下降，无断崖式性能跌落。整体长任务性能达到同类记忆增强方案的上游水平，但在需要精确逐字回溯的任务上表现弱于显式检索方案，短上下文任务性能与原基础模型持平，未因新增记忆分支带来精度损失。消融观察验证了设计前提：如果后训练阶段不做强制上下文轮换，模型会完全忽略记忆分支，性能与普通滑动窗口注意力无显著差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注问题定义部分对两类记忆功能的区分、后训练中防止记忆旁路的设计逻辑、上下文轮换的消融结论，Gated DeltaNet-2的具体实现是已有工作，无需深究。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-running LLM assistants and agents accumulate interaction history that eventually outgrows fixed context window limits, requiring rolling turnover of working context. Existing RAG, summarization, and retrieval pipelines provide on-demand access to stored historical content, but fail to maintain a fixed-capacity, online-updated internal latent state that persists across working context swaps, breaking computational continuity when old context is evicted.
summary_en.importance: This work draws a clear distinction between two orthogonal memory functions in long-running interaction: on-demand historical access implemented by RAG-style systems, and cross-context computational continuity implemented by recurrent latent states, resolving conceptual ambiguity in prior memory research. Its proposed post-training protocol to prevent memory bypass offers practical engineering reference for long-horizon agent systems. However, the approach is a plug-in branch added to fully pretrained attention LLMs, with no modification to pretraining objectives or backbone architecture, so its direct impact on foundation model pretraining paradigms is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: Architecturally, LiveMem adds a parallel recurrent memory branch built on Gated DeltaNet-2 alongside a pretrained full-attention decoder, maintaining a fixed-size persistent memory state across the entire interaction lifecycle. The main attention path operates on a bounded sliding KV window; when the window reaches capacity, the oldest KV chunks are directly evicted from the attention path, and relevant information is integrated into the persistent state via write operations in the memory branch. For training, a dedicated memory-oriented post-training task enforces forced context turnover, ensuring the model can only retrieve evicted historical information through the memory state, rather than learning to bypass the memory branch when full history remains visible during training. At inference, the memory state is updated continuously across the full lifecycle, fully decoupled from working context turnover.
summary_en.experiments: On LongMemEval and related long-range memory benchmarks, LiveMem retains significantly higher accuracy than sliding-window baselines even when supporting evidence is fully evicted from the active context window, with performance degrading smoothly as the distance between evidence and current window increases, rather than dropping off sharply. Overall long-task performance is competitive with top augmented memory systems, though the method underperforms explicit retrieval on tasks requiring exact verbatim recall. Short-context performance matches the base model exactly, with no accuracy penalty from the added memory branch. Ablations confirm the core design premise: without forced context turnover in post-training, the model learns to ignore the memory branch entirely, performing on par with vanilla sliding-window attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core framing and design logic. Prioritize the problem definition distinguishing the two memory functions, the post-training design that prevents memory bypass, and the context turnover ablation results. Implementation details of Gated DeltaNet-2 are borrowed from prior work and do not require close reading. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把记忆状态从 KV 里解耦出来的思路值得看，但摘要缺实验细节，先读方法图和 post-training 那一节，结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Decoupling memory state from the KV cache is worth a look, but the abstract lacks experimental detail; read the method figure and post-training section, treat claims as weak signal.

paper.title: Mixture-of-Translators: Translating KV Caches Across Heterogeneous Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Heterogeneous Large Language Model (LLM) systems increasingly rely on shared contexts, retrieved evidence, and multi-agent dialogue histories, yet their internal key-value (KV) caches remain model-specific and cannot be reused across architectures. Consequently, each model must repeatedly prefill or store caches for the same context, limiting the scalability of multi-model reasoning and long-context generation. We propose Mixture-of-Translators(MoT), a cache translation framework that maps conte

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是异构 LLM 之间 KV cache 不能互通的问题。一个模型对长上下文做完 prefill 后得到的 KV cache，另一个模型通常无法直接复用，因为层数、hidden size、attention head、KV head 布局都不同。结果就是在 multi-agent、shared context、cache-augmented generation 这类场景里，每个模型都要重复编码同一段上下文，或者各自存一份 cache，带来额外算力和显存开销。作者把这个问题表述为“跨模型内部状态翻译”：能否把源模型的 context cache 映射到目标模型的 cache 空间，同时尽量保留后续生成质量。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是核心论文，更偏推理系统与模型互操作，但仍有两点启发。第一，它把 KV cache 视为一种模型内部记忆，而不是单纯推理副产物，这个视角对研究表示兼容性、跨模型蒸馏、以及统一 latent interface 有参考价值。第二，论文指出单一路径投影很难覆盖异构模型之间复杂的状态对应关系，因此提出 mixture-of-translators。这个思路和 MoE、跨架构表示对齐、hidden-state communication 有相通之处。对做训练的人来说，值得关注的不是它能否直接用于预训练，而是它暴露出不同模型内部表征空间并不天然可交换，若未来想做跨模型共享记忆或联合系统，可能需要在训练阶段就引入更强的状态对齐约束。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成：Mixture-of-Translators（MoT）和 Context Correction Loss。

先说问题设定。给定源模型 MSrc 对上下文 xCtx 计算出的 KVSrc,Ctx，目标是得到目标模型可直接接续使用的 \hat{KV}Tgt,Ctx，使目标模型在后续接收 task prompt 和生成答案时，尽量接近它自己原生 prefill 得到的轨迹。难点在于源和目标模型可能在深度、维度、注意力布局上都不同，因此不存在一个简单线性映射能稳定处理所有 token 和所有层。

MoT 的核心想法是，不强迫所有 cache 状态走同一个 translator，而是准备多个 translator 模块，由门控机制在 token 级别或状态级别组合它们的输出。作者认为异构模型之间的映射不是单模态函数，而更像多种局部映射的混合：有些 token 对应实体记忆，有些对应句法依赖，有些对应长程语义压缩，不同子空间可能需要不同翻译器。相比单一 projection path 或共享 latent space，MoT 用 mixture 方式提高翻译容量。

论文还提出了两个误差来源：
1. propagation error：如果在较早层就开始翻译，翻译误差会沿目标模型后续层不断传播放大；
2. correction-deficit error：如果在太晚的层才接入翻译后的 cache，目标模型剩余层数太少，来不及把误差纠正回来。

作者用这个分析解释了为什么翻译层位置会出现 U 型验证损失：太早和太晚都不好，中间层最好。MoT 主要缓解前者，即通过更强翻译容量减少初始偏移；Context Correction Loss 则缓解后者，即直接监督“目标模型拿到翻译 cache 后的 replay 轨迹”贴近 native target trajectory。换句话说，除了让 cache 在静态空间里相似，还要求它在目标模型里跑起来后的动态演化也相似。这一点比只做 feature matching 更合理，因为真正影响生成的是 rollout 后的状态轨迹。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 closed-set QA、extractive QA、多 agent 推理、以及 long-context cache-augmented generation，模型组合包括 Qwen2.5、GPT-2、OPT 的同构和异构翻译。

从摘要和正文片段能确认的关键数字有：
1. 在 Qwen2.5-7B 规模上，MoT 在 closed-set QA 上平均准确率 51.0%，在 extractive QA 上平均 F1 为 0.43。
2. 在 GPT-family 实验中，平均准确率 42.0%，平均 F1 为 0.22。
3. 在 long-context cache-augmented generation 中，MoT 保留了 direct-context 方案 96.3% 的质量，说明翻译后的 cache 仍保留了大部分对下游生成有用的信息。
4. 在 10-agent 场景里，图 2 显示 MoT 在保持 F1 的同时，把峰值 GPU memory 降低了 1 GiB 以上，并呈现作者所说的 scale-invariant memory behavior。这里的意思是，随着 agent 数增加，系统不需要为每个 agent 线性复制完整上下文 cache。

论文还给出一个较有信息量的分析实验：改变 translation channels 接入的起始层，验证损失呈 U 型；同时 last-state shift 随层位置变化呈指数衰减。这组图支撑了前面提出的两类竞争误差，不只是经验观察。

如果要更谨慎地解读结果，需要看三点：第一，51.0% / 0.43 这些数值相对 native target 的保真度到底是多少；第二，heterogeneous pair 中哪些组合最难翻译，是否主要受 hidden size 或 tokenizer 差异影响；第三，训练 translator 的成本是否会抵消部分推理收益。当前片段没有给出这些完整细节。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看问题建模和误差分析，不必把所有任务结果逐表抠完。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2。这里能快速理解应用场景：multi-agent 共享上下文、长文档 cache 复用，以及为什么 cache translation 比重复 prefill 更省资源。

然后看 Figure 3/4 和对应分析。这是全文最有意思的部分。作者不是只给一个工程模块，而是提出 propagation error 与 correction-deficit error 两种失败机制，并用 U 型曲线解释翻译层位置选择。这个分析对任何“中间层接入外部状态”的系统都有参考意义。

方法部分重点看 translator mixture 的结构、gate 如何工作、以及 Context Correction Loss 具体监督什么轨迹。如果时间有限，可以跳过部分任务定义，直接看训练目标和 ablation。

实验部分建议重点看：MoT 对比单一 translator、共享 latent space、cache projection 基线的提升；以及 multi-agent memory 曲线。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若你关心 serving 或多模型系统，可再细看附录里的实现开销。
summary.authors_note: 从正文首页可确认有作者来自 Chungnam National University，通讯邮箱为 sungsu@cnu.ac.kr。其余作者与机构在给定片段中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical incompatibility in heterogeneous LLM systems: a KV cache produced by one model cannot usually be consumed by another. Differences in depth, hidden size, attention layout, and KV-head structure make cache reuse model-specific. As a result, in multi-agent reasoning, shared-context workflows, or cache-augmented generation, each model must either prefill the same context again or store its own copy of the cache. The paper formulates this as cross-model internal-state translation: can a source model’s context cache be mapped into a target model’s cache space while preserving downstream generation quality?
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper; it sits closer to inference systems and model interoperability. Still, it has useful implications for foundation-model research. First, it treats KV cache as model-specific memory rather than a disposable inference artifact. That perspective matters for representation compatibility, cross-model distillation, and any future attempt to build shared latent interfaces across models. Second, the paper argues that a single projection path is too weak for heterogeneous cache translation, and proposes a mixture-based translator instead. That connects naturally to ideas from MoE, hidden-state communication, and cross-architecture alignment. The broader lesson is that internal representation spaces are not naturally exchangeable, and if shared memory across models becomes important, stronger alignment may need to be introduced during training rather than patched only at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components: Mixture-of-Translators (MoT) and a Context Correction Loss.

The setup is straightforward. Given a source model MSrc and its context cache KVSrc,Ctx for a long context xCtx, the goal is to produce a translated cache \hat{KV}Tgt,Ctx that a target model can continue from, ideally behaving similarly to the target model’s own native prefill on the same context. The challenge is that source and target models may differ substantially in architecture, so a simple one-shot projection is often too rigid.

MoT addresses this by using multiple translator modules instead of a single universal translator. A gating mechanism combines them, effectively allowing token-level or state-level mixtures of translation modes. The underlying claim is sensible: heterogeneous source–target mappings are not uniform. Different tokens or subspaces may require different translation behaviors, so a mixture can model local correspondences better than one global path or one shared latent space.

The paper also identifies two competing error sources:
1. Propagation error: if translation happens too early, translation noise is propagated and amplified through the remaining target layers.
2. Correction-deficit error: if translation happens too late, the target model has too few upper layers left to repair the mismatch.

This explains the reported U-shaped validation loss as a function of translation depth. MoT mainly attacks the first issue by increasing translation capacity. The Context Correction Loss addresses the second by supervising the replayed target-side trajectory after translation to match the native target trajectory. This is more meaningful than static feature matching alone, because what matters for generation is not just whether translated caches look similar in isolation, but whether they evolve similarly once the target model continues computation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers closed-set QA, extractive QA, multi-agent reasoning, and long-context cache-augmented generation, using both homogeneous and heterogeneous source–target pairs among Qwen2.5, GPT-2, and OPT.

The key reported numbers from the provided text are:
1. At the Qwen2.5-7B scale, MoT achieves 51.0% average accuracy on closed-set QA and 0.43 average F1 on extractive QA.
2. In GPT-family experiments, it reaches 42.0% average accuracy and 0.22 average F1.
3. In long-context cache-augmented generation, MoT preserves 96.3% of direct-context quality, suggesting that translated caches retain most of the information needed for downstream generation.
4. In the 10-agent setting, Figure 2 shows that MoT maintains F1 while reducing peak GPU memory by more than 1 GiB, and the authors describe this as scale-invariant memory behavior because context memory does not need to grow linearly with the number of agents.

One of the more informative analyses varies the first translated layer and finds a U-shaped validation-loss curve. The paper also shows that last-state shift decays exponentially with layer position. Together, these results support the proposed two-error explanation rather than leaving it as an intuition.

For a careful reading, three questions remain important: how close these translated-cache results are to the native target upper bound, which heterogeneous pairs are hardest to translate, and whether translator training cost offsets part of the runtime benefit. Those details are not fully visible in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on the problem framing and the error analysis rather than every task table.

Start with the introduction and Figures 1 and 2. They quickly establish the use cases: shared context in multi-agent systems, long-context cache reuse, and why cache translation can reduce repeated prefilling and memory duplication.

Then read the analysis around Figures 3 and 4. This is the most interesting part. The paper does more than propose an engineering module; it gives a concrete failure model with propagation error and correction-deficit error, and uses it to explain why translation depth matters.

In the method section, focus on how the translator mixture is structured, how the gate selects or combines translators, and what exactly the Context Correction Loss supervises. If time is limited, you can skim some task-specific setup and go directly to the training objective and ablations.

In experiments, prioritize comparisons against single-translator, shared-latent, and cache-projection baselines, plus the multi-agent memory curves. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If you work on serving or multi-model systems, the implementation details in the appendix are worth an extra pass.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided excerpt confirms at least one author affiliation with Chungnam National University, with corresponding contact sungsu@cnu.ac.kr. The full author list and all affiliations are not visible in the excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和失败模式即可；如果内部有多模型长上下文服务，值得复现小规模 cache translation ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure-mode analysis; if you run multi-model long-context serving, a small cache-translation ablation is worth doing.

paper.title: Faster but Different: Diagnosing and Controlling Content Drift in Accelerated Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Training-free acceleration makes diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) more deployable, but it may silently change generated content. We study this serving-time consistency problem on 300 real images, comparing Fast-dLLM outputs with the same model's unaccelerated outputs. Across the mild parallelism induced in our long-form setting (1.05--1.25 committed tokens per step), confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but not baseline agreement. State-refresh ablations

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散式多模态语言模型在无训练加速推理时出现“内容漂移”的问题，即加速后输出内容与同一模型未加速解码结果不一致。
summary.importance: 这项工作不是在做更高分的生成，而是在诊断 serving-time consistency。对扩散/并行解码范式来说，这比单纯报速度更关键，因为部署侧常见的 cache、并行提交和状态复用会悄悄改写生成内容。
summary.technical_approach: 作者以 Fast-dLLM 为主，比较加速版与未加速版在真实图像长文本生成上的输出一致性；通过 confidence-threshold 调参、state-refresh 消融、image-swap 干预来定位漂移来源，指出陈旧的视觉状态和已生成文本状态是主要因素。进一步提出缩短 KV-cache refresh interval，得到速度与一致性的单调折中曲线；并在 dLLM-Cache、LaViDa 上做了初步外推验证。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 300 张真实图像，关注长文本场景下较轻度并行提交（每步约 1.05–1.25 committed tokens）。结果显示：调 confidence threshold 会改变解码行为，但不能改善与原始解码的一致性；缩短 KV 刷新间隔可稳定提升 agreement，并在实测约 1.3x 加速下接近精确复现未加速输出。对 dLLM-Cache 和 LaViDa 也观察到类似诊断现象，但 dLLM-Cache 只有同时收紧两类 cache 才能恢复一致性，代价是速度优势基本消失。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京理工大学和浙江大学。不是头部实验室的大规模系统报告，但问题设定很贴近扩散式 MLLM 的真实部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies content drift in accelerated diffusion-based multimodal LMs, where training-free serving-time acceleration changes the generated content relative to the same model's unaccelerated decoding.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not about chasing higher task scores, but about serving-time consistency. For diffusion and partially parallel decoding, this matters because cache reuse and stale states can silently alter outputs even when speedups look modest.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Fast-dLLM as the main case, the authors compare accelerated and unaccelerated generations on real-image long-form tasks. They run confidence-threshold tuning, state-refresh ablations, and image-swap interventions to localize the source of drift, identifying stale visual states and stale generated-text states as key contributors. They then shorten the KV-cache refresh interval and obtain a monotonic speed-agreement tradeoff. Similar diagnostics are also checked on dLLM-Cache and LaViDa.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 300 real images in a long-form setting with mild parallelism, around 1.05-1.25 committed tokens per step. Confidence-threshold tuning changes decoding behavior but does not improve baseline agreement. Shorter KV refresh intervals steadily improve agreement and recover near-exact outputs at a measured 1.3x speedup. Similar drift appears in dLLM-Cache and LaViDa, while dLLM-Cache only regains agreement after tightening both caches, which largely removes its speed benefit.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Beijing Institute of Technology and Zhejiang University. This is not a frontier-lab scaling report, but the problem setup is directly relevant to real deployment of diffusion-style multimodal LMs.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLM/dMLLM serving 的人该看：它提醒你速度提升未必是“同一个模型”，先看状态刷新与 cache 失真，读消融和 speed-agreement 曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about diffusion-LM serving: a speedup is not necessarily the same model anymore, and the useful part is the cache/state-refresh diagnosis plus the speed-agreement frontier.

paper.title: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
paper.abstract: Disaggregated LLM inference creates a datacenter networking problem that no existing system solves correctly. When prefill and decode run on separate GPU pools, the KV cache must be transferred between them. For a 70B model this is 2.6 GB per request, exceeding 100 GB/s aggregate at production scale. Yet DistServe, Splitwise, and Mooncake all use uniform RDMA, ignoring that bandwidth between two GPUs varies by 72x depending on their physical relationship: 900 GB/s via NVLink within a domain, 50

summary.core_problem: 要解决的是：在“prefill 与 decode 分离”的 disaggregated GPU 推理架构里，每个请求都要把 KV cache 从 prefill 池搬到 decode 池。KV 体量很大（例如 Llama-3-70B、4K prompt 时 2.6GB/req），而 GPU 集群互联是分层拓扑，带宽差异可达 72×。现有系统把传输当成均匀 RDMA 问题，导致要么浪费 NVLink 级带宽，要么选错传输方式直接不可用。论文提出需要一个“拓扑感知”的 KV 传输编排层。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 serving/系统，不是预训练方法论文。对基座预训练研究的间接价值在于：它把 KV cache 的真实体量、不同注意力/缓存压缩设计（如 GQA vs MLA）对系统瓶颈的影响讲得很具体，能反向影响架构选择与长上下文训练/推理的取舍。但如果只做 pretrain recipe，本篇优先级不高。
summary.technical_approach:
系统叫 TopKV，核心是“发现拓扑 + 按拓扑选传输协议 + 把 MoE 路由与缓存放置一起优化”。
1) 拓扑发现：启动时通过 nvidia-smi topology matrix、lspci、RDMA capability probes、K8s node labels 等构建 GPU 互联图。
2) 传输选择：每次 KV 迁移按源/目的 GPU 的物理关系选最高带宽通道：同 NVLink domain 用 NVLink；同节点跨 domain 用 PCIe；跨节点用 RDMA/InfiniBand；跨机房或兜底用 TCP。实现上提供 5 种 transport mode，并带生产级编排（重试、并发限制、完整性校验）。
3) 面向 MoE 的域感知路由：对 DeepSeek-V3 这类大量 experts 的 MoE，维护 expert registry（激活率、时延、队列深度），在 NVLink domain 级别做 cache-affinity / expert-locality / load-balance 三种策略，减少跨域流量。
4) CXL 3.0 溢出层：把 CXL Type-3 内存扩展作为 KV overflow tier（文中建模 150ns 读延迟、64GB/s/endpoint；每节点 4 endpoint 提供 512GB 额外容量），用于缓解 HBM 容量压力，延迟显著优于 NVMe。
summary.experiments:
这篇的限制写得很直白：完整端到端评测需要同时具备 NVLink + InfiniBand RDMA + CXL 3.0 的多节点集群，学术环境难以获得，因此主要给出“完整实现 + 基于公开硬件规格的分析模型”。
文中给出的关键量化点包括：
- Llama-3-70B（GQA）4K prompt 的 KV=2.6GB；DeepSeek-V3（MLA）KV=250MB（约 64× 压缩）；Mixtral-8x22B（GQA）KV=1.8GB。
- 2.6GB 在 50GB/s RDMA 下传输 52ms，直接加到 TTFT；在 900GB/s NVLink 下约 2.9ms（18×）。
- 以 100 rps 计，2.6GB/req 的聚合带宽需求 260GB/s。
（由于缺少真实集群实验，结论更像“系统设计正确性 + 上界收益估算”，而非已验证的生产收益曲线。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 prefill/ decode 算术强度差异与 KV 体量的推导与表格（Table 1/2），这部分对理解“为什么 disaggregation 必然遇到网络瓶颈”最有用。
- 再看 TopKV 的 transport selection 机制与失败兜底（NVLink/PCIe/RDMA/TCP 的选择条件），确认它解决的是“选错协议/浪费带宽”的工程问题。
- 如果关心 MoE serving，重点看 NVLink domain-aware routing 的三种策略与 expert registry 维护指标。
- 对预训练研究者：主要把它当作“KV 体量与互联带宽的现实约束”资料库即可，不必逐段精读实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In disaggregated LLM inference where prefill and decode run on separate GPU pools, every request requires transferring the KV cache from prefill workers to decode workers. KV caches are large (e.g., 2.6GB/request for Llama-3-70B with a 4K prompt), while datacenter GPU interconnect bandwidth is highly hierarchical (up to 72× variation). Existing systems largely assume uniform RDMA transfers, which can waste NVLink-class bandwidth or fail when the chosen transport is incompatible with the actual placement. The paper argues for topology-aware KV movement orchestration.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving/systems paper rather than pretraining. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect: it quantifies KV-cache sizes and shows how architectural choices (e.g., GQA vs MLA-style cache compression) translate into real transfer/TTFT budgets, which can feed back into model design and long-context trade-offs. If your focus is training recipes, it is not a priority read.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TopKV is a topology-aware KV-cache transfer orchestrator.
- Topology discovery at startup using hardware/software probes (nvidia-smi topology matrix, lspci, RDMA capability checks, Kubernetes labels) to build an interconnect graph.
- Per-transfer transport selection: choose the best available path based on the physical relationship between GPUs—NVLink within a domain, PCIe within a node across domains, RDMA across nodes, TCP as fallback. The system implements multiple transport modes with production-oriented orchestration (retries, concurrency control, integrity checks).
- NVLink-domain-aware MoE routing: for large MoE models (e.g., DeepSeek-V3 with many experts), maintain an expert registry (activation rates, latency, queue depth) and route with strategies such as cache-affinity, expert-locality, and load-balancing to reduce cross-domain traffic.
- CXL 3.0 overflow tier: integrate CXL Type-3 memory expanders as a KV overflow layer (modeled at ~150ns read latency and 64GB/s per endpoint) to extend capacity beyond HBM with much lower latency than NVMe.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper explicitly notes that full end-to-end evaluation requires rare hardware (multi-node NVLink + InfiniBand RDMA + CXL 3.0), so it provides a complete implementation and analytical models grounded in published specs.
Key quantitative points:
- KV sizes at 4K prompt: Llama-3-70B (GQA) 2.6GB; DeepSeek-V3 (MLA) 0.25GB (~64× smaller); Mixtral-8x22B (GQA) 1.8GB.
- Transfer time for 2.6GB: ~52ms at 50GB/s RDMA vs ~2.9ms at 900GB/s NVLink (~18×).
- At 100 rps, 2.6GB/request implies ~260GB/s aggregate transfer demand.
Given the lack of large-scale empirical validation, the results should be read as design justification and upper-bound performance modeling rather than demonstrated production gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Read the prefill vs decode arithmetic-intensity explanation and the KV-size derivations/tables (Table 1/2). This is the most transferable part.
- Review the transport-selection logic and fallback behavior to see how it avoids “wrong protocol / wasted bandwidth” issues.
- If you care about MoE serving, focus on the NVLink-domain-aware routing strategies and the expert-registry signals.
- For pretraining-focused readers, treat it mainly as a constraints-and-numbers reference for KV cache and interconnect bandwidth.

recommendation.zh: 值得看系统设计和带宽数字；它提醒 pretrain 侧别把 KV 形状、MoE placement 和 serving 拓扑割裂设计。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and bandwidth numbers; it is a useful warning that KV layout, MoE placement, and serving topology cannot be designed independently.

paper.title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: KV cache compression is essential for efficient long-context inference. Existing eviction methods permanently discard unselected tokens and consequently remove their aggregate contribution to attention. Merging-based alternatives preserve more information but can perturb retained keys and values that should remain exact. We observe that the information omitted by cache eviction can be formulated as residual statistics in both the numerator and denominator of softmax attention. Based on this obse

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的一个很具体但很核心的问题：在固定 KV cache 预算下，如何压缩历史 token，又尽量不丢掉它们对注意力的贡献。现有 eviction 方法把未保留 token 直接删掉，连同它们在 softmax 分母里的归一化质量和在分子里的 value 贡献一起消失；而 merging 方法虽然能保留部分信息，但会改写被保留的精确记忆，把“该原样保留的 token”和“被压缩的 token”混在一起。ResKV 试图解决的就是这个两难：既保留一部分 token 作为 exact memory，又用剩余预算显式重建被删 token 的聚合注意力贡献。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的直接价值不在预训练，而在 serving 与长上下文推理效率。即便如此，这类工作对模型设计仍有启发，因为它把 KV 压缩从“保留哪些 token”改写成“如何表示被省略的注意力质量”。这个视角比单纯做 token 选择更接近注意力计算本身。对长上下文模型、KV 预算分配、层头异质性分析都有参考意义。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的 inference method：不是改模型参数，而是在固定预算下改善 cache 表示，尤其适合 tight budget 和需要分散证据聚合的任务。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路是把被 eviction 的 token 看成 softmax attention 中一组“残差统计量”，而不是简单的缺失项。标准注意力可以写成分子和分母的比值：分子是各 token 的 exp(logit)·value 求和，分母是 exp(logit) 求和。传统 eviction 只保留主缓存中的若干 token，等于把其余 token 在分子和分母上的贡献都置零。ResKV 则把固定预算拆成两部分：main cache 存精确保留的 token；residual cache 存若干紧凑残差条目，用来近似重建被省略 token 的聚合贡献。

关键点有三个。第一，residual entry 不是 decode 后的外部修正项，而是和 main-cache token 一起进入同一个 softmax 归一化。这样它既能补回 denominator mass，也能补回 numerator mass。作者强调 shared-softmax residual formulation，这和很多只在输出端做补偿的方法不同。第二，main cache 中被选中的 token 保持 exact，不把被删 token 折叠进这些精确保留项里，因此避免 merging 方法常见的 retained-memory perturbation。第三，作者加入两级自适应控制：构建 cache 时，用 validation proxy 决定每层每个 KV head 是否值得分配 residual budget；解码时，用 dynamic gate 根据 main-cache attention 的尖锐程度缩放 residual logits。直觉上，如果主缓存已经形成很尖的检索峰值，就不该让残差项稀释它；如果注意力较分散，残差项更可能有帮助。

从全文描述看，作者同时考虑 query-aware 和 query-agnostic 两种构建方式。后者在压缩时看不到未来 query，更接近真实部署。这个设置很重要，因为很多压缩方法在 query-aware 下效果好，但在线服务里不一定可用。ResKV 的目标是在两种设置下都保持收益。方法上它介于 eviction 与 merging 之间：不完全删除，也不把信息揉进已有 token，而是单独给 omitted mass 一个可参与注意力的表示槽位。
summary.experiments:
作者在多个长上下文 benchmark、多个 backbone、多个压缩基线上做了评测。摘要和正文前部给出的主结果是：在相同 retained KV budget 下，ResKV 改善了主表中的全部 32 个 LongBench 配置，以及 64 个 RULER 配置中的 63 个。收益在 cache 预算紧张时更明显，也更集中出现在需要跨长上下文整合分散证据的任务上，这和方法设计是吻合的，因为 residual cache 主要补的是被删 token 的聚合质量。

效率方面，作者强调额外内存开销很小，长上下文下吞吐稳定，没有因为 residual 机制引入明显的服务端负担。消融实验则围绕三个部件展开：validation proxy、dynamic gate、shared softmax。按照论文叙述，这三者都各自有贡献，其中 shared softmax 是方法成立的关键，因为如果 residual 只做后验输出修正，就无法同时恢复 softmax 分母质量。另一个值得注意的实验维度是 query-aware 与 query-agnostic 的对比，后者更接近实际部署，ResKV 在这个更严格设定下仍保持优势，说明它不是依赖未来 query 的离线技巧。

目前给出的全文片段没有列出具体模型名称、压缩率分档、绝对分数和吞吐数字，因此无法安全补充更细的数值。但从结果组织方式看，作者比较重视“固定预算下的公平比较”和“不同预算区间的稳定收益”，而不是只挑一个压缩率报最好结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，抓住作者对三类方法的区分：eviction、merging、contribution estimation。然后重点看方法部分里 attention 的 numerator–denominator 重写，以及 main cache / residual cache 的联合表示，这里是全文真正的新意。接着看 adaptive residual control：一是 construction-time validation proxy，二是 decode-time dynamic gate，理解它们分别解决“要不要分配残差预算”和“什么时候让残差参与更多”这两个问题。实验部分建议先看主表，再看 tight-budget 条件和 query-agnostic 设定下的结果，因为这两处最能体现方法是否有实际部署价值。最后看 shared softmax 与 gate 的消融。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以把方法和实验主线看明白；如果你做 serving 或 KV 压缩，可以再细读实现细节和复杂度分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central long-context inference problem: under a fixed KV-cache budget, how can we compress history without discarding too much of its attention contribution? Standard eviction methods drop unselected tokens entirely, removing both their value contribution in the attention numerator and their probability mass in the softmax denominator. Merging methods preserve more information, but they alter retained entries that ideally should remain exact memories. ResKV is designed to resolve this trade-off by keeping a subset of tokens exact while explicitly reconstructing the aggregate contribution of omitted tokens within the same budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model work because it reframes KV compression at the level of attention computation itself. Instead of asking only which tokens to keep, it asks how to represent omitted attention mass. That perspective is useful for long-context model design, cache-budget allocation, and understanding layer/head heterogeneity. The contribution is best viewed as a practical serving method: it does not change model weights, but it improves the representation of compressed context under a fixed memory budget, especially in tight-budget regimes and tasks that require aggregating distributed evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is to treat evicted tokens as residual attention statistics rather than as deleted states. Softmax attention can be written as a numerator–denominator ratio: the numerator sums exp(logit) times value, and the denominator sums exp(logit). Standard eviction keeps only a subset of tokens and effectively sets the omitted side to zero in both terms. ResKV instead splits the fixed cache budget into two parts: a main cache that stores selected tokens exactly, and a residual cache that stores compact residual entries approximating the aggregate contribution of omitted tokens.

There are three key design choices. First, residual entries participate in the same softmax normalization as the exact main-cache tokens. They are not a post-hoc correction added after attention. This shared-softmax formulation allows each residual entry to restore both denominator mass and numerator mass. Second, selected main-cache tokens remain exact; omitted information is not folded into them. This avoids the retained-memory perturbation common in merging-based approaches. Third, the method includes adaptive residual control at two stages. During cache construction, a validation proxy decides whether a given layer/head should receive residual budget based on held-out attention-output reconstruction. During decoding, a dynamic gate scales residual logits according to the sharpness of the main-cache attention. If the main cache already forms a sharp retrieval peak, residual mass should not blur it; if attention is diffuse, residual entries are more likely to help.

The paper also evaluates both query-aware and query-agnostic construction. The latter is more realistic because compression must happen without access to future queries. This matters in practice, since some compression methods look strong only when they can use future-query information. Conceptually, ResKV sits between eviction and merging: it neither deletes omitted tokens outright nor folds them into retained tokens, but gives omitted mass its own compact representation that remains an attention participant.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans multiple long-context benchmarks, multiple backbones, and several representative compression baselines. The headline result reported in the paper is that, under the same retained-KV budget, ResKV improves all 32 displayed LongBench settings and 63 of 64 displayed RULER settings. Gains are especially clear under tight cache budgets and on tasks that require integrating evidence spread across the context, which matches the method’s design goal of restoring omitted aggregate attention mass.

On efficiency, the paper claims negligible additional memory overhead and stable throughput at long context lengths, suggesting that the residual mechanism does not impose a large serving penalty. Ablations focus on three components: the validation proxy, the dynamic gate, and the shared-softmax formulation. From the paper’s framing, all three matter, but shared softmax is the conceptual core because a pure output-side correction would not recover denominator mass. Another important experimental axis is the comparison between query-aware and query-agnostic construction. The latter is the more deployment-relevant setting, and ResKV still shows gains there, which argues against the method being an offline trick that depends on future-query access.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact backbone names, compression-ratio breakdowns, absolute scores, or throughput numbers, so it would be unsafe to invent finer-grained metrics. Still, the structure of the evaluation suggests that the authors care about fair fixed-budget comparisons and stable gains across budget regimes, not just a single favorable operating point.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction, especially the taxonomy of eviction, merging, and contribution-estimation methods. Then read the method section where attention is rewritten in numerator–denominator form and where the joint main-cache plus residual-cache representation is introduced. That is the real conceptual contribution. After that, focus on the adaptive residual control components: the construction-time validation proxy and the decode-time dynamic gate. They solve different problems, namely whether residual budget is worth allocating and when residual entries should be allowed to contribute more strongly. In the experiments, read the main tables first, then the tight-budget and query-agnostic results, since those are the most deployment-relevant settings. Finish with the ablations on shared softmax and gating. A first pass should take about 20–30 minutes; if you work on serving or KV compression, it is worth reading the implementation and complexity details more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 residual softmax 公式即可；这个方向对长上下文预训练的 serving 假设有用，但需等完整数值。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and residual-softmax formulation; it is relevant to long-context serving assumptions, but the full numbers matter.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory
paper.abstract: Transformer depth is not used uniformly: lower and middle layers build semantic representations, while upper layers increasingly specialize them for prediction. We turn this division of labor into CoMem (Comprehension Memory), which writes each context chunk only through an intermediate layer, retrieves a fixed number of cached residual states, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers over the resulting pack. For a fixed retrieval budget, model-side read compute and memory are independe

summary.core_problem: 利用 Transformer 不同深度层的功能分工，构造一种存储上下文长度不影响读时显存和计算的长上下文记忆机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长上下文推理与记忆系统创新，同时带有机制分析价值。它把“中间层负责理解、上层负责预测”的观察转化为可训练、可部署的缓存方案，对 KV-cache 长上下文路线有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoMem。每个上下文 chunk 只前向到中间层并写入残差状态；检索时取固定数量的缓存残差状态，与当前 query 组成 pack，再重新计算 query-conditioned 的上层网络。这样在固定检索预算下，读时计算和显存不随已存上下文长度增长。主实验冻结 Qwen3-8B base backbone，只训练 rank-32 self-distillation LoRA；另报告无 adapter 版本。
summary.experiments: 使用 continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM，在无 chat-template 的统一协议下评测。CoMem 在 RULER 达到 97.05，在 LoCoMo 达到 38.27；对比 full-context KV-Direct 的 34.59，差距很大。摘要还称对话记忆优势在 conversation-cluster resampling 和独立 judge 下仍保留，并补充了长上下文与长文档结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper turns depth-wise functional specialization in Transformers into a long-context memory mechanism whose read-time compute and memory do not grow with stored context length.
summary_en.importance: This is a long-context inference and memory-system contribution with a useful mechanistic angle. It converts the observation that middle layers encode semantics while upper layers specialize for prediction into a practical cache design, making it relevant to KV-cache alternatives.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoMem writes each context chunk only up to an intermediate layer and stores residual states. At read time, it retrieves a fixed number of cached states, packs them with the query, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers. With a fixed retrieval budget, read compute and memory are independent of the total stored context. The main setup freezes a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base model and trains only a rank-32 self-distillation LoRA; an adapter-free variant is also reported.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM under a unified chat-template-free protocol. CoMem reaches 97.05 on RULER and 38.27 on LoCoMo, compared with 34.59 for full-context KV-Direct. The abstract also reports robustness under conversation-cluster resampling, an independent judge, and additional long-context and long-document tests.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图、RULER/LoCoMo 设置和消融；若 setup 干净，应在内部长上下文 cache 实验复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram, RULER/LoCoMo setup, and ablations; if the setup is clean, this deserves an internal long-context cache reproduction.

paper.title: Stage-Replay Divergence Follows the KV Cache: Fixed-Prefix Precision Controls and Bidirectional Cache Transplantation
paper.abstract: Stage-replay diagnostics reconstruct intermediate token prefixes and treat fresh-prefill continuation as continuation from the decoder state that originally reached the prefix. We audit that assumption at a whole reasoning-stage boundary in a Qwen2.5-derived system. A matched 200-item experiment compares retained live cache with one-shot prefill of identical integer tokens and places an exact replica on both sides. In BF16, replicas remain exact while the constructions differ on 166 suffixes and

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文检查一个常被默认接受的诊断假设：把中间 token prefix 重新 prefill 一遍，是否等价于从原始 autoregressive decode 到达该 prefix 时的 live KV cache 继续生成。作者在一个 Qwen2.5-derived 系统中发现，在 BF16 下，两者可以消费完全相同的 token prefix，却产生不同后续轨迹。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练方法没有直接算法贡献，但对训练诊断、credit assignment、自训练分析、长链推理回放和中间状态蒸馏有明确警示。许多分析会把“相同 token prefix 的 fresh replay”当作“相同内部状态”的近似，这篇工作说明这个近似在低精度和 KV cache 路径差异下可能失效。更重要的是，论文没有把问题简化成准确率升降，而是把 replica 稳定性、token identity、live-state fidelity 和 cache 因果充分性分开验证。这种实验卫生对研究训练动态很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者研究的是一个带结构化推理阶段的 Qwen2.5-derived 系统：模型生成三个 reasoning branch，一个 merge trace，再生成 final answer。各阶段有 role embedding、role-visibility attention mask 和结构化 logits mask。诊断边界选在唯一的 <|merge|> token 被处理之后、生成第一个 merge content token 之前。实验比较两种构造：live path 保留普通增量解码过程中形成的 KV cache；replay path 丢弃 cache，只用完全相同的整数 token、role、position、mask 和 batch contract 做一次 fresh prefill，然后继续生成。为了排除随机性和 token 差异，作者设计了 matched duplicate matrix、固定 prefix 的 construction × precision 2×2 控制，以及双向 whole-cache transplantation。cache transplantation 是关键因果测试：保留 recipient 的 token state 和边界 logits，但替换完整 K/V cache，观察后续 suffix 跟随 donor 还是 recipient。
summary.experiments: 主实验为 200 个样本的 matched comparison。在 BF16 下，重复 replica 完全一致，说明每种执行路径自身稳定；但 live cache 与 one-shot prefill 在 166 个 suffix 上发生分歧，并导致 20 个 correctness label 不同。任务准确率差异只有 1 个百分点，paired 95% CI 为 [-3.5, +5.5]，说明这是 fidelity failure，不一定表现为显著准确率变化。固定 prefix 的 2×2 实验保持全部 200 个 token state 不变，只改变 construction 和 precision：BF16 分歧复现，而 FP32 没有观察到 decoded disagreement。prospective bridge 进一步显示，如果用 token-by-token incremental construction 到达同一个新 prefix，可以复现 ordinary live cache。最强的证据来自双向完整 K/V cache 移植：在 primary checkpoint 的 divergent rows 和一个 outcome-blind later-checkpoint replication 中，所有 divergent suffix 都跟随 K/V donor。这说明完整 KV cache 足以携带被观察到的后续轨迹差异，但论文谨慎地没有声称某个具体 kernel 或 scheduler 是根因，也没有声称 BF16/FP32 规律普遍成立。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Stage Replay and Experimental Design，重点看边界定义、live path 与 replay path 的执行契约是否真的匹配。随后看 fixed-prefix 2×2 控制和 cache transplantation 结果。读这篇不需要纠结任务本身的 branch/merge 设计，重点是实验隔离逻辑：相同 token 不等于相同 decoder state，重复稳定不等于 replay faithful，准确率接近不等于中间状态分析可靠。预计阅读 20 分钟；如果正在做 token credit、trajectory replay、蒸馏或自训练诊断，建议细读实验设计表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits a common assumption in stage-replay diagnostics: reconstructing an intermediate token prefix with a fresh prefill is often treated as equivalent to continuing from the live decoder state that originally reached that prefix. In a Qwen2.5-derived system, the authors show that this equivalence can fail under BF16 even when the integer token prefix is identical.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a new pretraining algorithm, but it is useful for training diagnostics and reasoning-system analysis. Token-credit studies, replay-based counterfactuals, self-training audits, and distillation from intermediate states often rely on fresh-prefix replay. This work shows that token identity and run-to-run determinism are not enough to establish state fidelity. The paper is especially helpful because it separates several notions that are often conflated: replica stability, identical discrete prefixes, fidelity to the live decoder state, and causal sufficiency of the KV cache.
summary_en.technical_approach: The audited system generates three reasoning branches, a learned merge trace, and a final answer. It uses role embeddings, role-visibility masks, and structural logit masks to enforce the staged format. The replay boundary is placed immediately after the unique <|merge|> token has been processed and before the first merge-content token is selected. The live path reaches this boundary through normal incremental decoding and retains the resulting KV cache. The replay path discards that cache and reconstructs the exact same integer prefix with one-shot prefill, while matching token IDs, roles, masks, positions, limits, and physical batching. The design then adds three controls: matched duplicates to isolate replica noise, a fixed-prefix 2×2 crossing of construction method and numerical precision, and bidirectional whole-cache transplantation. The transplantation test is the key causal intervention: the recipient keeps its token state and boundary logits, but receives the donor’s full K/V cache.
summary_en.experiments: The main matched experiment contains 200 items. In BF16, replicas are exact, which means each execution contract is stable. Yet live-cache continuation and one-shot-prefill continuation disagree on 166 suffixes and on 20 correctness labels. The aggregate accuracy difference is only one point, with a paired 95% confidence interval of [-3.5, +5.5], so the issue is primarily replay fidelity rather than a clear task-level accuracy effect. In the fixed-prefix 2×2 control, all 200 token states are held constant while construction and precision are varied. The BF16 disagreement recurs, while FP32 produces no decoded disagreement on the tested prefixes. A prospective bridge shows that token-by-token incremental construction reproduces an ordinary live cache when both consume the same newly reached prefix. The strongest evidence comes from whole-cache transplantation: for every divergent row in both the selected primary-checkpoint set and an outcome-blind later-checkpoint replication, the continuation follows the K/V donor. The result identifies the full KV cache as a sufficient carrier of the observed suffix differences, without claiming a universal BF16 rule or a specific kernel-level cause.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and the experimental-design section first, paying close attention to the exact replay boundary and the matched execution contract. Then read the fixed-prefix precision control and the cache-transplantation results. The task-specific branch/merge architecture is less important than the diagnostic logic: identical tokens do not imply identical decoder state; deterministic replicas do not imply faithful replay; similar final accuracy does not validate intermediate-state conclusions. A focused read should take about 20 minutes. Researchers using trajectory replay, token-credit estimation, or intermediate-state distillation should read the experimental tables more carefully.

recommendation.zh: KV cache构造方式+BF16精度会导致显著输出分歧，做后训练蒸馏/对齐时必须统一推理精度配置，重点看FP32对照实验与缓存移植方法
recommendation.en: KV cache construction + BF16 precision cause significant output divergence; unify inference precision settings during post-training distillation/alignment, focus on FP32 control experiments and cache transplantation method.

paper.title: SemPIC: Learning Semantic Position-Independent KV Caches
paper.abstract: Long-context retrieval and agentic workloads repeatedly reuse the same documents under changing instructions, histories, and document orders. Prefix caching cannot exploit this reuse, while position-independent caching (PIC) remains unreliable because independently compiled KV states lack the future context in which they will be consumed. Our diagnostics show that a learned boundary-conditioned baseline sharply reduces attention deviation near reusable-block boundaries but leaves interior and ta

summary.core_problem: 长上下文检索与 Agent 场景中，同一文档会在不同指令、历史上下文、文档顺序下被反复复用；传统前缀缓存只能在完全相同前缀下命中，位置无关缓存（PIC）虽支持任意拼接，但独立编译的 KV 缺失后续请求中实际存在的前缀上下文，直接拼接会导致注意力偏差与任务性能下降，现有方法仅修复块边界或在线修正，无法离线学习可被原始解码器直接复用的原生文档 KV。
