summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在推理侧缓存与模型适配的接口设计：证明仅靠边界条件不足以消除位置无关缓存的误差，需要对文档级表示做离线适配；同时给出了一种不改动在线解码路径、只通过 LoRA 训练离线 Writer 的方案，为长上下文模型的缓存复用、预训练后针对 KV 缓存特性的轻量适配提供了可落地路径。
summary.technical_approach: SemPIC 分为离线训练的 Writer 与保持不变的预训练 Reader 两部分。Writer 在每层为独立文档生成原生 KV，训练时仅启用 LoRA 适配器，通过行为蒸馏让 Reader 使用缓存后的输出分布逼近全量重算（Full Recompute）的教师分布，梯度经缓存接口回传以重塑 Writer，在线推理时 LoRA 完全禁用、解码路径与原模型一致。针对训练时每层 KV 可微带来的显存瓶颈，引入 KV Gradient Checkpointing：反向阶段重建 Writer 中间激活，但保留缓存 KV 及其梯度路径，在不影响命中时服务行为的前提下显著降低峰值显存。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 三个模型、四类任务上与 KV Packet、No Recompute、Full Recompute 对比，SemPIC 在 12 个设置中的 10 个优于 KV Packet，任务恢复率接近 Full Recompute；诊断指标显示相对 Full Recompute 的块内部注意力偏差在所有设置下均低于 KV Packet，验证了边界-内部不对称性：边界条件能显著降低边界附近误差，但内部与任务级残差仍需文档级适配。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点放在第 4 节对 KV Packet 的诊断分析（边界-内部不对称性的来源与量化）、第 3 节 SemPIC 的 Writer-Reader 解耦与行为蒸馏目标、以及 KV Gradient Checkpointing 的实现细节；图表重点看注意力偏差按块区域拆分的对比图和各任务恢复率柱状图。预计阅读时间 30-40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context retrieval and agent workloads, the same documents are repeatedly reused under varying instructions, conversation histories, and document orderings. Conventional prefix caching only hits under identical prefixes. Position-independent caching (PIC) allows arbitrary composition, but KV states compiled in isolation lack the prefix context that will precede the document at request time, causing attention drift and task degradation when naively stitched. Existing PIC methods only repair block boundaries or apply online corrections; none learns native document KVs offline that can be consumed directly by an unmodified decoder.
summary_en.importance: The work informs the interface between inference-time caching and post-pretrain adaptation. It shows that boundary conditioning alone is insufficient to close the PIC error gap and that document-level offline representation adaptation is required. The proposed recipe — a LoRA-trained offline Writer paired with an unchanged Reader — provides a practical path for long-context models to exploit cache reuse, and for lightweight post-pretrain adaptation targeted at KV cache properties without altering the online decoding path.
summary_en.technical_approach: SemPIC decouples the system into an offline Writer and a frozen pretrained Reader. The Writer produces native per-layer KVs for each document independently, with LoRA adapters enabled only during compilation. Behavioral distillation aligns the Reader's output distribution when consuming cached KVs to that of Full Recompute, so gradients flow back through the cache interface to reshape the Writer. At serving time, LoRA is disabled and the decoding path is identical to the base model. To resolve the memory bottleneck caused by differentiable KVs across all layers, KV Gradient Checkpointing reconstructs Writer intermediates during backward while preserving cached KVs and their gradient path, reducing peak memory without changing cache-hit serving behavior.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three models (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) and four tasks, SemPIC outperforms KV Packet in 10 of 12 settings, with task recovery approaching Full Recompute. Diagnostics show lower Full-relative interior attention deviation than KV Packet in every setting, confirming the boundary-interior asymmetry: boundary conditioning sharply reduces near-boundary error, but interior and task-level residuals persist without document-wide adaptation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 4 first for the diagnostic analysis of KV Packet that motivates the method, then Section 3 for the Writer-Reader decoupling, behavioral distillation objective, and KV Gradient Checkpointing details. Focus on figures that decompose attention deviation by block region and the task recovery bar charts. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文推理优化的增量工作，核心看离线KV蒸馏的设计与§3的注意力偏差诊断，可作为内部KV缓存优化的参考素材。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on long-context inference optimization; focus on the offline KV distillation design and §3 attention deviation diagnostics as reference for internal KV cache optimization.

paper.title: Back from the Future: Key-Value Cache Management by Counter-Causal Surprise
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache management through compression and eviction strategies has emerged as an important research direction in recent years. Computational demands of large language models (LLMs) and their multi-modal variants during output generation can be partially alleviated by caching previous key and value calculations needed by subsequent scaled dot-product attention operations. However, this leads to another problem: the size of the resulting KV cache grows linearly with context length and

summary.core_problem: 在有限显存下做自回归生成时，KV cache 随上下文线性增长。现有基于注意力分数的驱逐策略会产生自强化偏差：被保留的 token 持续获得后续注意力，分数累积后更难被驱逐；而只出现一次但对后续回答关键的低频 token 可能被误删。
summary.importance: 提出了一种不依赖训练、不依赖前向注意力权重的 KV cache 驱逐准则，对长上下文推理和多模态生成的显存管理有实际价值。对预训练研究的直接启发在于：它用“未来 token 能否预测当前 token”来度量上下文信息冗余，提供了一种不同于 heavy hitter 注意力统计的上下文可压缩性视角。
summary.technical_approach: 核心量是 counter-causal surprise。在生成过程中复用已计算的 KV，额外做一次带反因果上三角 mask 的前向计算，使每个位置只能注意 cache 中它之后的 token。如果一个旧 token 能被后续 token 很好预测，说明其信息已被后文吸收，surprise 低，可以驱逐；如果难以被后文预测，则保留。该方法天然偏向近期 token，类似滑动窗口但保留原则更明确。完整反因果 pass 的代价为 O(Ln²)，其中 L 是层数、n 是当前 cache 大小；作者进一步提出只在最后一层做反因果 pass 的快速近似，代价降到 O(n²)，在 Qwen2.5-7B、512 token cache 下每次刷新约 7.9ms，相对完整版本加速 7–9 倍。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖长提示和长生成两类任务，测试 prefill 与 decode 阶段，并在两个开源 LLM 系列、不同尺寸上比较。论文展示了注意力-based 方法在部分任务、模型和 cache 大小组合下退化更快的失败案例；counter-causal surprise 在质量上与现有方法持平或更好，同时快速近似保持了较低延迟。具体任务精度数字未在提供的正文中完整给出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看引言中对注意力自强化偏差的描述，再看方法部分关于反因果 mask 和 surprise 评分的定义。重点比较完整反因果 pass 与最后一层近似的精度-开销权衡。实验部分建议关注 cache 大小变化时的质量曲线和失败案例。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: During autoregressive generation under memory constraints, the KV cache grows linearly with context length. Attention-based eviction methods suffer from a self-reinforcing bias: retained tokens keep receiving attention in later decoding steps, accumulating score and becoming harder to evict, while low-frequency but factually critical tokens may be removed too early.
summary_en.importance: The paper introduces a training-free KV cache eviction criterion that does not rely on forward attention scores. It is practically relevant for long-context and multimodal inference. For pretraining research, its main interest is the notion that a past token is redundant if it can be predicted from later tokens, offering a different measure of context compressibility from heavy-hitter attention statistics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed score is counter-causal surprise. While reusing the already computed KV entries, the method runs an additional forward pass with an upper-triangular counter-causal attention mask, so each position attends only to tokens that come after it in the cache. A token with low surprise is predictable from future context and can be evicted; a token with high surprise carries unique information and should be kept. The rule also naturally favors recent tokens. The full counter-causal pass costs O(Ln²), where L is the number of layers and n is the current cache size. A fast approximation restricts the pass to the last transformer layer, reducing cost to O(n²); on Qwen2.5-7B with a 512-token cache, a refresh takes about 7.9 ms, yielding a 7–9× speedup over the full version.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks cover both long-prompt and long-generation settings and evaluate both prefill and decode phases across two families of open-weight LLMs of different sizes. The paper shows cases where attention-based methods degrade faster for certain task, model, and cache-size combinations. Counter-causal surprise is competitive with or better than existing eviction methods, while the last-layer approximation keeps overhead low. Exact task accuracy numbers are not fully included in the provided text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the self-reinforcing bias of attention-based eviction, then read the method section for the counter-causal mask and surprise definition. Pay special attention to the trade-off between the full counter-causal pass and the last-layer approximation. In the experiments, look at quality versus cache-size curves and the reported failure cases. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: KV缓存驱逐的新视角，用反因果可预测性判断冗余，思路新颖，重点看方法设计和消融实验。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective on KV cache eviction using counter-causal predictability; focus on the method design and ablation studies.

paper.title: Steering Instruction Hierarchies at Inference Time
paper.abstract: Instruction hierarchies are a core safety assumption of language model deployment: higher priority inputs, such as system prompts, should override conflicting lower priority inputs from users or tools. Yet frontier LLMs often violate this hierarchy. We introduce V-Steer, a training-free inference time method that restores privileged influence by editing cached value vectors at prompt positions. Using direct logit attribution on the first next token prediction, V-Steer identifies heads where lowe

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是指令层级在推理时失效的问题：系统/开发者指令本应压过用户或工具输出中的冲突指令，但模型内部注意力与残差贡献可能让低优先级 span 主导首 token 预测，导致 prompt injection 或 agent hijacking 成功。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对模型可控性、注意力头功能分析、以及推理时干预很有参考价值。它把“遵守指令层级”拆成可定位的中间表征问题，而不是只依赖安全微调或提示词工程。对于基座研究员，比较有用的是它展示了 DLA 这类 logit attribution 工具如何变成低成本干预信号，并说明 value cache 可能是比 attention matrix 更工程友好的控制入口。
summary.technical_approach: V-Steer 是训练-free 的推理时方法。它先在 prefill 阶段对首个 next-token prediction 做 Direct Logit Attribution，将不同层、不同 head、不同 prompt 位置对候选输出 logit 的贡献分解出来。输入中显式区分 privileged span 和 non-privileged span，例如系统指令与用户冲突指令。方法寻找那些低优先级 span 对输出贡献过强、而高优先级 span 贡献不足的 attention heads。随后它不改 attention kernel，也不重算训练参数，而是直接对 KV cache 中 prompt 位置的 value vectors 做原地乘法编辑：提升 privileged span 的 V，抑制冲突 lower-priority span 的 V。这个选择的关键取舍是工程路径。直接 steering attention weights 往往需要 materialize attention matrix，会破坏 FlashAttention 或 PyTorch SDPA 的 fast path；改 V cache 则保留 fused attention 的实现，只在 cache 上做一次性编辑。
summary.experiments: 论文在 7B 到 70B 规模的 Llama 与 Qwen 系列模型上评估。摘要和正文引言给出的主结果是：原始模型在指令层级 benchmark 上低于 18%，V-Steer 可提升到最高 92%。它优于 prompt engineering，也优于需要修改 attention 计算的 attention steering。直接 attention steering 在实现上可能带来最高 2.4× slowdown，而 V-Steer 因为只编辑 cached values，解码速度基本保持原始 fused-attention 路径。论文还声称在多个模型规模上达到或超过若干训练式方法。对实验应重点看 head 选择、只 boost 或只 suppress 的消融、首 token DLA 与全生成行为之间的相关性，以及不同模型家族中可迁移性是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1，理解作者关于“低优先级 span 在内部占优”的诊断。然后看 Preliminaries 中 DLA 如何展开 attention-to-logit 贡献，重点关注它如何把 span-level attribution 聚合到 head-level 决策。Method 部分需要看 value cache 乘法编辑的公式、head 筛选规则、boost/suppress 超参。实验部分优先看主表、速度对比表，以及 ablation；如果只关心基座训练，可把它当作 alignment failure 的机制分析案例，而不是训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inference-time failures of instruction hierarchy. System or developer messages are supposed to dominate conflicting user or tool-provided instructions, yet the model can internally assign more influence to lower-priority spans, causing prompt injection or agent hijacking to succeed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for studying controllability and mechanistic intervention in deployed LLMs. The main value is the framing: hierarchy following is treated as a localized representation and attribution problem, rather than only as an alignment-data problem. For base-model researchers, the interesting part is the conversion of direct logit attribution into a cheap runtime control signal, and the observation that value-cache editing is a practical intervention point.
summary_en.technical_approach: V-Steer is a training-free inference-time method. During the prefill pass, it applies Direct Logit Attribution to the first next-token prediction and decomposes logit contributions by layer, head, and prompt position. The prompt is partitioned into a privileged span and a conflicting lower-priority span. Heads are selected when attribution indicates that the lower-priority span dominates the privileged one. Instead of modifying attention scores, V-Steer edits the cached value tensors at prompt positions in place: it multiplicatively boosts values for privileged tokens and suppresses values for conflicting lower-priority tokens. This design avoids changing the attention kernel. Attention-weight steering often requires materializing the attention matrix and can fall off the FlashAttention or SDPA fast path, while value-cache editing keeps the normal fused-attention decoding path.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments across Llama and Qwen models from 7B to 70B parameters. On instruction-hierarchy benchmarks, baseline performance is reported below 18%, while V-Steer reaches up to 92%. It outperforms prompt-engineering baselines and attention-steering variants, while avoiding the reported attention-steering overhead of up to 2.4× slowdown. The method is also reported to match or exceed several training-based approaches across model scales. The most informative experimental details are the head-selection ablations, boost-versus-suppress comparisons, speed measurements, and the stability of the method across model families.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 1 to understand the failure mode and the cache-editing intervention. Then read the DLA derivation in the preliminaries, especially how token-position contributions are aggregated into span- and head-level signals. In the method section, focus on the value-cache edit rule, head filtering, and hyperparameters. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, latency comparison, and ablations. For pretraining work, the paper is best read as a mechanistic case study of alignment failure rather than as a training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“系统提示失效”落到 V-cache 可编辑对象上，值得看方法节和消融；若你做 controllability 或 posttrain↔pretrain 接口，这个切口很实用。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it turns instruction-hierarchy failure into a concrete V-cache intervention target; read the method and ablations if you care about controllability or the pretrain↔post-train interface.

institutions: Siebel School of Computing and Data Science

paper.title: The Sparsity Ceiling: Where Spiking Networks Can and Cannot Trade Activity for Energy
paper.abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are promoted as an energy-efficient substrate because sparse, event-driven activity replaces dense multiply-accumulates with cheap accumulates. We argue the energy dividend of sparsity is not a property of SNNs but of the task. Holding architecture fixed and swapping only the hidden unit (continuous vs. leaky-integrate-and-fire), plus a two-sided target-firing-rate probe, we measure how far activity can be pushed down before quality breaks. Low-load feed-forward pe

summary.core_problem: 研究 spiking neural networks 能否依靠稀疏放电稳定换取能耗收益，以及这种收益在前馈感知、循环语言模型和 spiking Transformer 中的边界在哪里。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是效率与架构分析。它对“稀疏事件驱动天然省能”的说法做了更细的拆解：能耗收益不只由 SNN 单元决定，还取决于任务的信息承载方式；对长序列模型尤其有参考意义，因为 recurrence 和 attention 的代价分别落在放电活动和 KV memory 上。
summary.technical_approach: 作者固定架构，只替换 hidden unit：连续单元 vs leaky-integrate-and-fire 单元；再用双侧 target firing-rate probe 测量在性能崩坏前可把活动率压到多低。通过比较前馈感知模型、循环语言模型和 spiking Transformer，分离“序列建模”与“循环压缩状态”带来的稀疏性上限。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告：低负载前馈感知任务可压到约 5% firing 且不损精度；循环语言模型不能低于约 50%，因为 recurrent state 需要持续活跃以携带信息；spiking Transformer 在 3 个 seed 下可稀疏到约 2%。但 attention 依赖完整 KV cache，将放电活动下限换成内存墙。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where spiking neural networks can actually trade sparse activity for energy savings, comparing feed-forward perception, recurrent language modeling, and spiking Transformers.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and architecture analysis. It refines the common claim that event-driven sparsity directly yields energy savings: the limit depends on how the task stores and transports information. For sequence models, recurrence and attention pay different costs—active state versus KV memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study holds the architecture fixed and swaps only the hidden unit between continuous activations and leaky-integrate-and-fire units. A two-sided target firing-rate probe measures how far activity can be reduced before quality collapses. The comparison separates limits caused by sequence modeling from limits caused by recurrent state compression.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that low-load feed-forward perception can reach roughly 5% firing with no accuracy loss; a recurrent language model cannot go below about 50% because its recurrent state must remain active; a spiking Transformer reaches about 2% firing across three seeds. Attention avoids the firing floor by keeping the full KV cache, creating a memory wall instead.

recommendation.zh: 只看抽象和实验表即可；它给了 recurrent state vs KV cache 能耗权衡的清晰反例。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and experiment tables only; the useful signal is the recurrent-state versus KV-cache energy trade-off.

paper.title: InferScale: GPU-Native KV Injection for Personalized LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed with persistent personalized context, such as accumulated memory profiles or long conversation histories, that is shared across a user's many requests. Production memory systems (e.g., Mem0, MemGPT, and Zep) retrieve a relevant subset of this memory and inject it into the prompt, forcing the serving engine to repeatedly prefill the same content. As the retrieval budget grows, time-to-first-token (TTFT) increases even though the underlying memory is

summary.core_problem: 解决个性化 LLM 服务中持久用户记忆被反复塞入 prompt，导致重复 prefill 和 TTFT 增长的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它关注生产环境里长期记忆、用户画像和历史对话被多次复用的场景，尝试把这些上下文从文本 prompt 转为可复用 KV state。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于理解 serving 侧对长上下文和位置编码的真实约束。
summary.technical_approach: InferScale 预先为每条 memory fact 计算 KV 表示，并与语义 embedding 一起存放在 GPU 上。请求到来时，系统检索相关 fact，并把对应 KV 直接注入 vLLM 的 paged cache，避免重新 prefill 文本。为处理 RoPE 下动态拼接 memory 的位置问题，论文提出 Chunked RoPE：存储旋转前的 key，在注入时按目标 chunk 位置重新施加旋转。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体吞吐、TTFT、显存或延迟数字。可确认的实验对象是个性化 memory serving 场景，基线是传统 retrieval-then-prompt-prefill 方式以及 vLLM paged cache 服务路径。效果幅度需要读正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses repeated prefill overhead in personalized LLM serving, where persistent user memory is repeatedly injected into prompts and increases time-to-first-token.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-system optimization. It targets production settings with reusable long-lived context such as user profiles and conversation histories, replacing text prompt reinjection with reusable KV state. For pretraining researchers, the indirect value is in understanding serving-side constraints on long context and positional encodings.
summary_en.technical_approach: InferScale precomputes the KV representation of each memory fact and stores it on GPU together with a semantic embedding. At request time, the system retrieves relevant facts and directly injects their KV into vLLM's paged cache, avoiding repeated text prefill. To support dynamically assembled memories under RoPE, the paper introduces Chunked RoPE: keys are stored before rotation and rotated at injection time according to their target chunk positions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete throughput, TTFT, memory, or latency numbers. The evaluated setting is personalized memory serving, with retrieval-then-prompt-prefill and vLLM paged-cache serving as the relevant baselines. The actual improvement magnitude needs to be checked in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Chunked RoPE 和 KV 注入接口；这是 serving trick，不会改变长上下文预训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Read only Chunked RoPE and the KV injection path; this is a serving trick, not a long-context pretraining prior.

paper.title: Seen, Said, or Forgotten? A Causal Audit of Visual KV Memory Across Dialog Turns
paper.abstract: Stateful multimodal assistants encode an image once but may answer questions about it many turns later. Attention-guided visual-KV eviction assumes that evidence irrelevant now will remain dispensable, although future questions are unknown. We ask when a visual fact is actually safe to forget and introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit (CVMA), a paired single-prefill framework that tests what later answers lose when a visual region, the whole image, or prior assistant text becomes unavailable.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多轮 VLM 中的视觉 KV cache 是否可以安全丢弃。具体问题是：当前轮 attention 低的视觉区域，是否真的对未来问题无用。作者指出，attention-based visual KV eviction 隐含了一个强假设：当前不重要的视觉证据，未来也不重要。但在多轮对话里，未来问题未知，这个假设经常不成立。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 VLM 记忆机制、长上下文多模态 serving、视觉 token 压缩有启发。它把“视觉信息是否已被模型看到、是否已被说出、是否仍保存在 KV 中”拆开分析。这个拆分很重要，因为多轮 VLM 的性能下降可能来自三种不同机制：视觉证据被错误删除、后续问题其实不依赖视觉、或者视觉事实已经迁移到 assistant text KV。对做 native multimodal LM 或视觉 token 压缩的人，论文的主要价值是提供了更干净的因果审计方法，而不是提出新的压缩策略。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Causal Visual Memory Audit，简称 CVMA。它保持单次 image prefill 的 stateful trajectory，然后在同一个对话轨迹内做 paired intervention。干预对象包括特定视觉区域、整张图像对应的 KV、以及历史 assistant text KV。技术细节上，drop 操作让对应 cache 位置不可读，但保持 cache 长度、位置索引和 RoPE index 不变，从而减少位置分布变化带来的混淆。评价指标是 reference answer 内容 token 的平均 cross-entropy。作者定义了 regional future utility，用删除某个区域后未来轮次 NLL 的上升衡量该区域未来是否有用；定义 all-image dependence，用删除整张图像后的损失衡量该对话是否仍需要视觉证据；还用 random retention 和 marginal-utility retention 控制，区分“attention 代理失效”和“选择问题本身无解”。最后，通过 image-text factorial interventions 分析 assistant 输出文本能否替代已删除的视觉 KV。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct BF16，因果审计还测试 Idefics3-8B-Llama3，附录中有 Qwen 3B scale check。数据包括 VisDial v1.0 validation 的 2,064 个十轮对话，以及 ConvBench 的 547 个三轮长回答对话，其中 546 个可用。完整 policy comparison 用全部样本；regional audit 在排除 72 个早期 pilot/confirmation ID 后，固定随机顺序取前 200 个样本。主要发现是：当前轮 attention 对未来区域效用的排序很差，在 VisDial 上甚至可能比随机更差；但 marginal-utility control 显示仍有选择空间，说明不是任务本身无法选择，而是 attention proxy 不适合预测未来。总体分数下降有时不大，因为很多后续轮次不依赖视觉，甚至可能因删除噪声视觉 KV 而改善。更细的 fact-level 分析显示，assistant text KV 可以替代那些已经被明确说出的视觉事实；没有说出的隐藏视觉事实是否保留，取决于模型和上下文，不稳定，也不一定能支持正确回答。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 CVMA 的 causal estimands 和 intervention 设计，尤其是如何在不改变 cache 几何结构的情况下删除视觉证据。实验部分优先看 attention ranking 与 future regional utility 的对比、all-image dependence 分桶结果、以及 image-text factorial intervention。若关注推理效率或 VLM serving，可以重点读 policy regret 和 retention budget 相关图表；若关注多模态预训练，可以关注视觉事实何时迁移到文本 KV，这对理解跨模态记忆边界更有用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when visual KV entries in a stateful multimodal assistant can be safely forgotten. The concrete question is whether visual regions that receive low attention in the current turn are truly irrelevant for future turns. The paper argues that attention-guided visual KV eviction makes a strong assumption: evidence that is not useful now will remain unnecessary later, even though future user questions are unknown.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for VLM memory analysis, multimodal long-context serving, and visual token compression. Its main contribution is to separate three mechanisms that aggregate scores usually mix together: the model may have seen a fact, the assistant may have verbalized it into text, or the visual KV that carried it may still be available. That distinction matters for native multimodal models because a small average loss after KV eviction can hide failures on visually dependent future turns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit, or CVMA. It keeps a single stateful trajectory in which the image is prefetched once, then applies paired interventions within the same dialog. The interventions remove access to a visual region, the entire image span, or prior assistant text KV. The drop operation preserves cache length, positions, and RoPE indices, so the intervention targets availability of evidence rather than sequence geometry. The outcome is the mean cross-entropy on reference answer content tokens. Regional future utility is measured by the loss increase after removing a region over later turns. All-image dependence measures whether the future dialog needs visual KV at all. Random and marginal-utility retention controls test whether attention is a bad proxy or whether selection is intrinsically difficult. Image–text factorial interventions then test when assistant text can replace missing visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct in BF16. The causal audit also includes Idefics3-8B-Llama3, with a Qwen 3B scale check in the appendix. The datasets are VisDial v1.0 validation with 2,064 ten-turn dialogs and ConvBench with 547 three-turn long-form dialogs, 546 of which are usable after excluding one degenerate reference. Full policy comparisons use all available dialogs. The regional audit removes 72 earlier pilot or confirmation IDs, shuffles the remaining set with a fixed seed, and freezes the first 200 examples. The main empirical result is that current attention can rank future-useful regions poorly, and on VisDial joint retention can be worse than random. A marginal-utility control shows that useful selection is still possible, so the issue is the proxy rather than the absence of signal. Aggregate degradation can look modest because many later turns do not require vision, and some low-dependence cases benefit from denoising. At the fact level, assistant text KV can substitute for visual KV when the fact has been stated, while unstated visual facts are not reliably recoverable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the CVMA definitions, the intervention invariants, and the comparison between current attention and future regional utility. The most useful results are the dependence-conditioned analyses, the retention-budget regret plots, and the image–text factorial interventions. For serving and compression work, the key lesson is that low current attention is not enough evidence for irreversible visual KV deletion. For multimodal pretraining research, the useful part is the analysis of when visual facts move into text memory and when they remain dependent on image KV.

recommendation.zh: 做过多模态 KV-cache 压缩的人该看：它直接打脸"按当前注意力分数驱逐"的默认假设，只看 §3 的 CVMA 设计和 Fig 中 random vs attention 对比即可。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal KV-cache compression, this directly challenges the default attention-score eviction heuristic; read §3 and the random-vs-attention comparison, skip the rest.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: GLIDE: Guided Layerwise Hybrid Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models scale to increasingly long contexts, the memory I/O and computational overhead of the Key-Value (KV) cache during decoding emerges as the primary throughput bottleneck. To address this, we propose GLIDE, a Guided Layerwise Hybrid Attention that strategically integrates sliding-window softmax attention with linear recurrent aggregation. GLIDE is motivated by layer-wise heterogeneity: early layers exhibit high sensitivity to softmax removal, while deeper layers demonstrate

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长上下文解码时 KV-cache 读写成为吞吐瓶颈的问题：在不显著损伤生成质量/推理准确率的前提下，如何减少 KV-cache I/O 并加速解码。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，但对预训练研究也有间接价值：它把“哪些层真正需要 full softmax attention”做成了可操作的层级分配策略，提示训练与架构设计里存在稳定的 layerwise heterogeneity（早层更敏感、深层更可替代）。如果这种异质性跨模型家族稳定，未来可能反向影响预训练架构（例如训练时就引入分层注意力预算、或在中后层用更便宜的注意力形式）。就当前论文而言，贡献主要在推理侧的可落地加速与一个更低维的配置搜索空间。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路：把“滑动窗口 softmax 注意力 + 线性/递归式聚合（linear recurrent aggregation）”做成分层混合，而不是所有层用同一混合比例。

动机来自实证观察：
- 他们系统性改变各层 softmax-to-linear 的比例，发现 softmax 的重要性强烈依赖层深：早期层去掉 softmax 会明显掉点，后期层可以更激进线性化。

Glide 的机制（按文中描述）：
- 将网络分成 early/middle/late 三段。
- early：保留 full softmax（记作 δ=0）。
- late：使用 full linearization（δ=w，w 可理解为 softmax window 被完全替换）。
- middle：部分线性化，用一个标量 α 控制 δ=α·w（α∈[0,1]）。

关键工程取舍：
- 通过把逐层配置压缩成单一标量 α，显著降低搜索/调参复杂度；相比“每层一个窗口/比例”的高维搜索更容易落地。
- 论文把 Glide 设计成可“无缝集成”到已有 retention-based 架构（如 Liger、LoLCats）上，强调不是重新训练一个新模型，而是作为混合注意力/蒸馏式替换的策略层。

与已有方法区别：
- 相比 uniform hybrid（每层同样的 softmax+linear 配比），Glide 的差异在于 layerwise non-uniform allocation：把昂贵的 softmax 预算集中在敏感层，把线性化集中在冗余层。
- 相比纯 sliding-window，它不靠直接丢远处 token，而是用线性递归聚合保留某种全局信息通路（代价是近似误差）。
summary.experiments:
论文在引言给出的关键数字：
- 在 Llama-3-8B 与 Mistral-7B 上，跨 6 个推理/推理类 benchmark，Glide 相对 baseline 达到 45×–62× 的 KV-cache I/O 降低。
- 解码速度提升最高 3.3×。
- 准确率保留在 baseline 的 92%–96%（文中不同段落给出 92–94% 与 92–96% 两种表述，精读时需要核对最终实验表格口径：是平均准确率比例、还是某种归一化分数）。

消融洞察（从文中描述提取）：
- 全线性化会在早层导致灾难性崩溃（提到平均准确率降到 36% 左右的量级），但在晚层可几乎无损。
- Glide 的优势来自“把 softmax 留在早层”，而不是某个特定线性注意力公式本身。

建议精读时补齐的实验细节（全文后续应有）：
- 序列长度设置、batch/并行设置、以及 I/O 统计口径（on-chip/off-chip、是否按 token 归一）。
- 不同 α 的曲线（Pareto frontier）与不同任务的敏感度差异。
- 与 LoLCats/Liger 的集成方式：是否需要额外微调/蒸馏、训练成本多少、对不同模型是否一致。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（skim）：
- 先看 Section III-A 的层敏感性实验：这是 Glide 合理性的证据来源。
- 再看 Section III-B 的参数化方式（early/middle/late + 单标量 α）：理解它如何把搜索空间降维。
- 最后看 Section IV 的 Pareto 曲线与主表：重点核对 I/O 下降、吞吐提升、准确率损失三者的口径是否一致。

预计阅读时间：25–40 分钟可以掌握方法与主要结果；如果要在自家 serving 栈落地，需要额外时间看实现细节与硬件假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the KV-cache memory I/O bottleneck in long-context autoregressive decoding: reduce KV traffic and latency while keeping generation quality/reasoning accuracy largely intact.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-efficiency contribution, but it surfaces a practically useful observation for model design: softmax attention is not equally important across depth. Early layers are much more sensitive to softmax removal, while later layers can be aggressively linearized. If this layerwise heterogeneity is stable across model families, it can feed back into pretraining-time architectural choices (depth-wise attention budgeting, hybrid blocks, etc.). The immediate value is a simpler, more deployable hybrid-attention allocation strategy with strong I/O savings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Glide is a guided, layerwise non-uniform hybrid attention scheme combining sliding-window softmax attention with a linear recurrent aggregation path.

Motivation via measurement:
- They sweep softmax-to-linear ratios across layers and observe strong depth dependence: early layers suffer large accuracy drops when linearized; deeper layers tolerate linearization.

Mechanism:
- Partition layers into early / middle / late stages.
- Early: full softmax (δ = 0).
- Late: full linearization (δ = w).
- Middle: partial linearization parameterized as δ = α·w with a single scalar α ∈ [0, 1].

Key design choice:
- Reduce a high-dimensional per-layer configuration problem to a 1D knob (α), making the search/tuning and deployment much easier.
- Designed to integrate with existing retention-based hybrid architectures (e.g., Liger, LoLCats), rather than requiring a fully new model from scratch.

Difference vs prior work:
- Uniform hybrid methods apply the same policy across layers; Glide allocates softmax budget where it matters (early layers) and linearizes where redundancy is higher (late layers).
- Unlike pure sliding-window eviction, it retains a global information pathway via linear recurrent aggregation, trading exactness for lower KV cost.
summary_en.experiments:
Headline numbers stated in the paper:
- Up to 45×–62× reduction in KV-cache I/O.
- Up to 3.3× decoding speedup.
- Retains ~92%–96% of baseline accuracy across six reasoning benchmarks on Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B (the exact range/definition should be verified against the main tables).

Ablation insight emphasized:
- Fully linearizing early layers causes catastrophic collapse (mentioned ~36% average accuracy), while fully linearizing late layers yields minimal degradation.
- Glide’s gains come mainly from depth-wise allocation, not from a single magic linear attention variant.

Details to verify in the full results section:
- Sequence lengths, hardware setup, and how KV I/O is measured.
- Pareto curves across α and task-wise sensitivity.
- Whether integration with LoLCats/Liger requires extra fine-tuning/distillation and what the cost is.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim focus:
- Section III-A: the layer sensitivity study (the empirical justification).
- Section III-B: the α-parameterized depth-wise policy (the main simplification).
- Section IV: Pareto frontiers and main tables; check consistency of I/O, speed, and accuracy accounting.

Time: ~25–40 minutes for method + results; longer if you need implementation/hardware assumptions for deployment.

recommendation.zh: 思路靠谱：按层分配softmax预算比“一刀切混合注意力”更像工程真相；先只看layer ablation与吞吐曲线，没硬数值别全信。
recommendation.en: The layer-wise softmax budget idea is more realistic than uniform hybrids; focus on layer ablations and throughput curves—without hard numbers, treat claims as weak signal.

paper.title: PTStore (Prefix Tensor Store): Distributed Prefix Caching and Replication for High Throughput Inference Serving

This reduces the latency of accessing the KV cache and alleviates load imbalance caused by a disproportionately large number of requests on servers containing popular tensors. Furthermore, thanks to decentralization, PTStore allows the expansion

summary.core_problem: 现有 prefix KV cache 主要局限在单 GPU 或单节点内复用，在多节点大规模 serving 中无法充分复用热门前缀，也容易让持有热门 prefix 的节点成为瓶颈。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于推理系统方向，对预训练方法本身影响有限，但对长上下文和高复用 workload 的基座部署有参考价值。它关注的是 KV cache 从“本地运行时优化”变成“分布式存储与复制问题”之后的设计取舍：缓存粒度、元数据查询、热门前缀复制、容量和带宽之间的平衡。这类系统约束会反过来影响长上下文模型的服务成本评估。
summary.technical_approach: PTStore 借鉴 CDN 的思路，把可复用的 KV cache prefix 作为分布式对象管理。核心设计有三点。第一，用 tensor-level 的细粒度增量存储表示 prefix，让多个请求共享公共前缀，同时允许后续分支像 trie 一样无重复扩展。第二，用合并后的元数据支持一次性 prefix 查询，避免在分布式 trie 上逐跳查找带来的延迟。第三，对热门 prefix 做复制，让访问更靠近发起请求的 GPU 或节点，并缓解少数节点因热门 tensor 被频繁读取而形成的负载不均。系统目标不是替代 vLLM 这类运行时，而是作为分布式 prefix cache 层，与现有 serving runtime 集成。
summary.experiments: 摘要和正文介绍部分给出的主要结果是：在长文档问答类 workload 上，PTStore 相比不聚合跨节点、跨 GPU KV cache 内存的基线，可实现约 5–6 倍更高的执行效率。论文还强调其在并发场景下能降低 I/O 开销和端到端运行时间。由于提供内容没有展开完整实验表格，具体集群规模、模型规模、prompt 长度分布、缓存命中率和带宽利用率需要直接查 Section 6。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Section 4 的设计原则，确认它如何把 prefix cache 抽象成分布式 tensor store。再看 Section 5 的实现细节，重点关注元数据组织、prefix query 路径和与 LLM runtime 的接口。最后看 Section 6 的实验，优先检查三个数字：端到端延迟/吞吐、缓存命中率、网络与存储 I/O 开销。若关心预训练研究，可只读 introduction 和实验设置，用来估算长上下文模型部署时 prefix 复用带来的成本变化。

summary_en.core_problem: Prefix KV caching is effective within a GPU or a node, but large-scale multi-node serving misses many reuse opportunities and can overload the nodes that hold popular prefixes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical: long-context and retrieval-heavy deployments increasingly depend on prefix reuse, and the cost model changes when KV cache becomes a distributed storage and replication problem. The paper is useful for understanding the trade-off among cache granularity, metadata lookup cost, hot-prefix replication, memory capacity, and network bandwidth.
summary_en.technical_approach: PTStore treats reusable KV-cache prefixes as distributed tensor objects, following a CDN-like design. The first idea is fine-grained tensor-level incremental storage, so common prefixes can be shared while divergent continuations grow without redundant copies, similar to a trie. The second idea is consolidated metadata, which allows one-shot prefix lookup instead of walking a distributed trie hop by hop. The third idea is popularity-aware replication of hot prefixes, improving locality and reducing load imbalance at the cost of controlled redundancy. The system is positioned as a distributed prefix-cache layer that can integrate with existing LLM serving runtimes rather than replacing them.
summary_en.experiments: The reported headline result is a 5–6x efficiency gain on long-passage question-answering workloads compared with baselines that do not aggregate KV-cache memory across nodes and GPUs and therefore often regenerate reusable prefixes. The paper also reports reduced I/O overhead and lower end-to-end runtime under concurrent serving. The provided text does not include the full experimental tables, so the cluster size, model size, prompt length distribution, cache hit rate, and bandwidth numbers should be checked in Section 6.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read Section 4 first for the design principles and the abstraction of a distributed prefix tensor store. Then read Section 5 for the metadata layout, prefix-query path, replication policy, and runtime integration. Section 6 is mainly for validating whether the reported gains come from higher cache hit rate, lower I/O cost, or better load balance. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the deployment cost implication for long-context models and prefix-heavy workloads.

recommendation.zh: 分布式前缀KV缓存的系统实现，思路借鉴CDN直观合理，长上下文服务场景可参考其架构设计，重点看§3的系统架构。
recommendation.en: Practical distributed prefix KV caching system borrowing CDN ideas; refer to Section 3 for architecture design when building long-context serving systems.

paper.title: Compute Globally, Materialize Locally: The Memory Contract of Sparse Event-KV
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents increasingly reuse their KV cache as memory: a serving system keeps a subset of cached entries and drops the rest. Eviction and episodic-memory schemes therefore rest on a premise rarely tested directly, that a retained event is still informative once the observations that produced it are gone. We test it by omitting one earlier observation from what is served, across otherwise identical agent histories. Among items sensitive to that observation, the answer overwhelmingly fol

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“KV cache 能不能当记忆”这种泛问题，而是一个更细、更关键的 serving 问题：当系统只保留一小部分历史事件对应的 KV 行、并把真正写入信息的源事件删掉之后，被保留的下游事件 KV 是否仍然携带了由已删除上游观测计算出来的状态。作者把这个现象定义为 semantic materialization。核心难点在于，普通准确率无法区分三种来源：答案是否直接写在保留文本里、模型是否靠先验或排除法猜对、还是 KV 行里真的保留了不可见的上游状态。论文因此设计了 donor-pair 因果对照：两段历史在所有被服务的 token 与位置上完全一致，只改变一个已被删除的源事件中的值，看最终回答是否跟着这个被删值变化。这样测到的就是“被保留 KV 行是否独立承载了已消失输入的计算结果”。
summary.importance: 对长上下文 agent、episodic memory、KV eviction、cache-backed memory 这条线，这篇工作的意义在于把一个常被默认成立的前提单独测了出来：保留下来的 KV 行不只代表它们可见文本，还可能携带来自已删除上下文的隐式状态。于是，很多“删掉源事件后性能不降”的结论并不能说明源事件不重要，只能说明某个下游 KV 块已经把信息写穿过去了。这会直接影响 memory policy 的评估方式、cache eviction 的解释、以及长期 agent 里‘记忆单元’应该如何设计。更进一步，作者还说明这种写入不是纯自然涌现、也不是稳定通道，而是一个可编程但容量有限、checkpoint 相关、表面形式敏感的机制。对做预训练和架构的人，这提示了一个值得认真看的方向：Transformer 预填充阶段会把部分中间计算压进后续 token 表示里，而 serving 时这些表示可能成为一种比文本更强、但也更脆弱的记忆接口。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最重要的是把“语义写入”从普通上下文利用中剥离出来。作者把 agent 历史表示成事件序列，一次 global prefill 后，每个事件的 KV 都已经被其前文上下文化。随后 serving 只取一个子集，故意删掉真正包含答案的 source event，只保留一个 downstream root event；这个 root event 的文本只引用 source，例如“ M mirrors S ”，但不显式说出值。若此时模型仍能回答 M 的状态，而且答案随 donor pair 中被删 source 的值切换，就说明 root 的 KV 行中已经 materialize 了上游状态。

论文围绕三个维度建立了“memory contract”。第一是 trigger：什么样的表面构造能触发写入。作者做了 16 种构造 bank，发现语义相近并不够，表面形式差异会让 write-through 从接近随机到 0.95 不等，说明 materialization 不是抽象语义层面自动成立，而是强依赖 checkpoint 对特定句式和关系模式的内部编码。第二是 landing：写入后的状态主要落在哪些被保留行里。结果显示 root event 承载主导 donor-aligned 信号，而某些 reference edge 更多像路由器，帮助查询回到 root；同时单个 row 的可读出内容还依赖 co-served 上下文，说明这不是一个完全局部、上下文无关的存储单元。第三是 access：这个通道能承载多大 payload。作者发现它更像紧凑状态通道，而不是通用信息通道：二元状态恢复明显高于随机，但 4-way、8-way 多分类接近机会水平，三位数字 payload 基本读不出来。

另一个关键贡献是“programmable carrier”。作者不满足于被动观察自然 mention，而是构造一种刻意书写、但不直接泄露答案的 carrier event，用来把上游状态写进后续表示。这个 carrier 能把 donor-aligned recovery 从 6% 提到 51%；在固定 query 位置上，只是把这个 carrier 与共享 downstream row 一起服务，就能把读出从 0.00 提到 0.42。这里的含义很直接：如果系统知道某类状态在未来可能需要、但原始操作数会被 eviction，那么可以在写时显式制造一个“承载事件”来提高后续可读性。不过作者也很克制，指出自然文本中的被动 harvesting 并不是可靠接口，真正工程上稳妥的做法仍然是保留显式 textual record 作为 fallback。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果来自 donor-pair 因果测试。在 Qwen3-8B 上，针对 donor-sensitive items，最终回答对被删除 source value 与其对照值的跟随比达到 99:0，而被服务文本中没有任何 span 明说哪个值正确。这基本排除了“看见答案文本”的解释，也大幅压低了纯猜测解释。

在可编程写入实验里，作者构造 answer-free carrier 后，Qwen3-8B 上 donor-aligned recovery 从 6% 提升到 51%。更细一点，在固定 query position 的设置下，给同一个 downstream row 旁边加上 carrier，读出分数从 0.00 提高到 0.42，说明 materialization 不是只存在于某个单点 token，而是能通过额外承载事件显著改变可服务状态。

触发条件实验用了 16 种 construction bank。作者报告这些构造在表面理解上平均可被模型正确读取到 0.98，但真正 write-through 效果从 chance 到 0.95 波动很大，而且没有任何一种构造在三种近期模型上都稳定属于强写入类。这说明“模型理解了句子”与“模型把状态写进后续 KV”不是一回事。

容量边界实验也很有信息量。二元状态恢复达到 0.934，对比随机基线 0.5 明显更高；但 4-way、8-way payload 基本靠近各自 chance rate，三位数字 payload 则几乎完全缺失。这个结果把现象从“神秘记忆”拉回到更可信的解释：模型能把少量、压缩过的判别状态写进后续表示，但远不是任意信息都能无损搬运。

论文还做了 landing 和 co-serving 相关分析，显示 root event 是主要承载体，而 reference edge 更像访问路径的一部分；同时同一 row 的可读出性依赖与哪些其他 span 一起被服务。这对 cache eviction 很重要，因为它意味着“保留哪一行”不是独立决策，组合也会改变可恢复信息。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住实验设计，再看边界条件。优先看 Introduction 里 donor-pair 的定义和 Fig.1，这里把问题设定得很清楚：比较对象不是文本 span，而是被独立服务的 KV block。然后看 §3，理解 99:0 这个主结果是怎么排除文本泄露、先验猜测和 decoy elimination 的。作者专门强调 decoy 要独立采样，这一点值得注意，因为很多类似实验会被“排除错误选项”伪装成“记住正确答案”。

接着看 §4 到 §6。§4 讲 trigger，适合快速建立直觉：materialization 对表面形式很敏感，不能把它当成稳定 API。§5 讲 landing 和 co-serving，适合做系统的人看，因为它直接关系到 memory selection policy。§6 讲 access envelope，是判断这个机制工程上能不能用的关键部分。若时间有限，先读这三节的图表和结论段，再回头看方法细节。

最后看 §7 和附录 F。§7 讨论 programmable carrier 与 passive harvesting 的差别，是整篇最接近工程启示的部分。附录 F 讨论“删源事件不掉点”为什么不能证明源事件没用，这对解读很多 memory ablation 很有帮助。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做 KV memory、long-horizon agent 或 cache eviction，建议把 donor-pair 设计和 access boundary 两部分精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a serving-time question that is usually assumed but rarely tested directly: if a system keeps only a subset of historical KV blocks and evicts the original source observation, can a retained downstream event still carry state computed from that missing source? The authors call this semantic materialization. The hard part is measurement. Raw accuracy cannot tell whether the model succeeds because the answer is explicitly present in the served text, because it guesses from priors or decoy elimination, or because the retained KV rows genuinely encode hidden upstream state. To separate these cases, the paper uses a donor-pair causal comparison: two histories are byte-identical on all served tokens and positions, and differ only in the value written by an earlier source event that is later omitted from serving. If the final answer tracks that omitted value, the retained downstream KV must be carrying information beyond visible text.
summary_en.importance: This matters for long-horizon agents, episodic memory, and KV-eviction systems because it changes how memory ablations should be interpreted. If dropping a source event does not hurt downstream accuracy, that does not prove the source was unnecessary; it may only mean that some retained downstream KV block had already absorbed the relevant state during prefill. That is a different claim, and a much stronger one than text retrieval can support. The paper therefore sharpens the evaluation target for cache-backed memory systems: row selection is not equivalent to text selection. For pretraining and architecture work, the broader implication is that causal prefill can compress some intermediate computation into later token representations, creating a serving interface that is stronger than raw text but also fragile, checkpoint-specific, and capacity-limited.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main methodological contribution is a clean causal probe for hidden state transfer through KV. The history is modeled as a sequence of events. After one global prefill, each event’s KV is contextualized by everything before it. Serving then keeps only a subset of event blocks, deliberately dropping the source event that contains the value of interest while retaining a downstream root event whose text refers to the source but does not restate the value. If the model can still answer the query and the answer flips with the omitted source value across donor pairs, the retained root KV has materialized upstream-derived state.

The paper organizes the phenomenon into a three-part contract: trigger, landing, and access. Trigger asks which surface constructions actually induce write-through. The authors build a 16-construction bank and show that semantic equivalence is not enough: constructions that are all easy to read can differ dramatically in whether they cause state to be written into downstream representations. This means materialization is sensitive to form, not just meaning, and must be calibrated per checkpoint. Landing asks where the donor-aligned signal resides once the source is gone. The dominant signal lands in the root event, while some served reference edges mostly help route the query back to that root. Importantly, what a row yields depends on what other spans are co-served with it, so the retained row is not a context-free storage cell. Access asks how much information this channel can carry. The answer is: only compact state. Binary payloads are recoverable well above chance, but larger discrete payloads collapse toward chance, and multi-digit values are absent.

A particularly useful part is the programmable carrier construction. Instead of passively harvesting naturally occurring mentions, the authors intentionally write an answer-free carrier event designed to commit upstream state into later representations without explicitly naming the value. This substantially improves donor-aligned recovery. The engineering message is concrete: if a system expects some state to be needed after its operands are evicted, it may be possible to write that state forward on purpose. But the paper is careful not to oversell this. Passive natural mentions are not a reliable interface, and explicit textual records remain the robust fallback.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is the donor-pair test on Qwen3-8B. Among donor-sensitive items, the model’s answer follows the omitted source value at a 99:0 ratio, even though no served span states which value is correct. That is the central evidence that retained KV rows can expose hidden upstream-derived state independently of visible text.

The programmable-carrier experiment is the most actionable systems result. On Qwen3-8B, an intentionally written answer-free carrier raises donor-aligned recovery from 6% to 51%. In a fixed query-position setup, adding the carrier alongside a shared downstream row moves the readout from 0.00 to 0.42. This shows that materialization is not merely an accidental property of one token position; it can be strengthened by writing a better downstream carrier.

The trigger study uses a 16-construction bank. Average read correctness of the constructions is reported at 0.98, but write-through ranges from chance to 0.95, and no construction is consistently strong across all three recent models tested. This is an important negative result: understanding a relation in text does not imply that the model will commit the resulting state into later KV in a way that survives source eviction.

The access-boundary experiments are also informative. Binary state recovers at 0.934 versus a 0.5 chance baseline, but 4-way and 8-way payloads sit near chance, and three-digit payloads are effectively absent. That sharply limits the interpretation of the phenomenon: it is a compact-state channel, not a general-purpose hidden memory bus.

Additional analyses on landing and co-serving show that the root event carries the dominant donor-aligned signal, while reference edges mostly help access it. The recoverability of a row also depends on which other spans are served together, which matters directly for eviction policy design.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the setup, not the claims. Read the introduction and Fig. 1 carefully until the donor-pair comparison is fully clear. The key object is the independently served KV block of a downstream event, not the visible text span itself. Then read Section 3, where the 99:0 result is established and the paper explains how it avoids confounds such as explicit answer leakage, priors, and decoy elimination. The note about independently sampled decoys is worth attention because many memory-style evaluations quietly fail there.

After that, Sections 4 to 6 are the core. Section 4 is about trigger sensitivity and is the fastest way to understand why this is not a stable semantic API. Section 5 is the most relevant part for systems and memory-policy work because it studies where the signal lands and how co-serving changes what can be read out. Section 6 gives the capacity boundary, which is essential if you want to judge whether the mechanism is practically usable.

If time is limited, read the figures and conclusion paragraphs of Sections 3–6 first, then return to the methodological details. Section 7 is the engineering takeaway: programmable carriers versus passive harvesting. Appendix F is worth a quick pass because it explains why “dropping the source causes no loss” is not evidence that the source was unnecessary. A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes; if you work on KV memory, long-horizon agents, or cache eviction, the donor-pair design and the access-boundary analysis deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这个结果会改变 KV eviction 的默认心智模型；先看 omission setup，再决定是否内部复现实验。
recommendation.en: This shifts the default mental model for KV eviction; read the omission setup first and consider an internal replication.

paper.title: Eviction as Estimation: A Fixed-Lag Smoothing View of Test-Time Memory, and When Measuring Beats Accumulating
paper.abstract: A language model with a bounded working memory must repeatedly decide which stored items to keep. Every deployed method decides the moment an item arrives, from the past (StreamingLLM, H2O) or from a guess about the future (SnapKV). We recast the choice as an estimation problem on a hidden signal, whether an item will be reused, placing existing methods on one axis, the commit lag $H$: online filters and learned predictors commit at $H=0$, while Belady's offline optimum sits where the whole futu

summary.core_problem: 长上下文/流式推理下，KV-cache 或工作记忆有硬预算时，如何做“保留/驱逐（eviction）”决策：把驱逐视为对“未来是否会复用”的隐藏信号做估计，并提出一个介于在线策略与离线最优（Belady）之间的固定滞后（fixed-lag smoothing）框架，回答‘什么时候测量近未来使用情况比预测更好’。
summary.importance:
对预训练不是直接贡献，但对长上下文推理与服务侧 memory 管理很有方法论价值：
- 提供一个统一坐标轴（commit lag H）把 StreamingLLM/H2O/学习式预测（SnapKV 等）与 Belady 放到同一条线上，便于讨论“信息可得性 vs 决策时机”的本质差异。
- 提出 demonstrated utility 这种“无标注、从模型自身注意力与 next-token 正确性读出”的近未来使用信号，作为把 Belady 思想迁移到神经缓存的桥。
- 结论比较克制：框架成立，但在独立基准上 RMM 只能做到 H2O 水平甚至更差；这对研究者很重要，因为它明确了适用边界：只有当复用是内生的、且在时间上有间隔时，fixed-lag 的‘测量’才可能胜过‘累计注意力/即时预测’。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 估计论视角：把每个缓存项 x 的“潜在效用”u(x)（保留它能降低未来损失的程度）当作隐藏状态；驱逐策略就是对 u(x) 的估计 û(x)。
2) 关键轴：commit lag H。现有方法几乎都在到达时立刻决定（H=0）：
- filtering：只用过去信息（如 recency、累计 attention）。
- prediction：用模型预测未来会不会用到。
Belady 是 H→∞ 的离线最优，需要完整未来请求序列。
3) fixed-lag smoothing：延迟 H 步再决定是否保留/驱逐，让“是否被复用”的证据从不可观测变为可观测（至少部分可观测）。代价是需要一个缓冲区与额外延迟。
4) Belady bridge：在神经注意力里没有显式 request stream，作者定义 demonstrated utility：从模型在近未来 token 预测中实际使用了哪些 KV（注意力分配）以及这些预测是否正确，构造一种无标注的‘被请求’信号。
5) 算法产物：RMM（training-free policy），被描述为 H2O 的严格泛化；并额外训练一个小模型去预测“我们随后将测量的排序”（用于更好地组织 fixed-lag 的测量/决策）。
6) 负结果与边界：当任务是单次长文阅读、复用不呈现清晰的时间分离时，fixed-lag 的测量会退化为累计注意力，策略等价/接近 H2O；在作者设计的 streaming/复用分离场景里机制更成立。
summary.experiments:
论文把证据分成两类：
- 受控实验（为隔离机制而构造）：RMM 能更贴近离线 oracle（Belady 风格），而纯过滤类方法会退化；用于证明 fixed-lag smoothing 在“复用内生且有时间间隔”的设定下确实能利用到额外信息。
- 独立基准（第三方 harness + 其自带 baselines）：RMM 与 H2O 大致同级，未稳定超过；在其目标 streaming 设定下甚至输给 H2O 与 SnapKV。作者把这作为核心结论之一，并在后文解释原因。
- 由于给出的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称、K 值、H 值扫描曲线与精确数值，这里不复述数字；精读时应重点核对 Section 7/8 的曲线与统计设置。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟，信息密度高但结构清楚）：
1) 先读 Section 3 的“eviction as estimation”与 Table 1/Figure 1（如果有）：把 filtering/prediction/smoothing 与 H 轴对齐，这是全文的组织骨架。
2) 精读 Section 4（demonstrated utility）：这是把 Belady 引入神经缓存的关键技术点，决定了信号是否可靠、是否会被注意力噪声污染。
3) 看 Section 5 的 RMM：理解它为何是 H2O 的严格泛化，以及在 H→0 或特定设置下如何退化回 H2O。
4) 直接跳到 Section 8/9：作者对负结果的解释与“什么时候 measuring beats accumulating”的边界图谱，是最有可迁移价值的部分。
5) 如果你做 pretrain/长上下文训练：把 demonstrated utility 当作一种潜在训练信号来思考——是否能在训练阶段塑造更‘可测量的复用’，从而让 fixed-lag 类策略在真实任务上不退化。

summary_en.core_problem: Under a hard working-memory budget (KV cache or recurrent state), how should a model decide what to keep vs evict? The paper reframes eviction as estimating a hidden signal—future reuse—and introduces fixed-lag smoothing as an intermediate regime between online policies (commit immediately) and the offline optimal Belady algorithm (knows the full future).
summary_en.importance:
Not a pretraining contribution per se, but highly relevant to long-context inference and memory management.
- It provides a clean unifying axis (commit lag H) that places recency/attention-accumulation methods (StreamingLLM, H2O), learned predictors (e.g., SnapKV-style), and Belady on one continuum.
- It proposes “demonstrated utility,” a label-free signal extracted from the model’s own attention and next-token correctness, as a way to make Belady-like reasoning feasible in neural caches.
- The paper is unusually explicit about limitations: on independent benchmarks, the resulting policy (RMM) is only H2O-class and can be worse in streaming settings. That boundary—when measurement beats accumulation—is arguably the most useful takeaway for practitioners.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Estimation framing: each cached item x has latent utility u(x), roughly how much keeping it reduces future loss; an eviction policy is an estimator û(x).
2) Commit lag H as the key degree of freedom:
- H=0 covers existing approaches that decide at arrival: filtering (past-only signals like recency or accumulated attention) and prediction (learned guesses about future reuse).
- H→∞ corresponds to Belady’s offline optimum.
3) Fixed-lag smoothing: delay the keep/evict commitment by H steps so near-future evidence of reuse is observed rather than predicted, trading off buffer memory and latency.
4) Belady bridge via demonstrated utility: since neural attention lacks an explicit request stream, the paper defines a proxy “request” signal from which cached items were actually used by attention in correct near-future predictions.
5) Resulting policy: RMM, a training-free eviction rule that strictly generalizes H2O; additionally, a small model is trained to predict an ordering that is then measured/confirmed under the lag.
6) Regime map: when reuse is endogenous and temporally separated, smoothing can help; for common single-shot long-context reading, the measurement collapses to accumulated attention, making RMM effectively H2O-like.
summary_en.experiments:
Evidence is presented in two tiers:
- Controlled tasks designed to isolate the mechanism: RMM tracks an offline oracle more closely, while pure filtering collapses—supporting the fixed-lag idea when reuse is structured and delayed.
- Independent benchmarks run in a third-party harness against that harness’s baselines: RMM is on par with H2O and does not consistently beat it; in the streaming regime it targets, it can lose to H2O and SnapKV.
- The excerpt provided does not include benchmark names, exact K/H sweeps, or numeric deltas; the key is to verify the curves and settings in Sections 7–9.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the estimation formulation and the H-axis unification (Section 3 + the main table/figure).
2) Spend time on demonstrated utility (Section 4): it is the technical hinge that determines whether Belady-style signals are meaningful in practice.
3) Review RMM (Section 5) to understand how it generalizes H2O and what it reduces to in limiting cases.
4) Jump to the negative results and regime analysis (Sections 8–9): the “when measuring beats accumulating” boundary is the most transferable insight.
5) If you work on pretraining/long-context training, treat demonstrated utility as a candidate training signal and ask whether training can make reuse more measurable, preventing the smoothing approach from degenerating to H2O on real workloads.

recommendation.zh: 固定滞后平滑这个 framing 值得看，尤其是 RMM=H2O 泛化；应在长上下文 KV eviction ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: The fixed-lag smoothing framing is worth reading, especially the RMM-as-H2O-generalization result; reproduce it in long-context KV eviction ablations.

paper.title: KAP: Bridging the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption Gap in LLM Systems
paper.abstract: Modern LLM systems increasingly rely on knowledge-selection processes that produce high-value structured priors, such as ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, and confidence signals. Yet LLM serving remains fundamentally oblivious to this rich structure: once such signals are serialized into a prompt, the backend observes only a flat token sequence, forcing dense and uniform consumption of the full key-value (KV) state during decoding. We term this architectural mismatch the Kno

summary.core_problem: 现代LLM系统存在上游知识选择与下游服务运行时之间的架构不匹配（被命名为KSRC gap）：上游知识选择流水线（如RAG重排序、GraphRAG的图结构遍历、置信度估计等）会产出丰富的结构化先验，但这些信息在prompt序列化阶段被压缩为扁平的token序列，后端serving系统只能无差别加载全部KV缓存进行解码，导致运行时成本随序列化后的上下文长度线性增长，而非随推理实际需要的知识量增长。随着知识选择能力增强、上下文规模扩大，这一不匹配会愈发严重。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：1. 长上下文预训练的性能收益需要与推理运行时效率协同设计，单纯扩大上下文窗口会被线性增长的解码成本抵消，无法充分释放价值；2. 预训练目标可考虑将结构化知识先验（重要性、图结构、置信度等）直接编码进模型表示，而非完全依赖prompt序列化传递，有望同时提升推理质量与效率；3. 长上下文预训练数据的价值评估应结合运行时知识消费模式，而非仅看原始上下文长度下的性能表现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Knowledge Access Planning（KAP）范式，采用编译器-执行器的拆分架构，引入统一的中间表示「运行时访问计划」，解耦逻辑prompt语义与物理KV缓存访问。KAP编译器将上游知识选择产出的高维结构化先验（排序结果、图拓扑、多模态对齐信号、置信度等）编译为该中间表示，KAP执行器则根据计划控制后端KV缓存的物理访问，全程无需修改知识选择前端、语言模型本身或逻辑prompt结构。论文还给出了一个具体实例GraphSpec，以GraphRAG为知识选择前端、vLLM为服务后端，将图结构先验编译为访问计划，指导后端选择性消费知识，同时保留全上下文验证能力。
summary.experiments: 本次提供的论文片段未包含完整实验结果。根据文中提及的内容，后续将通过GraphSpec实例验证其服务效率与回答质量的平衡，并在第4节从分析和实证层面支撑一项缩放原则：当知识选择的选择性提升且能保持执行保真度时，LLM服务的物理成本可随上下文长度亚线性缩放。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注第1节中KSRC gap的定义与问题背景，以及第2节中KAP范式的核心设计思路。关注系统实现的读者可查看第3节GraphSpec与vLLM的适配细节，关注缩放理论的读者可查看第4节的亚线性缩放原则分析。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLM systems face an architectural mismatch termed the Knowledge Selection–Runtime Consumption (KSRC) gap. Upstream knowledge selection pipelines (e.g., RAG reranking, GraphRAG graph traversal, confidence estimation) produce rich structured priors, but these are collapsed into a flat token sequence during prompt serialization. The serving backend only sees a linear token stream and loads the full KV-cache uniformly during decoding, so runtime cost scales with serialized context length rather than the small fraction of context actually needed for reasoning. This mismatch worsens as knowledge selection becomes more sophisticated and context grows longer.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers three actionable implications: 1. Long-context pretraining gains require co-design with serving runtime efficiency; simply expanding context window size is offset by linear growth in decoding cost, preventing full realization of performance improvements. 2. Pretraining objectives could be adapted to encode structured knowledge priors (importance, graph structure, confidence) directly into model representations, rather than relying solely on prompt serialization, potentially improving both reasoning quality and inference efficiency. 3. The value of long-context pretraining data should be evaluated alongside runtime knowledge consumption patterns, not just raw context length performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Knowledge Access Planning (KAP), a plan-driven paradigm for runtime knowledge consumption built on a compiler-executor split. A universal intermediate representation called the runtime access plan decouples logical prompt semantics from physical KV-cache access. The KAP compiler translates high-dimensional structured priors from upstream systems (ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, confidence scores) into this IR, while the KAP executor interprets the plan to control physical KV access in the serving backend. No changes are required to the knowledge selection frontend, the language model itself, or the logical prompt structure. As a concrete instantiation, GraphSpec implements KAP for GraphRAG frontends and vLLM backends, compiling graph-derived priors into access plans that guide selective KV consumption while retaining full-context verification capability.
summary_en.experiments: The provided paper fragment does not include full experimental results. The work states it will evaluate GraphSpec's serving efficiency and answer quality in Section 5, and provides both analytical and empirical grounding in Section 4 for a scaling principle: when knowledge selection becomes more selective while preserving execution fidelity, the physical cost of LLM serving can scale sublinearly with context length.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 1 for the formal definition of the KSRC gap and problem background, and the core KAP paradigm design in Section 2. Readers interested in system implementation can review Section 3 for GraphSpec's vLLM integration details, while those focused on scaling theory can check Section 4 for the sublinear scaling principle analysis. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 想法对长上下文 serving 有用；只看系统抽象和 KV traffic 实测，若无端到端数字就当概念稿。
recommendation.en: Useful for long-context serving design; read the abstraction and KV-traffic measurements, but treat it as conceptual if end-to-end numbers are missing.

paper.title: Kalypso: Relational LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as semantic operators for filtering, extracting, ranking, joining, and transforming unstructured data. Existing semantic query processing systems invoke request-centric LLM serving systems that are unaware of the query plan, leaving substantial performance opportunities unused. This paper introduces relational LLM serving, an abstraction that makes LLM serving aware of semantic query structure while preserving query semantics and output accuracy. The k

summary.core_problem: 现有请求中心化的LLM服务系统无法感知语义查询的算子计划结构，导致多算子流水线场景下KV缓存复用率低、推理成本高。
summary.importance: 跨算子KV缓存复用的思路，为预训练阶段优化缓存友好的注意力架构、针对结构化查询类工作负载设计训练数据提供了下游约束参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出关系型LLM服务抽象，在语义查询处理系统与底层推理引擎之间新增一层感知完整查询计划的服务层。核心是利用语义算子流水线执行时中间元组直接传递的KV前缀复用机会，设计自适应内存感知调度器：为每个算子预留前缀缓存的内存预算，根据内存利用率动态调整并发算子数量，在避免前缀提前淘汰的同时保证GPU利用率。还定义了支持语义算子与查询计划的通用API，兼容现有语义查询系统的代理模型、向量索引等优化。与现有减少请求数或使用近似模型的优化不同，该方法从服务层本身优化，不改变查询语义与输出精度。
summary.experiments: 给定的全文内容未覆盖完整实验章节，暂无法提供具体性能指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读系统设计与调度算法章节，以及实验部分（如有）。重点理解跨算子KV缓存复用的调度约束，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing request-centric LLM serving systems lack visibility into semantic query operator plan structure, leading to low KV cache reuse rates and high inference costs in multi-operator pipeline scenarios.
summary_en.importance: The cross-operator KV cache reuse idea provides downstream constraint references for pre-training research, including optimizing cache-friendly attention architectures and designing training data for structured query workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the relational LLM serving abstraction, a new layer between semantic query processing systems and underlying inference engines that has full visibility into the complete query plan. The core insight is that pipelined execution of semantic operators enables KV prefix reuse when intermediate tuples are passed directly between operators. An adaptive memory-aware scheduler reserves memory budgets for each operator's prefix cache, and dynamically adjusts concurrent operator count to avoid premature prefix eviction while maintaining GPU utilization. It also defines a general API for semantic operators and query plans, compatible with existing SQPS optimizations such as proxy models and vector indexes. Unlike prior optimizations that reduce request count or use approximate models, this approach optimizes serving itself without altering query semantics or output accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text does not cover the complete experimental section, so specific performance metrics are not available from the given content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the system design and scheduling algorithm sections, plus the experimental section if available. Focus on understanding the scheduling constraints of cross-operator KV cache reuse. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 LLM serving / 批量数据处理系统的人看调度问题建模即可；KV-cache 跨调用复用的思路对长文档批量抽取有参考，预训练侧无关。
recommendation.en: Relevant if you build LLM serving or batch data-processing stacks — the cross-operator KV reuse idea matters for bulk extraction; irrelevant to pretrain.

paper.title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inferenc

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型中视觉token占比高导致KV缓存内存压力大，现有prefill阶段KV选择方法在低缓存预算下容易丢弃关键视觉token，降低 grounding 与推理性能。
summary.importance: 指出多模态推理场景下prefill阶段query与decode阶段query分布偏移的核心问题，提出训练免费的prefill-only KV选择方案，在小缓存预算下保留更多关键视觉信息。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MM-ShiftKV，在prefill阶段近似模拟decode阶段的query分布特征，无需训练、无需修改解码流程，严格在prefill阶段完成KV重要性排序与选择。
summary.experiments: 在主流MLLM基准上测试，相同KV压缩率下，grounding准确率与多模态推理性能显著优于现有prefill KV选择基线。

summary_en.core_problem: High visual token counts in MLLMs cause severe KV cache memory pressure; existing prefill-stage KV selection methods often discard critical visual tokens under tight cache budgets, degrading grounding and reasoning performance.
summary_en.importance: Identifies the core issue of distribution shift between prefill-time and decode-time queries in multimodal inference, proposes a training-free prefill-only KV selection method that preserves critical visual information at small cache budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: MM-ShiftKV approximates decode-time query behavior during the prefill stage, requires no training or decoding pipeline changes, and completes KV importance ranking and selection strictly during prefill.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on mainstream MLLM benchmarks; at the same KV compression ratio, it outperforms existing prefill KV selection baselines on grounding accuracy and multimodal reasoning performance.

recommendation.zh: 解决MLLM部署的实际工程问题，指出了prefill/decode query分布偏移的点，做MLLM serving可参考，与通用预训练无关。
recommendation.en: Addresses a practical MLLM serving engineering issue, notes prefill/decode query distribution shift; relevant for MLLM deployment, not general pretraining research.

paper.title: Decoupled Attention Fusion: Accelerating RAG with Efficient KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively mitigates hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) but suffers from prohibitive Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency in long-context scenarios. Reusing pre-computed document KV caches addresses this but introduces a distribution mismatch, where offline caches lack the inter-document attention patterns required for coherent reasoning. CacheBlend reduces recomputation via selective attention, but suffers severe accuracy degradation at longer con

summary.core_problem: RAG 场景下如何复用离线预计算的文档 KV cache，同时避免独立编码文档带来的 KV cache mismatch。核心矛盾是：全量在线 prefill 准确但慢，直接复用离线 cache 快但缺少文档间注意力，质量会下降。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于推理效率方向，对长上下文 RAG serving 有直接价值。它不解决预训练目标或模型结构训练问题，但对基座模型部署和长上下文系统设计有启发：RAG 的文档语料通常是静态的，可以把一部分 prefill 计算前移到离线阶段；难点在于如何用很少的在线计算补回跨文档依赖。DAF 的价值在于把这个补偿问题改写成硬件友好的 dense attention，而不是依赖复杂稀疏 mask 或大量条件分支。
summary.technical_approach: DAF 将 prefill 拆成三部分。第一，选择重要 token，并只让这些 token 之间做 self-attention，用一个较小的全局交互场修复跨文档依赖。重要 token 的选择不只看单层 KV 偏移，而是聚合第 2 到第 4 层等多层信号，降低层间方差带来的误选。第二，question-document self-attention 让问题 token attend 到全部文档和问题上下文，其中重要 token 的 KV 已经在前一步更新，因此在线问答阶段使用的是混合 KV cache。第三，state fusion 将重要 token 路径和问题-文档路径的输出融合为最终 hidden states。复杂度从 CacheBlend 近似的 O(r L_d^2 + L_d L_q) 降到 O(r^2 L_d^2 + L_q(L_d + L_q))，其中 r 是重要 token 比例，L_d 是文档 token 总长，L_q 是问题长度。由于 DAF 的两个 attention 子问题都能表示为标准 dense attention，它可以直接使用 Flash-Attention，避免非标准 mask 和 GPU thread divergence。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-7B，在单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 上 greedy decoding。对比对象包括 vLLM 全量重算和 CacheBlend，重要 token 比例固定为 r = 0.3。评测覆盖 2WikiMultiHopQA、SAMSum 等 6k–9k token 任务，也包括 RULER、LongBench-V2 等最长约 136k token 的长上下文任务。指标包括 TTFT 和任务准确性指标，如 QA 的 Exact Match、摘要的 Rouge-L，并在表中统一为 Accuracy。结果显示，在 9k token 左右 DAF 与 CacheBlend 接近；到约 130k token 时，DAF 相比 CacheBlend 最高约 2 倍加速，相比 vLLM 全量重算约 5.6 倍加速，同时保持接近或更好的准确性。限制也比较明确：r 需要按任务调节；大规模语料的 KV cache 存储和调度仍然是系统瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。优先看 Methods 中三个模块：important-token self-attention、question-document self-attention、state fusion。复杂度分析值得看，关键是 r L_d^2 到 r^2 L_d^2 的差别，以及为什么 L_q 通常较小。硬件部分重点看它如何保持 Flash-Attention 兼容，这决定了理论复杂度能否转成真实 TTFT 收益。实验部分重点看长上下文长度增加时 DAF 与 CacheBlend 的分化，以及 r = 0.3 的固定设置是否足够支撑不同任务。若关注生产系统，还应重点看限制部分，因为 KV cache 存储可能比 attention 计算更早成为瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV cache reuse for RAG. Offline document caches can reduce prefill latency, but independently encoded documents miss inter-document attention, causing a representation mismatch and quality loss.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to inference efficiency and long-context RAG serving rather than pretraining itself. Its main lesson is that static retrieval corpora create an opportunity to move part of prefill computation offline, but the online stage must repair the missing cross-document dependencies. DAF is useful because it formulates this repair as standard dense attention operations that can run efficiently on existing Flash-Attention kernels.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decoupled Attention Fusion splits prefill into three components. First, it selects important document tokens and performs self-attention only among this subset, creating a compact interaction path across document boundaries. Unlike CacheBlend-style selection based on a single layer, DAF aggregates signals from multiple early layers, typically layers 2–4, to reduce layer-specific noise. Second, question tokens perform question-document self-attention over the full context, using a hybrid KV cache where important-token states have already been updated. Third, a state fusion step combines the outputs into final hidden states. The complexity changes from roughly O(r L_d^2 + L_d L_q) in CacheBlend to O(r^2 L_d^2 + L_q(L_d + L_q)), where r is the important-token ratio, L_d is total document length, and L_q is question length. The practical design choice is to keep the operations dense and Flash-Attention-compatible, avoiding custom masks and GPU branch divergence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5-7B on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU with greedy decoding. Baselines include full recomputation with vLLM and CacheBlend, with the important-token fraction fixed at r = 0.3. The evaluation spans shorter RAG tasks such as 2WikiMultiHopQA and SAMSum at around 6k–9k tokens, plus long-context tasks from RULER and LongBench-V2 up to about 136k tokens. Metrics include TTFT and task accuracy measures such as Exact Match and Rouge-L, reported under a unified Accuracy column. Around 9k tokens, DAF and CacheBlend are similar. Around 130k tokens, DAF reaches up to 2x speedup over CacheBlend and 5.6x over full recomputation with vLLM, while maintaining comparable or better accuracy. The main limitations are task-dependent tuning of r and the storage and management cost of large offline KV caches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the method section: important-token self-attention, question-document self-attention, and state fusion. The complexity analysis is the key technical part, especially the reduction from r L_d^2 to r^2 L_d^2 and the assumption that L_q is much smaller than L_d. The hardware compatibility discussion is also worth reading because Flash-Attention support is what makes the wall-clock speedup plausible. In the results, inspect how the gap between DAF and CacheBlend grows with context length. For production RAG systems, read the limitations carefully, since KV cache storage can become the dominant bottleneck even if online attention is accelerated.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和长上下文 ablation；如果数字扎实，DAF 是 RAG cache 预计算里比粗暴拼 KV 更干净的折中。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and long-context ablations; if the numbers hold, DAF is a cleaner compromise than blindly concatenating precomputed KV caches.

paper.title: HiKV: Hierarchical Importance-Aware KV Cache with Hardware Acceleration for LLM Decoding
paper.abstract: With the rapid adoption of long-context large language models (LLMs), the continuously growing KV cache during decoding has become the critical memory bottleneck. To tackle this challenge, we propose HiKV, a novel algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits KV cache redundancy through hierarchical importance awareness. Algorithmically, HiKV compresses the KV cache at two granularities: Stage I evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed budget, and Stage II further loads only the significant element

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段KV缓存随序列长度和batch规模线性增长，成为核心内存瓶颈；现有基于重要性的KV压缩仅在token粒度做驱逐，保留token的完整KV向量仍存在元素级冗余，且动态排序的计算开销大，缺乏算法与硬件的协同优化。
summary.importance: 算法-硬件协同设计的思路可延伸到长序列预训练的注意力内存优化场景；两级粒度的冗余消除模式为理解注意力稀疏性结构提供了实证依据，可为预训练中的稀疏注意力设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分层重要性感知的KV缓存压缩与硬件加速协同方案。算法分为两阶段：第一阶段在固定缓存预算内，基于累积注意力得分动态驱逐不重要的token；第二阶段对保留的token，仅加载对注意力计算影响显著的向量元素，实现单粒度方法无法达到的压缩比。硬件上设计专用加速器，核心是可重构重要性排序器，可在第一阶段的堆式重要性维护和第二阶段的并行分块排序两种数据通路间切换，统一两阶段加速需求，仅增加8%的系统级面积开销。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文基准测试中，相比token级最优方法，在精度损失不超过1%的约束下压缩比更优；相比原始基线，解码阶段注意力计算最高获得7.95倍加速，能耗降低90%，在等精度约束下性能优于现有KV缓存优化方案。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第III节的两级压缩算法设计思路和第V节的系统级性能对比，可跳过硬件电路实现细节；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with sequence length and batch size during long-context LLM decoding, becoming the dominant memory bottleneck. Existing importance-based KV compression only operates at token granularity, leaving element-level redundancy in full KV vectors of retained tokens, and the high overhead of dynamic sorting lacks algorithm-hardware co-optimization.
summary_en.importance: The algorithm-hardware co-design principle can be extended to attention memory optimization in long-sequence pretraining. The two-level redundancy elimination pattern provides empirical evidence for understanding attention sparsity structure, which can inform sparse attention design in pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiKV is a hierarchical importance-aware KV cache compression framework with dedicated hardware acceleration. Algorithmically, it runs two complementary stages: Stage I dynamically evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed cache budget based on accumulated attention scores; Stage II selectively loads only significant vector elements from retained tokens, achieving compression ratios unattainable by single-granularity methods. Architecturally, a custom accelerator with a reconfigurable importance sorter switches between heap-based importance maintenance (Stage I) and parallel chunk-based sorting (Stage II), unifying two-stage acceleration with only 8% system-level area overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On long-context benchmarks, HiKV achieves better compression ratios than leading token-level methods under 1% accuracy loss. Compared to the vanilla baseline, it delivers up to 7.95× speedup and 90% energy reduction in attention computation during decoding, outperforming existing KV cache optimizations under iso-accuracy constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on Section III for the two-stage compression algorithm design and Section V for system-level performance comparison; skip hardware circuit implementation details. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文 serving 的可以看；对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“token 级+元素级”双层压缩这个归纳值得记，先看方法图和质量退化表再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you care about long-context serving; limited pretrain impact, but the token-level plus element-level compression decomposition is a useful design pattern—check the method figure and quality-retention tables first.

paper.title: Persistent Computational State: A Session-Centric Runtime for Generative World Models
paper.abstract: Generative world models are increasingly driven as simulators: a planner forks a state, rolls out futures, backtracks, and returns to a visited viewpoint. Recent benchmarks establish that current video world models fail this usage, and attribute it to the model, prescribing new architectures and training objectives. We show this attribution is incomplete, and for an important class of models simply wrong. Snapshotting the state the runtime already holds -- an observation plus RNG state, a memory

summary.core_problem: 生成式世界模型做规划时的状态分叉、回滚、续接能力差，此前普遍归因于模型架构或训练目标缺陷，本文指出该归因不成立。
summary.importance: 纠正了领域内对世界模型规划能力缺陷的错误归因，指出问题出在从LM serving继承的请求中心化运行时设计而非模型本身，为生成式模拟器runtime设计提供了新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 识别出生成模型运行时中三类不可重算的状态内核（观测值+RNG状态、记忆库、窗口化KV上下文），通过对这些状态做快照与恢复即可实现字节级一致的续接，仅破坏RNG状态就会导致续接质量下降。
summary.experiments: 在三类不同架构的生成世界模型上完成机制验证：快照恢复状态可复现字节级一致的续接结果，仅损坏RNG状态会显著降低续接质量，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据集。

summary_en.core_problem: Generative world models perform poorly on state forking, backtracking and resumption during planning, which was previously attributed to model architecture or training objective flaws; this paper disproves this attribution.
summary_en.importance: Corrects the widespread misattribution of world model planning failures, locating the root cause in the request-centric serving design inherited from LLM serving rather than model capability, opening new directions for generative simulator runtime design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies three classes of non-recomputable state kernels in generative model runtimes (observation + RNG state, memory bank, windowed KV context); snapshotting and restoring these states enables byte-identical continuation, while corrupting only RNG state degrades performance.
summary_en.experiments: Mechanism validation across three generative world model architectures: snapshot-restore reproduces byte-identical never-left continuation, while isolated RNG corruption significantly degrades continuation quality; no specific model sizes or datasets are disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 指出把runtime问题错归为模型缺陷的普遍偏差，结论值得知道，全文聚焦世界模型无需细读。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing the core misattribution insight; no need to read the full paper as it focuses narrowly on world model runtimes.

paper.title: Closing the Loop: Training-Free Revisit Consistency for Autoregressive Generative Rendering
paper.abstract: Recent conditional video generation models have shown promising potentials to transform 3D engine renderings, such as depth maps and untextured geometry, into photorealistic videos for gaming and immersive content creation. These applications require long-horizon auto-regressive generation that continuously synthesizes new frames while preserving a persistent 3D world. Auto-regressive generators synthesize video chunk by chunk with a bounded KV cache, so when the camera revisits a location after

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频生成在长时渲染中因 KV cache 有限而遗忘旧场景，导致相机重访同一位置时外观不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是训练-free 的长时视频生成一致性方法，利用 3D 引擎已有的几何对应关系做 loop-closure memory。它主要属于视频生成，但对自回归生成器的外部记忆和 cache 管理有可迁移启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不做后训练，而是在推理时把历史 latent chunk 按相机位姿匹配检索回 KV cache，形成 temporal correspondence 的闭环记忆；同时利用相机位姿和深度重投影得到 spatial correspondence，约束重访区域的外观一致性。
