summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、视频长度、baseline 或定量提升。实验场景是从 3D engine renderings，如深度图或无纹理几何，条件生成照片级视频，并考察长时自回归生成中的重访一致性。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 The Pennsylvania State University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles revisit inconsistency in long-horizon autoregressive video rendering, where a bounded KV cache causes the model to forget previously generated locations and regenerate different appearances.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free consistency method for long video generation that uses geometric correspondences already available from a 3D engine as loop-closure memory. It is mainly a video generation paper, but its external-memory treatment for autoregressive generators is transferable.
summary_en.technical_approach: Without post-training, the method retrieves pose-matched historical latent chunks back into the KV cache as temporal loop-closure memory. It also uses camera pose and depth reprojection to establish spatial correspondences that help preserve appearance when revisiting a scene.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, video length, baselines, or exact gains. The target setting is conditional generation from 3D engine renderings, such as depth maps or untextured geometry, into photorealistic videos, with evaluation focused on long-horizon revisit consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is The Pennsylvania State University.

recommendation.zh: 看推理时 cache 回填机制即可；它是视频生成论文，但给长上下文 AR 记忆设计提供了一个干净类比。
recommendation.en: Read the inference-time cache reinsertion mechanism; it is a video paper, but it gives a clean analogy for long-context AR memory design.

paper.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a cheap draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP/NEXTN) draft head under the assumption that the draft is negligibly cheap. At million-token context this breaks: an MTP draft head typically runs full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step, so its read grows linearly with context and comes to dominate the draft cost -- precis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长上下文 speculative decoding 里一个被低估的瓶颈：内置 MTP/NEXTN draft head 在百万 token 上下文下并不“便宜”。虽然 target verify 端越来越多采用 hybrid 或 linear attention 来压低长上下文成本，但很多原生 draft head 仍然对全量 KV cache 做 full attention。结果是 draft 每走一步都要线性读取整段上下文，context 越长、draft 越深，这部分 draft-KV read tax 越重，甚至会把 speculative decoding 的净收益吃掉，在低 acceptance 的难任务上比不做 speculation 还慢。论文的核心问题不是如何提高 acceptance，而是如何去掉这个 full-context draft tax，同时保持 exact speculation 的正确性。
summary.importance: 对 serving 和模型共设计来说，这篇工作很重要，因为它指出了一个现实偏差：很多 speculative decoding 的成本模型默认 draft 近似免费，这在短上下文成立，但在 1M context 已经失真。更关键的是，随着 target 侧转向 hybrid/linear attention，这个失真会更严重，因为 verify 变便宜后，draft 的全上下文 attention 反而暴露成主成本。论文给出的方案很简单，但意义不小：只改 draft 的注意力工作集，不改 verify，因此不碰 exactness；不需要训练、蒸馏或额外参数，属于可以直接落地的系统改造。对预训练研究员的启发在于，内置 draft head 的设计不能只看短上下文吞吐，也要看与 target attention 形态是否匹配；否则 native MTP 在长上下文下会出现架构失配。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Windowed-MTP。核心思想是把 StreamingLLM 风格的 sliding window + attention sink 只应用在 draft head 上，而 target verify 仍然保留全上下文注意力。这样 draft 每一步只读取 W + sink 个 token 的 KV，而不是整段 S 长度上下文；例如 1M context 下 4K window 只占 0.4%。

为什么这能做到“lossless by construction”？因为 speculative decoding 的接受与否始终由 full-attention target 决定。windowing 只会改变 draft 提出的候选 token，不会改变 target 的验证规则，因此不会改变最终采样分布。论文还专门做了 greedy output diff，验证 windowed draft 与 native full-attention draft 的最终输出没有系统性分歧，超出范围的差异只来自 verifier 既有的 bf16 非确定性。

作者还给了一个逐步 latency model，把一次 speculative iteration 分成 γ 次 draft forward 和一次 verify forward，并分析在不同 acceptance length、draft depth d=γ+1、context length S 下，什么时候 native deep draft 会从加速退化到与 dense baseline 持平，甚至变成负收益。这个模型的意义在于，它不是只报告“快了多少”，而是解释为什么在长上下文、低 acceptance、verify 变便宜时，draft attention 会成为主导项。

机制分析部分也做得比较扎实。作者没有停留在“窗口够小也没掉速”这种经验结论，而是看了 window-size dose-response、每个 draft position 的 conditional acceptance 分解，以及 in-run decision-invariance probe。结论是：windowing 大多数时候并不改变 draft 的 top-1 proposal，保留了与 full-attention draft 相近的 acceptance profile，因此速度收益来自每步成本下降，而不是靠牺牲 acceptance 换吞吐。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三类架构：至少包括 dense Qwen-122B、hybrid Nemotron，以及另一类不同 attention 家族模型。重点都放在 1M context、batch size 1 的长上下文 decode。

首先，论文量化了 long-context draft-attention tax。在 γ=6、也就是 d=7 的设定下，仅 draft phase 相对 bare verify 就额外增加了 +92% 到 +138% 的每步成本，几乎把一次 decode step 的代价翻倍。这说明“draft 很便宜”的假设在百万上下文下已经不成立。更关键的是，在 hard、low-acceptance workload 上，原生 native draft 会出现净负收益：例如 Qwen-122B code QA 上 d=7 只有 0.80× no-speculation dense baseline，Nemotron hybrid 上是 0.97×；把 draft 加深到 d=9 也救不回来。

Windowed-MTP 的收益比较稳定。在 1M context 下，相对 native MTP，每个 speculative iteration 的 per-step cost 降低约 28%–44%，而且这个收益基本 input-invariant，大小与“draft 成本里有多少是可窗口化 attention”一致。作者还测了 draft KV pool 占总 KV 的比例，在三种模型上约为 7.7%–11%；windowing 之后，除了 W+sink 之外的 draft KV 都变成 dead state，可以回收到一个紧凑 ring buffer，且没有质量或速度副作用。

接受率方面，windowing 对 draft top-1 proposal 的保持率达到 86%–94%，整体 acceptance 曲线与 full-attention draft 在置信区间内接近。残余差异存在，但量级小、符号依赖输入和 draft depth，而且始终被每步成本下降带来的收益覆盖，所以端到端结果没有回退。论文还强调，这种改造在 exactness 上没有妥协，因为 target verify 完全不变。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合精读。先看 Introduction 和 Section 3，抓住作者提出的成本分解：speculative decoding 在长上下文下的问题不只是 acceptance 不够高，而是 draft 自身的 full-context attention 已经成为主要瓶颈。这里的 latency model 值得仔细看，它能帮助判断 native MTP 什么时候会从加速器变成负担。

然后重点读方法部分，尤其是“为什么只窗口化 draft 仍然保持 exactness”。很多人会把这类近似和 lossless 混在一起，这篇文章把边界讲得很清楚：近似发生在 proposal，正确性由 verifier 兜底。接着看 acceptance 机制分析，特别是 window-size sweep、per-position conditional acceptance 和 decision-invariance probe，这几部分解释了为什么 4K 级别窗口已经足够支撑 draft 的局部猜测。

实验上建议重点看 Table 13 一类展示 native draft 变成 net-negative 的结果，以及 1M context 下 28%–44% per-step 降幅的主表。若只想抓主线，读完引言、成本模型、主实验和 exactness 验证，大约 45–60 分钟。若要深挖，值得思考两个延伸问题：一是预训练阶段是否应该显式约束 draft head 的局部性，让它天然适配 windowed inference；二是当 target 进一步转向 linear/hybrid attention 时，draft 与 target 的 attention family 是否也应该共同设计，而不是把 full-attention MTP 直接挂在一个更便宜的 verifier 上。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 相关工作。正文里给出了 SGLang patch 和复现实验仓库，作者名单在提供内容中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific but increasingly important bottleneck in long-context speculative decoding: built-in MTP/NEXTN draft heads are not cheap at million-token context. While target models are moving toward hybrid or linear attention to reduce long-context verification cost, many native draft heads still run full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step. That makes draft cost scale linearly with context, and the deeper the draft chain, the worse the tax. On hard workloads with low acceptance, the native draft can erase the speedup of speculation and even become slower than plain decoding. The paper asks how to remove this full-context draft-KV tax without sacrificing the exactness guarantee of speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong systems paper with direct implications for model-serving co-design. It exposes a mismatch in the standard speculative-decoding cost model: treating the draft as negligible is fine at short context, but wrong at 1M tokens. The mismatch becomes sharper as the verifier gets cheaper through hybrid or linear attention. The proposed fix is simple and deployable: restrict only the draft’s attention working set, keep verification unchanged, and preserve exact decoding by construction. For pretraining-oriented readers, the broader lesson is that native draft-head design should be evaluated jointly with the target’s attention family and long-context operating regime; otherwise an apparently lightweight MTP head can become architecturally misaligned at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Windowed-MTP, applies a StreamingLLM-style sliding window plus attention sink to the draft head only, while leaving the target verifier at full attention. As a result, each draft forward reads only W + sink tokens from KV instead of the full context length S. At 1M context, a 4K window is only 0.4% of the sequence.

The key point is why this remains lossless. In speculative decoding, the target verifier always decides which proposed tokens are accepted. Windowing changes only the draft proposals, not the acceptance rule. Therefore the final output distribution remains identical to standard exact speculation. The paper validates this with greedy output diffs, showing no systematic divergence beyond the verifier’s existing bf16 nondeterminism.

The authors also provide a per-step latency model. One speculative iteration is decomposed into γ draft forwards plus one verify forward, and the model explains when a deeper native draft stops helping: long context increases draft KV reads, low acceptance reduces amortization, and cheaper verify phases expose the draft cost instead of hiding it. This is useful because the paper does not merely report speedups; it explains the regime in which native MTP collapses from accelerator to liability.

The mechanistic analysis is also stronger than usual. The paper studies window-size dose response, conditional acceptance by draft position, and an in-run decision-invariance probe. The conclusion is that windowing usually preserves the draft’s top-1 proposal and closely tracks the full-attention acceptance profile. The gain therefore comes from reducing per-step draft cost, not from trading away acceptance for throughput.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span three architecture families, including at least a dense Qwen-122B model, a hybrid Nemotron model, and a third model with a different attention design. The main operating point is 1M context with batch size 1.

First, the paper quantifies the long-context draft-attention tax. At γ=6, i.e. d=7, the draft phase alone adds about +92% to +138% on top of the bare verify cost per decode step, nearly doubling step latency. This directly falsifies the assumption that the draft is negligible at million-token context. More importantly, on hard low-acceptance workloads the shipped native draft can become net-negative: at d=7 it reaches only 0.80× the no-speculation dense baseline on Qwen-122B code QA and 0.97× on the hybrid Nemotron. Increasing draft depth to d=9 does not rescue the situation.

Windowed-MTP then delivers a fairly consistent reduction. At 1M context, it cuts per-speculative-iteration cost by about 28%–44% relative to native MTP, and the gain is largely input-invariant. Its magnitude tracks the fraction of draft cost attributable to windowable attention. The paper also measures that the draft KV pool is about 7.7%–11% of total KV across the three models; after windowing, all but W + sink of that draft KV becomes dead state and can be reclaimed into a compact ring buffer with no quality or speed penalty.

On acceptance behavior, windowing preserves the draft top-1 proposal 86%–94% of the time, and the resulting acceptance profile tracks full-attention draft within confidence intervals across the sweep. Residual differences exist, but they are small, depend on input and draft depth, and are always outweighed by the per-step latency reduction. End-to-end performance therefore never regresses in the reported settings, while exactness is preserved because the verifier is unchanged.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction and the latency decomposition section. The central insight is not simply that acceptance matters, but that full-context draft attention becomes the dominant cost at long context, especially when the verifier has already been optimized with hybrid or linear attention. The latency model is useful because it tells you when native MTP stops being a speedup mechanism.

Then read the method section with attention to the exactness argument. The paper is careful about the distinction between approximating the proposal path and preserving the final decoding distribution through full verification. That boundary is important. After that, spend time on the acceptance analysis: the window-size sweep, per-position conditional acceptance, and decision-invariance probe explain why a relatively small local window is enough for the draft to remain a good proposer.

For experiments, prioritize the tables showing native draft becoming net-negative and the main 1M-context latency reductions. A focused read of the introduction, cost model, main experiments, and exactness validation should take about 45–60 minutes. For deeper follow-up, two questions are especially interesting: whether pretraining should explicitly encourage locality in native draft heads so they are naturally compatible with windowed inference, and whether draft and verifier attention families should be co-designed rather than attaching a full-attention MTP head to an increasingly cheap hybrid/linear verifier.
summary_en.authors_note: Appears to be an NVIDIA-affiliated work. The provided text includes an SGLang patch and reproduction package, but the full author list is not visible in the supplied content.

recommendation.zh: 指出 MTP 在长上下文下的隐性税，是部署前沿模型必踩的坑；training-free 无损修复应立刻在内部长上下文 serving 栈里复现。
recommendation.en: Exposes a hidden tax of MTP at long context that every frontier serving stack will hit; the training-free lossless fix should be reproduced in your long-context serving stack immediately.

paper.title: Error Certificates for KV-Cache Eviction via Randomized Design
paper.abstract: Deterministic KV-cache eviction keeps the top-$k$ tokens under an importance score and deletes the rest. We prove that this design cannot know what it destroyed: evicted values can be altered so that everything the serving system retains is unchanged while the true attention-output error grows arbitrarily, so no serving-time estimator of that error is consistent. Randomized eviction restores identifiability. With a Poisson-sampled tail at known inclusion probabilities, one logit offset performs

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“怎样做更好的 KV eviction 分数”，而是一个更基础的问题：在线服务系统在做了 KV-cache eviction 之后，能不能只根据保留下来的状态，可靠估计这一步 eviction 到底带来了多大误差。论文给出的结论很硬：对确定性 eviction，答案是否定的。只要保留集合是由分数确定出来的，系统就永远看不到被删掉 value 的真实内容，因此存在一类不可辨识情形——保留部分完全一样，但真实 attention 输出误差可以任意大。作者把这类现象称为 silent failure。于是问题从“设计更好的监控信号”转成了“如何让误差变得可识别”。
summary.importance: 对长上下文 serving 来说，这篇工作的价值不在于提出了一个更强的 eviction 策略，而在于把一个常被忽略的统计识别问题讲清楚了：如果 eviction 机制本身不暴露可估计性，后面再叠加任何在线置信度、熵、margin 一类自诊断信号，都不可能稳定判断 eviction 伤害。这对推理系统研究有直接影响，也对训练侧有启发：很多压缩、稀疏化、token dropping 方法默认可以靠 retained-state signal 做在线控制，但如果设计是确定性的，控制信号可能在信息论层面就不成立。论文的贡献量级更像“把问题边界画清楚，并给出一个可操作的修复路径”，不是通用精度提升，但对系统设计原则有分量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是不可识别性定理。作者在单头单步 attention 设定下形式化 online information，证明任何仅依赖 retained KV、query history、打分和由此计算出的统计量的误差估计器，都不可能一致估计 eviction induced attention-output error。证明思路很直接：构造两个世界，它们在保留状态上逐位相同，但被删 value 不同，从而真实输出误差可以被放大到任意大。

第二部分是用随机化恢复可识别性。具体做法不是把全部 token 随机采样，而是 certainty-plus-Poisson 设计：高分 token 确定保留，tail 部分按已知 inclusion probability π_i 做 Poisson sampling。这样 sampling design 已知，就可以引入 survey sampling 的 design-based inference。作者把 Hájek 校正写进 softmax：对被保留的 tail token，在 logit 上加 log(1/π_i)，等价于做逆概率重加权后的归一化。这样可以消除 selection bias。然后对线性化误差构造 Sen–Yates–Grundy 型方差估计器，而且这个估计器只需要 retained set 就能算。最后再用 empirical-Bernstein 半径把方差估计转成每一步的 error certificate，并给出 e-process 扩展，尝试把逐步有效性推进到整个 autoregressive 轨迹上的 time-uniform validity。

有两个实现层面的点值得注意。第一，它是 training-free 的，不改模型参数，也不需要额外矩阵运算，额外开销主要是 tail 上的标量计算。第二，它的目标不是直接预测任务是否失败，而是估计“这次失败有多少是 eviction 造成的”，也就是 attribution 而不是 prediction。这个定位决定了它和 output confidence 的关系不是替代，而是分工不同。
summary.experiments:
实验分 attention-level、synthetic task-level 和 real workload 三层，而且作者做了 preregistration，提前写了 7 条可证伪 claim，这一点让结果更可信。

在 attention level，上述 certificate 的经验覆盖率达到 0.97，达到目标覆盖；certificate 与真实误差的相关性超过 0.94；同时没有带来精度损失。作者还专门测了 deterministic eviction 的自诊断信号失效：在真实任务上，类似 H2O、SnapKV 风格 eviction 的 retained-attention entropy 对 eviction-induced failure 的 AUC 约为 0.50，基本等于随机；一些其它在线信号如 margin 也接近 chance，evicted score mass 最多到 0.73，而随机化 certificate 可到 0.77–0.86。

在 synthetic long-context suites 上，certificate 能从 attention 误差转移到 task failure：16/16 个 model-task cell 都是正向 AUC，平均 0.836。这说明在压缩伤害主导的环境里，证书确实能反映任务层面的失败风险。

但真实工作负载的结果更克制，也更有信息量。作者明确承认 7 条预注册 claim 里有 3 条失败。原因是 LongBench 这类 question-aware eviction 在 25%–50% budget、6k 和 16k context 下本来就几乎不伤质量，所以总体 failure 更多来自任务本身难度，而不是 cache 压缩。于是 mean output log-probability 这种免费 baseline 在“预测答案会不会错”上反而优于 certificate；certificate-gated 从 25% 升到 50% budget 的 escalation 也没有收益。真正成立的是 attribution：在失败样本中，certificate 区分 eviction-induced failure 和 inherent failure 的 AUC 分别约 0.75 和 0.73，而 output confidence 在这个任务上接近或低于随机。进一步地，certificate-gated recomputation 在同等算力下优于 random gating 和 confidence gating；后者甚至可能低于随机，因为它把重算预算浪费在模型本来就答不出的样本上。整套证据链大约花了 70 GPU-hours，单 shard 在 H100/H200 上可跑。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 和 Section 3 的定理，理解作者为什么说 deterministic eviction 的在线误差估计在结构上不可能。这里不是某个 estimator 不够好，而是信息缺失导致不可识别。第二，看 Hájek correction 是怎样被写成一个简单 logit offset 的，这个实现很巧，说明 survey sampling 不是停留在统计术语层面，而是能直接嵌进 attention 计算。第三，看 Figure 2、Figure 4 和 real-workload 部分，重点体会作者如何区分 prediction 与 attribution：前者 output confidence 更强，后者 certificate 才有独特作用。

如果时间有限，建议读 Introduction、Section 3、Section 4 的 attention-level 结果，以及 Section 6.4 关于 recomputation scheduling 的实验，30–45 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，值得继续看 e-process 扩展和方差估计器推导，思考这种“通过随机化恢复在线可诊断性”的思路能否迁移到 token pruning、MoE routing 监控、训练时 sample dropping 等别的压缩环节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than “which KV eviction score is better”: after KV-cache eviction, can the serving system estimate, from the retained state alone, how much error the eviction caused on the current query? The answer is no for deterministic eviction. If the retained set is a deterministic function of scores, the evicted values remain fundamentally unobserved, so two worlds can look identical to the server while inducing arbitrarily different attention-output errors. The paper calls this silent failure. The real problem therefore becomes identifiability, not better heuristics for monitoring.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is conceptual and methodological rather than a new accuracy win. It shows that a large class of online self-diagnostics for deterministic cache compression are invalid in principle, not merely weak in practice. That matters for long-context serving, but also more broadly for compression and sparsification schemes that hope to control quality using retained-state signals. If the design destroys identifiability, no downstream monitor can recover it. The paper then gives a practical repair: inject randomization in a controlled way so that eviction error becomes estimable. That is a meaningful systems-statistics interface result.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two layers. First, an impossibility result. In a single-head, single-step attention setup, the authors formalize the online sigma-field available to the serving system: retained KV pairs, query history, scores, and any statistics computed from them. They prove that no estimator measurable with respect to this information can consistently estimate the true eviction-induced attention-output error under deterministic top-k-style selection. The proof is constructive: keep the retained state fixed, alter the evicted values, and the true error can change arbitrarily while every observable quantity remains unchanged.

Second, they restore identifiability via randomized design. The proposed mechanism is certainty-plus-Poisson eviction: high-score items are kept deterministically, while the tail is sampled with known inclusion probabilities π_i. Once the sampling design is known, design-based survey inference becomes available. The key implementation trick is elegant: Hájek correction is realized inside attention by adding log(1/π_i) to the logits of retained tail tokens, which performs inverse-probability reweighting through the softmax normalization. They then derive a retained-set variance estimator of Sen–Yates–Grundy type for the linearized error, and wrap it with an empirical-Bernstein radius to obtain a per-step error certificate. An e-process extension is also discussed to move toward time-uniform validity over the autoregressive trajectory.

Two aspects stand out. It is training-free and lightweight: no new parameters, no retraining, and only scalar work over the sampled tail. And its target is attribution rather than generic failure prediction: it aims to tell whether cache compression caused the damage, not whether the answer will be wrong for any reason.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study is unusually disciplined: the authors pre-register seven falsifiable claims and report the failures openly.

At the attention level, the certificate achieves about 0.97 empirical coverage, certificate-error correlation exceeds 0.94, and there is no accuracy penalty relative to deterministic top-k baselines. They also directly measure the silent-failure phenomenon: retained-attention entropy for H2O- and SnapKV-style deterministic eviction gives AUC around 0.50 for predicting eviction-induced failures, essentially chance. Other online self-signals such as margin behave similarly; evicted score mass reaches at most 0.73, while the randomized certificate reaches roughly 0.77–0.86 on the same attribution-oriented yardstick.

On synthetic long-context tasks, the signal transfers to task level: all 16 model-task cells show positive certificate-failure AUC, with mean 0.836. This is the regime where compression damage is a dominant source of failure, so the certificate remains informative.

The real-workload results are more nuanced and more useful. Three of the seven pre-registered claims fail. On LongBench-style question-aware eviction at 25%–50% budgets and 6k/16k contexts, eviction is nearly free, so overall task failure is dominated by intrinsic task difficulty rather than cache damage. In that regime, mean output log-probability, a free baseline, beats the certificate at predicting whether the final answer is wrong. Certificate-gated escalation from 25% to 50% budget also does not help. What survives is attribution: among failed examples, the certificate separates eviction-induced from inherent failures with AUC about 0.75 and 0.73 at the two scales, whereas output confidence is at or below chance because it conflates task difficulty with cache damage. In recomputation scheduling, certificate-gated reruns outperform random and confidence-based gating at matched compute; confidence gating can even underperform random because it spends budget on examples the model would fail anyway. The full evidence chain reportedly costs about 70 GPU-hours on H100/H200-class hardware.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three things. First, read the introduction and the theorem section to understand why deterministic eviction error is not merely hard to estimate but unidentifiable. That is the central idea. Second, inspect how the Hájek correction becomes a simple logit offset; this is the bridge from survey sampling theory to an implementable attention-layer mechanism. Third, read the figures and real-workload sections that separate prediction from attribution. The paper is strongest when it shows that output confidence is better for generic failure prediction, while the certificate is uniquely useful for diagnosing compression-induced damage.

If time is limited, the introduction, Section 3, the attention-level experiments, and the recomputation scheduling results are enough to capture the main contribution in 30–45 minutes. If reading more deeply, the variance-estimator derivation and the e-process extension are worth attention, especially if you care about extending the same randomized-diagnostic principle to token pruning, MoE routing diagnostics, or other online compression mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 不可识别性证明是真贡献，但预注册里三条主张被打脸，落地价值打折；只看 §3 的证明和 Hájek 修正构造即可。
recommendation.en: The non-identifiability proof is the real contribution; three pre-registered claims failed, so take the serving gains with salt—read §3 and the Hájek construction, skip the rest.

paper.title: Codec-Gauge: Learning Compression-Friendly Gauges for Transformer KV Caches
paper.abstract: Long-context Transformer inference increasingly relies on KV-cache compression or quantization. Prior rotation and transform-coding results suggest that the channel basis of each key/value vector affects how faithfully a fixed backend preserves model behavior. We introduce Codec-Gauge, a post-training cache-coordinate layer that learns small orthogonal channel transforms around existing compression and quantization backends. Its frequency-distribution objective combines a token-channel DCT spect

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存的压缩/量化保真度受KV通道基的几何结构约束，现有方案要么修改模型权重、注意力逻辑，要么改动压缩后端实现，始终未将KV表示的坐标基作为独立优化变量挖掘。
summary.importance: 该工作将KV缓存的坐标几何明确为后训练阶段可独立调优的维度，不需要改动预训练权重、注意力语义或现有压缩/量化后端的代码实现，即可在相同比特预算下提升压缩保真度，对长上下文推理部署有直接工程参考价值，也为KV压缩方向提供了新的设计轴。
summary.technical_approach: 在冻结模型和固定压缩后端之间插入可学习的正交通道变换层（gauge），变换仅在每个KV头的通道组内做基混合，不跨token、头、层操作，无误差路径下完全可逆。训练该变换不需要重建损失、语言建模损失或下游任务监督，仅使用两个面向压缩后端的频率分布目标：一是DCT谱质心损失将KV能量集中到低频系数，二是平滑率代理损失减少显著变换系数的数量，适配zfp这类块变换压缩的特性。推理时KV张量先经过gauge变换再压缩，解压后逆变换回原基再送入注意力计算。
summary.experiments: 在6个不同规模的语言模型上，3/4/6比特设置下，对比恒等变换、随机正交变换、Hadamard/DCT固定变换、PCA/KLT数据驱动变换，学习到的gauge让zfp压缩的KL散度降低44.0%，logit MSE降低43.3%，top1 logit翻转率降低24.5%，KV归一化均方根误差降低18.3%。相同变换对块均匀量化、KIVI风格量化也有一致提升，27B参数模型验证、长上下文序列化存储测试均复现了效果，变换本身的计算开销已计入时延测量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言中对坐标几何作为独立优化变量的动机阐述、方法部分的损失设计，以及实验中区分通用正交旋转收益和面向压缩的定向学习收益的对照设置，预计阅读时间20分钟。不需要深入推导细节，核心收获是「表示几何适配后端特性」的设计思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The fidelity of KV cache compression/quantization for long-context LLM inference is constrained by the channel basis geometry of key/value vectors, while existing approaches require modifications to model weights, attention semantics, or compression backend implementations, leaving coordinate basis as an unexploited independent optimization variable.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes KV cache coordinate geometry as a tunable post-training dimension that requires no changes to pretrained weights, attention logic, or existing compression/quantization backends, delivering higher compression fidelity under identical bit budgets. It provides practical engineering references for long-context inference deployment, and opens a new design axis for future KV compression research.
summary_en.technical_approach: A learnable orthogonal channel transform (gauge) is inserted between the frozen model and fixed compression backend. The transform only mixes channels within each KV head group, with no cross-token, cross-head, or cross-layer operations, and is exactly invertible under error-free paths. The gauge is trained without reconstruction loss, language modeling loss, or downstream task supervision, using two codec-facing frequency distribution objectives: a DCT spectral centroid loss that concentrates KV energy into low-frequency coefficients, and a smooth rate proxy that reduces the count of significant transform coefficients, aligned with the block-transform structure of codecs like zfp. At inference, KV tensors are mapped to the learned gauge before compression, and mapped back to the original basis after decompression prior to attention computation.
summary_en.experiments: Across 6 language models at 3, 4, and 6 bits per value, learned gauges outperform identity, random orthogonal, fixed Hadamard/DCT, and data-derived PCA/KLT baselines, reducing zfp KL divergence by 44.0%, logit MSE by 43.3%, top-1 logit flip rate by 24.5%, and KV NRMSE by 18.3%. The same learned coordinates also improve block-uniform quantization and KIVI-style quantization relative to raw-coordinate baselines. The effect is reproduced on a 27B parameter model, and serial context-length measurements confirm realized storage savings with transform overhead included in latency calculations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this work. Focus on the motivation for coordinate geometry as an independent optimization variable in the introduction, the loss design in the method section, and the controlled ablation setup that separates generic orthogonal rotation benefits from codec-oriented targeted learning. Expected reading time: 20 minutes. No need to dive into detailed derivations; the core takeaway is the design principle of aligning representation geometry to backend characteristics.

recommendation.zh: KV压缩方向的扎实增量改进，只看§3方法和Table1的对比结果即可，无需细读全文。
recommendation.en: Solid incremental improvement on KV cache compression; only check §3 method and Table 1 comparison results, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Beyond Independent Optimization: Compression, MoE Routing, and Quantization Interactions in Multimodal Edge Intelligence
paper.abstract: Efficient multimodal inference is increasingly constrained not only by model quality or FLOP count, but also by the cost of preserving, moving, routing, caching, and quantizing multimodal representations under latency, memory, and energy constraints. This paper reviews recent advances in efficient vision-language and multimodal large language models, covering visual token compression, video token management, KV-cache optimization, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing, low-bit quantization, edge depl

summary.core_problem: 多模态边缘推理优化中，视觉token压缩、MoE路由、量化、KV-cache等技术常被独立优化，忽略了彼此间的级联耦合效应，导致整体性能与效率次优。
summary.importance: 综述性工作，系统梳理了多模态边缘部署中各类效率优化技术的交互关系，指出独立优化的常见误区。
summary.technical_approach: 通过文献综述逐一分析各类优化技术的耦合路径：视觉token压缩改变下游特征分布进而影响MoE路由决策，路由行为影响专家利用率和量化敏感性，量化后的路由logits改变专家分配结果，KV-cache策略决定多模态证据留存，硬件约束使计算节省转化为内存/通信瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 为综述性工作，无原创实验，仅对现有研究中的优化交互效应做了定性梳理。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal edge inference, techniques such as visual token compression, MoE routing, quantization, and KV-cache optimization are often optimized independently, ignoring cascaded coupling effects that lead to suboptimal end-to-end performance and efficiency.
summary_en.importance: A survey that systematically reviews interactions between efficiency optimization techniques for multimodal edge deployment, pointing out the common pitfall of treating optimizations as independent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes coupling paths between optimizations via literature review: visual token compression alters downstream feature distributions and MoE routing decisions; routing behavior affects expert utilization and quantization sensitivity; quantized router logits change expert assignment; KV-cache policies determine retained multimodal evidence; hardware constraints convert computational savings into memory/communication bottlenecks.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey work with no original experiments, providing only qualitative synthesis of optimization interaction effects from existing research.

recommendation.zh: 多模态边缘推理优化的耦合效应综述，无原创实验结论，做多模态部署时可参考其交互项清单，无需通读。
recommendation.en: A survey on coupling effects across multimodal edge inference optimizations with no original results; refer to its interaction checklist for deployment, no full read needed.

paper.title: DecodeShare: Tracing the Shared Subspace of LLM Decode-Time Decisions
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) handle many tasks with one set of parameters, but under KV-cached inference it is unclear what task-general structure, if any, is used at decode time rather than during prefill. We propose DecodeShare, a protocol that identifies a low-dimensional subspace consistently shared across tasks in decode-time hidden states, and then tests its causal role by removing that subspace only during decoding. In our experiments, disturbing the discovered shared subspace degrades de

summary.core_problem: KV缓存推理模式下，现有激活干预方法大多从prefill阶段的隐藏状态估计干预方向，既没有区分整段prompt预计算与解码阶段单步单token计算的表示差异，也没有定位跨任务共享、真正驱动next-token决策的解码时表示结构，这是导致激活steering方法在提示模板变化、场景切换时效果脆弱、可复现性差的核心原因之一。
summary.importance: 该工作明确量化了激活干预中长期存在的「估计位置-干预位置不匹配」问题，找到了对解码决策有因果作用的跨任务通用解码时低维共享子空间，为激活steering的脆性提供了机制层面的解释，也为后续做可靠的模型行为干预、推理时对齐、模型多任务共享计算的可解释性研究提供了可复现的实验范式。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化区分两类隐藏状态：prefill阶段最后一个prompt位置的隐藏状态、KV缓存解码阶段每一步单token计算产生的、直接输出next-token logits的解码决策状态。DecodeShare协议分两步运行：第一步跨多个不同任务收集解码阶段的隐藏状态，通过PCA提取跨任务一致存在的低维共享子空间；第二步做因果对照干预，仅在解码步骤中移除隐藏状态在该子空间上的投影，保持prefill阶段计算完全不变，设置同维度的prefill子空间移除、随机子空间移除作为严格对照。最后分析该共享子空间与现有常用激活steering方向的重叠度，对比解码阶段、prefill阶段的评估结果对真实KV缓存推理下steering效果的预测能力。
summary.experiments: 在多款开源LLM、多类任务基准上的实验显示：1）同等干预维度预算下，移除解码共享子空间造成的任务准确率下降幅度，是移除prefill估计的同维度子空间、移除随机子空间的数倍，证明该子空间对解码决策有高杠杆因果作用；2）现有常用激活steering方向普遍和该解码共享子空间存在显著重叠，直接投影移除重叠分量无法得到通用的steering鲁棒性提升，只会引入任务相关的效用-鲁棒性权衡；3）基于解码阶段隐藏状态做steering方向效果排序，对留出集KV缓存解码场景下实际效果的预测准确度，显著高于基于prefill状态的排序结果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法部分对prefill和解码状态的形式化定义、DecodeShare流程设计、因果干预的对照实验逻辑，以及steering重叠度分析的消融结果。值得深挖的方向包括：该共享子空间在不同模型层的分布差异、子空间维度随模型规模的scaling规律、子空间编码的是通用决策控制信号还是任务特定内容。

summary_en.core_problem: Under KV-cached LLM inference, existing activation intervention methods mostly estimate steering directions from prefill-stage hidden states. These methods fail to distinguish representational differences between bulk prompt prefill computation and per-step single-token decode computation, and never explicitly localize the cross-task shared representational structure that directly drives next-token decisions. This estimator-intervention mismatch is a major under-explored cause of the widely observed brittleness and poor reproducibility of activation steering methods across prompt templates and deployment settings.
summary_en.importance: This work explicitly quantifies the long-noted prefill-decode representational mismatch, identifies a low-dimensional cross-task shared subspace at decode time with causal leverage on next-token decisions, and provides a mechanistic explanation for activation steering brittleness. The DecodeShare protocol offers a reproducible empirical foundation for future work on reliable model behavior intervention, inference-time alignment, and mechanistic interpretability of multi-task computation in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first formalizes the distinction between two types of hidden states: prefill hidden states sampled at the final prompt position, and decode-time decision states: the per-token hidden states computed at each KV-cached decode step that directly produce next-token logits. The DecodeShare protocol runs in two stages. First, it collects decode-time hidden states across a diverse set of tasks, and extracts a consistent low-dimensional shared subspace via PCA. Second, it runs controlled causal ablation interventions that only remove projection onto this subspace during decode steps, leaving prefill computation completely unmodified, with matched baselines using prefill-derived subspaces and random subspaces of equal dimension. The work further measures overlap between this shared decode subspace and widely used activation steering directions, and compares the predictive power of decode-time versus prefill-time evaluation for ranking steering vector utility under realistic KV-cached inference.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple open-source LLMs and task benchmarks: 1) Under matched intervention dimension budgets, removing the decode-shared subspace causes several times larger accuracy degradation than removing prefill-derived or random subspaces of the same size, confirming the high causal leverage of this subspace for decode decisions. 2) Common activation steering directions exhibit significant overlap with the shared decode subspace; projecting out this overlap does not produce universal steering robustness improvements, but instead introduces task-dependent utility-robustness tradeoffs. 3) Ranking steering vectors based on decode-time evaluation produces significantly better predictions of held-out KV-cached decoding performance than rankings derived from prefill states.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the formal definition of prefill vs decode states in the methodology section, the DecodeShare pipeline design, the matched causal intervention logic, and ablation results on steering vector overlap. High-value directions to explore include the layer-wise distribution of the shared subspace, scaling of subspace dimensionality with model size, and whether the subspace encodes generic decision control signals rather than task-specific content.

recommendation.zh: 将 prefill 和 decode 的表征空间解耦，发现 decode 阶段存在跨任务共享的决策子空间，对做 activation steering 和理解生成机制极具启发，建议细读实验设计。
recommendation.en: Decouples prefill and decode representation spaces, discovering a task-general decision subspace during decoding; highly inspiring for activation steering and understanding generation mechanisms. The experimental design is worth a close read.

paper.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence.   We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV c

summary.core_problem: 位置无关的 KV cache 复用机制为了提升推理吞吐，允许相同文本块在不同前缀、不同位置下直接复用已计算的 KV 状态。论文指出这一设计存在被攻击者劫持的安全漏洞：被复用的 KV 实际编码了原始计算时的上下文，而不是只代表当前块本身，因此攻击者可以预先污染公共块的 KV，在后续跨用户复用时静默改变其他用户的输出。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的直接启发不在建模范式，而在两个边界问题：一是 KV cache 对上下文的敏感性不仅是精度问题，也是安全边界，说明『把局部块的表征当作可独立缓存对象』这个工程假设与 Transformer 的实际计算语义存在张力；二是随着推理系统越来越激进地做跨请求、跨租户复用，模型内部状态的复用条件需要和训练时的因果假设一起设计，而不只是系统层事后优化。对研究长上下文、注意力机制和推理效率的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 HijackKV 攻击流程。攻击者先选择一个在真实部署中会被高频复用的良性文本块，例如公共 FAQ 或检索文档片段；然后为该块构造一段恶意优化前缀，使该块在前缀条件下计算得到的 KV 隐式携带攻击者目标，例如诱导后续回答偏向某一立场或注入特定内容。当服务端启用位置无关复用后，其他用户请求中只要命中这个相同文本块，就可能直接复用这份被污染的 KV，即使受害者上下文中完全没有攻击者前缀文本。攻击不要求在受害者输入里出现可见的恶意 token，因此区别于传统 prompt injection。论文还分析了现有补救措施，例如选择性重算部分 KV，指出这类方案原本为弥补精度损失设计，默认重算比例不足以消除被植入的上下文偏置。
summary.experiments: 论文在多模型、多 KV 复用机制上评估了攻击可行性。核心结果包括：单次尝试平均攻击成功率约 94%；即使缓存命中率低到 10%，攻击仍然有效；当系统启用最高 50% 比例的选择性 KV 重算时，攻击依旧保持较高成功率；在被污染 KV 之后插入超过 1000 个无关 token，攻击影响仍可保持，说明污染可以跨多轮持续；在黑盒设定下，恶意前缀对不同模型具有一定迁移性。论文没有提出完整防御方案，最后给出了安全设计建议，例如限制跨租户复用、引入上下文绑定校验、提高重算策略的安全阈值。
summary.reading_guide: 适合泛读。重点看引言中的威胁模型、Figure 1 对传统前缀复用与位置无关复用差异的图示，以及攻击为何不依赖受害者输入中出现恶意 token。实验部分重点关注三个数字：94% 成功率、10% 低命中率下仍有效、50% 重算仍失效；这三个结果最能说明问题不是边角案例。防御建议章节可读得快一些，因为目前还是原则性方向。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Position-independent KV cache reuse improves inference throughput by reusing cached KV states for identical text chunks across different positions and prefixes. The paper shows this optimization introduces a security vulnerability: reused KV states encode the original causal context in which they were computed, not just the local chunk itself, so an attacker can pre-poison KV entries of commonly shared chunks and silently hijack other users’ generations when those entries are later reused across requests.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretrain research is at the boundary between modeling assumptions and inference systems. First, context dependence of KV states is not only an accuracy issue for approximate reuse but also a security boundary, revealing a tension between aggressive chunk-level caching and the causal semantics of Transformers. Second, as serving systems move toward cross-request and cross-tenant reuse, the conditions under which internal states can be safely reused may need to be co-designed with model behavior rather than treated as a purely systems-level afterthought. This is useful for researchers working on long context, attention, and efficient inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HijackKV, an attack against position-independent KV reuse. The attacker first identifies a benign text chunk likely to be widely reused in deployment, such as a public FAQ page or a retrieved document fragment. The attacker then optimizes a malicious prefix such that the KV states computed for the benign chunk under that prefix implicitly encode the attacker’s objective. When a later victim request contains the same chunk, the serving system may directly reuse the poisoned KV entry even though the malicious prefix is absent from the victim context. This makes the attack different from prompt injection, where adversarial tokens must appear in the victim prompt. The paper also studies selective KV recomputation, a standard mitigation for accuracy degradation in reuse systems, and shows that typical recomputation budgets are insufficient to remove the implanted bias.
summary_en.experiments: The attack is evaluated across multiple models and KV reuse implementations. Key results include: about 94% average attack success rate with a single attempt; attack remains effective when chunk hit rate is as low as 10%; attack remains effective even when up to 50% of KV states are selectively recomputed; the effect persists after more than 1,000 unrelated tokens are appended after the hijacked chunk, suggesting persistence across multi-turn interactions; the malicious prefix shows some black-box transferability across models. The paper does not provide a full defense, but closes with design recommendations such as restricting cross-tenant reuse, binding cached entries more tightly to context, and raising recomputation thresholds under untrusted workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper for the threat model and its implications. Focus on the introduction, Figure 1 comparing prefix-based and position-independent reuse, and the key distinction from prompt injection. In experiments, pay most attention to three numbers—94% success, effectiveness at 10% hit rate, and persistence under 50% recomputation—because they establish that the issue is not a narrow corner case. The defense discussion is preliminary and can be read quickly. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 首次系统揭示位置无关KV缓存复用的安全漏洞，做推理优化的必看，预训练研究员可关注位置编码的侧信道风险。
recommendation.en: First systematic disclosure of position-independent KV reuse vulnerabilities; must-read for inference optimization researchers, note position encoding side-channel risks for pretraining.

paper.title: HeadCast: Casting Attention Heads for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have become a promising paradigm for long and streaming video synthesis, but the continuously growing Key-Value (KV) cache makes attention the dominant inference cost, especially at high resolution where each frame contributes many tokens. Existing remedies either evict the cache with coarse heuristics that cause inter-frame flickering, or require model re-training. We propose HeadCast, a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration framework built on the

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 AR video diffusion 在长视频和高分辨率推理时的 KV cache 膨胀问题。随着历史帧不断累积，注意力计算逐渐成为主要瓶颈。已有做法要么用统一滑窗，仍然很慢；要么激进驱逐缓存，容易丢掉长程依赖，出现 flicker 和结构漂移；要么需要重新训练模型。作者的问题设定很明确：能否不改模型参数，只根据预训练模型里不同 attention head 的稳定行为差异，给每个 head 分配不同的缓存和注意力路径，从而在不明显伤害时序一致性的前提下加速推理。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理效率，而不是预训练本身。对基座研究的直接价值有限，但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“head specialization”从分析现象变成了可部署的系统优化，说明预训练模型内部确实存在稳定、可利用的结构异质性。第二，它针对 AR video diffusion 这种统一 Transformer 推理栈给出训练后改造方案，这对多模态统一模型、长上下文缓存管理、以及 head-level routing 的研究有参考意义。若关注纯文本 LLM 预训练，这篇不是优先级很高；若关注统一生成架构和 serving 侧结构利用，可以快速看。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 HeadCast。作者先观察预训练 AR 视频模型的注意力图，发现不同 head 在时间和空间维度上有稳定且异质的依赖模式，并将其分成四类。Sink head 主要盯住首帧或首个 block，起到锚点作用；Dummy head 主要看当前 denoising block；Spatial head 不需要全局历史，只需要跨历史帧的局部空间邻域；Global head 则确实依赖完整上下文。基于这个分类，HeadCast 在短暂 warm-up 后，只在最大噪声步 t=1000 做一次 head classification，因为此时注意力更反映结构偏好而不是具体内容。之后每类 head 走不同的计算路径：Sink 和 Dummy 只保留极小缓存，Spatial 在固定网格邻域内做注意力，Global 继续保留完整滑窗。对应地，原本统一的 KV cache 被拆成 head-specific buffers。这样做的关键不是一味裁剪，而是显式保留少数真正需要全局历史的 head，避免像 Dummy Forcing 那样因为分类过粗而把维持时序一致性的长程信息一起删掉。整个方法 training-free、plug-and-play，不需要改权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 AR video diffusion 框架，包括 Self-Forcing、LongLive、Causal Forcing、Reward Forcing。主要结果是：加速收益会随着分辨率和缓存长度上升而变大，在 720P 上最高约 1.62×，在 1080P 上最高约 1.95×。质量方面，作者报告 VBench 指标基本保持，同时帧级保真度如 PSNR、LPIPS 也能维持，并且相较于更激进的缓存驱逐方法，明显减少 inter-frame flickering。论文的论证重点不只是平均指标，而是说明四类 head 的分工在生成过程中相对稳定，因此一次早期分类就足够；同时 ablation 也支持“必须保留 Global heads”这一点，否则时序一致性会明显下降。若从方法可信度看，最重要的证据是跨多个模型都能复用同一套分类-路由思路，而不是只在单一 backbone 上成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Motivation 和 Figure 1，理解四类 head 是怎么从时间稀疏和空间稀疏两个维度拆出来的。然后看 HeadCast 的流程图，重点弄清楚为什么分类只做一次、为什么选在最大噪声步、以及四类 head 各自保留什么缓存。实验部分优先看与 Dummy Forcing、滑窗基线的对比，以及关于 flicker 的可视化和 ablation。预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线。若你做的是文本 LLM 预训练，可以把它当成“head specialization 是否足够稳定到能驱动系统优化”的案例；若你做多模态生成或 serving，这篇更值得细看实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the KV-cache growth problem in autoregressive video diffusion. As more video blocks are generated, historical keys and values accumulate, and attention over the cache becomes the dominant inference cost, especially at high resolution where each frame contributes many tokens. Existing fixes either use a uniform sliding window, which remains expensive, or aggressively evict cache entries, which harms long-range temporal consistency and causes flicker. Training-based sparse-attention alternatives require retraining. The paper asks whether a pretrained model’s attention heads have stable enough roles that each head can be given its own cache policy without changing model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its direct relevance to language-model pretraining is modest. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, head specialization is not just an interpretive observation; it can be stable enough to support deployment-time optimization. Second, it shows how a unified Transformer-style generative stack can be restructured after training by exploiting heterogeneous head behavior. That is relevant to multimodal foundation models, long-context cache management, and head-level routing ideas. For pure text pretraining, this is not a high-priority read; for unified generation systems and serving, it is more useful.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, HeadCast, starts from an empirical observation: attention heads in pretrained AR video models show stable and heterogeneous temporal/spatial dependency patterns. The authors group heads into four archetypes. Sink heads anchor strongly to the first frame or first block. Dummy heads attend almost entirely to the current denoising block. Spatial heads do not need the full history, only a local spatial neighborhood across historical frames. Global heads genuinely require broad historical context. After a short warm-up, HeadCast performs a one-time head classification at the maximum-noise step, t=1000, where attention is argued to reflect structural preference more than content-specific details. Each head is then routed to a dedicated computation path: Sink and Dummy heads keep only tiny buffers, Spatial heads attend within a fixed spatial grid, and Global heads retain the full sliding-window context. The monolithic KV cache is split into compact head-specific buffers. The key design choice is not merely pruning harder, but explicitly preserving the small subset of heads that carry long-range temporal dependencies, avoiding the temporal instability seen in coarser cache-eviction schemes such as Dummy Forcing. The method is training-free and plug-and-play.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans several AR video diffusion frameworks, including Self-Forcing, LongLive, Causal Forcing, and Reward Forcing. The main result is that speedup grows with resolution and cache size: up to about 1.62x at 720P and 1.95x at 1080P. On quality, the paper reports preserved VBench performance together with stable frame-level fidelity metrics such as PSNR and LPIPS. Qualitatively, it reduces inter-frame flickering compared with more aggressive cache-eviction baselines. A central empirical point is that the four head archetypes remain stable enough during generation that a single early classification is sufficient. The ablations also support the need to retain Global heads; removing or over-pruning them degrades temporal coherence. The strongest evidence is not a single benchmark win, but the fact that the same classify-and-route idea transfers across multiple pretrained AR video generators.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, begin with the motivation section and the first attention visualizations. They explain how the four head types emerge from temporal sparsity and spatial sparsity. Then read the HeadCast pipeline carefully, focusing on three questions: why classification is done only once, why it is done at the maximum-noise step, and what cache each head type keeps. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against sliding-window baselines and Dummy Forcing, plus the flicker visualizations and the ablations on Global-head retention. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main idea. If your work is in text LLM pretraining, treat this as a case study in whether head specialization is stable enough to drive systems optimization; if you work on multimodal generation or serving, the implementation details are more worth studying.

recommendation.zh: 面向视频AR扩散的KV cache头分型思路可迁移到长上下文LLM；只看§3的头分类定义和消融图即可，视频生成细节可跳过。
recommendation.en: The head-typed KV cache idea transfers to long-context LLM inference; read §3 head taxonomy and ablations, skip video-specific generation details.

paper.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-video question answering requires a model to preserve visual evidence over time without repeatedly reprocessing the same video. A practical approach is to store the vision-language model's internal key-value (KV) cache for each video chunk and retrieve that state at query time. However, independently cached video chunks do not compose correctly: every chunk is prefilled from local rotary position zero, so naive concatenation collides temporal phases and removes the global order required for

summary.core_problem: 长视频 VLM 中，将视频分块独立预填充得到的 KV cache 直接拼接会导致多模态 RoPE 的时空位置冲突，无法支持跨块时序推理。
summary.importance: 指出多模态 RoPE（尤其是时空联合坐标）下 naive KV 拼接的几何不一致问题，给出训练无关的修复方案，对长视频/长上下文 KV cache 复用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ChronoStitch 在 post-rotary key 空间将各 chunk 的 KV 重映射到统一的全局三轴（time/height/width）RoPE 坐标系，而不是做一维标量 re-index；分析了一维 re-index 在视觉 token 上破坏空间结构的原因。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未给出完整模型与数据集规模，核心验证点是重基后跨 chunk 时序问题（先后、计数、变化）在不重训前提下恢复全局顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-video VLMs, naively concatenating independently prefilled KV caches across video chunks causes multimodal RoPE phase collisions across time and space, breaking cross-chunk temporal reasoning.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a geometric inconsistency of naive KV stitching under joint spatio-temporal multimodal RoPE and proposes a training-free fix, relevant to long-context KV reuse for video LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChronoStitch re-bases stored post-rotary keys onto a unified global three-axis RoPE coordinate system (time, height, width), showing why 1D scalar re-indexing is geometrically inconsistent for visual tokens and scrambles spatial order.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify exact model sizes and datasets; the stated claim is that re-basing recovers global ordering across chunks without retraining, enabling questions about event order, frequency, and change.

recommendation.zh: 训练无关的 KV stitching 思路实用，但分析只在多模态 RoPE 几何层面，建议只看 §3 的坐标系重基推导，正文实验当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a training-free KV stitching trick, but the analysis stays at multimodal RoPE geometry; read §3 for the re-basing argument and treat experiments as a weak signal.

paper.title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is central to modern large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. To mitigate the growing inference cost, recent work has explored key-value (KV) cache reuse to reduce redundant prefill computation. However, existing reuse methods primarily focus on computation savings and overlook a critical bottleneck in long-context LLM serving: the cost of storing and accessing large KV caches. While KV compression appears

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM serving 中非前缀 KV cache 复用与 KV 压缩难以同时成立的问题，目标是在减少 prefill 计算的同时降低 KV 存储和访问成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与缓存表示方法创新。长上下文 RAG、多文档推理和会话复用场景里，prefill 计算和 KV cache 内存都会成为瓶颈；已有 KV reuse 多关注省算力，较少处理大规模缓存的存取成本，而直接压缩非前缀 KV 往往损伤精度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C2KV，将非前缀 KV reuse、KV extraction 和 inference-time concatenation 放在同一个框架里优化。方法学习一个可组合、压缩且位置无关的 KV cache manifold，并引入轻量 sidecar Extractor、可学习 compression tokens 和结构化注意力机制，使抽取出的 KV 表示能在不同上下文位置下复用。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未提供模型参数量、数据规模、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。实验重点应是长上下文推理、RAG 或多文档场景下的 prefill latency、KV 内存占用、cache access cost 与任务精度之间的折中；需要看正文确认压缩率、吞吐提升和非前缀复用下的质量退化。
summary.authors_note: Alibaba Group 参与的 LLM inference / serving 方向工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the mismatch between non-prefix KV cache reuse and KV compression in long-context LLM serving, aiming to save both prefill compute and KV storage/access cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and cache-representation contribution. In long-context RAG, multi-document reasoning, and reusable-session serving, prefill compute is only part of the cost; storing and reading large KV caches can dominate. Existing reuse methods mostly optimize compute, while naive compression of non-prefix reusable KV often hurts accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: C2KV jointly optimizes KV extraction and inference-time concatenation for non-prefix reuse. It learns a compressed, composable, position-agnostic KV cache manifold, using a lightweight sidecar Extractor, learnable compression tokens, and structured attention so that extracted KV states can be reused across different context positions.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. The relevant experiments should be long-context reasoning, RAG, or multi-document serving, measuring prefill latency, KV memory footprint, cache access cost, and accuracy retention under non-prefix reuse; the full paper is needed for compression ratios and quality trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Alibaba Group on LLM inference and serving.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation 即可；如果非前缀 KV 复用要进生产，这篇的“位置无关压缩表示”值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if non-prefix KV reuse matters in production, the position-agnostic compressed cache representation is worth reproducing.

paper.title: LaCache: Exact Caching and Precision-Adaptive Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based Large Language Models(DLLMs) enable parallel generation via Semi-Autoregressive (SAR) decoding in text generation. However, current methods suffer from severe operator-level redundancy: they recompute the entire sequence during denoising steps, ignoring that the prefix and masked suffix remain invariant within a block. We propose LaCache, a training-free acceleration framework that alleviates this redundancy through lossless caching and mixed precision. Specifically, LaCache empl

summary.core_problem: Diffusion LLM 在半自回归分块解码中每个去噪步都重算整段序列，忽略前缀与块内未变 mask 后缀的算子级冗余。
summary.importance: 首个针对 DLLM 推理的无损缓存 + 混合精度加速框架，直接服务于新兴的离散扩散/MDLM 类文本建模范式的部署。
summary.technical_approach: LaCache 是免训练框架：(1) Lossless State Memoization 缓存三类中间结果——EmbedCache（embedding 输出）、RoPECache（逐 token 注意力前状态）、FACache（FlashAttention 在线 softmax 统计），对未变 token 跳过计算且输出完全一致；(2) 针对 FFN 的 per-group FP8 量化，按步定制以缓解内存带宽瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体模型、baseline 与加速比/精度数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LLMs recompute the entire sequence every denoising step during semi-autoregressive block decoding, ignoring operator-level redundancy in invariant prefixes and masked suffixes within a block.
summary_en.importance: A lossless caching plus mixed-precision acceleration framework tailored to DLLM inference, directly serving deployment of the emerging discrete diffusion / MDLM family of text models.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaCache is training-free: (1) Lossless State Memoization caches three intermediates—EmbedCache for embeddings, RoPECache for per-token pre-attention states, and FACache for FlashAttention online softmax stats—so unchanged tokens skip computation with identical outputs; (2) per-group FP8 quantization for FFN layers, tailored per denoising step to relieve memory-bandwidth pressure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports no specific models, baselines, speedups, or quality numbers.

recommendation.zh: 把 FlashAttention 在线 softmax 统计缓存做进 DLLM 是个实在的工程点，做 diffusion LM 部署的应读 §3-4 复现。
recommendation.en: Caching FlashAttention online softmax stats for DLLMs is a concrete systems trick; reproduce §3-4 if you deploy diffusion LMs.

paper.title: FlowBlock: Wavefront-Parallel Decoding for Self-Correcting Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Block-wise diffusion large language models (dLLMs) decode sequentially at the block level, enabling effective KV-cache reuse across blocks but making inter-block decoding strictly serial. Prior work has attempted to unlock inter-block parallelism through post-training methods, but achieves only modest speedups and often degrades accuracy. We observe that self-correcting dLLMs offer a training-free alternative: token-to-token (T2T) editing can repair tokens drafted with a slightly stale upstream

summary.core_problem: 解决 block-wise diffusion LLM 在块间必须串行解码的问题：KV-cache 可以复用，但 block finality 形成了硬依赖，限制并行度。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与生成机制结合的工程创新。它不改训练、不做后训练，而是利用 self-correcting dLLM 的 token-to-token 编辑能力，把“上游块必须完成”改成“上游块只需提供足够有信息的草稿”。这对 diffusion LM 能否在真实 serving 中获得吞吐优势很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlowBlock，一个 training-free 的 wavefront-parallel decoding 框架。核心包括 Gated Wavefront Decoding：只有满足 readiness gate 的 block 才进入有限 wavefront，并对活跃 blocks 联合做 T2T editing；同时按窗口化 block-causal 约束顺序 commit，避免并行草稿破坏输出一致性。方法属于调度与解码策略改进，而不是模型结构或训练目标改动。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 或速度/质量数字。可确认的实验目标应是比较原始 block-wise dLLM 串行解码、已有 post-training 并行化方法，以及 FlowBlock 在速度提升和精度保持上的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the inter-block serialization bottleneck in block-wise diffusion LLM decoding: KV-cache reuse works across blocks, but finalizing each upstream block becomes a hard dependency.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution tied to a non-AR language-modeling regime. It uses the self-correction property of diffusion LMs to relax block finality into a scheduling resource, which matters for whether dLLMs can translate their parallel generation promise into practical serving gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowBlock is a training-free wavefront-parallel decoding framework. Its main mechanism, Gated Wavefront Decoding, admits blocks into a bounded wavefront only after a readiness gate is satisfied, jointly refines active blocks through token-to-token editing, and commits blocks in order under a windowed block-causal constraint. The method changes scheduling and decoding, not the model or objective.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or exact speed/accuracy numbers. The intended comparison is against serial block-wise dLLM decoding and prior post-training approaches that try to expose inter-block parallelism.

recommendation.zh: 只看解码调度和质量退化曲线；若结果干净，dLLM serving 的并行假设要重新评估。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduling design and quality-speed curves; if clean, it changes the serving prior for block-wise dLLMs.

paper.title: Talaria: Session-Aware Serverless Serving of Hundred-Billion-Parameter LLMs
paper.abstract: Serverless multi-model LLM systems multiplex popularity-skewed model catalogs over shared GPU pools, yet typically schedule each request independently. Tool-using agents break this abstraction: a session repeatedly calls an LLM across short tool gaps, carries a long reusable KV prefix, and is judged by session completion time (SCT). Load-only routing can separate a continuation from both its model and KV state, while round-based model multiplexing can delay even a correctly placed continuation u

summary.core_problem: 现有无服务器多模型LLM服务按单请求调度，破坏了工具调用Agent会话的连续性，导致KV缓存丢失和会话完成时间（SCT）显著恶化。
summary.importance: 系统创新：首个面向百亿参数LLM的会话感知无服务器服务系统，联合处理放置与准入控制以保留KV局部性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Talaria系统，路由按模型驻留、KV局部性和实例压力排序放置；引入软预留机制预测会话短工具间隙后的返回请求，避免轮次复用导致的延迟；联合优化放置与准入决策。
summary.experiments: 面向百十亿参数LLM、工具调用Agent会话场景；对比负载优先路由和轮次复用调度，在长上下文KV和多模型混部条件下降低会话完成时间，提升GPU池利用率。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing serverless multi-model LLM serving schedules requests independently, breaking session continuity for tool-using agents and causing KV-cache loss and degraded session completion time (SCT).
summary_en.importance: Systems innovation: first session-aware serverless serving system for hundred-billion-parameter LLMs, jointly handling placement and admission control to preserve KV locality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents Talaria, whose router ranks placements by model residency, KV locality, and instance pressure; adds soft reservations to predict returning requests after short tool gaps, avoiding delays from round-based multiplexing; jointly optimizes placement and admission decisions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on hundred-billion-parameter LLMs with tool-using agent sessions; reduces SCT and improves GPU pool utilization under long-context KV and multi-model co-location compared to load-only routing and round-based multiplexing baselines.

recommendation.zh: 做推理服务或长上下文Agent部署的人重点看§3软预留和路由打分，KV局部性对SCT的收益比单纯扩显存更直接。
recommendation.en: For inference-serving or long-context agent deployment teams, focus on §3 soft reservations and the routing scorer — KV locality improves SCT more directly than raw memory scaling.

paper.title: SelKV: Selective KV Cache Merging with Per-Token Merge-or-Drop and Attention Compensation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate text autoregressively, relying on a key-value (KV) cache whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length, creating a major bottleneck. Recent compression methods mitigate this cost via token merging; however, these approaches often rely on indiscriminate aggregation, which degrades representations and introduces attention sag, a mismatch where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as individual tokens despite encoding multiple inputs. We prop

summary.core_problem: 现有 KV cache token 合并方法无差别聚合，破坏表征并产生 attention sag（合并 token 与单个 token 获得相同 softmax 质量）。
summary.importance: 提出免训练的 KV 压缩框架，显式建模合并/丢弃决策并修正合并带来的 softmax 失衡。
summary.technical_approach: SelKV 包含两部分：(1) 基于 value 向量相似度的 soft cosine gate，逐 token 决定合并或丢弃，抑制不相似 token；(2) attention-ratio 补偿，利用 prefill 注意力统计量在解码时加 logit bias，修正合并导致的 softmax 质量失衡。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上评测，摘要未给具体模型、压缩率与数值增益。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache token merging aggregates indiscriminately, degrading representations and causing attention sag where merged tokens receive the same softmax mass as single tokens.
summary_en.importance: A training-free KV compression framework that explicitly models merge-or-drop decisions and corrects the softmax imbalance induced by merging.
summary_en.technical_approach: SelKV has two components: (1) a soft cosine gate over value-vector similarity that makes per-token merge/drop decisions and suppresses dissimilar tokens; (2) an attention-ratio compensation that adds a decoding-time logit bias derived from prefill attention statistics to correct softmax mass imbalance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench; the abstract reports no specific models, compression ratios, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: attention sag 的诊断和 logit-bias 补偿思路值得做 KV 压缩的人看 §3，但整体是增量改进。
recommendation.en: The attention-sag diagnosis and logit-bias compensation are worth reading in §3 if you work on KV compression; otherwise incremental.

paper.title: SALT: Salience-Aware Lexical Trie for Long-Context Compression
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly longer prompts, computation and KV-cache memory costs have emerged as major bottlenecks in inference systems. Existing input-level prompt compression methods address this, but rank each sentence by a scalar relevance score, treating the document as an unstructured pool of words and sentences. Under tight budgets, this causes theme collapse, where the dominant theme(s) of a document consumes the budget, discarding less-frequent yet task-relevan

summary.core_problem: 现有输入级 prompt 压缩方法按句子孤立打分分配预算，紧预算下会出现主题坍缩，主导主题占满预算而丢弃低频但任务相关的主题，无法保证主题覆盖度。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模型无关的抽取式 prompt 压缩框架，解决了长上下文压缩中的主题覆盖缺陷，工程实现轻量可复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SALT 框架，将每个句子的关键词组织为按句子频率（SF）排序的字典树，用 SF 作为文档主题结构的轻量代理，通过 trie 结构平滑内存分配，避免主导主题垄断预算，结合多锚点检索提升任务相关性。
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要中实验部分被截断，未披露具体测试模型、数据集及量化提升结果，仅说明框架为模型无关，可复用句子频率作为主题结构代理。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing input-level prompt compression methods allocate budget via per-sentence isolated scoring, leading to theme collapse under tight budgets where dominant themes consume all budget and discard less frequent but task-relevant themes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a model-agnostic extractive prompt compression framework that fixes theme coverage flaws in long-context compression, with lightweight and reusable engineering implementation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SALT organizes per-sentence keywords into a trie sorted by sentence frequency (SF), a lightweight reusable proxy for document thematic structure; the trie smooths memory allocation to prevent dominant theme monopoly, combined with multi-anchor retrieval to improve relevance.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section is truncated in the provided abstract; no specific test models, datasets, or quantitative improvements are disclosed, only that the framework is model-agnostic and uses sentence frequency as a thematic proxy.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文prompt压缩的实用改进，解决了现有方法的主题坍缩问题，trie结构设计可参考，重点看§3的SF-trie构造。
recommendation.en: Practical long-context prompt compression improvement fixing theme collapse; refer to §3 for SF-trie construction design.

paper.title: Regularize or Localize: When Training-Time KV-Cache Geometry Pays Under Quantization
paper.abstract: We study whether \sigreg -- LeJEPA's anti-collapse objective -- can reshape representations during standard autoregressive language-model pretraining, and when the resulting geometry helps \kv-cache quantization. We train 110M-parameter models on 10B FineWeb tokens and report three findings. \textbf{(1)} At $λ{=}0.01$, \sigreg reduces hidden-state pairwise-cosine anisotropy by $38\%$ across three paired seeds. Perplexity increases by less than $0.35\%$ in every pair, with no consistent zero-shot

summary.core_problem: 研究训练时改变表示几何，是否能改善 LLM 的 KV-cache 量化质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练动态与推理效率之间的实证连接。它不是单纯做量化算法，而是问预训练或 continued training 中的正则项能否提前塑造 KV 分布，从而降低后续低比特缓存量化损失。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 LeJEPA 中用于防止表示坍缩的 SigReg 引入自回归 LM 训练，分别作用于 hidden states 以及 K/V cache。核心比较是：只正则隐藏状态、直接正则 K/V、冻结 trunk 后 retrofit、以及无 KV 项的匹配 continued training。度量重点是 pairwise-cosine anisotropy 和未变换、对称、group-free KV 量化下的性能变化。
summary.experiments: 作者训练 110M 参数模型，使用 10B FineWeb tokens。λ=0.01 时，hidden-state SigReg 在三组成对 seed 上将隐藏状态各向异性降低 38%，困惑度增加均小于 0.35%，zero-shot 没有一致退化；但该变化不传导到 KV cache。直接对 K/V 做 continued training 正则后，四个 checkpoint 的平均 cache 各向异性下降 94%，且在未变换对称 group-free 量化下，只有直接 KV 正则带来有效收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether shaping representation geometry during training can improve KV-cache quantization in autoregressive language models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical bridge between training-time representation geometry and inference-time memory efficiency. Rather than proposing another post-hoc quantizer, it tests whether continued training can make the KV cache easier to quantize.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt SigReg, the anti-collapse objective from LeJEPA, to autoregressive LM training. They apply it either to hidden states or directly to K and V tensors, and compare against matched continued training, frozen-trunk retrofits, and unregularized baselines. The key measurements are pairwise-cosine anisotropy and performance under untransformed symmetric group-free KV quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train 110M-parameter models on 10B FineWeb tokens. With λ=0.01, hidden-state SigReg reduces hidden-state anisotropy by 38% across three paired seeds, with less than 0.35% perplexity increase and no consistent zero-shot degradation. However, this does not transfer to KV-cache geometry. Direct K/V regularization during continued training reduces mean cache anisotropy by 94% across four checkpoints and is the only tested training condition that improves the target quantization setup.

recommendation.zh: 少数把预训练表示几何和 KV 量化直接连起来的干净小实验；重点看 KV 正则消融和量化表。
recommendation.en: A clean small-scale link between training-time geometry and KV quantization; read the KV-regularization ablations and quantization tables.

paper.title: Look Clearly Before Answering: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding. However, they remain prone to hallucinations, generating responses that are inconsistent with the visual evidence. Existing mitigation methods largely address language-prior bias or cross-modal imbalance, while progressive visual degradation across perception and memory remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment (SDPR), a training-free framework

summary.core_problem: 缓解 LVLM 在回答过程中逐步丢失视觉证据、进而产生与图像不一致的幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练免费推理修正和机制观察。它把 LVLM 幻觉的一部分原因定位到 attention sink 和 KV cache 的视觉空间失真，而不只归因于语言先验或跨模态权重失衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment。第一步用 saliency-driven attention redistribution 释放被非语义 sink token 占用的注意力；第二步做 saliency-driven cache alignment，减少生成过程中 KV cache 对查询相关视觉特征的空间扭曲；第三步用 prior-constrained contrastive decoding 惩罚不忠实的候选输出。方法是推理期插件，不需要重新训练 LVLM。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM、benchmark、baseline 和提升数值。可确认的实验目标是视觉幻觉缓解，比较对象应包括已有训练免费解码或注意力修正方法，但数值需要查正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce LVLM hallucinations caused by progressive loss of visual evidence during generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference correction method plus a mechanistic observation. It attributes part of LVLM hallucination to attention sinks and spatial distortion in the KV cache, not only to language priors or cross-modal imbalance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment has three components: saliency-driven attention redistribution to recover attention hijacked by non-semantic sink tokens, saliency-driven cache alignment to preserve query-relevant visual features during decoding, and prior-constrained contrastive decoding to penalize visually unfaithful candidates. It is an inference-time plug-in rather than a retraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific LVLMs, benchmarks, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluated target is visual hallucination mitigation, likely against existing training-free decoding or attention-adjustment methods, but the actual numbers require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention sink 与 KV cache distortion 的证据图；方法像插件，结论可当 VLM 推理机制弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the evidence on attention sinks and KV-cache distortion; the method is a plug-in, but the mechanism claim is a useful weak signal for VLM inference.

paper.title: Looped Latent Attention: Cross-Loop KV Compression for Looped Transformers
paper.abstract: Looped, weight-tied Transformers reduce parameters by reusing a block, but decoding still stores a separate K/V cache for every recurrence step. We show that this loop-indexed cache is highly structured. For a fixed token, layer and head, K/V vectors trace a short low-rank trajectory across loops, while the head and layer axes remain much flatter. We introduce Looped Latent Attention (LLA), a post-training cache codec that stores compact K and V latents and reconstructs loop-specific K/V vectors

summary.core_problem: 解决 looped / weight-tied Transformer 在解码时仍需为每个 recurrence step 单独保存 KV cache，导致推理内存优势被显著抵消的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇的价值不在新预训练范式，而在指出 looped Transformer 的真实瓶颈不只是参数量，而是 loop-indexed KV cache。对做长上下文、递归 Transformer、低内存 serving 的人有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者观察到：对固定 token、layer、head，K/V 向量沿 loop 维度形成短程低秩轨迹，而 head 与 layer 维度更难安全压缩。基于此提出 Looped Latent Attention（LLA），作为后训练 cache codec：只存紧凑 latent，在 attention 读取时再重建 loop-specific K/V。默认版本按每个 head 建 codec，专门压缩 recurrence 维；极限压缩版 LLA-2D 进一步把 head 维也折叠进 latent。codec 先用 teacher activations 的 SVD 初始化，再用 KL 和 attention-output distillation 微调。
summary.experiments: 论文将 LLA 与 head-axis MLA、cross-layer sharing、KV quantization、final-loop reuse 等方法在相同 cache budget 下比较，结论是 per-head LLA 效果最好，说明 recurrent cache 确实低秩，但不能粗暴塌缩成单一状态。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值提升幅度，因此目前更像一篇有意思的效率方向信号，是否能外推到主流大模型还要看正文实验覆盖。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Fin AI Research。不是头部实验室，但问题设定比较干净：专门研究 looped Transformer 的跨循环 KV 结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a key bottleneck in looped, weight-tied Transformers: decoding still requires a separate KV cache for every recurrence step, which erodes the memory advantage of parameter tying.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not a new pretraining recipe but a sharper diagnosis of where looped Transformers actually pay at inference time. For researchers working on long-context models, recurrent Transformers, or low-memory serving, this is a useful systems-level observation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors observe that for a fixed token, layer, and head, K/V vectors trace a short low-rank trajectory along the loop dimension, while the head and layer axes are less safely compressible. They propose Looped Latent Attention (LLA), a post-training cache codec that stores compact K and V latents and reconstructs loop-specific K/V only when attention reads them. The default codec works per head and compresses recurrence; an extreme-compression variant, LLA-2D, also folds heads into a shared latent. The codec is initialized from SVD of teacher activations and refined with KL and attention-output distillation.
summary_en.experiments: LLA is compared against head-axis MLA, cross-layer sharing, KV quantization, and final-loop reuse under matched cache budgets. The main reported result is that per-head LLA performs best, suggesting the recurrent cache is low-rank but cannot be safely collapsed into a single state. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, so the current signal is promising but still needs validation on larger and more standard LLM settings.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Fin AI Research. This is not a major lab release, but the problem setup is clean: it isolates cross-loop KV structure in looped Transformers.

recommendation.zh: 不是主线 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你别把 looped Transformer 的省参误当省显存；只看方法图和与 final-loop reuse 的对比就够，若你做递归架构应立刻测 cache rank。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it corrects the lazy assumption that looped Transformers save memory just because they save parameters; read the method figure and the comparison to final-loop reuse, then measure cache rank in your own recurrent stack.

paper.title: VarRate: Training-Free Variable-Rate KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) inference. Two leading training-free families are both structurally limited: token-selection methods (SnapKV, Ada-KV) score importance from an observation window and evict low-scoring tokens, but eviction is irreversible -- so when the importance signal degrades under query-agnostic reuse, accuracy collapses by 11-15 points; uniform low-rank coding keeps every token but spends equal rank everywhere,

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存占用过高，以及 token eviction 在长距离查询下不可逆丢信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率方法。它把 KV 压缩从“删 token”转成“给每个 token 分配不同低秩预算”，保留所有 token 的非零信息。对长上下文 serving、预训练侧长上下文评测和压缩鲁棒性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VarRate 是训练免费的 KV codec。它根据 query salience 为不同 token 分配可变低秩 rank，而不是直接淘汰低分 token；所有 token 都保留非零 rank。相对于统一低秩压缩，它避免把预算平均浪费在不重要位置；相对于 SnapKV、Ada-KV 等选择式方法，它避免不可逆删除。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上，以相同 20% KV 预算比较训练免费的 token-selection 方法和低秩方法。摘要称 SnapKV、Ada-KV 类方法在 query-agnostic reuse 下会掉 11-15 分，而 VarRate 在相同困难场景下只掉 3.5-5.5 分。摘要未给出完整模型规模和全部任务明细。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache memory pressure in long-context LLM inference and the irreversible information loss caused by token eviction.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It reframes KV compression from dropping tokens to allocating different low-rank budgets per token, keeping nonzero information for every position. It is relevant to long-context serving and to robustness analysis of compression schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: VarRate is a training-free KV codec that assigns variable low-rank ranks to tokens according to query salience. It keeps every token at a nonzero rank. Compared with uniform low-rank compression, it avoids wasting equal budget everywhere; compared with SnapKV- or Ada-KV-style token selection, it avoids irreversible eviction.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports LongBench results at a matched 20% KV budget. The abstract states that token-selection methods lose 11–15 points when query-agnostic reuse degrades the importance signal, while VarRate loses only 3.5–5.5 points in the same regime. The abstract does not provide full model sizes or all task-level details.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 LongBench 失败案例即可；“低秩保留全部 token”比 eviction 更稳，是长上下文压缩的有用 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LongBench failure cases; keeping all tokens at low rank is a useful prior over eviction for long-context compression.

paper.title: Polestar: Drift-Aware Cache Calibration and Token Commitment for Efficient Inference of Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: The inference efficiency of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is constrained by two challenges: bidirectional attention precludes efficient KV-cache reuse, while increasing decoding parallelism with static confidence thresholds can compromise generation quality. We observe that both challenges arise from a shared phenomenon: as tokens are decoded, their contextual integration through bidirectional attention causes token representations to drift (evolve) across decoding steps. This insight

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的两个耦合问题：一是双向注意力导致标准 AR 式 KV-cache 不能直接复用，每一步都要重算；二是为了减少 denoising 步数而做并行 token 提交时，固定阈值往往在不同样本、不同步数下失灵，容易把尚未稳定的 token 过早提交，带来质量下降。论文的关键判断是，这两个问题不是彼此独立的工程细节，而是都来自同一个机制：在迭代去噪过程中，token 表示会因为双向上下文持续重整而发生 drift，旧 cache 之所以失效、token 之所以不能安全提交，都是因为表示还在变。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于它把 dLLM 推理中的“缓存有效性”和“提交时机”统一成了一个可测的表示动力学信号。这个视角比只看置信度、attention 热点或固定 block 边界更接近 dLLM 的真实计算结构。若后续有人做 diffusion / masked / any-order LM 的训练-推理协同设计，这篇工作的价值在于给出了一个较清楚的中间量：表示 drift 可以作为推理控制信号，也可能反过来成为训练时的辅助目标、校准目标或 early-exit 信号。就当前工作本身看，它属于推理优化，但对非 AR 语言建模范式的系统化落地有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
