Those are the parts that determine whether the paper is merely combining existing ideas or actually proposing a new optimization framework. In the experiments, prioritize the Pareto curves, the shared-versus-separate router ablation, the routing-granularity study, and the tail-token analysis. A 30-minute skim can cover the method overview, the main result figures, and the key ablations. For a deeper read, pay attention to implementation implications: how much training overhead the controller adds, and whether per-token/per-layer/per-head dynamic decisions can be realized cleanly in real serving stacks with existing KV layouts, fused kernels, and batching constraints.

recommendation.zh: 想法比数字更值得看；只读 controller 设计和预算损失，别被未披露的加速结果牵着走。
recommendation.en: The idea is more useful than the reported numbers; read the controller and budget objective, not the unspecified speedup claims.

paper.title: Fractal KV-Cache Archives: Lossless Symbolic Storage with In-Place Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates the memory cost of long-context autoregressive inference, and a growing body of work compresses it through quantization, eviction, or offloading. We study a complementary question: once a position's KV state has been quantized to codebook indices, how should the resulting symbol stream be stored, and can the storage layer do more than store? A family of contractive iterated-map codes that serialize a symbol sequence into a sequence of low-dimensional real vecto

summary.core_problem: 长上下文自回归推理中KV cache占主要内存开销，现有工作聚焦量化、驱逐、卸载优化，缺少针对量化后KV符号序列的专用存储格式，难以同时满足无损、快速追加、随机访问需求。
summary.importance: 探索基于压缩迭代映射的分形编码作为量化KV cache的归档存储格式，是KV cache优化在存储层的新奇思路，补充了现有优化路径的设计空间。
summary.technical_approach: 重新审视压缩迭代映射（分形IFS）编码，将量化得到的KV符号序列序列化为低维实向量流，实现线性时间编解码、O(1)随机访问、均摊O(1)追加写入；实践中保留小部分精确KV窗口（4个attention sink + 32个最近token），其余历史KV全部归档。
summary.experiments: 仅在GPT-2模型、1024token上下文上开展量化器对照实验验证存储格式的基本访问特性，未提供大模型、长上下文场景下的压缩比、推理速度、PPL、下游任务效果等关键指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The KV cache dominates memory cost in long-context autoregressive inference; existing work focuses on quantization, eviction, and offloading, but lacks specialized storage formats for quantized KV symbol streams that jointly support lossless storage, fast appends, and random access.
summary_en.importance: Explores fractal coding via contractive iterated maps as an archival storage format for quantized KV caches, a novel storage-layer design that expands the KV cache optimization design space.
summary_en.technical_approach: Revisits contractive iterated-map (fractal IFS) codes to serialize quantized KV symbol streams into low-dimensional real vectors, enabling linear-time en/decoding, O(1) random access, and amortized O(1) appends; keeps a small exact KV window (4 attention sinks + 32 most recent tokens) and archives all older entries.
summary_en.experiments: Only runs controlled quantizer studies on GPT-2 with 1024-token contexts to validate basic access properties; no key metrics (compression ratio, speed, perplexity, downstream performance) are reported for large models or long-context settings.

recommendation.zh: 思路新奇但实验仅覆盖GPT-2 1k上下文，未在大模型长场景验证收益，作为KV存储的奇特思路备查即可，无需细读。
recommendation.en: Novel storage idea but only validated on GPT-2 with 1k context, no large-model long-context results; keep as a curious KV storage design note, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Benchmarking KV-Cache Optimizations across Task Quality and System Performance for Long-Context Serving
paper.abstract: Large language model serving is increasingly limited by KV-cache growth under long-context workloads, yet existing KV-cache compression techniques are difficult to compare because they were evaluated on different models, tasks, budgets, and serving stacks. This paper presents a workload-aware benchmark of representative KV-cache optimization mechanisms spanning quantization, pruning, and merging, including KIVI, TurboQuant, SnapKV, and CaM, evaluated on LongBench-style multi-document QA, single-

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是长上下文推理中 KV-cache 优化方法难以公平比较的问题。已有方法通常各自使用不同模型、任务、压缩预算和 serving 栈，导致“压缩率高”是否真的带来端到端收益并不清楚。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接贡献不在预训练方法，而在长上下文 serving 评测。它有助于判断某类 KV-cache 压缩是否会改变长上下文能力的实际可用边界。对预训练研究员的启发点是：长上下文能力不能只看训练时 context length 或 benchmark 分数，还要看推理时 KV 内存、带宽、TTFT 和输出吞吐之间的约束。压缩率本身不是充分指标，实际收益取决于任务形态、上下文长度桶、模型结构和实现开销。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了一个 workload-aware benchmark，在统一设置下比较三类代表性 KV-cache 优化：量化类 KIVI、TurboQuant，剪枝/驱逐类 SnapKV，以及合并类 CaM。评测使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3，覆盖 LongBench 风格的多文档问答、单文档问答、few-shot learning 和摘要任务。系统指标包括 time-to-first-token、输出吞吐、prefill KV-cache 内存占用和实际压缩率。方法上的重点不是提出新的压缩算法，而是把质量指标和系统指标放在同一套实验协议里，避免只看 accuracy 或只看 memory saving 的片面结论。
summary.experiments: 实验选取 LongBench 中 6 个数据集衡量任务质量，并用 NarrativeQA、GovReport、Qasper 等长上下文数据集衡量系统性能。模型为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3。比较对象覆盖 KIVI、TurboQuant、SnapKV、CaM。结果强调几个现象：第一，不同压缩范式在不同任务上的质量损失差异明显，摘要、多文档 QA 和 few-shot learning 对 cache 处理的敏感性并不相同。第二，高压缩率不一定转化为更高输出吞吐或更低 TTFT，因为实现开销、访存模式和预填充阶段代价会抵消部分收益。第三，实际压缩率需要按上下文长度桶报告，平均数字容易掩盖长尾输入下的内存压力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看实验设置和结果分析部分，尤其是 workload 划分、指标定义、不同 context-length bucket 下的质量-效率曲线。背景部分可快速扫过，主要用于确认各类 KV-cache 方法的归类。最值得保留的是它的评测协议和指标组合：如果要做新的 KV-cache 压缩或长上下文 serving 方法，可以直接检查自己的实验是否同时覆盖任务质量、TTFT、吞吐、内存占用和实际压缩率。

summary_en.core_problem: This work addresses the lack of a fair comparison protocol for KV-cache optimization under long-context serving. Existing methods are usually evaluated with different models, tasks, compression budgets, and serving stacks, so it is hard to know whether a higher compression ratio translates into useful end-to-end gains.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and systems benchmark rather than a pretraining method. It is still relevant for foundation-model research because long-context capability is constrained not only by training-time context length or benchmark scores, but also by KV memory, bandwidth, TTFT, and decoding throughput at inference time. A key lesson is that compression ratio alone is not a reliable proxy for serving performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a workload-aware benchmark that evaluates representative KV-cache optimization families under a unified setup: quantization methods such as KIVI and TurboQuant, pruning or eviction methods such as SnapKV, and merging methods such as CaM. The benchmark uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3. It covers LongBench-style multi-document QA, single-document QA, few-shot learning, and summarization. The measured metrics include task quality, time-to-first-token, output throughput, prefill KV-cache memory footprint, and realized compression ratio. The main methodological contribution is the joint measurement of quality and system behavior rather than a new compression algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates task quality on six LongBench-derived datasets and system performance on long-context workloads such as NarrativeQA, GovReport, and Qasper. It compares KIVI, TurboQuant, SnapKV, and CaM on two instruction-tuned 7B/8B-class models. The reported findings stress that task sensitivity differs across workloads: summarization, multi-document QA, and few-shot tasks do not tolerate the same cache manipulation patterns. The experiments also show that high nominal compression does not necessarily improve throughput or TTFT, because extra compute, memory access patterns, and prefill overhead can offset memory savings. Reporting results by context-length buckets is important, since aggregate compression numbers can hide the behavior on long inputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the experimental setup, metric definitions, and the quality-versus-systems trade-off plots across context-length buckets. The background section can be read quickly to check how the paper categorizes quantization, pruning, and merging methods. The most reusable part is the benchmark design: any new KV-cache compression method should be checked against task quality, TTFT, output throughput, memory footprint, and realized compression ratio under a shared workload mix.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果矩阵和长度分桶即可；它提醒内部压测别再用压缩率单指标选 KV-cache 方案。
recommendation.en: Read the result matrix and length buckets; it is a useful warning against choosing KV-cache methods by compression ratio alone.

paper.title: PEEK: Predictive Queue-Informed KV Cache Management for LLM Serving
paper.abstract: We present PEEK, a lightweight scheduling and eviction framework for both online (streaming) and offline (batch) LLM serving; this paper focuses on the online regime. PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue, exposing   prefix-sharing clusters no existing engine surfaces. A low-overhead dual-walk matches the tree against the engine's prefix cache to yield longest-prefix-match for every waiting request; PEEK then admits cluster pioneers first so siblings   inherit the fresh

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 LLM serving 中 KV cache 复用没有利用等待队列结构的问题。现有 SGLang 和 vLLM 主要根据当前 cache 状态调度或按到达顺序调度，无法提前看到排队请求之间的 prefix sharing，导致长上下文、RAG、批量相似请求场景中出现 cache thrashing。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于推理系统优化，对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型研究平台有实际参考价值。长上下文训练和评测越来越依赖高吞吐推理管线，尤其是数据合成、agent rollout、RL sampling 和 benchmark evaluation。PEEK 的启发点是：请求队列本身包含可预测的未来 KV 需求，调度和 eviction 应该联合使用这个信号，而不是只看已缓存内容。
summary.technical_approach: PEEK 在 pending queue 上维护一个增量 radix tree，用来表示等待请求之间的公共前缀结构。插入和删除开销为 O(D)，调度和 eviction 查询可近似 O(1) 读取聚类信号。对 SGLang 的 radix cache，PEEK 使用 dual-walk 同时遍历 pending tree 和 engine cache，为所有等待请求计算 longest-prefix-match，复杂度从 naive 的 O(ND) 降为 O(CD)，其中 C 是 prefix-sharing clusters 数量，通常小于 N。调度上，Cluster-LPM 不只看当前 cache hit length，也让同一 prefix cluster 的请求尽量相邻进入系统，使一次 prefill 能被后续 sibling 复用。eviction 上，PEEK 保护未来排队请求依赖的 ancestral blocks，优先淘汰没有 pending demand 的 blocks。为避免 cluster-first 导致 singleton 饥饿，系统加入按到达时间排序的 fairness lane，并用 stride scheduler 和动态 lane controller 在 locality 与等待时间之间调整。
summary.experiments: 实验在 SGLang 和 vLLM 上进行，覆盖 5 类 workload，包含 shared-prompt chat、long-prefix RAG、multi-GPU 70B 场景、agentic conversation bursts 和 singleton-dominated chat，规模最高到 4×H100，DP=2、TP=2。在线 serving 结果显示，在有明显 prefix 结构的 W1/W2/W3 中，PEEK 在 SGLang/vLLM 上分别带来最高 3.0×/2.6× cache hit 提升，7.9×/7.1× TTFT 改善，6.7×/5.5× end-to-end latency 改善，以及 3.6×/4.5× throughput 提升。在 prefix 结构弱或已经按到达顺序较好聚集的 W4/W5 中，E2E 和 throughput 基本与最强 baseline 持平，波动约 ±2%，TTFT 波动约 ±5–7%。消融显示 cluster-aware admission 是主要来源：cLPM 单独已经接近完整系统，cache hit 与 full stack 相差约 3 个百分点；queue-aware eviction 在 SGLang 上进一步降低 0–3% TTFT/E2E，在 vLLM 上影响较小；dynamic lane 主要用于减少 singleton deferral 带来的延迟。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Background and Motivation 中对 SGLang LPM、DFS_WEIGHT、vLLM FCFS/APC 的限制分析；然后看方法部分的 pending radix tree、dual-walk、cLPM admission 和 queue-aware eviction。实验部分优先看 W1/W2/W3 的 cache pressure 分析和 ablation，因为它们说明收益来自哪里。低重叠 workload 的结果也值得扫一眼，用来判断这种调度策略是否会牺牲尾部请求或 singleton 请求。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a serving inefficiency: current LLM engines reuse KV cache based mostly on the current cache state or arrival order, but they do not exploit prefix sharing among requests that are still waiting in the queue. This leaves a strong predictive signal unused and can cause cache thrashing in long-context, RAG, and bursty shared-prefix workloads.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining method paper, but it is relevant to large-scale model research infrastructure. Data generation, evaluation, agent rollouts, and RL sampling often run through high-throughput serving stacks with repeated long prefixes. The useful idea is to treat the waiting queue as a forecast of future KV demand, and to co-design scheduling and eviction around that forecast instead of optimizing them separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK maintains an incremental radix tree over the pending queue to expose prefix-sharing clusters. Inserts and removals cost O(D), while scheduling and eviction can read cluster-level signals cheaply. On SGLang, PEEK performs a dual walk over the pending radix tree and the engine’s radix cache to compute longest-prefix matches for waiting requests in O(CD), instead of O(ND), where C is the number of prefix-sharing clusters and N is the queue size. On vLLM’s flat block-hash cache, it still uses the queue tree for cluster signals even if cache probes are per request. The scheduler uses Cluster-LPM to admit cluster pioneers first so that sibling requests can reuse the freshly materialized prefix. The eviction hook protects blocks that are ancestors of large queued clusters and evicts zero-demand blocks first. To avoid starving singleton requests, PEEK adds an arrival-ordered fairness lane, stride interleaving, and a dynamic lane controller that increases the fairness share when singleton pressure or wait time grows.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers SGLang and vLLM across five workloads, from shared-prompt chat and long-prefix RAG to multi-GPU 70B settings, agentic conversation bursts, and singleton-heavy chat. The largest online setup uses 4 H100 GPUs with DP=2 over TP=2. On prefix-rich workloads, PEEK improves cache hit rate by up to 3.0× on SGLang and 2.6× on vLLM, TTFT by up to 7.9×/7.1×, end-to-end latency by up to 6.7×/5.5×, and throughput by up to 3.6×/4.5×. On workloads with little sharing or already coherent arrivals, it stays close to the strongest baselines, with E2E and throughput within about ±2% and TTFT within roughly ±5–7%. Ablations show that cluster-aware admission is the main lever: cLPM alone is within about 3 percentage points of the full cache-hit gain. Dynamic lanes recover latency lost to singleton deferral, while queue-aware eviction adds a smaller 0–3% TTFT/E2E improvement on SGLang and is mostly flat on vLLM.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Start with the motivation section comparing SGLang LPM, DFS_WEIGHT, and vLLM FCFS/APC, because it clarifies what signal existing engines miss. Then read the method sections on the pending radix tree, dual-walk matching, Cluster-LPM admission, and queue-aware eviction. In the experiments, prioritize the cache-pressure studies and ablations on W1/W2/W3; they show why the method works. Also check the low-sharing workloads to understand the fairness and no-regression behavior.

recommendation.zh: 队列感知KV缓存调度思路新颖，提升幅度扎实，做长上下文推理/Serving优化的人值得读方法和实验部分。
recommendation.en: The queue-aware KV cache scheduling idea is novel with solid performance gains, worth reading the method and experiment sections for practitioners working on long-context inference and serving.

paper.title: KVpop -- Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache growth is a major bottleneck in autoregressive decoding, as memory and bandwidth scale linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction methods often rely on static heuristics or proxy scores, which poorly track future token utility and cause brittle eviction as relevance shifts. To address this, we introduce KVpop, which learns a fixed-budget KV eviction policy by directly supervising the keep-or-drop decision. The scorer is trained against a novel future-attention target

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存压缩方法要么依赖启发式规则无法精准识别长期有用token，要么学习式策略在token插入时就做驱逐决策且监督信号未对齐未来实际效用，导致高压缩率下性能下降明显。
summary.importance: KV缓存驱逐策略的设计可与训练阶段的未来注意力监督信号深度结合，该思路不仅适用于推理优化，还可迁移到Transformer-SSM混合架构等需要动态选择序列记忆的场景；延迟决策到驱逐边界的设计，为平衡短期上下文证据与长期记忆保留提供了可落地的方案，且无需修改基础模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作为预训练LLM的稀疏注意力改造方案，每个KV头固定保留少量sink token、最近的保护窗口token，其余旧token竞争固定数量的长期缓存槽位；核心设计包括两点：一是用token离开保护窗口后收到的未来注意力质量作为监督信号，训练时通过转置注意力pass计算目标，无需实例化稠密注意力图，无推理开销；二是支持有状态打分器，将token的打分决策延迟到其即将离开保护窗口的驱逐边界，利用保护窗口内积累的近未来上下文提升判断准确性；训练时采用边界感知的pairwise logistic loss，仅关注决定缓存去留的边界处token排序，推理时每个头的KV缓存大小固定。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-4B上，75%和88%的KV压缩率下分别保留95%和94%的稠密注意力性能；在Qwen3-8B上，同压缩率下分别保留95%和99%的稠密注意力性能，表现优于启发式与现有学习式驱逐基线；学到的驱逐策略可迁移到分布外的代码生成与STEM推理基准，同时实现近乎恒定的内存占用与更快的长序列生成速度。
summary.reading_guide: 先看引言中现有KV驱逐方法的缺陷与Figure1的整体架构示意图，再泛读方法部分的未来注意力目标定义、边界感知损失设计与有状态打分器机制；实验部分重点关注不同压缩率下的性能保留率与跨域迁移结果，附录的实现细节可按需查阅，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache compression methods rely on either heuristic rules that fail to identify long-term useful tokens or learned policies that make eviction decisions at insertion time with supervision unaligned to future utility, leading to steep performance drops at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: The design of KV eviction policies can be tightly coupled with training-time supervision from future attention patterns, a principle that extends beyond inference optimization to memory selection mechanisms in hybrid architectures such as Transformer-SSM models. The delayed-decision framing provides a practical way to balance short-term context evidence and long-term memory retention without modifying the base model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: A sparse-attention retrofit for pretrained LLMs that enforces a fixed per-head KV budget: each head permanently retains a small set of sink tokens, a protected window of recent tokens, and a fixed-size top-k long-range cache for older tokens. Two core designs distinguish it from prior work: first, supervision uses the future attention mass a token receives after leaving the protected window, computed via a training-only transposed attention pass that avoids materializing dense attention maps, adding no inference overhead; second, stateful scorers delay retention scoring until the token reaches the eviction boundary, leveraging near-future context accumulated during the protected period. Training uses a boundary-aware pairwise logistic loss that only focuses on token ranking decisions that determine cache membership, keeping per-step compute overhead low.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-4B, it retains 95% and 94% of dense-attention performance at 75% and 88% KV compression ratios respectively. On Qwen3-8B, it retains 95% and 99% of dense performance under the same compression ratios, outperforming both heuristic and existing learned eviction baselines. The learned policy transfers to out-of-domain code generation and STEM reasoning benchmarks, with near-constant memory usage and faster long-sequence generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the limitations of prior KV eviction methods in the introduction and the overall pipeline diagram in Figure 1, then skim the method section for the future-attention target definition, boundary-aware loss design, and stateful scorer mechanism. Focus the experiment review on performance retention across compression ratios and out-of-domain transfer results; skip appendix implementation details unless reproducing the method. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读这篇主要不是学 serving，而是看它把“未来注意力”当监督信号这件事；若结果稳，说明很多 KV 启发式其实一直在错估 token utility。
recommendation.en: Read it less for serving tricks and more for the idea of supervising cache eviction with future attention; if the setup holds, many heuristic KV policies have been mismeasuring token utility.

paper.title: Sangam: Efficiently Serving Diffusion LLMs with the AR Stack
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked response and can commit multiple output positions per model invocation. Their bidirectional attention prevents exact autoregressive-style KV caching, since committing one position shifts the KV activations of all others. Approximate caching techniques such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache refresh KV activations repeatedly and reuse them across intervening decodes, inducing a repeated prefill/decode structure. This makes

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 diffusion LLM 在并发服务中的系统问题。dLLM 通过反复去噪一个 mask response 区域生成文本，可以一次提交多个位置，但双向注意力使 AR 模型中精确 KV cache 的假设失效。已有近似 KV cache 方法会形成反复 prefill/decode 的执行模式，而现有 AR serving 栈不能直接套用。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模研究的价值在于，它把 diffusion LM 的建模差异落到了服务约束上。dLLM 的训练目标和注意力模式不同，不只影响单请求生成速度，也改变 batching、KV cache、prefill/decode 切分和 GPU 调度。若 diffusion LM 要成为 AR LM 的实际替代方案，服务栈是否能支撑高并发和稳定延迟是关键约束。该工作有助于判断 diffusion LM 的系统可行性，而不是只看单样本解码步数。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析 cached dLLM 与 AR serving 的三个错配。第一，decode 粒度不同：AR decode 每次每请求贡献一个 query token，而 blockwise dLLM decode 会处理一个 response block，并且仍要 attend 到 prompt 和 response 上下文，因此 batch size 增大后 decode 代价增长更快。第二，prefill 不只发生在请求到达时；Fast-dLLM、dKV-Cache 等近似缓存方法会在 block boundary 或 cache refresh point 反复触发 prefill。第三，prefill/decode 的工作比例随请求状态、负载和采样策略变化，固定 GPU 分区容易产生空闲容量。Sangam 的方向是复用 AR serving 中的连续 batching、prefill/decode 管理和 KV 管理思想，但按 dLLM 的块级 decode、重复 prefill、双向注意力不可 chunked prefill 等特点重新组织调度。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文可确认的实验信息主要是定性系统测量：论文指出 dLLM decode iteration time 随并发 decode 数增长更快，少量并发 decode 就可能使 GPU compute 和 memory bandwidth 接近饱和；继续扩大 decode batch 对吞吐的帮助有限。工作还以 Fast-dLLM 和 dKV-Cache 这类近似缓存执行模式为背景，分析 repeated prefill/decode 对调度的影响。具体吞吐、延迟、GPU 数量和相对提升幅度需要看实验章节的 trace-based serving 结果与 baseline 对比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 和系统动机部分，重点看 cached dLLM 为什么不同于 AR serving：decode 是 block-sized，prefill 会周期性回流，双向注意力阻止 chunked prefill。之后看 scheduler 设计、prefill/decode 资源分配策略和 KV 管理部分。实验部分优先看吞吐-延迟曲线、不同并发负载下的 GPU 利用率、与 vLLM/AR-style serving 改造 baseline 的对比，以及 Fast-dLLM、dKV-Cache 两种缓存策略下是否稳定。预计阅读 40–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses efficient concurrent serving for diffusion language models. Masked diffusion LMs generate by repeatedly denoising a fixed response region and can commit multiple positions per model call. Because attention is bidirectional, exact AR-style KV caching is invalid: once a position is committed, the activations of other positions may change. Approximate caching methods create a repeated prefill/decode execution pattern, but the standard AR serving stack does not directly fit this pattern.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for pretraining and alternative language modeling research because it exposes the serving consequences of the diffusion LM objective and attention pattern. Diffusion LMs should not be evaluated only by single-request generation speed or number of denoising iterations. Their viability also depends on batching behavior, cache refresh cost, prefill/decode interference, and GPU placement under load. This is an important systems constraint for judging whether diffusion LMs can compete with AR models in practical deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper identifies three mismatches between cached dLLM execution and AR serving. First, decode cost has a different shape: an AR decode step adds one query token per request, while a blockwise dLLM decode processes a response block while attending over the prompt-response context. Decode time therefore grows much faster with batch size. Second, prefill is recurring and request-dependent. Methods such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache periodically refresh KV states at block boundaries or cache refresh points, so requests move back and forth between prefill and decode. Third, fixed prefill/decode disaggregation can strand capacity because the balance between phases changes with request progress, load, and sampling behavior. Sangam adapts AR serving ideas such as continuous batching, phase management, and KV-cache organization, but reorganizes them around block-sized dLLM decode, repeated refreshes, and the fact that bidirectional prefill cannot be chunked in the same way as causal AR prefill.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text gives the key qualitative measurement: dLLM decode iteration time rises quickly with the number of concurrent decodes, and only a small number of active decodes can saturate GPU compute and memory bandwidth. Larger decode batches therefore do not provide the same throughput benefit as in AR serving. The experimental setup is framed around cached dLLM methods such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache, where repeated prefill/decode phases dominate scheduling behavior. Exact throughput, latency, GPU-count, and relative-improvement numbers should be taken from the system evaluation section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and motivation first. The most important concepts are block-sized decode, recurring prefill, the impossibility of AR-style chunked prefill under bidirectional attention, and the instability of fixed prefill/decode partitioning. Then read the scheduler design, resource-allocation policy, and KV-management sections. In the evaluation, focus on throughput-latency curves, GPU utilization under different loads, comparisons against AR-style serving baselines, and whether the results hold for both Fast-dLLM-like and dKV-Cache-like execution. Expected reading time is 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散LM推理服务的首个系统化方案，调度设计有参考价值；做dLLM推理效率的研究者可重点看§3调度器设计。
recommendation.en: First systematic serving solution for diffusion LLMs; scheduler design is informative. Researchers working on dLLM inference efficiency should focus on §3 scheduler design.

paper.title: Online Linear Programming for Multi-Objective Routing in LLM Serving
paper.abstract: We study the online routing problem in large language model serving, where requests arrive sequentially and must be dispatched to parallel decode workers under tight batch-size and KV-cache constraints. Unlike widely used routing heuristics that are not tied to explicit service-level objectives (SLOs) and offer limited control over latency-throughput trade-offs, we introduce a multi-objective optimization framework that formulates routing as an online linear programming with interpretable decisi

summary.core_problem: LLM serving 中请求在线到达时，如何在 batch-size 与 KV-cache 约束下做路由，并显式控制多种 SLO（延迟/吞吐/收益）权衡。
summary.importance: 把常见“启发式路由”改写成可解释的在线优化目标（online LP + shadow price），对大规模推理系统的可控性与可调参性更强；对预训练本身不直接，但对“训练-推理闭环”的成本与吞吐约束有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 将路由建模为在线线性规划：每个请求有 SLO 加权收益，资源约束由 KV-cache、并行 decode worker、batch 约束表达；用 bid-price control（对偶变量/影子价格）决定接收与分配；为毫秒级决策实现 warm-start 的投影一阶更新，在线跟踪对偶价格以保证稳定运行时延。
summary.experiments: 在 Vidur simulator 集成路由器，对比“标准基线路由策略”（摘要未给出具体名称与数值）；在多个 SLO regime 下展示显著改进（摘要截断，缺少具体提升幅度、模型/trace 规模与统计显著性细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Online request routing for LLM serving under tight batch-size and KV-cache constraints, with explicit control over multiple SLOs (latency/throughput/utility).
summary_en.importance: Replaces ad-hoc routing heuristics with an interpretable online optimization objective (online LP + shadow prices). Not pretraining-facing, but relevant to the training–inference cost loop and controllable serving trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates routing as an online linear program with SLO-weighted rewards and resource constraints; uses bid-price control via dual shadow prices to admit/route requests; implements millisecond decisions with warm-started projected first-order dual updates to track evolving prices online.
summary_en.experiments: Integrated into the Vidur simulator; reports substantial gains over standard routing baselines across multiple SLO regimes (abstract is truncated; lacks concrete numbers, traces, and ablation details).

recommendation.zh: 把“路由拍脑袋”换成 shadow price 的可控框架，适合做 serving 侧成本建模；但只在模拟器里赢，先当工程思路备查。
recommendation.en: A clean shadow-price framing for controllable routing—useful for serving cost modeling, but simulator-only wins make it a weak signal until reproduced on real traces.

paper.title: Wan-Streamer v0.2: Higher Resolution, Same Latency
paper.abstract: We present Wan-Streamer v0.2, a latency-preserving upgrade of the native-streaming, end-to-end audio-visual interaction model. v0.2 keeps the v0.1 modeling formulation, but raises the interactive output stream from 192x336 to 640x368 while preserving approximately 200 ms model-side signal-to-signal latency at 25 FPS. The higher-resolution stream supports scene-grounded mid-shot agents whose posture, gaze, hands, nearby objects, and local scene layout remain legible during real-time conversation.

summary.core_problem: 在原生流式音视频交互模型中，把输出分辨率显著提高，同时维持约 200ms 的端到端模型侧延迟。
summary.importance: 这类工作对统一语音/视频/语言生成系统的工程实现有参考价值，尤其是低延迟多 GPU 并行、KV 写入和上下文切分策略。但它更偏实时生成系统优化，而不是基座预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: Wan-Streamer v0.2 延续 v0.1 的建模形式，但把系统拆成低延迟单 GPU thinker 路径和多 GPU context-parallel 的 performer 路径。thinker 负责流式感知、短语言/状态 Transformer 和 generation cache 构建；performer 负责高成本的下一单元 latent video 生成。为控制延迟，作者采用 Ulysses 风格上下文并行、预分片本地 KV cache 写入，以及对长高分辨率 latent video 序列做跨 rank 切分。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：在 25 FPS 下，把交互视频流从 192×336 提升到 640×368，同时保持约 200ms 模型侧 signal-to-signal latency。实验重点显然是系统吞吐与交互质量，而非预训练规模、数据配比或统一建模目标函数。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Jingren Zhou，团队风格接近工业界大规模生成系统与基础设施方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper increases output resolution in a native streaming audio-visual interaction model while preserving roughly 200ms model-side latency.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant as an engineering reference for unified speech/video/language generation systems, especially around low-latency multi-GPU parallelism, KV handling, and context partitioning. But it is more of a real-time generation systems paper than a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Wan-Streamer v0.2 keeps the v0.1 modeling formulation but splits the system into a low-latency single-GPU thinker path and a multi-GPU context-parallel performer path. The thinker handles streaming perception, a short language/state Transformer pass, and generation-cache construction; the performer handles expensive next-unit latent video generation. To preserve latency, it uses Ulysses-style context parallelism, pre-sharded local KV-cache writes, and cross-rank partitioning of long high-resolution latent video sequences.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is raising the interactive stream from 192×336 to 640×368 at 25 FPS while keeping about 200ms model-side signal-to-signal latency. The evaluation is clearly centered on system latency and interactive quality rather than pretraining scale, data mixture, or modeling objectives.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jingren Zhou, and the work has the flavor of an industrial large-scale generative systems/infrastructure team.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做原生流式多模态系统，看看它的 thinker/performer 拆分和 KV 分片；否则正文不用细读，这更像 serving 设计而不是 pretrain 方法。
recommendation.en: Read it only if you care about native streaming multimodal systems—the thinker/performer split and KV sharding are the useful bits; otherwise this is serving design, not pretraining methodology.

paper.title: Reading Between the Dots: Decoding Hidden Computation across Filler Tokens
paper.abstract: Frontier LLMs can perform multi-step reasoning over content-free filler tokens like dots or counting sequences, producing correct answers with no visible chain-of-thought (CoT). This is a limit case for behavioral oversight, where surface tokens carry no information about the underlying reasoning. But hidden from the output is not the same as hidden from us. On four task families (fact retrieval, parallel numeric composition, string manipulation, and in-context computation), two open-weights fro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“模型会不会在 filler token 上思考”，而是更关键的两层问题：第一，这种看起来空白的输出区间里是否真的承载了任务相关计算；第二，这些隐藏计算能否被外部审计，而不是只能从行为上猜。作者把问题放在 CoT 可监督性的边界条件上来讨论：如果模型在一串点号、计数序列、字母序列上完成了中间推理，那么单靠读可见输出就失效了。论文的核心贡献，是把“隐藏于表面文本”与“不可被机制分析恢复”明确区分开，并用开放权重前沿模型证明，filler 区域里确实存在结构化、可定位、可解码、且对最终答案有因果作用的中间表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练和基座模型研究，这篇论文的重要性不在于提出新训练方法，而在于它直接触到一个越来越现实的问题：模型的有效计算未必沿着人类可读的 token 语义展开。只要模型学会把 residual stream 当作内部工作区，表面 token 可以几乎不携带可读信息，但内部状态仍然在推进推理。这个结论会影响三类研究。其一，CoT 监控和行为审计的可靠性边界，需要从“看输出”转向“看内部表征与路由”。其二，预训练目标和推理行为的关系：next-token 训练并不要求中间 token 对人类可解释，只要求它们对后续预测有用，因此 filler computation 不是异常现象，而可能是语言模型自然会利用的计算自由度。其三，机制分析方法的价值被抬高了：attention tracing、logit lens、activation transplant 这类工具，不只是解释性附属品，而是未来审计隐藏推理的必要手段。贡献量级上，这篇工作更像是一个扎实的机制证据包，而不是单点现象复现。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步，层层递进。第一步是行为层面确认 filler uplift。作者构造四类带明确中间变量的任务：1-fact addition、2-fact addition、2-hop letter position、以及完全在上下文内计算的线性方程系统。然后在问题和答案槽之间插入不同类型的内容空洞 token，如 dots、counting sequences、alphabet sequences，并比较有无 filler 时的正确率变化。这里设计得比较好的一点，是既覆盖“检索型中间量”，也覆盖“上下文内计算型中间量”，避免把现象误判为单纯 retrieval artifact。

第二步是定位机制。作者先看 attention，发现加入 filler 后，answer token 不再主要直接看 question，而是形成 question→filler→answer 的 relay 结构。这个观察本身还不够，因为 attention 不等于 computation。于是他们进一步用 logit lens 在每一层、每个 filler 位置上读 residual stream，检查哪些中间值在何时出现。结果显示，不同任务的中间变量会按时间和位置逐步浮现：例如 2-fact addition 中，A1 往往在 filler 前段较早层出现，A2 在后续位置出现，而 A1+A2 的和在靠近答案前的晚层才稳定“结晶”。这说明 filler 区域不是均匀缓存，而是有阶段性的计算轨迹。

第三步是做因果验证。作者采用 KV-cache transplant，只替换 filler token 对应的 KV 行，而不动问题和答案位置，观察答案分布是否随 donor example 改变。如果仅移植 filler 区域就能显著把答案 logits 推向 donor 的中间值或最终答案，那么 filler 中编码的内容就不是旁观信号，而是实际参与了生成。更细的一步是只移植那些 logit lens 已经能读出 addend 的位置，发现大部分效应都能保留；移植互补位置则几乎无效。这把“某些特定 filler 位置承载关键中间量”从相关性推进到了位置级因果性。

在无监督恢复部分，作者给出一个很实用的 pipeline：对所有 layer-position 做 logit lens，减去跨样本均值以抑制系统性伪影，再跨位置聚合 token 分数，把 top-50 候选交给 LLM judge 解释。这个流程不需要中间变量标签，也不训练 probe，重点是证明隐藏计算并不一定需要重监督才能恢复。与常见 probe 工作不同，这里更强调“可审计性”而不是“线性可分性”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类开放权重前沿模型：DeepSeek V3（总参数约 671B，每 token 激活约 37B）和 Kimi K2（总参数约 1T，每 token 激活约 32B）。行为结果上，filler token 在四类任务里都带来稳定提升。DeepSeek V3 上，1-fact addition 从 54% 提升到 72%；2-fact addition 从 21% 到 24%，其中 9% 样本发生 wrong→right 翻转；2-hop letter position 从 61% 到 70%；system of equations 从 31% 到 61%。Kimi K2 上，2-fact addition 从 27% 到 35%；2-hop letter position 从 69% 到 75%；system of equations 从 18% 到 36%。这些数字说明 uplift 在需要多步中间态的任务上更明显，尤其是方程系统这种上下文内计算任务，增幅很大。

filler 类型消融也很关键。dots、计数序列、字母序列效果接近，而 scrambled sequences 明显更差。这个结果说明模型需要的是一段“非破坏性、可持续推进状态”的 token 轨道，而不是某种特定语义内容。换句话说，filler 的作用更像给模型提供额外计算步数和稳定位置结构，而不是提供知识。

机制实验里，attention 图显示 answer 对 filler 的依赖显著增强；logit lens 则在不同层和位置读出任务中间量。论文最有说服力的部分是 KV transplant：仅替换 filler 区域，就能让 donor 答案的 rank 上升几十到几百名；对检索得到的事实值和上下文内算出的变量值都成立。再往下做位置选择移植，只移植“能解出 addend 的位置”就能恢复大部分效应，说明编码不是弥散在整段 filler 上，而是有局部功能分工。

无监督恢复实验中，作者报告 strongest LLM judge 在两种模型、四类任务上都能以 80%–95% 的准确率恢复中间值，包括数值型事实、字符串型实体名，以及方程系统里在上下文中算出的变量。这一点很重要，因为它表明即便没有人工标注中间步骤，也能从 hidden states 中相当稳定地挖出模型到底在算什么。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“现象—机制—因果—恢复”的顺序读。先看引言和行为实验，确认作者不是只展示一个有趣例子，而是在四类任务、两种大模型上建立了较稳定的 filler uplift。这里重点看各任务定义，以及不同 filler 类型的对比，因为这决定了后面的机制解释是否站得住。

第二步重点读 attention 和 logit lens 部分。不要只看图上亮不亮，而要看作者如何把中间变量的出现时间与任务结构对应起来。2-fact addition 和 system-of-equations 两节最值得精读：前者展示检索+组合，后者展示纯上下文内计算，二者一起说明 filler 不是单一 retrieval cache。

第三步一定要细看 KV-cache transplant。这是全文最关键的证据，因为它把“能读出来”推进到“对答案有因果作用”。需要关注三点：移植的是哪些 KV 行；donor/recipient 如何匹配；以及只移植关键位置与移植补集位置时效应差多少。这里能看出作者对 activation patching 类方法的使用是否严谨。

最后看无监督恢复 pipeline。重点不是 judge 模型本身，而是前面的去均值、跨位置聚合、top-k 候选构造，这些步骤决定了方法是否能从 noisy hidden states 中提取稳定信号。如果做后续研究，可以沿两条线深挖：一是把这种恢复流程扩展到更自由的 reasoning setting，而不是人工构造任务；二是研究 filler computation 与训练目标、解码策略、RL 后训练之间的关系。全文里最值得反复对照的是行为提升曲线、layer-position 解码热图，以及 transplant 的 rank-shift 结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether models can “think over filler tokens.” It asks whether the apparently empty region between a question and an answer actually carries task-relevant computation, and whether that computation can be audited mechanistically rather than inferred from behavior alone. The setup targets a hard limit of chain-of-thought oversight: if a model reasons through dots or counting tokens, there is no readable CoT to inspect. The central claim is that hidden-from-output does not mean hidden-from-analysis. In open-weight frontier models, filler positions contain structured intermediate states that can be localized, decoded, and shown to causally affect the final answer.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and foundation-model research, the value of this work is not a new training recipe but a concrete demonstration of a broader property of next-token models: useful internal computation does not need to align with human-readable token semantics. Once the residual stream is used as a workspace, surface tokens can be semantically empty while still supporting multi-step reasoning. That matters in at least three ways. First, it sets a real boundary on CoT-based monitoring and behavioral oversight. Second, it clarifies what autoregressive training permits: the objective only rewards states that help future prediction, not states that remain legible to humans. Third, it raises the importance of mechanistic tools such as attention tracing, logit-lens readout, and activation/KV transplantation as auditing instruments rather than optional interpretability add-ons. The contribution is best understood as a strong mechanistic evidence package around a phenomenon that has mostly been discussed behaviorally.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method proceeds in three stages. The first stage establishes the behavioral phenomenon. The authors build four task families with explicit intermediate values: 1-fact addition, 2-fact addition, 2-hop letter-position queries, and a system-of-equations task where the relevant values are computed entirely in context. They insert content-free fillers between the question and the answer slot, using dots, counting sequences, and alphabet sequences. This task design is important because it spans both retrieved intermediates and in-context computed intermediates, reducing the chance that the effect is just a retrieval artifact.

The second stage localizes the mechanism. Attention analysis shows that when filler is present, the answer token no longer relies mainly on a direct question-to-answer path. Instead, the model forms a relay structure: question to filler to answer. Since attention alone is not computation, the paper then applies the logit lens at every layer and filler position to inspect what is present in the residual stream. The resulting picture is temporally and spatially structured. In 2-fact addition, one addend tends to appear early in the filler region, the second later, and the sum stabilizes only in late layers near the answer. This suggests that the filler region is not a passive buffer but a staged computational trajectory.

The third stage tests causality with KV-cache transplantation. The authors replace only the KV rows corresponding to filler tokens, leaving the question and answer positions untouched, and measure whether the answer distribution shifts toward the donor example. If swapping only the filler region changes the answer, the filler content is not merely correlated with the computation; it participates in it. They further restrict transplantation to positions where the logit lens already decodes an addend and find that most of the effect is preserved, while the complementary positions carry little effect. This gives position-level causal evidence that specific filler locations encode specific intermediate values.

The unsupervised recovery pipeline is also notable. It applies the logit lens over all layer-position pairs, subtracts the cross-example mean to remove shared artifacts, aggregates scores across positions, and sends the top-50 candidate tokens to an LLM judge for interpretation. No intermediate labels and no trained probe are required. Compared with standard probing work, the emphasis here is less on linear separability and more on practical auditability of hidden computation.
summary_en.experiments:
The study uses two open-weight frontier models: DeepSeek V3 (about 671B total parameters, roughly 37B activated per token) and Kimi K2 (about 1T total parameters, roughly 32B activated per token). Behaviorally, filler tokens improve accuracy across all four task families. On DeepSeek V3, 1-fact addition rises from 54% to 72%; 2-fact addition from 21% to 24%, with 9% of examples flipping from wrong to right; 2-hop letter position from 61% to 70%; and the system-of-equations task from 31% to 61%. On Kimi K2, 2-fact addition rises from 27% to 35%; 2-hop letter position from 69% to 75%; and the equations task from 18% to 36%. The largest gains appear on tasks that clearly benefit from extra intermediate computation, especially the in-context equations setting.

The filler-type ablation is informative. Dots, counting sequences, and alphabet sequences produce similar gains, while scrambled sequences underperform. This suggests that the model benefits from a non-disruptive token scaffold with stable positional structure, not from any particular semantic content. In other words, the filler acts more like extra computational runway than extra knowledge.

The mechanistic evidence is strongest in the KV-transplant experiments. Attention maps show increased reliance on filler positions, and logit-lens readouts reveal intermediate values across layers and positions. But the key result is that transplanting only the filler KV rows can move the donor answer upward by tens to hundreds of ranks, for both retrieved facts and values computed in context. When transplantation is restricted to positions that decode an addend, most of the effect remains; the complementary positions contribute little. This argues for localized functional structure rather than diffuse storage across the whole filler span.

In the unsupervised recovery experiments, the strongest LLM judge recovers intermediate values with 80% to 95% accuracy across both models and all four task families. The recovered content includes numeric facts, string-valued entities such as city or element names, and variables computed inside the prompt in the equations task. That result matters because it shows that hidden reasoning traces can be extracted without supervised labels for the intermediate steps.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, mechanism, causality, and recovery. Start with the introduction and behavioral section to verify that this is not a single anecdote but a repeated effect across four task families and two large models. Pay attention to the task construction and the filler-type comparisons, because they determine whether the later mechanistic claims are well supported.

Next, focus on the attention and logit-lens sections. Do not stop at the visual patterns. Track how the emergence of decoded intermediates aligns with the structure of each task. The 2-fact addition and system-of-equations analyses are the most useful pair: one shows retrieval plus composition, the other shows purely in-context computation.

Then read the KV-cache transplantation section carefully. This is the core evidence in the paper because it upgrades decodability into causal relevance. The important details are which KV rows are swapped, how donor and recipient examples are matched, and how much effect remains when only the “decoded” positions are transplanted versus their complement. That section reveals whether the activation-patching logic is used rigorously.

Finish with the unsupervised recovery pipeline. The main point is not the judge model but the preprocessing steps: mean subtraction, aggregation across positions, and candidate construction. Those choices determine whether stable signals can be extracted from noisy hidden states. Two follow-up directions are especially natural: extending the recovery method to less synthetic reasoning settings, and studying how filler computation interacts with training objective, decoding policy, and post-training. The figures worth revisiting are the behavioral uplift plots, the layer-position decoding heatmaps, and the transplant rank-shift results.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对“无 CoT 就无可审计计算”的 prior；建议复现 KV transplant 和隐状态解码。
recommendation.en: This weakens the prior that no visible CoT means no auditable computation; reproduce the KV transplants and hidden-state decoder.

paper.title: Lynx: Progressive Speculative Quantization for accelerating KV Transfer in Long-Context Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly common in large language model (LLM) serving, driven by retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems. In disaggregated inference, these workloads require transferring large Key-Value (KV) caches across the network, where decoding cannot begin until the transfer completes. Recent KV quantization techniques reduce data volume and alleviate this bottleneck, but existing schemes fail to achieve both low network-exposed latency and high inference accuracy.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文、分离式推理里的一个具体瓶颈：Prefill 端生成的 KV cache 需要跨网络传给 Decode 端，而 Decode 往往必须等整份 KV 到齐后才能开始。上下文一长，KV 体积线性增长，网络传输就会直接暴露在首 token 延迟里。已有 KV 量化方法虽然能缩小传输量，但通常在两点之间做艰难取舍：要么压得狠、延迟低，但注意力误差变大，生成质量掉得明显；要么保守量化，精度较稳，但 TTFT 改善有限。Lynx 试图打破的不是单纯“如何把 KV 压得更小”，而是“KV 是否必须作为一个不可分割的整体被完整接收后才能使用”这个系统假设。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型系统设计有直接启发，尤其是长上下文 serving、PD-disaggregation、远程 KV 检索这类越来越常见的部署形态。它的重要性在于把 KV 量化从“静态压缩问题”改成了“分层信息传输 + 可验证近似推理”的联合问题：先传最关键的高位信息，让模型尽早开始 decode，再在后台补齐低位残差，并用 speculative verification 保证最终采样分布与全精度一致。这种思路对后续很多系统问题都有参考价值，比如分阶段状态传输、分辨率渐进式上下文恢复、以及把近似计算包进可校验框架里。对做训练的人，启发主要在于：模型内部状态并不是所有 bit 同等重要，系统层可以利用这种不均匀性，而不必把张量视作刚性对象。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 Hierarchical Split-Stream Quantization。作者把 KV 不是压成单一路径的低比特表示，而是显式拆成 Anchor 和 Residual 两条流。Anchor 保留高价值、粗粒度的信息，用来尽快恢复一个可用但不完全精确的 KV；Residual 再补充细节，逐步逼近原始状态。这里的关键不是简单高低位切分，而是结合非线性对数量化和 outlier-aware chunking，尽量在固定 bit budget 下保住 attention 输出分布。对数量化适合处理 KV 中动态范围不均的问题；outlier-aware chunking 则避免少数极端值把整块量化尺度拉坏。

第二部分是 Split-Stream Pipelining Architecture。系统层面，Lynx 让网络优先发送 Anchor 流，Decode 端在只拿到部分 KV 状态时就启动计算，而 Residual 在后台继续传输和反序列化。这里需要自定义的序列化/反序列化协议和 non-blocking runtime，避免传统“收齐—解压—装载—再算”的串行路径。论文强调的不只是网络传输时间，还包括 deserialize 和把 KV 装入 paged device memory 的开销，因此它把通信和运行时一起做了设计。

第三部分是 Speculative Decoding Verification。因为基于 Anchor 的早期 decode 仍然是近似的，作者借用 speculative decoding 的验证机制：先用部分信息生成候选 token，再用完整或更精确状态验证。如果候选通过验证，最终输出分布与未量化全精度模型一致；如果不通过，则回退。这个设计很关键，因为它把“快但近似”的系统优化包进了一个有形式保证的采样框架里，避免只追求平均精度而牺牲分布一致性。

和已有 KV quantization 方法相比，Lynx 的区别主要有三点。第一，已有方法多把 KV 当成一次性压缩、一次性恢复的对象，Lynx 则把它视作可渐进恢复的状态。第二，已有方法通常只优化压缩率和重建误差，Lynx 直接优化网络暴露延迟。第三，已有方法的精度退化往往是不可逆的，而 Lynx 通过 verification 把最终生成质量拉回到与全精度一致的目标上。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的代表性结果是：在长上下文、带宽受限的分离式推理场景下，Lynx 达到接近 INT4 级别的 KV 传输延迟，同时保持接近 INT8 或 BF16 的推理精度。相对 INT8 baseline，TTFT 最多降低 30.5%，Time-to-32nd-Token 最多降低 10.7%；相对 CacheGen，推理准确率最多高 5.1%。这些收益在更长上下文和更低带宽下更明显，这和方法设计是对齐的，因为此时网络传输更容易成为主瓶颈。

文中还给了一个很直观的规模例子：Qwen3-235B-A22B 在 128k context 下，单请求可产生约 23.5 GB 的 BF16 KV 数据；在 100Gbps 网络上，仅传输就大约需要 2 秒。这说明问题不是边角优化，而是会直接决定分离式推理是否成立。Figure 2 的时间分解也说明，除了纯网络时间，deserialize 和 KV 装载本身也是不可忽略的延迟来源，因此只做压缩算法而不改 runtime，收益会被吃掉。

从实验解读上，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是三类对比：一是与 INT8/BF16 的精度-延迟折中，说明 Anchor/Residual 设计确实把“快”和“准”拆开了；二是与 CacheGen 这类已有 KV 压缩方法的对比，说明渐进式传输比单次压缩更适合 PD-disaggregation；三是不同上下文长度、不同带宽下的趋势，验证了它不是只在某个甜点配置上有效。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先看引言和 Figure 2，抓住问题定义——瓶颈不是算力，而是 KV 传输暴露在 decode 启动路径上。然后看方法部分里关于 Anchor/Residual 的定义、量化方式和 pipeline 设计，理解作者为什么不把 KV 当成一个整体。再看 speculative verification 的描述，确认它如何保证最终分布不偏。最后看实验里不同带宽、不同上下文长度的曲线和与 CacheGen、INT8 baseline 的对比。

如果时间有限，优先看三处：1）KV 体积和传输时间的量级估算；2）Split-Stream Quantization 的实现细节，尤其是对数量化和 outlier 处理；3）验证协议如何把近似 decode 变成可接受的系统优化。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要贡献；若要复现或迁移到自家 serving 栈，需要细读 runtime、SerDes 和验证流程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in long-context disaggregated inference: KV caches produced by the prefill worker must be transferred over the network to the decode worker, and decoding typically cannot start until the full KV state arrives. Since KV size grows linearly with context length, network transfer becomes directly exposed in TTFT. Existing KV quantization methods reduce payload size, but they usually trade latency against generation quality: aggressive compression lowers transfer time but hurts attention fidelity, while conservative quantization preserves accuracy but leaves much of the latency untouched. Lynx questions a deeper systems assumption: the KV cache does not have to be treated as an indivisible object that must be fully received before it becomes usable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model systems, especially for long-context serving, prefill-decode disaggregation, and remote KV retrieval. Its main contribution is to reframe KV quantization from a static compression problem into a joint problem of hierarchical information transfer and verifiable approximate decoding. The system sends the most important bits first, starts decoding early from a coarse KV state, and fills in the residual information in the background, while speculative verification preserves equivalence to full-precision sampling. That design pattern is useful beyond this specific setting: staged state transfer, progressive context reconstruction, and wrapping approximate computation inside a correctness-preserving verification loop are all broadly applicable ideas. For researchers closer to training, the useful takeaway is that internal model states are not uniformly important at the bit level, and systems can exploit that non-uniformity instead of treating tensors as rigid blobs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, Hierarchical Split-Stream Quantization. Instead of producing a single low-bit representation of the KV cache, Lynx explicitly decomposes KV into two streams: Anchors and Residuals. Anchors carry the coarse but high-value information needed to reconstruct a usable KV state quickly; Residuals refine that state toward the original representation. This is not just a naive MSB/LSB split. The paper combines non-linear logarithmic quantization with outlier-aware chunking to minimize reconstruction error under a constrained bit budget while preserving the downstream attention-output distribution. Logarithmic quantization helps with the uneven dynamic range of KV values, and outlier-aware chunking prevents a few extreme values from corrupting the scale of an entire chunk.

Second, Split-Stream Pipelining Architecture. At the systems level, Lynx prioritizes Anchor transmission so the decode worker can begin computation from a partial KV state, while Residuals continue to transfer and deserialize in the background. This requires a custom serialization/deserialization protocol and a non-blocking serving runtime, because the conventional path of receive-then-decompress-then-load-then-compute would erase much of the benefit. The paper explicitly accounts not only for network time but also for deserialization overhead and loading serialized KV into paged device memory.

Third, Speculative Decoding Verification. Since early decoding from Anchors is approximate, Lynx uses a verification protocol inspired by speculative decoding: candidate tokens are generated from the partial state and then checked against a more accurate or complete state. If accepted, the resulting token distribution matches that of the unquantized full-precision model; otherwise the system falls back. This is the key mechanism that turns a fast-but-approximate systems trick into one with formal distributional guarantees.

Relative to prior KV quantization work, Lynx differs in three ways. It treats KV as progressively recoverable state rather than a one-shot compressed object. It optimizes network-exposed latency rather than only compression ratio or reconstruction error. And instead of accepting irreversible quality loss, it uses verification to recover equivalence to the full-precision model at the sampling level.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is that under long-context, bandwidth-constrained disaggregated inference, Lynx achieves roughly INT4-level KV transfer latency while maintaining inference accuracy close to INT8 or BF16. Compared with an INT8 baseline, it reduces TTFT by up to 30.5% and Time-to-32nd-Token by up to 10.7%. Compared with CacheGen, it improves inference accuracy by up to 5.1%. The gains become larger at longer context lengths and lower available bandwidth, which is exactly where KV transfer dominates the critical path.

The paper also gives a useful scale example: for Qwen3-235B-A22B at 128K context, a single request can produce about 23.5 GB of BF16 KV data. On a 100 Gbps interconnect, transfer alone takes roughly 2 seconds. That makes the problem operationally significant rather than marginal. Figure 2 is also important because it shows that deserialization and loading serialized KV into paged device memory are non-trivial contributors to latency, so compression alone is not enough without runtime co-design.

The most informative experimental comparisons are not just the final benchmark numbers, but three trends: the latency-accuracy tradeoff against INT8/BF16 baselines, showing that Anchor/Residual separation decouples early usability from final fidelity; the comparison against prior KV compression methods such as CacheGen, showing that progressive transfer is better aligned with PD-disaggregation; and the scaling behavior across context lengths and bandwidth regimes, showing that the method is not confined to a narrow sweet spot.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the problem framing: the bottleneck is not compute, but KV transfer sitting directly on the decode start path. Then read the method sections defining Anchors and Residuals, the quantization design, and the split-stream pipeline. After that, inspect the speculative verification section carefully, because that is where the paper justifies distributional equivalence rather than just approximate quality preservation. Finally, look at the experiments across bandwidths and context lengths, especially the comparisons with CacheGen and the INT8 baseline.

If time is limited, focus on three parts: (1) the order-of-magnitude estimates for KV size and transfer time, (2) the implementation details of split-stream quantization, especially logarithmic quantization and outlier handling, and (3) the verification protocol that makes approximate early decoding acceptable. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. A deeper read is only needed if you want to reproduce the runtime, integrate it into a serving stack, or reason about the exact correctness guarantees.

recommendation.zh: 渐进式 KV 传输的思路对长上下文 serving 系统设计有启发，重点看 §3 的比特位重要性分析和系统架构部分。
recommendation.en: The progressive KV transfer idea is insightful for long-context serving design; focus on §3 for bit-level importance analysis and system architecture.

paper.title: Kara: Efficient Reasoning LLM Serving via Sliding-Window KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models often generate long chain-of-thought (CoT), which accumulates a massive KV cache during the decoding phase and incurs high decoding latency and limited throughput. To address these issues, KV cache compression has emerged as a promising technique for reducing memory overhead by selectively removing unimportant KV pairs while preserving useful ones for subsequent decoding. Nevertheless, we identify two key limitations in existing KV cache compression methods: 1) their th

summary.core_problem: Kara 解决的是 reasoning LLM 在长 CoT 解码时 KV cache 快速膨胀的问题，重点不是压缩率本身，而是现有阈值触发式 KV 压缩在高并发 serving 下会带来吞吐反转和重复压缩造成的信息损失。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 serving，但对预训练研究有间接价值。长推理模型把大量计算转移到解码阶段，KV cache 管理会反过来影响可训练目标和推理长度的设计边界。Kara 的启发点在于：压缩策略不能只看单序列精度，还要看连续 batching、PagedAttention、压缩触发频率和历史 token 被反复压缩后的累积误差。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两层。第一层是 Kara 的滑动窗口压缩：只对最近生成的一段上下文做压缩，而不是每次对整个历史 cache 重做筛选。这样可以避免早期 token 在多轮压缩中被持续淘汰。重要性评分使用 accumulated bidirectional attention，即一个 KV pair 在窗口内累计收到的双向注意力，作为它对后续解码是否有用的信号。第二层是 Token2Chunk：先找出离散的候选 KV token，再把相邻候选索引视为 chunk 端点，根据宽度和端点分数筛选 chunk，最终同时保留离散 token 与可变长度连续片段。这个设计介于 token-level selection 和 fixed chunk selection 之间，避免只保留孤立 token 丢失局部语义，也避免固定边界 chunk 过于僵硬。系统层面，作者在 nano-vLLM 上实现 KvLLM，并适配 PagedAttention；压缩策略改为固定步长周期性压缩 trailing blocks，降低阈值触发带来的频繁压缩开销。
summary.experiments: 论文用 Qwen3-14B 的 128K FP16 KV cache 约 20GB 作为动机，说明长上下文推理的显存压力。作者先用 vLLM/nano-vLLM、SnapKV、distilled Llama-8B 和 MATH-500 做诊断实验，展示阈值触发压缩在并发序列数增加时可能反而降低 output throughput，并且早期 token 的 KV pairs 会在重复压缩后几乎被清空。主实验声称 Kara/KvLLM 能在降低 KV cache 显存的同时改善吞吐，并保持 reasoning 性能，但给出的内容片段没有完整数字，阅读时需要重点核对压缩率、吞吐提升、延迟、不同 batch size 下的曲线，以及 MATH/GSM/代码类任务上的精度损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 threshold-triggered compression 的两个失败模式；再看方法部分的 sliding-window compression、accumulated bidirectional attention 和 Token2Chunk；最后看系统实验，尤其是 throughput-concurrency 曲线、memory-throughput trade-off、与 SnapKV/ChunkKV 等方法的对比。值得留意的是压缩开销是否被准确计入，以及在更长输出、更大 batch、更大模型上是否仍然稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Kara targets KV-cache growth during long chain-of-thought decoding. The main issue is not only memory reduction, but the fact that threshold-triggered KV compression can hurt throughput under high-concurrency serving and can repeatedly erase early-context information.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-serving paper, but it has useful implications for foundation-model research. Reasoning models increasingly move cost into the decoding phase, so cache management becomes part of the practical design envelope for long reasoning. The useful lesson is that KV compression should be evaluated jointly with continuous batching, PagedAttention, trigger frequency, and cumulative information loss, not just single-request accuracy at a fixed compression ratio.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. Kara applies compression only to a recent sliding window rather than recompressing the entire history. This prevents early tokens from being repeatedly pruned. It scores KV pairs using accumulated bidirectional attention, treating the total attention received by a KV pair as a proxy for usefulness. It then introduces Token2Chunk: discrete high-scoring candidate tokens are first selected, adjacent candidate indices are treated as potential chunk endpoints, and chunks are filtered by width and endpoint scores. The final cache keeps both isolated KV pairs and variable-length contiguous chunks. At the system level, the authors build KvLLM on nano-vLLM and adapt the method to PagedAttention. Instead of threshold-triggered grow-and-compress behavior, KvLLM periodically compresses trailing blocks every fixed number of decoding steps.
summary_en.experiments: The paper motivates the problem with a concrete example: a 128K-token FP16 KV cache for Qwen3-14B takes roughly 20GB. A diagnostic experiment with nano-vLLM, SnapKV, distilled Llama-8B, and MATH-500 shows that threshold-triggered compression can reduce output throughput as concurrency increases, and repeated compression can almost eliminate KV pairs for early tokens. The main experiments report lower KV memory usage and improved serving throughput with limited reasoning-quality loss, but the provided text does not include the full numerical table. The key numbers to verify are compression ratio, output throughput, latency, batch-size scaling, and accuracy degradation on math, reasoning, and coding workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the failure analysis of threshold-triggered compression, then read the sliding-window scoring rule and Token2Chunk module. For experiments, prioritize throughput-versus-concurrency curves, memory-throughput trade-offs, and comparisons against SnapKV or chunk-based baselines. Check whether compression overhead is included and whether the gains hold for longer generations, larger batches, and larger models.

recommendation.zh: 只看压缩调度和质量-吞吐曲线；若它真避免整块遗忘，长 CoT serving 可以复现。
recommendation.en: Skim the compression policy and quality-throughput curves; if block-level forgetting is really avoided, it is worth reproducing for long-CoT serving.

paper.title: The risk of KV cache compression
paper.abstract: Transformer inference on long sequences is expensive because softmax attention repeatedly reads from a large KV cache. The prevalent approach to this bottleneck is KV cache compression, which replaces the full cache with a compact summary. Despite its practical importance, the design of such summaries is largely driven by empirical experimentation. On the theoretical side, existing results show that KV cache compression can be impossible in the worst case, but offer little systematic guidance fo

summary.core_problem: KV cache compression常用启发式规则决定保留哪些 token，例如近因性、累计 attention mass 或 attention sink，但缺少一个回答“什么时候能安全压缩、压缩到多小会不可避免地产生误差”的理论框架。该工作研究固定压缩预算下，压缩后的 KV cache 在未来 query 上保留 softmax attention 输出的最小可达风险。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏理论和推理效率，但对长上下文预训练研究也有启发。它把 KV cache 看成模型对过去上下文的可查询记忆，而不是一串可按局部分数删除的 token。结论提示：压缩是否安全取决于未来 query 如何探测这段 cache；如果很多历史 token 对未来 query 是可区分、可单独检索的，小摘要必然丢信息；如果 query 分布只能看到低复杂度结构，则可以大幅压缩。这有助于设计长上下文模型和推理系统时区分“上下文长度”与“可用记忆容量”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，单个 attention head 的 KV cache 被形式化为 key-value 空间上的概率测度 P。softmax attention 被改写为带 Gaussian kernel 的积分形式，value 输出只依赖于 P 在未来 query 下诱导的加权响应。KV 压缩因此变成稀疏测度近似：用一个更少原子的测度 Q 替代完整 cache，并度量两者在未来 query 分布上的 attention 输出误差。该工作给出 minimax risk 的上下界，用一个数据相关的 intrinsic complexity 描述 cache 在未来 query 下的可压缩性。它还区分了能访问未来 query 分布和不能访问未来 query 分布的算法，证明两者存在风险差距。算法设计原则不是简单 token eviction，而是保留未来 query 实际能区分的 kernel-weighted value 结构。
summary.experiments: 实验部分主要用于验证理论设计原则，而不是追求大规模系统指标。作者在 LongBench 上做 targeted evaluation，将理论原则实例化为一个 KV compression 算法，并和常见压缩启发式进行比较。结果显示，在长上下文任务和压缩预算受限时，该方法能保持较好的任务表现，说明基于 query-cache 交互结构的压缩比单纯按近因性或历史 attention mass 更稳。材料中未给出完整表格数字，因此不宜过度解读绝对性能。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 分钟。先看 Problem setup，理解为什么 softmax attention 可以写成 context measure 上的 kernel attention；再看 minimax risk 的定义和上下界陈述，重点是 intrinsic complexity 如何刻画“未来 query 能分辨多少历史信息”。算法部分主要看它如何在 causal prefill 和 autoregressive decoding 中近似这些理论条件。实验只需看 LongBench 设置、压缩预算和失败案例，因为理论假设与真实 Transformer 多层多头之间的差距是判断实用性的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache compression is widely used for long-context inference, but most methods rely on heuristics such as recency, accumulated attention mass, or attention sinks. The paper asks a more basic question: for a fixed compression budget, what is the unavoidable error when replacing a full KV cache with a compact summary that must preserve future softmax attention outputs?
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly about inference efficiency, but it is relevant to long-context model research because it treats the KV cache as a queryable memory rather than a sequence of tokens with fixed salience. The key implication is that compressibility is not an intrinsic property of a token. It depends on how future queries interact with the cache. If many past items are separately retrievable, small summaries must lose information. If future queries only probe a low-complexity structure, substantial compression is possible. This distinction matters for both serving systems and the design of long-context training regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes the KV cache of a single attention head as a probability measure over key-value pairs. Softmax attention is rewritten as a kernel attention map, using a Gaussian-kernel representation after absorbing key-norm factors into the measure. Compression then becomes sparse approximation of this measure: replace the full context measure P with an m-atomic summary Q and measure the discrepancy in attention outputs under a future-query distribution. The main theoretical contribution is a characterization of minimax risk through an intrinsic complexity measure that captures how richly future queries can probe the cache. The results also show a separation between algorithms that know the future-query distribution and those that do not. The resulting design principle is to preserve the query-visible kernel-weighted value structure, not just to evict tokens by local importance scores.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section instantiates the theory into a concrete KV compression algorithm and evaluates it on LongBench with targeted long-context experiments. The reported behavior is consistent with the theory: compression works better when the retained summary matches the future query-cache interaction, and simple eviction heuristics are less reliable under tight budgets. The experiments should be read as evidence that the theoretical criteria are operational, rather than as a complete systems benchmark. The provided material does not include enough table-level numbers to make precise claims about absolute margins.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the problem setup to understand the measure-theoretic view of attention. Then read the minimax-risk definitions and the upper/lower-bound statements; the important object is the intrinsic complexity measure, not the proof details. The algorithm section is useful for seeing how the theory maps to causal prefill and autoregressive decoding. For the experiments, focus on LongBench settings, compression budgets, and cases where the method fails or degrades, since these reveal the gap between the single-head theory and real multi-layer Transformers.

recommendation.zh: 从最小最大风险角度给出KV压缩的理论边界和设计原则，做长上下文推理优化的话看风险刻画章节即可。
recommendation.en: Minimax risk characterization of KV compression provides theoretical bounds and design principles; read the risk analysis section if working on long-context inference optimization.

paper.title: PARTREP: Learning What to Repeat for Decoder-only LLMs
paper.abstract: While decoder-only LLMs excel at a vast array of natural language tasks, it suffers from an asymmetric information flow induced by causal attention: later tokens are richer in contextual grounding than earlier ones. A simple and effective remedy is prompt repetition -- just appending a second copy of prompt before generation can redistribute grounding across positions and improve reasoning performance. However, full repetition of the original prompt doubles the KV cache footprint and quadruples

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 decoder-only LLM 的一个结构性问题：因果注意力导致信息流不对称，序列后部 token 比前部 token 拥有更充分的上下文 grounding，因此模型会出现 premise order sensitivity、选项顺序偏置、lost-in-the-middle 等现象。已有工作发现把 prompt 完整重复一遍能缓解这个问题，但代价很高：KV cache 翻倍，prefill attention 计算接近四倍。论文要解决的是，能不能只重复一小部分真正关键的 token，保留大部分收益，同时把额外内存和计算压下来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在对 AR 解码范式局限的一个很具体的修补：它把“prompt repetition 为什么有效”进一步落到 token 级信息选择上，并给出一个可部署的近似方案。对做架构和推理的人，这篇文章有两个启发。第一，很多所谓 reasoning 提升并不一定来自更强的推理机制，而可能来自更均匀的上下文可达性。第二，token 级 surprisal/NLL 可以作为 prompt 内部信息密度的代理信号，这个想法未必只适用于 repetition，也可能用于长上下文压缩、检索片段重排、甚至训练时的 token-level curriculum。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 PartRep，核心思想是 selective repetition。不是把整段 prompt 再复制一次，而是从原 prompt 中选出一个子序列 t_part，追加到末尾，让这些被选中的 token 在序列后部形成“回声”，从而给后续位置提供更好的可访问上下文。

作者先把问题形式化为一个受预算约束的 token selection 问题：在重复比例 τ 给定时，找一个 subsequence，使模型准确率最大。为什么限定输出必须是原 prompt 的子序列，而不是摘要或重写？作者给出的理由很务实：如果 selector 只是对每个 token 做二分类，就可以用很轻的 gate 实现；如果要生成摘要，就会引入新的生成模型和额外不稳定性，成本也未必低。

选择信号方面，论文提出用 token-wise NLL 作为信息重要性的代理。直觉是：高 NLL token 说明它难以由前文预测，信息没有被上下文冗余编码，因此把它在后部再放一次，边际收益更大。这个假设不是拍脑袋，文中在附录和实验里都试图说明，高 NLL token 的重复比低 NLL token 或随机 token 更有效。

但精确 NLL 需要先完整跑一遍模型，这会抵消效率收益。为此作者训练了一个轻量 gate，用目标模型早期层 hidden states 预测哪些 token 属于 top-τ 高 NLL。实现上是一个带 attention 的两层 MLP，挂在目标模型中间层表示上，在 mid-prefill 阶段就能做选择。随后把选中的 token 通过一段很短的自然语言桥接语拼接到原 prompt 后面，例如提示模型“注意这些关键 token”，然后只做一次最终前向生成。

从机制上看，PartRep 不是在改变模型参数，也不是在做 retrieval augmentation，而是在利用 AR 模型对后部 token 更敏感这一事实，主动把高信息密度 token 重新放到更有利的位置。它和 full repetition 的区别不只是压缩长度，而是默认 prompt 内部信息分布高度不均匀，真正值得“回声强化”的只是少数 token。
summary.experiments:
论文在 8 个 benchmark 上做实验，覆盖 GSM8K、RULER 等任务，并在 Qwen2.5、Llama3.2、Gemma4 等多个 decoder-only 模型家族上验证。主结论是：PartRep 基本保留了 full repetition 的准确率收益，有些设置下还能略好，同时只需要 59.4% 的 KV cache 预算和 79.0% 的 prefill FLOPs。这个结果说明，full repetition 的收益并不要求把整个 prompt 原样复制，关键是把少量高价值 token 放到序列尾部。

从论文给出的任务类型看，收益主要出现在需要较强上下文整合或长上下文定位的场景，这和方法假设一致。作者还比较了不同 token 选择策略，核心是验证 NLL 作为 importance signal 是否成立。虽然你给出的全文片段没有展开所有表格，但从方法叙述可以看出，论文至少对比了随机选择、可能的启发式选择，以及 oracle-like NLL 选择与 gate 预测选择之间的差距。这里最重要的不是绝对分数，而是两点：一，真实 NLL 排序确实比简单启发式更接近 full repetition；二，轻量 gate 对高 NLL token 的近似已经足够把大部分收益拿回来。

另一个值得注意的实验维度是效率。作者没有只报 accuracy，而是明确把 prefill FLOPs 和 KV cache footprint 作为约束目标来衡量，这使得 PartRep 更像一个可落地的 inference-time method，而不是单纯 prompt trick。对于长上下文场景，这一点比小幅精度差异更关键。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，弄清楚作者到底在修什么问题：不是一般的 prompt engineering，而是 causal attention 带来的位置不对称。然后看方法部分里两个关键点：为什么用 token-wise NLL 做选择信号，以及 gate 如何在不额外完整前向的情况下近似这个信号。

实验部分建议优先看三类表：一是 PartRep 对 full repetition 和原始 prompt 的精度对比；二是不同选择策略的消融；三是效率表，尤其 KV cache 和 prefill FLOPs。若时间有限，20 到 30 分钟足够。若想深一点，可以追问两个问题：高 NLL token 是否只是“稀有词/数字/实体”的替代指标；以及这种方法在 instruction-heavy prompt、代码 prompt、超长检索上下文里是否会出现选择偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural weakness of decoder-only LLMs: causal attention creates asymmetric information flow, so later tokens are better grounded than earlier ones. This asymmetry is linked to premise-order sensitivity, option-order bias, and lost-in-the-middle behavior. Full prompt repetition is known to help, because the second copy gives the model a late-position “echo” of the original context. But full repetition is expensive: it doubles KV cache and roughly quadruples prefill attention cost. The paper asks whether one can repeat only a small subset of critical tokens and retain most of the benefit.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but real. The paper turns prompt repetition from a heuristic into a token-selection problem and offers a deployable approximation. Two ideas are useful beyond this specific method. First, some apparent reasoning gains may come from better context accessibility rather than deeper reasoning ability. Second, token-level surprisal or NLL can serve as a practical proxy for information density inside a prompt. That idea could transfer to long-context compression, retrieval chunk prioritization, or even token-level curriculum design during training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, PartRep, performs selective repetition instead of duplicating the entire prompt. Given an input sequence t, it chooses a subsequence t_part and appends only that subsequence near the end of the prompt. The goal is to create late-position echoes for the most informative tokens while staying within a repetition budget τ.

The formulation is deliberately constrained: the selector must output a subsequence of the original prompt, not a summary or a rewritten version. This keeps the selector lightweight, since it only needs to make binary keep/drop decisions per token. A more general compressor would require generation in vocabulary space and would likely erase the efficiency advantage.

For token importance, the paper uses token-wise negative log-likelihood as the main signal. The intuition is simple: high-NLL tokens are hard to predict from the preceding context, so their information is not redundantly encoded elsewhere. Repeating them should therefore provide the largest marginal gain when placed later in the sequence. The paper argues, both conceptually and empirically, that repeating high-surprisal tokens is more useful than repeating low-surprisal or random tokens.

Exact NLL, however, would require a full forward pass, which defeats the purpose. To avoid that, the authors train a lightweight gate that predicts the top-τ high-NLL tokens from early-layer hidden states of the target model. The gate is implemented as a small two-layer MLP with attention on top of intermediate representations, enabling token selection during mid-prefill. The selected tokens are then appended through a short natural-language bridge, and the model performs a single final generation pass.

Mechanistically, PartRep does not change model parameters and is not a retrieval method. It exploits a known property of autoregressive transformers: tokens placed later in the sequence are more accessible under causal attention. The key claim is that prompt information is highly non-uniform, so only a small subset of tokens needs to be echoed.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates on 8 benchmarks, including GSM8K and RULER, and across several decoder-only model families such as Qwen2.5, Llama3.2, and Gemma4. The main result is that PartRep largely preserves the accuracy gains of full repetition, and in some settings slightly exceeds it, while using only 59.4% of the KV cache budget and 79.0% of the prefill FLOPs. This is the central empirical point: the benefit of repetition does not require duplicating the whole prompt.

The gains appear on tasks that require stronger context integration or long-context access, which is consistent with the method’s motivation. The paper also studies token-selection strategies to validate NLL as an importance signal. Even though the provided excerpt does not include all tables, the method description makes clear that the authors compare oracle-like NLL selection, learned gate selection, and weaker baselines such as random or heuristic choices. The important takeaway is not the exact score gap, but the pattern: true NLL ranking is a strong selector, and the lightweight gate is accurate enough to recover most of that benefit without paying the full cost.

Another strength is that the paper treats efficiency as a first-class metric. It reports not only task accuracy but also prefill FLOPs and KV cache footprint. That makes PartRep more than a prompt trick; it is an inference-time systems method targeted at long-context deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and problem formulation to understand the exact failure mode: the method is not generic prompt engineering, but a response to causal-attention asymmetry. Then read the method section with two questions in mind: why token-wise NLL is a sensible importance signal, and how the gate approximates that signal without requiring an extra full pass.

In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: accuracy versus the original prompt and full repetition, ablations over token-selection strategies, and the efficiency tables for KV cache and prefill FLOPs. Twenty to thirty minutes should be enough. If you want to think more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth asking: whether high-NLL tokens are simply a proxy for rare entities, numbers, and symbols; and whether the same selection rule remains stable for instruction-heavy prompts, code prompts, or very long retrieval contexts.

recommendation.zh: 只看 NLL 选 token 和缓存成本分析；它像廉价 context reordering，不改训练，但能暴露 causal attention 的位置偏置。
recommendation.en: Skim the NLL token selection and cache-cost analysis; it is cheap context reordering, not training, but it exposes a real positional bias in causal attention.

institutions: Pohang University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Cache Merging as a Convergent Replicated State for Multi-Agent Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent latent reasoning composes agents' KV-caches into one context for a final agent. Prior work (Agent Primitives) does this by concatenating caches along the sequence axis with RoPE re-encoding, which we call BagMerge. BagMerge is non-commutative, and the best input ordering is unpredictable, shifting with the regime, the latent-step budget, and the model scale. We make this exchange a convergent replicated state. First, CanonicalMerge fixes the layout by content: ordering caches by mean

summary.core_problem: 解决多智能体潜推理中现有KV缓存拼接方法（BagMerge）非交换、输入顺序影响合并结果且不可预测的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将多智能体缓存合并建模为收敛复制状态，实现了顺序无关的字节级一致缓存合并
summary.technical_approach: 提出CanonicalMerge策略，按Transformer中间层的K向量均值范数对各智能体的KV缓存排序，消除输入顺序影响；进一步将缓存抽象为内容寻址的潜片段集合（满足CvRDT的交换/结合/幂等/吸收性），CanonicalMerge为该集合的确定性渲染函数
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B模型上，算法验证N≤5时的排列不变性，实际推理中实现任意输入排列下的字节级相同合并缓存；未提及下游任务性能对比

summary_en.core_problem: Resolve the non-commutativity and unpredictable order sensitivity of existing BagMerge KV-cache concatenation in multi-agent latent reasoning
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first models multi-agent cache merging as a convergent replicated state, enabling order-invariant byte-identical cache merging
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CanonicalMerge, which sorts per-agent KV-caches by mean K-norm at a middle Transformer layer to eliminate order dependence; further abstracts cache state as a set of content-addressed latent fragments (a CvRDT with commutativity, associativity, idempotence, absorption), with CanonicalMerge as its deterministic render
summary_en.experiments: Verifies algorithmic permutation invariance for arity N≤5, and bit-for-bit identical merged caches under arbitrary input permutations on Qwen3-1.7B and 4B models; no downstream task performance comparisons reported

recommendation.zh: 关注KV-cache复用与顺序无关合并的可看排序策略设计，其余偏分布式系统理论，对预训练直接帮助有限，仅浏览核心方法即可
recommendation.en: Useful for researchers exploring KV-cache reuse and order-invariant merging; mostly distributed systems theory otherwise, skim only the core method section.

paper.title: InduceKV: Fixed-Footprint Continual Adaptation of Multimodal LLMs via Inducing KV Memories
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models must adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet continual improvement under bounded deployment footprint remains difficult because repeated parameter updates or growing replay stores can accumulate adaptation state over time. We study fixed-footprint continual adaptation: the deployed adaptation state is kept under a fixed memory budget, while the backbone model is left unchanged and task-specific updates are externalized. We propose InduceKV, a retrieval-based met

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在持续适配新任务与新领域时，现有方法难以同时满足「固定部署内存占用」的约束——参数更新类方法（如PEFT、专家路由）会不断增加模型状态、可能扰动预训练跨模态接口，回放类方法则受限于内存预算难以平衡历史能力保留与新任务学习。
summary.importance: 将多模态持续适配从「参数增量更新」问题重构为「预算约束下的外部记忆分配」问题，提供了完全冻结骨干网络、通过注意力原生KV记忆注入实现能力增量的技术路径，对需要严格控制部署后模型状态、避免扰动预训练基座的持续适配场景有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 冻结全部MLLM骨干参数，将任务增量知识编码为注意力兼容的外部KV记忆条目。每个条目包含两部分：一是固定表示空间中的单位范数检索键（由前缀最后一层隐状态池化得到），二是逐层KV载荷（通过固定平均池化矩阵将前缀KV压缩至统一长度m，保证所有记忆条目长度一致）。推理时通过余弦相似度检索相关记忆，将其KV载荷作为额外缓存令牌注入每层自注意力参与生成。记忆库构建采用双层优化：内层拟合轻量检索校准参数以适配当前任务，外层在固定记忆预算下选择条目，同时优化当前任务似然、历史锚点集的能力保留，以及检索空间中的冗余感知谱覆盖正则项以降低记忆冗余。
summary.experiments: 在持续指令调优、持续视觉问答等多种多模态持续学习场景下，性能优于现有基线方法。完整消融实验与量化结果需参考原文全文学术版本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1章中「固定内存占用（fixed footprint）」持续适配的问题定义、第2章的KV记忆构造方式与双层优化框架，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。关注部署效率的读者可查看推理时KV注入的开销分析相关章节。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require continual adaptation to new tasks and domains in production, but existing methods cannot satisfy a fixed deployment memory footprint constraint while preserving historical competencies and generalizability. Parameter-updating approaches (e.g., PEFT, expert routing) grow model state over time and risk disrupting the pretrained cross-modal interface, while replay-based methods struggle to balance retention and new task learning within tight memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: This work reframes continual MLLM adaptation as a budgeted external memory allocation problem rather than a parameter increment problem, providing a path for capacity expansion via attention-native KV memory injection without modifying the pretrained backbone. It is relevant for deployment scenarios requiring strict bounds on model state size and minimal perturbation to the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The entire MLLM backbone is frozen, and task-specific knowledge is stored as external, attention-compatible KV memory entries. Each entry has two components: a unit-norm retrieval key (pooled from final-layer prefix hidden states) in a fixed representation space, and layer-wise KV payloads compressed to a uniform length m via a static average pooling matrix to ensure consistent entry size. At inference, relevant memories are retrieved via cosine similarity and injected as additional cache tokens into each layer’s masked self-attention.
