The memory bank is built via bilevel optimization: an inner loop fits lightweight retrieval calibration parameters for the current task, while an outer loop selects a budgeted subset of entries to jointly optimize current-task likelihood, retention on historical anchor sets, and a redundancy-aware spectral coverage regularizer in the frozen retrieval space.
summary_en.experiments: The method outperforms existing baselines across multiple continual multimodal learning settings, including continual instruction tuning and continual VQA. Full ablation studies and detailed quantitative results are available in the full version of the work.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on the problem definition of fixed-footprint continual adaptation in Section 1, and the KV memory construction + bilevel optimization framework in Section 2. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested in deployment efficiency may also check the section on inference overhead of KV injection.

recommendation.zh: 多模态LLM的固定内存持续适配方案，核心是KV记忆的检索式复用，可参考§3的双层选择策略设计，无需通读全文。
recommendation.en: Fixed-footprint continual adaptation for MLLMs via retrieval-augmented KV memories; focus on §3's bilevel selection design for parameter-efficient adaptation, skip full text.

paper.title: MosaicKV: Serving Long-Context LLM with Dynamic Two-D KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM services now sustain prompts with hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a first-order serving cost. Because the cache grows linearly with context length, it can exhaust GPU memory, force smaller batches, and reduce serving throughput. Prior KV cache compression techniques typically target only the sequence dimension or only the channel dimension, which leaves limited headroom as context windows scale. Compressing both dimensions promises hi

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM服务场景中，现有KV缓存压缩方法单独在序列维度或通道维度压缩时压缩率存在上限，直接同时在两个维度做全生命周期压缩会造成严重精度损失；同时高压缩率引入的细粒度稀疏访存和动态管理开销，往往会抵消内存缩减带来的吞吐收益，甚至导致性能低于未压缩基线。
summary.importance: 这是长上下文推理侧KV缓存优化的实用工程工作，对十万到百万级token上下文场景的部署成本控制有直接参考价值；论文对KV元素重要性分布异质性的观察，也为理解长上下文注意力的结构模式提供了线索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出动态二维KV压缩框架MosaicKV。第一，用逐向量的元素选择替代此前所有KV向量共用统一通道掩码的做法，匹配单个KV向量内部重要元素分布不对齐的特性；第二，按KV缓存不同区域的元素分布特征（如数值方差、离群值分布）分区段应用适配的压缩策略，避免全局统一策略造成的精度损失；第三，配套压缩KV缓存管理优化，缓解细粒度稀疏带来的GPU缓存命中率下降问题，将SVD计算、重压缩等重操作移出解码关键路径，消除性能回退。
summary.experiments: 验证结果显示，朴素叠加70%通道压缩与序列压缩会造成82.8%的长上下文任务精度损失；在长上下文检索、多文档问答、代码生成等典型场景下，MosaicKV的精度-压缩率权衡显著优于Quest、ThinK、InfiniGen、ShadowKV等现有压缩方案，可在全生命周期对K、V向量同时应用二维压缩，同时解决了细粒度稀疏访存和动态管理开销导致的解码性能回退问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计15分钟。重点关注引言中对朴素二维压缩精度损失原因的观察、动态压缩策略的设计逻辑，以及系统优化层面的取舍；CUDA实现细节可直接跳过，除非从事推理系统开发工作。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context LLM serving, existing KV cache compression methods operating solely on the sequence or channel dimension hit strict compression ratio ceilings. Naive combination of compression on both dimensions across the full decode lifecycle causes severe accuracy degradation. Additionally, fine-grained sparse memory access patterns and runtime management overhead introduced by high-compression schemes often erase throughput gains from reduced memory usage, sometimes leading to worse performance than uncompressed baselines.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical engineering work for KV cache optimization in long-context deployment, with direct applicability to cost control for 100K to 1M token context serving. The observation of heterogeneous importance distributions across KV elements also provides useful insight into the structural patterns of long-context attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: MosaicKV implements a dynamic two-dimensional KV compression framework. First, it replaces the global uniform channel mask used in prior work with per-vector element selection, accounting for misaligned important element distributions across individual KV vectors. Second, it partitions the KV cache into segments based on regional distribution characteristics (e.g., magnitude variance, outlier presence) and applies tailored compression policies to each segment, avoiding accuracy loss from one-size-fits-all strategies. Third, it includes compressed cache management optimizations to mitigate poor GPU cache locality from fine-grained sparsity, and moves expensive operations such as SVD computation and recompression off the critical decode path to eliminate performance regressions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations show that naively combining 70% channel compression with sequence compression causes 82.8% accuracy loss on long-context tasks. Across long-context retrieval, multi-document QA, and code generation tasks, MosaicKV delivers substantially better accuracy-compression tradeoffs than prior methods including Quest, ThinK, InfiniGen, and ShadowKV. It supports full two-dimensional compression on both key and value vectors across the entire decode lifecycle, while eliminating performance regressions caused by sparse memory access and runtime overhead in naive implementations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 15 minutes. Focus on the introductory observations of accuracy loss causes in naive two-dimensional compression, the design logic of the dynamic compression policy, and system-level tradeoffs. CUDA implementation details can be skipped unless working directly on inference system development.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文KV压缩的系统级创新，重点看§3的动态二维分块策略，对预训练时长上下文注意力稀疏设计有参考价值
recommendation.en: System-level innovation for long-context KV compression; focus on §3 for dynamic 2D partitioning, informs sparse attention design in pretraining

paper.title: Towards Memory-Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation via Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) streaming models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, the linearly growing Key-Value (KV) cache poses a significant bottleneck, leading to memory overload and degraded inference throughput. A common compression method is to drop redundant KV tokens, which often breaks long-range dependencies, resulting in temporal flickering and identity loss. In this paper, we propose Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption (ISPA), a novel framework that sh

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归长视频生成中 KV cache 随时间线性增长，导致显存爆炸和吞吐下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率与缓存压缩。虽然场景是视频生成，不是文本 LLM，但“不要丢 KV，而是把历史吸收到参数里”的思路，对长上下文推理和实例级缓存压缩有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISPA（Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption）。方法在短暂 warmup 后，监控全局注意力与局部注意力的输出差异，在切换点求解一个闭式最小二乘问题，得到 instance-specific 的权重调制项，把历史上下文“吸收”进部分层参数中；随后将部分层从 full attention 切到 local attention，以减少 KV cache 负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其目标是 AR streaming video generation，主要对比常见的 KV token 丢弃式压缩方法，关注显存、吞吐以及时序闪烁和身份保持。未在摘要中给出模型参数量、数据规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the linear KV-cache growth in autoregressive long-video generation, which causes memory blow-up and poor inference throughput.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper. The setting is video generation rather than text LLMs, but the idea of absorbing history into parameters instead of dropping KV tokens is still mildly relevant for long-context inference research.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISPA (Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption) performs a brief warmup, measures the discrepancy between global and local attention, and at a transition point solves a closed-form least-squares problem to obtain an instance-specific weight modulation. This lets some layers switch from full attention to local attention while compensating for lost global context through temporary parameter adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on autoregressive streaming video generation, mainly against token-dropping KV compression baselines, with metrics around memory, throughput, temporal flicker, and identity preservation. Model size, data scale, and exact gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本 LLM，但思路有点意思：把 cache 压缩从删 token 改成实例级参数吸收。先看闭式解那一节；若代价太高，对 LLM 未必成立。
recommendation.en: Not a text-LLM paper, but the angle is interesting: turn cache compression from token dropping into instance-specific parameter absorption. Read the closed-form adaptation section first; the overhead may kill it for LLMs.

paper.title: GSRQ: Gain-Shape Residual Quantization for Sub-1-bit KV Cache
paper.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with extended context windows is increasingly constrained by the linear growth of Key-Value (KV) cache memory. Vector Quantization (VQ), particularly Residual Quantization (RQ), is a promising approach for pushing KV cache storage toward the sub-1-bit regime by progressively encoding residuals with small codebooks. However, most VQ methods still rely on standard $\ell_2$ $K$-means as the core codebook-learning primitive. We identify a subtle high-di

summary.core_problem: 解决残差量化用于KV缓存压缩时，标准ℓ2 K-means在高维下存在质心收缩、削弱角度对齐、方向保真差的问题，目标是实现亚1位KV缓存。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出改进的K-means变体用于残差量化，提升高维向量量化的方向保真度，为亚1位KV缓存提供新的量化方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Gain-Shape K-means（GSKM）作为标准K-means的直接替代，将质心更新分解为增益（幅度）和形状（方向）两部分，缓解质心收缩问题；在此基础上构建Gain-Shape残差量化（GSRQ），用于KV缓存的亚1位压缩。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出实验细节，提到在部分场景下ℓ2失真与标准方法相当甚至更优，方向保真度提升；具体模型参数量、基线、下游任务效果未在摘要中体现。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses centroid shrinkage and poor directional fidelity of standard ℓ2 K-means in high-dimensional residual quantization for KV cache compression, targeting sub-1-bit KV cache storage.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an improved K-means variant for residual quantization that enhances directional fidelity of high-dimensional vector quantization, enabling a new sub-1-bit KV cache quantization scheme.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gain-Shape K-means (GSKM) as a drop-in replacement for standard K-means, decomposing centroid updates into gain (magnitude) and shape (direction) components to mitigate centroid shrinkage; builds Gain-Shape Residual Quantization (GSRQ) on top for sub-1-bit KV cache compression.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide full experimental details; notes ℓ2 distortion matches or improves on standard methods in some regimes, with better directional fidelity. Model size, baselines, and downstream performance are not specified.

recommendation.zh: 亚1位KV量化的增量改进，gain-shape分解思路可作为量化感知预训练的参考，看摘要和方法核心部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for sub-1-bit KV quantization; the gain-shape decomposition idea is a minor reference for quantization-aware pretraining, read abstract and core method section only.

paper.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context Large Language Model inference is severely bottlenecked by the massive Key-Value (KV) cache, yet existing sparse attention methods often suffer from static fixed-budget (Top-k) retrieval or rely on proxy scores that are computationally expensive and biased. To address these limitations, we propose RaBitQCache, a novel sparse attention framework that utilizes randomized rotated binary quantization and high-throughput binary-INT4 arithmetic to efficiently estimate attention weights. O

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的 KV cache 访问瓶颈。问题不只是显存大，而是每一步解码都要在巨大的历史 KV 上做选择和读取。已有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法通常依赖固定预算的 Top-k 检索，或者依赖近似但偏差较大的 proxy score 来估计注意力重要性。前者不够自适应，后者既不够准，也缺少误差保证，因此很难安全地做 Top-p 这类按真实注意力质量自适应分配预算的检索。作者要解决的核心问题是：能否构造一个足够便宜、足够准、还有理论误差界的注意力代理分数，用它在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下做动态稀疏检索。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 efficient inference，而不是预训练本身，但对大模型系统研究有现实价值。它的重要性主要在两个层面。第一，方法上它把 KV 选择问题明确地写成高维向量相似度估计问题，并借助 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 视角构造了带理论界的 proxy score，这比很多经验型 sparse attention 方法更扎实。第二，系统上它不是只给一个近似公式，而是把二值化、INT4 查询、异步流水和 lazy update 一起做成了可运行方案。对基座研究员来说，直接启发不在建模，而在于：长上下文能力的上限越来越受 memory movement 和 retrieval policy 约束，未来训练和推理可能需要更统一地考虑“哪些历史 token 值得被精确保留”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 RaBitQCache，核心思想是把 Key 的高维浮点向量映射成随机旋转后的二值码，再用一个极轻量的二值-低比特算术近似 query-key 内积，从而估计注意力权重。具体分成几个层次。

第一层是表示压缩。在 prefill 阶段，作者对 Key 向量做随机旋转，然后映射到单位超立方体顶点，也就是得到 binary code。随机旋转的作用是让原始空间中的几何关系在低成本表示里尽量保真，避免直接按坐标符号切分带来的偏置。这个设计明显受 JL lemma 和相关近似近邻检索方法启发。

第二层是 proxy score 构造。在 decoding 阶段，不再直接用全精度 query 与所有 key 做内积，而是把 Query 做 INT4 量化，再与二值化 Key 进行高吞吐计算，得到一个对真实 attention score 的无偏估计。论文强调两点：一，这个估计器是 unbiased；二，它有严格的误差界。前者意味着估计值不会系统性高估或低估某类 token，后者意味着不仅能做相对排序，还能对分数大小本身有一定可信度，这正是支持 Top-p 检索的关键。

第三层是检索策略。不同于固定 Top-k，RaBitQCache 用估计到的注意力质量做 adaptive Top-p retrieval。因为不同层、不同头、不同任务的注意力稀疏度差异很大，固定 k 往往要么取多了浪费算力，要么取少了伤精度。Top-p 更接近“保留足够多的重要质量”，理论上更适合异质的注意力分布，但前提就是 proxy score 必须能近似真实权重幅值，而不只是给个粗排序。

第四层是系统实现。作者实现了硬件感知的 kernel 和调度，包括异步流水线以及 lazy updates，用来隐藏二值检索和数据搬运的额外开销。这个部分很关键，因为很多 sparse/offloading 方法算法上省 FLOPs，系统上却被 gather/scatter 和 CPU-GPU 传输拖垮。RaBitQCache 试图把“近似检索”真正做成吞吐友好的路径。

和 Quest、DS 这类方法相比，区别主要在三点：检索粒度更细，不是整页粗选；proxy score 更接近真实内积，不是部分维度或启发式统计；支持自适应 Top-p，而不是被迫固定预算。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法描述看，作者做的是长上下文推理加速实验，并声称显著优于现有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法。虽然给出的片段没有完整主表数字，但正文明确强调了几个结果方向。第一，在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下，RaBitQCache 能在保持模型性能基本稳定的同时提升长上下文推理效率。第二，相比现有方法，它的优势来自更准确的 token 重要性估计，因此在相同预算下精度损失更小，或者在相近精度下可进一步减少检索 token 数。第三，系统优化后，额外的代理分数计算和调度开销被较好掩蔽，否则算法收益很难兑现成端到端 latency 改善。

如果通读全文，建议重点抓几类实验。其一，proxy score 与真实 attention score 的相关性或误差分析，这是方法成立的根。其二，Top-k 与 Top-p 的对比，尤其是在不同层、不同头、不同任务上的预算自适应效果。其三，和 Quest、DS、静态位置选择等基线的端到端 latency、吞吐、显存/带宽占用比较。其四，消融随机旋转、二值码长度、INT4 量化精度、lazy update 和异步流水各自贡献。真正有说服力的结果通常不是单一 speedup，而是 accuracy-latency 曲线整体外移。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看引言里对现有动态 KV 检索两类缺陷的归纳：proxy 不准，以及没有误差界。这两点决定了作者为什么坚持做带理论保证的估计器。然后直接看方法部分中 proxy score 的定义与定理，确认无偏性和误差界到底针对的是 query-key 内积、attention logits，还是归一化后的权重。接着看系统实现图，判断异步流水和 lazy update 是否只是工程补丁，还是和算法设计强耦合。最后看主实验和消融，重点关注 accuracy-latency tradeoff，而不是只看单点加速比。

如果只想快速判断价值，优先读三处：理论部分的主命题、Top-p 检索实验、端到端系统性能表。若要深挖，可以继续追两个问题：一，随机旋转和二值化在不同层的分布漂移下是否稳定；二，这种 proxy 是否能迁移到训练时的 memory compression 或检索增强注意力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the main bottleneck in long-context decoding: not just the size of the KV cache, but the cost of repeatedly selecting and reading from a very large history. Existing sparse-attention and KV-offloading methods usually rely on either fixed-budget Top-k retrieval or cheap but biased proxy scores for token importance. Fixed Top-k is not adaptive enough, while weak proxies are often inaccurate and lack error guarantees, which makes adaptive Top-p retrieval hard to trust. The core question here is whether one can build a proxy score that is cheap, accurate, and theoretically controlled, so that dynamic sparse retrieval can be done without touching the full KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model systems work. Its main value is twofold. First, it formulates KV selection as a high-dimensional similarity estimation problem and brings in a Johnson-Lindenstrauss-style perspective to construct a proxy with explicit guarantees. That is methodologically stronger than many heuristic sparse-attention designs. Second, it does not stop at the estimator: it also builds a hardware-aware implementation around binary keys, INT4 queries, asynchronous pipelining, and lazy updates. For LLM researchers, the broader lesson is that long-context capability is increasingly constrained by memory movement and retrieval policy, not only by model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RaBitQCache compresses high-dimensional key vectors into rotated binary codes, then uses very cheap binary-low-bit arithmetic to estimate query-key similarity during decoding. The method has several layers.

First is representation compression. During prefill, each key vector is randomly rotated and then mapped to the vertices of a unit hypercube, producing a binary code. The random rotation is important: it preserves geometric structure better than naive sign binarization and reduces coordinate-aligned bias. This design is clearly inspired by JL-style dimensionality reduction and approximate nearest-neighbor methods.

Second is the proxy-score construction. During decoding, the method does not compute full-precision inner products between the query and all keys. Instead, it quantizes the query to INT4 and computes a lightweight interaction with the binary keys. The resulting score is used as an estimator of the true attention score. The paper emphasizes two properties: the estimator is unbiased, and it comes with a rigorous error bound. Unbiasedness matters because it avoids systematic distortion of token importance. The error bound matters because it enables not just rough ranking but magnitude-aware estimation, which is exactly what adaptive Top-p retrieval needs.

Third is the retrieval policy. Unlike fixed Top-k methods, RaBitQCache uses the estimated attention mass to perform adaptive Top-p retrieval. This is a meaningful design choice because attention sparsity varies widely across layers, heads, and tasks. A fixed k is often either too conservative, wasting compute, or too aggressive, hurting accuracy. Top-p is a better match to heterogeneous attention distributions, but only if the proxy can estimate score magnitudes reasonably well rather than merely preserving order.

Fourth is the systems layer. The paper implements hardware-aware kernels and scheduling, including asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates, to hide the overhead of proxy computation and data movement. This part is important because many sparse or offloading methods save arithmetic on paper but lose the benefit in practice due to gather/scatter overhead and transfer latency.

Relative to methods such as Quest or DS, the differences are clear: finer retrieval granularity, a proxy closer to the true inner product, and support for adaptive Top-p rather than fixed-budget selection.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper evaluates long-context inference acceleration and claims clear gains over prior sparse-attention and KV-offloading baselines. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, but the experimental story is already visible. First, RaBitQCache improves long-context inference efficiency without requiring access to the full KV cache and while keeping model quality largely intact. Second, its advantage comes from more accurate token-importance estimation, which means lower quality loss at the same retrieval budget, or lower budget at similar quality. Third, the systems optimizations appear necessary to convert algorithmic savings into end-to-end latency gains.

When reading the full paper, four experimental blocks deserve attention. One is the correlation or error analysis between the proxy score and the true attention score; that is the foundation of the method. Another is the comparison between Top-k and Top-p retrieval, especially across layers, heads, and tasks with different sparsity patterns. A third is the end-to-end comparison against baselines such as Quest, DS, and static-position retrieval in terms of latency, throughput, and memory or bandwidth usage. A fourth is the ablation over random rotation, binary code length, INT4 quantization, lazy updates, and asynchronous scheduling. The most convincing evidence will likely be an improved accuracy-latency frontier rather than a single speedup number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A 25-35 minute skim should be enough to judge the paper. Start with the introduction's diagnosis of prior dynamic KV retrieval: inaccurate proxies and no error bounds. That framing explains why the paper insists on a theoretically grounded estimator. Then go straight to the method section and read the definition of the proxy score together with the main theorem. Check carefully whether the guarantee applies to the raw query-key inner product, the attention logits, or something after normalization. After that, inspect the systems diagram to see whether asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates are core to the design or just implementation details. Finally, read the main results and ablations with an eye on the accuracy-latency tradeoff, not just isolated speedup numbers.

If time is limited, prioritize three parts: the main theoretical proposition, the Top-p retrieval experiments, and the end-to-end system table. For deeper follow-up, two questions are worth asking: how stable the rotated binary representation is under layer-wise distribution shift, and whether the same proxy machinery could be reused for training-time memory compression or retrieval-augmented attention.

recommendation.zh: KV cache二值量化+自适应Top-p稀疏方案扎实，无偏估计证明与硬件流水线设计，可作为预训练做长上下文兼容设计的直接参考
recommendation.en: Solid KV cache binary quantization + adaptive Top-p sparsity design; the unbiasedness proof and hardware pipeline are directly useful for long-context compatible pretraining.

paper.title: Coverage-Driven KV Cache Eviction for Efficient and Improved Inference of LLM
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex tasks like question answering and summarization, thanks to their ability to handle long-context inputs. However, deploying LLMs is costly, not only due to the high computational demands of quadratic complexity of self-attention and auto-regressive generation, but also because of the significant memory overhead required for storing the key-value (KV) cache during inference. To reduce the memory cost, existing KV-cache eviction strategies leverage the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是长上下文推理中的 KV cache 压缩问题。已有 eviction 方法主要按注意力分数保留 token，但在高压缩率下，不同 head 和不同 layer 往往保留同一批靠近 prompt 末尾的 token，导致被覆盖的唯一 token 数下降。作者把这种现象称为 coverage loss，并认为它是长上下文任务性能下降的关键原因。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在推理效率，不是预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发在于：KV cache 压缩不能只看单个 head 或单层的局部重要性，还要看跨 head、跨 layer 后的信息覆盖。这个观察也可用于分析长上下文模型的注意力冗余、recency bias，以及训练时是否学到更均匀的信息路由。量级上属于实用型改进，适合做 serving 或长上下文推理系统的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 K-VEC，一种 coverage-aware KV cache eviction 方法。核心不是重新训练模型，而是在推理时改变 cache token 的选择策略。论文先分析 SnapKV 等方法的 eviction score，发现多个 head 和 layer 的选择高度重合，并且偏向 prompt 末尾。K-VEC 用两个模块缓解这个问题：cross-head coverage 通过调整少量 head 的 attention span，让不同 head 覆盖更不同的 token；cross-layer coverage 鼓励后续 layer 选择那些全局重要但早期 layer 未覆盖的 token。这样做的目标是，在相同 KV budget 下，提高被至少一个 head 或 layer 保留过的唯一 token 数。作者还用 information bottleneck 视角解释 coverage 与输入输出互信息之间的关系：覆盖越低，可传递到生成端的信息越少，长上下文任务更容易退化。
summary.experiments: 实验沿用 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O 等工作的长上下文评测设置，在 LongBench 的 16 个子任务上测试，包括单文档问答、多文档问答、摘要、few-shot learning、合成任务和代码任务。KV cache budget 设置为 128、256、512、1024 token。K-VEC 在低 budget 下收益更明显，128 token budget 时单项最高比已有方法提升 10.35 分，16 个数据集平均提升 1.61 分。论文还做了模块消融和敏感性分析，用来验证 cross-head coverage 与 cross-layer coverage 分别带来的贡献。计算开销与已有 eviction 方法保持接近，主要额外成本来自 coverage-aware 的选择逻辑。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 coverage loss 的定义，以及 Figure 1 到 Figure 3 对 recency bias 和 token 覆盖下降的可视化。方法部分关注 cross-head coverage 和 cross-layer coverage 如何改变 token 选择，而不是只看最终分数。实验部分优先看 128 和 256 token budget 下的 LongBench 表格，以及消融实验；这些结果最能说明 coverage 是否比单纯 attention score 更稳。理论部分可以快速看结论，信息瓶颈推导更多是为经验观察提供解释，不是方法成立的唯一依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache compression for long-context LLM inference. Existing eviction methods retain tokens based on attention-derived scores, but under aggressive budgets, different heads and layers often keep the same recent tokens. This reduces the number of unique input tokens covered by the cache, and the paper identifies this coverage loss as a major source of degradation on long-context reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference efficiency rather than pretraining. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the coverage view: cache quality should not be measured only by local attention scores, but also by how much non-redundant information survives across heads and layers. This also provides a diagnostic lens for attention redundancy, recency bias, and long-context routing behavior. The impact is practical and system-facing, with moderate research relevance for long-context model analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: K-VEC is a coverage-aware KV-cache eviction strategy applied at inference time. The paper first shows that SnapKV-like scoring produces overlapping selections across heads and layers, with a strong bias toward the end of the prompt. K-VEC introduces two mechanisms. Cross-head coverage adjusts the attention span of selected heads so that different heads preserve more diverse tokens. Cross-layer coverage encourages later layers to retain globally useful tokens that were not selected by earlier layers. The method therefore tries to maximize useful unique-token coverage under the same cache budget. The authors also frame coverage loss through an information-bottleneck argument: when fewer input tokens are represented in the cache, the mutual information between the input and the generated output is constrained.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation follows prior KV-cache eviction protocols and uses 16 LongBench subsets, covering single-document QA, multi-document QA, summarization, few-shot tasks, synthetic tasks, and code. Cache budgets are 128, 256, 512, and 1024 tokens. Gains are largest under tight budgets: at 128 cached tokens, K-VEC reports up to a 10.35-point improvement on an individual task and an average gain of 1.61 points across the 16 datasets over existing methods. Ablations and sensitivity studies are used to isolate the effect of the cross-head and cross-layer coverage modules. Runtime overhead is kept close to prior eviction methods, since the main change is in token selection rather than model computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the coverage-loss analysis in the introduction and the visual evidence in Figures 1 to 3. Then read the method description of cross-head and cross-layer coverage; that is where the actual design choice sits. In the experiments, focus on LongBench results under 128 and 256 token budgets, since aggressive compression exposes the method’s behavior most clearly. The information-bottleneck section can be read for intuition, but the empirical coverage analysis is the stronger part of the paper.

recommendation.zh: 别只把它当又一篇 KV eviction；若主表成立，‘coverage 而非 attention 峰值’这个解释值得迁移到长上下文训练与稀疏注意力设计里。
recommendation.en: Do not dismiss this as just another KV eviction paper; if the main tables hold, the ‘coverage over peak attention’ framing is worth porting into long-context training and sparse-attention design.

paper.title: DiLaServe: High SLO Attainment Serving for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional autoregressive language models. By generating multiple tokens in parallel during each denoising step, they offer higher inference throughput while maintaining competitive quality. However, realizing these throughput gains while meeting latency SLOs in a serving system requires addressing challenges introduced by DLMs' unique characteristics. These include navigating the speed-quality tradeoff create

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）推理时每步都能并行解mask多个token，理论吞吐显著高于AR模型，但现有AR专用serving系统无法处理DLM独有的三个问题：置信度阈值带来的速度-质量显式旋钮、张量并行度与集群吞吐的trade-off、近似KV缓存刷新导致的步级计算成本不均。这些问题合起来使得DLM在生产环境中很难同时满足高吞吐和严格时延SLO。
summary.importance: 这是首个面向集群级DLM serving的完整系统设计。对预训练研究的价值在于：它把DLM特有的“置信度解mask步数、并行度、KV刷新策略”这些本来只在训练/建模时关心的超参，转化为服务端的动态调度决策；其测到的SLO提升和时延下降数字，直接给DLM是否值得在生产替代AR提供了工程化参考，也会反过来指导下一代DLM在训练时对齐serving友好的目标（例如更鲁棒的置信度校准）。
summary.technical_approach: DiLaServe基于vLLM和Ray扩展，调度粒度细化到单次去噪步。关键设计有三层：（1）请求级SLO感知阈值选择：根据每个请求剩余时延预算，选能在预算内完成的最高置信度阈值，优先保质量；（2）自适应负载控制：给每个请求设最大可用阈值上限，保证集群总负载不超过处理能力；（3）两阶段整数线性规划做集群重配置：第一阶段选每个张量并行度下的实例数，最大化平均置信度阈值与SLO达成率；第二阶段计算实例迁移方案以最小化服务中断。近似KV缓存的非均匀步级成本被直接纳入调度与ILP的耗时估计。
summary.experiments: 系统基于真实LLM服务流量trace评测。主要结果：相对基线，SLO达成率提升30.2个百分点，端到端时延降低46%，质量分数仅下降0.09；在多个准确性基准、高负载场景下，SLO达成率最高提升56.6个百分点，准确率仅下降0.9%。同时验证了近似KV缓存配合精细调度，能在几乎不损失质量的前提下进一步提升吞吐。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看Introduction中关于DLM与AR serving差异的三张示意图（置信度步数、并行度trade-off、KV刷新），直接建立问题直觉。方法部分重点读三部分：SLO阈值选择的决策逻辑、负载上界如何约束每个请求的阈值、两阶段ILP的决策变量与目标函数。实验部分读主表中SLO/时延/质量三者的trade-off数字即可。若要做系统实现再深入KV缓存刷新与调度器集成细节。预计阅读时间40–60分钟。
summary.authors_note: 文中未标注具体机构与作者名单，返回""

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can unmask multiple tokens in parallel per denoising step and thus have much higher theoretical throughput than autoregressive models. However, AR-oriented serving systems cannot handle three DLM-specific issues: the explicit speed-quality knob introduced by confidence-based unmasking, the throughput-latency trade-off of tensor parallelism under fluctuating load, and the per-step cost heterogeneity caused by approximate KV-cache refresh. Together these make it hard to deliver both high throughput and strict latency SLOs in production DLM deployments.
summary_en.importance: DiLaServe is the first complete cluster-scale serving system designed for DLMs. For pretraining research, its significance lies in translating modeling-time knobs — denoising steps, parallelism degree, KV refresh policy — into runtime scheduling decisions. The measured SLO and latency gains provide concrete engineering evidence for whether DLMs can replace AR models in production, and will feed back into how future DLMs are trained: better confidence calibration and serving-aware objectives during pretraining become first-order goals rather than afterthoughts.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiLaServe extends vLLM and Ray with scheduling at the granularity of individual denoising steps. The design has three layers: (1) SLO-aware threshold selection: for each request, pick the highest confidence threshold that still fits within the remaining latency budget, maximizing quality subject to the deadline; (2) adaptive load control: cap the maximum threshold each request can use so aggregate load stays within cluster capacity; (3) a two-stage integer linear program (ILP) for cluster reconfiguration: stage one chooses the number of instances at each tensor-parallel degree to maximize average confidence threshold and SLO attainment; stage two computes a migration plan minimizing service disruption. Non-uniform step costs from approximate KV caching are directly folded into scheduling cost estimates and the ILP.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation uses real-world LLM serving traces. Key results: 30.2 percentage point higher SLO attainment, 46% lower end-to-end latency, and only 0.09 quality-score drop versus baselines. Across multiple accuracy benchmarks under high load, SLO attainment improves by up to 56.6 percentage points with a 0.9% accuracy drop. Approximate KV caching combined with fine-grained scheduling is shown to further increase throughput with negligible quality loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a first pass, focus on the three schematic figures in the introduction that illustrate confidence-based step counts, the parallelism trade-off, and KV refresh — they give the right problem intuition immediately. In the method section, read the SLO-aware threshold policy, the load control bound on per-request thresholds, and the two-stage ILP's variables and objective. In experiments, the main tables summarizing the SLO / latency / quality trade-offs are sufficient. Dive into KV-cache refresh and scheduler integration details only if implementation is planned. Estimated reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DLM 若要和 AR 竞争，serving 约束绕不过；重点看调度目标如何把质量写进 SLO，而不是只看吞吐数字。
recommendation.en: If DLMs are to compete with AR models, serving constraints matter; read how the scheduler encodes quality into SLOs, not just the throughput plots.

paper.title: ReFreeKV: Towards Threshold-Free KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: To reduce memory consumption during LLM inference, a handful of methods have been proposed for KV cache pruning. While these techniques can accomplish lossless memory reduction on many datasets, they often hinge on an under-emphasized condition: an input/domain-specific threshold for KV cache budget needs to be pre-determined to achieve the optimal performance. However, such input-sensitive design may be considerably limited in real-world scenarios, as open-domain inputs span diverse domains, le

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 KV cache 压缩方法在真实开放输入中依赖数据集特定阈值的问题：同一个 cache budget 在 LongBench、GSM8K、needle-in-the-haystack 等任务上表现差异很大，固定阈值难以迁移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文模型的推理侧评估有启发。它把 KV 压缩目标从“在某个 benchmark 上压到多小”改成“在不调输入特定阈值的情况下维持接近 full-cache 的性能”。这个目标更接近实际服务场景，也提醒长上下文能力评估不能只看单一数据集上的压缩率。
summary.technical_approach: ReFreeKV 采用两阶段流程。第一步根据位置重要性对所有 KV cache 位置排序。第二步按排序逐步保留 key-value 向量，并用一个输入不敏感的停止准则决定何时停止保留。核心是 Uni-Metric：它不是为每个数据集预先设定 cache ratio 或固定 token 数，而是用一个相对稳定的指标动态决定预算。方法仍然有停止阈值，但不需要针对输入域、长度或任务难度校准。实现上强调并行算子，避免逐 token 的顺序处理，使延迟接近已有高效 KV pruning 方法。
summary.experiments: 论文使用 13 个数据集，覆盖数学与常识推理、阅读理解、代码、长上下文检索等任务，并在多个规模的 LLM 上测试。引言给出的关键数字包括：Llama3-70B 在 20K tokens 下 KV cache 可达约 50GB；D2O 在 LongBench 上 20% cache budget 可接近 full-cache，但在 GSM8K 上可能需要约 80%；CAKE 在 LongBench 上保留 1024 个位置可行，但同样预算在 needle-in-the-haystack 上失效。ReFreeKV 在 Llama3-8B 上自动分配平均 63.7% 的 KV budget，并在 13 个数据集平均表现上略高于 full-cache。它不是每个数据集压缩率最高的方法，但在“不调数据集阈值且保持性能”这个约束下更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对阈值敏感性的实验动机，尤其是不同数据集所需预算差异；再看 Methodology 中 Uni-Metric 的定义和停止准则，这是论文的主要技术点；最后看 Table 2 和延迟实验，判断它是否真的在性能、压缩率、运行开销之间取得了可用折中。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必深挖所有推理系统实现细节，但可以关注它提出的评估目标：压缩方法需要在混合分布输入上稳定，而不是只在单一 benchmark 上报告最优预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical weakness in KV-cache compression: most pruning methods require an input- or dataset-specific cache budget, and the same threshold can fail badly when domains, sequence lengths, or task difficulty change.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful lesson for foundation-model work is the evaluation objective. For long-context models, a KV-compression method should not only report the smallest budget on a fixed benchmark; it should preserve full-cache behavior under mixed, open-domain inputs without per-dataset calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReFreeKV uses a two-stage pruning procedure. It first ranks cache positions by positional importance, then keeps KV vectors progressively according to that ranking until a stopping rule is satisfied. The key component is Uni-Metric, a stopping metric designed to be insensitive to input domain and sequence length. The method is not literally thresholdless; rather, its threshold does not need to be tuned for each dataset or input type. The implementation is designed around parallel operators, so the pruning overhead stays comparable to prior efficient KV-pruning approaches.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 13 datasets spanning reasoning, reading comprehension, coding, and long-context retrieval, with multiple LLM sizes. The paper reports several calibration failures for prior methods: D2O can match full-cache performance on LongBench with a 20% budget but may need around 80% on GSM8K; CAKE works with 1024 retained positions on LongBench but underperforms on needle-in-the-haystack. With Llama3-8B, ReFreeKV allocates an average KV budget of 63.7% and slightly exceeds full-cache performance on average across the 13 datasets. Its main result is not maximum compression on every dataset, but stable performance without dataset-specific budget tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation experiments in the introduction first, because they define the failure mode clearly. Then focus on the Uni-Metric definition and the stopping rule in the method section. The most informative results are the mixed-dataset comparison table and the latency study. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is the evaluation principle for long-context serving: robustness under distribution mixtures matters more than a tuned compression ratio on one benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员重点看§3的目标函数设计，其自适应预算思想可迁移到训练时的稀疏注意力正则与KV感知预训练。
recommendation.en: For pretraining researchers, focus on §3 objective design; its adaptive budgeting idea transfers to sparse attention regularization and KV-aware pretraining.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Bifocal Diffusion Language Models: Asymmetric Bidirectional Context for Parallel Generation
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) recover masked tokens in parallel, offering significant speedups over autoregressive (AR) generation. However, such promising frameworks face a fundamental architectural design dilemma: \ding{182} Adopting bidirectional attention achieves strong generation quality by allowing each position to access the full context, but is inherently incompatible with KV caching, limiting inference throughput in batch-serving scenarios; \ding{183} Conversely, causal at

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散语言模型(dLLM)存在架构两难：双向注意力保证生成质量但无法兼容KV缓存，因果注意力支持缓存但丢失右上下文导致质量下降，阻碍批处理吞吐量提升。
summary.importance: 方法/范式改进，首次提出不对称双向上下文范式解决dLLM的质量-推理效率核心矛盾，为非AR语言模型实用化扫清架构障碍。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Bifocal dLLMs范式，实例化为R2LM(Right-to-Left Mamba)，结合两种互补机制：1)标准因果注意力提供精确左上下文，完全兼容KV缓存；2)右到左Mamba模块捕获右侧上下文信息，无需双向注意力即可实现全局建模。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据集、Baseline及定量效果对比，仅明确方法针对离散扩散语言模型的并行生成场景设计。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Fei Tian(田飞)，其余作者机构未明确披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) face a fundamental architectural dilemma: bidirectional attention ensures generation quality but is incompatible with KV caching, while causal attention supports caching but loses right-side context degrading performance, limiting batch serving throughput.
summary_en.importance: Methodological/paradigm improvement resolving the core quality-efficiency tradeoff in dLLMs, removing a critical architectural barrier to practical non-autoregressive LM deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Bifocal dLLMs paradigm, instantiated as R2LM (Right-to-Left Mamba), combining two complementary mechanisms: 1) standard causal attention for precise left-context modeling with full KV cache compatibility; 2) a right-to-left Mamba module capturing right-side context without bidirectional attention.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose specific model sizes, training datasets, baselines, or quantitative performance comparisons; method is designed for parallel generation scenarios of discrete diffusion LMs.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Fei Tian (known researcher in LLM and generation), institutional affiliations of other authors not explicitly stated.

recommendation.zh: 离散扩散LM的核心架构突破，解决非AR生成的KV缓存兼容性问题，重点读§3的R2LM结构与吞吐量对比实验。
recommendation.en: Key architectural breakthrough for discrete diffusion LMs resolving KV cache compatibility of non-AR generation, focus on §3 R2LM design and throughput experiments.

paper.title: Position Rebinding Cache Reuse: Replay-Free Visual Revisiting for Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Interleaved multimodal reasoning improves visual grounding by revisiting visual evidence during multi-step generation, yet existing methods typically rely on token replay, repeatedly forwarding selected visual tokens. A natural shortcut is to reuse the historical visual key-value (KV) cache directly. However, we identify a critical failure mode of this strategy: cached visual keys are already bound to their original positional context. Such stale positional binding distorts attention under later

summary.core_problem: 交错多模态推理中，现有token回放方法存在冗余计算，而直接复用历史视觉KV缓存会因旧位置绑定干扰注意力、触发自回归解码崩溃，缺乏有效的无回放视觉证据复现方案。
summary.importance: 明确了多模态KV缓存复用的核心失效机制为位置上下文不匹配，为MLLM推理优化、甚至未来支持跨上下文视觉特征复用的位置编码预训练设计提供了问题指向；缓存复用框架可降低多模态长上下文推理的计算开销，对部署侧有实际参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无回放的位置重绑定缓存复用（PRCR）框架，核心包含两部分：一是原始视觉证据内存，存储加位置编码前的原始视觉KV及对应视觉token的空间坐标；二是位置重分配机制，当需要复现视觉证据时，为选中的KV重新分配适配当前解码上下文的位置、重新施加位置编码后，再插入活跃解码器缓存，无需重新前向传播视觉token。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基线，在M3CoT数据集上，直接KV复用方案准确率从基线的66.4%骤降至23.5%，且频繁出现重复token循环、输出熵崩溃的解码失效现象；PRCR可恢复至甚至超过token回放方法的准确率，同时在不同的视觉token选择预算、模型规模下，显著降低视觉复现环节的FLOPs。
summary.reading_guide: 先通读引言中直接KV复用失效的核心现象（图1a、图2的解码崩溃分析），再了解PRCR的两大核心模块设计，重点关注图1的准确率-FLOPs对比、图3的注意力扰动诊断结果，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In interleaved multimodal reasoning, existing token replay methods introduce heavy redundant computation, while direct reuse of historical visual KV caches disrupts attention and triggers catastrophic autoregressive decoding collapse due to stale positional binding, leaving a gap for efficient replay-free visual evidence revisiting solutions.
summary_en.importance: It identifies positional context mismatch as the root failure mode of multimodal KV cache reuse, providing clear guidance for MLLM inference optimization and even future pretraining design of positional encoding schemes that support cross-context visual feature reuse. The cache reuse framework also cuts computational overhead for multimodal long-context inference, with practical reference value for deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Position Rebinding Cache Reuse (PRCR), a replay-free framework with two core components: 1) Raw Visual Evidence Memory, which stores pre-positional-encoding visual KV entries along with the spatial coordinates of corresponding visual tokens; 2) Position Reassignment mechanism, which reallocates context-compatible positions to selected KV entries during visual revisiting, re-applies positional encoding, and inserts the reconstructed cache into the active decoder cache without re-forwarding visual tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the baseline, Direct KV Cache Reuse reduces M3CoT accuracy sharply from 66.4% to 23.5%, accompanied by frequent repeated-token loops and output entropy collapse. PRCR recovers to or even outperforms the accuracy of token replay methods, while substantially reducing FLOPs of the visual revisiting stage across different selected-token budgets and model scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the core failure phenomenon of direct KV reuse in the introduction (Figure 1a, decoding collapse analysis in Figure 2), then review the two core modules of PRCR. Focus on Figure 1 (accuracy vs. FLOPs comparison) and Figure 3 (attention perturbation diagnosis). Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 failure analysis 和位置重绑定公式；它提醒 cache 不是无语义状态，做 VLM 长链推理优化时这个坑很实。
recommendation.en: Read the failure analysis and the rebinding formulation; it is a concrete warning that cache is not position-free state in long-chain VLM inference.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
paper.abstract: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly limited by key-value (KV) cache movement rather than dense matrix multiplication. Modern paged-attention systems reduce KV-cache fragmentation and mature kernels such as FlashInfer provide highly optimized native-paged decode attention. However, the best single-kernel implementation is not always the best serving schedule: low-active long-context decode can under-utilize commodity GPUs, while mixed sequence lengths introduce a ten

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文 LLM 推理的 decode 阶段，由于算术强度低，性能瓶颈往往在于 KV-cache 的访存和调度。现有的单一最优 kernel（如 FlashInfer）在面对低并发、长上下文或混合序列长度的 serving 场景时，可能无法充分利用 GPU 资源。
summary.importance: 深入探讨了长上下文 decode 阶段的调度策略，指出不存在“一招鲜”的 attention kernel。通过提出 PersistentKV 并与 FlashInfer 进行对比，强调了在 LLM serving 系统中，应根据请求状态动态选择 kernel 调度策略，而非强制使用单一方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 PersistentKV，一个针对 GQA (Grouped-Query Attention) 的原生块表 (block-table) decode attention 引擎。其核心设计包括：1) 按 KV-head 组映射任务，在分组的 query head 间复用 K,V tile；2) 采用原生 paged cache 布局，避免 KV 重排开销；3) 引入行级序列长度调度和紧凑工作队列 (workqueue)，使任务划分和预取严格遵循实际请求长度，减少 padding 浪费。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama 风格的 GQA 配置下，将 PersistentKV 与 FlashInfer 在相同的页表分布、上下文长度和数值精度下进行了直接对比。结果表明，PersistentKV 在低并发和中等并发的长上下文场景下具有优势，而 FlashInfer 在小 batch 场景下表现更好（因为 PersistentKV 的 split-merge 开销占主导）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Methodology 部分关于 PersistentKV 的任务映射（按 KV-head group 和 sequence split）以及紧凑工作队列的设计。实验部分需注意其在不同并发度和上下文长度下与 FlashInfer 的性能交叉点，这直接支撑了其“自适应调度”的核心主张。

summary_en.core_problem: During the decode phase of long-context LLM inference, low arithmetic intensity makes KV-cache memory traffic and scheduling the primary bottlenecks. A single highly-optimized kernel (like FlashInfer) may under-utilize GPUs in serving scenarios with low-active, long-context requests or mixed sequence lengths.
summary_en.importance: Provides a deep dive into decode scheduling for long-context LLMs, demonstrating that no single attention kernel is optimal across all regimes. By introducing PersistentKV and comparing it with FlashInfer, the paper advocates for an adaptive serving policy that chooses the kernel schedule based on request state rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all approach.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PersistentKV, a native block-table decode attention engine tailored for Grouped-Query Attention (GQA). Key features include: 1) Mapping work by KV-head group to reuse K,V tiles across grouped query heads; 2) Operating directly on native paged cache layouts to avoid repacking overhead; 3) Implementing row-local sequence-length scheduling and a compact workqueue to align split boundaries and prefetches with true request lengths, minimizing padding waste.
summary_en.experiments: Compared PersistentKV directly against FlashInfer using a Llama-style GQA configuration under identical page-table distributions, context lengths, and numerical tolerances. Results indicate PersistentKV excels in low- and moderate-active long-context regimes, whereas FlashInfer remains superior for small active batches where PersistentKV's split-merge overhead dominates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section detailing PersistentKV's work mapping (by KV-head group and sequence split) and the compact workqueue design. In the experiments, pay attention to the performance crossover points between PersistentKV and FlashInfer across different batch sizes and context lengths, which justify the proposed adaptive scheduling policy.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度设计和混合长度实验即可；它不改变模型训练，但能提醒长上下文效率瓶颈已从 kernel 转到 page-level scheduling。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduler and mixed-length experiments; it does not change training, but it shows long-context serving bottlenecks moving from kernels to page-level scheduling.

paper.title: ProtoKV: Streaming Video Understanding under Delayed Query with Summary-State Memory
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) must answer queries that arrive asynchronously while visual tokens stream continuously under strict GPU-memory and query-time latency budgets. A key challenge is delayed query: decisive cues may appear briefly, yet many subsequent updates occur before the query arrives, increasing the risk that those cues are evicted or diluted under bounded memory. We propose ProtoKV, a constant-footprint SVU memory that represents far history as a fixed-capacity summary stat

summary.core_problem: 解决流式视频理解中查询延迟到达时，关键早期视觉证据在有限显存下被 KV 缓存淘汰或稀释的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长时序多模态推理的记忆结构和推理效率改进。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对长上下文压缩、KV 记忆抽象和延迟查询场景有可迁移的工程启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProtoKV：保留近端窗口的精确 KV cache，把远端历史压缩为固定容量的语义-空间 prototype bank，并维护 residual statistics。查询时将这些 prototype 通过受限数量的 pseudo-token 暴露给标准 attention，因此可以较低改动接入现有模型。
summary.experiments: 在流式视频理解 benchmark 的长延迟设置下，与 token-retention 类基线在相同内存预算和相近查询时延下比较，最高提升 12.5 个准确率点。摘要未披露具体模型参数量和训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets streaming video understanding where a query arrives late and decisive early cues may have already been evicted from a bounded memory.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an efficient memory abstraction for long-horizon multimodal inference. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it has useful parallels to long-context compression and KV-cache summarization.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProtoKV keeps an exact KV cache for the recent window and compresses older history into a fixed-capacity semantic-spatial prototype bank with residual statistics. At query time, prototypes are exposed as bounded pseudo-tokens that remain compatible with standard attention.
summary_en.experiments: On streaming video understanding benchmarks in long-delay regimes, ProtoKV reports up to a 12.5-point accuracy gain over token-retention baselines under matched memory budgets and comparable query-time cost. The abstract does not provide model size or training data details.

recommendation.zh: 只看 delayed-query setup 和 prototype pseudo-token 接口；和 LLM 长上下文压缩有类比，但视频结论不能直接外推。
recommendation.en: Read the delayed-query setup and pseudo-token interface only; it is a useful analogy for LLM context compression, not direct evidence.

paper.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: While speculative decoding improves inference throughput for multi-batch long-context Large Language Models (LLMs), its efficiency is often limited by a verification bottleneck where Key-Value (KV) cache loading dominates latency. Existing compression methods fail in this regime: static eviction incurs accuracy loss due to saliency shift, while dynamic selection introduces prohibitive computational overhead during the verification path. We propose Dustin, a sparse verification framework designed

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 speculative decoding 在真实大模型推理里最卡的一段：verification 阶段的 KV cache 读取。问题不在于 speculative decoding 没有减少算力，而在于长上下文、多 batch 下，验证阶段仍要反复搬运大体量 KV，内存带宽成为主瓶颈。已有 KV 压缩方法要么做静态淘汰，容易因为 saliency shift 丢掉后续会变重要的 token；要么做动态选择，但每步重算重要性本身就太贵，放在 verification 路径上得不偿失。作者要解决的是：能不能在 speculative verification 这个特殊场景下，用足够便宜的方式找出未来几个验证步真正关键的 KV token，从而在不明显伤害生成质量的前提下，把 verification 的带宽成本压下去。
summary.importance: 它主要属于推理效率，而不是预训练方法，但对基座研究仍有两点实际价值。第一，长上下文模型的训练与部署越来越一体化，很多 pretrain 研究最后都要落到 32k、64k 甚至更长上下文的 serving 约束上；这篇工作把“verification 不是算力瓶颈，而是 KV 读带宽瓶颈”讲得很具体。第二，它说明在多步验证场景里，token 重要性不是单靠 target model 的历史注意力就能稳定预测的，因为未来几个 token 的 saliency 会漂移；引入 draft model 的 lookahead 信号后，才能更接近 verification 真正需要的 token 子集。这种“用便宜模型预测昂贵模型未来注意力”的思路，对训练期做稀疏注意力近似、课程式上下文裁剪也有启发。
summary.technical_approach: Dustin 的核心是一个面向 speculative verification 的稀疏 KV 选择框架。作者先把问题形式化成在验证窗口 [i, i+w-1] 上选择固定预算 k 个 KV 位置，使保留下来的注意力质量尽量接近全量注意力。为此定义了 ARR，衡量被选 token 覆盖了多少原始注意力质量，并在附录里说明 ARR 与输出 logit 的 KL divergence 强负相关，因此可作为稀疏前向 fidelity 的代理指标。方法上有两个关键设计。第一是 hybrid token selection：不用单一来源估计 token 重要性，而是融合 target model 的 historical attention 与 draft model 的 lookahead attention。前者便宜且反映已发生的依赖，后者能看到 verification 窗口内未来 token 的潜在关注点，适合应对 saliency shift。第二是 sparse estimation：为了避免动态选择本身过慢，作者不在所有层和头上完整物化注意力，而是搜索一个最小但足够有效的 attention head 子集，只在这些头上做重要性估计。这样做的逻辑很清楚：verification 路径里任何额外计算都必须比“直接跑全 KV”更便宜，否则压缩没有意义。文中还把 Dustin 与几类基线区分开来：静态 eviction 方法因为永久丢上下文，在多步验证里容易失真；基于完整 attention 重打分的方法精度高但开销过大；Quest 这类 page-level 近似虽然避免精确 QK^T，但估分仍有不小成本，且不如作者的稀疏估计快。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Llama3 与 Qwen2.5 系列，评测集包括 LongBench 和 PG-19。分析部分主要用 Qwen2.5-32B 作为 target model、Qwen2.5-0.5B 作为 draft model，并在 LongReward 数据上研究时间维度和层间行为，数据平均上下文长度约 13.5k。系统结果里，作者报告在 Qwen2.5-72B、32k context、batch size 16 的设定下，self-attention 计算可加速 27.85×，最终 decoding phase 达到最高 9.17× 提速，同时保持很小的精度损失。引言里还有一个很关键的系统观察：在 32k 输入长度、batch 16 时，verification 最多占到总解码延迟的 87.5%，这解释了为什么优化 verification 比继续抠 draft 端更有收益。方法验证上，作者先证明只看历史注意力不够，因为 verification 一次要处理未来 w 个 token，过去的 saliency 不能稳定外推；只看 draft lookahead 也不够，因为小模型对重要 token 的判断有偏差。混合策略在 ARR 上更接近 oracle，且 ARR 与 logit KL 的相关性支持它作为代理指标。文中还提到一个负结果：如果用朴素方式在所有头和层上重算注意力重要性，超过 4k token 后，额外开销会比直接做全缓存 self-attention 还大，这个结论对任何想在 verification 路径上做“精细动态选择”的方法都很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议按“问题诊断—指标—系统设计—端到端结果”的顺序看。先看 Introduction，抓住 verification 在长上下文 speculative decoding 里的带宽瓶颈，以及静态/动态 KV 压缩各自为什么不合适。然后看 Observation 部分，尤其是作者如何比较 historical attention 和 lookahead attention 的局限，这一段决定了 hybrid 设计是否站得住。接着看 ARR 的定义和它与 logit KL 的关系，理解作者为什么用 ARR 做快速分析。最后看主结果表，重点关注 32k、batch 16、72B 这类最接近真实部署压力的设定。若只花 20 分钟，读引言、ARR 定义、hybrid policy、head subset search、主结果表和 5.4.1 的开销分析即可。若想判断能否迁移到自己的系统，值得细看不同 KV budget、不同 verification window、不同模型家族下的精度-速度折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the real bottleneck of long-context speculative decoding: verification-time KV cache loading. In large-batch, long-context generation, speculative decoding reduces some compute, but verification still has to read massive KV caches, so memory bandwidth dominates latency. Existing KV compression methods are a poor fit here. Static eviction loses accuracy because token saliency shifts over time, while dynamic selection often costs too much because importance has to be recomputed on the verification path. The paper asks whether one can cheaply identify the small subset of KV tokens that matter for a multi-step verification window, so that verification becomes sparse without noticeably hurting generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model work for two reasons. First, long-context pretraining and long-context serving are increasingly coupled in practice; once models are trained for 32k or longer contexts, deployment is constrained by KV bandwidth rather than pure FLOPs. The paper makes that bottleneck concrete. Second, it shows that token importance in speculative verification cannot be predicted well from target-model history alone because saliency drifts across future steps. Bringing in lookahead signals from the draft model is therefore not just a heuristic but a way to better match the actual verification objective. That idea may transfer to training-time sparse attention approximations or context-selection schemes where a cheap model predicts what the expensive model will need next.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dustin is a sparse verification framework specialized for speculative decoding. The problem is formulated as selecting a fixed budget of k KV positions for a verification window [i, i+w-1], with the goal of preserving as much of the original attention mass as possible. To evaluate selection quality, the paper defines Attention Recovery Rate (ARR), which measures how much attention mass is retained by the selected KV subset. The appendix further shows that ARR is strongly negatively correlated with output-logit KL divergence, making it a useful proxy for sparse-forward fidelity. The method has two main components. The first is a hybrid token-selection policy that combines historical attention from the target model with lookahead attention from the draft model. Historical attention is cheap and reflects established dependencies, while draft lookahead provides information about future tokens inside the verification block and helps handle saliency shift. The second is a sparse estimation scheme designed to keep the selector itself cheap. Instead of materializing attention importance across all heads and layers, Dustin searches for a minimal subset of attention heads that is sufficient for accurate importance estimation. This is a crucial systems choice: any dynamic selector on the verification path must be cheaper than simply running dense attention over the full KV cache, otherwise compression is pointless. The paper also positions Dustin against several baselines. Static eviction permanently discards context and therefore struggles under saliency shift. Full dynamic rescoring is accurate but too expensive. Page-level approximations such as Quest avoid exact QK^T but still incur non-trivial scoring overhead and remain slower than Dustin’s sparse estimator in the authors’ analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover the Llama3 and Qwen2.5 families on LongBench and PG-19. The analysis sections mainly use Qwen2.5-32B as the target model and Qwen2.5-0.5B as the draft model, with LongReward as the analysis dataset, whose average context length is about 13.5k tokens. The headline system result is up to 27.85x acceleration for self-attention computation and up to 9.17x decoding-phase speedup on Qwen2.5-72B at 32k context length and batch size 16, with only minimal accuracy loss. One of the most informative observations appears early: at 32k input length and batch size 16, verification can account for as much as 87.5% of total decoding latency. That explains why optimizing verification matters more than squeezing a bit more speed from the draft side. On the method side, the paper shows that historical attention alone is insufficient because speculative verification processes a future block of w tokens, so past saliency does not extrapolate reliably. Draft lookahead alone is also insufficient because the smaller model is imperfect at predicting which tokens the target model will care about. The hybrid policy gets closer to the oracle in ARR, and the ARR-to-logit-KL relationship supports ARR as a meaningful proxy. Another practically important result is negative: a naive dynamic selector that recomputes importance from all heads and layers becomes slower than full-cache self-attention beyond 4k tokens. That finding is broadly relevant for any method that tries to do fine-grained dynamic KV selection during verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim order is: bottleneck diagnosis, metric, system design, then end-to-end results. Start with the introduction to understand why verification, not drafting, dominates latency in long-context speculative decoding, and why both static and standard dynamic KV compression are mismatched to this regime. Then read the observation section comparing historical attention and draft lookahead; this is the empirical basis for the hybrid policy. Next, read the ARR definition and the evidence connecting ARR to logit KL, since ARR is the paper’s main analysis tool. Finally, inspect the main result tables, especially the 32k, batch-16, 72B settings that are closest to realistic deployment pressure. If time is limited to about 20 minutes, focus on the introduction, ARR, the hybrid policy, the head-subset search, the main throughput tables, and the overhead analysis in the section discussing naive dynamic scoring. If evaluating transferability to another serving stack, pay extra attention to the trade-offs across KV budgets, verification window sizes, and model families.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 serving 的人值得看；它不是改模型而是改验证路径，读 latency breakdown 和 token/head 选择开销， headline speedup 先别全信。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about long-context serving: it attacks the verification path rather than the model, but check the latency breakdown and selector overhead before trusting the headline speedup.

paper.title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint and decoding cost of key-value (KV) caches, limiting sustainable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Existing KV cache eviction methods typically apply heuristic token scoring over all heads in GQA-based LLMs. These methods ignore the different functionalities of attention heads, leading to the eviction of critical tokens and thus degrading the performance of LLMs. To address this issue

summary.core_problem: 现有基于注意力分数的 KV cache 驱逐方法在 GQA 架构上对所有 head 做均等聚合，忽视了 head 功能异质性，导致偏向保留 prompt 首尾的 Streaming Heads 主导打分，中间语义关键 token 被误驱逐；同时各层 KV 预算要么固定均分，要么依赖在线统计，泛化性和开销都不理想。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率方向的增量工作，主要价值在于再次明确指出 GQA 下 head 异质性对 KV 压缩策略的影响，并给出一个基于离线层误差分配预算的实用方案。对 pretrain 研究的直接启发有限，但对理解 attention head 分工、长上下文推理时的信息保留机制有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CompressKV，分三步：(1) 离线识别 Semantic Retrieval Heads（SRHs），即能同时关注 prompt 首尾 token 及其周边语义上下文的 head，而不是只盯住首尾的 Streaming Heads；(2) 在每层内仅用 SRHs 的注意力分数来选择重要 token，并在该层的所有 head 间共享同一套保留 token 索引，避免 Streaming Heads 主导驱逐决策；(3) 离线计算每层在压缩前后 attention block 输出差的 Frobenius 范数，以此估计该层对压缩误差的敏感度，按比例分配各层 KV 预算，不引入在线开销。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上评测多个 GQA LLM。LongBench 上以 19% KV 预算保留超过 99% 的全 cache 性能，3% 预算下保留约 97% 的 QA 准确率；NIAH 上以 0.7% KV 存储达到 90% 的基线检索准确率。实验验证了 SRH 选择和离线层自适应分配两个组件各自有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看方法部分对 Streaming Heads 与 Semantic Retrieval Heads 的区分、以及基于 Frobenius 范数做离线层预算分配的思路。图 1 关于 head 异质性导致误驱逐的示意比较直观。预计阅读时间 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention-score-based KV cache eviction methods for GQA models aggregate scores uniformly across heads, ignoring functional heterogeneity across attention heads. As a result, Streaming Heads that focus primarily on the beginning and end of the prompt dominate eviction decisions, causing semantically important mid-context tokens to be discarded. Existing layer budget allocation is either fixed across layers or relies on online statistics with limited generalization and non-trivial overhead.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental inference-efficiency paper. Its main value is in making the head-heterogeneity problem in GQA-based KV compression explicit and providing a practical, offline layer-budget allocation scheme. Its direct implications for pretraining are limited, but it offers useful observations on attention head specialization and information retention in long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: CompressKV consists of three steps: (1) offline identification of Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs), i.e., heads that retrieve important mid-prompt tokens and attend to their semantic context, as opposed to Streaming Heads that mostly attend to initial and final tokens; (2) important-token selection based only on SRH attention scores within each layer, with a single set of preserved token indices shared across all heads in that layer, so that eviction is no longer dominated by Streaming Heads; (3) offline error-aware layer budget allocation, where the Frobenius norm of the attention-block output difference between full and compressed cache is used to estimate per-layer compression sensitivity, and budgets are allocated proportionally without online overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack across multiple GQA LLMs. On LongBench, CompressKV retains over 99% of full-cache performance with 19% KV budget and about 97% QA accuracy with 3% budget. On NIAH, it reaches 90% of baseline retrieval accuracy with only 0.7% KV storage. Ablations support the contribution of both SRH-based token selection and offline layer-adaptive allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the distinction between Streaming Heads and Semantic Retrieval Heads, and on the offline Frobenius-based layer budget allocation idea. Figure 1 gives a clear illustration of how head heterogeneity causes incorrect eviction. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 SRH 识别和 layer budget ablation；若只在少数长文任务上有效，不要过度外推到训练期 head 分工。
recommendation.en: Read the SRH identification and layer-budget ablations; if gains are task-narrow, do not overread them as training-time head specialization.

paper.title: Forget Without Compromise: Nexus Sampling for Streaming KV-Cache Eviction Under Fixed Budgets
paper.abstract: Long-context and agentic LLM workloads push the KV cache past any fixed memory budget, forcing the inference stack to permanently evict tokens at every step of a continuous-inference stream. Existing methods all share the same template, a per-step direct-attention score followed by deterministic top-$K$ selection, which converts a single below-cutoff step into an irreversible verdict and permanently erases any subtly important token that direct attention cannot single out from noise. To address

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是长上下文连续推理中的 KV-cache 淘汰问题：当缓存超过固定显存预算时，系统必须永久丢弃一部分 token，而现有方法多用当前注意力分数做确定性 top-K，容易把一次低分误判成永久不重要。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对长上下文模型的 serving 和 agent 式持续交互有参考价值。它把 KV-cache eviction 明确建模成流式固定预算问题，而不是一次性的稀疏读取问题。这个区分有意义，因为训练阶段看到的是完整上下文，推理阶段的缓存删减会改变模型可访问的信息结构，进而影响长上下文能力的真实落地。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Nexus Sampling，是一个无需训练的 KV-cache 淘汰策略。它有两步。第一步是 Nexus scoring：不只看当前 query 对历史 token 的直接注意力，而是在注意力图上做短步迭代传播，用来提高“桥接 token”的权重。这类 token 单次直接注意力可能不高，但连接了一组相互关联的上下文片段，删掉后会破坏局部信息结构。第二步是 weighted reservoir sampling：用带权蓄水池采样替代确定性 top-K，使 token 的保留概率与权重相关，而不是一次低于阈值就被永久淘汰。论文的核心差异在于把选择机制从 hard cutoff 改成概率式保留，并把打分从局部直接注意力扩展到包含间接连接信息的权重。
summary.experiments: 关键结果集中在固定缓存密度下的长上下文性能。论文报告在 20% cache density 时，Nexus Sampling 在 LongBench 上与 dense attention 的差距约在 1 分以内；在 retrieval-heavy 的长上下文任务上优于基于确定性 top-K 的淘汰基线。内存方面，相比 dense FlashAttention-2，每个序列的 cache memory 可降低到约 1/10。理论分析给出的直觉是：蓄水池采样下 token 的长期存活由多步 inclusion probability 的乘积决定，而确定性 top-K 会在第一次低于 cutoff 时直接归零，因此更容易产生边缘 token 的单调流失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对 sparse attention 与 cache eviction 的区分，以及“monotone marginal erosion”的问题定义。方法部分重点看 Nexus scoring 的迭代传播公式和 weighted reservoir selection 的具体实现。Appendix A 的理论对比值得扫一遍，主要看 product-over-steps 与 first-below-cutoff 的差异。实验部分优先看 LongBench、retrieval-heavy tasks、不同 cache density 下的曲线；如果关注部署，还要看它与 FlashAttention-2 dense cache 的显存对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache eviction under a fixed memory budget for long-context and continuous inference. Existing methods usually score tokens by current attention and keep the deterministic top-K, which can turn a transiently low score into irreversible deletion.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference-time memory management rather than pretraining. It is still relevant for foundation-model researchers because long-context capability is only useful if the serving stack preserves the right information under memory pressure. The paper makes a useful distinction: sparse attention is a read policy over a full cache, while eviction is a streaming decision problem where deletions are permanent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Nexus Sampling combines two mechanisms. Nexus scoring augments direct attention with a short iterative walk over the attention structure, raising the weight of bridge tokens that connect clusters of mutually related context tokens but may not receive high direct attention from any single query. Weighted reservoir sampling then replaces deterministic top-K. Tokens are retained with probability proportional to the Nexus weight, so marginal but repeatedly useful tokens are less likely to be lost after one unlucky step. The main design choice is to fix both the scoring myopia and the hard-cutoff selection rule.
summary_en.experiments: At 20% cache density, the method is reported to stay within roughly one point of dense attention on LongBench. It outperforms top-K eviction baselines on retrieval-heavy long-context tasks. The paper also reports up to a 10x reduction in per-sequence cache memory compared with dense FlashAttention-2. The theoretical analysis frames the difference clearly: reservoir survival depends on a product of per-step inclusion probabilities, while deterministic top-K survival drops to zero once a token falls below the cutoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the distinction between sparse attention and irreversible eviction, and for the monotone marginal erosion failure mode. In the method section, focus on the iterative Nexus score and the weighted reservoir selection rule. Appendix A is useful for the survival-probability argument. For practical relevance, look at the LongBench results, retrieval-heavy tasks, cache-density curves, and memory comparisons against dense FlashAttention-2.

recommendation.zh: 概率化KV驱逐思路扎实，80%驱逐率下精度损失<1%，看方法和实验即可，可在推理栈AB测试
recommendation.en: Solid probabilistic KV eviction idea with <1% accuracy loss at 80% eviction, read method and experiments, ready for inference stack AB testing

paper.title: Latent Personal Memory: Represent personal memory as dynamic soft prompts
paper.abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires encoding long-term, user-specific behavioral patterns in a way that is computationally efficient, scalable, and compatible with a frozen base model. We present Latent Personal Memory (LPM), a scalable framework that represents user-specific history as a compact, persistent matrix of N latent slots, that are interpretable. A shared cross-attention projection network maps these slots into dynamic, input-conditioned soft prompts that are prepended

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是个性化 LLM 里的一个老问题：怎样在不改动基座模型的前提下，把用户长期历史压缩成可持续更新、推理成本稳定、且能随问题动态调用的记忆表示。现有几条路各有明显短板。全量上下文拼接准确但推理代价随历史长度快速上升；RAG 和文本记忆把信息保存在离散文本里，适合精确事实回忆，但很难抽象用户偏好演化，也会随着记忆库增长带来检索和上下文拥塞；LoRA 这类 per-user 参数适配会改动模型行为，存在泛化能力受扰动的风险；静态 soft prompt 又表达力不足，无法根据当前问题选择性激活不同记忆。LPM 的目标很明确：把“用户长期历史”表示成一小组可学习 latent slots，再由共享投影网络按当前输入动态生成 soft prompts，让冻结的 LLM 在几乎恒定的推理开销下利用个体记忆。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于它提升了通用预训练能力，而在于它给出了一个较干净的“外置个体记忆接口”：用户特定信息不写回主模型参数，也不以长文本形式反复喂给模型，而是压缩成可查询的连续表示，再通过 query-conditioned prompt 注入。这种设计对 pretrain/post-train 接口有启发：一方面，它把长期记忆和通用能力解耦，避免 per-user 微调污染基座；另一方面，它说明 soft prompt 不一定要是静态参数，也可以是由外部 latent memory 动态生成的条件化前缀。从系统角度看，作者把个性化问题重新表述为“低成本记忆压缩 + 条件检索”的组合，而不是“给每个用户训练一个小模型”。这对未来做 continual personalization、federated personalization、甚至多模态用户记忆压缩，都有参考价值。不过它更像 inference-time memory architecture，而不是预训练范式本身。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 per-user latent memory。每个用户 u 对应一个记忆矩阵 M_u，形状是 N×d_mem；实际实现里还用了 H 个独立 memory heads，每个 head 有自己的 slots 和投影参数，用来缓解单一记忆矩阵的瓶颈。第二部分是共享 projection network。给定当前输入 x，先用一个小型冻结 embedding model 得到输入表示 ε(x)，再让 ε(x) 作为 query、用户 memory slots 作为 key/value 做 cross-attention，得到每个 head 的检索结果；之后经过 MLP 和 LayerNorm 映射到 LLM hidden size，形成若干 soft prompt 向量，拼接后前置到原始输入前面。关键点在于 prompt 不是用户固定参数，而是由“当前问题 × 用户记忆”共同决定，因此同一用户在不同问题下会激活不同记忆子空间。

训练方式也有几个值得注意的细节。作者不是直接把整段用户历史编码成一个向量，而是把完整历史切成固定大小的 chunks，按时间顺序处理。处理第 t 个 chunk 时，使用从前一 chunk 检索出的 prompt P_{t-1} 来做 next-token prediction，这样避免未来信息泄漏。训练时更新的参数包括 cross-attention 的 W_Q/W_K/W_V、MLP、LayerNorm，以及用户自己的 memory slots；基座 LLM 完全冻结。为了避免 slot-attention 坍缩到少数槽位，作者加入了一个 hinge-style entropy regularizer：当注意力熵低于目标值时才惩罚，目的是防止所有槽位学成同一语义，同时又不强迫完全均匀分配。这个设计比直接最大化熵更稳，因为记忆检索本来就应该允许在某些问题上高度集中。另一个工程选择是共享 projection network 的梯度在所有用户上累积后每个 epoch 再更新一次，以降低 per-user 更新带来的噪声；这也让它更接近可扩展的 federated setting。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 PersonaMem v1 和 LoCoMo，两套数据都面向长期个性化记忆，但侧重点不同。骨干模型用的是 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B，说明作者想验证方法对不同容量冻结模型的兼容性。主要结论有三点。

第一，在 PersonaMem v1 上，LPM 相比 LoRA 和 Prompt Tuning 都有稳定优势。摘要给出的数字是：整体准确率相对 LoRA 最多提升 8.8%，相对 Prompt Tuning 最多提升 54.4%。这说明动态 memory-conditioned prompt 的表达力明显强于静态 prompt，也说明在这个任务上，把用户信息写进少量适配参数不如显式维护可检索记忆。

第二，LPM 接近 full-context 的准确率，但推理代价显著更低。作者报告最高可做到 64× 更小的 KV cache 和 4× 更低延迟。这里的意义不是单纯省显存，而是它的成本基本不随历史长度线性恶化；对长周期用户交互，这比一次性在短 benchmark 上多几个点更重要。

第三，在 LoCoMo 上，LPM 与 LoRA 准确率相当，但训练参数量少约 120×。这说明它在某些更难压缩或更偏事实回忆的场景里，未必总能明显超过参数适配，但至少能用更小的 per-user 状态达到接近效果。

从文中描述看，作者还强调了可解释性：不同 memory heads 和 slots 可以对应不同类型的用户信息。虽然这里没有看到特别强的定量解释性评测，但如果附录里给了 slot 可视化或 attention 分布案例，值得重点看。另一个值得留意的点是 chunked compression 的训练动态：如果 chunk 太短，记忆更新可能碎片化；太长又会削弱压缩优势。文中若有 N、H、slot 数量、正则强度的消融，这些比主表更能说明方法边界。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但方法部分要看细。优先看 Introduction 里对几类 personalization 路线的拆分，作者把 full-context、RAG/text memory、LoRA、prompt tuning、latent memory 的取舍讲得比较清楚。然后直接看方法图和 LPMMethodology，重点抓三件事：一是 per-user latent slots 如何组织；二是 query-conditioned cross-attention 如何把 memory 变成动态 soft prompts；三是 chunk-by-chunk 训练时为什么要用前一块生成的 prompt 来避免泄漏。实验部分建议先看 PersonaMem v1 主表，再看效率表，确认它到底是“更准”还是“更省”；LoCoMo 的结果主要用来判断它在另一类长期记忆任务上的稳健性。预计 25 到 35 分钟能把主线读明白；如果要深挖，重点看 entropy regularizer、memory head 设计和附录里的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical personalization problem: how to encode long-term user-specific behavior into a form that is compact, query-aware, and usable by a frozen LLM without replaying the full history at inference time. Existing options each fail on one axis. Full-context prompting preserves fidelity but scales poorly in latency and KV cache. RAG and text-memory systems keep growing external stores and operate in discrete text space, which is good for exact recall but weak at abstracting evolving preferences. Per-user LoRA modifies the model itself and can interfere with general capabilities. Static prompt tuning is lightweight but too limited to express rich user state. LPM is designed to sit in between: store user history in a small latent memory, then convert that memory into input-conditioned soft prompts so the same frozen backbone can behave differently for different users and different queries.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is less about improving pretraining directly and more about defining a clean interface between a general model and persistent user memory. The method separates universal knowledge from user-specific state: the base model stays frozen, while personalization lives in a compact external latent representation. That is an important design choice if one cares about continual personalization, federated deployment, or avoiding contamination of the base model through per-user adaptation. It also broadens the notion of soft prompting. Instead of learning a static prompt per user, LPM generates prompts dynamically from the interaction between the current query and a user memory bank. Conceptually, this is closer to a learned memory read mechanism than to standard PEFT. It is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-deployment interface and to architectures for persistent memory.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LPM has two main components. First, each user u owns a persistent latent memory matrix M_u with N slots of dimension d_mem. In practice, the memory is split into H independent heads, each with its own slots and projection parameters, to avoid overloading a single memory bank. Second, a shared projection network turns those slots into prompts conditioned on the current input x. The input is embedded with a small frozen embedding model to produce epsilon(x). Then epsilon(x) attends over the user memory through cross-attention, using the input as query and the slots as key/value. Each head produces a retrieved representation, which is passed through an MLP and LayerNorm to match the hidden size of the frozen LLM. The resulting vectors are concatenated and prepended as soft prompts.

The key distinction from prompt tuning is that the prompt is not static. It depends jointly on the query and the user memory, so the same user can expose different aspects of memory for different questions. The training procedure is also carefully designed. User history is split into fixed-size chunks and processed sequentially. For chunk t, the model predicts next tokens using a prompt retrieved from the previous chunk, P_{t-1}, which prevents future-token leakage. Trainable parameters include the cross-attention projections, the MLP, LayerNorm, and the user-specific memory slots; the backbone LLM remains frozen throughout. To avoid attention collapse onto a few slots, the paper adds a hinge-style entropy regularizer: it penalizes low-entropy slot attention only when entropy falls below a target threshold. This is more sensible than forcing uniform attention, because memory retrieval should sometimes be sharp. Another notable engineering choice is to accumulate gradients for the shared projection network across users and update once per epoch, reducing noisy user-level updates and making the setup more compatible with federated training.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation uses PersonaMem v1 and LoCoMo with frozen Qwen3 backbones at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B. The main empirical message is consistent across scales.

On PersonaMem v1, LPM outperforms both LoRA and prompt tuning. The abstract reports gains of up to 8.8% over LoRA and 54.4% over prompt tuning in overall accuracy. That gap is meaningful because LoRA is already a stronger personalization baseline than static prompts in many settings. It suggests that dynamic memory-conditioned prompting is a better fit than storing user information in small adapter weights.

LPM also approaches the accuracy of full-context inference while being much cheaper. The reported efficiency numbers are up to 64x smaller KV cache and 4x lower latency. This matters because the method is intended for long-horizon deployment, where inference cost grows with user history under full-context approaches.

On LoCoMo, LPM matches LoRA-level accuracy while using roughly 120x fewer trainable parameters. That result is more nuanced: it suggests that in some settings LPM is not strictly more accurate, but it can reach similar quality with a much smaller per-user footprint.

The paper also claims interpretability through latent slots and multiple heads. If the appendix includes slot visualizations or attention patterns, those are worth checking, because interpretability is otherwise easy to overclaim in latent-memory systems. The most informative ablations are likely the number of slots, number of heads, chunk size, and the entropy regularizer strength, since those determine whether the memory is actually compressing useful long-range information rather than acting as a weak prompt adapter.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a memory-architecture paper, not as a generic PEFT paper. Start with the introduction, where the authors separate full-context, RAG/text memory, LoRA, prompt tuning, and latent memory. That framing is useful and mostly fair. Then go straight to the main method figure and the LPM methodology section. Three details matter most: how per-user latent slots are organized, how cross-attention turns them into query-conditioned prompts, and how chunk-wise training avoids leakage by using prompts from the previous chunk. In the experiments, first inspect the main PersonaMem table, then the efficiency comparison, to see whether the method is winning on quality, cost, or both. LoCoMo is mainly useful as a robustness check on a different long-horizon memory benchmark. A careful skim should take around half an hour. If reading deeper, focus on the entropy regularizer, the multi-head memory design, and the appendix ablations.

recommendation.zh: 把“记忆”做成latent slots→动态soft prompt，直接给出参数量/KV-cache的量化账本；建议重点看128K对比与LoRA等价性是否干净。
recommendation.en: Memory-as-latent-slots → dynamic soft prompts with a clear params vs KV-cache ledger; scrutinize the 128K comparisons and whether the LoRA parity is clean.

paper.title: Kamera: Unified Position-Invariant Multimodal KV Cache for Training-Free Reuse
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents repeatedly re-examine the same video frames, UI screenshots, and rendered artifacts as their context window slides and reasoning iterates, yet every look-back re-encodes from scratch, because prefix caches serve reuse only at a fixed leading position. We show this recompute is avoidable, and identify exactly what naive KV reuse loses: the cross-chunk conditioning a chunk absorbs from its neighbours. This loss is asymmetric. The direct readout of a cached chunk is recovered exac

summary.core_problem: 多模态 Agent 的典型工作流（滑动窗口回看视频帧、UI 截图、文档页）会反复对同一段视觉内容重新编码，因为传统前缀缓存/基数缓存只支持“固定起始位置 + 字节级相同前缀”下的复用，一旦位置偏移、前缀变化或内容被换出后再召回，就必须重新做视觉编码和 KV prefill。现有针对 KV 复用的修补方案（重算少量关键 token）针对的是单跳场景，无法修复多跳推理真正依赖的跨块绑定信息。
summary.importance: 定位了朴素 KV 复用的信息损失的结构：损失不是单跳读取项，而是被缓存块从其邻居吸收来的跨块条件信息。该损失在 token 维度弥散、在特征维度低秩、且集中在深层——这一结构诊断直接否定了“挑几个重要 token 重算”路线在多跳窗口化 Agent 场景下的有效性。工作把 KV 复用以位置为索引的范式改成了以内容为索引，对长上下文多模态 Agent 的工程实现和缓存架构设计有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 把一段内容 B 的 KV 拆成两部分：无前缀的 canonical KV(B|∅)，以及条件化残差 Δ = KV(B|A) − KV(B|∅)，后者是 B 在前缀 A 下做 prefill 时吸收到的跨块绑定信息。经验上 Δ 具有三个性质：token 维弥散（oracle 选 token 也要大约 50% 才能恢复）、特征维低秩（约 90% 输出相关能量集中在约 32 个方向）、深层集中。因此不用重算 token，而是给每个 chunk 存一个 canonical KV 加一个秩 m 的条件化 patch（Δ 的 top-m SVD 分解）。复用时先对 canonical 的 key 做 RoPE 相位旋转对齐新绝对位置，再叠加上 patch，即可恢复条件化 KV。同一 chunk 的 canonical + patch 支持在任意位置、任意前缀组合下复用。这套机制覆盖 MLA、GQA、MHA 三种注意力布局，且无需训练、无需在线重算。基于此把重排序、滑动窗口存活、可逆逐出三类操作从 O(n) prefill 改造成毫秒级缓存编辑。
