summary.experiments: 给出了结构分析和多跳任务上的定量对比。诊断层面：盲复用下单跳问答准确率保持不变（两页文档任务 MLA 为 0.57），多跳准确率 MLA 从 0.41 掉到 0.28，GQA 从 0.28 掉到 0.15——模型输出依然通顺，但不再能解析“前面展示过的那个物体”这类指代。方法对比层面：CacheBlend、VLCache、EPIC、MPIC 等基于重算少量 token 的方法在真实多跳视频任务上平均只能恢复约 20% 的答案翻转，任何 token 预算下最高不超过 36%；而 rank-m patch 方案恢复了约 97%。延迟层面：编码 1024 token 视频段约需 230ms 视觉塔计算，重放已缓存 KV 约需 5ms。
summary.reading_guide: 优先读第 2 节对 Δ 的定义和结构分析，这是全文论证的核心，也是与既有 KV 压缩/复用路线的根本区别；第 3 节的 patch 形式化和三种注意力布局的统一处理；第 5 节三类窗口操作（重排序/滑动存活/可逆逐出）的工程落地方式；第 6 节与既有方法的对比实验。对 Δ 的低秩和深层集中性质的图可以多停留。第 4 节的编译/运行时集成细节如果不做系统工程可以略读。预计阅读时间 50-70 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构与作者信息在提供的全文片段中未完整呈现。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal agents routinely re-examine the same video frames, UI screenshots, or document pages as they slide attention windows, iterate on reasoning, or re-admit evicted content. Traditional prefix and radix caches only support reuse under a fixed leading position with a byte-identical prefix. Once position shifts, prefix changes, or content is recalled after eviction, the vision-tower encode and KV prefill must be redone from scratch. Existing KV-reuse fixes, which recompute a small set of 'important tokens', are designed for single-hop scenarios and fail to recover the cross-chunk binding that multi-hop reasoning actually depends on.
summary_en.importance: This work precisely characterizes what naive KV reuse loses: not the direct readout term, but the cross-chunk conditioning that a cached block absorbs from its neighbors. This deficit is diffuse across tokens, low-rank in features, and concentrated in deep layers — a structural diagnosis that directly explains why token-selection methods underperform on windowed multi-hop agent tasks. The result reframes KV reuse from a position-indexed regime to a content-indexed one, with direct implications for the engineering of long-context multimodal agents and cache architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The KV of a chunk B is decomposed into a prefix-free canonical form KV(B|∅) plus a conditioning residue Δ = KV(B|A) − KV(B|∅), where the latter captures the cross-chunk binding B absorbs when prefilling under antecedent A. Empirically Δ is diffuse across tokens (an oracle token selector needs ≈50% of tokens to recover), low-rank in features (≈90% of output-relevant energy concentrated in ≈32 directions), and concentrated in deep layers. Instead of recomputing tokens, the method stores per chunk a canonical KV plus a rank-m conditioning patch (the top-m SVD factors of Δ). At reuse time, the canonical keys are re-rotated via RoPE phase shift to match the new absolute position, and the patch is added on top to recover conditioned KV. The same canonical+patch supports reuse at any position and under any prefix combination. The mechanism unifies MLA, GQA, and MHA layouts and is both training-free and online-recompute-free. It turns three window operations — reorder, sliding-window survival, and reversible eviction — from O(n) prefills into millisecond cache edits.
summary_en.experiments: Structural diagnostics show that blind reuse leaves single-hop QA accuracy unchanged (0.57 on a two-page document task for MLA) while multi-hop accuracy drops from 0.41→0.28 for MLA and 0.28→0.15 for GQA: outputs remain fluent, but references like 'the object shown earlier' are no longer resolved. On a realistic multi-hop video task, token-reselection baselines (CacheBlend, VLCache, EPIC, MPIC) recover on average ≈20% of answer flips, ≤36% at any token budget, whereas the rank-m patch recovers ≈97%. Latency numbers place a 1024-token video segment encode at ≈230 ms of vision-tower compute, while replay of cached KV costs ≈5 ms.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 first for the definition of Δ and its structural characterization — this is the paper's core argument and the root distinction from prior KV compression/reuse lines. Then Section 3 for the patch formalization and the unified treatment across MLA/GQA/MHA layouts, Section 5 for the three window-operation mechanics, and Section 6 for the comparison to existing approaches. Spend extra time on plots documenting Δ's low-rank, deep-layer structure. Section 4 on compile/runtime integration can be skimmed if systems engineering is not the focus. Estimated reading time: 50-70 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information is not fully specified in the provided manuscript excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 多模态KV复用的误差拆解很干净，低秩补丁思路可直接迁移到长上下文VLM推理管线，重点看§3误差分解与§4补丁设计。
recommendation.en: The error decomposition of multimodal KV reuse is clean; the low-rank patch idea can be directly migrated to long-context VLM inference pipelines, focus on §3 error decomposition and §4 patch design.

paper.title: Geometry-Aware Online Scheduling for LLM Serving: From Theoretical Bound to System Practice
paper.abstract: The explosive demand for interactive Large Language Model serving has highlighted the management of the Key-Value cache's dynamic memory footprint as a critical area for performance optimization in inference engines. Modern inference systems overwhelmingly rely on time-centric scheduling heuristics, such as Shortest Job First. However, their theoretical optimality is rooted in traditional schedule modeling, failing to capture the highly dynamic, 2D spatio-temporal geometric growth specific to LL

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理调度普遍采用SJF（短作业优先）等一维时间优先的启发式策略，未建模LLM推理独有的KV缓存时空二维动态增长特性：自回归解码每生成一个token就线性扩张KV内存占用，连续批处理机制带来batch size的动态波动。已有理论证明SJF在LLM服务模型下最坏情况竞争比无界，导致平均延迟与尾延迟优化存在根本性缺陷。
summary.importance: 现有LLM服务调度多依赖工程启发式，缺少跨工作负载的通用性能保证。这套几何调度框架把KV缓存与时间的耦合关系建模从经验试错推进到有严格理论界支撑的层面，为推理友好的预训练设计、KV缓存结构优化、长序列训练的内存-时间权衡提供了系统侧的参考基准。轻量版1-bit SVF几乎不需要额外预测开销，可直接集成进vLLM等主流推理框架，落地成本低。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是将调度优先级从一维的“剩余执行时间”替换为二维的“KV缓存占用对时间的积分（即KV体积）”，提出Smallest Volume First（SVF）算法：优先调度KV体积最小的请求，从几何层面匹配LLM推理的内存-时间耦合特性。进一步提出1-bit SVF轻量变体，仅需1比特信息（判断请求输出长度属于长序列还是短序列）即可实现接近完整SVF的调度效果，无需精准预测输出长度。理论推导覆盖不同流量模型、不同信息可得性下的四类竞争比界，其中突发流量到达、已知输出长度场景下的最坏情况竞争比从此前的48收紧至5。实现上为vLLM的即插即用调度器替换，与分页注意力、连续批处理等现有底层执行优化完全兼容。
summary.experiments: 集成进vLLM的评测显示，SVF可同时降低平均延迟与尾延迟；1-bit SVF仅需极少量预测信息，调度本身计算开销可忽略，性能接近完整SVF。算法与现有推理系统的执行层优化无冲突，叠加使用不会引入额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言中对传统调度理论与LLM推理动态特性的本质差异分析，以及SVF/1-bit SVF的核心设计逻辑、理论边界条件。形式化证明部分可跳过，系统实现部分仅需了解与vLLM的集成方式即可，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。从事推理系统研发的读者可重点关注几何建模的证明思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference schedulers overwhelmingly rely on 1D time-centric heuristics such as Shortest Job First (SJF), which fail to model the unique 2D spatio-temporal dynamics of LLM decoding: autoregressive generation linearly expands KV cache memory per output token, and continuous batching introduces dynamic fluctuations in concurrent batch size. Prior theoretical work has proven SJF has an unbounded worst-case competitive ratio under LLM-specific serving models, creating fundamental limits to average and tail latency optimization.
summary_en.importance: Most production LLM scheduling rules are derived from ad-hoc engineering heuristics without universal performance guarantees across workloads. The geometric scheduling framework models the coupled dynamics of KV cache memory and time with rigorous competitive ratio bounds, providing a system-level reference for inference-aware pretraining design, KV cache compression, and memory-time tradeoffs in long-context training. The lightweight 1-bit SVF variant requires almost no additional prediction overhead and can be directly integrated into mainstream inference frameworks such as vLLM with minimal deployment cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design replaces the 1D 'remaining processing time' priority metric with a 2D measure: the integral of KV cache consumption over time, referred to as KV 'volume'. The Smallest Volume First (SVF) algorithm prioritizes requests with the smallest predicted KV volume, natively matching the memory-time coupling of LLM decoding. A lightweight 1-bit SVF variant requires only a single bit of information (whether a request will produce a long or short output) to achieve near-SVF performance, eliminating the need for precise output length prediction. Four separate competitive ratio bounds are derived across traffic models and information availability settings; most notably, the worst-case competitive ratio under burst arrival with known output lengths is tightened from the prior bound of 48 to 5. The implementation is a plug-and-play scheduler replacement for vLLM, fully compatible with existing execution optimizations including paged attention and continuous batching.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations in the vLLM framework show SVF reduces both average and tail latency across workloads. 1-bit SVF delivers near-identical performance with negligible scheduling compute overhead, requiring no precise length prediction. The scheduler operates orthogonally to lower-level inference optimizations, and can be deployed without modifying existing execution engine logic.
summary_en.reading_guide: For casual reading, focus on the introduction's analysis of fundamental mismatches between classical scheduling theory and LLM inference dynamics, the core design logic of SVF and 1-bit SVF, and the high-level conditions for the theoretical bounds. Formal proofs can be skipped unless working directly on LLM serving systems; skim the implementation section for vLLM integration notes. Expected reading time: 15-20 minutes. Readers focused on inference systems may dive into the proof methodology for the geometric scheduling model.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度模型和竞争比证明即可；它把 KV-cache 成本从“时间”改成“体积”，这个抽象值得系统侧复用。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduling model and competitive-ratio proof; the useful abstraction is treating KV-cache cost as volume rather than time.

paper.title: SpotAttention: Plug-In Block-Sparse Routing for Pretrained Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: Long contexts have become standard in pretrained LLMs, yet they remain expensive to run: prefill compute grows quadratically with sequence length, and every decode step re-reads a key-value cache that grows linearly with it. Sparse attention cuts these costs by attending only to a relevant subset of past tokens, but selecting that subset is itself expensive. We present SpotAttention, a lightweight selector that attaches to a frozen pretrained transformer and learns by KL distillation to estimate

summary.core_problem: 现有预训练长上下文LLM的稀疏注意力方案存在选择器计算开销高、无法即插即用适配已训练完成的主模型的问题。
summary.importance: 验证了无需修改预训练主模型结构、仅通过外挂轻量选择器加KL蒸馏即可实现高效稀疏注意力，为长上下文模型的推理优化提供了与预训练解耦的可行路径，也揭示了不同层注意力预算存在不对称性这一训练动态特征。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计即插即用的块级稀疏选择器，挂载在已冻结的预训练Transformer每一层全注意力层上，仅通过KL散度蒸馏匹配原模型的头平均注意力分布，无需重新训练主模型；2. 选择器采用块级Q-K评分（按查询块×键块而非逐token计算），可直接通过张量核矩阵乘实现，降低选择开销；3. 提出双top-p规则，直接从选择器输出的校准注意力分布中为每个查询、每层动态分配注意力预算，同时预留sink和近邻块避免被核采样过滤，无需额外剪枝阶段；4. 支持对选择器的K缓存做INT4/FP4量化进一步降低内存开销。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3（稠密注意力，4B-32B）和Qwen3.5（混合线性/全注意力，4B-9B）共7个backbone上完成选择器训练，其中5个完成完整验证；128K上下文解码场景下，Qwen3-8B的吞吐量是FlashAttention的3.9倍、是Twilight的1.8倍；选择器K缓存量化到INT4/FP4可缩小3.5倍体积且保持BF16级精度；在最长128K上下文下性能与稠密注意力持平；观测到不同层的注意力预算存在显著不对称性，静态top-K规则无法匹配该特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节方法部分的双top-p规则设计、第4节的长上下文吞吐量与精度对比实验，附录中的选择器结构与训练策略消融实验；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing sparse attention solutions for pretrained long-context LLMs face two core bottlenecks: high computation overhead of the token selector, and lack of plug-and-play compatibility with fully trained backbone models.
summary_en.importance: Validates that efficient sparse attention can be achieved without modifying pretrained backbone architecture, via a lightweight add-on selector trained with KL distillation. This provides a pretraining-decoupled path for long-context inference optimization, and reveals notable inter-layer attention budget asymmetry as a previously underdiscussed training dynamic.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A plug-in block-wise sparse selector is attached to each frozen full-attention layer of a pretrained Transformer, trained only via KL divergence to match the backbone's head-averaged attention distribution, with no retraining of the main model. 2. Block-wise Q-K scoring (per query-block × key-block tile instead of per-token) runs as a single tensor-core matrix multiplication, cutting selector overhead sharply. 3. A dual top-p rule directly allocates per-query, per-layer attention budgets from the selector's calibrated output distribution, with reserved sink and recency blocks to avoid exclusion by nucleus sampling and no separate pruning stage. 4. INT4/FP4 quantization of the selector's K-cache is supported for further memory reduction.
summary_en.experiments: Selector training completed on 7 backbones across two architecture families: Qwen3 (dense attention, 4B–32B) and Qwen3.5 (hybrid linear/full attention, 4B–9B), with full validation on 5 of them. For Qwen3-8B at 128K context decode, throughput reaches 3.9× FlashAttention and 1.8× Twilight. Quantizing the selector's K-cache to INT4/FP4 reduces its size by 3.5× while retaining BF16-level accuracy. Performance matches dense attention at contexts up to 128K; significant inter-layer attention budget asymmetry is observed, which static top-K rules cannot match.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (dual top-p rule design in the method pipeline), Section 4 (long-context throughput and accuracy comparison experiments), and ablation studies on selector structure and training strategy in the appendix; estimated reading time 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §方法和长外推实验；若 128K 上真能稳住精度，内部长上下文服务应复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and length-extrapolation experiments; if 128K accuracy holds, this deserves an internal serving reproduction.

paper.title: HyperQuant: A Rate-Distortion-Optimal Quantization Pipeline for Large Language and Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We present HyperQuant (Hadamard, optimallY Packing, Entropy Rice-coding), a unified post-training quantization pipeline for the weights and the KV cache of large language and diffusion transformers. Across a suite of self-contained experiments (Table 1), HyperQuant outperforms the recent HIGGS scheme at every operating point from 3 to 5 bits per scalar (bps) on weights, and beats both TurboQuant and OCTOPUS on KV quantization down to 1.7 bps. Beyond the LLM setting, HyperQuant quantizes the 19B-

summary.core_problem: 现有覆盖LLM、扩散Transformer的训练后量化方案（权重量化+KV缓存量化）普遍采用固定码率码本，未充分利用熵编码的压缩潜力，同时低比特下KV缓存的内积估计存在系统性偏差，缺乏无数据依赖、适配硬件计算指令、达到最优率失真权衡的统一量化流水线。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的HyperQuant是工程完成度较高的无数据训练后量化方案，在3-5比特权重量化、1.7-3比特KV缓存量化区间性能超过此前公开方案，同时统一支持自回归LLM和DiT结构的视频扩散模型，对推理部署有直接工程参考价值；其对量化率失真差距的量化分解、格点量化加熵编码的组合设计，也为后续量化方案优化提供了清晰的对比基线。
summary.technical_approach: HyperQuant将四个成熟信号处理组件按率失真最优原则组装为统一流水线：1）按硬件MMA计算块和格点维度做分块随机哈达玛变换，将权重和KV向量的分布转为近似高斯，变换可折叠进前序RMSNorm/LayerNorm操作，无额外运行时开销；2）采用低维最优格点（E8/D4/A2）做向量量化，消除有限大小Lloyd码本存在的码本外误差；3）剥离格点成员身份可确定的冗余比特，对量化索引用适配高斯分布的Rice编码做熵编码，实际码率与目标码率偏差在0.01bps以内；4）针对KV缓存设计偏差校正选项，包括±1随机旋转、量化Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换和减性抖动，证明减性格点抖动可保证单向量级别的内积估计无偏，而非仅分布平均无偏。
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3.1-8B上，3-5bps权重量化全区间性能超过此前的HIGGS方案，4bps下实现权重压缩3.9倍、KV缓存压缩3.79倍，精度接近无损；KV缓存量化在1.7bps下性能超过TurboQuant和OCTOPUS；同一条流水线应用于19B参数的LTX-2视频DiT模型，4bps下权重压缩3.7倍，无可见逐帧画质损失。消融实验拆解了与HIGGS的性能差距来源：约2/3来自固定码率的索引冗余（任何熵编码改造都可回收这部分收益），约1/3来自无限格点码本相对有限Lloyd码本的结构优势；E8格点相对低维格点在3bps下可带来0.53PPL的额外增益，4bps以上增益可忽略。KV缓存量化存在两个清晰的质量区间：≥2.5bps时所有偏差校正变体的PPL与fp16差距在0.04以内，1.7-2.5bps区间QJL风格旋转可带来最高0.5PPL的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 从事推理优化和部署的读者可精读，预训练方向读者泛读即可。重点关注第6章的率失真差距分解、KV缓存两档质量区间的结论，以及格点量化加熵编码的核心设计思路，不需要过度纠结具体硬件适配细节，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) pipelines for LLMs and diffusion Transformers (covering both weight and KV cache quantization) rely on fixed-rate codebooks, leaving entropy coding compression potential untapped. Low-bit KV cache quantization also suffers from systematic inner product estimation bias, and no unified, data-free, hardware-aligned pipeline exists that achieves optimal rate-distortion tradeoffs across both autoregressive and diffusion model families.
summary_en.importance: HyperQuant is a production-ready, data-free PTQ pipeline that outperforms prior open schemes across the 3-5 bps weight quantization and 1.7-3 bps KV cache quantization regimes, with unified support for both LLMs and DiT-based video diffusion models, delivering direct practical value for inference deployment. Its explicit decomposition of quantization rate-distortion gaps, and the combined lattice quantization + entropy coding design, set a clear baseline for future quantization optimization work.
summary_en.technical_approach: HyperQuant assembles four established signal processing components into a rate-distortion optimal unified pipeline: 1) Tile-wise Randomized Hadamard Transform aligned to hardware MMA tile sizes and lattice dimensions, transforming weight and KV vector distributions to approximate Gaussian, with transforms foldable into preceding RMSNorm/LayerNorm operations for zero runtime overhead; 2) Vector quantization with optimal low-dimensional lattices (E8/D4/A2), eliminating out-of-codebook error present in finite-size Lloyd codebooks; 3) Bit-stripping of redundant bits deterministically fixed by lattice membership, followed by Rice coding of quantization indices calibrated to per-tile Gaussian distributions, achieving actual bitrates within 0.01 bps of target values; 4) KV cache bias correction options including ±1 random rotation, quantized Johnson-Lindenstrauss transform, and subtractive dither, with formal proof that subtractive lattice dither guarantees per-vector inner product unbiasedness rather than only distribution-average unbiasedness.
summary_en.experiments: On Llama-3.1-8B, HyperQuant outperforms the prior leading scheme HIGGS across all 3-5 bps weight operating points, achieving ~3.9x weight compression and ~3.79x KV cache compression at 4 bps with near-lossless quality. KV cache quantization outperforms TurboQuant and OCTOPUS down to 1.7 bps. The same pipeline applied to the 19B-parameter LTX-2 video DiT delivers 3.7x weight compression at 4 bps with no observable per-frame artifacts. Ablations decompose the performance gap to HIGGS: ~2/3 comes from fixed-rate index redundancy recoverable via entropy coding, ~1/3 comes from the structural advantage of unbounded lattice codebooks over finite Lloyd codebooks; E8 lattices deliver an additional 0.53 PPL gain at 3 bps with negligible gains above 4 bps. KV cache quantization shows two clear regimes: ≥2.5 bps where all bias correction variants are within 0.04 PPL of fp16, and 1.7-2.5 bps where QJL-style rotation delivers up to 0.5 PPL advantage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Readers focused on inference optimization and deployment can read in full; pretraining researchers may skim. Focus on the rate-distortion gap decomposition in Section 6, the two-regime characterization of KV cache quantization quality, and the core lattice quantization + entropy coding design. Hardware-specific implementation details can be skipped for readers not focused on serving systems. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是新数学，但把 Hadamard、lattice 和熵编码拼得很工程化；只看 Table 1 和 H100 端到端段落即可。
recommendation.en: The math is not new, but the Hadamard-lattice-entropy stack looks engineered well; read Table 1 and the H100 end-to-end section.

paper.title: Recency/Frequency Adaptive KV Caching for Large Language Model Serving
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is a powerful technique for accelerating large language model inference and generation. Inference workloads are large and diverse, which makes them difficult to cache effectively. Existing cache management strategies adopt the least-recently-used policy for evicting cache blocks. However, LRU leads to multiple unrelated workloads flushing each other's caches. To address this, we integrate adaptive caching that dynamically allocates cache space between recently and frequent

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM serving 中 KV cache 只按 LRU 驱逐时，异质请求流会相互冲刷缓存、降低命中率和首 token 延迟的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统层面的缓存策略改进，对长上下文、多租户和 RAG/文档问答服务有实际参考价值；贡献是把 recency 与 frequency 自适应结合，而不是改模型结构或训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法在 KV cache 管理中动态分配空间给最近出现和高频出现的 cache blocks，避免单纯 LRU 被多个无关 workload 轮流污染。它面向 vLLM 式块级 KV 管理，可解释性较强，并支持 batch inference。
summary.experiments: 在合成文档问答 workload 上，相比 naive vLLM，KV cache hit rate 最多提升 10.8%，TTFT 最多降低 12.6%；在真实对话 workload 上，命中率和 TTFT 分别提升 2.1% 和 2.0%。摘要未给出模型规模和硬件细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache eviction in LLM serving, where a pure LRU policy lets heterogeneous request streams flush each other’s useful cache blocks and hurts time to first token.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution relevant to long-context, multi-tenant, and RAG/document-QA serving. The main idea is an adaptive recency-frequency cache policy rather than a change to model architecture or training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method dynamically partitions KV-cache capacity between recently accessed and frequently reused blocks, reducing cache pollution from unrelated workloads. It targets vLLM-style block-level KV management, remains interpretable, and generalizes to batched inference.
summary_en.experiments: On synthetic document-QA workloads, it improves KV-cache hit rate by up to 10.8% and reduces TTFT by up to 12.6% over naive vLLM. On real conversation workloads, the gains are 2.1% hit-rate improvement and 2.0% TTFT reduction. Model scale and hardware details are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验 workload 和消融即可；真实对话收益很小，但 recency/frequency 拆分适合内网 serving 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the workload setup and ablations only; real-chat gains are small, but the recency/frequency split is worth reproducing in internal serving.

paper.title: WiSP: A Working-Set View of Mixture-of-Experts Serving on Extremely Low-Resource Hardware
paper.abstract: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models place most of their parameters in expert layers, yet only a small fraction of those experts are used for any token. The unused weights must still be stored where the GPU can reach them. On commodity GPUs the common fix is layer-level CPU offloading, which keeps memory low but streams all of a layer's experts across PCIe on every forward pass, losing much of MoE's sparsity benefit. We cast low-resource MoE serving as a working-set management problem on the G

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但很现实的问题：在显存极小、并发很低的硬件上，怎么把 MoE 模型跑起来，同时尽量保住 MoE 稀疏激活带来的推理收益。传统 layer-level CPU offload 会把整层专家都搬到 GPU，实际没有利用 routing 稀疏性，PCIe 传输开销很大。
summary.importance: 它不属于预训练方法本身，但对大模型系统研究有启发，尤其是 MoE 架构在低资源部署时的真实瓶颈。文章最有价值的点是把问题重新表述成 working-set management：专家权重和 KV cache 不是两个独立模块，而是在同一块 VRAM 上竞争的两类驻留对象。这个视角对训练侧也有借鉴意义，因为它提醒人们，MoE 的理论稀疏性只有在内存层级和调度策略配合时才会兑现。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 WiSP，把低资源 MoE serving 设计成 routing-aware expert paging。核心机制是在不改 serving engine、kernel、模型权重和数值精度的前提下，利用引擎已有的间接寻址，把每层 MoE expert 重定向到一小块 GPU scratch space，只把当前需要、且值得保留的专家页驻留在显存中，其余放在主存。这样输出保持 byte-identical。

更关键的是内存分配策略。作者认为 expert pages 和 KV cache 共享同一 VRAM 预算，单独优化任一方都可能拖累整体吞吐，于是提出 MV-WSA，用“每字节带来的边际延迟收益”来决定两者的内存切分，并设置最小 KV 预算保证 admission。文中同时给出 offline configurator 和 online controller。另一个结论也很实在：在低并发 decode 场景里，routing prediction 用来 prefetch 专家帮助不大，因为没有足够计算去隐藏 PCIe 传输，瓶颈主要是带宽，不是预测准确率。
summary.experiments:
实验主要围绕吞吐和内存预算展开。结论很清楚：当模型放不进 VRAM 时，在相同显存预算下，WiSP 相比静态 offload 的 decode throughput 最多提升 1.95×；当模型本身能完整驻留显存时，静态常驻更快，因为 paging 额外引入了间接层。作者把这个 crossover 明确报告出来，这一点比较诚实。

在内存切分上，offline configurator 是唯一一个在 prefill 和 decode 两阶段都表现稳定的策略；仿真中它距离按工作流定制的 oracle 只差几个百分点，而固定切分大约差 20%。online controller 在相同 VRAM 预算下还能比最佳 offline split 再提升 1.20×。这些结果说明，真正决定低资源 MoE 服务性能的，不只是 expert cache 命中率，还包括 expert 与 KV 两个工作集的联合管理。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把问题设定和适用边界看清：低并发、交互式、显存受限，不是大批量数据中心 serving。然后看系统设计图，理解 scratch space、专家页替换和与现有引擎的接口方式。最后看 MV-WSA 的定义和实验表，重点关注 throughput-vs-VRAM 曲线、静态 offload 与 WiSP 的交叉点，以及 offline/online 分配策略的比较。若只想抓住主线，30-45 分钟足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical serving problem: how to run MoE models on very small GPUs under low-concurrency interactive workloads without throwing away the sparsity advantage of expert routing. Standard layer-level CPU offload moves all experts in a layer over PCIe, even though only a few are actually used per token.
summary_en.importance: This is a systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to MoE research because it clarifies where sparsity gains disappear in real deployments. The main conceptual contribution is the working-set view: expert weights and the KV cache should be treated as two competing memory streams sharing the same VRAM budget. That framing is useful beyond serving because it makes explicit that MoE efficiency depends on memory hierarchy and residency policy, not just sparse activation on paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
WiSP implements routing-aware expert paging as a drop-in mechanism. It does not modify the serving engine, kernels, model weights, or numerical precision, and therefore preserves byte-identical outputs. The system uses an indirection already exposed by the engine to map each MoE layer to a small GPU scratch space that holds only the currently resident experts. Experts are paged between host memory and GPU memory based on routing behavior, so the GPU keeps a cache of likely useful experts rather than transferring an entire layer.

The more interesting part is memory allocation. The paper argues that expert pages and the KV cache must be managed jointly. To do that, it introduces MV-WSA, which allocates VRAM by equalizing marginal latency benefit per byte while enforcing a minimum KV budget for request admission. The method is implemented both as an offline configurator and as an online controller. The paper also evaluates routing-based prefetching and finds that in low-concurrency decode it helps little, because there is not enough compute to hide PCIe transfer time. In this regime, routing information is more useful for deciding what should stay resident than for speculative prefetch.
summary_en.experiments:
The main result is straightforward: when the model does not fit in VRAM, WiSP improves decode throughput by up to 1.95x over static offload at the same GPU-memory budget. When the model does fit, static full residency is faster because paging adds unnecessary indirection. The paper explicitly reports this crossover instead of hiding it.

For memory partitioning, the offline configurator is the only tested policy that performs well on both prefill and decode. In simulation, it stays within a few percent of a workflow-specific oracle, while fixed memory splits are about 20% worse. The online controller further improves throughput by 1.20x over the best offline split at the same VRAM budget. The broader lesson is that low-resource MoE serving is governed not just by expert-cache hit rate, but by joint management of expert and KV working sets.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction to understand the target regime: low-concurrency, interactive, memory-bound serving on commodity hardware, not high-throughput datacenter inference. Then read the system design section to see how scratch-space indirection and expert paging are implemented without changing model numerics. After that, focus on MV-WSA and the throughput-versus-VRAM plots. The most useful figures are the crossover between static offload and WiSP, and the comparison between fixed, offline, and online memory-split policies. Around 30 to 45 minutes is enough for a solid skim.

recommendation.zh: 做MoE架构的研究员需关注路由感知分页与KV缓存的权衡，训练时优化路由局部性能直接降低serving成本，看§3和实验部分即可
recommendation.en: MoE architecture researchers should note the routing-aware paging and KV cache tradeoff; training-time routing locality directly reduces serving cost, read §3 and experiments only

paper.title: UltraQuant: 4-bit KV Caching for Context-Heavy Agents
paper.abstract: Context-heavy agents place unusual pressure on the key-value (KV) cache: long prefixes are reused across many short turns, while concurrency determines whether the serving system can keep GPUs utilized. We study 4-bit KV-cache compression for this setting, using TurboQuant-style rotation and codebook quantization as a quality anchor and vLLM FP8 KV caching as the deployment anchor. We report three contributions. First, we frame 4-bit KV caching around multi-round agent workloads where task quali

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注长上下文 agent serving 中的 KV cache 压力：多轮会话会反复复用长前缀，高并发又要求尽量把更多前缀常驻在 GPU HBM 中。核心问题不是单纯把 KV 压到 4 bit，而是在质量、cache residency、TTFT/TPOT 三者之间找到可部署的折中。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文模型的系统可用性有参考价值。它说明 4-bit KV cache 的瓶颈不只在量化误差，还在 decode attention kernel、paged serving、cache eviction 以及多轮 agent workload 的真实延迟结构。对做长上下文预训练或 agent-oriented pretrain 的团队，价值在于帮助判断长上下文能力落地时的 memory budget，而不是改变训练目标本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分成两个端点。Ultra-TQ 保留 TurboQuant 的 4-bit key/value 表示，用 Walsh–Hadamard rotation 分散 outlier energy，让 KV 维度更接近轻尾分布，再用 16-entry codebook 做标量量化。论文进一步做了 model-specific centroid calibration：原始 TurboQuant 的 Lloyd–Max centroids 假设旋转后的坐标服从随机单位向量坐标的理论分布，但真实激活有偏差，因此只对高 MSE 的约 10% 层用少量捕获激活重拟合 centroids。UltraQuant 则把 codebook lookup 换成 FP4 micro-tensor approximation，让反量化更容易折入 AMD CDNA4 的 scaled-MFMA 指令路径，减少软件查表带来的 kernel 开销。论文强调 K/V 非对称处理、rotation、layout、lookup、MFMA scheduling 等工程选择，而不是只报告压缩率。
summary.experiments: 主要实验围绕 vLLM 多轮 benchmark，使用 ShareGPT 会话，模拟 32 个并发 chat sessions，并报告 P50 TTFT 与 P50 TPOT。结果显示，在长前缀和高并发下，FP8 KV cache 会因为 resident cache 容量不足而频繁驱逐有用前缀；UltraQuant 能保留更多上下文，后期轮次 TTFT 相比 FP8 提升 3.47×。量化消融中，model-specific centroids 将 key 的 per-element quantization MSE 从 1.32e-4 降到 1.18e-4，下降 10.3%，GPQA 提升 1.20 个百分点。未旋转分布即使重拟合 centroids，MSE 仍约为旋转后的 2.3×，说明 rotation 对误差控制比 codebook 微调更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 agent workload 的问题定义、Agentic Workflow and Concurrency Analysis 中的 TTFT/TPOT 评测设置和 Fig. 1/Table 1、Ultra-TurboQuant 中关于 rotation 与 centroid calibration 的消融。若关注 serving kernel，可再看 appendix 的实现细节。若只关心预训练，不必深读 FP4/MFMA 的底层优化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies KV-cache compression for long-context, multi-turn agent serving. The key issue is not just reaching 4-bit storage, but preserving task quality while keeping long prefixes resident on GPU memory and avoiding latency regressions from quantization overhead.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical. Long-context pretraining only becomes useful if the serving stack can keep reusable prefixes in memory under concurrency. The paper gives a deployment-oriented view of the tradeoff among KV precision, cache residency, TTFT, and TPOT, which is useful for teams designing context-heavy agents or long-context model releases.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper studies two implementations. Ultra-TQ keeps the TurboQuant-style representation: Walsh–Hadamard rotation spreads outlier energy across channels, after which 4-bit scalar codebook quantization becomes more accurate. It then calibrates the Lloyd–Max centroids on real model activations because the theoretical random-unit-vector assumption is only approximate. In practice, the authors recalibrate only the roughly 10% of layers with higher MSE. UltraQuant replaces codebook lookup with an FP4 micro-tensor approximation so dequantization can be folded into native AMD CDNA4 scaled-MFMA execution. The engineering focus is on asymmetric K/V handling, layout, lookup, and decode-attention scheduling rather than compression ratio alone.
summary_en.experiments: The main serving evaluation uses vLLM’s multi-turn benchmark with ShareGPT conversations and 32 concurrent chat sessions, reporting P50 TTFT and P50 TPOT. Under long-prefix pressure, FP8 caching evicts useful state, while UltraQuant keeps more prefixes resident; in later rounds TTFT improves by 3.47× versus FP8. For the quantization ablation, calibrated centroids reduce key per-element MSE from 1.32e-4 to 1.18e-4, a 10.3% reduction, and improve GPQA by 1.20 percentage points. Fitting centroids without rotation still leaves about 2.3× higher MSE, showing that rotation is the dominant accuracy lever.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, roughly 20–30 minutes. Read the workload framing in the introduction, the concurrency and latency analysis around Table 1 and Fig. 1, and the Ultra-TQ ablation on rotation and centroid calibration. Kernel specialists may want the appendix. Readers focused only on pretraining can skip most of the FP4/MFMA implementation detail.

recommendation.zh: 多轮Agent场景4-bit KV量化的工程落地，读§3设计选择和§5 CDNA4 kernel优化即可
recommendation.en: Practical 4-bit KV cache for multi-turn agent workloads; focus on §3 design choices and §5 CDNA4 kernel optimizations.

paper.title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: LLM serving exhibits extreme length variability, making size-based scheduling difficult in practice. Recent LLM schedulers approximate SJF/SRPT using predicted decode lengths or ranks and primarily report mean-centric metrics such as TTFT and TBT. We show that these prediction-driven policies can be fragile under distribution shifts, bursty arrivals, and GPU memory pressure, while offering limited control over the tail latency (P90-P99) that dominates user experience, even with perfect decode-le

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 LLM 在线推理调度中的尾延迟问题。现有系统常用输出长度预测来近似 SJF 或 SRPT，以降低平均响应时间。但 reasoning workload 的 decode 长度高度不稳定，分布会随时间和请求类型变化，预测驱动策略在 bursty arrival、分布漂移和 GPU KV cache 压力下容易失效，也很难直接控制 P90 到 P99 的 TTLT。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练的关系偏系统侧，但对研究有现实意义：reasoning model 的生成长度、KV cache 占用和用户可见延迟正在成为模型训练目标之外的约束。若 posttrain 鼓励更长链路推理，serving 层就需要更稳健的调度策略。该工作强调不要只围绕平均 TTFT/TBT 优化，也不要假设 decode length 可可靠预测；这对设计推理模型的训练预算、长度控制和部署评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用 distribution-aware boosting 替代显式长度预测。它以 FCFS 为基线，对请求计算连续的 soft boost，再按 arrival time minus boost 排序。boost 来自轻量可观测信号，例如已解码 token 数、历史请求延迟分布等，而不是预测最终 decode 长度或剩余长度。这样的策略避免了硬性的短作业优先排序，在部分可观测和分布漂移下更稳。LLM serving 的特殊难点是 KV cache 让调度和内存强耦合：抢占、换出和重算会影响 TTLT。为此，方法把 boost-based scheduling 和 cache-aware preemption / eviction 联合设计，避免为了降低排队时间而造成 KV cache thrashing。
summary.experiments: 可见内容报告了多种异构 workload 下的实验，包括 decode 长度长尾、bursty arrivals、predictor 质量下降和分布漂移场景。指标关注 tail TTLT、吞吐 tokens/s，以及 TTFT/TBT 等交互延迟。结果主张是：相比 prediction-heavy 的 SRPT 近似，distribution-aware 且 eviction-conscious 的调度在 P90/P99 TTLT 和吞吐上更稳定，尤其在预测器退化或 workload 变化时优势更明显。当前提供内容未包含完整结果表，因此不宜补充具体提升百分比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Background，重点理解为什么“完美长度预测也不等于尾延迟可控”。再看 boost policy 的定义，以及它如何从经典 tail-optimal scheduling 改造成适合 LLM serving 的在线策略。系统部分重点看 KV cache eviction 与 preemption 的联合设计。实验部分优先看 P90/P99 TTLT、throughput、predictor degradation、distribution shift 的图表。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Cornell University、Microsoft Azure System Research、NVIDIA。可见内容只显示 Yueying Li 为通讯作者，完整作者列表无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: This work targets tail latency in online LLM inference. Existing schedulers often predict output length or remaining decode length and approximate SJF or SRPT, which is effective for mean latency when size estimates are accurate. In reasoning-heavy workloads, decode length is highly variable, workload distributions shift, and bursty arrivals are common. Under these conditions, prediction-driven scheduling can be fragile and may still provide poor control over P90 to P99 TTLT.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on the serving side, but it matters for model research because reasoning-oriented posttraining changes the length and memory profile of inference. Longer adaptive generation increases KV-cache pressure and makes average-centric metrics less informative. The work argues for deployment-aware evaluation of reasoning models: output-length behavior, tail latency, and cache dynamics should be treated as part of the practical cost of a model, not just as an implementation detail.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed scheduler replaces explicit decode-length prediction with distribution-aware soft priority boosting. It starts from FCFS and assigns each request a smooth boost computed from lightweight observable signals, such as decoded-token progress and historical latency statistics. Requests are then ordered by arrival time minus boost, rather than by predicted final length or remaining length. This avoids hard size-based ranking and is intended to be more robust under partial observability and distribution shift. The system also co-designs scheduling with cache-aware preemption and eviction, since LLM decoding is stateful and memory-coupled. A priority decision that ignores KV-cache capacity can reduce queueing delay but increase TTLT through recomputation and cache thrashing.
summary_en.experiments: The visible content reports experiments across heterogeneous workloads with long-tailed decode lengths, bursty arrivals, degraded predictors, and distribution shifts. The evaluation emphasizes tail TTLT, throughput in tokens per second, and interactive latency metrics such as TTFT and TBT. The reported conclusion is that distribution-aware boosting combined with eviction-aware execution improves tail TTLT and throughput more consistently than prediction-heavy SRPT-style baselines, especially when predictor quality drops or workload distributions change. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, so exact percentage gains are not recoverable here.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the Introduction and Background first to understand why accurate length prediction alone does not solve tail latency. Then focus on the boost-based scheduling rule and how it differs from SJF/SRPT-style ranking. The most important systems detail is the coupling between prioritization, KV-cache eviction, and preemption. In the evaluation, prioritize the plots for P90/P99 TTLT, throughput, predictor degradation, and distribution shift.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations shown in the supplied text include Cornell University, Microsoft Azure System Research, and NVIDIA. Yueying Li is listed as the correspondence contact; the complete author list is not available from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 推理调度方向的扎实工作，尾延迟优化思路对 pretrain 研究员理解 serving 约束反哺训练配置有参考，重点看 §3 优先级设计与 §5 尾延迟分解。
recommendation.en: Solid inference-scheduling work; tail-latency insights inform how serving constraints should feed back into pretraining configs; focus on §3 priority design and §5 tail breakdown.

paper.title: Variable-Width Transformers
paper.abstract: Scaling model size, specifically depth and width, has driven significant progress in transformer-based language models. However, most architectures maintain a constant width across all layers, allocating a fixed parameter and computation budget evenly despite different layers potentially playing distinct computational roles. In this work, we empirically investigate nonuniform capacity allocation across network depth by proposing a $\times$-shaped > <former architecture. This design maintains wid

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是一个很具体但长期被默认处理的问题：在固定深度和参数预算下，Transformer 的每一层是否都应该使用相同 hidden width。现有 scaling 研究通常比较深度、宽度、总参数量的全局比例，但很少改变层内宽度随深度的分布。作者发现，均匀宽度不是一个自然最优点；早期层和晚期层保留更大宽度，中间层收窄的 ×-shaped 配置，在相同参数量下更好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响在于，它把“模型形状”从全局 depth/width ratio 推进到 layer-wise capacity allocation。这个问题直接关系到 dense LM 和 MoE LM 的参数、FLOPs、KV cache 如何分配。论文给出的收益不只是困惑度改善：在 200M–2B dense 和 3B MoE 设置下，×-shaped 结构相对同参数 uniform baseline 约有 3% 相对 perplexity 改善，同时 KV cache 约少 10%，FLOPs 约少 3%。这个量级不算大，但方向清楚，而且与 serving 成本相关。更重要的是，它提示预训练架构搜索不应只搜索总宽度和深度，还应搜索宽度沿深度的 profile。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Variable-Width Transformer，并重点验证一种早晚宽、中间窄的 ×-shaped 结构，称为 > <former。对比的形状包括 growing 的 ∨-shaped、narrowing 的 ∧-shaped、先宽后窄或先窄后宽的其它 profile。关键实现不是简单在层间加 projection，而是维护一个固定的全局 residual stream，宽度等于最宽层。每个 block 只读写 residual stream 的一个 slice；当前层不用的坐标绕过该层，后续需要扩展时从最近一次处理过该坐标的层恢复。收窄时截断到当前层宽度，扩宽时复制此前保存的坐标；如果此前不存在该坐标，则补零。这个设计避免了可学习 projection 带来的瓶颈和额外参数，也尽量保持 residual path 的语义。与只调整 FFN intermediate dimension 的做法不同，这里调整的是整个 block 的模型宽度，因此 attention、MLP、KV cache 和激活搬运都会一起改变。论文还分析了为什么同参数匹配时平均层宽会下降：参数量近似随宽度平方增长，而 attention FLOPs 和 KV cache 更接近随宽度线性增长，所以不均匀宽度可以在保留总参数量的同时降低平均 KV 宽度。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 decoder-only LM，dense 规模从 200M 到 2B 参数，另有 3B 参数 MoE。主结果是 > <former 在参数匹配的 uniform-width baseline 上稳定降低语言建模 perplexity，平均约 3% 相对改善，同时约减少 10% KV-cache size 和约 3% FLOPs。作者还做了多种 shape 对比，结论是早晚层更宽、中间层更窄优于单调增宽、单调收窄等 profile。残差 resize 的消融很关键：固定全局 residual stream 加 slice/copy 的参数无关方案优于可学习 projection 和简单 zero padding，说明收益不是来自额外映射层，而是来自保留绕过中间窄层的残差信息。论文还讨论了 bottleneck width 和 bottleneck location 与模型预算的关系，并给出经验指导：瓶颈不能过窄，位置也不能任意移动；合适的中层收窄能减少 mid-layer representation collapse。表示分析显示，> <former 学到的表示策略不同于 uniform baseline，中间层的表示坍缩程度更低。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一是 Variable-Width Transformer 的 residual resizing 设计，这是能否复现结果的核心；重点看固定 residual stream、slice 读写、截断和复制恢复的定义，以及为什么不用 projection。第二是主实验和 shape 对比，重点确认参数匹配方式、FLOPs/KV cache 计算方式，以及 ×-shaped 相对其它 profile 的稳定性。第三是消融和表示分析，尤其是 resize 策略、bottleneck width/location、mid-layer representation collapse。对做大模型预训练的人，最值得深挖的是两点：一是宽度 profile 是否能与 depth scaling law 联合建模；二是这种结构在长上下文、GQA/MQA、MoE routing、训练稳定性上是否仍保持同样收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a simple architectural assumption that is rarely isolated: under a fixed depth and parameter budget, should every Transformer layer have the same hidden width. Most scaling work varies global depth, width, and parameter count, while keeping width constant across layers. The paper finds that this uniform allocation is not necessarily optimal. A profile with wider early and late layers and narrower middle layers performs better at matched parameter count.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is layer-wise capacity allocation for pretraining-scale decoder LMs. It extends the notion of model shape beyond a global depth-width ratio and makes it a function over depth. The result is relevant to both training and inference: across 200M–2B dense LMs and a 3B MoE LM, the proposed ×-shaped design improves perplexity by about 3% relative to parameter-matched uniform baselines, while reducing KV-cache size by about 10% and FLOPs by about 3%. The gains are modest but operationally meaningful, because they affect both pretraining loss and serving cost. The broader lesson is that architecture scaling laws should not assume uniform width by default.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Variable-Width Transformer changes the model dimension by layer. The best-performing profile is ×-shaped: wide at the bottom, narrow in the middle, and wide again near the top. The implementation detail that matters is the residual stream. Instead of inserting learned projections between layers, the model keeps a fixed global residual dimension equal to the widest layer. Each block reads from and writes to a layer-specific slice of this residual stream. When a layer is narrower, unused coordinates bypass the block. When a later layer expands, those coordinates are restored from the most recent layer that actively processed them; if no such value exists, the coordinate is zero-padded. This parameter-free resizing avoids projection bottlenecks and keeps the skip path closer to a standard residual stream. The design differs from work that only reallocates FFN intermediate width: here the full block width changes, so attention, MLP parameters, KV cache, activation movement, and compute are all affected.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train decoder-only language models from 200M to 2B dense parameters, plus a 3B-parameter MoE setting. The ×-shaped > <former consistently outperforms parameter-matched constant-width baselines, with roughly 3% relative perplexity improvement. Because parameters scale roughly quadratically with width while attention FLOPs and KV-cache size scale more linearly, parameter matching leads to a lower average layer width; the reported outcome is about 10% smaller KV cache and about 3% fewer FLOPs. Shape comparisons show that the early-and-late-wide profile is better than monotonic growing, monotonic narrowing, and other nonuniform alternatives. Ablations on resizing are important: the fixed-residual slice/copy mechanism beats learned projection and naive zero-padding variants. Additional analyses study bottleneck width and location, and suggest that the architecture uses a different representation strategy while reducing mid-layer representation collapse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the residual resizing mechanism carefully first; it is the key engineering idea behind the result. Then inspect the main shape-comparison experiments and check how parameter matching, FLOPs, and KV-cache size are computed. The ablations on learned projections, zero padding, bottleneck width, and bottleneck location are the most useful parts for replication. The representation-collapse analysis is also worth reading, because it gives a possible explanation for why narrowing the middle layers does not simply remove useful capacity. For pretraining work, the natural follow-up questions are whether this width profile interacts predictably with depth scaling, long context, GQA or MQA, MoE routing, and loss-spike behavior.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动到“层宽恒定”这个默认设定；先看 scaling-curve 拟合和 ablation 是否控干净，若成立，内部模型设计该把 width schedule 当一等超参。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the constant-width default; inspect the scaling-curve fitting and ablation hygiene first, and if it holds, width scheduling should become a first-class architecture hyperparameter.

paper.title: The Price of Anarchy in Disaggregated Inference
paper.abstract: Disaggregated inference architectures physically separate prefill and decode phases onto distinct GPU pools, creating competing "agents" that share a fixed hardware budget. We provide, to our knowledge, the first formal game-theoretic analysis of this architecture, using NVIDIA Dynamo as a concrete case study. We model disaggregated serving as three coupled games: a two-player resource game between prefill and decode pools, a selfish caching game over the hierarchical KV cache, and a congestion

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 disaggregated LLM inference 中的资源竞争问题：prefill、decode、KV cache 和 request routing 各自优化局部目标时，系统整体效率会损失多少，以及这种损失在 GPU 饱和附近如何变化。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的直接贡献不在预训练，而在 serving 系统分析。价值在于把 prefill/decode 分离、KV cache 分层管理、请求路由这些工程问题放进统一的博弈论框架，用 Price of Anarchy 衡量局部贪心决策相对全局最优的效率差。对做长上下文、KV-cache 设计、prefill/decode 解耦和推理成本建模的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 NVIDIA Dynamo 为案例，把 disaggregated inference 拆成三个耦合的 game。第一是 prefill pool 和 decode pool 争夺固定 GPU 预算的两方资源分配问题，对应 TTFT 与 ITL 的目标冲突。第二是 hierarchical KV cache 上的 selfish caching game，请求或 cache block 的局部放置会给后续复用与驱逐带来外部性。第三是 request routing 的 congestion game，路由到 cache-warm worker 对当前请求有利，但可能造成 worker 拥塞。论文强调 game theory 在这里主要是分析工具，而不是在线求 Nash equilibrium；运行时仍应使用低开销的调度与路由近似。
summary.experiments: 实验主要验证 KV cache placement 和 request routing 两个子问题，覆盖三种 prefill/decode 拓扑。prefill/decode GPU 资源分配部分以解析建模为主，没有做同等强度的实证验证。关键发现是 GPU 利用率未到饱和前，路由低效指标较稳定；接近或超过系统 knee 后，prefill pool 过载会改变 payoff structure，局部贪心路由的效率损失快速增加。这说明 disaggregated serving 的性能退化不是线性变差，而是在饱和附近出现明显 regime transition。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读。重点看 Introduction 中对 Dynamo 组件的抽象，Section 4 的三个 game 定义，以及 Section 5 关于 saturation knee 的分析。实验部分看三种拓扑下 routing inefficiency 和 cache 行为如何变化。Section 9.2 需要留意，因为它说明 P/D resource game 主要是解析分析而非实证验证。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies resource competition in disaggregated LLM inference: how much efficiency is lost when prefill workers, decode workers, KV-cache placement, and request routing optimize local objectives, especially near GPU saturation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to inference-aware model and system design. Its main contribution is an analytical framing for prefill/decode disaggregation, hierarchical KV-cache management, and request routing. Price of Anarchy is used to quantify the gap between greedy local decisions and coordinated global allocation. The work is useful for researchers thinking about long-context serving, KV-cache economics, prefill/decode separation, and latency-cost tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using NVIDIA Dynamo as the reference architecture, the paper decomposes disaggregated inference into three coupled games. The first is a two-player resource allocation game between prefill and decode GPU pools, reflecting the conflict between time-to-first-token and inter-token latency. The second is a selfish caching game over hierarchical KV storage, where placing or evicting a block creates future recomputation costs and cache-locality externalities. The third is a congestion game for request routing: sending a request to a cache-warm worker may reduce that request’s cost but can increase congestion for later requests. The paper is explicit that game theory is used for analysis rather than runtime equilibrium computation; practical serving still requires simple low-overhead scheduling and routing mechanisms.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical validation focuses on the KV-cache and routing games across three prefill/decode topologies. The prefill/decode resource game is treated analytically rather than validated with the same experimental depth. The central result is a saturation-driven regime change. Below the saturation knee, the routing inefficiency index remains relatively stable. Once the prefill pool becomes overloaded, local greedy routing becomes much less efficient and the Price-of-Anarchy-style gap grows quickly. This supports the claim that disaggregated inference degradation is not merely a smooth utilization effect; the payoff structure changes around saturation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim rather than read line by line. The most useful parts are the Dynamo abstraction in the Introduction, the three-game formulation in Section 4, and the saturation analysis in Section 5. The experiments are useful for seeing how routing inefficiency and cache behavior vary under different prefill/decode topologies. Section 9.2 is important for understanding the limits of the empirical claims, especially the analytical-only treatment of the P/D resource game. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看博弈建模和饱和区间结论；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但会影响长上下文和 KV-heavy 架构的服务侧假设。
recommendation.en: Read the game model and saturation-regime results; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it does stress-test assumptions behind long-context and KV-heavy architectures.

paper.title: Models Take Notes at Prefill: KV Cache Can Be Editable and Composable
paper.abstract: Prefix caching reuses prefill only across an exactly shared prefix, so one changed field invalidates the entire downstream cache. Yet overwriting the field's own key/value vectors and reusing the rest leaves the model acting on the old value. The reason, established causally across four model families: at prefill the model has already written the field-conditioned conclusion onto downstream notes; the field's own key/value drives under 1% of the decision. Read as a notebook of memoized conclusio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 KV cache 为什么不能像普通内存一样局部修改和复用。具体问题是：当长上下文中某个字段发生变化时，只覆盖该字段自身的 key/value 向量并不能让模型基于新字段做决策，模型仍会沿用旧结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在解释 Transformer prefill 阶段的计算形态：模型会把中间推理结果写入后续 token 的 KV cache，尤其是分隔符、换行、聚合位置等 token。这个观察对长上下文、agent memory、prefix caching、可组合上下文和未来训练模型显式暴露可写 cache 都有启发。它也提示，KV cache 不是简单的 token 表示缓存，而是带有已计算结论的运行时状态。
summary.technical_approach: 核心技术路线是把 KV cache 看成一组“预填阶段写下的笔记”。作者先构造可控字段编辑任务，比较完整重算、字段 KV 替换、下游 suffix patch 等干预。结果显示，字段自身 KV 对最终决策的因果贡献通常低于 1%，真正驱动决策的是字段之后若干聚合 token 上的 KV。为验证机制，使用 locality patching、suffix concentration、linear probing、circuit knockout 等因果探针，并做 content/conclusion dissociation、layer timing、specificity、note injection 等控制实验。应用层面提出两类操作：一是编辑，通过加入显著 erratum 或重算受影响 suffix 来覆盖旧笔记；在有 chain-of-thought 时，便宜的字段级 in-place edit 更容易生效，因为模型会重新读取字段。二是组合，把预编译 skill 的 cache reposition 后拼接到新上下文中，并用 seam repair 处理拼接边界。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3、Llama-3.1、Gemma-2、Mistral 等四个模型家族，并扩展到 MoE、低比特量化、多模态图像 cache、MLA、interleaved M-RoPE、sliding-window attention 等设置。关键数字包括：字段自身 KV 对决策贡献低于 1%；带 CoT 的字段级编辑在 8B 模型上可恢复到 1.00 决策一致性，计算量约为完整重算的 1%；cache composition 在 32k 长度下给出 13.9 倍 TTFT 改善，复杂度从近似 O(L^2) prefill 降到 O(L) 拼接；user memory 场景在保持接近完整重算决策的情况下带来 2.3 到 4.3 倍 TTFT 降低，并验证到 70B 模型和 LoCoMo 长对话记忆；vLLM 在线 serving benchmark 中 prefix-cache hit rate 从约 1% 提升到 98.5%，p90 TTFT 降低 53 到 398 倍，高负载下吞吐提升最高 14.5 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 40 到 60 分钟。优先看机制部分的 causal probes，尤其是字段 KV 替换失败、下游 note patch 成功、aggregator token 集中承载结论这几组图。然后看编辑部分，区分 erratum、full affected suffix recompute、top-K selective recompute、field-only edit 的适用条件。composition 部分重点看 position portability 和 seam repair，因为它决定 cache 拼接能否从玩具任务走向系统实现。系统 benchmark 可快速扫读，重点关注负载模型、continuous batching、prefix hit rate 定义和 TTFT 统计口径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why KV cache cannot be locally edited like ordinary memory. When a field inside a long prompt changes, replacing only that field’s key/value vectors does not update the model’s decision; the model still behaves as if the old value were present.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining-oriented researchers is the mechanistic view of prefill computation. The model does not merely cache token representations. During prefill, it writes field-conditioned conclusions into later tokens, especially delimiters, newlines, and other aggregator positions. This matters for long-context training, agent memory, prefix caching, compositional prompting, and future models that may expose a more programmable runtime memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work treats KV cache as a notebook of memoized conclusions. It first builds controlled field-editing setups and compares full recomputation, field-only KV replacement, downstream suffix patching, and note injection. The key finding is causal: the field’s own KV vectors account for less than 1% of the final decision, while downstream cached notes carry nearly all of it. The mechanism is tested with locality patching, suffix concentration, linear probes, and circuit knockouts, plus controls for content-versus-conclusion dissociation, layer timing, specificity, and note injection. On top of this mechanism, the paper proposes two operations. Editing amends stale notes, either with a salient erratum or by recomputing affected downstream notes. Field-only in-place editing is cheap but works reliably mainly when chain-of-thought makes the model reread the field. Composition transplants precompiled skill caches into new contexts by repositioning and splicing cached notes, with seam repair at the boundary.
summary_en.experiments: The results are reported across Qwen3, Llama-3.1, Gemma-2, and Mistral families, with additional coverage for MoE models, low-bit quantization, multimodal image caches, MLA, interleaved M-RoPE, and sliding-window attention. The most useful numbers are: field KV contributes under 1% of the decision; with CoT, field-level editing reaches 1.00 decision recovery on an 8B model at roughly 1% of the compute of full recomputation; cache composition gives a 13.9x TTFT improvement at 32k context length, replacing an O(L^2)-like prefill cost with O(L) splicing; in user-memory settings, decision-faithful reuse gives 2.3x to 4.3x lower TTFT and is validated up to 70B and on LoCoMo; in a vLLM online serving benchmark, prefix-cache hit rate increases from about 1% to 98.5%, p90 TTFT drops by 53x to 398x, and throughput improves by up to 14.5x under higher load.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 40 to 60 minutes. Start with the causal-probe section: the important figures are the failure of field-only KV replacement, the success of downstream note patching, and the concentration of conclusions on aggregator tokens. Then read the editing section to separate the regimes where errata, full affected-suffix recomputation, selective top-K recomputation, and field-only editing work. The composition section is worth reading for position portability and seam repair, since these determine whether cache splicing is a systems primitive rather than a toy intervention. The serving benchmark can be skimmed, but check the load model, continuous batching setup, cache-hit definition, and TTFT statistics.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，不只是 cache 小技巧；如果因果干预做得干净，它会改变你对 prefill 表征的 prior，先读机制实验和 logit-cosine 那几张图。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it is more than a cache trick; if the causal interventions are clean, it changes the prior on what prefill actually writes into the KV state.

paper.title: Towards Distributed Inference of LLMs on a P2P Network
paper.abstract: Prefix caching can reduce LLM inference latency by reusing KV caches across requests with shared prompts, but cluster-scale reuse is challenging because caches are partitioned across nodes. We propose a decentralized, prefix-cache-aware routing scheme for peer-to-peer LLM serving. Each node maintains a local radix tree of its own cached prefixes and asynchronously refreshed estimates of peer caches using periodic anti-entropy. Requests are routed to the node with the longest estimated prefix mat

summary.core_problem: 在没有中心化协调和 KV-cache 迁移的 P2P LLM serving 网络中，利用前缀缓存复用降低推理延迟。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统设计。它关注 prefix cache 在多节点、弱一致性、去中心化环境中的路由问题，对 serving 侧的缓存命中率、热点和网络延迟分析有参考价值，但对预训练方法论影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 prefix-cache-aware decentralized routing。每个节点维护本地 cached prefix 的 radix tree，并通过周期性 anti-entropy 异步刷新对 peer cache 的估计；请求被路由到估计最长前缀匹配的节点。元数据过期只会导致 cache miss，不会改变模型输出，因此系统不需要强一致性。
summary.experiments: 在模拟的 MMLU workload 上评估。结果显示，在网络通信延迟低、prompt 前缀分布偏斜时，去中心化路由能降低延迟；当网络延迟较高或 prefix affinity 造成热点时，收益受限。摘要未给出真实集群规模、模型参数量或绝对延迟数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to exploit prefix-cache reuse for LLM inference on a peer-to-peer network without centralized coordination or KV-cache transfer.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution. It is useful for understanding cache-aware routing, weak consistency, hotspots, and network-latency limits in serving, but its relevance to pretraining methodology is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system uses decentralized prefix-cache-aware routing. Each node keeps a local radix tree of cached prefixes and asynchronously refreshes estimates of peer caches through periodic anti-entropy. Requests are routed to the peer with the longest estimated prefix match. Stale metadata can cause a missed cache hit but cannot affect output correctness, so weak consistency is sufficient.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses simulated MMLU workloads. Decentralized routing improves latency when communication delay is low and prefix distributions are skewed, while high network latency and affinity-induced hotspots limit the benefit. The abstract does not report real-cluster scale, model sizes, or absolute latency numbers.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练影响间接，但 prefix-cache 路由的负结果边界有用；看模拟假设和热点分析即可。
recommendation.en: The pretraining impact is indirect, but the boundary conditions for prefix-cache routing are useful; read the simulation assumptions and hotspot analysis.

paper.title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
paper.abstract: Post-hoc context erasing over the KV cache is challenging because a local edit has a global consequence: once a span has been processed, its influence propagates into the cached states of all subsequent tokens. This issue arises naturally in long-context LLM applications, where stale retrieved facts, incorrect tool observations, retracted user preferences, or harmful prompt injections may be identified only after prefill. Exact erasing must then recompute all tokens after the deleted span, makin

summary.core_problem: 在不重算后缀token的前提下，实现对已prefill上下文中某一局部span的“精确/近似精确”删除，使其不再影响后续生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧新能力+训练方法：把“KV cache不可逆”这个长上下文系统痛点变成可学习的cache编辑问题；对RAG纠错、prompt注入清除、偏好撤回等场景是硬需求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出KVEraser：给定已处理上下文与待删除span，仅替换该区间的KV状态为学习到的steering states，同时复用其余cache不变；用两阶段训练获得可迁移的擦除机制：先做通用的span-neighbor预训练（学会在局部扰动下保持邻域一致性/可控影响），再做面向任务/分布的训练以提升实际擦除效果与泛化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与基线细节；核心对比应是“重算后缀”(exact recompute)与“直接剪掉/置零KV”等朴素cache编辑，指标应同时看擦除正确性与计算量随suffix长度的缩放（论文正文应有）。
summary.authors_note: Meta, Georgia Institute of Technology

summary_en.core_problem: Erase the influence of a localized span in an already-prefilled context without recomputing the entire suffix, by editing KV cache states directly.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time capability + training recipe: reframes KV-cache irreversibility as a learnable cache-editing problem, directly relevant to long-context systems (RAG corrections, prompt-injection removal, preference retraction).
summary_en.technical_approach: KVEraser replaces only the KV states within the erased interval with learned steering states while reusing the rest of the cache unchanged; a two-stage training pipeline (generic span-neighbor pretraining, then task/distribution-focused training) aims for transferability and robust erasing.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model sizes and baselines; the key comparison should be against exact suffix recomputation and naive KV edits, measuring erasing fidelity and compute scaling with suffix length (expected in the paper).
summary_en.authors_note: Meta, Georgia Institute of Technology

recommendation.zh: 这是少见的“KV可编辑”方向：如果结果干净，会改变长上下文系统必须重算后缀的默认假设，建议优先复现其擦除保真度曲线。
recommendation.en: A rare 'editable KV-cache' paper—if the eval is clean, it breaks the default assumption that suffix recompute is unavoidable; prioritize reproducing the erasure-fidelity vs compute curves.

paper.title: Service-Induced Congestion in Memory-Constrained LLM Serving
paper.abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving, each request accumulates persistent graphics processing unit (GPU) memory during service as its key-value cache grows with every generated token. Under high concurrency, aggregate memory usage therefore increases endogenously over time: the service process itself creates future capacity pressure. When memory capacity is exceeded, systems evict active requests, discarding cached state and restarting them later, which wastes computation and reduces throughput

summary.core_problem: 刻画 LLM continuous batching serving 中 KV cache 随生成过程增长导致的内生显存拥塞、驱逐和重启问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理服务系统建模。它不是单纯优化 kernel 或调度启发式，而是给出 memory-constrained serving 的动态系统分析，对长输出、高并发和 admission control 的设计有直接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文建立离散时间动力系统模型，同时描述请求进入、服务过程中 KV cache 增长、显存容量约束和超限后的 active request eviction。在 saturated-input regime 下分析系统的 fixed points、limit cycles 和稳定性；对同质 workload，证明无驱逐均衡不稳定，并给出几乎处处收敛到最差 limit cycle 的结论。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要呈现理论建模和稳定性结论，没有给出真实 serving traces、GPU 集群规模、与 vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 等系统的实测对比或吞吐提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper models endogenous memory congestion in continuous-batching LLM serving, where each request grows its KV cache during generation and can trigger eviction and restart.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-systems analysis contribution. Rather than proposing another scheduling heuristic, it gives a dynamical model for memory-constrained inference, relevant to long-output workloads, high concurrency, and admission-control design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a discrete-time dynamical model covering admission, KV-cache growth during service, memory capacity, and eviction of active requests. In the saturated-input regime, they analyze fixed points, limit cycles, and stability; for homogeneous workloads, they show eviction-free equilibria are unstable and almost all trajectories converge to a worst-case limit cycle.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theoretical results and does not report real serving traces, GPU-cluster scale, comparisons with systems such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM, or measured throughput gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看模型假设和稳定性定理即可；它提醒 serving 不是静态装箱，KV 增长会把系统推入自激振荡。
recommendation.en: Read the model assumptions and stability theorem; the useful prior update is that KV growth can turn serving into a self-induced oscillatory system.

paper.title: ReQAT: Achieving Full-Precision Reasoning Accuracy with 4-bit Floating-Point Quantization-Aware Training
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong problem-solving through long chain-of-thought, but their deployment is constrained by the high cost of full-precision inference and growing KV cache footprints. Microscaled FP4 formats enable efficient FP4 deployment; however, fully quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches (W4A4KV4) causes severe reasoning degradation that existing PTQ and QAT fail to recover. We identify that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens--precise symbolic comm

summary.core_problem: 解决大型推理模型在 W4A4KV4 的 FP4 全量量化下推理能力明显下降的问题，尤其是长 CoT 中错误会级联放大。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和量化训练方法创新。它把 FP4 失效定位到低熵 token，例如数字、运算符和确定性符号承诺，这比只报告平均精度下降更接近可操作的误差机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReQAT，一个面向推理轨迹的 FP4 QAT 框架。核心包括 Trace-Aligned QAT，让模型反复访问相同推理轨迹以集中修复关键低熵决策；Selective Entropy Minimization，在低熵位置增强置信度；Q-FIT，用更适合量化的初始化或适配流程降低 FP4 噪声敏感性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和 benchmark 数字。实验目标是 W4A4KV4，即权重、激活和 KV cache 都使用 4-bit 浮点量化；论文声称相比现有 PTQ 和 QAT，ReQAT 能恢复接近全精度的 reasoning accuracy，并缓解低熵符号位置的采样错误级联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the severe reasoning degradation of large reasoning models under full FP4 quantization, especially W4A4KV4 quantization across weights, activations, and KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and quantization-training contribution. Its useful part is the diagnosis that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens such as digits, operators, and precise symbolic commitments, rather than being uniform noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReQAT is a reasoning-centric FP4 QAT framework. It uses Trace-Aligned QAT to revisit identical reasoning traces and focus updates on critical low-entropy decisions, Selective Entropy Minimization to sharpen confidence at those positions, and Q-FIT to initialize or adapt the model in a quantization-friendly way.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, or benchmark details. The evaluated setting is W4A4KV4 FP4 deployment, quantizing weights, activations, and KV cache. The paper claims ReQAT recovers near full-precision reasoning accuracy where prior PTQ and QAT fail.

recommendation.zh: 只看低熵 token 失效分析和 TAQ/SEM 消融；若数字任务成立，FP4 推理不该再按平均误差建模。
recommendation.en: Read the low-entropy token failure analysis and TAQ/SEM ablations; if the math-task evidence holds, FP4 reasoning should not be modeled by average quantization error.

paper.title: Towards Direct Latent-Space Synthesis for Parallel Branches in LLM-Agent Workflows
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as execution engines for agentic systems, yet they still consume context through a sequential text interface. This creates a mismatch with modern structured agent workflows, in which independent branches explore subtasks, retrieve evidence, or generate candidate solutions before a final synthesis step. Existing systems typically merge these branches by concatenating their textual outputs, which discards the parallel structure and incurs redundant prefill

summary.core_problem: 论文试图解决并行 agent workflow 在合成阶段仍要把多个分支输出串接成文本、再由 synthesizer 重新 prefill 的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型接口研究的启发在于：LLM 不一定只能通过线性文本上下文交换中间状态。把并行分支的 KV cache 作为可消费的 latent context，可以减少重复 prefill，并保留分支之间的独立结构。这个方向和长上下文 RAG 的 cache reuse、agent latent communication、非线性上下文接口有关，但论文主要还是推理时系统与适配训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: Parallel-Synthesis 让下游 synthesizer 直接读取多个 worker agent 产生的 KV cache，而不是读取这些 worker 输出的文本拼接。由于这些 cache 来自独立上下文，不能直接当作一个标准自回归 prefix 使用，方法引入 cache mapper 对分支 cache 做校准，并用 synthesizer LoRA 让模型适应这种非顺序的 cache 输入接口。训练数据分三类：一类是 continued-pretraining-style dialogue data，用于让模型广泛适应 parallel cache contexts；一类是 multi-source synthesis tasks，用于学习从多个 cached contexts 汇聚信息；一类是从标准文本拼接 synthesis pipeline 蒸馏来的数据，用于保留复杂轨迹上的判断和推理能力。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖数学推理、科学问答、代码生成、tool-use agentic QA、多 agent 诊断推理等任务。相对于标准文本拼接 synthesis，Parallel-Synthesis 在 9 个数据集中的 7 个达到持平或更好，剩余 2 个只有小幅差距。效率收益主要来自避免重新 prefill 分支输出，time-to-first-token 降低约 2.5 倍到 11 倍。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整参数规模、训练 token 数和每项任务的细粒度表格，因此需要查看实验表确认收益是否集中在长分支、高并行度场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 理解问题设定：DAG-style agent workflow 与线性上下文接口的冲突。然后看方法部分的 cache mapper、synthesizer LoRA 和训练数据构造。实验部分重点看三点：不同分支数量和分支长度下 TTFT 的变化；7/9 数据集持平或提升的具体分布；失败或小幅落后的两个数据集是否暴露了 latent cache 合成在细节保真、跨分支冲突处理上的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a mismatch in parallel agent workflows: independent branches are executed in parallel, but their outputs are usually concatenated into a single text prompt and prefilling is repeated by the final synthesizer.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea is a non-textual interface for agent communication. Instead of treating every intermediate result as serialized natural language, the synthesizer consumes branch KV caches directly. This is relevant to latent communication, cache reuse for long-context RAG, and non-linear context interfaces. The contribution is closer to inference-time systems plus adaptation training than to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Parallel-Synthesis reuses KV caches produced by parallel worker agents and feeds them to a downstream synthesizer. Because these caches were produced under independent contexts, they are not equivalent to a single autoregressive prefix. The method uses a cache mapper to calibrate branch caches and a synthesizer LoRA to adapt the model to the non-sequential cache interface. The adaptation data has three roles: continued-pretraining-style dialogue data for broad exposure to parallel cache contexts, multi-source synthesis data for aggregating information from multiple cached contexts, and distillation data from a standard text-concatenation synthesis pipeline to preserve judgment and reasoning over complex trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, tool-use agentic QA, and multi-agent diagnostic reasoning. Compared with standard text-based synthesis, Parallel-Synthesis matches or improves performance on 7 of 9 datasets and has only small gaps on the remaining two. The main efficiency result is lower time-to-first-token by avoiding re-prefill of branch outputs, with reported speedups of about 2.5x to 11x. The provided text does not include full model sizes, training-token counts, or per-dataset tables, so the detailed evidence should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 to 35 minutes. Read the introduction to understand the conflict between DAG-like agent workflows and the linear context interface. Then inspect the method sections on the cache mapper, synthesizer LoRA, and adaptation data. In the experiments, focus on how TTFT scales with branch length and branch count, where the 7-of-9 quality result comes from, and whether the two weaker datasets reveal limitations in preserving fine-grained evidence or resolving conflicts across branches.

recommendation.zh: KV-cache 可以被校准并合并——这个观察对长上下文推理和多分支 agent 有启示，但工程性强理论贡献弱，看 §3 cache mapper 设计即可。
recommendation.en: KV-caches can be calibrated and merged — an interesting observation for long-context and multi-branch agents, but mostly engineering; read §3 on cache mapper design only.

paper.title: DynamicPTQ: Mitigating Activation Quantization Collapse via Residual-Stream Dynamics
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for efficient large language model inference, but reliably quantizing activations remains challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are all quantized to 4-bit precision. A key difficulty lies in massive activations, whose extreme values dominate the activation range and amplify quantization errors. State-of-the-art methods mainly mitigate massive activations through transformation-based smoothing, such as orthogonal rotations and affine sc

summary.core_problem: 解决 4-bit 权重、激活和 KV cache 同时量化时，激活极值导致量化尺度失控和精度崩塌的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率与量化机制分析。它不是只给一个新的 PTQ trick，而是把激活量化失败归因到 residual stream 的跨层动态，对理解低比特 LLM 推理部署有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文指出 massive activations 在网络深度上呈阶段性出现和消失，并引发残差流的大幅跳变。作者提出 Jump Ratio 和 Historical Feature SNR 两个指标，用来刻画新注入的层更新如何主导 4-bit 量化尺度，并削弱历史残差信息。方法方向上是在静态 smoothing、rotation、affine scaling 之外，引入随层动态变化的量化处理思路。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确设定为 weights、activations、KV caches 均为 4-bit 的 PTQ 场景，并与当前基于正交旋转和仿射缩放的 activation smoothing 方法对比。具体模型规模、数据集和数值提升在给定摘要中未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses activation collapse in 4-bit PTQ when weights, activations, and KV caches are all quantized.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an inference-efficiency and quantization-dynamics analysis. Instead of treating outlier activations as a static calibration artifact, it links failure to cross-layer residual-stream dynamics, which is useful for practical low-bit LLM serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors argue that massive activations appear and disappear in phases across depth, causing large residual-stream jumps. They introduce Jump Ratio and Historical Feature SNR to measure how newly injected layer updates dominate the 4-bit quantization range and suppress historical residual information. The method points beyond static smoothing, rotations, and affine scaling toward dynamic residual-aware PTQ.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on the hard setting where weights, activations, and KV caches are all quantized to 4-bit precision, and compares conceptually against rotation- and scaling-based smoothing methods. Model sizes, datasets, and numerical gains are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 residual-stream 动态分析和两个指标；若内部在做 W4A4KV4，值得复现实验，不要只抄 smoothing。
recommendation.en: Read the residual-stream dynamics and the two metrics; if you run W4A4KV4 internally, reproduce the failure analysis rather than just copying smoothing tricks.

paper.title: MiniPIC: Flexible Position-Independent Caching in <100LOC
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented and agentic workloads repeatedly prefill recurring predictable structured inputs (which we call "spans") such as documents and code files. Yet, prefix caching in engines such as vLLM cannot reuse their KV entries unless they share identical prefixes with another request, while Position-Independent Caching (PIC) implementations within production-grade inference servers typically either require substantial server code changes or keep KV state outside the server, incurring host-

summary.core_problem: 现有vLLM等推理引擎的前缀缓存仅能复用完全相同前缀的KV条目，已有位置无关缓存实现要么需要大规模修改服务端代码，要么引入主机-设备传输开销，无法高效复用RAG和agent场景下重复出现的结构化输入。
summary.importance: 轻量工程贡献，以不足100行代码在生产级推理引擎中实现低开销位置无关缓存，降低重复结构化输入的prefill算力浪费。
summary.technical_approach: 在KV缓存中存储未做RoPE旋转的原始K向量，注意力计算时按每个请求的逻辑位置对K瓦片动态施加RoPE；暴露三个用户侧token级原语（块对齐填充、跨度分隔符、提示依赖）控制缓存哈希逻辑，原生适配现有vLLM架构。
summary.experiments: 论文以设计与实现说明为主，未给出大规模量化性能对比，核心面向跨请求重复出现的文档、代码块等结构化跨度的缓存复用场景。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自IBM Research，聚焦LLM推理系统优化。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference engines like vLLM only reuse KV entries for requests with exact prefix matches, while prior position-independent caching implementations either require invasive code changes or incur host-device transfer overhead, causing redundant prefill for recurring structured spans in RAG and agent workloads.
summary_en.importance: A lightweight engineering contribution delivering low-overhead position-independent caching in vLLM with minimal code changes, cutting unnecessary prefill computation for repeated structured inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniPIC stores unrotated key vectors in the KV cache, applies RoPE to K tiles dynamically at attention time using per-request logical positions, and exposes three token-level user primitives (block-aligned padding, span separator, prompt depend) to control cache hashing, all in under 100 lines of native vLLM code.
summary_en.experiments: The paper presents design and implementation details without large-scale quantitative benchmarks, targeting reuse of recurring document and code spans across requests at arbitrary positions.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from IBM Research, working on LLM inference system optimization.

recommendation.zh: 存未旋转K做PIC的思路并不新，胜在<100行可直接移植，了解实现思路即可，不必细读全文。
recommendation.en: Caching unrotated KV for position-independent reuse is not a new idea, but the minimal 100LOC vLLM implementation is practically useful; no novel research insight justifies close reading.

paper.title: TetherCache: Stabilizing Autoregressive Long-Form Video Generation with Gated Recall and Trusted Alignment
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models provide a natural formulation for streaming and variable-length video generation by conditioning newly generated frames on previously generated content. However, extending these models to minute-level generation remains challenging: the limited KV-cache budget prevents the model from retaining the full history, while repeatedly conditioning on self-generated frames induces a context distribution shift that accumulates over time, leading to visual artifacts,

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中因 KV-cache 预算有限和自生成上下文分布漂移导致的质量退化、伪影和时间漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的长程生成缓存管理方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但把长上下文生成中的 cache 选择、attention relevance、历史漂移控制放到视频扩散场景里，对研究长程自回归生成有旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: TetherCache 将缓存划分为 sink、memory 和 recent 三个区域。GRAB 机制用门控分数结合基于注意力的相关性与时间多样性，选择长程记忆帧；另有 trusted alignment 机制，用更可信的历史锚点约束当前生成，减少反复条件化自生成帧带来的漂移。方法是 plug-and-play、training-free，不需要重新训练视频生成模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要称面向分钟级长视频生成，比较长时生成质量、视觉伪影、时间漂移和 cache 预算下的稳定性；未给出具体 backbone、参数量、视频数据集、baseline 名称或量化提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses quality degradation, artifacts, and temporal drift in autoregressive video diffusion models caused by limited KV-cache budgets and distribution shift from self-generated context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free cache-management method for long-form generation. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but its treatment of cache selection, attention relevance, and drift control is useful as evidence for long-horizon autoregressive generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TetherCache partitions the cache into sink, memory, and recent regions. GRAB selects long-range memory frames with a gated score combining attention-based relevance and temporal diversity. A trusted-alignment component uses reliable historical anchors to reduce drift from repeatedly conditioning on generated frames. The method is plug-and-play and does not require model retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims evaluation on minute-level video generation, focusing on quality, artifacts, temporal drift, and stability under cache constraints. It does not provide the backbone model, parameter scale, datasets, baseline names, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 可看作视频版长上下文 cache ablation；只扫缓存分区和 GRAB 打分，别把结论外推到文本 LM。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a video-side long-context cache ablation; skim the cache partitioning and GRAB score, but do not over-transfer the claims to text LMs.

paper.title: Can I Buy Your KV Cache?
paper.abstract: Right now, across the world, AI agents are repeating the same absurd act: to read one document, they each recompute it from scratch. Every agent re-runs prefill, the most compute-intensive step a large model takes, over identical text, only to rebuild a key-value (KV) cache identical to the one the agent before it just built. The same answer, computed a million times. We make a proposal that is almost offensively simple: compute it once. Let a publisher precompute a document's KV cache, and let
