summary.core_problem: 多个 agent 反复读取同一文档时会重复执行昂贵 prefill，论文探讨能否把文档 KV cache 预计算并复用。
summary.importance: 贡献更像系统设想和小规模验证：把 KV cache 从单次请求内部状态变成可交易、可复用的计算资产。它对 serving 和 agent 工作流有启发，但距离完整生产系统还需要处理模型版本、tokenizer、位置编码、精度、隐私和信任边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出由发布者为文档预计算 KV cache，后续 agent 购买或加载该 cache，从而跳过 prefill；作者强调在相同模型和相同 token 前缀下，加载 KV 后继续生成应与从头 prefill token-exact，并讨论 KV 放置和传输成本问题。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-4B 上验证预计算 KV 与从头 prefill 在 greedy 生成的 24/24 个 token 以及 logits 层面匹配；报告 KV 复用的计算成本比 prefill 低 9-50 倍，且上下文越长差距越大。摘要未显示大规模线上负载实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether agents repeatedly reading the same document can reuse a precomputed KV cache instead of paying the prefill cost each time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is closer to a systems proposal with a small empirical check: it treats KV cache as a reusable compute artifact rather than a per-request transient state. It is relevant to serving and agent workloads, but a production design still needs to solve model-versioning, tokenizer, positional encoding, precision, privacy, and trust-boundary issues.
summary_en.technical_approach: A publisher precomputes a document's KV cache, and downstream agents load that cache to skip prefill. Under the same model and token prefix, continuation from the loaded KV should be token-exact relative to recomputing prefill. The paper also discusses where the KV should live, since shipping large KV tensors can erase the benefit.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-4B, loading a precomputed KV matches full prefill for 24/24 greedy tokens and at the logits level. The reported compute cost of reuse is 9-50x lower than prefill, with larger gains for longer inputs. The abstract does not show large-scale serving experiments.

recommendation.zh: 想法朴素但命中 agent 负载痛点；看 token-exact 条件和成本模型即可，安全与版本问题先打问号。
recommendation.en: The idea is simple but hits a real agent-serving pain point; read the token-exact conditions and cost model, while treating security and versioning as open issues.

paper.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) project images into hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, making decoder inference expensive in both attention computation and KV-cache memory. Existing visual-token reduction methods largely follow a rank-and-remove paradigm: they score visual tokens, keep a compact subset, and permanently discard the rest. We show that this irreversible action is fragile because visual-token importance changes across decoder depth; tokens ranked low at one stage may become relev

summary.core_problem: VLM 中常见的 visual token 剪枝是一次性永久丢弃，而不同解码器层对 token 的重要性判断会变化，导致 grounding 类查询受损。
summary.importance: 提出可恢复的视觉 token 路由范式替代 rank-and-remove，属于轻量、training-free 的推理效率方法。
summary.technical_approach: Reroute 为 training-free 插件：在每个路由阶段，被选中的视觉 token 进入当前 decoder 块，延迟的 token 跳过该阶段并在下一轮路由重新进入候选池，复用已有注意力打分规则和阶段调度，保持与被增强的剪枝方法相同的渐近 FLOPs 与 KV-cache 预算。
summary.experiments: 在多种 VLM + 多种现有 token 剪枝方法上做插件式替换（摘要截断，具体数据集/数值未完整给出），在相同 FLOPs/KV-cache 预算下比永久剪枝更稳，尤其改善 grounding 敏感查询。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual-token reduction for VLMs permanently drops tokens, yet token importance shifts across decoder layers, hurting grounding-sensitive queries.
summary_en.importance: Proposes recoverable routing as an alternative to the rank-and-remove pruning paradigm; a training-free inference-efficiency plugin.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reroute is a training-free plug-in: at each routing stage selected visual tokens go through the decoder block while deferred tokens bypass and re-enter the candidate pool at the next stage, reusing existing attention-score ranking and stage-wise schedules, preserving the TFLOPs/KV-cache budget class of the underlying pruner.
summary_en.experiments: Plugged into multiple VLMs on top of existing pruning methods (details truncated); under matched FLOPs/KV-cache budgets it outperforms permanent removal, particularly for grounding-sensitive queries.

recommendation.zh: 对做 VLM 推理/多模态预训练的人有用："延迟而非丢弃"这个视角比剪枝更稳；纯文本 LLM 研究员看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on VLM inference or multimodal pretraining; the "defer instead of drop" framing is cleaner than hard pruning, but text-only pretrain folks can stop at the abstract.

paper.title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) re-encode the entire prefix at every denoising step, causing recomputation that scales   quadratically with context length and becomes prohibitive for long-context scenarios. We propose Prefilling-dLLM, a training-free   prefill-decode disaggregation framework for dLLMs that partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches their KV representations once,   and selects the top-K most relevant chunks with intra-chunk token sparsity for decoding, showing that spars

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion language model 在长上下文推理时每个去噪步都要重编码整段前缀、导致计算随上下文长度急剧膨胀的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇对 dLLM 很相关，因为它抓住了 diffusion LM 与 AR LM 在推理路径上的核心差异：dLLM 没有天然的 KV-cache 复用。贡献类型是训练无关的推理系统/算法改进，不改模型本体，但直接影响 dLLM 是否能进入长上下文可用区间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prefilling-dLLM，一个 training-free 的 prefill-decode disaggregation 框架。方法把前缀切成 N 个 chunk，只缓存一次各 chunk 的 KV 表示；解码时只选 top-K 相关 chunk，并在 chunk 内再做 token sparsity，从而把每步复杂度从依赖完整上下文的二次复杂度，降到主要依赖 decode length 的复杂度。另一个关键点是为非连续缓存 chunk KV 设计并行 attention kernel。作者还观察到给每个 chunk prepend BOS token 有助于稳定检索和质量。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 InfiniteBench 上评测，摘要称在 dLLM 加速方法中达到当前最优质量，并在 8K 到 32K 上下文下获得 9.1x 到 28.0x 的速度提升。机构包含港大、密歇根和 LMSYS，说明工作更偏系统与评测结合。摘要未给出具体 dLLM 基座、参数规模和与 dense baseline 的精确质量差距，但从问题设定看是 dLLM 长上下文推理里较实用的一步。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括香港大学、密歇根大学安娜堡分校和 LMSYS。LMSYS 在推理系统、评测和开源 serving 生态上有持续影响力。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the long-context inference bottleneck in diffusion LMs, where the full prefix is re-encoded at every denoising step and cost explodes with context length.
summary_en.importance: This is quite relevant for dLLMs because it targets a core inference-path weakness relative to autoregressive LMs: dLLMs do not naturally inherit efficient KV-cache reuse. The contribution is a training-free inference/system method rather than a new model, but it directly affects whether dLLMs are practical in long-context settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prefilling-dLLM is a training-free prefill-decode disaggregation framework. It partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches each chunk's KV once, then selects top-K relevant chunks during decoding and applies intra-chunk token sparsity. This reduces per-step complexity from being quadratic in the full context to being quadratic mainly in the decode length. The paper also introduces an attention kernel that can decode over non-contiguously cached chunk KVs in parallel. An additional empirical trick is prepending BOS tokens to each chunk to stabilize retrieval and quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on LongBench and InfiniteBench, reporting state-of-the-art quality among dLLM acceleration methods and 9.1x-28.0x speedups at 8K-32K contexts. The institutions include HKU, University of Michigan, and LMSYS, suggesting a systems-oriented effort. The abstract does not specify the exact dLLM backbone, parameter scale, or dense-baseline quality deltas, but the setup is clearly relevant to practical long-context dLLM serving.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include The University of Hong Kong, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, and LMSYS. LMSYS has a strong track record in inference systems, evaluation, and open serving infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: 做 dLLM 的人该看，尤其是 sparse prefilling 竟能赢 dense attention 这一点；先盯复杂度分析、chunk 检索策略和 BOS trick，别急着把结论外推到所有生成范式。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about dLLMs: the interesting part is that sparse prefilling can beat dense attention; focus on the complexity argument, chunk retrieval, and the BOS trick before generalizing the result.

paper.title: Alignment Collapse Under KV Cache Quantization: Diagnosis and Mitigation
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache quantization is widely used to reduce Large Language Model (LLM) inference memory, yet existing evaluations solely focus on measuring perplexity and accuracy without assessing the safety impact. In this study, we explore alignment preservation under KV cache quantization. Across eleven instruction-tuned models (3.8B-72B) and five benchmarks (1,894 prompts), we find that low-bit quantization can silently destroy safety alignment: Mistral-7B loses 15.2% of its refusals at only

summary.core_problem: KV cache 量化可以降低长上下文推理显存，但低比特量化可能在困惑度和任务准确率几乎不变时破坏拒答行为；这篇工作系统诊断这种 alignment collapse 的出现条件和缓解方式。
summary.importance: 对基座和后训练研究的启发在于：对齐能力不是只由权重决定，服务侧的 activation 表示和压缩策略也会改变模型行为。常规 PPL 监控无法覆盖安全拒答子空间，低比特 KV cache 可能把后训练得到的拒答方向扰乱掉。对长上下文 serving、量化评测、post-train 到部署的接口都有直接影响。它也提醒预训练研究者，在设计长上下文架构、activation 分布和 outlier 通道时，需要考虑后续量化是否会集中伤害少数行为控制方向。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把问题定位为几何脆弱性。拒答相关特征集中在低维 activation 子空间，而 KV cache 量化噪声并不是均匀地伤害所有语义特征。当安全关键通道与 activation outlier 通道的重合关系不同，per-channel 量化、layer protection 或提高 bit-width 的效果也不同。作者提出 Per-Channel Reduction, PCR，用约 20 个 calibration prompts 测量模型在关键通道上的量化敏感性，并据此把模型归入不同失败模式。缓解方案是训练-free 的：根据 PCR 结果选择保留部分层为 FP16、改用更细粒度量化，或提高基础 bit-width。方法强调诊断先于修复，而不是给所有模型套同一个量化配置。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 11 个 instruction-tuned 模型，规模从 3.8B 到 72B；5 个安全 benchmark，共 1,894 个 prompts。结果显示不存在通用安全 bit-width：collapse onset 从 6-bit 到 2-bit 跨越四个 bit。例子包括 Qwen-2.5-7B 在 6-bit 已出现崩塌，而 Gemma-2-9B 到 3-bit 仍保持安全；Mistral-7B 在 PPL 仅变为 1.03× 时，拒答率下降 15.2%。作者进一步报告安全特征子空间比整体表示空间对量化噪声脆弱 10^2–10^3 倍。PCR 用 20 个 calibration prompts、约 35 GPU-min 诊断模型，并在九个主要模型和一个 held-out 模型上给出正确缓解选择；该诊断在 KIVI、不同 system prompt 和不同 layer-selection heuristic 下仍能工作。缓解方案最高可恢复 97% 的丢失对齐，典型显存额外开销为 0–7%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看现象部分：不同模型的 bit-width collapse 曲线，以及 PPL 与 refusal rate 脱钩的图。然后看几何分析：安全子空间、outlier channel overlap、per-channel 量化为何对不同模型效果不同。最后看 PCR 诊断和 mitigation 表格，确认它如何从 20 个 prompts 推出具体策略。对做 serving 或量化的人，缓解 protocol 值得细看；对做预训练的人，最有用的是 activation outlier 与行为方向重合这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache quantization saves inference memory, but low-bit cache compression can destroy refusal behavior while leaving perplexity and task accuracy nearly unchanged. The paper diagnoses when this happens and how to mitigate it without retraining.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson is that alignment is not only a property of model weights. It also depends on activation geometry and on the compression scheme used at serving time. Standard PPL-based validation can miss a large change in refusal behavior because the safety signal lives in a small subspace. This matters for long-context serving, quantization evaluation, and the handoff from post-training to deployment. It also gives pretraining researchers a concrete reason to care about activation outliers and whether behavior-controlling directions are concentrated in fragile channels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames the failure as a geometric interaction between quantization noise and safety-critical activation directions. Refusal features occupy a low-dimensional subspace, and this subspace can be much more sensitive to cache quantization than the full representation. Whether per-channel quantization helps depends on the overlap between safety-critical channels and activation outlier channels. The proposed diagnostic, Per-Channel Reduction (PCR), uses about 20 calibration prompts to classify a model into a failure mode and select a mitigation. The mitigation is training-free: protect selected layers in FP16, use finer-grained quantization, or increase the base bit-width depending on the PCR diagnosis. The key design choice is model-specific diagnosis rather than a universal low-bit recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 11 instruction-tuned models from 3.8B to 72B on five safety benchmarks with 1,894 prompts. Collapse thresholds vary widely, from 6-bit to 2-bit. For example, Qwen-2.5-7B collapses around 6-bit, while Gemma-2-9B remains safe through 3-bit. Mistral-7B loses 15.2% of its refusals while perplexity increases only to 1.03×, showing why PPL monitoring is insufficient. The safety subspace is reported to be 10^2–10^3 times more vulnerable to quantization noise than the full representation space. PCR, computed from 20 calibration prompts in about 35 GPU-minutes, selects the right mitigation on nine primary models and one held-out model, and remains predictive across KIVI, system prompts, and layer-selection heuristics. The mitigation recovers up to 97% of lost alignment with typical memory overhead between 0% and 7%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the collapse curves that compare bit-width, refusal rate, and perplexity; they are the clearest evidence that standard metrics miss the failure. Then read the geometry section on safety subspaces and outlier-channel overlap. Finish with the PCR diagnostic and mitigation tables to see how the calibration signal maps to an action. For inference and quantization work, the protocol details are the most actionable. For pretraining work, the useful part is the link between activation outliers and behavior-critical directions.

recommendation.zh: 一个被忽视的真实问题：量化的安全退化不体现在 perplexity 上。几何机制解释（低维安全子空间）很有说服力，做量化/部署的人应看 §4 的 PCR 诊断。
recommendation.en: A real and understudied failure mode: quantization degrades safety without showing up in perplexity. The geometric explanation (low-dimensional safety subspace) is convincing; read §4 for the PCR diagnostic if you do quantization or deployment.

paper.title: Express Language Modeling
paper.abstract: We introduce a new tool, Express, for converting a non-causal attention approximation into a causal approximation with matching approximation guarantees. When combined with the state-of-the-art Thinformer approximation, Express improves upon the best known causal attention guarantees, delivering $\log^{3/2}(n)/s$ approximation error with only $O(s)$ memory and $O(s^2 \log^2(n))$ compression overhead for a sequence of length $n$. We pair these developments with an efficient I/O-aware Triton imple

summary.core_problem: 解决非因果 attention 近似难以直接用于自回归语言模型的问题，并把理论保证转化为长上下文预填充、KV cache 压缩和长文本解码中的实际加速。
summary.importance: 这是高效长上下文语言建模和推理系统工作，贡献类型是算法转换工具加工程实现。对预训练研究员有用的点在于：它把 attention 近似的理论误差、显存占用和 I/O-aware kernel 放到同一个语言建模 pipeline 中评估，而不是只报告单个算子的速度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Express，将非因果 attention approximation 转换为因果 approximation，并保持相匹配的近似保证。与 Thinformer 结合后，给出长度 n、压缩参数 s 下的因果 attention 误差界：log^{3/2}(n)/s，同时只需 O(s) memory 和 O(s^2 log^2(n)) compression overhead。论文还实现了 I/O-aware Triton kernel，并把方法用于四个瓶颈：long-context prefill、KV cache compression、memory-constrained decoding 和 compute-constrained decoding。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 Express 的 Triton 实现在若干语言建模 pipeline 场景中相对 FlashAttention 2 有明显加速，并覆盖长上下文预填充、KV cache 压缩和两类长文本受限解码设置。摘要未给出具体模型参数量、上下文长度、数据集和精确加速倍数。
summary.authors_note: Lester Mackey 是知名机器学习研究者，长期做可扩展统计学习、核方法、压缩和高效算法相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between non-causal attention approximations and causal autoregressive language modeling, then applies the resulting approximation to long-context prefill, KV-cache compression, and long-form decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient long-context language modeling and inference-systems contribution: an algorithmic conversion tool paired with a practical implementation. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is that it connects approximation error, memory, and I/O-aware kernels inside the LM pipeline rather than benchmarking an isolated operator.
summary_en.technical_approach: Express converts a non-causal attention approximation into a causal approximation with matching guarantees. Combined with Thinformer, it gives a causal attention error bound of log^{3/2}(n)/s for sequence length n and compression size s, using O(s) memory and O(s^2 log^2(n)) compression overhead. The paper also provides an I/O-aware Triton implementation and applies it to four bottlenecks: long-context prefill, KV-cache compression, memory-constrained decoding, and compute-constrained decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial speedups over FlashAttention 2 across several language-modeling pipeline settings, including long-context prefill, KV-cache compression, and two long-form decoding regimes. It does not provide the concrete model sizes, context lengths, datasets, or exact speedup factors in the excerpt.
summary_en.authors_note: Lester Mackey is a well-known machine learning researcher with substantial work on scalable statistical learning, kernel methods, compression, and efficient algorithms.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 theorem 和 Triton 实验表；它不改 LM 目标，但可能改变长上下文 prefill 与 KV 压缩的默认实现选择。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem and Triton tables; it does not change the LM objective, but it may change default choices for long-context prefill and KV compression.

paper.title: FadeMem: Distance-Aware Memory Consolidation for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos by generating successive temporal segments, but their historical KV cache grows with video length. Existing bounded-cache methods reduce this cost with local windows, sink tokens, or compressed memory states, yet they usually assign fixed roles to different parts of the history. We propose FadeMem, a distance-aware KV memory consolidation mechanism that organizes historical KV blocks into a temporal hierarchy under a fixed cache budget. This

summary.core_problem: 自回归视频生成器的历史 KV cache 随视频长度线性增长，现有固定 cache 策略（局部窗口、sink token、压缩记忆态）对不同历史区间分配固定角色，未根据时间距离自适应分配内存。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的启发在于：长视频中的频率依赖时间衰减规律（细节快速去相关、粗结构长期保持）可能适用于文本长上下文，提示 KV cache 管理可以借鉴距离感知的渐进合并策略；FadeMem 无需架构修改，兼容现有自回归生成器。
summary.technical_approach: 核心洞察：长视频中帧间相关性随时间距离衰减，且衰减具有频率依赖性——高频细节（纹理、局部运动）快速去相关，低频结构（场景布局、物体身份）长期保持。据此提出 FadeMem：在固定 cache 预算下将历史 KV 块组织为时间层次结构，新近历史保持细粒度，远处历史渐进合并为粗粒度跨度级条目；当条目预算超限时，将最旧的相邻条目合并。形成近密远疏的时间层次，无需单独的 local/sink/辅助记忆模块。
summary.experiments: 在标准长程自回归生成设置中，相比现有有界 cache 策略，FadeMem 在主体一致性、背景稳定性、时间连贯性上均有提升，有效减少了身份漂移和场景退化。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐速读 Introduction 中对时间距离依赖频谱衰减的经验分析（图 2）和 Method 中渐进合并的核心机制（图 3）；Experiments 部分可略读。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息从提供内容中无法明确确认，应为学术机构的视频生成研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Historical KV cache in autoregressive video generators grows linearly with video length; existing bounded-cache strategies (local windows, sink tokens, compressed memory states) assign fixed roles to different history segments without adaptive memory allocation based on temporal distance.
summary_en.importance: Inspiration for LLM foundation research: the frequency-dependent temporal decay pattern in long videos (fine details decorrelate fast, coarse structure persists) may apply to text long-context modeling, suggesting KV cache management can benefit from distance-aware progressive consolidation. FadeMem requires no architectural changes and is compatible with existing autoregressive generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: Key insight: frame-to-frame correlations in long videos decay with temporal distance in a frequency-dependent manner — high-frequency details (texture, local motion) decorrelate rapidly while low-frequency structure (scene layout, object identity) persists. FadeMem organizes historical KV blocks into a temporal hierarchy under a fixed budget: recent history stays fine-grained, distant history is progressively merged into coarser span-level entries; when entry budget is exceeded, the oldest adjacent entries are merged. Forms a dense-near / sparse-far temporal hierarchy without separate local / sink / auxiliary memory modules.
summary_en.experiments: In standard long-horizon autoregressive settings, FadeMem improves subject consistency, background stability, and temporal coherence over existing bounded-cache strategies, effectively reducing identity drift and scene degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction for the empirical analysis of distance-dependent spectral decay (Figure 2) and the Method section for the progressive consolidation mechanism (Figure 3). Experiments can be read lightly. Estimated reading time: 15-20 min.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly identified from the provided content; likely an academic video generation research group.

recommendation.zh: KV缓存压缩的幂律衰减思路对长文本LLM推理有迁移价值，看§3内存合并机制即可，视频生成场景可忽略
recommendation.en: The power-law decay idea for KV cache compression is transferable to long-text LLM inference; read §3 memory consolidation mechanism only, ignore video generation specifics

paper.title: Streaming Knowledge Compilation: Proactive Materiality-Scored Pinning for Time-Evolving LLM Wikis
paper.abstract: LLM wiki systems compile knowledge into pre-filled KV caches for efficient inference, but assume a static corpus -- an assumption that fails whenever the underlying information landscape evolves. We formalize Streaming Knowledge Compilation: given a document stream, a fixed token budget, and future queries unknown at ingestion time, maintain a compiled wiki that minimizes cumulative regret against an offline oracle with perfect foresight. The enabling insight is a materiality signal $φ_t(k,n)\in

summary.core_problem: LLM wiki 系统将知识编译到预填充 KV cache 中以实现高效推理，但假设语料库是静态的——当底层信息随时间演化时这一假设失效。
summary.importance: 首次形式化 Streaming Knowledge Compilation 问题：在文档流、固定 token 预算和未知未来查询的约束下，维护编译 wiki 并最小化与离线 oracle 的累计 regret。贡献类型：理论框架创新 + 算法设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 materiality signal φ_t(k,n) ∈ [0,1]，对实体 k 在时间 t 的文档重要性打分，作为查询相关性的替代信号用于主动 pinning；证明 O(√(T log K)) 的 regret bound。在金融领域用 Llama 3.1 8B 冻结分类头预测异常波动作为 φ_t。
summary.experiments: 金融领域：76K 文章，严格时间分割，AUROC = 0.728；实现 1.49× 更高的 realized 指标（摘要被截断）。
summary.authors_note: Juan M. Huerta（未明确标注机构）

summary_en.core_problem: LLM wiki systems compile knowledge into pre-filled KV caches for efficient inference but assume a static corpus, which fails when the underlying information landscape evolves over time.
summary_en.importance: First formalization of Streaming Knowledge Compilation: maintaining a compiled wiki under a document stream, fixed token budget, and unknown future queries to minimize cumulative regret against an offline oracle. Contribution: theoretical framework + algorithm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a materiality signal φ_t(k,n) ∈ [0,1] scoring document importance for entity k at time t, acting as a query-relevance surrogate for proactive pinning; proves an O(√(T log K)) regret bound. Instantiated in finance using a frozen Llama 3.1 8B classification head to predict abnormal stock volatility as φ_t.
summary_en.experiments: Finance domain: 76K articles, strict temporal split, AUROC = 0.728; achieves 1.49× higher realized metric (abstract truncated).
summary_en.authors_note: Juan M. Huerta (institution not explicitly stated)

recommendation.zh: 理论框架有趣但落地场景偏门（金融 wiki），对 pretrain 研究员几乎无启发；作为 KV-cache 应用文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Theoretical framework is interesting but the use case is niche (finance wiki); offers little insight for pretrain researchers—keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: RKSC: Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing and Confident Early Exit for Multi-Step LLM Inference
paper.abstract: We introduce RKSC (Reasoning-Aware KV Cache Sharing), a training-free inference framework that eliminates two structural redundancies in multi-branch LLM reasoning pipelines. ASKS (Attention-Similarity KV Sharing) computes the prefix KV cache once and broadcasts it to all semantically similar branches via hidden-state cosine similarity, strictly generalising the token-exact prefix caching used by vLLM and SGLang. CGEE (Confidence-Gated Early Exit) applies two complementary exit mechanisms: (1) i

summary.core_problem: 多分支、多步推理流水线中，LLM 会在相似分支上重复构建 KV cache，并在 verification 阶段做大量冗余前向计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它不是改预训练或模型结构，而是针对 reasoning-time compute 的结构性浪费提出训练无关的缓存共享和早退机制，对理解 test-time scaling 的系统成本有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RKSC 包含三部分：ASKS 用 hidden-state cosine similarity 判断语义相似前缀，把一次计算得到的 prefix KV cache 广播给相似分支，扩展了 vLLM/SGLang 的 token-exact prefix caching；CGEE 用分支生成置信度跳过 verification forward，或在中间层 entropy 稳定时提前停止；RSBCM 用 attention-weighted depth-priority eviction 控制 cache 增长。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 5 个 7B-10B 模型家族、4 个 benchmark、1000 道问题上评估，并声称取得平均加速；给定摘要被截断，无法确认具体加速幅度、精度损失和 baseline 设置是否完整。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-branch reasoning pipelines repeatedly build KV caches for similar branches and spend redundant compute in verification passes.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution rather than a pretraining or architecture paper. It is useful mainly as a signal about where reasoning-time compute is wasted in practical test-time scaling pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: RKSC has three components: ASKS shares prefix KV caches across semantically similar branches using hidden-state cosine similarity, generalizing token-exact prefix caching in vLLM/SGLang; CGEE skips verification when branch confidence is decisive or exits at an intermediate layer when per-layer entropy stabilizes; RSBCM bounds cache growth with attention-weighted depth-priority eviction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments across five 7B-10B model families, four benchmarks, and 1,000 problems, with a claimed mean speedup. The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact speedup, accuracy tradeoff, and baseline details cannot be verified here.

recommendation.zh: 只看缓存共享判据和早退阈值；setup 若没有严格质量损失分析，结论只能当 serving trick。
recommendation.en: Read only the cache-sharing criterion and exit thresholds; without a clean quality-loss analysis, treat it as a serving trick.

paper.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA), a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate t

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM解码时需加载全部KV cache，超长上下文推理时GPU内存瓶颈严重。
summary.importance: 范式级创新：提出Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)，由Neural Memory Indexer主动预测未来上下文需求，仅保留关键KV chunk在GPU内存中。
summary.technical_approach: LSA采用backbone-free解耦训练策略：将indexer建模为标准dual-encoder架构，独立于LLM backbone单独训练（用标准检索训练框架，无需加载大模型。在DeepSeek-V4架构上实例化。
summary.experiments: 在主要长上下文评测套件上验证了效率显著提升（未见完整数据（abstract被截断）。声称显著提升serving效率并同时作为attention denoiser。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队。这是继DeepSeek-V4架构的FlashMemory技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing severe GPU memory bottlenecks for ultra-long context serving.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level innovation: Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA) proactively predicts future context demands and retains only query-critical KV chunks in GPU memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSA uses a backbone-free decoupled training strategy: the indexer is formulated as a standard dual-encoder architecture, trained independently using standard retrieval frameworks without loading the massive backbone model. Instantiated on DeepSeek-V4.
summary_en.experiments: Significant improvements on major long-context evaluation suites (results truncated). Claims both serving efficiency and acts as attention denoiser.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team; this is the FlashMemory technical report for DeepSeek-V4.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对长上下文推理的认知——用独立dual-encoder indexer预测未来KV需求，backbone-free训练策略极具工程启发性，应立刻在内部ablation中复现核心思路。
recommendation.en: Changes my view on long-context inference: a standalone dual-encoder indexer predicting future KV needs with backbone-free training is highly engineerable; should reproduce core idea in internal ablations immediately.

paper.title: AGENTSERVESIM: A Hardware-aware Simulator for Multi-Turn LLM Agent Serving
paper.abstract: Multi-turn LLM agents interleave model calls with external tool invocations, shifting serving from stateless request processing to stateful program execution. Serving these workloads requires scheduling, KV-cache management, and routing policies that use program-level context, including turn dependencies, tool-induced gaps, and reusable KV state. Evaluating such policies directly on real systems is costly, since each design point may require dedicated accelerator time across arrival rates, model

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多轮 LLM agent serving 的评估问题：现有 serving simulator 基本按无状态单请求建模，无法刻画 agent 工作负载中的跨轮依赖、tool gap 和 KV-cache 驻留行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是系统建模与仿真工具。它对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对理解 agent 时代推理系统的真实瓶颈很有用，尤其是当模型调用不再是独立样本，而是带程序状态的长生命周期任务时。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 AGENTSERVESIM，一个面向多轮 agent serving 的 hardware-aware simulator。核心在于把评估粒度从 request 提升到 program：显式建模 turn dependency、工具调用造成的空档期、跨轮可复用 KV 状态，以及不同加速器、内存层级、实例数和到达率下的调度、路由和 cache 管理策略。也就是说，它不是简单重放 token latency，而是把 agent 执行过程当成有状态程序来模拟。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整数值，但强调该系统可在不同 arrival rate、模型规模、serving instance 数和 memory hierarchy 下评估策略，目标是替代昂贵的真实集群试验。预期实验重点应包括：与真实系统的拟合精度、不同调度/路由/KV 驻留策略的吞吐与延迟对比，以及 program-level 模拟相对 request-level 模拟的误差差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation for multi-turn LLM agent serving, where existing simulators assume stateless request-level workloads and therefore miss cross-turn dependencies, tool gaps, and KV-cache residency effects.
summary_en.importance: This is a systems and simulation contribution. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is useful for understanding the real serving bottlenecks of agent workloads, where model calls are no longer independent requests but stateful program executions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors present AGENTSERVESIM, a hardware-aware simulator for multi-turn agent serving. The key move is to elevate the simulation unit from request to program, explicitly modeling turn dependencies, tool-induced idle gaps, reusable KV state across turns, and the interaction of scheduling, routing, and cache management under different accelerators, memory hierarchies, instance counts, and arrival rates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed numbers, but the intended evaluation space includes varying arrival rates, model scales, serving-instance counts, and memory hierarchies. Likely experiments include fidelity against real systems and comparisons of scheduling, routing, and KV-residency policies under program-level versus request-level simulation.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 agent inference stack，这篇值得看；它把 workload 单位从 request 改成 program，这个抽象是对的。对 pretrain 研究员只需看系统假设是否足够贴近真实 tool-use trace。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about agent inference stacks: moving the workload unit from request to program is the right abstraction. For pretraining folks, just check whether the simulator assumptions actually match real tool-use traces.

paper.title: End-to-End Context Compression at Scale
paper.abstract: Long-context language model inference is bottlenecked by memory, as the KV cache grows with context length. Recent techniques to compress the KV cache fall short: they either degrade model quality substantially or require considerable time and compute to compress a single long prompt. Furthermore, many methods require the input to fit within the target model's context window, and are generally incompatible with modern production inference engines. Encoder-decoder compressors, which map a long to

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 随上下文长度线性增长导致的显存瓶颈，同时避免现有压缩方法质量下降、压缩耗时高或难以接入生产推理引擎的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长上下文推理系统与压缩架构改进。它重新评估 encoder-decoder context compressor，并通过从头预训练多种结构做设计搜索，试图把 latent compression 拉到与 KV cache compression 可竞争的准确率-效率前沿。
summary.technical_approach: 采用 encoder-decoder compressor：encoder 将长 token 序列映射为更短的 latent embeddings，decoder 消费这些压缩表示完成生成。论文先从头预训练多个架构变体做 architecture search，分析压缩器设计与训练方式，再基于发现进行持续预训练，使压缩器更适合目标长上下文推理路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验包含大量从头预训练的压缩器变体，并与现有 KV cache compression 和 encoder-decoder compression 方法比较准确率-效率边界。摘要未给出具体参数规模、训练 token 数、压缩比、延迟或精度提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory bottleneck of long-context inference, where KV cache grows with context length, while existing compression methods often hurt quality, require expensive prompt-time compression, or do not fit production inference engines.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-context inference and compression architecture study. It revisits encoder-decoder context compressors and uses from-scratch pretraining of many variants to move latent compression closer to the accuracy-efficiency frontier of KV-cache compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach uses an encoder-decoder compressor: the encoder maps a long token sequence into a shorter sequence of latent embeddings consumed by the decoder. The authors first pretrain many architecture variants from scratch to search the design space, then use the findings to guide continual pretraining for a more competitive compressor.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a large architecture-search experiment with many compressors pretrained from scratch, compared against KV-cache compression and prior encoder-decoder compression methods on the accuracy-efficiency frontier. It does not report exact parameter counts, token budgets, compression ratios, latency, or accuracy numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构搜索结论和准确率-效率曲线；若 compressor 真能接 production engine，比常规 KV 剪枝更值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture-search findings and accuracy-efficiency frontier; if the compressor truly fits production engines, it is more actionable than another KV-pruning variant.

paper.title: From Rigid to Dynamic: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Inference for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: Existing sparse attention and KV cache compression methods for long-context LLM inference typically apply fixed sparsity patterns or uniform budgets across all attention heads, overlooking the substantial variation in attention behavior among heads and contexts. We observe two distinct entropy patterns among attention heads: Rigid Heads, whose entropy stays near zero across input segments, and Dynamic Heads, whose entropy fluctuates significantly. Crucially, the distribution of these types is co

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中，固定稀疏注意力模式和统一 KV cache 预算没有利用不同 attention head、不同上下文片段之间的行为差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法创新。它把注意力熵作为在线信号，用来区分更稳定的 head 和更依赖上下文的 head，对长上下文 prefill 与 decode 阶段分别做自适应计算分配和 KV 保留。这类工作不直接改预训练，但会影响长上下文训练目标与推理时真实瓶颈的判断。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EntropyInfer，一个 training-free 框架。prefill 阶段按 head 和 segment 粒度计算 attention entropy，把低熵、行为稳定的 Rigid Heads 与熵波动明显的 Dynamic Heads 区分开，并动态分配计算预算。decode 阶段提出 latent KV cache compression，不只依赖 prefill token 的重要性，还利用已生成输出 token 来识别更关键的 cache entries。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 Llama、Qwen 和 openPangu 系列模型上做了实验，覆盖长上下文推理场景。具体数据集、上下文长度、压缩率、延迟收益和精度损失未在摘要中给出，需要看正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LLM inference often uses fixed sparse attention patterns or uniform KV-cache budgets, ignoring large head-level and context-dependent variation in attention behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It uses attention entropy as an online signal to allocate compute and cache budget per head and segment. It does not change pretraining directly, but it gives useful evidence about which long-context attention behaviors actually matter at serving time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes EntropyInfer, a training-free framework. During prefilling, it measures attention entropy at the head and segment level, separating low-entropy Rigid Heads from high-variance Dynamic Heads and allocating compute adaptively. During decoding, it introduces latent KV-cache compression that uses generated output tokens, not only prefill tokens, to decide which cache entries to retain.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on Llama, Qwen, and openPangu model families in long-context settings. The exact datasets, context lengths, compression ratios, latency gains, and accuracy tradeoffs are not visible from the abstract and need to be checked in the main tables.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵分组和 decode cache 部分；若 Table 里精度-压缩曲线干净，可作为长上下文 serving ablation 候选。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy grouping and decode-cache sections; if the accuracy-compression curves are clean, this is worth reproducing as a long-context serving ablation.

paper.title: Enabling KV Caching of Shared Prefix for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching for shared prefixes is essential for high-throughput large language model (LLM) serving, but it faces critical challenges in emerging diffusion language models (DLMs). In DLMs, bidirectional attention means that updating any token dynamically alters the entire context and its corresponding KVs. Thus, existing caching techniques developed for LLMs, which assume that KVs remain invariant once computed, corrupt the shared prefix KVs. Our experiments show that applying these t

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散语言模型在共享前缀场景下无法直接复用 KV cache 的问题；双向注意力会让任意 token 更新污染整段上下文的 KV，导致现有 LLM 缓存方法在 DLM 上几乎失效。
summary.importance: 这是面向新型语言建模范式的 serving 基础设施问题。贡献类型主要是推理系统方法：把 AR LLM 中成熟的 shared-prefix caching 迁移到 DLM 时，先明确指出“直接套用会精度崩塌”，再给出可工作的缓存策略。对判断 DLM 是否具备实际部署前景有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 bidirectional prefix caching（bicache）。核心观察是：共享前缀对应的 KV 在浅层相对稳定、可复用，而深层会因双向上下文更新而失真；可复用的浅层深度又取决于请求中 shared prefix token 的占比。基于此，方法动态识别一个安全的浅层边界，只缓存并复用这些层的前缀 KV，避免深层缓存带来的语义污染。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模，但实验结论很明确：把现有 LLM 的 shared-prefix caching 直接用于 DLM，会让准确率接近 0；bicache 在保持精度的同时提升吞吐。论文的关键实验应包括：不同共享前缀比例下的安全缓存深度分析、与无缓存/错误缓存/静态层数缓存的对比，以及吞吐-精度权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles shared-prefix KV caching for diffusion language models, where bidirectional attention makes any token update alter the whole context and invalidates standard LLM caching assumptions.
summary_en.importance: This is a serving-enablement problem for an alternative LM paradigm. The contribution is mainly systems-oriented: it shows that naively reusing AR-LM prefix caching in DLMs can collapse accuracy, then provides a workable caching scheme. That matters if one wants DLMs to be deployable rather than just trainable.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes bidirectional prefix caching (bicache). The key observation is that shared-prefix KVs remain relatively stable and reusable in shallow layers, while deeper layers become corrupted by bidirectional context updates; the safe shallow depth depends on the fraction of shared-prefix tokens in each request. Bicache dynamically selects this safe boundary and only reuses prefix KVs there.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full model scales, but the main empirical result is clear: applying existing LLM shared-prefix caching to DLMs drives accuracy close to zero, whereas bicache preserves accuracy while improving throughput. The important experiments likely analyze safe cache depth vs. shared-prefix ratio and compare against no-cache, naive cache, and static-depth baselines.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 DLM，不要只盯训练目标；这篇把“能不能像 AR 一样高吞吐部署”这个硬约束讲清了，先看失败案例和层深稳定性分析。
recommendation.en: If you care about DLMs, do not stop at the objective; this paper makes the serving constraint concrete, and the failure case plus layerwise stability analysis are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: STAR-KV: Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Soft Thresholding for Adaptive Rank Control
paper.abstract: Low-rank projection has emerged as a promising approach for compressing the KV cache by exploiting hidden-dimension redundancy. However, prior methods rely on fixed or heuristic rank selection and struggle to achieve aggressive compression with minimal accuracy degradation. We propose STAR-KV, an adaptive low-rank KV cache compression framework with fine-grained rank control. STAR-KV encompasses 1) a differentiable thresholding mechanism that enables optimal rank selection at both attention-head

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 占用过大，而现有低秩压缩方法 rank 选择僵硬、压缩激进时精度掉得快的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工程方法创新。它不直接改变预训练范式，但对长上下文 serving、训练后评测和 RL 长 rollout 的系统成本都有现实影响，尤其是把低秩压缩、量化和自适应 rank 控制放到一个统一框架里。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STAR-KV：用可微 soft-thresholding 在 attention head 和 block 两个粒度上自适应选 rank；对 K/V 采用不同的低秩分解策略，利用两者敏感性差异；再叠加 low-rank-aware mixed-precision quantization，根据统计特性做近无损低比特量化。实现上配了 Triton GPU kernel，说明作者关心的不只是离线压缩率，而是实际吞吐。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的结果是在多个 LLM 和 benchmark 上，单独做 KV 压缩可达 75% 压缩率，结合量化后总体 KV cache reduction 最高到 20x，同时尽量维持精度。具体模型规模、基线和退化幅度摘要未完整给出，但对比对象显然是固定 rank 或启发式 rank 的低秩 KV 方法，以及常规量化方案。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the KV-cache memory bottleneck in long-context inference, where prior low-rank methods rely on fixed or heuristic rank choices and degrade quickly under aggressive compression.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering contribution in inference efficiency rather than pretraining proper, but it matters for long-context serving, post-training evaluation, and RL rollouts because it combines adaptive low-rank compression and quantization in one deployable stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: STAR-KV introduces differentiable soft-thresholding for adaptive rank selection at both head and block granularity, uses different low-rank factorizations for keys and values based on their sensitivity, and adds low-rank-aware mixed-precision quantization driven by data statistics. The Triton kernel implementation suggests the work is aimed at real throughput, not just offline compression ratios.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, STAR-KV reaches up to 75% KV compression across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, and up to 20x total KV reduction when combined with quantization, while keeping accuracy degradation small. The likely baselines are fixed-rank or heuristic-rank low-rank KV methods plus standard quantization schemes, though the abstract does not expose the full setup.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型值得看实现细节的系统论文，不改 pretrain prior，但若你关心长上下文或 RL rollout 成本，只看自适应 rank 设计和 kernel 结果就够了。
recommendation.en: A solid systems paper to mine for implementation ideas; it does not change pretraining priors, but if long-context serving or RL rollout cost matters, read the adaptive-rank design and kernel results.

paper.title: Still: Amortized KV Cache Compaction in a Single Forward Pass
paper.abstract: The KV cache is the memory bottleneck of long-horizon language model deployment. Practically, a deployable compactor must be lightweight enough to call during inference, expressive enough to preserve context under constraint, and reusable across a trajectory. Existing compaction methods satisfy only part of this requirement: selection methods are lightweight but subset-bound, while synthesis methods are expressive but rely on per-context optimization. Here we introduce Still, a small per-layer P

summary.core_problem: 如何在长上下文 LLM 推理中，通过单次前向传播实现轻量且高压缩率的 KV Cache 压缩？
summary.importance: 提出了一种摊销的 KV Cache 压缩方法，在保持高压缩率的同时，避免了现有方法中选择性压缩的子集限制和合成性压缩的逐上下文优化开销。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 Still，一个针对冻结基础模型训练的小型逐层 Perceiver。它在单次前向传播中生成紧凑的 Key 和 Value，实现摊销的 KV Cache 压缩。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 和 Gemma 模型上，Still 在 8x 到 200x 的压缩率和 8k 到 128k 的上下文长度下，实现了速度和质量的良好平衡。在长上下文 RULER 网格上，超过最强基线 8-22 分。在 HELMET 上的自由形式摘要任务中也保持了大部分全上下文增益。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve lightweight and high-compression KV Cache compaction in a single forward pass for long-context LLM inference?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an amortized KV Cache compaction method that maintains high compression rates while avoiding the subset limitations of selective compression and the per-context optimization overhead of synthetic compression in existing methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Still, a small per-layer Perceiver trained against a frozen base model. It generates compact Keys and Values in a single forward pass, enabling amortized KV Cache compaction.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen and Gemma models, Still achieves a favorable speed-quality balance across compression ratios from 8x to 200x and context lengths from 8k to 128k. It outperforms the strongest baseline by 8-22 points on the long-context RULER grid and preserves most full-context gains on free-form summarization in HELMET.

recommendation.zh: 用 Perceiver 做 KV Cache 的单次前向压缩，思路干净，值得关注其在极高压缩率（200x）下的表现和训练代价。
recommendation.en: Using a Perceiver for single-forward KV Cache compaction is a clean approach; worth checking its performance at extreme compression ratios (200x) and the training cost.

paper.title: BUDDY: BUdget-Driven DYnamic Depth Routing for Adaptive Large Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) incur high inference cost due to their depth and parameter scale. Depth pruning can reduce latency by skipping redundant Transformer blocks, but existing methods (i) provide limited control under user-specific compute budgets and (ii) typically fix the routing path, failing to adapt as the context grows during decoding. We propose Buddy, a budget-driven dynamic depth routing framework. Buddy uses a lightweight Decision Module to score intermediate layers conditioned

summary.core_problem: 在不显著牺牲生成质量的前提下，让 LLM 推理时能按“用户给定算力预算”动态跳层，并且在解码过程中随上下文变化自适应路由。
summary.importance: 属于推理侧的“动态深度/早退”路线，但把“预算可控”与“decode-time 自适应”作为核心约束来做，直接对应线上 serving 的成本-质量控制问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Buddy：用轻量 Decision Module 对各层打分，在每步推理中确定性选择 top-k 层执行以满足预算；为降低解码阶段路由开销，复用第一层 KV cache 作为全局上下文特征，并与最新 token 表示池化后再做路由决策；可选 Budget Predictor 在未给定预算时预测输入相关的计算量，实现自动的质量-成本折中。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-family 与 Qwen 模型上评测（摘要未给出具体规模/数据与完整指标）；对比深度剪枝/固定路由等基线，主张在相同或更低计算下保持更好的质量-延迟折中，并展示随解码步数动态调整路径的效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Enable budget-controlled, decode-time adaptive layer skipping for LLM inference without large quality loss as context grows during generation.
summary_en.importance: A practical take on dynamic-depth/early-exit inference, explicitly targeting per-request compute budgets and step-wise adaptation—two constraints that matter in real serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Buddy uses a lightweight decision module to score layers and deterministically executes the top-k layers to meet a given budget. For low-overhead decode-time adaptation, it reuses the first-layer KV cache as a global context feature and pools it with the newest token representation before each routing decision. An optional budget predictor estimates an input-dependent compute level when no budget is provided.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama-family and Qwen models (abstract does not specify sizes/datasets/metrics). Compared against depth pruning and fixed routing baselines, reporting improved quality–latency trade-offs and demonstrating dynamic routing across decoding steps.

recommendation.zh: 把“预算约束”做成一等公民且支持 decode-time 动态路由，适合对照你们线上早退/跳层方案；重点看路由特征用首层 KV 的设计是否真能跨任务泛化。
recommendation.en: Treats compute budget as a first-class constraint and supports decode-time routing; worth comparing to your early-exit setup—focus on whether the first-layer-KV feature actually generalizes across tasks.

paper.title: OmniMem: Perturbation-aware Memory Compression for Streaming Audio-Visual LLMs
paper.abstract: Audio-visual large language models (LLMs) hold strong promise for long-form video understanding, yet their long-video inference is fundamentally limited by the linear growth of video tokens and key-value (KV) caches. We present OmniMem, a memory-efficient streaming framework designed specifically for audio-visual LLMs. Unlike existing compression methods that treat all tokens uniformly, OmniMem introduces a modality-aware memory allocation strategy that separately manages visual and audio contex

summary.core_problem: 音频-视觉LLM在长视频推理中受限于视频token和KV缓存的线性增长，现有压缩方法对所有token统一处理，忽略了视觉和音频之间严重的token不平衡问题。
summary.importance: 首次提出专为音视频LLM设计的流式内存高效框架，引入模态感知内存分配策略和扰动感知内存选择，解决了跨模态token不平衡的KV缓存压缩问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OmniMem：(1)模态感知内存分配策略，分别管理视觉和音频上下文以解决token不平衡；(2)扰动感知内存选择，保留有信息和非冗余的KV状态；(3)预算感知微调，在部署约束下加强压缩效果。
summary.experiments: 在VideoMME Long、LVBench和LVOmniBench上实验，在紧凑内存预算下保持了长程理解性能，优于现有统一压缩方法。
summary.authors_note: 无法从论文信息确认机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Audio-visual LLMs for long-form video understanding are fundamentally limited by the linear growth of video tokens and KV caches; existing compression methods treat all tokens uniformly, ignoring the severe token imbalance between visual and audio modalities.
summary_en.importance: First memory-efficient streaming framework specifically designed for audio-visual LLMs, introducing modality-aware memory allocation and perturbation-aware memory selection to address cross-modal token imbalance in KV cache compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents OmniMem with three key components: (1) modality-aware memory allocation strategy separately managing visual and audio contexts to address token imbalance; (2) perturbation-aware memory selection preserving informative and non-redundant KV states; (3) budget-aware fine-tuning to strengthen compression under realistic deployment constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on VideoMME Long, LVBench, and LVOmniBench demonstrate that OmniMem maintains long-range understanding performance under tight memory budgets, outperforming existing uniform compression methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliations not identifiable from paper information.

recommendation.zh: 面向AV-LLM的KV缓存压缩，模态感知分配策略有一定启发性。只看方法部分了解跨模态KV压缩思路即可。
recommendation.en: KV cache compression for AV-LLMs with modality-aware allocation strategy is somewhat illuminating; read only the method section for cross-modal KV compression insights.

paper.title: Semantic Cache Distillation: Efficient State Transfer via Reuse and Selective Patching
paper.abstract: Disaggregated serving alleviates memory bottlenecks in Large Language Model (LLM) inference but creates a severe communication bottleneck: transmitting high-dimensional Key-Value (KV) caches often dominates time-to-first-token (TTFT). Moreover, reusing caches across heterogeneous models (e.g., base and fine-tuned variants) causes semantic misalignment that accumulates over layers, degrading generation quality. We propose Semantic Cache Distillation (SCD), a loss-constrained framework that replac

summary.core_problem: 在disaggregated serving里，跨节点传输KV-cache导致TTFT被通信主导；且跨异构模型复用KV会语义失配、层间误差累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统/表示压缩方法：把“KV传输”改成“语义码传输+重建”，并显式处理跨模型复用的误差传播；对大规模推理集群的prefill/TTFT瓶颈很现实。
summary.technical_approach: Semantic Cache Distillation (SCD)：用loss约束学习紧凑semantic codes替代原始KV；两机制——Reuse：多数层用低秩子空间重建以降带宽；Patch：在稀疏的过渡层预测归一化输入做补丁，截断误差跨层传播，缓解异构模型语义漂移。
summary.experiments: 报告在质量-延迟Pareto上优于量化与选择性重算等基线；相对“oracle consumer prefill”最高约2.65× TTFT加速（摘要口径）；任务/模型规模与失真度量需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: In disaggregated LLM serving, KV-cache transfer dominates TTFT, and reusing caches across heterogeneous models causes semantic misalignment that compounds across layers.
summary_en.importance: Inference efficiency/system contribution: replaces raw KV transfer with compact semantic-code transfer plus reconstruction, explicitly addressing cross-model reuse error propagation—highly relevant to large-scale serving bottlenecks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Semantic Cache Distillation (SCD): a loss-constrained framework that learns compact semantic codes instead of transmitting full KV. Two mechanisms: Reuse reconstructs most layers from low-rank subspaces; Patch predicts normalized inputs at sparse transition layers to truncate error accumulation.
summary_en.experiments: Claims better quality–latency Pareto than quantization and selective recomputation baselines; up to ~2.65× TTFT speedup over an oracle consumer prefill (per abstract). Model/task details require the paper.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当“又一个KV量化”：核心是跨模型复用时的误差传播控制；只看Patch层的设计与消融，判断是否真能稳定复用。
recommendation.en: Not just another KV quantization: the key is controlling error propagation under cross-model cache reuse—skim the Patch design and ablations to judge stability.

paper.title: YouZhi: Towards High-Concurrency Financial LLMs via Adaptive GQA-to-MLA Transition
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) drive significant financial innovations, yet their high-concurrency deployment is severely bottlenecked by KV cache memory overhead, which inflates infrastructure costs and throttles scalability. To address this, we propose YouZhi-LLM, a highly efficient financial LLM empowered by a comprehensive structural transition and training pipeline natively built on the Huawei Ascend ecosystem. At its algorithmic core, YouZhi-LLM features a layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transitio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际、但常被金融垂类模型忽略的问题：如何把已有 GQA 架构的大模型改造成更适合高并发线上服务的 MLA 架构，同时尽量不伤害原有语言建模能力和金融领域能力。难点不在于“能不能转”，而在于“怎么转得细”。论文全文的关键发现是，GQA→MLA 转换带来的困惑度退化具有明显层间异质性：浅层更能接受较大的 FreqFold 压缩，部分中层则对 RoPE 频率近似更敏感，统一配置会把本来可控的结构改造变成不必要的能力损失。因此核心问题被具体化为：在给定 KV cache 压缩目标下，如何做逐层自适应的结构迁移，并配合后续训练把结构损伤和领域能力缺口补回来。
summary.importance: 对预训练/基座研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它说明“架构改造”和“后训练恢复”可以作为一个连续流程来设计，而不是先压缩、再单独补救。对于已经训练完成的大模型，这是一种介于重新预训练和纯推理优化之间的中间路线。第二，它给出一个较清楚的信号：注意力结构的可替换性不是全层均匀的，层功能分化会直接决定结构迁移的代价。这一点对后续做 GQA/MQA/MLA/混合注意力、甚至 MoE 层级异构设计都有参考意义。贡献量级上，它更像一篇工程导向但方法上有实质内容的系统论文，不是新的预训练范式，但对“如何把已有基座模型改造成可部署模型”这件事有较强现实价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是逐层退化分析。作者在 partial RoPE stage 做单层替换实验：一次只把一个 GQA 层改成 MLA，其余层保持不变，然后测困惑度变化。这样可以把不同层对 FreqFold 的敏感性拆开看。结果显示，浅层在较大 FreqFold 下反而更稳，说明主成分压缩收益大于频率近似误差；中层则更依赖精确频率信息，FreqFold=1 往往最好。

第二部分是 layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transition。作者把每层 FreqFold 选择写成组合优化问题，但直接穷举不可行，于是改写成多轮顺序决策，逐层分配压缩配置，目标是在整体 KV 压缩和困惑度退化之间找更优折中。虽然给出的摘要片段没有完整展开算法细节，但从全文脉络看，核心不是训练一个复杂控制器，而是利用前面的层敏感性分析，把统一超参替换成逐层可变配置。这一点与常见“一刀切 MLA 转换”区别很大。

第三部分是能力恢复与领域注入。结构迁移后，作者没有只做普通 SFT，而是设计了完整 post-training pipeline：包括分层数据压缩、金融领域数据增强、合规拒答数据构造、以及指令跟随强化。这里的逻辑很清楚：结构转换先解决服务瓶颈，但会损伤表示能力；后训练再把通用能力和金融能力拉回到可用区间。论文还强调其训练和部署都原生适配华为 Ascend 生态，并在 vLLM-Ascend 上实现 MLA operator，这使得方法不是停留在离线实验，而是能落到真实 serving 栈里。
summary.experiments: 实验里最重要的结果有三类。第一类是结构转换本身的收益。作者报告最终模型实现了 72% 的 KV cache 降低，以及 2.69× 的最大并发提升，这直接对应高并发金融场景的部署目标。第二类是逐层自适应优于统一转换。全文的关键证据来自 layer-wise perplexity degradation 曲线：不同层的最优 FreqFold 明显不同，说明统一配置不是 Pareto 最优。作者声称在多个主流 LLM 上，自适应分配相比 uniform conversion 能显著降低困惑度退化。第三类是后训练恢复效果。通过金融数据增强、拒答构造和指令强化，模型不仅补回了结构改造造成的能力损失，还在金融 benchmark 和真实手机银行任务上取得提升。摘要片段没有给出完整参数规模和全部 benchmark 数字，因此无法在这里精确复述每个表格的绝对分数；但从全文主线看，最该关注的不是单点分数，而是“精度-并发”Pareto 前沿是否整体右上移动，论文声称这一点成立。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，理解作者到底在优化什么：不是单纯压缩，而是面向高并发金融服务的 accuracy-efficiency trade-off。第二看方法部分关于单层替换分析和 Figure 4，这基本是全文最有信息量的地方，决定了为什么必须做 layer-adaptive 而不是统一 FreqFold。第三看实验里关于 KV cache、最大并发、以及金融任务恢复效果的表格，判断这是不是“压缩后还能用”，还是“压缩后重新训回来了”。

预计 25-35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。若要深挖，重点看两点：一是逐层敏感性的来源，是否和层内频率编码使用方式、特征谱分布、或注意力头功能分工有关；二是 post-training 在恢复结构损伤时到底恢复了什么，是语言建模能力、指令能力，还是金融知识本身。前者关系到能否推广到别的架构迁移，后者关系到这种路线是否能替代部分持续预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a deployment-driven but technically nontrivial problem: how to convert existing GQA-based LLMs into MLA-style models for high-concurrency serving, while keeping the loss in language modeling quality and domain capability under control. The key observation from the full paper is that GQA-to-MLA conversion is not layer-uniform. Different layers react very differently to FreqFold compression during the partial-RoPE transition. Early layers can tolerate more aggressive folding, while some middle layers are much more sensitive to RoPE frequency approximation. So the real problem is not merely whether MLA can compress KV cache, but how to perform a layer-adaptive structural transition and then recover the lost capacity through targeted post-training.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model research, the main value is methodological rather than conceptual novelty. It shows that architectural conversion and capability recovery should be treated as one pipeline, not as separate compression and fine-tuning stages. This is useful for practitioners working with already-trained base models, where full re-pretraining is too expensive but pure inference-side optimization is insufficient. A second useful signal is that attention-structure substitutability is strongly layer-dependent. That matters beyond MLA: it is relevant to mixed attention designs, GQA/MQA/MLA hybrids, and more generally to heterogeneous layer design in large models. The contribution is best read as a solid systems-and-modeling paper with practical implications, not as a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three connected pieces. First, the authors run a layer-wise degradation study. In the partial-RoPE stage, they convert only one layer from GQA to MLA at a time while keeping all other layers unchanged, then measure perplexity degradation. This isolates each layer’s sensitivity to different FreqFold settings. The main finding is clear: shallow layers often prefer larger FreqFold values, suggesting that principal-component concentration helps more than frequency approximation hurts; middle layers often prefer FreqFold=1, meaning accurate RoPE frequency preservation matters more there.

Second, they build a layer-adaptive GQA-to-MLA transition algorithm. The per-layer FreqFold assignment is formulated as a combinatorial optimization problem, then reframed as a multi-round sequential decision process to avoid brute-force search over all layer configurations. The central idea is simple but important: replace a uniform conversion hyperparameter with a per-layer allocation strategy guided by measured sensitivity. That is the main methodological difference from one-shot, globally uniform MLA conversion.

Third, they add a post-training pipeline to recover capability and inject financial expertise. This includes stratified data compression, financial-domain augmentation, refusal-data construction for compliance scenarios, and instruction-following reinforcement. The logic is coherent: structural conversion solves the serving bottleneck, but it weakens representation quality; post-training is then used to restore general and domain-specific competence. The paper also emphasizes native implementation on Huawei Ascend and deployment through vLLM-Ascend with MLA operators, which makes the work more than an offline architecture study.
summary_en.experiments: The most important results fall into three groups. First, the serving gains are substantial: the final model reports a 72% reduction in KV-cache usage and a 2.69× increase in maximum concurrency. These are the headline numbers because the target setting is high-traffic financial deployment. Second, the layer-adaptive conversion outperforms uniform conversion. The evidence comes from the layer-wise perplexity degradation curves: the optimal FreqFold differs markedly by layer, so a single global setting is not Pareto-efficient. The paper reports lower perplexity degradation than uniform baselines across several mainstream LLM backbones. Third, the post-training pipeline recovers and improves task performance. With domain augmentation, refusal construction, and instruction reinforcement, the converted model not only regains capability lost during transition but also improves on financial benchmarks and real mobile-banking tasks. The provided text does not include the full model sizes or every benchmark score, so the most reliable takeaway is the shift of the accuracy-efficiency frontier rather than any single absolute metric.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. Start with the introduction and the first system-level figures to understand the actual optimization target: not generic compression, but the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under high-concurrency financial serving. Then go to the method section around the single-layer conversion analysis and the layer-wise degradation figure. That is the most informative part of the paper and the main reason the adaptive design is justified. Finally, inspect the tables on KV-cache reduction, concurrency, and financial-task recovery to judge whether the converted model remains practically usable.

A solid skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. If you want to go deeper, there are two worthwhile questions. One is why layer sensitivity differs: is it tied to RoPE usage, spectral structure of features, or functional specialization across layers? The other is what exactly post-training recovers after structural conversion: language modeling quality, instruction following, domain knowledge, or all three to different degrees. Those questions determine how transferable this recipe is to other architecture transitions.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和消融表：GQA→MLA 的逐层改造若可复现，可作为存量模型降 KV 的现实路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: if the layerwise GQA-to-MLA conversion holds up, it is a practical path for reducing KV cost in existing models.

paper.title: Beyond tokens: a unified framework for latent communication in LLM-based multi-agent systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) have become a prevailing paradigm for tackling complex reasoning, planning, and tool-use tasks. The dominant communication protocol in such systems is natural language: agents exchange messages token-by-token, verbalising their internal reasoning so that peers can read, verify, and respond. While convenient and interpretable, this protocol suffers from three structural drawbacks -- high inference cost, irreversible information loss during

summary.core_problem: 整理并统一 LLM 多智能体系统中的 latent communication 研究，回答 agent 之间除了自然语言外还能交换什么、怎么交换、如何训练与评估。
summary.importance: 这是综述/框架化文章，不是新方法。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于把 hidden states、embeddings、KV-cache 作为通信介质这一支文献梳理清楚，便于判断哪些设定可能反哺统一建模或 test-time compute 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 文章沿三个正交维度组织现有工作：通信内容（WHAT）、通信时机/对象（WHEN/WHO）、以及训练与优化方式（HOW）。核心不是提出算法，而是给 latent communication 建一个统一坐标系，比较文本通信与连续表示通信在成本、信息保真和可解释性上的取舍。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看没有新的系统实验或 benchmark，重点是文献归纳与概念框架。若正文包含案例表格或 taxonomy 图，适合作为快速索引，但不应当作实证结论来源。

summary_en.core_problem: It organizes the literature on latent communication in LLM-based multi-agent systems, asking what agents can exchange beyond natural language, when they exchange it, and how it is trained and evaluated.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey/framework paper rather than a new method. Its value for a pretraining researcher is mainly in clarifying the design space around hidden states, embeddings, and KV-cache as communication media, which may inform unified modeling or test-time compute design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper structures existing work along three orthogonal axes: WHAT is communicated, WHEN/WHO communicates, and HOW the communication is optimized. The contribution is a unified taxonomy rather than a new algorithm, contrasting text-based communication with continuous-representation exchange in terms of cost, information fidelity, and interpretability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not indicate new system experiments or a benchmark; the main output is conceptual organization. If the full paper includes good taxonomy figures or comparison tables, it is useful as an index, not as primary empirical evidence.

recommendation.zh: 这是文献地图，不是结果论文；如果你在想 hidden state/KV 能否替代 token 通信，扫 taxonomy 和 related work 就够，不必细读。
recommendation.en: This is a literature map, not a results paper; if you are thinking about hidden-state/KV communication as a substitute for token exchange, skim the taxonomy and related-work tables and stop there.

paper.title: QCFuse: Query-Aware Cache Fusion via Compressed View for Efficient RAG Serving
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language model (LLM) answer quality by grounding generation in external evidence, but processing retrieved contexts makes the prefill stage a dominant serving cost. RAG cache fusion reduces this cost by reusing precomputed key-value (KV) caches for retrieved chunks and selectively recomputing tokens under the current prompt. Existing selectors, however, face a dilemma between quality and efficiency: fast query-agnostic or final-layer query-to-c

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG场景下的KV缓存融合方案在选择需要重计算的token时面临质量和效率的两难：查询无关的选择器或仅用最后一层注意力的选择器会丢失关键上下文，全视角的查询感知选择器需要提前加载所有层的KV缓存，打断分层流水线并行，大幅增加延迟。
summary.importance: 优化了RAG服务的预填充阶段效率，对大模型推理部署的成本降低有实际工程价值，也为缓存复用与查询感知的结合提供了新的轻量化思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QCFuse压缩视角查询感知选择器，从两个维度压缩选择器的计算开销：1）离线阶段为每个RAG语块选择代表性锚点token，在线阶段仅用锚点集合计算查询与语块的相关性，无需遍历全部上下文token；2）离线阶段识别出查询-上下文注意力最能定位相关token的关键层，在线阶段仅扫描这些关键层的注意力信号，无需遍历所有层；整体方案兼容分层缓存融合流水线，不打断并行流程。
summary.experiments: 在多款开源LLM和数据集上测试，相同生成质量下，QCFuse的预填充阶段速度比完全预计算平均快1.7倍，比最强的保质量基线ProphetKV平均快1.5倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言部分了解缓存融合的现有瓶颈，第3章重点看锚点探测和关键层 profiling 的核心设计，实验部分看端到端延迟和质量对比即可，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache fusion schemes for RAG scenarios face a quality-efficiency dilemma when selecting tokens for recomputation: query-agnostic selectors or selectors only using last-layer attention miss critical context, while full-view query-aware selectors require preloading KV caches of all layers, breaking layer-wise pipeline parallelism and significantly increasing latency.
summary_en.importance: QCFuse optimizes prefill stage efficiency for RAG serving, delivering practical engineering value for reducing LLM inference deployment costs, and provides a new lightweight approach for combining cache reuse with query awareness.
summary_en.technical_approach: QCFuse is a compressed-view query-aware selector that reduces computation overhead from two dimensions: 1) Offline stage selects representative anchor tokens for each RAG chunk; during online serving, query-chunk relevance is computed only over anchor sets, eliminating the need to traverse all context tokens. 2) Offline stage identifies critical layers where query-to-context attention best localizes relevant tokens; during online serving, the selector only scans attention signals from these critical layers, avoiding full layer traversal. The entire scheme is compatible with layer-wise cache fusion pipelines and does not interrupt parallel processing.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple open-source LLMs and datasets, at matched generation quality, QCFuse achieves an average 1.7× prefill speedup over full prefill, and 1.5× average speedup over ProphetKV, the strongest quality-preserving baseline.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction to understand existing bottlenecks of cache fusion, focus on the core designs of anchor probing and critical layer profiling in Section 3, and review end-to-end latency and quality comparisons in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 setup 很实；做长上下文 serving 的只看 compressed view selector 和 critical-layer profiling 两个点就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup looks practical; if you care about long-context serving, just read the compressed-view selector and critical-layer profiling pieces.

paper.title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
paper.abstract: As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Several important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems lar

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM服务中KV缓存是核心瓶颈，现有系统采用统一的token级KV管理和稠密布局，与实际工作负载中注意力头级的稀疏性结构不匹配，导致位置无关KV缓存复用率低、短上下文下占比过半的FFN开销无法被注意力侧优化覆盖、稀疏KV掩码触发FlashAttention慢路径，实际收益远低于理论预期。
summary.importance: 其观测到的真实服务负载下的头级稀疏性规律，为预训练阶段的注意力架构设计、冗余头裁剪提供了实证依据，存储、计算、负载粒度三者对齐的协同优化思路，也为预训练阶段的推理友好性设计提供了明确方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RedKnot服务系统，包含三个协同设计的机制：1）头级分类稀疏化：离线将每个（层，头）对分为全局头（12-15%，复用时重新预填充）和局部头（85-88%，滑动窗口内直接复用），运行时通过边质量信号自适应升级局部头，避免token级补丁的级联陈旧问题；2）SegPagedAttention：替换稠密布局为每个（层，头）独立的分页KV存储，配合融合变长注意力内核，物理上只保留每个头需要的token，全程走FlashAttention快路径，消除掩码带来的4.9-7.6倍内核开销；3）稀疏FFN：只计算注意力得分最高的top-k个token的FFN，覆盖2-8K短上下文场景下占比57-62%的FFN开销，三个机制的收益可叠加。
summary.experiments: 基于SGLang实现，在8卡H800服务器上测试Mistral-7B、Qwen3-32B、Llama-3.3-70B三个模型，上下文长度覆盖8K到128K，共6个QA数据集；相比稠密基线，首token延迟提升1.6-3.54倍，单GPU并发会话数提升4.7-7.8倍，预填充FLOPs减少67-79.5%，端到端精度不低于稠密基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看第3节对现有系统三个结构不匹配问题的分析，再看第4节的三个核心机制设计，重点关注头级稀疏性的实证统计数据，预计阅读时间20-25分钟；若关注预训练的推理友好性设计，可重点查看头分类的统计规律部分。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache is the dominant bottleneck in long-context LLM serving. Existing systems use unified token-level KV management and dense layouts, which mismatch the per-head sparsity structure of real workloads. This mismatch leads to low reuse rate of position-independent KV cache, unaddressed FFN overhead that accounts for over half of short-context latency, and 4.9-7.6x kernel penalty from sparse attention masks that disable the FlashAttention fast path, resulting in far lower real-world gains than theoretical predictions.
summary_en.importance: The observed per-head sparsity patterns from real serving workloads provide empirical evidence for attention architecture design and redundant head pruning during pretraining. The co-design principle of aligning storage, computation, and workload granularity also offers clear direction for inference-friendly design in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RedKnot is a serving system built on SGLang with three co-designed mechanisms: 1) Head-class sparsification: offline classification of each (layer, head) pair into global heads (12-15%, re-prefilled on reuse) and local heads (85-88%, reused directly within a sliding window), with adaptive runtime promotion of local heads via edge-mass signal to avoid cascading staleness of token-level patches. 2) SegPagedAttention: replaces dense KV layout with per-(layer, head) paged KV store and fused varlen attention kernel, physically retaining only tokens required by each head to stay on the FlashAttention fast path and eliminate mask-induced kernel penalty. 3) Sparse FFN: computes FFN only for top-k tokens with highest attention scores to address the 57-62% FFN overhead in 2-8K short-context workloads that no attention-side optimization can cover. Gains from the three mechanisms are multiplicative.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on an 8x NVIDIA H800 server across Mistral-7B, Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.3-70B, 6 QA datasets, and context lengths from 8K to 128K. Compared to dense baselines, RedKnot delivers 1.6-3.54x time-to-first-token speedup, 4.7-7.8x higher concurrent sessions per GPU, 67-79.5% reduction in prefill FLOPs, while matching or exceeding end-to-end accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first read section 3 on the three structural mismatches of existing serving systems, then review the three core mechanisms in section 4, with focus on empirical statistics of per-head sparsity. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes. If focused on inference-friendly pretraining design, refer to the statistics of head classification.

recommendation.zh: 打破了 KV Cache 同质化管理的 prior，提出 Head-Aware 的细粒度管理（SegPagedAttention），对长文本推理系统的内存优化非常有启发，建议系统/推理优化方向的研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: Breaks the prior of homogeneous KV Cache management, proposing Head-Aware fine-grained management (SegPagedAttention); highly inspiring for memory optimization in long-context inference systems. Recommended for system/inference optimization researchers.

paper.title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) serving is critical for consistent user experiences, yet the linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant pressure on GPU memory and bandwidth. Non-uniform KV compression effectively preserves more information by considering the individual importance of each KV cache. However, such KV cache heterogeneity introduces various systemic challenges - including memory fragmentation, scheduling complexities, and diminished kernel utilization - which

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“如何设计更好的 KV 压缩算法”，而是一个更实际的问题：非均匀 KV cache 压缩在算法上已经显示出比均匀压缩更好的精度-压缩权衡，但一旦放进真实多轮 serving 系统，就会因为内存布局、调度和 kernel 执行三方面的不匹配而失去收益。具体说，现有 vLLM / SGLang 一类系统默认所有 attention head 的 KV 长度一致；而非均匀压缩让不同 head 保留不同长度，结果带来页碎片、运行时回收开销、GPU workload 不均衡，最终使“理论上省下来的 KV”无法转化成吞吐提升。Tangram 的核心问题就是：怎样把 head-wise heterogeneous KV cache 变成一个可被高吞吐 serving 系统稳定利用的对象。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练本身，而在 serving 约束如何反过来影响建模与压缩方法的可落地性。很多 KV 压缩论文只报告 perplexity 或长上下文精度，却默认系统可以无代价地承接异构 cache；Tangram 说明这一步并不成立。它的贡献更像是把“非均匀 KV 压缩”从算法想法推进到系统可部署层面。对做预训练和架构的人，这篇文章的启发是：如果模型内部确实存在稳定的 retrieval heads 或 head-wise retention pattern，那么这些结构性不均匀性不仅可以用于压缩，也可以作为系统 co-design 的先验。换句话说，模型统计规律若足够稳定，就值得在 serving 栈里显式编码，而不是只停留在分析层面。
summary.technical_approach:
Tangram 的技术路线围绕一个关键观察展开：不同 attention head 需要保留多少历史 token，这种 retention pattern 在同一模型内是相对稳定、可预先估计的，而不是每个请求都剧烈变化。基于这个观察，作者把原本需要在线决定的异构 KV 管理，改写成一个尽量静态、可预编排的问题。

第一部分是 Deterministic Budget Allocation。传统非均匀压缩如果按请求动态回收 KV，会产生大量控制面开销，因为系统要跟踪每个 head、每个 page 的占用与释放。Tangram 直接为各 head 预分配确定性的 retention budget，把动态 reclaim 变成静态 footprint 规划。这样做的好处是把复杂的在线内存管理前移，减少 runtime bookkeeping。代价是灵活性下降，但作者的前提是 head-wise pattern 足够稳定，因此这个取舍成立。

第二部分是 Head Group Page。现有 paged KV 设计通常以统一 page 结构管理所有 heads，适合均匀长度，不适合异构长度，因为某些 head 压缩后释放不出完整 page，形成严重内部碎片。Tangram 将具有相近 budget 的 heads 分组，给每组建立独立 page table。这样 page 的物理回收粒度更贴近真实保留长度，能显著减少 fragmentation。为了避免 page table 操作本身成为 CPU 瓶颈，作者还实现了 vectorized block table，用 CPU SIMD 并行处理映射与查表。

第三部分是 Ahead-of-Time Load Balancing。非均匀 KV 长度会让不同 head 或不同块的 attention 计算量差异很大，若仍按常规方式分配给 GPU SM，会出现 straggler，拖低 kernel 利用率。Tangram 利用预算分布是静态已知这一点，离线预计算 workload 切分方案，把负载均衡从 runtime planner 挪到 ahead-of-time 阶段。这样 kernel 执行时不需要再做复杂调度，能更稳定地维持 SM 利用率。

从方法性质看，这不是单点优化，而是一个围绕“静态化异构结构”的系统级重构：先把 head-wise retention 视为模型固有属性，再据此重写内存分配、页组织和 kernel 调度。它和单纯改 attention kernel 或单纯改压缩策略不同，重点在于把算法侧的异构性转成系统侧可利用的确定性结构。
summary.experiments:
文中最核心的结果是端到端多轮 serving 吞吐最高提升 2.6×。这个数字的重要性在于，它不是单独某个 kernel microbenchmark，而是作者声称把非均匀 KV 压缩真正转化成了系统级收益。

实验设计围绕三类瓶颈展开：
1. 内存效率：比较 Tangram 与现有 paged KV 方案在非均匀压缩下的实际可回收显存，重点看 fragmentation 是否显著下降。论文的论证方向很明确：如果没有 head-group page，理论压缩率和实际显存回收之间会有明显落差。
2. 调度与控制开销：比较动态 reclaim 与 deterministic budget allocation 的 CPU/runtime overhead。作者强调在线跟踪 scattered pages 会拖慢系统，而静态预算能显著降低控制面成本。
3. GPU 利用率：比较默认执行方式与 AOT load balancing 在 heterogeneous KV 下的 SM 利用率和 straggler 效应。这里的关键不是单次 latency，而是持续高并发下吞吐是否稳定。

从全文给出的信息看，作者主要在多轮对话 serving 场景下评估，关注随着 turn 增长 KV cache 线性膨胀时，系统吞吐如何退化，以及 Tangram 能否延缓这种退化。论文还把 Tangram 放到现有 serving 栈语境中讨论，说明它不是脱离 vLLM/SGLang 生态的孤立原型。

如果从研究者角度看，最值得注意的不是单个绝对数字，而是作者把收益拆成了“压缩算法收益”和“系统兑现率”两层：非均匀压缩本身保留精度，但 Tangram 关注的是这些节省下来的 token budget 最终有多少能变成真实吞吐与显存收益。这种评价方式比只报压缩比更扎实。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇文章适合泛读，重点不是公式，而是系统瓶颈拆解是否清楚。建议先看 Introduction，确认作者定义的三个问题：monolithic page structure、dynamic reclamation bottleneck、workload imbalance。这里决定了整篇文章是否成立。

然后看方法部分的三块：
- Deterministic Budget Allocation：看作者如何证明 head-wise retention pattern 足够稳定，静态预算不会明显损失压缩效果。
- Head Group Page：重点看 page layout 图和 fragmentation 分析，这部分最能体现为什么现有 paged attention 不能直接承接非均匀 KV。
- AOT Load Balancing：重点看 workload 切分示意图和 kernel 利用率结果，理解作者如何把异构长度转成可预调度的执行计划。

实验部分建议优先看端到端 throughput、memory reclamation、SM utilization 三类图表。若时间有限，抓住“2.6× throughput 提升来自哪些组件叠加”即可，预计 20–30 分钟能读完主线。若想深挖，可进一步看作者对 retention stability 的实证，因为这是整个系统静态化设计的前提；如果这个前提只在少数模型上成立，方法的泛化边界就会比较明显。

summary_en.core_problem: Tangram is not about inventing a better KV compression rule. It addresses a more practical gap: non-uniform KV compression often looks better than uniform compression in accuracy-vs-memory trade-offs, but existing LLM serving stacks cannot realize those gains efficiently. Current systems such as vLLM and SGLang are built around a uniform-KV assumption, where all heads share the same cache shape. Once different heads retain different numbers of tokens, the system runs into three coupled issues: page fragmentation, high runtime reclamation overhead, and poor GPU kernel utilization due to workload skew. The paper asks a concrete systems question: how to make head-wise heterogeneous KV caches usable in high-throughput multi-turn serving.
summary_en.importance: The value of this work is not in pretraining directly, but in showing that model-side structure only matters if the serving stack can exploit it. Many KV compression papers report perplexity or long-context accuracy improvements and implicitly assume the systems layer is free. Tangram shows that this assumption breaks for non-uniform caches. For foundation-model researchers, the useful takeaway is that stable head-level structure—such as retrieval heads or persistent retention asymmetry—can be treated as a systems prior, not just an interpretability observation. If those patterns are stable enough, they can shape memory layout, scheduling, and kernel design. That is a meaningful bridge between model analysis and deployment reality.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The entire design is built on one observation: the retention budget needed by each attention head is relatively stable for a given model. Tangram uses that stability to turn an online heterogeneous-memory problem into a mostly static planning problem.

The first component is Deterministic Budget Allocation. A naive non-uniform KV system would reclaim memory dynamically as requests evolve, but that creates substantial control-plane overhead because the runtime must track and recover scattered pages for many heads. Tangram instead assigns deterministic per-head budgets ahead of time, converting dynamic reclamation into a preplanned memory footprint. The gain is lower runtime bookkeeping and simpler scheduling. The trade-off is reduced flexibility, but the paper argues that the head-wise pattern is stable enough that this is acceptable.

The second component is Head Group Page. Existing paged-KV designs use a monolithic page structure that works well when all heads have the same cache length. Under heterogeneous retention, that design causes severe internal fragmentation because compressed heads cannot reclaim memory cleanly at the right granularity. Tangram groups heads with similar budgets and gives each group its own page table. This makes physical memory reclamation better aligned with actual retention lengths. To keep page-table operations from becoming a CPU bottleneck, the system also introduces a vectorized block table implemented with CPU SIMD parallelism.

The third component is Ahead-of-Time Load Balancing. Non-uniform KV lengths create large differences in attention workload across heads and blocks. If the runtime uses standard scheduling, some GPU SMs become stragglers while others idle. Since the cache shape is known in advance from the deterministic budgets, Tangram moves load balancing offline and precomputes a workload distribution plan. This avoids runtime planning latency and improves kernel utilization under heterogeneous cache layouts.

What matters here is the overall design philosophy. Tangram does not optimize a single kernel in isolation. It treats head-wise heterogeneity as a predictable structural property and then co-designs memory management, paging, and execution around that property.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is up to 2.6x end-to-end throughput improvement in multi-turn serving. That number matters because it is presented as a system-level outcome rather than a narrow kernel microbenchmark.

The evaluation is organized around the three bottlenecks identified earlier:
