summary.experiments: 摘要称在直接谱近似会预测失败的压缩比例下，VideoMLA 仍能保持视频质量。实验聚焦长 rollout causal video diffusion 的 KV cache 压缩、显存和延迟收益，以及压缩后质量保持。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 列表和完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces KV-cache memory and latency for minute-scale autoregressive video diffusion while preserving long-video generation quality.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-efficiency and mechanism-analysis contribution. VideoMLA transfers Multi-Head Latent Attention from language models to video diffusion and argues that MLA can work even when the usual low-rank attention-spectrum assumption does not hold.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces per-head keys and values with a shared low-rank content latent and a shared decoupled 3D-RoPE positional key. This reduces per-token KV memory by 92.7% at every cached layer. The paper also analyzes the effective rank of pretrained video attention and finds that the 99%-energy rank is far above practical latent dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that VideoMLA preserves quality at compression ratios where direct spectral approximation would predict large degradation. Experiments focus on KV-cache compression, memory and latency benefits, and quality retention in long-rollout causal video diffusion. The abstract does not provide model scale, training data, baseline list, or full numbers.

recommendation.zh: 重点看“非低秩但 MLA 仍有效”的分析；这会修正把 MLA 只理解成谱压缩的朴素 prior。
recommendation.en: Focus on the “not low-rank yet MLA works” analysis; it corrects the simplistic view that MLA is just spectral compression.

paper.title: Moment-KV: Momentum-Based Decode-Time KV Cache Compression for Long Generation
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) cache remains a major bottleneck for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in long-generation tasks. Prior work often applies uniform compression across both prefill and decoding caches, but compressing the prefill cache degrades performance by corrupting critical context. While preserving the prefill cache is essential, decoding-phase compression remains underexplored, with existing methods relying on rigid recency windows or instantaneous attention. Our analysis of attention dy

summary.core_problem: 长文本生成任务中，KV Cache 的线性增长导致严重的显存瓶颈。现有压缩方法多针对 Prefill 阶段，或在 Decode 阶段使用简单的滑动窗口/最近性启发式策略，忽略了注意力机制的动态时序特征（即重要 token 的注意力可能短暂下降后恢复），导致关键 token 被过早驱逐。
summary.importance: 揭示了 Decode 阶段注意力动态变化的规律（Heavy Hitters 的非单调性），提出了一种基于动量的 KV Cache 压缩策略，为长文本生成的推理优化提供了一个不依赖静态启发式规则的新视角，且与 Prefill 压缩方法正交。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Moment-KV。核心机制是：1) 冻结 Prefill Cache 以保留完整上下文；2) 在 Decode 阶段，不依赖单步的瞬时注意力，而是引入动量机制（Momentum-Based），将历史注意力得分进行衰减聚合，作为 token 的持续重要性状态；3) 当 Cache 容量超限时，纯粹基于聚合重要性得分进行驱逐，完全摒弃最近性偏置（Recency Bias）。
summary.experiments: 在 LongGenBench 和 HelloBench（输出长度 4K-16K）上评估。在 1024 和 512 token 的 Decode 预算下，Moment-KV 均优于基线，相对提升分别为 2.32% 和 3.26%，且不影响吞吐量。与 Prefill 压缩策略结合时，性能进一步提升 7.26%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 §3 对 LLaMA-3.1 注意力模式的分析（图 1），理解 Heavy Hitters 的非单调性；以及 §4 中动量聚合公式的设计。适合关注长文本推理优化和 KV Cache 压缩的研究者泛读，预计 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The linear growth of KV Cache causes severe memory bottlenecks in long-text generation. Existing compression methods mostly focus on the prefill phase or use simple sliding window/recency heuristics in the decode phase, ignoring the dynamic temporal characteristics of attention (i.e., attention to important tokens may temporarily drop and then recover), leading to premature eviction of critical tokens.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the dynamic patterns of attention during the decode phase (the non-monotonicity of Heavy Hitters) and proposes a momentum-based KV Cache compression strategy, providing a new perspective for inference optimization in long-text generation that does not rely on static heuristics, and is orthogonal to prefill compression methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Moment-KV. The core mechanisms are: 1) Freezing the prefill cache to preserve full context; 2) In the decode phase, instead of relying on single-step instantaneous attention, introducing a momentum mechanism to aggregate historical attention scores with decay as the continuous importance state of tokens; 3) When cache capacity is exceeded, evicting tokens purely based on aggregated importance scores, completely discarding recency bias.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongGenBench and HelloBench (output lengths 4K-16K). Under decode budgets of 1024 and 512 tokens, Moment-KV consistently outperforms baselines, with relative improvements of 2.32% and 3.26%, respectively, without affecting throughput. When combined with prefill compression strategies, performance further improves by 7.26%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 for the analysis of LLaMA-3.1 attention patterns (Figure 1) to understand the non-monotonicity of Heavy Hitters, and §4 for the design of the momentum aggregation formula. Suitable for researchers interested in long-context inference optimization and KV Cache compression. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 思路不新到改写范式，但“prefill 别乱压、decode 用时间聚合做保留”这个判断很实在；先看 attention dynamics 分析和压缩率-质量曲线。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but the claim that prefill should be left mostly intact while decode cache needs temporal aggregation is practical; read the attention-dynamics analysis and the compression-quality curves first.

paper.title: MarginGate: Sparse Margin-Triggered Verification for Batch-Invariant LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Temperature-zero BF16 LLM inference is often treated as reproducible, yet the same request can emit different tokens when decoded alone or inside a larger batch. Existing fixes use batch-invariant operators or LLM-42's per-token verification, incurring cost even when most steps are stable. We ask whether verification can be applied exclusively to flipped tokens. Across five models, batch-induced token flips are sparse on the flip-rate benchmarks: on MATH500, Llama-3.1-8B flips on $0.48\%$ of syn

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 BF16 贪心解码的批大小敏感性：同一个请求在单独解码和混入动态 batch 解码时，即使 temperature=0，也可能因为 CUDA reduction 顺序、算子形状和数值舍入差异产生不同 token。已有确定性方案要么改大量算子，要么像 LLM-42 一样逐 token 做确定性重算，成本偏高。MarginGate 关注的问题更窄：能否只在真正有翻转风险的少数步骤上触发验证。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对基座模型评测、蒸馏、回归测试、LLM-as-a-judge、RL/SFT 数据生成有实际意义。这些流程常把 greedy decoding 当作确定性原语，如果 serving batch 形状改变输出，会污染评测可复现性和训练数据一致性。论文的价值在于把“确定性推理”从全局算子替换或全量验证，推进到按风险选择性验证，并给出了一个可测量的成本—确定性边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法建立在三个观察上。第一，batch-induced token flip 很稀疏，论文在多个模型和 MATH500、GSM8K、HumanEval 上观察到同步解码步骤的翻转率大约在 0.3% 到 1.3%。第二，翻转前 protected request 的 K/V 轨迹相对确定性参考没有明显时间轴漂移，分叉主要发生在当前 decode position 的 K/V column。第三，top-1 与 top-2 logit margin 很低时更容易发生 argmax 翻转。MarginGate 因此采用 step-local 策略：每步先走默认 BF16 batched fast path；若当前 top-1/top-2 margin 低于模型校准阈值，则调用确定性 verifier；若 verifier 给出的 token 与 BF16 path 不同，只覆盖当前 K/V column，并输出 verifier token。它和 LLM-42 的区别是 verifier 不再每步调用，而是由 margin gate 稀疏触发；它和 batch-invariant ops / LayerCast 的区别是没有在整个 decode loop 上广泛替换或 upcast 算子。
summary.experiments: 核心实验比较了 BF16 默认推理、Batch-Invariant Ops、LayerCast、LLM-42 全量逐 token 验证和 MarginGate。论文报告，在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，MarginGate 可以恢复 sequence-level deterministic decoding，verifier 只在 18.56% 的同步 decode 步骤触发；Qwen2.5-14B 的触发率为 15.05%，也达到确定性；DSR1-Distill-Qwen-7B 是边界情况，低 margin 区间更宽，触发率升至 49.50%。相对 LLM-42 的 100% 逐 token 验证，MarginGate 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上将 LLM-42 的 latency increment 降低约 2.23 倍，在 Qwen2.5-14B 上约 1.99 倍。消融和诊断部分的关键信息是：K/V perturbation 在翻转前保持平坦，oracle single-column repair 支持“当前列局部修复”假设，阈值 sweep 展示了不同模型的触发率和确定性恢复之间的 tradeoff。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看第 2 节的 motivating observations，尤其是 flip-rate 定义、synchronous samples 的处理、K/V 轨迹诊断和 margin 与 flip risk 的关系；再看第 3 节 MarginGate policy，确认 verifier 触发和当前 K/V column 覆盖的实现细节；最后看第 4 节的 latency、trigger rate、determinism 对比。对基座研究员最有用的是实验方法：它提供了一套检查 greedy decoding 是否真的可复现的 protocol，可用于评测流水线、蒸馏数据生成和服务端回归测试。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies batch-sensitive BF16 greedy decoding. A request can produce different tokens when decoded alone versus inside a dynamic batch, even at temperature zero, because different serving shapes induce different reduction orders and rounding behavior. Existing deterministic fixes either modify broad operator classes or verify every generated token, as in LLM-42. MarginGate asks a narrower question: can verification be restricted to the few steps that are actually at risk of a token flip?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for model evaluation, distillation, regression testing, LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, and RL/SFT data generation. These workflows often treat greedy decoding as a deterministic primitive. If outputs depend on batch composition, both evaluation reproducibility and generated training data can drift. The useful contribution is a selective determinism mechanism with an explicit cost-determinism frontier, rather than a blanket deterministic inference path.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is based on three empirical observations. First, batch-induced token flips are sparse: across the reported models and MATH500, GSM8K, and HumanEval, only about 0.3% to 1.3% of synchronous decode steps flip. Second, the protected request’s K/V trajectory does not show measurable pre-flip time-axis drift relative to a deterministic reference; the branch point is localized to the current decode position’s K/V column. Third, a small top-1/top-2 logit margin is a reference-free signal of argmax instability. MarginGate therefore keeps the normal BF16 batched path for each step, computes the current logit margin, and invokes a deterministic verifier only when the margin is below a calibrated threshold. If the verifier disagrees, the system emits the verifier token and overwrites only the current K/V column. Compared with LLM-42, the verifier is sparse rather than per-token. Compared with batch-invariant operators or LayerCast, the intervention is local and conditional rather than applied throughout the decode loop.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares the default BF16 path, Batch-Invariant Ops, LayerCast, LLM-42-style per-token verification, and MarginGate. On Llama-3.1-8B, MarginGate restores sequence-level deterministic decoding while triggering the verifier on 18.56% of synchronous decode steps. On Qwen2.5-14B, it reaches the same goal at a 15.05% trigger rate. DSR1-Distill-Qwen-7B is a harder case: its wider near-tie region pushes the trigger rate to 49.50%. Relative to LLM-42’s 100% token verification, MarginGate reduces the LLM-42 latency increment by 2.23x on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.99x on Qwen2.5-14B. The diagnostic experiments are important: K/V perturbations remain flat before flips, oracle single-column repair supports local correction, and threshold sweeps expose each model’s operating point.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on Section 2 for the flip-rate definition, the use of synchronous samples, K/V trajectory analysis, and the relationship between logit margin and flip risk. Then read Section 3 for the exact MarginGate policy and the current-column repair mechanism. Section 4 is worth checking for latency, trigger-rate, and determinism comparisons. The most reusable part is the measurement protocol for testing whether greedy decoding is genuinely reproducible in evaluation, distillation, and serving regression pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 只看 flip 稀疏性和 margin gating 的校准曲线；它不改预训练，但会改变对 BF16 serving 可复现成本的估计。
recommendation.en: Read the flip-sparsity and margin-calibration results; it does not affect pretraining, but it changes the cost model for reproducible BF16 serving.

paper.title: CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM inference turns the key--value (KV) cache into the dominant GPU memory consumer and makes per-token attention increasingly expensive. Many common eviction policies use static recency windows or historical attention, leaving unused a signal computed on every decoding step: the model's current uncertainty. We introduce CONF-KV, a KV-cache manager that converts the next-token distribution into a scalar confidence score and uses it to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中，KV Cache 占用大量显存并拖慢注意力计算。现有的缓存驱逐策略多依赖历史信息（如静态窗口或历史注意力），忽略了当前解码步模型输出分布所蕴含的不确定性信号。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于模型当前置信度动态调整 KV Cache 预算的驱逐策略 Conf-KV，证明了利用 next-token 分布的熵等信号可以有效指导缓存管理，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低显存开销。
summary.technical_approach: Conf-KV 在每一步解码时，根据 next-token 分布的熵、对数概率差和 top-token 概率计算一个标量置信度分数。当模型不确定时（置信度低），分配较大的缓存预算；当模型确定时（置信度高），分配较小的预算并激进驱逐。在预算内，结合注意力权重（EMA）和时间局部性（Recency）对 token 进行排序驱逐，并保留最近的 token 窗口以维持局部连贯性。此外，结合了分块在线 softmax 注意力和 FP16/INT8 混合精度存储。
summary.experiments: 在同等显存下，Conf-KV-L 在 GPT-2 上弥补了 512-token 滑动窗口与全量 KV 之间 74% 的困惑度差距。在长上下文检索（Needle-in-a-Haystack）和 Web Agent（VisualWebArena）任务中，Conf-KV 均能保持良好性能，并在吞吐量上优于基线。消融实验表明，置信度信号与截断近期上下文引起的 KL 散度变化呈负相关，验证了策略的核心假设。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 §3（Conf-KV 方法设计，特别是置信度分数的计算和动态预算分配机制）和 §4（实验结果，关注其在长上下文任务上的表现）。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context LLM inference, the KV cache consumes significant GPU memory and slows down attention computation. Existing cache eviction policies mostly rely on historical information (e.g., static windows or historical attention), ignoring the uncertainty signal embedded in the model's output distribution at the current decoding step.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Conf-KV, a confidence-aware KV cache eviction policy that dynamically adjusts the cache budget based on the model's current confidence. It demonstrates that signals like the entropy of the next-token distribution can effectively guide cache management, significantly reducing memory overhead while maintaining model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: At each decoding step, Conf-KV computes a scalar confidence score based on the entropy, log-probability margin, and top-token probability of the next-token distribution. When the model is uncertain (low confidence), a larger cache budget is allocated; when certain (high confidence), a smaller budget is used, and eviction is aggressive. Within the budget, tokens are ranked and evicted based on a combination of attention mass (EMA) and recency, while a recent token window is protected to maintain local coherence. It also integrates blockwise online softmax attention and mixed FP16/INT8 precision storage.
summary_en.experiments: At matched memory, Conf-KV-L closes 74% of the perplexity gap between a 512-token sliding window and full KV on GPT-2. In long-context retrieval (Needle-in-a-Haystack) and Web Agent (VisualWebArena) tasks, Conf-KV maintains strong performance and outperforms baselines in throughput. Ablation studies show that the confidence signal anti-correlates with the KL shift induced by ablating recent context, validating the core assumption of the policy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 (Conf-KV method design, especially the calculation of the confidence score and the dynamic budget allocation mechanism) and §4 (experimental results, paying attention to its performance on long-context tasks). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 置信度驱动KV驱逐是个好思路，但核心贡献在工程实现；重点看§3的预算分配公式和混合精度存储部分，对推理侧有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: Confidence-driven KV eviction is a clever idea, but the core contribution is engineering implementation; focus on §3 budget allocation and mixed-precision storage for direct inference-side reference.

paper.title: AdaState: Self-Evolving Anchors for Streaming Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate streaming video by producing frames sequentially, conditioning each chunk on previously generated content. These models are structurally anchored to the first frame: its key-value representation occupies a privileged position in the attention cache and serves as the primary scene reference throughout generation. As the cleanest and most error-free position in the cache, this anchor draws disproportionate attention, suppressing video dynamics, and lo

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散在流式生成中被第一帧锚定，导致长程视频动态、视角变化和场景演进不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成机制改进。论文指出固定第一帧作为 KV cache 中的特权 anchor 会带来静态一致性与动态演化之间的取舍，这个观察对长序列生成和 cache 条件设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaState，用一个随每个 chunk 共同去噪但不渲染的隐藏 latent 替代固定第一帧 anchor。该 latent 作为自演化场景状态，每步由模型根据历史内容更新，用于提供当前场景参考，而不是长期引用初始帧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或数值结果。实验目标应是比较固定首帧 anchor 与 adaptive state 在运动幅度、camera movement、场景进展和时间一致性上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the first-frame anchoring problem in autoregressive streaming video diffusion, where long-rollout dynamics, viewpoint changes, and scene progression are suppressed.
summary_en.importance: It is a video generation mechanism improvement. The key observation is that a privileged first-frame representation in the KV cache creates a trade-off between static consistency and temporal evolution, which is relevant to long-sequence generation and cache-based conditioning.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaState replaces the fixed first-frame anchor with a hidden latent state that is denoised alongside each generated chunk but never rendered. This latent acts as a self-evolving scene reference updated from history, rather than a frozen reference to the initial frame.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model scale, training data, baselines, or numerical results. The expected comparisons are between fixed first-frame anchoring and adaptive state conditioning on motion, camera movement, scene progression, and temporal consistency.

recommendation.zh: 只需看 anchor 失效分析；方法偏视频生成，但“干净早期 token 吸走注意力”像长上下文里的 sink 问题。
recommendation.en: Skim the anchor failure analysis; the method is video-specific, but the clean early-token attention sink resembles long-context pathologies.

paper.title: PrunePath: Towards Highly Structured Sparse Language Models
paper.abstract: Feed-forward networks (FFNs) dominate the parameter count and computation of modern language models, yet existing pruning methods often struggle to convert sparsity into hardware-friendly inference efficiency gains. We introduce \textbf{PrunePath}, a budget-adaptive structured sparsification framework for FFN layers. Built on MoEfication, PrunePath replaces independent expert-wise thresholding with a softmax-normalized routing distribution and activates important experts under a cumulative-mass

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期没有被很好解决的问题：FFN 占了现代 LLM 大部分参数和相当一部分推理开销，但常见剪枝方法要么是非结构化稀疏，难以转成真实硬件收益；要么结构过硬，精度掉得快。MoEfication 这条路把 dense FFN 重排成若干 expert，只激活部分 expert，方向是对的，但已有代表方法 LTE 用独立 sigmoid 给每个 expert 做二分类，缺少 token 级全局预算约束，容易在低预算场景下保守过激活，导致稀疏度不够可控，重建误差也偏大。PrunePath 的核心问题，就是如何把 dense FFN 变成一种既结构化、又可按 token 自适应、还能在单一 checkpoint 上连续调节稀疏度的稀疏 FFN。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是在改训练目标或 scaling law，而是给出了一条更像“后验结构化稀疏化”的路线：不改主干 Transformer，不重新训练一个原生 MoE，而是把已有 dense FFN 转成可控稀疏结构，并把稀疏度从离散 checkpoint 选择变成推理时旋钮。这对大模型部署和模型族构建有现实意义，尤其适合已有 dense 基座想做多档位推理成本控制的场景。更重要的一点是，它说明 FFN 稀疏化里，router 设计不是小修小补：从独立阈值决策改成带竞争的概率质量预算，会明显改变误差-稀疏权衡。这对以后做可训练 sparse FFN、dense-to-sparse 转换、甚至 MoE router 设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在 MoEfication 上。先把原始 FFN 的中间维度神经元按相似性做 balanced k-means 聚类，把神经元重排成 E 个连续块，每个块视为一个 expert。这样不会改变 FFN 的表达形式，只是把原本一个大 FFN 重新解释成多个小 expert 的并联。

关键改动在 routing。LTE 的做法是给每个 expert 一个 sigmoid 分数，超过阈值就激活，本质是独立 Bernoulli 决策。PrunePath 改成 softmax 归一化后的 expert 分布，再按分数从高到低排序，选择累计概率质量不超过阈值 τ 的最小 expert 集合。这样做有三个直接后果：
1. expert 之间形成竞争关系，不再是各自独立“过线”；
2. 稀疏预算变成 token 级概率质量预算，τ 直接控制激活总量；
3. 不同 token 可激活不同数量的 expert，形成自适应 sparsity。

从机制上看，这比固定 top-k 更柔和。top-k 强制每个 token 用同样数量 expert；独立阈值又缺少全局约束。累计质量阈值介于两者之间：既允许 easy token 用更少 expert，也避免 hard token 被过早截断。

论文还强调 single-checkpoint dynamic sparsity。训练时采用 progressive 方式，让同一个模型在一段 τ 范围内都能工作，推理时只改 τ 就能沿着精度-效率曲线移动，不需要为不同 sparsity 单独训练多个模型。这一点对实际部署比单点最优更重要。

工程上，作者实现了 Triton kernel，把这种结构化 FFN 稀疏真正落到 autoregressive decoding 上，重点优化的是 FFN 相关的激活和矩阵乘，目标不是理论 FLOPs 漂亮，而是 peak memory 和 decode latency 真下降。这个取向是对的，因为很多剪枝工作停在“稀疏率高”，没有把 kernel 和访存模式打通。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结论看，实验覆盖 NLU、NLG 和 instruction-tuning 场景，比较对象主要是 LTE 及其他 pruning/sparsification 基线。作者反复强调的结果有两类。

第一类是精度-稀疏权衡。PrunePath 在实用稀疏区间内优于 LTE，尤其在低激活 expert 数的 regime 更明显。原因是 LTE 的独立阈值路由在预算紧时更容易留下冗余 expert，导致“花了预算但没买到足够重建质量”；PrunePath 的累计质量选择能更集中地保留高贡献 expert。文中 Figure 2 就是在说明这一点：当只保留少量 top-ranked experts 时，PrunePath 的 reconstruction error 更低。

第二类是单 checkpoint 的动态可调性。作者展示了通过调 τ，同一 checkpoint 可以平滑扫出一条效率-准确率曲线，而不是像很多方法那样每个 sparsity 点都要重新训练或重新校准。这说明 progressive training 确实让 router 学到了跨预算稳健性，而不是只在某个固定阈值附近工作。

系统结果方面，作者实现了 Triton-accelerated sparse FFN inference，并报告了 autoregressive decoding 下的 peak-memory reduction 和 decode-only latency improvement。摘要里没有给出具体数字，全文片段也未完整展开表格，因此这里不硬填数值。但从写法看，作者把“硬件友好”作为主要卖点之一，不只是离线 perplexity 或任务分数。

需要注意的是，这篇工作的证据重点不是大规模预训练收益，而是 dense 模型经 MoEfication 后在下游评测和推理效率上的折中表现。如果关心 pretrain-time stability、从头训练 sparse FFN 是否更优，文中并没有真正回答。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。

第一，看方法部分里 LTE 与 PrunePath 的 routing 差异。重点不是公式本身，而是理解“独立 sigmoid 阈值”为什么会导致 conservative over-activation，以及“累计概率质量阈值”为什么能把预算控制从间接变成直接。把这一点看明白，整篇文章就通了。

第二，看 Figure 2 和与 reconstruction error 相关的分析。这部分最能说明作者为什么认为自己的路由更适合低预算稀疏化，也最接近方法成立的核心证据。

第三，看系统实现和 latency/memory 结果。如果只看任务分数，会把它误读成普通剪枝论文；它真正想证明的是 structured sparse FFN 可以在 decode 场景里转成真实收益。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想判断是否值得进一步跟进，读 Introduction、routing 方法、主结果图表和 Triton kernel 对应实验即可。若要深挖，可以继续看 progressive training 的具体做法，以及不同 τ 下 expert 激活分布是否稳定，这关系到单 checkpoint 动态稀疏是否真的可靠。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in modern LLMs: FFNs dominate parameter count and a large share of inference cost, yet most pruning methods fail to turn sparsity into real deployment gains. Unstructured pruning is hard to accelerate on hardware, while rigid structured sparsity often hurts quality. MoEfication is a more promising route because it rewrites a dense FFN as multiple experts and activates only a subset per token. The limitation of prior work, especially LTE, is the router: independent sigmoid thresholding makes expert activation a set of separate binary decisions, so sparsity is only indirectly controlled and low-budget settings tend to over-activate experts. PrunePath asks how to build a structured sparse FFN that is token-adaptive, hardware-friendly, and continuously controllable from a single checkpoint.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-objective paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it sharpens the dense-to-sparse conversion story for FFNs. Instead of training a native MoE from scratch, it shows that an existing dense model can be transformed into a structured sparse model with an inference-time sparsity knob. The more interesting lesson is methodological: router design is not a minor detail. Replacing independent thresholding with a competitive probability-budgeted routing rule materially changes the sparsity-quality trade-off. That insight is relevant beyond this paper, including sparse FFN design, post-hoc MoEfication, and possibly router objectives in train-time sparse models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from MoEfication. Intermediate FFN neurons are clustered with balanced k-means and permuted into E contiguous blocks, each treated as an expert. This preserves the original FFN computation while exposing a structured expert decomposition.

The main change is the routing mechanism. LTE uses sigmoid scores and activates every expert whose score exceeds a threshold, which is effectively a set of independent Bernoulli-style decisions. PrunePath instead computes a softmax-normalized distribution over experts, sorts experts by probability, and activates the smallest prefix whose cumulative mass reaches a threshold tau. This introduces three useful properties:
1. experts compete with each other under normalization;
2. sparsity becomes a token-level global probability budget rather than an indirect threshold effect;
3. the number of active experts can vary across tokens.

Mechanistically, this sits between fixed top-k and independent thresholding. Fixed top-k is too rigid because every token gets the same expert count. Independent thresholding lacks a global budget and can over-activate. Cumulative-mass routing keeps adaptivity while making the budget explicit.

A second contribution is single-checkpoint dynamic sparsity. The model is trained progressively so that one checkpoint supports a range of tau values at inference time, tracing a smooth efficiency-accuracy frontier without retraining separate sparse variants.

On the systems side, the authors implement Triton kernels for sparse FFN inference in autoregressive decoding. This is important because many pruning papers stop at sparsity statistics or FLOP estimates; here the goal is actual peak-memory and latency reduction under a realistic serving path.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers NLU, NLG, and instruction-tuning settings, with LTE and related sparsification baselines as the main references. Two findings stand out.

First, PrunePath improves the sparsity-performance trade-off in practical regimes, especially when only a small number of experts can be kept active. The paper argues that LTE wastes budget through conservative over-activation, while cumulative-mass routing concentrates computation on the most useful experts. Figure 2 is central here: under small retained-expert budgets, PrunePath yields lower reconstruction error than LTE.

Second, the single-checkpoint claim is backed by experiments sweeping tau at inference time. One trained checkpoint produces a relatively smooth efficiency-accuracy curve, rather than requiring separate training runs for each sparsity target. That suggests the progressive training recipe gives the router some robustness across budgets.

The systems section reports Triton-accelerated sparse FFN inference with reductions in peak memory and improvements in decode-only latency during autoregressive generation. The abstract and the provided text fragment do not expose all numeric details, so it is better not to invent exact values here. Still, the paper clearly treats hardware-realizable gains as a primary result, not a side note.

A limitation is that the evidence is mostly post-hoc sparsification and downstream evaluation. It does not answer whether training such sparse FFNs from scratch would be better, nor does it deeply study pretraining dynamics or optimization stability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, read the routing section carefully and compare LTE against PrunePath. The key is not the formula itself but the failure mode of independent sigmoid thresholding and why cumulative probability mass gives a more direct sparsity control.

Second, inspect the reconstruction-error analysis, especially Figure 2. That is the clearest evidence for the claimed advantage in low-budget regimes.

Third, read the Triton/kernel and latency-memory results. Without that section, the work can look like a generic pruning paper; with it, the deployment angle becomes much clearer.

A reasonable skim takes 20–30 minutes. If deciding whether to follow up, read the introduction, routing method, main result figures, and the sparse inference section. If going deeper, examine the progressive training setup and the stability of expert activation patterns across tau values, since that determines whether the single-checkpoint dynamic sparsity claim is robust.

recommendation.zh: 别只看“稀疏-精度曲线”，重点看它把路由做成 token 级预算旋钮、以及解码 kernel 是否真能吃到收益；若实现细节不扎实就只是换皮 MoE。
recommendation.en: Skim for the token-level probability budget knob and the decoding kernel details—if the Triton path doesn’t deliver real wins, it’s just MoEfication with nicer routing.

paper.title: UNIQUE: Universal Top-k Sparse Attention for Training-free Inference and Sparsity-aware Training
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linear growth of the self-attention key-value (KV) cache. Top-k sparse attention alleviates this by loading only a small fraction of the KV cache, but accurately and cheaply estimating cache importance, for both training-free use and sparsity-aware training, remains challenging. This paper proposes UNIQUE, a universal top-k sparse attention framework that addresses both requirements and stays consistently effective acr

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理的KV缓存随序列长度线性增长成为解码瓶颈，现有top-k稀疏注意力存在免训练精度不足、可训练方案成本高且仅适配文本模态的问题。
summary.importance: 为长上下文推理优化与稀疏感知训练的统一设计提供参考，提出的免训练页级重要性打分方案可低成本落地到现有LLM与语音LM的推理流程，无需重训即可获得加速，同时支持后续稀疏感知微调进一步缩小训练推理差距。
summary.technical_approach: 提出UNIQUE通用top-k稀疏注意力框架，核心设计有三点：一是采用页级粒度划分KV缓存，对齐硬件访存特性；二是偏移增强的页重要性打分，以每页key的均值为表征向量，叠加key的标准差作为偏移项，补偿均值池化对高信息token的重要性低估，该打分无需训练即可计算；三是可微分sigmoid软掩码，基于top-k决策边界生成可微门控，无需额外参数或辅助损失即可支持稀疏感知训练，让模型主动优化top-k选择以降低训练推理差异。此外还提供了优化的CUDA核，top-k选择速度比PyTorch和FlashInfer快至少2倍。
summary.experiments: 公开的论文片段未提供完整的加速比与性能下降量化数据，已验证场景覆盖长文本理解和长语音识别两类任务，结论显示UNIQUE在免训练场景下性能优于现有免训练稀疏注意力方案，经稀疏感知微调后可进一步缩小与稠密注意力的性能差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点看第1章对跨模态长上下文KV瓶颈的分析、第3章的页重要性打分与可微分软掩码设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。可待论文完整发布后查看实验部分的量化加速数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The linear growth of KV cache with sequence length has become the core decoding bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing top-k sparse attention methods have limitations: training-free approaches have insufficient accuracy, trainable solutions have high costs and are only validated on text modalities.
summary_en.importance: Provides reference for the unified design of long-context inference optimization and sparsity-aware training. The proposed training-free page-level importance scoring can be deployed to existing LLM and speech LM inference pipelines at low cost, delivering acceleration without retraining, while supporting subsequent sparsity-aware fine-tuning to further close the train-inference gap.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes UNIQUE, a universal top-k sparse attention framework with three core designs. First, page-granularity KV cache partitioning aligned with hardware memory access characteristics. Second, offset-augmented page importance scoring: uses the mean of keys in each page as the representative vector, adds the standard deviation of keys as an offset term to compensate for underestimated importance of high-information tokens diluted by mean pooling. This score can be computed without training. Third, differentiable sigmoid soft mask: generates a differentiable gate based on the top-k decision boundary, enabling sparsity-aware training without extra parameters or auxiliary losses, allowing the model to actively optimize top-k selection to reduce train-inference mismatch. It also includes optimized CUDA kernels, with top-k selection speed at least 2x faster than PyTorch and FlashInfer implementations.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available paper excerpt does not include full quantitative data of speedup and performance degradation. Validated on two scenarios: long-text understanding and long-form speech recognition. Results show UNIQUE outperforms existing training-free sparse attention methods in zero-training deployment, and further closes the performance gap with dense attention after sparsity-aware fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on Section 1 for the analysis of cross-modal long-context KV bottleneck, and Section 3 for the design of page importance scoring and differentiable soft mask. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. Check the full experiment section for quantitative speedup data once the paper is completely released.

recommendation.zh: 只看 page scoring 和 soft-mask training；若 kernel 路径真实可落地，值得复现到长上下文 serving ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the page scoring and soft-mask training parts; if the kernel path is practical, reproduce it in long-context serving ablations.

paper.title: CIVIC: End-to-End Sequence Compactness for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory and latency bottlenecks due to high-resolution visual tokens. While current token reduction methods theoretically save FLOPs, post-hoc pruning introduces structural overhead, failing to yield proportional wall-clock acceleration. However, enforcing a contiguous compact pathway risks geometric disorientation and loss of fine-grained localization. To overcome these barriers, this paper introduces CIVIC, a path-consistent compact visual inference fra

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM视觉token压缩方法仅能降低理论FLOPs，事后剪枝/合并会引入非连续内存访问、稠密表示恢复、接口适配等额外运行时开销，无法转化为对等的实际端到端延迟下降；同时强制连续紧凑序列会破坏2D空间结构、丢失细粒度定位信息，还与传统蒸馏流程不兼容。
summary.importance: 对VLM推理优化和紧凑多模态建模有工程参考价值，明确了「理论FLOP下降≠实际延迟优化」的落地gap，提出的端到端路径一致的紧凑设计思路可迁移至其他多模态模型的效率优化场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CIVIC端到端紧凑推理框架，全程保持紧凑序列的路径一致性，覆盖视觉编码器、投影层、LLM预填充、KV-cache全链路：1）用可学习锚点聚合将稠密patch转换为连续token，保留空间映射关系；2）带自适应空间保留下限的KV压缩注意力，避免细粒度定位信息丢失；3）文本对齐的KL蒸馏，让紧凑嵌入直接替换LLM预填充中的稠密占位序列，无需额外运行时路由或稠密恢复。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-VL架构上验证，端到端紧凑处理大幅降低延迟和KV-cache占用，同时保留细粒度多模态精度，消除了事后压缩带来的运行时额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有压缩方法落地gap的分析、方法论中三部分核心设计，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual token compression methods for VLMs only reduce theoretical FLOPs. Post-hoc pruning or merging introduces non-negligible runtime overhead such as discontinuous memory access, dense representation restoration, and interface adaptation, which fails to translate into proportional end-to-end latency reduction. Meanwhile, enforcing contiguous compact sequences breaks 2D spatial structure, loses fine-grained localization signals, and conflicts with traditional distillation pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Offers practical engineering reference for VLM inference optimization and compact multimodal modeling. It explicitly identifies the deployment gap between theoretical FLOP reduction and real latency improvement, and the end-to-end path-consistent compact design can be generalized to efficiency optimization of other multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CIVIC, an end-to-end compact inference framework that maintains path consistency of compact sequences across the entire pipeline including vision encoder, projection layer, LLM prefill, and KV-cache: 1) Learned anchor-based aggregation converts dense patches into consecutive tokens while preserving spatial mapping; 2) KV-compressed attention with an adaptive spatial retention floor avoids loss of fine-grained localization information; 3) Text-aligned KL distillation enables compact embeddings to directly replace dense placeholder spans in LLM prefill without extra runtime routing or dense restoration.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen3-VL architecture. End-to-end compact processing significantly reduces latency and KV-cache footprint, while preserving fine-grained multimodal accuracy and eliminating additional runtime overhead from post-hoc compression.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on the analysis of deployment gap of existing compression methods in the introduction, and the three core designs in the methodology section. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读系统路径图和 latency 表；价值在端到端连续压缩，不在又一个视觉 token 打分器。
recommendation.en: Read the system path and latency table; the value is end-to-end contiguous compression, not another visual-token scorer.

paper.title: Hurwitz Quaternion Multiplicative Quantization for KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: We propose \textbf{Hurwitz Quaternion Multiplicative Quantization (HQMQ)}, a \textbf{calibration-free} method for KV cache compression of large language models. HQMQ treats each 4-element chunk of K or V as a quaternion and quantizes its unit direction to the \emph{product} $q_p \cdot q_s$, where $q_p$ ranges over the 24-element Hurwitz group $2T$ (the 24 vertices of the 24-cell on $S^3$, pairwise angle $60^\circ$) and $q_s$ ranges over a per-(layer, head) secondary codebook of $S$ \emph{random}

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV Cache 显存占用过高，现有标量量化在 4-bit 以下掉点严重，而向量量化方法通常需要复杂的校准或训练过程。
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需校准的 KV Cache 压缩方法，利用四元数代数结构实现了极低比特（<4-bit）下的高质量压缩，为长上下文推理提供了新的高效量化思路。
summary.technical_approach: 将 K 和 V 的每 4 个元素视为一个四元数，分别量化其模长和单位方向。方向量化采用 Hurwitz 四元数乘法量化（HQMQ）：将方向分解为固定主码本（24 个 Hurwitz 单位四元数）和随机副码本（S 个单位四元数）的乘积。由于四元数左乘是等距变换，随机初始化的副码本即可生成准均匀的球面覆盖，无需校准。此外，引入了基于中位数的异常值提取机制（Med3x），以适应现代 LLM 中常见的异常值问题。
summary.experiments: 在 Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 等多个模型上验证。在 3.79-bit 下，HQMQ 匹配了需要校准的 KIVI-4（约 4.5-bit）的性能；在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，结合 Med3x，4.42-bit 的 HQMQ 将 PPL 从朴素 int4 的 18079 降至 9.69，实现了显著的质量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 3 了解 HQMQ 的核心数学原理（特别是乘法码本的构造），以及 Section 4.8 中与现有 SOTA 方法的对比实验。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The memory cost of KV Cache in long-context LLM inference is prohibitively high. Existing scalar quantization degrades severely below 4 bits, while vector quantization methods typically require complex calibration or training.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a calibration-free KV Cache compression method leveraging quaternion algebraic structures, achieving high-quality compression at extremely low bitrates (<4-bit) and offering a novel, efficient quantization paradigm for long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats every 4 elements of K and V as a quaternion, quantizing its magnitude and unit direction separately. Direction quantization uses Hurwitz Quaternion Multiplicative Quantization (HQMQ): decomposing the direction into the product of a fixed primary codebook (24 Hurwitz unit quaternions) and a random secondary codebook (S unit quaternions). Since quaternion left-multiplication is an isometry, a randomly initialized secondary codebook generates a quasi-uniform spherical covering without calibration. Additionally, introduces a median-multiplier outlier extraction mechanism (Med3x) to handle outliers common in modern LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on models like Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B. At 3.79 bits, HQMQ matches the performance of the calibrated KIVI-4 (~4.5 bits); on Qwen2.5-7B, combined with Med3x, 4.42-bit HQMQ reduces PPL from 18,079 (naive int4) to 9.69, achieving significant quality improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the core mathematical principles of HQMQ (especially the construction of the multiplicative codebook) and Section 4.8 for comparative experiments with existing SOTA methods. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看量化几何和 outlier 处理即可；随机码本若真稳，会削弱校准型 KV 量化的必要性。
recommendation.en: Read the quantization geometry and outlier handling; if the random-codebook result holds, it weakens the case for calibrated KV quantizers.

paper.title: Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks; however, their attention mechanism scales poorly with context length. To handle this, we study a sleep-like consolidation mechanism in which a model periodically converts recent context into persistent fast weights before clearing its key-value cache. During sleep, the model performs $N$ offline recurrent passes over the accumulated context and updates the fast weights in its state-space model (SSM) blocks thro

summary.core_problem: SSM-attention 混合模型在上下文被驱逐出 KV cache 后，无法对已驱逐上下文进行深度推理。单纯的 fast weight 记忆容量不是瓶颈，将瞬时上下文转化为有用内部状态所需的计算量才是瓶颈——推理深度增加时，vanilla SSM 即使 fast weight 容量足够也会性能下降。
summary.importance: 提出了一种类睡眠（sleep-like）的离线循环巩固机制，将额外计算从推理时刻转移到离线巩固阶段，为长程推理场景下的记忆-计算权衡提供了新思路。对持续学习和长上下文 LLM 推理有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 当模型上下文窗口填满时，进入"睡眠"阶段：对累积上下文进行多次前向传播（离线循环），通过学到的局部规则递归更新 SSM 模块中的 fast weights。睡眠期间不接收外部输入。巩固后清空上下文窗口，模型以更新后的 fast weights 恢复工作。训练时通过完整过程端到端反向传播优化。核心区别于先前循环/loop 模型：循环计算不在预测时执行，而是在离线巩固阶段完成，预测时仍为单次前向。
summary.experiments: 实验包含三部分：(1) 元胞自动机等受控合成任务，展示 vanilla GDN（SSM）随推理深度增加性能显著下降，而 sleep 架构通过增加循环深度（N=8）可恢复性能；(2) 多跳图检索任务，sleep 架构在深推理跳数下相比 GDN 有最大幅度提升；(3) GSM-Infinite 数学推理任务，使用预训练 LLM 初始化验证了方法有效性。具体数字未在正文完整体现，主要以定性趋势展示。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 部分对 SSM-attention 混合模型推理瓶颈的诊断（第3-4段），这是最有价值的观察。Method 部分看 sleep 机制与普通 SSM fast weight 更新的区别。实验部分关注合成任务的推理深度控制实验。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在提供的全文片段中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: SSM-attention hybrid models cannot perform deep reasoning over context that has been evicted from the KV cache. The bottleneck is not fast weight memory capacity but the amount of computation needed to transform transient context into a useful internal state — vanilla SSMs degrade with increasing reasoning depth even when fast weight capacity is sufficient.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a sleep-like offline recurrent consolidation mechanism that shifts extra computation from inference time to an offline consolidation phase, offering a new perspective on memory-compute tradeoffs for long-horizon reasoning. Some relevance to continual learning and long-context LLM inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: When the context window fills up, the model enters a 'sleep' phase: performing multiple offline recurrent forward passes over accumulated context to recursively update fast weights in SSM blocks via a learned local rule. No external tokens are received during sleep. After consolidation, the context window is cleared and the model resumes with updated fast weights. Training is end-to-end backprop through the entire process. Key distinction from prior looped models: recurrent computation is spent offline during consolidation rather than at prediction time, enabling single-pass prediction after sleep.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover three settings: (1) Controlled synthetic tasks (cellular automata) showing vanilla GDNs degrade with increasing reasoning depth, while the sleep architecture recovers performance via deeper recurrence (N=8); (2) Multi-hop graph retrieval, where the sleep architecture shows largest gains on the deepest reasoning instances; (3) GSM-Infinite math reasoning with pretrained LLM initializations. Specific numerical results are not fully elaborated in the provided text fragments, shown primarily as qualitative trends.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the diagnosis of the reasoning bottleneck in SSM-attention hybrids in the Introduction (paragraphs 3-4) — this is the most valuable observation. In the Method section, understand how sleep differs from standard SSM fast weight updates. In experiments, focus on the reasoning depth control experiments in synthetic tasks. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not explicitly provided in the available text fragments.

recommendation.zh: 只看 sleep-duration scaling 和 fast-weight 更新；结果早期，但离线测试时计算写入状态这件事值得小模型复现。
recommendation.en: Read the sleep-duration scaling and fast-weight update; the results are early, but writing offline test-time compute into state deserves a small-model replication.

paper.title: Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contributi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion 里的 KV-cache 低比特量化失真问题。核心观察是，INT2 量化后的质量下降不只是普通量化噪声，而是 softmax 注意力中出现了系统性偏置：被量化的历史 key 会获得过多注意力，挤压当前未量化 chunk 的注意力质量。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不高，但对长上下文生成模型和多模态 diffusion transformer 的推理系统有参考价值。它把 KV-cache 量化误差从“数值近似问题”细化到“softmax 分布偏移问题”，这对 LLM/VLM 的 KV 量化也有启发：key 的误差不只影响 score 的均方误差，还会通过指数函数改变 partition function，从而系统性改变注意力分配。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的关键是 Jensen bias correction。量化 key 时，key 误差近似为零均值，因此 pre-softmax score 在期望上可以保持无偏。但 softmax 使用 exp，指数函数是凸函数，零均值 score noise 经过 exp 后会带来正向膨胀：E[exp(s+η)] 大于 exp(s)。历史 cached token 的 key 被量化，而当前 chunk 的 key 没有被量化，于是 cached token 的 softmax 分母贡献被系统性放大。论文根据量化 step size 在线估计每个 attention score 的噪声方差，并在 cached-key score 上减去一个校正项。二阶 Taylor 近似下，校正项接近 score noise 方差的一半；方差由 query 各通道幅度和 key 量化步长共同决定。方法不需要重新训练，不修改 value cache，也可以和 Hadamard rotation、per-token 或 group-wise quantization 结合。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是提出新的视频生成模型，而是定位和修正 INT2/INT4 KV-cache 量化的注意力偏置。论文报告 INT4 KV-cache 量化通常还能维持可接受质量，INT2 会出现明显帧失真。注意力诊断显示，量化后 attention mass 会稳定偏向 cached tokens，这一现象跨 layer、head、denoising step 和 prompt 都存在，并且和视频质量下降相关。加入 Jensen bias correction 后，注意力分配更接近未量化模型，并在多个视频 diffusion 模型和量化配置上改善最终视频质量。提供的内容没有完整实验表，无法可靠给出具体 benchmark 数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的失真现象定义，Preliminaries 中的量化设定和 Hadamard rotation，Section 4 附近关于 Jensen bias 的推导，以及 Fig. 1–3 的 attention mass 诊断。若关心 LLM KV-cache 量化，可重点检查校正项是否依赖视频 diffusion 的 chunk 结构；如果公式只依赖 query 和 key quantization step size，它有机会迁移到文本和多模态长上下文 serving。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why low-bit KV-cache quantization hurts chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion. The main issue is not just random quantization error. Quantized cached keys systematically attract too much attention mass, stealing probability from the current, unquantized chunk.
summary_en.importance: The work is only indirectly related to LLM pretraining, but it is useful for long-context generative serving and multimodal transformer systems. Its main value is a sharper diagnosis of KV-cache quantization: key noise changes the softmax partition function through the exponential, so preserving unbiased pre-softmax scores is not enough. This is a relevant lesson for KV compression in LLMs and VLMs as well.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed fix targets what the authors call Jensen bias. Quantizing cached keys introduces approximately zero-mean perturbations to attention scores. Because softmax applies an exponential, positive score perturbations are amplified more than negative perturbations are suppressed, so E[exp(s+η)] exceeds exp(s). Since only past cached keys are quantized while current-chunk keys remain full precision, the bias selectively inflates the cached-token contribution. The method estimates a per-score correction from the quantization step sizes available at inference time and subtracts it from cached-key attention logits before softmax. A second-order Taylor approximation gives a practical correction close to half of the score-noise variance. The procedure is training-free, leaves cached values unchanged, and is compatible with Hadamard rotation and token/group-wise quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is built around attention diagnostics and end-to-end video quality. INT4 KV-cache quantization remains usable in the reported setting, while INT2 causes severe visual artifacts. The authors show a consistent shift of attention mass toward cached tokens across layers, heads, denoising steps, and prompts, and this shift correlates with poor video quality. Applying the correction brings the attention distribution closer to the unquantized model and improves video-generation benchmarks across multiple models and quantization schemes. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, so exact metric values should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode, the quantization preliminaries for the cache setup, the Jensen-bias derivation for the core idea, and Figures 1–3 for the diagnostic evidence. For LLM KV-cache work, the main question to check is whether the correction depends on video-specific chunking or only on query magnitudes and key quantization scales; the latter would make the idea easier to port to text and multimodal long-context inference.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Jensen bias 推导和量化消融；若 LLM KV 量化还默认零均值噪声无偏，这篇会改 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the Jensen-bias derivation and quantization ablations; it challenges the lazy prior that zero-mean KV noise is harmless under softmax.

paper.title: Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling
paper.abstract: Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.   We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多轮、多 Agent 工具调用中的重复 prefill 问题。Agent 会不断在已有上下文后追加少量新 token，但常见推理框架仍把每次 API 调用当成独立请求，反复处理几乎相同的长前缀。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏 serving 和 agent inference system。但它对理解新型 LLM 工作负载有参考价值：Agent 场景的主要瓶颈不一定在 decode，而是在大量短增量请求反复 prefill。若基座模型未来在训练或评测中大量纳入工具调用轨迹，这类 stateful execution 也会影响数据生成、在线评测和 RL rollout 的系统成本。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是把 stateless request 改成 stateful session。系统为每个长期会话保留 KV cache，只处理本轮新增 token，将每轮 prefill 从 O(n_t) 降到 O(Δ_t)。具体机制包括：用 sequence pool 预分配并复用命名 sequence ID，避免每次请求重建上下文；用 radix prefix cache 在统一 KV cache 上做元数据级 aliasing，使长前缀恢复接近常数时间；调度侧用 cell-budget admission 控制 KV 资源，并把共享完全相同前缀的请求做 grouped prefill；对完全相同 prompt，使用由 prompt hash 决定随机种子的 response cache；decode 侧加入 prompt-lookup speculation、流式 JSON 工具调用校验、设备端 greedy sampling，以及异常安全的 RAII session 生命周期管理。与 vLLM/SGLang 这类以请求为中心的 prefix caching 不同，它把会话状态作为一级抽象，而不是把 cache 当成可有可无的加速项。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的关键 workload 观察是：典型 5 轮 Agent 对话中，相邻轮次 85–95% prompt token 相同。示例里系统提示约 200 token，每轮约 150 token，到最后一轮 prompt 约 950 token，但新增 token 只有约 150。论文主张这类结构使传统 per-request prefill 产生接近多倍的重复 FLOPs。给出的复杂度收益是从每轮 O(n_t) 转为 O(Δ_t)，共享前缀的 N 个 slot 可由 leader-follower prefill 合并为一次 forward。提供内容中未看到可独立核验的端到端吞吐、TTFT、显存占用或多并发压测数字，因此实验部分更像系统设计论证，而不是完整 benchmark 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 Agent traffic 的 workload 刻画，以及九个机制的边界分工。Problem Formulation 值得看，因为它把多 Agent 交错请求下的 prefix-extension 关系写清楚了。若只关心 LLM 基座训练，可跳过实现细节；若关心 RL rollout、工具调用数据生成或长上下文 serving，可以重点看 radix prefix cache、cell-budget admission 和 streaming tool-call validator。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets redundant prefill in multi-turn, multi-agent tool calling. Agent prompts grow by appending small deltas, yet common inference stacks often handle each API call as an independent request and reprocess a large repeated prefix.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in serving infrastructure rather than pretraining. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful: agentic workloads can be dominated by repeated prefill rather than token generation. If tool-use traces become a larger part of data generation, evaluation, or RL rollouts, stateful inference will materially affect system cost and experiment throughput.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central move is to replace stateless requests with stateful sessions. A persistent KV cache is kept across turns, so each request only ingests newly appended tokens, changing the per-turn prefill cost from O(n_t) to O(Δ_t). The design combines several mechanisms: a sequence pool with reusable named sequence IDs; a radix prefix cache that restores cached prefixes through metadata aliasing over a unified KV cache; cell-budget admission and prefix-aware grouped prefill; a prompt-deterministic response cache using prompt-hash seeding; prompt-lookup speculative decoding with concurrency caps; a streaming JSON validator for tool calls; on-device greedy sampling; and RAII-style lifecycle management for session slots. Compared with prefix caching in request-driven systems such as vLLM or SGLang, the key distinction is that session state is treated as a first-class abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The main quantitative workload claim is that consecutive turns in typical 5-turn agent conversations share 85–95% of prompt tokens. In the paper’s example, a 200-token system prompt plus roughly 150 tokens per turn yields a final prompt of about 950 tokens, of which only about 150 are new. The claimed algorithmic gain is delta-only prefill, and shared-prefix grouped prefill can collapse N redundant forward passes into one. The provided text does not include independently checkable end-to-end numbers for throughput, TTFT, memory pressure, or high-concurrency stress tests, so the evidence should be read primarily as a system design argument.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on the workload characterization in the introduction and the division of responsibilities across the nine mechanisms. The problem formulation is useful because it makes the prefix-extension structure explicit under interleaved multi-agent calls. For foundation-model training interests, most implementation details can be skipped; for RL rollout systems, tool-use data generation, or long-context serving, the radix cache, cell-budget admission, and streaming tool-call validator are the parts worth reading more carefully.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 workloads；若真实 agent 流量确有 85–95% prompt 复用，这类 stateful KV 会比继续卷 attention kernel 更先省钱。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and workloads; if real agent traffic indeed has 85–95% prompt reuse, stateful KV reuse will save money before another attention-kernel tweak does.

paper.title: NestedKV: Nested Memory Routing for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: Long-context language models are limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing training-free KV compression methods usually rank tokens by one importance signal -- attention, recency, layer-wise allocation, or key distinctiveness -- which becomes brittle when useful context is globally distinctive, locally episodic, or immediately relevant. We introduce NestedKV, a key-only KV cache compression method inspired by the Continuum Memory System in Nested Learning. NestedKV ma

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文推理中的 KV cache 内存问题：在不训练、不改模型和不改 attention kernel 的前提下，如何决定哪些历史 token 的 KV 应该保留。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，主要属于推理效率。但它对长上下文基座模型研究有参考价值。核心观察是，attention mass、recency、sink token 或单一 key distinctiveness 都只刻画一种“重要性”，在强压缩和超长上下文下容易错删答案相关 token。NestedKV 把 cache eviction 改写为 key 空间中的多时间尺度异常检测，这个角度有助于理解长上下文模型的内部记忆几何，也能为后续长上下文训练目标或注意力结构设计提供信号。
summary.technical_approach: NestedKV 在 prefill 之后、autoregressive decoding 之前压缩每层 KV cache。模型参数、value 向量内容和 attention 实现不变，只选择保留哪些位置。方法只使用 key stream，维护三类 anchor：stable/global anchor 捕捉文档级背景，episodic/block-level anchor 捕捉局部片段变化，current/sliding-window anchor 捕捉近端上下文。每个 token 会根据它相对不同 anchor 的 cosine anomaly 得到多套排名。外层的 training-free learner 再做两件事：一是按 head 调整不同时间尺度排名的权重，让不同 head 偏向不同记忆角色；二是用跨尺度排名分歧作为 surprise signal，在 blended score 和最强单尺度 score 之间平滑路由。最后再配合 adaptive per-head budget，区分“某个 head 内哪些 token 重要”和“哪个 head 应该获得更多 cache 预算”。
summary.experiments: 实验使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B 作为主模型，覆盖 RULER、LongBench、LooGLE、LongBench-E、InfiniteBench 和 MMLU-Pro。作者报告的主要趋势是，压缩越激进、上下文越长，多时间尺度 key anomaly 的优势越明显。在 RULER 多个 context length 与 compression ratio 组合上，NestedKV 达到最好或接近最好的结果。LongBench 在作者定义的 r=0.75 设置下，平均分从 30.77 提升到 50.06。MMLU-Pro 上，在 r=0.25 时与 Full KV 上限只差 0.2 分，说明短上下文知识能力基本没有被 cache 策略破坏。需要注意的是，结果主要支撑 training-free serving 场景，不能直接推出训练阶段的长程依赖学习能力提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 attention-based 压缩失配的图示和论证，再看 Method 中三类 anchor、cosine anomaly、head-adaptive mixing、surprise-gated routing 的定义。实验部分重点看 RULER 的长上下文高压缩区域、LongBench 平均分变化，以及 MMLU-Pro 是否保留短上下文能力。若只关心预训练，可以略读工程实现细节，重点保留 key 空间多尺度记忆这一建模视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the memory cost of long-context inference: how to compress the KV cache after prefill while keeping the model, the attention implementation, and the parameters unchanged.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant for long-context foundation model research. Its main point is that a single token-importance signal is brittle. Attention mass, recency, sink preservation, or a single key-distinctiveness score each captures only one notion of memory. Under aggressive compression, answer-bearing tokens may be globally distinctive, locally episodic, or immediately relevant, and these cases are not well served by one anchor. The key-space, multi-timescale view is useful for thinking about memory geometry in long-context models and may inform future training objectives or attention designs.
summary_en.technical_approach: NestedKV compresses the cache after prefill and before autoregressive decoding, independently at each Transformer layer. It only decides which cached positions remain; values, model weights, and attention kernels are unchanged. The method builds three key-space anchors: a stable/global anchor for document-level background, an episodic/block-level anchor for local topic shifts, and a current/sliding-window anchor for immediate context. Each token receives cosine-anomaly rankings against these timescales. A training-free outer combiner then adapts the mixture per attention head, upweighting the most discriminative timescale for that head. It also computes cross-scale rank disagreement as a surprise signal and routes each token between the blended score and the strongest individual timescale score. The final selection is paired with adaptive per-head cache budgets, separating token scoring within a head from memory allocation across heads.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use frozen Qwen3-4B and evaluate on RULER, LongBench, LooGLE, LongBench-E, InfiniteBench, and MMLU-Pro. The reported pattern is strongest under long contexts and aggressive compression. NestedKV is best or close to best across many RULER context-ratio cells. On LongBench, under the paper’s r=0.75 setting, the average score rises from 30.77 to 50.06. On MMLU-Pro, at r=0.25, it stays within 0.2 points of the Full KV result, suggesting that the compression rule does not materially damage short-context knowledge behavior. The evidence mainly supports training-free serving use cases; it should not be read as evidence that the model has learned better long-range dependencies during training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Start with the introduction’s argument that attention-based eviction can miss answer-bearing tokens. Then read the method definitions for the three anchors, cosine anomaly scoring, head-adaptive mixing, surprise-gated routing, and adaptive head budgets. In the experiments, focus on the high-compression long-context RULER cells, the LongBench average, and the MMLU-Pro retention result. Readers focused on pretraining can skip most implementation detail and keep the multi-timescale key-memory perspective.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 head-adaptive budget 细节即可；多尺度 key 信号比单一 attention 分数更像可部署启发。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and head-adaptive budgets; multi-scale key signals look more deployable than another single attention-score heuristic.

paper.title: IndexMem: Learned KV-Cache Eviction with Latent Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to operate over long contexts, yet standard softmax attention incurs a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, quickly becoming the bottleneck for long context inference. A practical remedy is to evict less important KV entries; however, existing eviction policies are largely heuristic and struggle to capture the rich, input-dependent distribution of token importance. In this work, we introduce a learnable indexer that predicts KV

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理时 KV-cache 线性膨胀带来显存与带宽瓶颈。现有 KV eviction 多为启发式打分，难以做输入相关的“未来重要性”预测；同时被驱逐 token 信息永久丢失，导致长程检索/回忆不可逆退化。论文要解决的是：在固定 KV 预算下，如何更准确地保留未来会用到的 token，并为被驱逐 token 提供可恢复的信息通路。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身影响有限，但对“长上下文能力如何在推理侧落地”很直接：它把 KV eviction 从规则工程推进到可学习策略，并补上了 eviction 的信息不可逆问题。对做长上下文训练/评测的人也有间接价值：它提示了一个常被忽略的变量——推理时的 cache 管理策略会显著改变长程任务表现，可能影响 long-context benchmark 的可比性与训练-推理一致性讨论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两块组成：
1) Learned indexer（可学习打分器）：把“每个历史 token 的 KV 是否该保留”建模成一个预测问题，输出每个位置的重要性分数，再做 top-L' 选择与 cache compaction。相对 SnapKV（局部窗口注意力统计）、KeyDiff（key 差异度代理）、Expected Attention（用语料平均 query 估计）这类 proxy，indexer 试图直接拟合输入相关的未来使用分布。
2) Latent memory（驱逐信息的压缩记忆）：为避免 eviction 的永久遗忘，把被驱逐的 KV 信息在线压缩进一个固定大小的潜在记忆状态（latent slots）。后续解码时，注意力不仅能访问保留的 KV，也能访问这份压缩记忆，从而在“严格限制 KV 长度”的同时保留一定的长程可检索性。
整体上，它把 KV 管理写成“显式选择（保留少量原始 token）+ 连续压缩（把其余信息汇总进小内存）”的两通道结构，取舍是：保留通道保证精确信息，压缩通道提供长程召回的兜底。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的结果口径：
- RULER：在 Qwen/Mistral/Llama 系列上，长上下文指标最高可提升约 +25 分（相对若干 eviction baseline）。
- NIAH retrieval：更稳健的长程检索（文中强调“more robust”，但片段未给出具体数值表）。
- LongBench：整体分数更好（片段未给出具体提升幅度）。
当前提供的内容未包含：训练 indexer/latent memory 的监督信号构造、训练数据规模、不同 KV 预算下的曲线、以及与量化/低秩压缩的叠加实验细节；这些通常决定方法是否“工程可用”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 25–40 分钟，重点抓机制与实验结论）：
- 先看 unified scoring-and-selection 框架那一节：它把各类 eviction 方法统一成“打分→top-k→gather”，便于定位 indexer 的插入点。
- 重点看 indexer 的训练目标与特征输入：它到底在预测什么（未来 attention、未来 loss 贡献、还是某种 proxy），以及是否按 head/layer 分开建模。
- 重点看 latent memory 的更新规则与读写方式：是类似在线聚合/EMA、attention 写入、还是小型 RNN/MLP 更新；以及它如何与原 attention 融合。
- 实验部分优先看：不同 KV budget 下的性能-显存曲线、长程检索任务（NIAH/RULER）的失败案例分析、以及消融（无 indexer / 无 memory / 只 memory / 只 indexer）。这些决定它是不是“只在某个 benchmark 上有效”。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context decoding hits a memory/bandwidth wall because the KV cache grows linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction policies are mostly heuristic and fail to predict input-dependent, future token importance; worse, evicted tokens are gone forever, causing irreversible long-range forgetting. The paper targets a practical question: under a fixed KV budget, how to retain truly future-critical tokens while still preserving recoverable information from evicted ones.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-time contribution rather than a pretraining recipe change. Still, it matters for foundation-model researchers working on long-context: (1) it turns KV eviction into a learnable, context-adaptive policy; (2) it highlights that long-context benchmark outcomes can be strongly confounded by cache management, which affects training–inference consistency discussions and the interpretation of long-context evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
IndexMem combines two components:
- A learnable indexer that predicts per-token KV importance scores, then performs top-L' selection and cache compaction. This replaces hand-crafted proxies used by methods like SnapKV (local attention-window bias), KeyDiff (key diversity proxy), or Expected Attention (corpus-level average query assumption).
- A lightweight latent memory module that compresses evicted tokens into a fixed-size latent state updated online during decoding. Future steps can attend to both the retained raw KV entries and the latent memory, mitigating the irreversibility of eviction.
Conceptually, it is a two-path memory system: sparse exact retention for precision + continuous compression for long-range recall, trading a small extra compute/module for bounded KV footprint.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the reported highlights are:
- RULER: consistent gains across Qwen/Mistral/Llama families, with improvements up to about +25 points.
- NIAH retrieval: more robust long-range retrieval (exact numbers not visible in the excerpt).
- LongBench: improved overall scores (exact deltas not visible in the excerpt).
Key missing details in the excerpt that are important for assessing practicality include: how the indexer is trained (labels/objective), budget–quality curves, latency overhead, and composability with KV quantization/low-rank compression.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Start with the unified “scoring-and-selection” formulation to see precisely where the learnable indexer plugs in.
- Focus on the indexer training signal and inputs: what target it predicts (future attention, loss contribution, etc.), and whether it is head-/layer-specific.
- Inspect the latent memory read/write mechanism and how it is integrated into attention at decode time.
- In experiments, prioritize budget sweeps, ablations (indexer-only vs memory-only vs both), and failure-case analysis on retrieval-heavy tasks (RULER/NIAH).

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它不再把 KV eviction 当启发式排序，而是把“删掉后如何补偿”一起建模；先看方法图和同 budget 对比表，若 setup 不齐就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it treats KV eviction as a learned decision with explicit post-eviction compensation; check the method figure and same-budget comparisons first, otherwise treat the gains cautiously.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频扩散 world model 的长期一致性与实时推理之间的冲突。完整 KV-cache attention 能在重访场景时保持内容一致，但显存和 attention 计算随 rollout 长度线性增长；滑动窗口能保持速度，却会丢掉早期场景记忆，导致重访时漂移或生成新内容。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于传统 LLM 预训练方法，但对自回归多模态生成模型和长期上下文推理有参考价值。它的关键观察是：KV cache 不只是加速缓存，也可以作为模型已有的隐式世界记忆。与训练外部 memory module 或显式 3D 表示相比，WorldKV 选择直接管理模型自身的 KV cache，因此更接近 serving-time memory policy。对 LLM 研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不一定只靠扩大上下文窗口，也可以通过检索、压缩、重插入已有 KV 来获得更低成本的历史访问。
summary.technical_approach: WorldKV 是 training-free 框架，由 World Retrieval 和 World Compression 两部分组成。World Retrieval 把滑动窗口中被驱逐的 KV-cache chunk 存到 GPU/CPU memory，在模型重访相关场景时再选择性取回，并直接插回原生 attention window，不需要重编码，也不改模型结构。检索策略是模块化的，可以使用 camera/action correspondence，也可以使用 attention-based retrieval。World Compression 针对相邻帧 KV 高度冗余的问题，用 Key-Key similarity 识别并裁剪重复 token，把每个 chunk 大约压到一半大小。这样在同样 memory budget 下能保留约 2 倍历史，同时避免完整历史 attention 的线性开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个不同规模的自回归视频 world model 上评估：Matrix-Game-2.0 和 LingBot-World-Fast。一个重要实验现象是，即使 Matrix-Game-2.0 训练时只用 6-frame sliding window，推理时放开完整 KV-cache 仍能利用过去 cache 重建曾经看过的视角，说明这种记忆并不完全依赖长序列训练。成本方面，论文指出每帧会产生约 880 到 1,560 个 token，一分钟 rollout 会累积到数十万 token；LingBot-World-Fast 使用完整历史时，FPS 从 8.87 降到 3.61。World Compression 能把 chunk 约减半，World Retrieval 则在不读取完整历史的情况下提升 revisit fidelity。论文称 training-free KV 管理在重访一致性上可匹配或超过 full KV-cache attention 和 memory-trained baselines，同时保持实时推理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 的 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解“KV cache 已经携带世界记忆”和“完整历史 attention 不可承受”这两个前提。方法部分重点看 World Retrieval 如何定义 chunk、如何根据相机/动作或 attention 取回历史 KV，以及 World Compression 的 Key-Key similarity pruning。实验部分关注 Matrix-Game-2.0 的短上下文训练但长记忆可用这一点，这比具体应用演示更有方法价值。Appendix C 如果有时间可以看，用来判断 retrieval 策略是否可迁移到其他自回归多模态模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tension between long-term consistency and real-time inference in autoregressive video diffusion world models. Full-history KV-cache attention can preserve scene consistency during revisits, but memory and attention cost grow with rollout length. Sliding-window inference keeps the system fast, but evicts the very caches needed to recover previously seen views.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as an inference-time memory management study for autoregressive multimodal generation. Its central observation is that KV cache is not only a compute buffer; it can act as an implicit world memory already available inside the model. Instead of training an external memory module, adding cross-attention, or reconstructing an explicit 3D scene, the method manages and reuses the model’s own KV cache. For LLM researchers, the useful analogy is long-context access under a bounded budget: selective retrieval and compression of past KV can be an alternative to simply increasing the active context window.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV is a training-free framework with two components. World Retrieval stores evicted KV-cache chunks in GPU or CPU memory and retrieves scene-relevant chunks when the camera or action trajectory indicates a revisit. The retrieved caches are inserted back into the native attention window, without re-encoding and without architectural changes. The retrieval interface is modular and can use camera/action correspondence or attention-based selection. World Compression reduces redundancy across adjacent video frames by pruning tokens according to Key-Key similarity. Since neighboring frames produce near-duplicate KV entries, compressing each chunk to roughly half size allows about twice as much history to be retained under the same memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot-World-Fast. A notable finding is that Matrix-Game-2.0, although trained with only a 6-frame sliding window, can still use full past KV caches at inference time to reconstruct previously visited viewpoints. This supports the claim that the memory effect is not limited to models trained on minute-long sequences. The cost motivation is concrete: each frame produces around 880 to 1,560 tokens, so a one-minute rollout can accumulate hundreds of thousands of tokens. On LingBot-World-Fast, full-history attention reduces FPS from 8.87 to 3.61 over a one-minute rollout. WorldKV uses retrieval to avoid attending to the full history and compression to roughly halve chunk size. The reported results show revisit fidelity comparable to or better than full KV-cache attention and memory-trained baselines while maintaining real-time inference.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 in the introduction: they establish the two core claims, namely that KV carries usable scene memory and that full-history attention is too expensive. Then read the method sections on World Retrieval and World Compression. The most transferable details are chunk construction, camera/action-based retrieval, attention-based retrieval, and Key-Key similarity pruning. The Matrix-Game-2.0 result is worth noting because it separates inference-time cache reuse from long-sequence training. Appendix C is useful if the goal is to judge whether the retrieval policy could be adapted to other autoregressive multimodal models.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 KV 记忆的思路值得借鉴；重点看 retrieval key 的定义和压缩误差，别被视频场景绑住。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for long-context KV memory design; focus on the retrieval key and compression error, not the video-specific framing.

paper.title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent progress in LLM reasoning has increasingly shifted from single-pass generation to explicit search over intermediate reasoning states. Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) organizes inference to tree-structured search with branching and backtracking, but it substantially amplifies the Key--Value (KV) cache: retaining KV states for a frontier of partial trajectories quickly becomes a memory bottleneck that limits throughput and constrains search depth and width under fixed hardware budgets. We address th

summary.core_problem: ArborKV 解决 Tree-of-Thoughts 这类树状推理中的 KV cache 内存瓶颈：为了支持分支扩展和回溯，系统需要保留大量部分轨迹的 KV 状态，峰值显存很快限制搜索宽度、深度和吞吐。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于推理效率方向，对预训练研究的间接价值在于帮助理解“更强推理能力”在系统层面的真实成本。Tree search、agentic reasoning 和长程 CoT 如果要成为可扩展的训练或评测范式，KV cache 管理不能只按线性序列设计。ArborKV 的关键启发是把 cache 单位从 token 序列改成 thought block，并把保留策略和搜索拓扑绑定。这对未来训练推理一体化系统、long-horizon verifier、以及大规模生成推理数据都有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把树状推理轨迹建模为 rooted tree，每个节点是一个 thought block，即一个局部连贯推理步骤对应的连续 token span。核心观察是：当前自回归扩展只依赖 active leaf 及其祖先链，非活跃分支短期复用概率低，但在回溯时必须可恢复。因此，传统面向平坦序列的 token-level KV 剪枝不适配 ToT。ArborKV 包含两个模块。Multi-Signal Value Estimator 用低开销信号估计 thought block 价值，融合搜索控制器的策略反馈、模型生成置信度、语义不确定性和注意力统计，不额外引入在线 forward。Tree-Aware Eviction Policy 再把这些价值分数映射到树拓扑，根据节点到当前搜索前沿的距离和语义价值分配保留预算。被淘汰的 KV 状态通过 lazy rehydration 在回溯需要时恢复。作者还把该策略形式化为受内存预算约束的优化问题，用于平衡语义重要性和拓扑邻近性。
summary.experiments: 实验在 ToT 风格推理任务上进行，包括 GSM8K、SVAMP 和 Game of 24。作者报告 ArborKV 在接近 full-retention 推理准确率的情况下，最多实现约 4× 峰值 KV cache 降低。结果强调两点：第一，在固定显存下可以支持更大的树搜索配置，避免原本会 OOM 的深度或宽度；第二，相比只做线性序列 token 压缩的方法，树结构感知的保留策略更符合分支和回溯的访问模式。文中还提到 intra-block token-extractive mechanism，用于在 thought block 内进一步做 token 级保留，从而结合 block 级拓扑管理和局部 token 压缩。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看问题形式化部分：thought block 树、active branch、frontier、backtracking 这些定义决定了 ArborKV 与普通 KV pruning 的差异。方法部分优先看 MSVE 的信号来源和 TAE 的预算分配规则，再看 lazy rehydration 的系统代价。实验部分关注 peak KV reduction 与 accuracy retention 的折中曲线，而不只看单点数字。若关心推理系统与训练数据生成的结合，可以重点思考一个问题：树搜索的中间状态是否应该成为调度和存储的一等对象，而不是被压平成普通序列。

summary_en.core_problem: ArborKV addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in tree-based reasoning. Tree-of-Thoughts style inference keeps many partial trajectories alive for branching and backtracking, so peak KV memory can become the limiting factor for search width, search depth, and throughput.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, with indirect but concrete relevance to foundation-model research. Test-time search, long-horizon reasoning, and agentic workflows all become expensive when intermediate states are stored as ordinary linear decoding histories. ArborKV’s useful contribution is to make the reasoning tree itself part of the cache policy. That perspective matters for scalable reasoning evaluation, verifier-guided search, and large-scale generation of reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method represents a reasoning trajectory as a rooted tree of thought blocks, where each node is a contiguous span corresponding to a coherent reasoning step. The key observation is that near-term decoding needs the active leaf and its ancestor chain, while inactive subtrees have low immediate reuse probability but must remain recoverable for later backtracking. ArborKV has two main components. The Multi-Signal Value Estimator scores each thought block using low-overhead signals from the search controller, generation confidence, semantic uncertainty, and attention statistics, without requiring extra online forward passes. The Tree-Aware Eviction policy then combines these utility scores with tree topology, prioritizing blocks that are both semantically useful and close to the active search frontier. Evicted states can be restored through lazy rehydration when the search backtracks. The paper also frames the allocation as a constrained optimization problem under a fixed memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use ToT-style reasoning benchmarks including GSM8K, SVAMP, and Game of 24. ArborKV is reported to reduce peak KV cache by up to about 4× while maintaining reasoning accuracy close to full KV retention. The results emphasize that structure-aware cache management can enable larger tree-search settings under fixed device budgets, including cases where full retention would run out of memory. The paper also mentions an intra-block token-extractive mechanism, which complements block-level tree-aware eviction with token-level compression inside each thought block.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the formalization of thought blocks and the tree search state, because that is where the paper departs from standard sequence-level KV pruning. Then read the MSVE scoring signals, the TAE allocation rule, and the lazy rehydration mechanism. In the experiments, focus on the accuracy versus peak-KV trade-off and on settings that would otherwise exceed the memory budget. The main idea to retain is that intermediate reasoning states may need first-class system support rather than being treated as flat token histories.

recommendation.zh: 树状推理的KV优化是测试时缩放的核心工程瓶颈，重点看§3的结构化驱逐策略设计。
recommendation.en: KV optimization for tree-structured reasoning is a core engineering bottleneck for test-time scaling; focus on §3 structured eviction policy design.

paper.title: EntmaxKV: Support-Aware Decoding for Entmax Attention
paper.abstract: Long-context decoding is increasingly limited by KV-cache memory traffic since each generated token attends over a cache whose size grows linearly with context length. Existing sparse decoding methods reduce this cost by selecting subsets of tokens or pages, but are designed for softmax attention, whose dense tails make any truncation discard nonzero probability mass. In contrast, $α$-entmax produces exact zeros, turning sparse decoding from dense-tail approximation into support recovery: if the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文解码里的一个很具体但很关键的问题：KV-cache 读取已经成为单 token 解码延迟的主要瓶颈，而现有 sparse decoding 方法大多是围绕 softmax 设计的。softmax 注意力对所有 token 都给正概率，因此任何截断都会丢掉非零质量，误差只能靠近似控制。作者抓住了 α-entmax 的一个不同点：它会产生精确的零权重，于是 sparse decoding 的目标不再是“逼近 dense tail”，而是“在加载 KV 之前找回真正的 support”。如果候选页覆盖了 entmax 的非零支持集，解码结果就与全量 attention 完全一致。论文要解决的核心问题，就是如何在不先读取全部 KV 的前提下，用轻量元数据预测哪些 page 可能包含 entmax support，从而把 entmax 的稀疏性真正转化成解码时的带宽节省。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于提出一个通用的新注意力层，而在于把“训练时可稀疏”和“推理时可省带宽”这两件常被割裂的事接上了。很多稀疏注意力方法训练阶段看起来有结构，但解码时仍要先扫完整个 cache，稀疏性来得太晚，系统收益有限。EntmaxKV 说明：如果注意力分布本身有精确 support，解码优化可以从近似问题变成 support recovery 问题，理论上更干净，工程上也更可控。对预训练研究员，这个点的启发在于：选择 softmax 还是 entmax，不只是建模偏好，还会影响后续 inference kernel、paged attention 设计和长上下文 serving 的上限。不过这篇工作的影响更偏“推理-建模接口”，不是训练 recipe 层面的范式变化，因此更适合 skim 而不是精读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是误差视角的重写。作者把 sparse decoding 的误差归结为 dropped probability mass δ，并证明输出误差可由 2Bδ 上界控制，其中 B 是 value 向量范数界。对 softmax，任何 budget 下 δ 都严格大于 0；对 entmax，只要候选集合包含真实 support，δ 就直接变成 0，输出完全精确。这个结论把问题从“保留大权重 token”改写成“不要漏掉 support token”。

第二部分是分页选择机制。KV cache 被分成 pages，每个 page 预存轻量统计量而不是完整 K/V。解码时先用 query 与 page metadata 计算一个 page-level score 或上界，只把最可能含有 support token 的 pages 读入，再在候选 token 上做真正的 α-entmax attention。这样做的关键不是简单 top-k，而是尽量在 page 级别恢复 support，同时减少 HBM 读流量。

第三部分是 Gaussian-aware entmax selector。作者利用 page 内 score 分布的近似统计，估计 entmax 阈值 τ，并据此判断某个 page 是否可能包含满足 (α-1)s_i > τ 的 token。相比 softmax 稀疏解码常见的基于最大分数、块上界或启发式阈值的方法，这里 selector 是围绕 entmax 的 support 条件设计的。它会根据分数分布自适应调整 candidate budget，而不是固定保留同样数量的页。论文还讨论了 query-aware metadata 的构造，以及如何在不显著增加预处理和存储成本的前提下，让 page 选择足够便宜。

与已有方法的区别有两点。第一，目标函数不同：不是近似 softmax 输出，而是恢复 entmax support。第二，选择依据不同：不是只看高分 token 的贡献大小，而是估计哪些 page 可能跨过 entmax 阈值。这个差异决定了它在 support retention、dropped mass 和输出误差上的行为会明显不同。
summary.experiments:
实验重点放在三类指标：support retention、dropped mass δ、以及最终 attention/output 误差，同时报告长序列解码速度。全文给出的主结论是，EntmaxKV 在相同 page budget 下比 softmax-based sparse decoding 更容易保住真正有用的 token，因而 dropped mass 更低；当 budget 足够覆盖 support 时，误差会像理论预测那样降到 0，而 softmax 截断误差不会消失。作者还展示了在长序列场景下，相比 full-cache softmax 和 full-cache entmax，EntmaxKV 能带来实际 wall-clock 加速。

从论文内容看，最值得注意的不是某一个绝对数字，而是几条实验现象：
1. 随着 candidate budget 增加，entmax 的误差曲线会出现明显“归零拐点”，对应 support 被完整恢复；softmax 则是平滑下降但不归零。
2. Gaussian-aware selector 比更朴素的 page ranking 更稳，尤其在 score 分布偏尖或不同层/头稀疏度差异较大时，support recall 更高。
3. 在长上下文下，速度收益主要来自减少 KV page 读取，而不是 attention FLOPs 本身；这与作者对 memory-bound decoding 的问题设定一致。

由于给到的全文片段没有完整表格数字、模型规模和具体序列长度配置，无法可靠摘录参数量、页大小、精确加速倍数等细节；阅读时应直接核对实验章节和附录表格，而不要只记结论性表述。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议抓三处。

第一看引言和 Figure 1。这里把 softmax 截断与 entmax support recovery 的差别讲得最清楚，决定了整篇论文的立论是否成立。

第二看理论部分关于 dropped mass δ 的定义和误差界。重点不是推导细节本身，而是理解为什么 entmax 下“候选覆盖 support 即可精确”这件事成立，以及这个条件在 page 级选择里如何被近似实现。

第三看方法章节里 Gaussian-aware selector 的设计，再对照实验里的 support retention / output error 曲线。这里最能看出作者不是简单把已有 sparse decoding 套到 entmax 上，而是围绕 entmax 阈值机制重写了 selector。

如果时间有限，预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线：引言、方法总览、核心实验图。若要判断是否值得进一步跟进，需要补看附录里的实现细节，尤其是 metadata 存储开销、page 粒度选择、不同 α 值下的稳定性，以及训练好的 entmax 模型是否会牺牲通用质量。
