summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific but important bottleneck in long-context decoding: KV-cache traffic dominates per-token latency, yet most sparse decoding methods are built for softmax attention. With softmax, every token has nonzero probability, so any truncation necessarily drops some mass and introduces approximation error. The key observation here is that α-entmax yields exact zeros. That changes sparse decoding from dense-tail approximation into support recovery: if the selected pages contain the true entmax support, the sparse result is exactly equal to full-cache attention. The core problem is therefore how to predict, before loading the full KV cache, which pages are likely to contain support tokens, so that entmax sparsity becomes an actual decoding-time bandwidth reduction rather than a post hoc property.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is not that it proposes a new universal attention layer, but that it closes the gap between train-time sparsity and inference-time systems benefit. Many sparse attention ideas look structured during training, yet still require scanning the full cache at decode time, which limits practical gains. EntmaxKV shows that if the attention distribution has exact support, decoding optimization can be framed as support recovery rather than approximation. That is cleaner theoretically and more actionable at the kernel/serving level. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is that choosing entmax over softmax is not only a modeling decision; it also changes what is possible for paged attention, cache selection, and long-context serving. Still, the contribution sits more at the modeling–inference interface than at the core pretraining recipe level, so it fits a skim recommendation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, the paper rewrites sparse decoding error in terms of dropped probability mass δ and proves that the output error is bounded by 2Bδ, where B bounds the value vectors. Under softmax, δ remains strictly positive for any finite truncation budget. Under entmax, once the candidate set covers the true support, δ becomes zero and the output is exact. This reframes the objective from preserving large weights to avoiding support misses.

Second, the KV cache is partitioned into pages, and each page stores lightweight metadata rather than requiring full key/value loading. At decode time, the query interacts with page metadata to produce page-level scores or bounds; only the most promising pages are fetched, and α-entmax attention is computed over the selected entries. The point is not generic top-k pruning, but page-level support recovery with reduced HBM traffic.

Third, the paper introduces a Gaussian-aware entmax selector. Using lightweight statistics of score distributions within pages, it estimates the entmax threshold τ and predicts whether a page may contain tokens satisfying the support condition (α−1)s_i > τ. Unlike softmax-oriented sparse decoding methods that rely on max-score heuristics, block bounds, or generic thresholds, this selector is designed around the entmax support criterion itself. It also adapts the candidate budget to the score distribution instead of using a fixed number of retained pages.

Relative to prior sparse decoding work, the differences are clear. The target is not to approximate softmax outputs, but to recover entmax support. The selection rule is not based only on token contribution magnitude, but on whether a page may cross the entmax threshold. That leads to different behavior in support retention, dropped mass, and output error.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on three metrics: support retention, dropped mass δ, and final attention/output error, along with long-sequence decoding speed. The main empirical result is that EntmaxKV preserves more true support tokens than softmax-based sparse decoding under the same page budget, which leads to lower dropped mass. As the budget increases, the entmax error curve exhibits a clear zero-error transition once the support is fully recovered, matching the theory; softmax truncation does not show such a regime. The paper also reports wall-clock speedups over full-cache softmax and full-cache entmax in long-context decoding.

The most useful empirical patterns are:
1. As the candidate budget grows, entmax error drops to zero after a distinct support-recovery point, whereas softmax error decays smoothly but never vanishes.
2. The Gaussian-aware selector is more robust than simpler page-ranking baselines, especially when score distributions are sharp or sparsity varies across heads/layers.
3. The speed gains come primarily from reduced KV-page reads rather than reduced attention FLOPs, which is consistent with the paper’s memory-bound decoding premise.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete tables with model sizes, sequence lengths, page sizes, or exact speedup numbers, so those details should be checked directly in the experimental section and appendix rather than inferred from the narrative.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, read the introduction and Figure 1. They make the central distinction between softmax truncation and entmax support recovery very clear, and that distinction carries the whole paper.

Second, read the theory around dropped mass δ and the output-error bound. The main point is not the algebra itself, but why exact decoding becomes possible once the support is covered, and how that condition is approximated at the page-selection stage.

Third, read the method section on the Gaussian-aware selector and then compare it with the support-retention and output-error plots. That is where the paper shows it is not merely porting an existing sparse decoder to entmax, but redesigning the selector around the entmax threshold mechanism.

If time is limited, 20–30 minutes is enough for the main line: introduction, method overview, and core figures. If deciding whether to follow up more deeply, check the appendix for metadata overhead, page granularity, stability across α values, and whether entmax-trained models trade off general quality for decode-time sparsity.

recommendation.zh: 做Entmax注意力落地或长上下文推理优化可参考，读§3方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Referable for entmax attention deployment or long-context inference optimization, only §3 method section needs reading

paper.title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on intermediate communication to coordinate complex tasks. While most existing systems communicate through natural language, recent work shows that latent communication, particularly through transformer key-value (KV) caches, can improve efficiency and preserve richer task-relevant information. However, KV caches also encode contextual inputs, intermediate reasoning states, and agent-specific information, creating an opaque c

summary.core_problem: 在多 LLM agent 系统中，KV cache 作为隐式通信通道可能泄露上下文、推理状态和 agent 私有信息，论文试图在共享 KV 前做安全过滤。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多 agent latent communication 的安全框架。它关注的不是传统文本消息过滤，而是表示层面的 KV cache 共享风险；这对使用 KV-cache 传递中间状态、做 agent 间加速或隐式协作的系统有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: LCGuard 将共享 KV cache 视为 latent working memory，在缓存片段传输给其他 agent 前学习表示级变换。论文把敏感信息泄露操作化定义为 representation-level leakage，并试图通过变换降低隐私泄露，同时保留任务相关信息。摘要未给出具体损失、攻击模型、变换网络结构和保真度约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、使用的 LLM、agent 任务、攻击/探测器设置、泄露降低幅度或任务性能损失。只能确认其实验目标应是评估 KV latent communication 中的敏感信息泄露与 LCGuard 的防护效果。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute 和 IBM Research；主题位于 LLM 多 agent 系统、KV cache 通信和安全表示学习交叉处。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses sensitive-information leakage when multi-agent LLM systems share KV caches as a latent communication channel.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety framework for latent communication among LLM agents. Rather than filtering natural-language messages, it targets representation-level leakage through KV-cache artifacts, which is relevant to systems that share hidden states for efficiency or coordination.
summary_en.technical_approach: LCGuard treats shared KV caches as latent working memory and learns representation-level transformations before cache artifacts are transmitted across agents. It operationalizes sensitive-information leakage at the representation level and aims to suppress private content while preserving task-relevant information. The abstract does not specify the loss, threat model, transformation architecture, or fidelity constraint.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, LLM backbones, agent tasks, attack or probing setup, leakage reduction, or utility loss. The likely evaluation target is privacy leakage and task preservation under KV-based latent communication.
summary_en.authors_note: The work comes from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and IBM Research, at the intersection of LLM multi-agent systems, KV-cache communication, and safety-oriented representation learning.

recommendation.zh: 看威胁模型就够；KV 通信泄露是真问题，但若没有强 probe 和效用曲线，结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model only; KV leakage is real, but without strong probes and utility curves the result is only a weak signal.

paper.title: PulseCol: Periodically Refreshed Column-Sparse Attention for Accelerating Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Inference in diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is computationally expensive, as full self-attention must be repeatedly executed at each step of the denoising process without KV cache. Recent sparse attention methods for dLLMs mitigate this cost via block-sparse computation, which is applied only in later iterations when model performance is less sensitive to coarse-grained sparse approximation, but yields limited improvements in computational efficiency and acceleration. This motivates a f

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）推理需要在每个去噪步重复做全量自注意力，且无法像 AR 那样用 KV cache，导致注意力开销随步数线性累积；现有稀疏注意力多在后期才敢启用、且以块稀疏为主，早期去噪一旦稀疏化就容易掉质量。论文要解决的是：如何在早期去噪阶段也能安全引入稀疏注意力，并把算法稀疏真正转化为端到端 GPU 加速。
summary.importance: 对“非 AR 生成范式”的工程化落地更直接：它不改训练目标，而是抓住 dLLM 推理的结构性瓶颈（多步重复 attention）做可实现的加速。对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：1）dLLM 的注意力结构在去噪时间轴上有可复用的统计规律（相邻步相似、早期呈列稀疏），这类规律未来可反向影响训练（例如训练时加入稀疏/结构先验以提升可加速性）；2）提示 dLLM 的“早期敏感”并不等价于“必须全密集”，而是需要匹配正确的稀疏粒度。
summary.technical_approach:
核心观察：早期去噪步的注意力并非真正稠密，高分注意力集中在少数 key 的“列”（column）上，呈现列方向的稀疏结构；而已有方法常用块稀疏（block sparse）在空间上做粗粒度近似，容易在早期误删关键连接，从而表现为“早期稀疏很脆”。
方法 PulseCol：
1）列稀疏注意力（column-sparse）：直接选择少量重要的 key 列参与注意力计算，而不是按块保留/丢弃。直觉是更贴合早期注意力的真实形态，因此能把稀疏窗口前移到更早的去噪步。
2）周期刷新（periodically refreshed）：注意力模式会随去噪演化，若每步都重算稀疏索引会抵消收益；若全程固定又会失配。PulseCol 在相邻若干步复用同一组列索引，并每隔 R 步刷新一次以跟踪模式漂移，在“索引更新成本”和“模式失配误差”之间做折中。
3）工程实现：提供列稀疏 attention 的 GPU kernel，使得列选择带来的算子级 FLOPs/带宽节省能落到 wall-clock speedup，而不是停留在理论稀疏率。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的关键信息包括：
- 在相同稀疏预算下，PulseCol 的生成质量-效率折中优于已有 dLLM 稀疏注意力基线；尤其在高稀疏率下更稳。
- 80% sparsity 时，PulseCol 与全注意力相比“只略有落后”，同时明显优于既有稀疏方法（文中表述为 on average outperforms prior baselines）。
- 结合自定义列稀疏 kernel，在不同上下文长度下相对 FlashAttention 的端到端推理加速最高可达 1.95×。
（当前提供的全文片段未包含更细的任务指标/模型规模/步数 T/刷新周期 R 的具体数值表格；精读时需要从实验章节补齐这些可复现细节。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先抓三件事：
1）引言里对“早期注意力并不稠密、而是列稀疏”的实证图/统计（决定了为什么块稀疏不合适）。
2）方法部分：列索引如何选、如何在多头/多层共享或独立、刷新周期如何设定，以及索引更新本身的开销是否计入。
3）实验部分：在不同去噪阶段启用稀疏的策略、与哪些基线比（尤其是后期才稀疏的方案）、以及速度评测是否包含索引刷新与 kernel launch 的真实开销。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可把核心思路与主要结果读清；若要复现/迁移到自家 dLLM，需要额外细看 kernel 与 profiling 设定。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LMs must recompute full self-attention at every denoising step and cannot rely on KV cache, making inference expensive. Prior sparse-attention approaches for dLLMs typically sparsify only in late steps and often use coarse block sparsity; applying sparsity early tends to hurt quality. The paper targets early-step-safe sparsification and turning sparsity into real GPU speedups.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference/serving contribution for diffusion LMs rather than a new pretraining recipe. The pretraining-relevant takeaway is the empirical structure: attention patterns evolve smoothly across denoising steps and, crucially, early steps exhibit strong column-wise concentration. That suggests early-step fragility is not “sparsity is impossible” but “the sparsity granularity is mismatched,” and it hints at future training-time regularization/architectural priors to make diffusion inference more accelerator-friendly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Key finding: early denoising attention is not truly dense; high attention mass concentrates on a small set of key columns (column-wise sparsity). Block-sparse approximations are too coarse and can drop critical connections early.
PulseCol design:
1) Column-sparse attention: keep a selected subset of key columns instead of block structures, better matching the intrinsic pattern and enabling sparsity from earlier steps.
2) Periodic refresh: reuse the selected column indices for several adjacent denoising steps (to avoid recomputing sparsity every step), but refresh them every R steps to track pattern drift over the denoising trajectory.
3) Systems component: an optimized GPU kernel for column-sparse attention so algorithmic sparsity yields wall-clock gains.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported highlights:
- Under the same sparsity budget, PulseCol achieves a better quality–efficiency trade-off than prior sparse-attention baselines for dLLMs.
- At 80% sparsity, it is only slightly worse than full attention while clearly outperforming existing sparse methods.
- With the custom column-sparse kernel, it reaches up to 1.95× end-to-end speedup over FlashAttention across multiple context lengths.
(The provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed tables for model size, denoising steps, refresh period, and task metrics; those need to be pulled from the experiments section for a complete reproduction-grade read.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
1) The empirical analysis showing column-wise sparsity in early denoising (figures/statistics that justify the design).
2) The method details: how columns are selected, whether indices are shared across heads/layers, refresh scheduling, and the overhead accounting.
3) The speed evaluation methodology: whether refresh/indexing costs are included, and how the kernel is benchmarked.
Time: ~20–30 minutes to capture the main idea and results; longer if you want to port the kernel or replicate profiling.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；dLLM 没有 KV-cache 的痛点真实，column sparsity 是否稳要看质量-速度曲线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the no-KV-cache bottleneck is real, but column sparsity must be judged by the quality-speed curve.

paper.title: Runtime-Certified Bounded-Error Quantized Attention
paper.abstract: KV cache quantization reduces the memory cost of long-context LLM inference, but introduces approximation error that is typically validated only empirically. Existing systems rely on average-case robustness, with no mechanism to detect or recover from failures at runtime. We present a tiered KV cache architecture that enables runtime-certified attention: INT8 keys and INT4 values are stored in GPU memory, while FP16 originals are retained in system RAM for deterministic fallback. A two-term erro

summary.core_problem: KV cache 量化是长上下文推理的关键优化，但现有方案仅依赖经验验证（ perplexity 平均指标），无法在逐解码步骤粒度上检测或恢复量化误差，存在静默失败风险（即对某些 prompt/attention 模式产生大的 step-wise 偏差）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在推理可靠性维度。该工作将 KV cache 量化从「固定近似」重新定义为「运行时可验证计算」，提供了一种 principled 的误差界框架，而非纯经验调参。对需要确定性服务质量的生产部署有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心创新有三点：(1) 分层存储架构：GPU VRAM 存放 INT8 key + INT4 value 的量化缓存，系统内存（pinned RAM）保留 FP16 原始数据用于确定性 fallback，FP16 数据不丢弃；(2) 两项误差分解：独立界定 key 量化导致的 attention 分布畸变和 value 量化导致的重建误差，两个界都可以在运行时用量化 scale、query 范数、value 范围等已跟踪量计算；(3) 自适应精度选择 + 四级 fallback 梯子：根据 attention mass 分布决定哪些 block 需要 FP16 key，同时用 ranking-consistency 检查检测 INT8 评分噪声何时扭曲 attention 分布，触发 per-head fallback 到 dense attention。
summary.experiments: 论文以 LLaMA 3.1-8B 为目标模型架构（32层，GQA 8 KV heads，head dim 128），在 128K 上下文下 FP16 KV cache 约 17GB。提出的 INT8 key + INT4 value 缓存占 FP16 的约 56%（含元数据）。文中包含形式化误差界推导（第 4 节）和 arithmetic-path gap 分析（第 9.10 节），但未报告完整的端到端性能/精度对比实验数据（从提供的全文来看）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看第 1 节（问题定义和核心思想概述）和第 3 节（分层存储架构 + fallback 机制），第 4 节的误差分解可根据兴趣选读。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。对预训练研究员来说，主要价值在于其 runtime verification 的框架思路，而非具体量化参数。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在提供的全文中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache quantization is a critical optimization for long-context inference, but existing schemes rely solely on empirical validation (average perplexity metrics) and cannot detect or recover from quantization errors at the per-decode-step granularity, risking silent failures—large step-wise deviations on certain prompts/attention patterns.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretrain research is in the inference reliability dimension. This work reframes KV cache quantization from a 'fixed approximation' to 'runtime-verifiable computation', providing a principled error-bound framework rather than purely empirical tuning. It offers reference value for production deployments requiring deterministic service quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core innovations: (1) Tiered storage architecture: GPU VRAM holds INT8 key + INT4 value quantized cache, while FP16 originals are retained in pinned system RAM for deterministic fallback—FP16 data is never discarded; (2) Two-term error decomposition: independently bounds attention distribution distortion from key quantization and reconstruction error from value compression, both computable at runtime from already-tracked quantities (quantization scales, query norms, value ranges); (3) Adaptive precision selection + four-rung fallback ladder: determines which blocks need FP16 keys based on attention mass distribution, and uses a ranking-consistency check to detect when INT8 scoring noise distorts the attention distribution, triggering per-head fallback to dense attention.
summary_en.experiments: The target architecture is LLaMA 3.1-8B (32 layers, GQA 8 KV heads, head dim 128), with FP16 KV cache ~17GB at 128K context. The proposed INT8 key + INT4 value cache occupies ~56% of FP16 (including metadata). The paper includes formal error bound derivations (Section 4) and arithmetic-path gap analysis (Section 9.10), but complete end-to-end performance/accuracy comparison experiment data is not reported in the provided full text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guidance: focus on Section 1 (problem definition and core idea overview) and Section 3 (tiered storage architecture + fallback mechanism). Section 4 error decomposition is optional based on interest. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. For pretrain researchers, the main value is the runtime verification framework, not the specific quantization parameters.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not specified in the provided full text.

recommendation.zh: 运行时认证量化的思路有新意，误差分解和回退机制设计对长上下文推理系统有参考价值，关注 §3 的误差界推导。
recommendation.en: Runtime-certified quantization is a novel direction; the error decomposition and fallback mechanism is useful for long-context inference systems. Focus on the bound derivation in §3.

paper.title: OCTOPUS: Optimized KV Cache for Transformers via Octahedral Parametrization Under optimal Squared error quantization
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory bandwidth and footprint in long-context autoregressive inference. Recent rotation-preconditioned codecs (TurboQuant, PolarQuant) show that a structured random rotation followed by a per-coordinate scalar quantizer matched to an analytically tractable marginal is a near-optimal recipe for KV compression. OCTOPUS advances this paradigm through joint quantization of rotated coordinate triplets. Each triplet's direction is mapped to a square via an octahedra

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文自回归推理中KV缓存占用内存带宽和空间过高的问题，突破现有基于旋转预处理的KV量化方法单坐标独立量化带来的压缩效率瓶颈。
summary.importance: 提出了新的KV量化范式，在更低比特预算下保持推理性能，可提升长上下文推理的批量规模、降低延迟，同时支持多模态Transformer的KV压缩，适用范围广。
summary.technical_approach: 沿用带符号翻转的Walsh-Hadamard变换做预处理让KV坐标各向同性，将旋转后的坐标划分为三元组，分别量化每个三元组的范数和方向：方向采用计算机图形学中的八面体参数化映射为二维坐标，再与范数一起使用Lloyd-Max量化，基于MSE最优做非均匀比特分配；不需要数据依赖的校准，码本仅由隐层维度和总比特预算决定；支持可选的1-bit QJL残差消除点积偏差，采用融合Triton核实现解码时实时重构KV，无需实例化完整KV张量。
summary.experiments: 在4/3/2比特KV量化配置下，该方法在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M长上下文语言模型、CausVid因果视频扩散模型、帧级因果视频生成模型、自回归音频模型四类任务上，性能均优于同比特的其他旋转基KV量化方法，低比特下性能优势更显著。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读推荐关注第3节核心量化流程、第4节多模态实验结果，重点了解八面体参数化实现方式与比特分配策略，预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: To address the high memory bandwidth and footprint overhead of KV cache in long-context autoregressive inference, and break the compression efficiency bottleneck of existing rotation-preconditioned KV quantization methods that quantize each coordinate independently.
summary_en.importance: It introduces a new KV quantization paradigm that maintains inference performance at lower bit budgets, improves long-context inference batch size and reduces latency, and supports KV compression for multimodal transformers with wide applicability.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses sign-flipped Walsh-Hadamard transform preconditioning to make rotated KV coordinates isotropic first, then splits rotated coordinates into triplets and quantizes each triplet's norm and direction separately: triplet direction is mapped to 2D scalars via octahedral parameterization from computer graphics, then both direction coordinates and triplet norm are quantized with Lloyd-Max quantizer under MSE-optimal non-uniform bit allocation. No data-dependent calibration is required, and codebooks only depend on hidden dimension and total bit budget. It also supports optional 1-bit QJL residual to eliminate dot product bias, and uses fused Triton kernels to reconstruct KV on the fly during decoding without materializing full KV tensors.
summary_en.experiments: Under 4/3/2 bit KV quantization settings, OCTOPUS outperforms other rotation-based KV codecs with matched bit width across four tasks: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M long-context language modeling, CausVid causal video diffusion, frame-wise causal video generation, and autoregressive audio generation, with larger performance gaps at lower bit budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for core quantization pipeline, Section 4 for multimodal empirical results, focus on octahedral parameterization implementation and bit allocation strategy. Expected reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 八面体参数化联合量化三元组的设计比较巧妙，重点看§3量化公式推导和§4多模态精度对比即可
recommendation.en: The joint triplet quantization design with octahedral parameterization is clever; focus on §3 quantization formula derivation and §4 multimodal accuracy comparison

paper.title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in large language models is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of full attention. Existing efficient alternatives often rely either on native sparse training or on heuristic token eviction, creating an undesirable trade-off among efficiency, training cost, and accuracy. In this work, we show that full-attention LLMs are already intrinsically sparse and can be transformed into highly sparse models with only minimal adaptation. Our approach is built on three observations: (1

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长上下文推理中的 full attention 成本问题。核心问题不是重新训练一个原生 sparse attention 模型，而是问：已经用 full attention 训练好的 LLM，能否通过很小的改造和少量继续训练，转成高稀疏推理模型，同时尽量保持原能力。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究有间接但清楚的启发。它支持一个实用判断：full-attention 预训练仍然有竞争力，因为模型训练后已经形成可利用的 head-level 和 token-level 稀疏结构。相比从头训练稀疏架构，RTPurbo 更像是 post-pretrain 的结构压缩和推理适配。对基座训练的含义是，训练阶段可以先保留表达能力更稳的 full attention，再在部署前用低成本蒸馏和稀疏化提取推理效率。这会影响长上下文模型在训练目标、架构选择和 serving 成本之间的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 RTPurbo。设计基于三个观察。第一，attention head 功能不均匀，只有少量 retrieval heads 真正需要远程上下文，多数 head 主要处理局部信息。因此方法只为 retrieval heads 保留完整或更长程的 KV 访问，对 local heads 丢弃远程 token。第二，远程检索主要依赖低维子空间。论文从 RoPE 的频率结构解释这一点：高频 rotary 分量随相对距离快速变化，长距离下更容易干扰语义检索；低频分量变化平滑，更适合保持远程相关性。因此 RTPurbo 用低维 projector/indexer 做 token selection，文中强调 16 维即可获得较高 recall。第三，固定 Top-k token budget 不适合所有 query，因为不同 query 的注意力分布尖锐程度不同。RTPurbo 使用 Top-p 式自适应选择，让 token 数随 attention mass 分布变化。最后，它用 self-distillation 对齐稀疏模型和原 full-attention 模型的输出，只需几百步、约 1M label tokens，避免大规模重新训练。
summary.experiments: 关键结果包括：16 维低维检索器可达到超过 90% 的 recall；少量自蒸馏即可恢复稀疏化后的性能；配合定制 sparse kernels，prefill 最高加速 9.36×，decoding 最高加速 2.01×。论文还报告 Top-p selector 在推理和长上下文任务上优于静态 Top-k，说明自适应 token budget 对保留能力很关键。整体实验支持一个结论：full-attention 模型内部已经存在显著稀疏性，稀疏化主要需要识别和对齐，而不一定需要从头训练稀疏模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 minimal surgery 的问题定义，以及 Insight Behind RTPurbo 部分对 retrieval heads、RoPE 低频子空间和自适应 sparsity 的解释。实验部分优先看四类结果：retrieval head 选择是否稳定、16 维 indexer 的 recall、Top-p 与 Top-k 的对照、自蒸馏步数和性能恢复曲线。对做预训练的人，最值得深挖的是 full-attention 训练后自然形成的稀疏结构，以及这种结构是否能反过来指导长上下文预训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost of full attention in long-context inference. The key question is whether a full-attention LLM can be converted into a highly sparse inference model with minimal modification and only a small amount of adaptation, instead of training a sparse-attention model from scratch.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining strategy through the training–serving interface. It suggests that full-attention pretraining remains a practical choice because trained models already contain exploitable sparsity at both the head and token levels. RTPurbo turns this latent structure into an inference-time sparse model through lightweight continuation and distillation. This changes the trade-off: one can keep the more reliable full-attention objective during pretraining, then extract efficiency before deployment, rather than committing to native sparse attention throughout training.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTPurbo is built around three observations. First, attention heads are functionally heterogeneous. Only a small subset acts as retrieval heads that need remote context; many other heads mostly use local information. RTPurbo therefore preserves long-range KV access for retrieval heads and removes remote tokens for local heads. Second, long-range retrieval can be approximated in a low-dimensional subspace. The paper links this to RoPE: high-frequency rotary components vary rapidly with relative distance and can hurt long-range matching, while low-frequency components change smoothly and better preserve retrieval signals. RTPurbo uses a compact low-dimensional projector or indexer for token selection, with 16 dimensions highlighted in the results. Third, a fixed Top-k budget is too rigid because different queries have different attention concentration. The method uses a Top-p-style adaptive selector. A short self-distillation stage then aligns the sparse model with the original full-attention model, requiring only a few hundred steps and about 1M label tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show that the 16-dimensional indexer achieves over 90% recall for relevant tokens. Self-distillation recovers sparse-model performance with a very small amount of training. With custom sparse kernels, RTPurbo reaches up to 9.36× prefill speedup and 2.01× decoding speedup. The ablations indicate that Top-p adaptive selection works better than static Top-k on reasoning and long-context tasks, supporting the claim that query-dependent token budgets are important. The experiments collectively show that much of the needed sparsity is already present in full-attention models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the problem framing in the Introduction, especially the idea of minimal surgery on a full-attention model. Then read the RTPurbo insight section for retrieval-head specialization, the RoPE low-frequency argument, and adaptive sparsity. In the experiments, focus on four points: retrieval-head identification, 16-dimensional indexer recall, Top-p versus Top-k ablations, and the self-distillation recovery curve. For pretraining researchers, the most useful angle is whether the sparsity that emerges after full-attention training can inform future long-context training recipes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §attention-head ablation 和延迟表；若百步迁移成立，native sparse pretraining 的必要性要重新估。
recommendation.en: Read the attention-head ablations and latency table; if the hundred-step transfer holds, the need for native sparse pretraining should be re-estimated.

paper.title: KVServe: Service-Aware KV Cache Compression for Communication-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving
paper.abstract: LLMs are widely adopted in production, pushing inference systems to their limits. Disaggregated LLM serving (e.g., PD separation and KV state disaggregation) improves scalability and cost efficiency, but it also turns KV into an explicit payload crossing network and storage boundaries, making KV a dominant end-to-end bottleneck. Existing KV compression are typically static runtime configurations, despite production service context varies over time in workload mix, bandwidth, and SLO/quality budg

summary.core_problem: 在 PD 分离与 KV 远端化的解耦式 LLM serving 中，KV cache 从“GPU 内部状态”变成跨网络/存储边界传输的显式 payload，通信带宽成为端到端瓶颈；而现有 KV 压缩通常是静态配置，无法随在线服务上下文（带宽、workload 结构、SLO/质量预算）变化自适应选择，导致在某些场景下不但不降延迟，反而出现负优化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作主要是 serving 系统贡献，不是预训练方法论文；但它对基座研究的间接价值在于：长上下文与 agentic workload 会把 KV 体量与带宽压力推到“系统主导”的量级，进而反向约束模型侧的设计（上下文长度策略、KV 结构/精度、长上下文训练与推理预算）。它把 KV 压缩从“选一个算法”提升为“受约束的策略选择问题”，给后续做端到端 co-design（模型结构/量化友好 KV、训练时对 KV 量化鲁棒性）提供了更清晰的接口。
summary.technical_approach:
KVServe 的核心是把分散的 KV 压缩方法抽象成可组合的模块化流水线，并在此之上做离线搜索 + 在线自适应控制。
1) 统一抽象与策略空间：将 KV 压缩拆成若干可插拔组件（如变换/预处理、量化粒度与位宽、编码/codec 等），把 CacheGen/KIVI/KVQuant 等代表方法“解耦重组”，并额外引入作者设计的新量化组件，使得不同方法的部件可以复用与组合，形成可枚举的策略集合。
2) Bayesian Profiling Engine：策略空间组合爆炸，端到端 profiling 成本高。用贝叶斯优化在离线阶段选择少量高价值候选进行 profiling，以显著减少需要跑的配置数；论文声称将离线搜索开销从约 1000 小时量级降到约 20 小时量级。
3) Service-Aware Online Controller：在线阶段感知服务上下文（workload、有效带宽、SLO/质量预算等），从离线候选中快速选取策略。控制器结合解析延迟模型（用于快速估算与约束）+ 轻量 bandit（用于修正离线 profiling 与线上真实运行的偏差/漂移），支持策略切换并避免因环境变化导致的负优化。
4) 系统集成：集成进 vLLM 推理流水线，面向 PD-separated 与 KV-disaggregated 两类解耦架构评估。
summary.experiments:
论文在端到端实验中指出 KV 通信可占 job completion time 的最高约 60%。在效果上，作者报告：
- 在 PD-separated serving 场景，相比 baseline 与若干 SOTA KV 压缩方法，最高可达 9.13× 的 JCT 降低。
- 在 KV-disaggregated serving 场景，最高可达 32.8× 的 TTFT 降低。
引言还给出若干量级例子用于说明瓶颈强度：如 Llama 3.1-70B 在 128K token 时 KV 约 39.06GB；以及某些大模型长输入场景下 prefill 集群对 KV egress 带宽需求可达 Tbps 量级，而常见跨集群带宽远低于此（<100Gbps）。这些数字主要用于动机与系统约束刻画。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Sec.2.2（或对应的动机章节）里“静态配置为何会切换最优/产生负优化”的测量与例子，这是把问题从算法选择变成策略选择的关键。
- 重点看系统抽象图（KV 压缩流水线的模块划分）和策略空间如何枚举；这决定了它能否真正复用现有方法而不是“重新实现一个压缩”。
- 看 Bayesian profiling 的目标函数、约束与采样策略：它决定离线成本是否可信，以及是否会偏向某类 workload。
- 看在线控制器的解析延迟模型假设、bandit 的反馈信号与切换开销处理；这里最容易出现工程上“论文可行、线上难用”的落差。
- 结果部分优先看：不同带宽/不同 workload mix 下的策略切换曲线与鲁棒性，而不只是峰值倍数。

summary_en.core_problem: In disaggregated LLM serving (prefill/decode separation and remote/disaggregated KV state), the KV cache becomes an explicit payload crossing network/storage boundaries, turning KV transfer into a dominant end-to-end bottleneck. Existing KV compression methods are typically configured statically, but the latency-optimal configuration depends on the live service context (workload mix, effective bandwidth, and SLO/quality budgets). A fixed choice can therefore be suboptimal or even increase latency (negative optimization).
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving-systems paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical: long-context and agentic workloads can make KV bandwidth the limiting factor, which in turn constrains model-side choices (context length policies, KV precision/structure, and robustness to KV quantization). The paper reframes KV compression from “pick an algorithm” to a constrained, context-dependent strategy selection problem, which is a useful interface for future model–system co-design (e.g., training-time robustness to KV quantization or KV-friendly architectures).
summary_en.technical_approach:
KVServe combines (i) a modular abstraction of KV compression into a composable pipeline, (ii) efficient offline search over a combinatorial strategy space, and (iii) an online controller that adapts to changing service conditions.
1) Modular strategy space: it decomposes representative KV compression methods into plug-and-play components (e.g., transforms/preprocessing, quantization schemes and granularities, codecs), enabling cross-method reuse and composition; the authors also introduce a new quantization component.
2) Bayesian Profiling Engine: because exhaustive end-to-end profiling is infeasible, it uses Bayesian optimization to select a small set of promising configurations to profile offline, reportedly reducing search cost from ~1000 hours to ~20 hours.
3) Service-aware online control: at runtime, it senses service context and selects an optimal profile from offline candidates under SLO/quality constraints. It combines an analytical latency model (fast constraint-aware selection) with a lightweight bandit mechanism to correct offline/online mismatch and handle drift, enabling robust switching.
4) Integration: implemented in the vLLM pipeline and evaluated for both PD-separated and KV-disaggregated serving architectures.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports that KV communication can account for up to ~60% of job completion time in their end-to-end measurements. Claimed improvements include:
- Up to 9.13× JCT reduction for PD-separated serving versus baselines and prior KV compression methods.
- Up to 32.8× TTFT reduction for KV-disaggregated serving.
Motivating scale examples include ~39.06GB KV for Llama 3.1-70B at 128K tokens, and Tbps-level KV egress demand in large-model long-input settings, contrasted with typical cross-cluster bandwidth limits (<100Gbps) and remote storage throughput constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the motivation/measurement section that demonstrates regime switches and negative optimization under static configs; this is the key problem statement.
- Focus on the pipeline abstraction figure and how strategies are enumerated/composed across prior methods.
- Read the Bayesian profiling objective and sampling procedure to judge whether the offline cost and coverage are realistic.
- Inspect the online controller: assumptions in the analytical latency model, the bandit feedback signal, and how switching overhead is handled.
- In results, prioritize robustness across bandwidth/workload regimes and strategy-switching behavior over peak “×” numbers.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和 profiling 部分即可；它不改预训练方法，但会影响长上下文模型的服务侧真实成本模型。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and profiling sections; it does not change pretraining, but it updates the real serving cost model for long-context LMs.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散世界模型在长时 rollout 中，KV-cache 线性增长导致无法同时保持实时性和世界一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率与长时记忆管理问题。虽然对象是视频世界模型，不是文本LLM，但其中的 cache 检索与压缩思路对长上下文推理、外部记忆和 KV 管理有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldKV，包含两部分：World Retrieval 将被驱逐的 KV chunk 存入 GPU/CPU，并根据相机/动作对应关系选择性取回插回原生 attention window；World Compression 则基于 key-key similarity 相对 anchor frame 剪除冗余 token，把每个 chunk 的存储压到约一半。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示在 Matrix-Game-2.0 等环境上验证，目标是在固定预算下保留更长历史并维持世界一致性，同时满足实时约束；但这是视频扩散推理系统实验，不是语言模型标准长上下文基准。
summary.authors_note: 作者中 Sangdoo Yun 在高效模型与视觉生成方向有一定代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the inability of autoregressive video diffusion world models to maintain both real-time throughput and persistent world consistency as KV-cache grows linearly with rollout length.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and long-horizon memory-management paper. The target is video world models rather than text LLMs, but the cache retrieval and compression ideas are transferable to long-context inference and external memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV has two parts: World Retrieval stores evicted KV chunks in GPU/CPU memory and selectively retrieves scene-relevant chunks using camera/action correspondence, while World Compression prunes redundant tokens within each chunk via key-key similarity to an anchor frame, roughly halving storage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on environments such as Matrix-Game-2.0, aiming to preserve longer history under a fixed memory budget while maintaining world consistency and real-time constraints. The setup is a video diffusion inference system rather than a standard language long-context benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: Sangdoo Yun is a recognizable researcher in efficient models and vision generation.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本LLM，但‘驱逐后可检索KV’这个思路值得借到长上下文 serving；看 retrieval 条件和压缩准则就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a text LLM paper, but the retrievable-evicted-KV idea is worth borrowing for long-context serving; read the retrieval trigger and compression rule, then move on.

paper.title: SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly constrained by the KV cache: resident memory grows with context length, and decoding becomes limited by repeated High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) streaming rather than arithmetic. Existing methods such as eviction, windowing, quantization, and offloading reduce footprint, but often leave the critical-path bottleneck only partially addressed, especially when compressed states must still be reconstructed into dense vectors during decoding.   We present Spherical K

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理时，瓶颈从 FLOPs 转向 KV cache 的容量与 HBM 带宽：KV 线性随上下文增长，解码阶段每 token 都要反复流式读取大量 KV 页面，导致吞吐下降、可用 batch/context 受限。论文要解决的是：在不显著破坏生成行为稳定性（输出长度、推理轨迹、终止行为）的前提下，如何同时降低 KV 常驻内存与每 token 的 HBM 读写，并且方法要能落到 paged/ragged KV 的生产栈与可融合 kernel 上。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理/Serving 侧，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的间接价值在于：它把“KV 表示”当作可压缩信号，强调 rate–distortion 视角与 kernel 现实（不可融合的压缩等于没省），这会反过来影响长上下文训练与评测的设计（例如：训练时是否要考虑 KV 压缩带来的行为漂移、以及长上下文能力是否应在受限 KV 表示下定义）。但如果你的关注点是预训练目标/数据/训练动态，它的相关性有限。
summary.technical_approach:
从全文开头部分能确认的技术路线是：提出一种“角度域注意力（Angle-domain attention）+ rate–distortion retention”的 KV 表示/保留方案，目标是在压缩 KV 的同时避免传统量化/压缩带来的‘重建税’（解包/反量化/重建 dense 向量导致 kernel 不可融合、HBM 压力回潮）。作者明确把部署约束写进设计目标：
- 兼容 paged/block-allocated KV（PagedAttention 抽象），支持 ragged batch；
- 尽量 block-local，避免不规则 gather；
- 避免需要 dense materialization 的变换，保证可走高效 attention kernel 路径。
此外，作者把现有 KV 方法分成三类杠杆：少存 token（窗口/重点击/一次性压缩）、少存 bit（量化/压缩）、存到别处（offload/reuse），并强调真正决定端到端收益的是第四个约束：kernel/serving 兼容性。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的全文片段主要是问题定义与系统约束梳理，尚未包含方法细节、实验设置与具体数字（如：在多长上下文、哪个模型、KV 节省比例、吞吐提升、困惑度/任务分数变化、以及生成稳定性指标）。因此无法基于现有内容给出可靠的定量结论或消融洞察。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（15–25 分钟，偏系统读法）：
1) 先读 1.1–1.2：作者对“HBM bytes 才是 killer”的论证，以及 paged KV/融合 kernel 作为硬约束的立场。
2) 如果你在做长上下文训练或评测，重点看作者如何定义“behavioral stability”（是否跟踪 trace length、终止、推理轨迹漂移），这类指标往往比单点任务分数更能暴露 KV 干预的副作用。
3) 是否值得精读取决于后续章节：如果他们给出了可落地的 cache 格式、端到端 kernel 路径、以及在真实 serving 栈上的 wall-clock 与质量曲线（rate–distortion 曲线），再投入时间逐节看实现与消融；否则把它当作一篇把问题讲清楚的系统化动机文即可。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context autoregressive decoding, the bottleneck shifts from FLOPs to KV-cache capacity and HBM bandwidth. KV grows linearly with context length, and each generated token repeatedly streams large KV pages from HBM, throttling throughput and limiting feasible batch/context. The paper targets a KV representation/retention scheme that reduces both resident KV bytes and per-token IO while preserving behavioral stability (generation length, termination, reasoning traces) and remaining compatible with paged/ragged production KV layouts and fused attention kernels.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference/serving paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its indirect relevance to foundation-model research is the framing: KV as a rate–distortion problem under hard kernel constraints (“savings that cannot be fused do not count”). That perspective can influence how long-context capability is trained and evaluated—e.g., whether long-context behavior should be robust under constrained/compact KV representations. If your focus is data, objectives, scaling laws, or training dynamics, the direct payoff is limited.
summary_en.experiments: The excerpt available is largely motivation and systems constraints; it does not include the core algorithmic details, experimental setup, or quantitative results (KV reduction ratios, throughput gains, quality deltas, or stability metrics). With the current content, a faithful numeric summary is not possible.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (15–25 minutes) as a systems-oriented read:
1) Read Sections 1.1–1.2 for the argument that HBM traffic dominates and for the “paged KV + fusion” constraints.
2) If you work on long-context training/evaluation, pay attention to how they propose measuring behavioral stability (trace length, termination, reasoning drift), since KV interventions often change generation dynamics.
3) Decide whether to deep-read based on later sections: it becomes worth time only if they provide a concrete cache format, an end-to-end kernel path, and wall-clock vs quality rate–distortion curves on realistic serving stacks.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和误差分析；若角度域attention真能绕开dense重构，长上下文serving的瓶颈模型要重算。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and error analysis; if angle-domain attention really avoids dense reconstruction, long-context serving cost models change.

paper.title: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
paper.abstract: The rapid advancement toward long-context reasoning and multi-modal intelligence has made the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck for efficient deployment. While the established per-channel quantization effectively accommodates intrinsic channel-wise outliers in Key tensors, its efficacy diminishes under extreme compression. In this work, we revisit the inherent limitations of the per-channel quantization paradigm from both empirical and theoretical perspect

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论极低比特 KV cache 量化中的一个具体瓶颈：per-channel Key 量化在 INT2 这类强压缩下失效，不只是因为 channel outlier，而是因为不同 token 的 Key/Value 范数差异过大。作者把这个现象定义为 Token Norm Imbalance，简称 TNI。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的启发在于：长上下文和多模态模型的部署瓶颈会反过来约束模型设计，尤其是 KV cache 的统计分布。论文把 KV 量化误差从 channel outlier 重新定位到 token-wise norm imbalance，有助于理解为什么一些训练后量化方法在短上下文或中等比特下有效，但在极低比特、长上下文、多模态输入下不稳。
summary.technical_approach: OScaR 是一个 training-free 的 KV cache 量化框架，目标是在不引入复杂辅助模块的情况下改善极低比特量化。方法有两个核心步骤。第一步是 Canalized Rotation，用 Hadamard transform 先旋转 Key/Value 表示，避免后续 token scaling 把局部大值放大成新的 outlier，作者称为 Scaling-Induced Outlier Artifacts。第二步是 Omni-Token Scaling，对序列维度做归一化，缓解不同 token 范数差异带来的共享量化参数失配。它不是放弃 per-channel 量化，而是在 per-channel 框架前后加入轻量的 token 归一化和旋转，使量化尺度同时适配 channel outlier 和 token norm imbalance。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在 text-only、multi-modal、omni-modal LLM 上评测，并在 INT2 KV cache 量化下保持接近无损的性能。全文片段中没有给出完整表格数字，但作者强调 OScaR 相比依赖额外参数、在线校正或复杂补偿机制的方法，有更低计算开销，并配套实现了 CUDA kernel。关键实验应包括：TNI 与量化误差的相关性分析、per-channel 量化在极低比特下的退化、Canalized Rotation 与 Omni-Token Scaling 的消融，以及不同模态模型上的吞吐和显存对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 TNI 的实证分析和理论推导，再看 OScaR 的两个组件消融。系统实现部分适合做 serving 或长上下文推理的人细读。对预训练研究员来说，重点不是具体 CUDA 优化，而是 KV cache 中 token-wise norm 分布是否可以在训练阶段被正则化或通过架构设计改善。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in extreme low-bit KV-cache quantization. Per-channel Key quantization works reasonably well when channel-wise outliers dominate, but degrades under INT2-level compression because tokens can have highly imbalanced norms. The authors name this property Token Norm Imbalance, or TNI.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that long-context and multimodal deployment constraints expose representation statistics that are often ignored during training. The main useful idea is the shift from viewing Key quantization only through channel outliers to analyzing token-wise norm imbalance, which may explain why some post-training quantization methods fail in long-context or multimodal settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: OScaR is a training-free KV-cache quantization method. It keeps the per-channel quantization paradigm but adds two lightweight operations. First, Canalized Rotation applies a Hadamard transform to reduce scaling-induced outlier artifacts before token scaling. Second, Omni-Token Scaling normalizes sequence-level token norms so that shared quantization parameters are less affected by TNI. The design avoids extra learned parameters and heavy online correction mechanisms, aiming for a simpler path to INT2 KV quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports evaluations across text-only, multimodal, and omni-modal LLMs, with near-lossless behavior under INT2 KV-cache quantization. Exact tables are not available in the supplied content. The important experimental axes are likely the empirical link between TNI and quantization error, degradation of vanilla per-channel quantization at extreme bit widths, ablations of rotation and token scaling, and comparisons of memory, latency, and throughput with more complex KV-quantization baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the TNI analysis, the error-amplification argument, and the ablation of Canalized Rotation versus Omni-Token Scaling. The CUDA and kernel sections are most relevant for serving work. For pretraining researchers, the interesting question is whether token-norm imbalance can be shaped during training rather than repaired only at inference time.

recommendation.zh: 只看 TNI 分析和极低比特消融；若结论成立，KV 量化瓶颈不应再只盯 channel outlier。
recommendation.en: Read the TNI analysis and low-bit ablations; if the result holds, KV quantization should not be framed only around channel outliers.

paper.title: Rotation-Aligned Key Channel Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models suffer severe KV cache pressure at inference, as a single image often encodes into thousands of tokens. Most existing methods exploit token sparsity through token pruning, but permanently discarding visual content causes substantial degradation on fine-grained perception tasks. This motivates a complementary axis, feature sparsity: under a fixed KV cache budget, compressing the channel dimension preserves more visual tokens at the same memory cost. Prior Key channel prunin

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 VLM 推理时视觉 KV cache 过大的问题。视觉输入通常被编码成数百到数千个 token，图像、视频和多图场景会让 KV cache 成为主要显存瓶颈。现有方法多做视觉 token pruning，但直接丢 token 会伤害文档理解、细粒度感知和 grounding 等任务。作者转向另一个压缩轴：在保留更多视觉 token 的同时压缩 Key 的 channel 维度。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，主要属于多模态推理效率。但它对 native multimodal 预训练有间接启发：如果视觉 token 数量在服务侧可以通过结构化 Key channel 压缩承载，预训练阶段就不必只围绕少量视觉 token 设计模型接口；长图、多图和视频输入的 token budget 也可以重新评估。它还提醒一个工程事实：VLM 的瓶颈不只有 token 数，channel 维度的冗余同样可以利用。
summary.technical_approach: RotateK 的核心是把原始 Key 表示旋转到一个更适合结构化裁剪的正交基中。直接做 token-wise channel pruning 表达力强，因为每个 token 的重要 channel 可以不同，但 mask 大小是 O(Ld)，解码时 IO 和 kernel 实现都不友好。Head-wise pruning 只需 O(d) mask，硬件友好，但因为无法刻画 token 间差异，在高压缩率下容易掉精度。RotateK 的思路是：token 相关的重要性在原始坐标系里看起来分散，但经过合适的正交变换后，可以对齐到共享低维子空间。具体做法是用 query-weighted PCA 在线估计旋转，把与查询相关的 Key 信息集中到少量 channel，再用共享的结构化 channel mask 裁剪。为了降低在线 PCA 成本，作者使用 Cholesky-based subspace iteration；为了让稀疏 channel 真正带来解码收益，还实现了面向结构化稀疏 Key 的 Triton kernel。
summary.experiments: 给出的正文显示，作者比较了 token-only pruning、传统 head-wise Key pruning、token-wise Key pruning 与 RotateK。实验结论是 RotateK 在固定 KV cache budget 下能保留更多视觉 token，并比纯 token pruning 更稳，尤其适合信息分散的细粒度视觉任务；它也缩小了高效 head-wise pruning 与高表达 token-wise pruning 之间的精度差距。Motivational Study 中通过 Key tensor 可视化说明 VLM 继承了 LLM 中由 RoPE 与 Key projection 交互产生的 channel outlier，但少数全局 outlier 不足以支撑鲁棒压缩，因此需要旋转对齐的共享子空间。论文还提供了长上下文 VLM 推理下的显存和延迟分析，以及自定义 Triton kernel 的加速讨论。给出的正文片段没有包含完整 benchmark 数字，不能补写具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 15 到 25 分钟。先看 Figure 1，理解 token pruning 与 channel pruning 在同一 KV budget 下的取舍。再看 Figure 2 的 Key outlier 和 mask 对比，它解释了为什么原始坐标下 head-wise pruning 不够好。方法部分重点看 query-weighted PCA 的目标函数、旋转矩阵如何在线估计、裁剪后 attention score 的扰动如何控制。系统部分重点看 Cholesky subspace iteration 和 Triton kernel，因为 channel pruning 若不能转成真实 kernel 收益，价值会大打折扣。对预训练研究员来说，重点不是复现实验，而是理解视觉 token 数、Key channel 维度和服务成本之间的约束关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the KV-cache bottleneck in VLM inference. Visual inputs often produce hundreds to thousands of tokens, and multi-image or video inputs can make the visual KV cache dominate memory usage. Token pruning reduces this cost but permanently removes visual content, which hurts fine-grained perception, document understanding, and grounding. The paper therefore compresses another axis: the Key channel dimension.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an efficiency paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but practical. If structured Key-channel compression can preserve more visual tokens under the same serving budget, the design space for native multimodal models changes: visual token count does not have to be constrained only by token pruning or aggressive visual resampling. It also highlights that VLM efficiency is not just a sequence-length problem; feature-dimensional redundancy in KV states can be exploited.
summary_en.technical_approach: RotateK applies an orthogonal rotation to the Key representation so that token-dependent channel importance becomes aligned in a shared low-dimensional subspace. Existing token-wise channel pruning is expressive because each token can keep different channels, but it requires an O(Ld) mask and creates heavy decoding overhead. Head-wise pruning uses a compact O(d) mask and is hardware-friendly, but it loses accuracy at high compression ratios because it cannot model token-level variation. RotateK tries to get the benefits of both. It uses query-weighted PCA to concentrate query-relevant Key information into a shared basis, then prunes channels with a structured head-wise mask. The method reduces attention-score perturbation while keeping the sparsity pattern simple enough for efficient kernels. The implementation uses Cholesky-based subspace iteration to lower online PCA cost and a custom Triton kernel to make structured sparse channels useful during decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text indicates comparisons against token-only pruning, conventional head-wise Key pruning, and token-wise Key pruning. RotateK is reported to preserve more visual tokens under a fixed KV-cache budget and to be more robust than token-only pruning on fine-grained visual understanding settings. It also narrows the accuracy gap between efficient head-wise pruning and more expressive token-wise pruning. The motivation study visualizes Key-channel outliers in VLMs and argues that these outliers likely arise from the interaction between RoPE and learned Key projections, as in LLMs. However, globally dominant channels are too few for robust compression, motivating the rotation-aligned shared subspace. The paper also includes memory and latency analysis for long-context VLM inference and discusses acceleration through a Triton kernel. Complete benchmark numbers are not available in the supplied text, so exact gains should not be fabricated.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 15 to 25 minutes. Start with Figure 1 to understand the budget trade-off between dropping visual tokens and compressing Key channels. Then read the motivation study and Figure 2, which show why raw-coordinate head-wise pruning is too rigid. In the method section, focus on the query-weighted PCA objective, how the rotation is estimated online, and how attention-score perturbation is controlled after pruning. The systems section is important: Cholesky subspace iteration and the Triton kernel determine whether the method produces real latency benefits rather than only memory savings. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is the interaction between visual token budgets, KV-cache channel redundancy, and feasible multimodal context length.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当“新模型”，当成 VLM KV 压力的工程解法：重点看旋转对齐+结构化 mask 是否真比纯 token pruning 稳。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a KV-cache engineering fix, not a modeling paper; focus on whether rotation-aligned structured masks actually beat pure token pruning on fine-grained tasks.

paper.title: Echo-Forcing: A Scene Memory Framework for Interactive Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable open-ended generation through local attention and KV caching. However, existing training-free long-video optimization methods mainly focus on stable extension under a single prompt, making them difficult to handle interactive scenarios involving prompt switching, old scene forgetting, and historical scene recall. We identify the core bottleneck as the functional entanglement of historical KV states: stable anchors and recent dynamics are handled by th

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式长视频生成中 prompt 切换、旧场景遗忘、历史场景召回和背景污染之间的冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成中的训练免费记忆框架。它把视频扩展问题从单 prompt 稳定续写扩展到交互式场景管理，和 AR video diffusion 的 KV cache 使用有关，但对 LLM 预训练方法论影响较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Echo-Forcing，将历史 KV 状态拆成稳定锚点、压缩历史和近期窗口三类记忆。核心机制包括 Hierarchical Temporal Memory、Scene Recall Frames，以及在 relative RoPE 下管理长程 scene memory，避免同一 cache policy 同时承担稳定背景和近期动态。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模、数据集和量化提升。论文声称面向 autoregressive video diffusion models 的交互式长视频生成，并与已有 training-free long-video optimization 方法比较，重点评估 prompt switching、scene forgetting 和 long-range recall。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses prompt switching, old-scene forgetting, historical scene recall, and background contamination in interactive long-video generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free memory framework for multimodal generation. It extends long-video optimization from stable continuation under a single prompt to interactive scene management. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, though it touches AR video diffusion and KV-cache behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Echo-Forcing separates historical KV states into stable anchors, compressed history, and recent windows. Its mechanisms include hierarchical temporal memory, scene recall frames, and long-range scene memory under relative RoPE, avoiding one cache policy being responsible for both stable background and recent dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, dataset details, or numerical gains. The paper targets autoregressive video diffusion models and compares against training-free long-video optimization methods on prompt switching, scene forgetting, and long-range recall.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道它怎样拆 KV 记忆角色；视频生成细节对 pretrain 价值有限，不必读完整实验。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for how it separates KV memory roles; the video-generation specifics have limited pretraining value, so no need to read the full experiments.

paper.title: DealMaTe: Multi-Dimensional Material Transfer via Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: Recently, diffusion-based material transfer methods rely on image fine-tuning or complex architectures with auxiliary networks but face challenges such as text dependency, additional computational costs, and feature misalignment. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{DealMaTe}, using \underline{\textbf{de}}pth, norm\underline{\textbf{a}}l, and \underline{\textbf{l}}ighting images for \underline{\textbf{ma}}terial \underline{\textbf{t}}ransf\underline{\textbf{e}}r. DealMaTe is a simpli

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion material transfer 对文本提示、参考网络和复杂辅助结构依赖较强，导致条件不稳、特征错位和推理开销偏高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像/材质生成方法改进：用几何和光照条件替代文本引导，并通过轻量 LoRA 和注意力改造降低多条件控制成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DealMaTe，使用 depth、normal、lighting 图作为材料迁移条件；设计 Multi-Dim 3D Shader LoRA，在不改 base model 权重的情况下接入兼容控制信号；再用 Shader Causal Mutual Attention 和 KV caching 减少多条件推理延迟。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练数据规模、backbone、baseline 和定量指标；声称相比依赖图像微调、文本或参考网络的方法，结果更协调稳定，并改善多条件推理效率。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua University、Pengcheng Laboratory、National Cheng-Kung University、Great Bay University 等；这是图形与视觉生成方向工作，不是通用多模态基座预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses diffusion-based material transfer methods that depend on text prompts, reference networks, or complex auxiliary modules, causing unstable control, feature misalignment, and higher inference cost.
summary_en.importance: It is an image/material-generation method contribution: geometry and lighting conditions replace text guidance, while lightweight LoRA and attention modifications reduce the cost of multi-condition control.
summary_en.technical_approach: DealMaTe conditions on depth, normal, and lighting images. Multi-Dim 3D Shader LoRA injects compatible 3D control signals without modifying the base model weights, while Shader Causal Mutual Attention and KV caching reduce latency under multiple conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide training scale, backbone details, baselines, or numerical metrics. It claims more harmonious and stable material transfer than methods relying on image fine-tuning, text guidance, or reference networks, with improved inference efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University, Pengcheng Laboratory, National Cheng-Kung University, Great Bay University, and related labs. The work sits in graphics and visual generation rather than foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看条件注入和注意力缓存设计即可；它是图像生成工程改进，不会改变语言建模判断。
recommendation.en: Skim only the condition-injection and attention-caching design; this is an image-generation engineering paper, not a language-modeling signal.

institutions: Dongguan Key Laboratory for Intelligence and Information Technology

paper.title: Minimal-Intervention KV Retention: A Design-Space Study and a Diversity-Penalty Survivor
paper.abstract: KV-cache compression at small budgets is a crowded design space spanning cache representation, head-wise routing, compression cadence, decoding behavior, and within-budget scoring. We study seven mechanisms across these five families under matched mean cache on long-form mathematical reasoning (MATH-500~\cite{hendrycks2021math}) with two distilled-reasoning models (Qwen-7B and Llama-8B variants of DeepSeek-R1-Distill~\cite{deepseek2025r1}) at budgets $b \in \{64, 128\}$. All seven were rejected.

summary.core_problem: 在极小 KV-cache budget 下，长程数学推理的缓存保留策略哪些设计真正有效，哪些只是未控变量下的表面收益。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率设计空间研究和负结果报告；它用 matched mean cache、冻结开发集和独立 held-out split 控制评估，直接针对 KV 压缩论文中常见的不干净比较问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文系统测试七类机制，覆盖 cache representation、head-wise routing、compression cadence、decoding behavior 和 within-budget scoring；在全部未通过后，提出对 TriAttention retention scorer 的单函数修改 α，用带 V-space redundancy penalty 的 greedy facility-location 风格选择替代 argmax top-k，并用单一 λ 控制多样性惩罚。
summary.experiments: 实验在 MATH-500 长程数学推理上进行，使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill 系列的 Qwen-7B 和 Llama-8B 变体，cache budget 为 64 和 128；七个既有机制均被拒绝，λ=0.5 的 α 在四个 model-budget cell 中有两个通过 Bonferroni 校正，且摘要称无 cell 显著变差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies which KV-cache retention mechanisms actually work for long-form mathematical reasoning under very small cache budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency design-space study with useful negative results. Its matched-cache evaluation, frozen development split, and held-out confirmation address a common weakness in KV-compression papers: uncontrolled comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors test seven mechanisms across cache representation, head-wise routing, compression cadence, decoding behavior, and within-budget scoring. After rejecting them, they propose α, a one-function modification to TriAttention that replaces argmax top-k with a greedy facility-location-style selector using a V-space redundancy penalty controlled by λ.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses MATH-500 with Qwen-7B and Llama-8B DeepSeek-R1-Distill variants at cache budgets 64 and 128. All seven tested mechanisms are rejected. With λ=0.5, α passes Bonferroni correction in two of four model-budget cells and reportedly shows no significant regression in any cell.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验协议而不是方法名；§设计空间和 Bonferroni 结果能帮你过滤一批 KV 压缩幻觉收益。
recommendation.en: Read it for the protocol, not the method name; the design-space tests and Bonferroni results are useful for filtering illusory KV-compression gains.

paper.title: CoRDS: Coreset-based Representative and Diverse Selection for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding with large vision-language models (VLMs) requires a compact memory that can support future reasoning over an ever-growing visual history. A common solution is to compress the key-value (KV) cache, but existing streaming methods typically rely on local token-wise heuristics, such as recency, temporal redundancy, or saliency, which do not explicitly optimize whether the retained cache is representative of the accumulated history. We propose to view KV-cache compressio

summary.core_problem: 流式视频理解中VLM的KV缓存压缩依赖局部token级启发式方法（如新近性、时间冗余），未显式优化保留内容是否代表累积视觉历史。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将KV缓存压缩视为coreset选择问题，在联合KV表示空间中做几何覆盖优化。
summary.technical_approach: CoRDS方法：(1)双准则目标平衡key和value空间的覆盖度，同时保留检索结构和输出相关信息；(2)正交性驱动的多样性准则促进保留子集的多样性。
summary.experiments: 在流式视频理解任务上验证，据称优于局部启发式方法。
summary.authors_note: UBC、Vector Institute，Leonid Sigal是资深CV/VLM领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache compression for streaming video understanding with VLMs relies on local token-wise heuristics (recency, temporal redundancy, saliency) that do not explicitly optimize whether retained content represents accumulated visual history.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: reframes KV-cache compression as a coreset selection problem, optimizing geometric coverage in joint KV representation space.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRDS method: (1) bicriteria objective balancing coverage in key and value spaces, preserving both retrieval structure and output-relevant information; (2) orthogonality-driven diversity criterion for diverse retained subsets.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on streaming video understanding tasks, outperforming local heuristic methods.
summary_en.authors_note: UBC, Vector Institute; Leonid Sigal is a well-known researcher in CV/VLM.

recommendation.zh: 将coreset方法应用于KV缓存压缩是新颖视角，但属于视频VLM推理优化，对LLM基座预训练研究员参考价值有限，仅作方法灵感参考。
recommendation.en: Coreset-based KV compression is a novel perspective but limited to video VLM inference optimization; minimal relevance for LLM foundation pretraining; reference for method inspiration only.

paper.title: HeatKV: Head-tuned KV-cache Compression for Visual Autoregressive Modeling
paper.abstract: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models have recently demonstrated impressive image generation quality while maintaining low latency. However, they suffer from severe KV-cache memory constraints, often requiring gigabytes of memory per generated image. We introduce HeatKV, a novel compression method that adapts cache allocation in each head based on its attention to previously generated scales. Using a small offline calibration set, the attention heads are ranked according to their attention scores o

summary.core_problem: 视觉自回归(VAR)模型生成图像时KV缓存内存占用过高，单张生成需数GB内存的问题
summary.importance: 工程创新，提出细粒度头级KV缓存压缩方法
summary.technical_approach: 通过小规模离线校准集按注意力头对先前生成尺度的注意力得分排序，构造适配给定内存预算的静态剪枝策略
summary.experiments: 在Infinity-2B模型上，相比现有方法KV缓存压缩比提升2倍，同时保持图像保真度、prompt对齐度和人类感知得分相当
summary.authors_note: 瑞典隆德大学，无公开知名作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models suffer from extremely high KV-cache memory consumption, requiring gigabytes of memory per generated image
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation, proposes a fine-grained head-level KV-cache compression method
summary_en.technical_approach: Ranks attention heads based on their attention scores over prior generated scales using a small offline calibration set, then constructs a static pruning schedule tailored to given memory budget
summary_en.experiments: On Infinity-2B model, achieves 2x higher KV-cache compression ratio than existing methods, while maintaining comparable image fidelity, prompt alignment and human perception score
summary_en.authors_note: Lund University, Sweden, no publicly known notable authors

recommendation.zh: 纯VAR模型推理侧优化工作，做视觉大模型部署的研究员可参考，预训练研究员无需精读
recommendation.en: Pure inference optimization for VAR models, only researchers working on visual LLM deployment need to reference it, pretrain researchers do not need intensive reading

paper.title: KVPO: ODE-Native GRPO for Autoregressive Video Alignment via KV Semantic Exploration
paper.abstract: Aligning streaming autoregressive (AR) video generators with human preferences is challenging. Existing reinforcement learning methods predominantly rely on noise-based exploration and SDE-based surrogate policies that are mismatched to the deterministic ODE dynamics of distilled AR models, and tend to perturb low-level appearance rather than the high-level semantic storyline progression critical for long-horizon coherence. To address these limitations, we present KVPO, an ODE-native online Grou

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的问题不是通用 LLM 预训练，而是流式自回归视频生成模型的偏好对齐。更具体地说，作者关注的是：已经蒸馏成少步、可用 KV-cache 做因果生成的 AR 视频模型，如何在不破坏其原生 ODE/flow-matching 生成动力学的前提下做在线偏好优化。现有做法要么只是 reward-weighted distillation，缺少主动探索；要么把确定性 ODE 过程改写成带噪声的 SDE 来做探索，但这会偏离模型原本的生成轨迹，而且噪声主要扰动低层外观，不一定能探索到长程叙事和语义变化。
summary.importance: 它对纯预训练研究的直接相关性有限，更接近 post-train / alignment for generative video models。但其中有两个点对基座研究仍有启发。第一，作者把探索源从噪声注入转移到 KV-cache 路由，这说明在因果生成模型里，历史记忆本身可以作为策略探索的结构化自由度，而不必总靠 latent noise。第二，作者在 flow-matching 的 velocity field 空间里定义 surrogate policy，而不是借助外部距离度量，这反映出一个更一般的思路：如果生成模型有明确的原生动力学，偏好优化最好在该动力学空间内完成，而不是强行套用不匹配的 RL 近似。对做 AR+diffusion 联合建模、视频/语音生成对齐的人，这个思路有参考价值；对文本 LLM 预训练本身，启发较间接。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 Causal History Routing，简称 CHR。流式 AR 视频生成通常按 block 逐段生成，每一段都依赖历史视频内容的 KV cache。作者认为，未来视频内容的高层语义和叙事走向，很大程度由历史上下文决定，因此如果想做有意义的探索，不应在 latent 上加噪，而应对历史 KV 的组成方式做分支化采样。具体做法是：保持 sink cache 不变，用它维持全局锚点；对 local cache 做随机路由，在固定槽位布局下，对部分较早历史帧进行分支式选择，而最近几帧保持不变。这样每个分支都仍然建立在真实历史上，探索发生在因果语义层面，而不是低层像素噪声层面。作者强调这种探索是 on-manifold 的，因为没有把采样过程改写成额外随机扩散。

第二部分是 ODE-native surrogate policy。现有 NeighborGRPO 一类方法用样本间欧氏距离近似 surrogate policy，隐含假设是生成空间几何比较均匀。作者认为这对视频生成不合适，因为不同 latent 维度对策略概率的贡献并不均匀。于是他们转向 flow-matching 的 velocity field 空间，定义了 Trajectory Velocity Energy，简称 TVE，用来衡量当前策略在原生 ODE 动力学下复现某个分支轨迹的相对可能性。基于 TVE 构造 Gibbs 形式的 surrogate policy，再结合组内相对奖励，得到 reward-weighted contrastive flow-matching objective。这样做的关键点在于：偏好优化目标直接作用在模型原本学习的速度场上，而不是在外部样本距离或 SDE 转移核上做近似。

从方法取舍上看，这篇论文的逻辑是清楚的：如果模型原本是 few-step distilled AR video generator，且推理依赖 causal attention 与 KV cache，那么探索和优化都应尽量利用这两个结构，而不是引入与原模型不一致的随机机制。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕多个 distilled AR 视频生成器展开，评测场景包括单提示短视频和多提示长视频。作者报告 KVPO 在人类偏好对齐上优于 reward-weighted distillation、噪声驱动探索方法以及基于邻域距离的 ODE 优化方法。全文可见的核心结论是：CHR 带来的分支更偏向语义和叙事差异，而不是仅仅改变纹理或局部外观；TVE surrogate policy 比欧氏距离 surrogate 更能稳定反映分支优劣。

不过，从当前给出的全文片段看，具体数值、模型规模、训练步数、视频长度、奖励模型配置等细节没有完整展开，因此不适合在这里复述未经确认的数字。更值得注意的是实验设计意图：作者不仅比较最终偏好分数，还试图区分不同探索机制产生的分支类型，强调“噪声探索偏低层，KV 路由探索偏高层语义”。如果读原文，建议重点核对这部分可视化和消融，因为这是方法成立的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看 Introduction、Method 和消融实验。先抓住两个问题：为什么 SDE/noise exploration 不适合 few-step distilled AR video generator；为什么 KV cache 可以成为更自然的探索变量。然后看 CHR 的 cache 结构设计，尤其是 sink/local 的分工，以及哪些历史帧被固定、哪些被路由。接着看 TVE surrogate policy 的定义，理解它如何把分支轨迹映射成 Gibbs 权重。

如果只想判断是否值得进一步跟进，45 分钟左右足够。真正值得读细的是消融：去掉 CHR、改回噪声探索、把 TVE 换成欧氏距离 surrogate 后，长视频一致性和偏好分数怎么变。对做文本 LLM 的人，不必深究视频细节，但可以留意它对“在模型原生状态空间里做对齐”这件事的处理方式。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not about core LLM pretraining; it addresses preference alignment for streaming autoregressive video generators. More specifically, it asks how to perform online policy optimization for few-step distilled AR video models without breaking their native ODE / flow-matching formulation. Existing approaches either rely on reward-weighted distillation with weak exploration, or convert the deterministic ODE process into an SDE with injected noise, which can distort the model’s original generation dynamics and mostly perturbs low-level appearance rather than long-horizon semantics.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to language-model pretraining is limited, but it contains two ideas that are still useful for foundation-model researchers. First, it shifts exploration from latent noise to KV-cache routing. That suggests a broader principle: in causal generative models, historical memory can itself be a structured exploration variable. Second, it defines the surrogate policy inside the model’s native flow-matching velocity-field space rather than through an external distance metric. That is a meaningful alignment design choice: if a generator has a well-defined native dynamical space, preference optimization may work better when formulated there instead of being forced into a mismatched RL approximation. This is more relevant to AR+diffusion hybrids, video generation, and possibly speech generation than to text-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Causal History Routing (CHR). Streaming AR video generation proceeds block by block, and each new block depends on a historical KV cache. The authors argue that meaningful exploration should happen through alternative uses of historical context rather than through noise injection in latent space. In CHR, the sink cache is kept fixed to preserve global anchors, while the local cache is stochastically routed to create branch-specific contexts. The most recent frames remain fixed, while earlier local-memory slots are selectively varied across branches. This is intended to produce semantically different but causally grounded continuations. The key claim is that such exploration stays on-manifold because it does not alter the generator into a stochastic diffusion process.

The second component is an ODE-native surrogate policy. Prior ODE-based GRPO variants such as NeighborGRPO approximate the surrogate policy using Euclidean distances between generated samples. The authors argue that this assumes an overly uniform geometry in latent space and may not reflect the model’s actual preference structure. They instead define Trajectory Velocity Energy (TVE) in the flow-matching velocity-field space, measuring how likely the current policy is to reproduce a branch trajectory under the native ODE dynamics. A Gibbs-form surrogate policy is then built from TVE, and combined with group-relative rewards to form a reward-weighted contrastive flow-matching objective. The main design choice is clear: preference optimization is embedded directly into the model’s learned velocity field rather than imposed through external sample-space geometry or SDE transition kernels.

Methodologically, the paper is internally consistent. If the base model is a few-step distilled AR video generator with causal attention and KV caching, then both exploration and optimization are designed to exploit exactly those structures.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are conducted on multiple distilled AR video generators, covering both single-prompt short-video and multi-prompt long-video settings. The reported outcome is that KVPO improves human-preference alignment over reward-weighted distillation baselines, noise-driven exploration methods, and ODE-based methods using neighborhood-distance surrogates. The qualitative claim is that CHR produces branch diversity at the semantic and narrative level, while noise injection mostly changes texture or local appearance. The TVE-based surrogate is also claimed to better reflect branch quality than Euclidean-distance approximations.

From the provided full-text excerpt, however, the exact numerical results, model sizes, training budgets, and reward-model details are not fully visible, so it would be unsafe to restate specific numbers without the complete tables. The more important point is the experimental logic: the paper tries to show not only better final preference scores, but also that the source of exploration matters. If you read the original, the key evidence to verify is in the ablations and visual comparisons that separate semantic exploration from low-level perturbation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read the Introduction, Method, and ablations. Start with two questions: why SDE/noise-based exploration is a poor fit for few-step distilled AR video generators, and why the KV cache is a more natural exploration handle. Then inspect the CHR design, especially the sink/local cache split and which historical frames are fixed versus routed. After that, read the TVE surrogate-policy definition carefully to understand how branch trajectories are converted into Gibbs-style policy weights.

Roughly 45 minutes is enough for a useful pass. The most important part to check is the ablation section: what happens when CHR is removed, when noise exploration is restored, or when TVE is replaced by a Euclidean-distance surrogate. For text-LLM researchers, the video-specific details are secondary; the transferable idea is how alignment is formulated inside the model’s native state space.

recommendation.zh: 将RL对齐方法从文本拓展到视频生成，核心insight是用KV缓存而非噪声做探索，这对多模态RL有启发，建议读§3方法section了解机制。
recommendation.en: Extends RL alignment from text to video generation; core insight uses KV cache instead of noise for exploration, informative for multimodal RL; read §3 for mechanism.

paper.title: Head Forcing: Long Autoregressive Video Generation via Head Heterogeneity
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models support real-time synthesis but suffer from error accumulation and context loss over long horizons. We discover that attention heads in AR video diffusion transformers serve functionally distinct roles as local heads for detail refinement, anchor heads for structural stabilization, and memory heads for long-range context aggregation, yet existing methods treat them uniformly, leading to suboptimal KV cache allocation. We propose Head Forcing, a training-free

summary.core_problem: 自回归视频扩散模型生成长序列时存在误差累积、上下文丢失问题，现有方法对所有注意力头统一处理导致KV缓存分配不合理，限制生成长度。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次发现AR视频扩散Transformer注意力头的功能异质性，提出无额外训练的长序列生成优化框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Head Forcing框架，将注意力头划分为局部细节头、结构锚点头、长程记忆头三类，分别配置定制化KV缓存策略，记忆头采用分层动态更新的内存系统，同时增加头级RoPE重编码保证位置编码落在预训练范围内。
summary.experiments: 无需额外训练，将原模型生成时长从5秒提升至分钟级，支持多提示交互合成，效果保持稳定。
summary.authors_note: 西湖大学AGI实验室、加州大学默塞德分校团队，无公开知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive video diffusion models suffer from error accumulation and context loss during long-sequence generation, existing methods treat all attention heads uniformly leading to suboptimal KV cache allocation, limiting generation length.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first discovers functional heterogeneity of attention heads in AR video diffusion transformers, proposes a training-free long-sequence generation optimization framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Head Forcing framework, divides attention heads into three categories: local detail heads, structure anchor heads, long-range memory heads, assigns tailored KV cache strategies for each type, memory heads adopt hierarchical dynamic memory system, adds head-wise RoPE re-encoding to ensure positional encodings stay within pretrained range.
summary_en.experiments: Without extra training, extends generation duration from 5 seconds to minute level, supports multi-prompt interactive synthesis with stable performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Westlake University AGI Lab, University of California Merced, no public notable authors.

recommendation.zh: 注意力头功能异质性的观察有微弱参考价值，仅看头分类相关实验部分即可，无复现必要。
recommendation.en: The observation of attention head functional heterogeneity has weak reference value, only read head classification related experiments, no need to reproduce.

institutions: ing inherent scalability to extended durations and enabling real-time streaming
on AR video DiTs for long, controllable video generation that allocates KV

paper.title: Pyramid Forcing: Head-Aware Pyramid KV Cache Policy for High-Quality Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation enables streaming and open-ended long video synthesis, but still suffers from long-term degradation caused by accumulated errors. Existing KVCache strategies usually apply unified historical-frame retention, implicitly assuming homogeneous historical dependencies across attention heads. We revisit historical-frame attention and reveal three distinct head types: Anchor Heads require broad long-range context, Wave Heads exhibit periodic temporal dependencies, and Ve

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频生成中的长程退化问题：生成时间变长后，外观漂移、运动变弱、身份模糊会逐步积累。作者指出，问题不只是历史信息太多或太少，而是现有 KV cache 策略把所有 attention head 当成同一种历史依赖模式处理，导致该保留的长程锚点、周期性运动信息和局部连续性被混在一起压缩。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不强，因为工作对象是自回归视频扩散生成，不是语言模型预训练。但它对长上下文建模和推理期记忆压缩有启发：不同 attention head 对历史 token 的使用方式可能高度异质，统一的滑窗、sink token 或重要性采样策略会损失结构化依赖。对研究长上下文 LM、KV cache 压缩、流式生成和多模态 AR 生成的人，可以把它看作一个 head-aware cache policy 的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Pyramid Forcing，核心是先识别 head 类型，再给不同 head 分配不同的历史帧缓存策略。作者把历史依赖模式分成三类：Anchor Heads 需要宽范围长程上下文，用来稳定外观和身份；Wave Heads 对历史帧呈周期性注意力波动，更像是在跟踪运动节律；Veil Heads 对近期历史注意力较弱，但对初始帧敏感，过多历史反而会遮蔽它们对第一帧的关注。分类阶段采用小规模 calibration set，结合 sign-rate statistics 和频域周期性来做 offline head classification。策略阶段，Anchor Heads 使用 strided retention 覆盖长历史，Wave Heads 使用 period-aligned sampling 保留周期相关帧，Veil Heads 使用 compact local merging 控制历史干扰并保留局部连续性。由于不同 head 的 cache 长度不同，作者还实现了 ragged-cache attention，以支持 head-level heterogeneous KV cache，而不是把所有 head padding 到同一长度。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Self Forcing 和 Causal Forcing 两个自回归视频生成 backbone 上评估，使用 VBench-Long，覆盖 30 秒和 60 秒长视频生成。关键数字是：在 Self Forcing 的 60 秒生成上，总分从 77.87 提升到 81.21。动态程度指标提升更明显，在 Causal Forcing 上最高提升 29.36 分，说明该策略主要缓解了长视频中运动衰减的问题。作者还强调方法同时改善 motion dynamics、visual fidelity 和 semantic consistency，但全文片段中没有给出完整消融表；最值得确认的是三类 head 分类是否稳定、每类 cache policy 的独立贡献，以及 ragged-cache attention 的额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议重点看 Introduction 中对三类 head 的观察，以及方法部分的 Offline Tri-Pattern Head Classification、Pyramid KVCache Policies 和 Heterogeneous KVCache Computation Optimization。图 1 和图 2 是理解问题设定的入口：前者展示长程退化，后者对比统一 cache 与 head-aware cache。实验部分重点看 30 秒、60 秒 VBench-Long 结果和动态程度指标。若关注 LLM 长上下文，可跳过视频生成细节，重点抽取两个问题：head specialization 如何测量，以及异构 cache 如何在工程上避免 padding 浪费。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-horizon degradation in autoregressive video generation. As generation proceeds, appearance drifts, motion weakens, and object identity becomes less stable. The main claim is that existing KV-cache policies treat all attention heads as if they had the same temporal dependency pattern, while heads actually use historical frames in different ways.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is useful for long-context modeling and inference-time memory compression.
