paper.title: Long-Context Aware Upcycling: A New Frontier for Hybrid LLM Scaling
paper.abstract: Hybrid sequence models that combine efficient Transformer components with linear sequence modeling blocks are a promising alternative to pure Transformers, but most are still pretrained from scratch and therefore fail to reuse existing Transformer checkpoints. We study upcycling as a practical path to convert pretrained Transformer LLMs into hybrid architectures while preserving short-context quality and improving long-context capability. We call our solution \emph{HyLo} (HYbrid LOng-context): a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能不能把已经训练好的 Transformer LLM 低成本改造成 hybrid sequence model，在尽量保住原有短上下文能力的同时，真正把长上下文能力拉起来，而不是只在架构上换成线性模块却没有得到可用的 long-context 行为。现有 upcycling 工作大多把目标放在短上下文 perplexity 或常规 benchmark 保持上，对长上下文训练长度、蒸馏方式、推理系统适配都研究得不够。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义比较直接。第一，它把“从头训练新架构”换成“复用现有 checkpoint 再继续训练”，这关系到新架构研究的现实成本边界。第二，它把 long-context preservation 明确设成 upcycling 的一等目标，而不是附带指标，这对以后评估 hybrid 架构很重要。第三，它展示了一个较完整的 recipe：架构替换、初始化、分阶段长上下文训练、teacher-guided distillation、再到 serving 落地。对于做架构演化、continual pretrain、mid-training 的人，这篇文章的价值大于单点模型分数，因为它讨论的是如何把已有 Transformer 资产迁移到更高效的序列建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
HyLo 是一个 long-context-aware upcycling recipe，而不是单一新模块。核心由三部分组成。

第一部分是 hybrid 架构设计。作者用 MLA（Multi-Head Latent Attention）加线性序列模块构成混合层，线性模块选了两类：Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet。MLA 层保留较强的注意力表达能力，但会带来 KV-cache；线性层没有 KV-cache 开销，适合把上下文拉长。论文把 MLA-to-linear ratio 作为质量与效率的主要旋钮，而不是简单追求“越线性越好”。这点很务实，因为纯线性替换往往会伤害短上下文质量。

第二部分是从 Transformer checkpoint 到 hybrid 模型的初始化与 upcycling。做法沿着 Zebra-Llama 的思路，但更系统。作者先构造 pure MLA 和 pure linear 两种替换模型，并从原始 Transformer 权重初始化。对于 GDN，论文专门给了 attention-to-GDN 的权重迁移方案，处理了 GQA 等投影维度不匹配问题，同时保留原层的 SwiGLU MLP 和 RMSNorm。这个设计说明作者并不试图完全重写 block，而是尽量保留 Transformer 中已经稳定的子结构，只替换序列混合器。

第三部分是长上下文训练 recipe。这里是全文最关键的贡献。作者不是一次性把上下文拉到很长，而是 staged training，从 8K 逐步扩到 64K。这样做的原因很明确：upcycled hybrid 模型在结构突变后已经存在优化不稳定，再叠加超长序列训练，容易把原有能力冲掉。为此他们加入 teacher-guided long-context distillation，用 chunk-wise KL 监督学生模型在长序列上的输出分布。chunk-wise 设计意味着蒸馏不是对整条超长序列一次性做全局对齐，而是按块约束，降低显存和优化难度。论文也讨论了这种蒸馏的限制：它会把学生绑在 teacher 的局部行为上，因此需要在保真和架构自由度之间取舍。

从方法定位看，HyLo 与从头训练 hybrid 模型的区别不只是省算力，更重要的是它把“架构研究”变成“checkpoint transformation + continued training”问题；与早期 upcycling 方法相比，它把 long-context 训练和 distillation 放到了中心位置，而不是只做短上下文恢复。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两个 Transformer 家族（Llama、Qwen）和两种线性模块（Mamba-2、GDN），说明作者想证明 recipe 的可迁移性，而不是只在单一底模上成立。摘要里给出的最明确数字有两类：
1. 训练长度方面，HyLo 把 staged long-context training 从常见的约 24K 扩展到 64K；
2. serving 方面，在接入 vLLM 并做 tensor parallel 后，Llama-3.2-3B 级别模型可在 8 张 AMD MI300X 上支持最高 2M token 上下文，约为原模型的 30 倍扩展。

结果层面，论文主张 HyLo 相比 Zebra-Llama 风格基线有更好的 long-context 表现，同时 short-context 表现可比。作者还系统分析了训练序列长度对 long-context 泛化的影响，这一点比单纯报一个“训练到 64K”更重要：它回答的是长训练长度是否真的外推到更长上下文，以及不同阶段长度安排是否影响最终稳定性。

另一个关键实验是 teacher-guided distillation 的收益。论文显示 chunk-wise KL 监督能显著提升长上下文性能，并改善 upcycling 后的优化稳定性。由于全文片段里没有完整 benchmark 数字，最该关注的是趋势：
- 只做架构替换和继续训练，不足以稳定获得强 long-context；
- staged length curriculum 有帮助；
- 再叠加 teacher-guided distillation，长上下文质量进一步提升；
- 这些结论在不同底模和不同线性模块上都大体成立。

如果看研究含义，最有价值的不是某个单点分数，而是作者把“长上下文能力来自哪里”拆成了三个因素：架构本身、训练长度课程、蒸馏约束。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你做架构或继续预训练，建议接近精读。推荐顺序：
1. 先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，明确作者要优化的是 short-context 保持与 long-context 提升的双目标；
2. 再看 Architecture Design，重点看 MLA 与 Mamba-2/GDN 的组合方式，以及为什么 MLA ratio 是关键超参；
3. 然后看初始化部分，尤其是 GDN 从 Transformer 权重迁移的细节，这决定 upcycling 是否能稳定起步；
4. 训练部分重点看 staged long-context training 和 chunk-wise KL distillation；
5. 实验里优先看不同训练长度、不同蒸馏设置、不同底模/线性模块的对比表。

预计 45–60 分钟能抓住主线。值得深挖的点有：第一，长上下文能力究竟更多来自 MLA 保留的稀疏注意力锚点，还是来自线性模块的状态压缩；第二，teacher distillation 是否会限制 hybrid 架构学出不同于 Transformer 的更优长程归纳偏置；第三，这套 recipe 能否推广到更大规模模型和更强 base checkpoint，而不只是中小规模验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a pretrained Transformer LLM can be converted into a hybrid sequence model cheaply, while preserving short-context quality and actually improving usable long-context behavior. Prior upcycling work mostly optimizes for short-context perplexity or standard benchmarks and treats long-context capability as secondary. HyLo makes long-context preservation and extension a primary objective.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining and continued-training research. It reframes architecture innovation from training a new model from scratch to transforming an existing checkpoint and continuing training. That matters because the practical cost of evaluating new sequence-modeling architectures is now dominated by pretraining reuse. The paper is also useful because it treats long-context ability as a training and optimization problem, not just an architectural promise. For researchers interested in hybrid models, continual pretraining, or mid-training adaptation, the contribution is the recipe more than any single benchmark number.
summary_en.technical_approach:
HyLo is a long-context-aware upcycling recipe rather than a single architectural novelty.

First, the model architecture is hybrid: it combines Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) with linear sequence modules, specifically Mamba-2 or Gated DeltaNet (GDN). MLA preserves stronger attention capacity but still incurs KV-cache cost, while the linear blocks add no KV-cache overhead and are better suited for long contexts. The MLA-to-linear ratio is treated as the main quality-efficiency trade-off knob, which is a sensible choice because aggressively replacing attention often hurts short-context quality.

Second, the paper develops a checkpoint transformation path from a pretrained Transformer to the hybrid model. Following the spirit of Zebra-Llama, the authors construct pure-MLA and pure-linear variants initialized from the original Transformer weights. For GDN, they provide an explicit attention-to-GDN weight transfer procedure that handles projection mismatches such as grouped-query attention layouts, while keeping the original SwiGLU MLP and RMSNorm sublayers intact. This is an important design choice: the sequence mixer is replaced, but the stable feed-forward and normalization structure of the Transformer is preserved.

Third, and most importantly, HyLo introduces a staged long-context training recipe. Instead of jumping directly to very long sequences, training progresses from 8K to 64K context. This matters because upcycled models already face optimization stress from architectural mismatch, and combining that with immediate ultra-long training can destroy inherited capabilities. To stabilize this process, the paper adds teacher-guided long-context distillation using chunk-wise KL supervision. The chunk-wise design avoids a monolithic full-sequence distillation objective and makes optimization and memory usage more manageable. The paper also acknowledges the trade-off: distillation improves fidelity and stability, but it can constrain the student to remain too close to the teacher's local behavior.

Relative to training hybrid models from scratch, HyLo is about checkpoint reuse and continued training. Relative to earlier upcycling work, its main shift is to center long-context training and distillation rather than treating them as afterthoughts.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和消融：checkpoint upcycling 若真能稳住短上下文，是混合架构比从零预训更可落地的路线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: if short-context quality is preserved, checkpoint upcycling is the practical path for hybrid architectures.

paper.title: Stochastic KV Routing: Enabling Adaptive Depth-Wise Cache Sharing
paper.abstract: Serving transformer language models with high throughput requires caching Key-Values (KVs) to avoid redundant computation during autoregressive generation. The memory footprint of KV caching is significant and heavily impacts serving costs. This work proposes to lessen these memory requirements. While recent work has largely addressed KV cache reduction via compression and eviction along the temporal axis, we argue that the \emph{depth} dimension offers an orthogonal and robust avenue for optimi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决自回归推理中 KV cache 随层数线性增长的问题，重点是沿深度维度做 cache sharing，而不是沿时间维度丢 token。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率，但对预训练和模型设计有一个清楚启发：如果模型在训练或微调阶段见过跨层 KV 复用，它就不必强依赖每一层自己的 K/V 表示。相比推理时事后压缩或 eviction，这种做法把容错性写进模型行为里。它提示了一个方向：cache 友好型架构不一定只靠 GQA/MQA，也可以通过训练目标或随机路由机制让层间表示更可共享。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Random Cross-Layer Attention，简称 R-CLA。对第 l 层，训练时以概率 p 使用本层自己的 K/V，保持标准 self-attention；以概率 1-p 随机选择一个更早的层 l'，让第 l 层使用该早层的 K/V。这个随机过程相当于在深度维度模拟 cache fault。模型被迫学习从不同层的表示空间中取信息，而不是固定依赖本层 K/V。推理时可以只缓存部分层，例如每 4 层缓存一次，中间层复用最近或指定的已缓存 K/V。这样同一个模型可以在不同硬件预算下使用不同 cache retention ratio，而不必为每种 cache 策略单独训练模型。它和时间维度 eviction 的区别在于，时间 eviction 要判断哪些历史 token 重要，且 token 重要性会随 query 变化；深度维度共享保留完整时间轴，但减少每个 token 在层上的副本数量。
summary.experiments: 实验结论主要围绕 cache 保留比例、质量和服务成本的折中。作者报告 R-CLA 可以在丢弃 50% 到 75% 层级 cache 的设置下，比等价的普通 self-attention 模型更稳。较大模型中，训练阶段引入的随机跨层 K/V 还有一定正则化效果，在 full cache retention 下性能经常能保持，部分任务上还会提升。已有内容没有给出完整表格中的具体任务分数、模型规模和吞吐/TTFT 数字，因此不宜把结论解释为通用部署收益。更稳妥的读法是：R-CLA 证明了深度维度 cache sharing 可以通过训练适配，而不是完全依赖推理时的后处理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 KV cache 规模的量化例子，它说明为什么 depth-wise sharing 是独立于 token eviction 的优化轴。然后看 R-CLA 的方法定义，尤其是 p、候选源层 l'<l、以及推理时 cache 保留策略如何对应。实验部分建议只抓三类表：不同 cache retention ratio 下的质量下降，TTFT/throughput 或显存节省，full-retention 下是否损伤原模型能力。若只关心预训练研究，可以重点思考这个随机跨层注意力是否应在预训练阶段引入，以及它会不会改变层间表征分工。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the memory cost of KV cache during autoregressive inference. Instead of dropping tokens along the temporal axis, it reduces redundancy along the depth axis by making layers able to reuse K/V states from other layers.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an efficiency paper, but it has a relevant modeling lesson. If a model is trained or fine-tuned to tolerate cross-layer K/V reuse, it no longer needs to depend rigidly on each layer’s private cache. That is different from post-hoc cache compression or token eviction, where the model was not trained for the failure mode. The work suggests that cache-efficient models can be obtained not only through MQA or GQA-style architectural changes, but also through training-time stochastic routing that encourages layerwise representational compatibility.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Random Cross-Layer Attention, or R-CLA. During training, for layer l, the model uses its own K/V states with probability p, matching standard self-attention. With probability 1-p, it randomly selects a preceding layer l' < l and forces layer l to attend using that earlier layer’s K/V states. This simulates structural cache faults along the depth dimension. The layer learns to extract useful information from representations produced at different depths instead of relying only on its own feature space. At inference time, the model can cache only a subset of layers, such as every fourth layer, and have intermediate layers reuse the nearest or selected cached K/V states. This is orthogonal to temporal eviction: it preserves the full token history while reducing how many layer-specific K/V copies are stored per token.
summary_en.experiments: The reported findings focus on the quality-memory trade-off under different cache retention ratios. R-CLA is reported to handle dropping 50–75% of layerwise caches better than comparable standard self-attention models. For larger models, the stochasticity introduced during training appears to act as a regularizer: full-retention performance is often preserved and sometimes improves across tasks. The available content does not include the detailed tables with exact model sizes, benchmark scores, throughput, or TTFT numbers, so the safest interpretation is methodological rather than deployment-universal. The important result is that depth-wise cache sharing becomes much more viable when the model is explicitly trained for it.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–25 minute skim should be enough. Start with the KV cache size examples in the introduction; they motivate why depth-wise sharing is a separate optimization axis from token eviction. Then read the R-CLA definition carefully, especially the probability p, the constraint l' < l, and the mapping from training-time random routing to inference-time cache retention policies. In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: quality versus cache retention ratio, memory/latency or throughput gains, and whether full-cache inference is harmed. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main question is whether this kind of stochastic cross-layer attention should be introduced during pretraining rather than only during adaptation, and how it changes layer specialization.

recommendation.zh: 别被“无信息损失”口号带跑：重点看它的随机跨层路由训练是否真能稳住 PPL/TTFT，值得在自家 serving 复现实验。
recommendation.en: Ignore the “no information loss” slogan; focus on whether stochastic cross-layer routing actually preserves PPL while improving TTFT/memory—worth a quick internal reproduction.

paper.title: MTServe: Efficient Serving for Generative Recommendation Models with Hierarchical Caches
paper.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) offers superior modeling capabilities but suffers from prohibitive inference costs due to the repeated encoding of long user histories. While cross-request Key-Value (KV) cache reuse presents a significant optimization opportunity, the massive scale of individual user states creates a storage explosion that far exceeds physical GPU limits. We propose MTServe, a hierarchical cache management system that virtualizes GPU memory by leveraging host RAM as a scalable bac

summary.core_problem: 生成式推荐模型在在线服务时会反复编码用户长历史。用户历史前缀变化很小，但标准推理系统把每次请求当作独立样本处理，导致大量重复计算。直接持久化每个用户的 KV cache 又会带来显存爆炸和频繁 PCIe 交换。MTServe 解决的是生成式推荐服务中的跨请求 KV cache 持久化与分层管理问题。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对通用 LLM 预训练方法本身影响有限，主要价值在 serving 系统。它的启发在于：当 Transformer 用于推荐这类“用户级长状态”场景时，KV cache 的复用模式不同于对话式 LLM。LLM serving 常见的是会话内缓存或共享前缀缓存，而生成式推荐需要为海量用户维护长期、个性化、低复用度的状态。这对未来把行为序列、个性化记忆、长期用户状态纳入大模型服务有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: MTServe 使用 GPU HBM 与 CPU host memory 的两级缓存。GPU 只保留近期或高频用户状态，CPU 内存作为更大的持久化后备存储。核心设计有三点。第一，Page-Chunk 双粒度存储：GPU 侧用细粒度 page 降低碎片，CPU/传输侧用较粗粒度 chunk 提高 PCIe 传输效率。第二，异步传输流水线：使用 double-buffered DMA、自定义 scatter/gather kernel，以及按 layer 的细粒度同步，把用户状态恢复的 I/O 尽量藏在模型 forward 计算之后或之中。第三，局部性驱动的替换策略：利用用户访问的时间突发性，用 LRU 管理 GPU resident cache，并把数据持久化和物理 slot 回收解耦，避免在关键请求路径上做阻塞式写回。
summary.experiments: 论文在 KuaiRand-1K 和美团生产数据上评估。文中给出的代表性例子显示，三个连续请求如果不复用缓存需要编码累计 4031 个 token，使用用户侧 KV cache 后只需处理 529 个 token。存储压力也很明显：以 HSTU 类模型为例，1000 个用户、每人 10000 token 历史就需要超过 160GB KV cache，已经超过两张 A100 80GB 的总 HBM。性能上，相比重新计算范式，MTServe 在 batch size 条件下达到约 3.04x 和 3.1x 的延迟加速。实验重点不是模型质量，而是缓存命中、显存占用、PCIe 传输和端到端延迟之间的取舍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20-30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对生成式推荐 KV cache 形态的拆解，以及 Figure 1 对重复编码量的说明。系统部分重点看 Page-Chunk 抽象、异步 DMA 流水线、LRU 与持久化解耦。对 LLM 基座研究员来说，不必深挖推荐业务指标；更值得关注的是这种“长期个体状态 + 低共享前缀 + 高频恢复”的 workload 是否会出现在个性化 LLM、长期记忆模型和多模态行为建模中。

summary_en.core_problem: MTServe addresses cross-request KV-cache persistence for generative recommendation models. The expensive part is repeatedly encoding long user histories, while each new request usually appends only a small number of fresh interactions. Keeping a KV cache for every user removes redundant computation, but the per-user state is too large for GPU memory and creates frequent host-device swapping.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly a serving-systems contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its useful signal for LLM researchers is the workload distinction. Standard LLM serving often benefits from session-local caches or shared-prefix caches. Generative recommendation requires durable, individualized, long-lived states for many users. This pattern is relevant to future personalized LMs, long-term memory systems, and behavior-sequence modeling with Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: MTServe builds a two-tier cache over GPU HBM and host RAM. GPU memory stores hot user states, while CPU memory acts as a scalable backing store. The system has three main components. First, a Page-Chunk storage abstraction combines fine-grained GPU paging for low fragmentation with coarse-grained CPU chunks for efficient PCIe transfer. Second, an asynchronous transfer pipeline uses double-buffered DMA, optimized scatter/gather kernels, and layer-wise synchronization to overlap state restoration with forward computation. Third, a locality-aware management policy uses LRU-style residency and separates persistence from physical slot reclamation, so eviction metadata can be updated without blocking the inference path.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses KuaiRand-1K and a production Meituan dataset. A motivating example shows that three consecutive requests require 4,031 tokens of cumulative encoding under recomputation, but only 529 tokens with user-side cache reuse. The storage challenge is also quantified: for a representative HSTU model, 1,000 users with 10,000-token histories require more than 160GB of KV cache, exceeding the HBM capacity of two A100 80GB GPUs. Reported end-to-end latency speedups over recomputation are about 3.04x and 3.1x under the evaluated batch settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20-30 minutes. The most relevant parts are the workload analysis in the introduction, Figure 1, the Page-Chunk abstraction, the DMA overlap pipeline, and the eviction/persistence design. Model-quality results are less important here. The useful question is whether the same cache pattern appears in personalized LLM serving or long-term memory systems.

recommendation.zh: 针对推荐场景长序列的 KV Cache 分层管理系统，其异步传输和混合存储设计对长上下文 LLM serving 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A hierarchical KV cache management system for long-sequence recommendation; its asynchronous transfer and hybrid storage designs are relevant for long-context LLM serving.

paper.title: Kwai Summary Attention Technical Report
paper.abstract: Long-context ability, has become one of the most important iteration direction of next-generation Large Language Models, particularly in semantic understanding/reasoning, code agentic intelligence and recommendation system. However, the standard softmax attention exhibits quadratic time complexity with respect to sequence length. As the sequence length increases, this incurs substantial overhead in long-context settings, leading the training and inference costs of extremely long sequences deteri

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是长上下文 Transformer 的 KV cache 和注意力计算开销问题，目标是在保留远程依赖可见性的同时，把远距离历史压缩到更少的 summary token 中。
summary.importance: 这篇更适合泛读。它不是预训练目标层面的新范式，而是长上下文架构和推理效率方向的工程型方案。对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“序列级 KV 压缩”作为介于全量 KV 保留和线性/滑窗注意力之间的路线：不追求固定大小状态，也不完全丢弃远距上下文，而是用可学习 summary token 以 O(n/k) 的形式保留历史摘要。这类设计会影响长上下文预训练的数据组织、位置编码、mask 设计和后续 RL/agent 轨迹训练的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: Kwai Summary Attention, 简称 KSA，将输入序列切成固定大小 chunk，并在每个 chunk 边界插入一个可学习 summary token。summary token 的职责是汇总当前 chunk，因此它只看同一 chunk 内的文本 token。后续文本 token 则同时看局部邻近文本和此前 chunk 的 summary token。这样，近处信息仍通过局部文本注意力保留细节，远处信息通过 summary token 提供压缩后的全局记忆。与 GQA、MLA 这类按 head 或低秩投影压缩每个 token 的 KV 不同，KSA 压缩的是序列长度维度；与滑窗注意力不同，它没有完全切断窗口外信息；与线性注意力不同，它不是把所有历史压成固定状态，而是按 chunk 保留一串显式摘要。图中还给出 hybrid-KSA 的设计：KSA block 与 full attention block 交错使用，例如 3 个 KSA block 配 1 个 full attention block，用来平衡表达能力和效率。
summary.experiments: 提供内容显示作者做了从零训练和持续预训练两类实验，并在多个下游 benchmark 上比较 KSA 及其架构变体，同时提供训练 recipe 和计算 kernel。由于给出的全文片段未包含具体结果表格，不能确认准确提升幅度、模型规模和长上下文 benchmark 分数。可确认的实验关注点包括：KSA 相比 full attention 的 KV cache 与计算节省；相比 sliding-window 或 linear attention 的长程依赖保留；chunk size、summary token 位置、KSA/full attention 混合比例等消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Figure 2，理解 summary token 的插入方式和 mask 规则，这是整篇的核心。然后看 methodology 中对三条路线的比较：GQA/MLA 的每 token KV 压缩、SWA/linear 的固定或局部状态、KSA 的序列级压缩。实验部分优先查找长上下文检索、困惑度或语言建模 loss、KV cache 占用、decode latency，以及 hybrid 比例消融。若只关心预训练架构选择，重点看从零训练和 CPT 是否稳定，以及 KSA 是否需要特殊 curriculum 或位置编码调整。
summary.authors_note: 快手/Kwai，Kuaishou-OneRec 开源仓库；作者名单未在提供内容中出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the KV-cache and attention-compute cost of long-context Transformers. The goal is to preserve access to distant dependencies while compressing long-range history into a smaller set of summary tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is a skim-level paper for pretraining researchers. It is not a new language modeling objective, but an efficient long-context architecture. The useful idea is sequence-level KV compression as a middle path between full attention and fixed-state or local attention. Instead of keeping every past token or discarding everything outside a window, KSA keeps an explicit compressed history at O(n/k) granularity. This design can affect long-context pretraining recipes, masking, positional encoding, and the stability of later RL or agent-trajectory training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Kwai Summary Attention splits the sequence into chunks and inserts a learnable summary token at each chunk boundary. A summary token summarizes its own chunk and only attends to text tokens within that chunk. Later text tokens attend to local neighboring text tokens and to summary tokens from previous chunks. Nearby context is therefore represented with token-level detail, while distant context is represented through explicit learned summaries. This differs from GQA and MLA, which compress KV per token through head sharing or low-rank projections. It also differs from sliding-window attention, which drops out-of-window context, and from linear attention, which compresses the whole past into a fixed-size state. The report also proposes a hybrid design that interleaves KSA blocks with full-attention blocks; the figure suggests a 3-to-1 KSA/full-attention pattern as one operating point.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that the authors run both from-scratch training and continual pretraining, evaluate on a range of downstream benchmarks, and perform ablations over architectural variants. They also release training recipes and a computation kernel. The available excerpt does not include the numerical tables, so exact model sizes, benchmark scores, latency reductions, and KV-cache savings cannot be verified here. The key experimental axes to inspect are KSA versus full attention in memory and latency, KSA versus sliding-window or linear attention in long-range dependency retention, and ablations over chunk size, summary-token placement, and the KSA/full-attention mixing ratio.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 2 to understand token insertion and the attention masks; that is the core mechanism. Then read the methodology comparison among per-token KV compression, local or fixed-state attention, and KSA-style sequence-level compression. In the experiments, look for long-context retrieval results, language modeling loss or perplexity, KV-cache footprint, decoding latency, and hybrid-ratio ablations. For pretraining architecture decisions, the most relevant evidence is whether KSA remains stable in from-scratch training and CPT, and whether it requires special curriculum or positional-encoding changes.
summary_en.authors_note: Kwai/Kuaishou, with a Kuaishou-OneRec open-source repository; the author list is not present in the provided text.

paper.title: DepthKV: Layer-Dependent KV Cache Pruning for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning is a critical capability of large language models (LLMs), enabling applications such as long-document understanding, summarization, and code generation. However, efficient autoregressive inference relies on the key-value (KV) cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length, leading to a major memory bottleneck. To mitigate this overhead, KV cache pruning methods discard cached tokens with low attention scores during inference. Most existing methods apply

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长上下文推理中的 KV cache 内存瓶颈，但切入点不是再做统一比例的 token 剪枝，而是回答一个更细的问题：不同 transformer 层对 KV 剪枝的敏感度是否相同。如果不相同，那么在固定全局 KV 预算下，按层平均分配缓存就是低效的。作者的结论很明确：层间重要性显著不均匀，尤其某些中间层对内容生成和最终任务表现更关键，因此应该做 layer-dependent 的预算分配。
summary.importance: 它属于推理效率而不是预训练方法，但对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，它提供了一个较清楚的经验事实：层的功能分工在长上下文场景下并不均匀，且这种不均匀性会直接体现在缓存压缩容忍度上。这对理解 transformer 层级结构、训练时是否需要显式鼓励层间分工、以及长上下文能力如何在层内传播都有参考价值。第二，它把 KV 剪枝从“选哪些 token”扩展到“每层保留多少 token”，说明很多后训练压缩问题其实是联合优化 token 选择与层预算分配，而不是单一排序问题。贡献量级是扎实的 inference-time 方法改进，适合做部署和机制分析的人关注。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 DepthKV，一个在固定全局 KV 预算下进行按层非均匀分配的框架。标准设定里，给定 L 层 decoder-only transformer 和长度为 N 的输入，每层都会产生 N 个 token 的 key/value 表示，完整缓存的内存是 O(LNd)。传统 post-training KV pruning 通常对所有层使用相同保留比例，等价于令每层预算 B^(l) 相同。DepthKV 放弃这个假设，允许不同层有不同预算 B^(l)，只要求总预算受全局约束。

作者先做 layer-wise ablation：一次只在单层施加剪枝，其余层保持不变，观察下游性能下降。随后用 permutation test 检验“各层同等重要”这一零假设，并在不同模型和数据集上拒绝该假设。这个实验不是装饰性的，它直接为非均匀分配提供依据。

在此基础上，DepthKV 提出多种预算分配策略。按引言描述，至少包括三类：
1）position-dependent protection：对特定层段做保护，例如优先保留中间层更多 KV；
2）metric-guided allocation：根据某种层重要性分数给高分层分配更多预算；
3）hybrid strategy：把位置先验和度量引导结合起来。

剪枝本身发生在 prefill 阶段，token 重要性由全序列注意力权重估计。也就是说，DepthKV 并不是重新设计注意力结构，也不需要重新训练模型，而是在已有 KV pruning 管线之上增加一层“预算如何跨层分配”的优化。它兼容已有 token-level 选择规则，创新点是把 layer budget 当成一等公民。

全文还提出了一个有意思的分析概念：content amplification layers。作者观察到，某些对剪枝最敏感的层一旦被强剪，模型会生成更短、信息量更低的输出。这说明这些层的作用不只是局部注意力聚合，而可能与维持内容展开、信息延续有关。这个现象让 DepthKV 不只是工程技巧，也带一点机制分析意味。
summary.experiments:
可见全文片段没有给出完整结果表，因此不能编造具体分数，但实验设计和主要结论已经比较清楚。

1）任务设置：作者评测 document summarization、question answering、mathematical reasoning 等长上下文任务，并强调这些任务通常“输入远长于输出”，因此 prefill 才是主要计算和内存瓶颈。这个设定合理，因为 prefill 剪枝的收益在这类场景最直接。

2）层重要性分析：通过单层剪枝消融，作者发现不同层对性能下降的影响差异显著。随后 permutation test 在多模型、多数据集上都拒绝“层重要性均匀”的假设。这是全文最关键的实证基础。

3）生成行为分析：被识别为高敏感度的层在遭到剪枝后，会导致输出更短、信息更少。作者把这类层称为 content amplification layers，并指出它们与最终任务性能高度相关。

4）主结果：在相同 KV 预算下，DepthKV 在各类长上下文任务和不同模型上都稳定优于 uniform pruning。这里最值得关注的不是单点最优，而是“同预算下持续更好”这一趋势，因为它说明收益来自预算分配原则，而不是某个特定任务的偶然性。

精读时建议补齐以下数字：测试模型名称与规模、上下文长度、预算压缩比、与哪些 pruning baseline 比较、不同 allocation strategy 的差异、以及在极低预算区间是否仍然保持优势。这些细节决定方法的实用边界。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“证据链”来读。先看 layer-wise ablation 和 permutation test，对应作者为什么有资格否定 uniform pruning 假设。没有这部分，DepthKV 只是一个经验调参技巧；有了这部分，它才成为一个有根据的框架。

然后看方法章节里预算分配的形式化定义。重点不是 token importance 公式本身，而是全局预算约束下 B^(l) 如何分配、不同策略需要什么先验或统计量、以及它们是否需要额外校准数据。

接着看生成长度和信息量分析，也就是 content amplification layers 那部分。这部分对理解 transformer 中间层在长上下文生成中的作用很有价值，甚至比主结果表更值得看。

最后看主实验表和消融。优先关注：同一预算下相对 uniform pruning 的提升、不同任务是否一致、不同模型是否一致、以及 hybrid strategy 是否稳定优于单一策略。若只是泛读，30 分钟足够抓住核心；若要用于实际部署，建议把附录中的实现细节、预算设定和复杂度分析也一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies KV-cache pruning for long-context inference, but the real question is not simply which tokens to keep. It asks whether transformer layers are equally tolerant to KV pruning. If they are not, then the common practice of applying a uniform pruning ratio across layers is wasteful. The paper’s main finding is that layer sensitivity is highly non-uniform, with some layers—especially in the middle of the stack—being much more important for preserving generation quality and downstream performance.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it has two broader implications for foundation-model research. First, it provides empirical evidence that layer roles in long-context processing are uneven, and that this unevenness shows up directly in compression tolerance. That is useful for understanding transformer depth, long-context information flow, and possibly training-time architectural choices. Second, it reframes KV pruning as a joint problem of token selection and layer-wise budget allocation. That is a more faithful view of the optimization problem than treating pruning as a single global ranking over tokens. The contribution is a solid post-training inference improvement with some mechanism-level insight.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is DepthKV, a framework that allocates a fixed global KV budget non-uniformly across transformer layers. In a standard decoder-only transformer with L layers and input length N, each layer stores N key-value pairs, leading to O(LNd) memory. Most prior post-training pruning methods keep the same retention ratio in every layer, effectively setting the per-layer budget B^(l) to be uniform. DepthKV relaxes that assumption and allows different layers to receive different budgets under a fixed total memory constraint.

The paper first establishes the need for this design through layer-wise ablation. It prunes one layer at a time while keeping the others unchanged, then measures the downstream degradation. A permutation test is used to reject the null hypothesis that all layers are equally important. This is an important part of the paper because it turns the method from a heuristic into a response to a measurable structural property.

On top of that, DepthKV supports several allocation strategies. From the visible text, these include: (1) position-dependent protection, where certain depth regions such as middle layers are preserved more aggressively; (2) metric-guided allocation, where layers with higher importance scores receive larger budgets; and (3) hybrid strategies that combine positional priors with metric-based ranking.

Pruning itself is performed during the prefill stage, with token importance estimated from full-sequence attention weights. So the method does not require retraining or architectural changes. It can be viewed as an additional optimization layer on top of existing KV-pruning pipelines: keep the token selector, but stop assuming that every layer deserves the same cache budget.

A particularly interesting analytical contribution is the notion of content amplification layers. The paper observes that pruning the most sensitive layers leads to shorter and less informative outputs. That suggests these layers are not merely storing redundant context but are important for sustaining content generation. This makes the paper more than a deployment trick; it also offers a useful lens on layer function in long-context generation.
summary_en.experiments:
The visible excerpt does not include the full result tables, so exact scores, model sizes, and compression ratios should not be invented. Still, the experimental structure and main conclusions are clear.

First, the evaluation covers long-context tasks such as document summarization, question answering, and mathematical reasoning. The paper explicitly focuses on settings where inputs are much longer than outputs, making prefill the dominant compute and memory bottleneck. That is the right regime for studying prefill-time KV pruning.

Second, the layer-importance analysis is central. By pruning one layer at a time, the authors show that performance degradation varies substantially across layers. A permutation test then rejects the hypothesis of uniform layer importance across models and datasets. This is the empirical foundation of the method.

Third, the paper analyzes generation behavior and finds that pruning highly sensitive layers causes outputs to become shorter and less informative. These layers are termed content amplification layers, and their sensitivity correlates strongly with downstream performance.

Fourth, the main result is that under the same total KV budget, DepthKV consistently outperforms uniform pruning across tasks and models. The important point is not a single best-case number but the consistency of the gain under matched memory constraints.

When reading the full paper, the most important details to extract are: model names and scales, context lengths, budget ratios, baseline pruning methods, differences among allocation strategies, and whether the advantage persists in very aggressive compression regimes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this paper through its evidence chain. Start with the layer-wise ablation and permutation-test sections. Those sections justify why uniform pruning is the wrong default. Without them, DepthKV would look like a tuning heuristic; with them, it becomes a principled response to a measured non-uniformity.

Then move to the formalization of layer-wise budget allocation. The key issue is not the token-importance formula itself, but how the global budget is distributed across layers, what statistics are needed to do so, and whether the method requires calibration data.

After that, pay attention to the analysis of generation length and informativeness, especially the content amplification layer discussion. That part is useful even beyond deployment because it says something about what middle transformer layers are doing in long-context generation.

Finally, inspect the main result tables and ablations. Focus on matched-budget comparisons against uniform pruning, consistency across tasks and models, and whether hybrid allocation is reliably better than simpler strategies. A quick read takes about 30 minutes. If the goal is deployment, the appendix on implementation details, budget settings, and complexity is worth reading carefully.

recommendation.en: Read only the layer-sensitivity analysis and budget-allocation ablations; it is not pretraining work, but it sharpens intuition about memory roles across depth.

paper.title: Sparse Forcing: Native Trainable Sparse Attention for Real-time Autoregressive Diffusion Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Sparse Forcing, a training-and-inference paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models that improves long-horizon generation quality while reducing decoding latency. Sparse Forcing is motivated by an empirical observation in autoregressive diffusion rollouts: attention concentrates on a persistent subset of salient visual blocks, forming an implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, and exhibits a locally structured block-sparse pattern within sliding windows. Building on

summary.core_problem: 自回归扩散视频生成同时存在两个核心问题：一是长序列推理时全量注意力计算复杂度随上下文长度平方增长，延迟和显存开销过高；二是自回归迭代生成过程中预测误差不断累积，长时生成质量快速下降。
summary.importance: 打破了稀疏注意力仅用于效率优化的固有认知，证明结构化稀疏可以同时控制误差传播路径、提升长序列生成质量，相关设计可迁移到长上下文LLM预训练、AR+diffusion统一多模态建模范式的优化中。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过实验观察到自回归扩散迭代生成时，注意力会集中在少数持续存在的显著视觉块上，在KV缓存中形成隐式时空记忆，且局部滑动窗口内呈现块稀疏结构。基于该观察提出Sparse Forcing范式：可训练的原生稀疏机制会学习压缩、保留、更新这些持久块，同时将每个局部窗口的计算限制在动态选择的邻域内。配套开发了Persistent Block-Sparse Attention（PBSA）GPU内核，适配大规模训练和推理场景，降低延迟和显存占用。
summary.experiments: 已披露的结果显示，该方法在短视频生成上质量优于基线，扩展到分钟级长视频时质量增益无衰减，训练和推理端到端速度提升，显存占用降低，完整量化结果未在当前公开的部分内容中呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注引言中稀疏性抑制误差累积的逻辑分析、方法部分的可训练稀疏注意力设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive diffusion video generation faces two coupled core challenges: first, full attention introduces quadratic compute overhead with growing context length during long-sequence inference, leading to excessively high latency and memory footprint; second, prediction errors compound over autoregressive rollouts, causing rapid quality degradation for long-horizon generation.
summary_en.importance: It expands the application scope of sparse attention beyond pure efficiency optimization, proving structured sparsity can simultaneously regulate error propagation paths and improve long-sequence generation quality. The related design can be migrated to long-context LLM pretraining and optimization of unified AR+diffusion multimodal modeling paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first empirically observes that during autoregressive diffusion rollouts, attention concentrates on a small subset of persistent salient visual blocks, forming implicit spatiotemporal memory in the KV cache, with block-sparse patterns inside local sliding windows. Based on this observation, the Sparse Forcing paradigm is proposed: a trainable native sparsity mechanism that learns to compress, preserve and update these persistent blocks, while restricting computation within each local window to a dynamically selected neighborhood. A dedicated Persistent Block-Sparse Attention (PBSA) GPU kernel is developed to support large-scale training and inference with lower latency and memory footprint.
summary_en.experiments: Disclosed results show the method outperforms baselines on short video generation, and its quality gain remains stable when scaled to minute-level long videos. It delivers end-to-end speedup for both training and inference with reduced memory consumption. Full quantitative results are not included in the currently available partial content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the analysis of sparsity mitigating error propagation in the Introduction, and the trainable sparse attention design in the Methodology section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不属于 pretrain 核心，但“持久块记忆”这个观察值得看；先读注意力可视化和 PBSA 设计，看看是否能迁到长上下文多模态 LM。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the 'persistent block memory' observation is worth stealing; read the attention analysis and PBSA design to see if it transfers to long-context multimodal LMs.

paper.title: SparKV: Overhead-Aware KV Cache Loading for Efficient On-Device LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Efficient inference for on-device Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging due to limited hardware resources and the high cost of the prefill stage, which processes the full input context to construct Key-Value (KV) caches. We present SparKV, an adaptive KV loading framework that combines cloud-based KV streaming with on-device computation. SparKV models the cost of individual KV chunks and decides whether each chunk should be streamed or computed locally, while overlapping the two execu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是端侧 LLM 推理里的 prefill 延迟问题，具体是“已有上下文可复用时，KV cache 到底该从云端传，还是在本地重新算”。现有方案通常只押注一边：要么做 KV 压缩后传输，要么优化本地 prefill 计算。但在真实边缘设备上，通信带宽、算力余量、内存带宽都在波动，而且不同 KV chunk 的传输成本和重算成本差异很大。论文要解决的核心问题，是在严格的 Transformer 依赖约束下，对每个 chunk 做 overhead-aware 的路径选择，并让云传输与本地计算尽可能重叠，从而降低 TTFT。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性不高，它更偏 serving / efficient inference，而不是建模或训练方法。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把 KV cache 看成可按 token、head、layer 多维切分并调度的对象，这种更细粒度的 cache 抽象，对长上下文 serving 和训练时 activation / state 管理都有启发。第二，它强调“不要盲目 overlap，而要按 chunk 成本路由”，这是一种很工程但很扎实的系统思路：瓶颈不是单一算力或单一带宽，而是依赖图上的异构代价最优化。若你的关注点是推理系统、边缘部署、context reuse，这篇有实际价值；若只看 pretrain，可快速略读。
summary.technical_approach:
SparKV 的方法由三部分组成。第一是 KV chunk scheduler。云端先把预计算好的 KV cache 按 token、attention head、Transformer layer 进行索引化切分。调度器随后对每个 chunk 决定走哪条路径：直接从云端流式加载，还是在设备端根据原始上下文局部重算。这个决策不是静态规则，而是要满足层间和因果依赖，同时最小化端到端 TTFT。

第二是 overhead model。作者用一个轻量 MLP 预测每个 chunk 的本地计算时延，输入特征来自 attention sparsity 等信息。这样做的原因是，不同 chunk 的重算代价并不均匀：有些 chunk 因为稀疏注意力或结构位置原因，本地算更便宜；另一些则更适合直接传。相比统一按层或按段切分，这种 per-chunk 成本建模更细。

第三是 runtime controller。离线生成的调度在真实无线网络和边缘设备上不够稳，因为吞吐和可用算力会波动。控制器在滑动窗口里监控无线带宽和设备 compute headroom，运行时动态把部分 chunk 从“传输路径”迁到“本地计算路径”，或反过来迁移，以重新平衡通信与计算。论文的关键主张不是简单的 cloud-edge 协同，而是依赖感知、成本感知、并且能在线修正的协同。

与已有工作相比，区别主要有三点：1）不是单纯做 KV 压缩或优先级传输；2）不是只优化本地 prefill kernel/sparse attention；3）不是粗粒度的双向并行，而是更细粒度地在 chunk 级别做路由和 overlap。作者认为，只有这样才能在严格依赖约束下真正吃到通信和计算的并行收益。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖多个 LLM、数据集和边缘设备，主指标是 TTFT，同时也看能耗和输出质量保持。引言里给出的核心结果是：相对已有高效 KV loading 方案，SparKV 将 TTFT 降低到 1.3× 到 5.1× 的加速区间，单请求能耗降低 1.5× 到 3.3×，并且在真实无线环境和算力波动下仍保持鲁棒。文中还给了一个很直观的背景数字：在 Redmi K80 Pro 16GB 上，顺序 prefill 处理 15K 以上上下文会超过 15 秒；即便在 Jetson Orin 上使用稀疏注意力，15K context 仍需 5 秒以上，这说明问题设定并不轻。

从论文结构推测，关键消融应包括：是否使用 overhead-aware 调度、是否启用 runtime controller、chunk 切分粒度变化、以及不同网络条件下的性能退化。真正值得看的不是平均加速比，而是它在带宽抖动和设备负载变化时是否还能维持稳定收益。如果主表之外还有 schedule 可视化或 chunk 路由分布图，那会帮助判断该方法是否真的学到了“哪些块该传、哪些块该算”，而不是仅仅利用某个固定场景。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合系统向泛读。先看问题设定和 Figure 1，确认三类 workflow 的差别：纯传输、纯本地算、以及 SparKV 的混合路径。然后看 scheduler 的依赖建模，重点不是公式细节，而是它如何在 token/head/layer 三个维度切 chunk，同时不破坏 Transformer 的执行依赖。接着看 overhead model 的输入特征和预测误差，再看 runtime controller 在无线波动下如何改写离线 schedule。最后看真实设备实验和鲁棒性结果。

如果只想抓住方法要点，20–30 分钟足够。若你做 serving，可以多看调度算法和 runtime adaptation；若你做 pretrain，这篇主要看它对“状态缓存可被细粒度调度”的系统抽象，不必深挖实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses prefill latency for on-device LLM inference, specifically the decision problem of whether reusable KV cache should be streamed from the cloud or recomputed locally. Existing systems usually commit to one side: either compress and transmit KV caches, or accelerate local prefill. In practice, edge devices face fluctuating bandwidth, limited compute headroom, and heterogeneous chunk costs. Different KV chunks have very different communication and recomputation overheads. The core problem here is therefore to make per-chunk routing decisions under strict Transformer dependencies, while overlapping cloud streaming and local computation as much as possible to reduce time-to-first-token.
summary_en.importance: This is not directly a pretraining paper; it sits in efficient inference / serving. Still, it offers two useful ideas. First, it treats KV cache as a schedulable object that can be partitioned across token, head, and layer dimensions, which is a more fine-grained systems abstraction than many prior works. That abstraction may be relevant to long-context serving and, more loosely, to thinking about state management in training systems. Second, the paper’s main lesson is practical and sound: overlap is not enough by itself; routing must be cost-aware. The bottleneck is not just compute or just bandwidth, but optimization over a dependency graph with heterogeneous costs. For researchers focused on edge deployment or context reuse, this is useful. For pure pretraining work, it is peripheral.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SparKV has three main components. The first is a KV chunk scheduler. The cloud stores precomputed KV caches and partitions them into indexed chunks along token, attention-head, and Transformer-layer dimensions. For each chunk, the scheduler decides whether it should be streamed from the cloud or recomputed on the device, subject to causal and layer-wise dependencies, with the objective of minimizing end-to-end TTFT.

The second component is an overhead model. The paper uses a lightweight MLP to predict per-chunk local computation latency from features such as attention sparsity. This matters because recomputation cost is highly non-uniform across chunks: some are cheap to recompute locally, while others are better streamed. Compared with coarse layer-level or segment-level scheduling, this gives the system a finer cost model.

The third component is a runtime controller. Offline schedules are fragile under real wireless conditions and changing edge workloads. The controller monitors wireless throughput and available compute headroom over sliding windows, then dynamically migrates chunks between the streaming path and the local-compute path. The key point is that SparKV is not just cloud-edge cooperation in a generic sense; it is dependency-aware, cost-aware, and runtime-adaptive.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear: it is not only KV compression or priority-based streaming; it is not only local prefill acceleration through kernels or sparse attention; and it is not a coarse bidirectional overlap scheme. The novelty is chunk-level routing plus overlap under dependency constraints.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span multiple LLMs, datasets, and edge devices, with TTFT as the main metric, plus energy and quality preservation. The headline result stated in the paper is a 1.3x to 5.1x TTFT reduction over prior efficient KV-loading schemes, together with 1.5x to 3.3x lower per-request energy. The paper also claims robustness under varying compute availability and real wireless conditions. The motivation numbers are also useful: on a Redmi K80 Pro with 16 GB memory, sequential prefill for long reused contexts can exceed 15 seconds; even with sparse attention on a Jetson Orin, a 15K-token context still takes more than 5 seconds. So the target regime is genuinely challenging.

The most informative ablations are likely to be the value of overhead-aware scheduling, the effect of the runtime controller, the impact of chunk granularity, and degradation under bandwidth fluctuation. What matters most is not the average speedup alone, but whether the method remains effective when network throughput and device load shift during execution. If the paper includes schedule visualizations or chunk-routing distributions, those are worth checking because they reveal whether the system is actually learning meaningful routing patterns rather than exploiting a narrow setup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a systems paper. Start with the problem setup and Figure 1 to understand the three workflows: pure streaming, pure local prefill, and SparKV’s hybrid path. Then read the scheduler section, focusing less on every formula and more on how chunking across token/head/layer dimensions respects Transformer dependencies. After that, inspect the overhead model inputs and prediction quality, then the runtime controller and how it revises offline schedules under wireless variability. Finish with the real-device evaluation and robustness results.

If the goal is just to capture the main idea, 20–30 minutes is enough. For serving researchers, the scheduling and runtime adaptation sections are the most useful. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is the systems abstraction that cached model state can be partitioned and routed at a finer granularity than is commonly assumed.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但边云协同 KV 的 cost model 很实在；只看调度建模和 runtime refinement，别在质量结论上过度外推。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the edge-cloud KV scheduling cost model is worth stealing; read the scheduler and runtime refinement, not the quality claims.

institutions: availability, SparKV further refines offline-generated schedules

paper.title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framewo

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多智能体 LLM 系统中的通信接口是否应被学习，而不是固定为自然语言消息传递；核心问题是如何把 latent communication 与多轮协作推理联合优化。
summary.importance: 贡献在 agent 范式而非基座预训练。它有一点方法新意：把 agent 间通信从显式文本协议改成可训练的潜表示交换，并做参数高效监督训练。对研究内部表征、KV 级通信和 test-time collaboration 的人有参考价值，但离预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DiffMAS，把多智能体交互中的 latent trajectory 作为训练对象，允许 agent 通过内部表示如 KV cache 进行通信，并通过参数高效监督训练联合学习“如何编码信息”和“如何解释信息”。目标不是单个 agent 更强，而是让通信协议本身适配协作推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在数学推理、科学问答、代码生成和常识任务上，相比单 agent 推理、文本通信基线和其他 latent communication 方法，DiffMAS 在准确率和解码稳定性上都有提升。未见大规模预训练设置，实验更偏系统方法验证。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper asks whether communication in multi-agent LLM systems should be learned rather than fixed as natural-language message passing; the core problem is how to jointly optimize latent communication and collaborative reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in agent methodology rather than foundation-model pretraining. The main novelty is to replace explicit text-based protocols with trainable latent communication and optimize it with parameter-efficient supervision. It is relevant if you care about internal representations, KV-level communication, or test-time collaboration, but it is not central to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose DiffMAS, which treats multi-agent latent trajectories as the training target. Agents communicate through internal representations such as KV caches, and parameter-efficient supervised training jointly learns how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. The goal is to adapt the communication protocol itself to collaborative reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, DiffMAS improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based communication baselines, and prior latent-communication approaches on math reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks. There is no indication of large-scale pretraining; this is mainly a systems/method validation paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

recommendation.zh: 想看 agent 新接口可以扫一眼，但别把它误读成 pretrain 方法；只需看 latent trajectory 训练目标和与 text protocol 的对比表，判断是否真有信息带宽优势。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look if you care about new agent interfaces, but do not mistake it for a pretraining paper; read the latent-trajectory objective and the comparison against text protocols to judge whether there is real bandwidth gain.

paper.title: TTKV: Temporal-Tiered KV Cache for Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is critical for efficient inference in large language models (LLMs), yet its memory footprint scales linearly with context length, resulting in a severe scalability bottleneck. Existing approaches largely treat KV states as equally important across time, implicitly assuming uniform precision and accessibility. However, this assumption contrasts with human memory systems, where memories vary in clarity, recall frequency, and relevance with temporal proximity.Motivated by th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里一个很实际的系统瓶颈：KV cache 随上下文长度线性增长，最终不只是显存不够，而是 HBM 放不下后必须溢出到 DRAM，导致 host-to-GPU 传输成为 decode 延迟主因。已有方法通常只做一件事：要么压缩 KV，要么做 offloading；但两者单独使用都不够，直接叠加又常常把精度、传输量和延迟的矛盾放大。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何把“KV 压缩”和“分层存储”联合设计，让长上下文下真正减少跨层流量和端到端解码延迟，同时尽量不伤模型质量。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的意义主要不在预训练方法本身，而在长上下文 serving 的系统抽象。文章给出的价值是：第一，把 KV cache 视为具有时间异质性的状态，而不是所有 token 一视同仁，这个假设比统一量化、统一 offload 更贴近实际注意力使用模式；第二，它说明长上下文推理的关键指标不是单纯压缩率，而是跨 HBM/DRAM 的有效访问代价；第三，它把精度分配、稀疏化和流式 attention 放到同一个设计里，给后续做训练时长上下文适配、memory-aware architecture、甚至 attention budget 学习提供了系统侧参照。就研究量级看，这是偏工程系统但有清晰方法论的工作，适合做 inference stack 设计参考，不属于改变建模范式的论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Temporal-Tiered KV Cache。设计分三层。第一层是 Tier Layout：把 KV cache 显式拆成 fast tier 和 slow tier，前者放 HBM，后者放 DRAM，对应“短期记忆”和“长期记忆”。这样做不是简单分页，而是从一开始就假设最近 token 对下一步生成更敏感，需要低延迟高精度访问。第二层是 Tier Content：不同时间段的 KV 用不同保真度存储。近期、频繁访问的 token 保留全精度；更早的 token 放入慢层后再做 differential quantization 和 sparsification。这里的关键不是只压缩旧 token，而是把‘时间相关性’作为压缩策略的主轴，因此压缩预算和访问预算是联动的。第三层是 Tier Interaction：为避免 decode 时每步都被 DRAM 访问拖慢，作者引入 streaming attention，把慢层 KV 的传输和计算流水化重叠。也就是说，系统不是先把所有远端 KV 拉回再算，而是边传边算，尽量隐藏 PCIe 带宽和延迟成本。

从论文给出的 framing 看，TTKV 与 KIVI、KVQuant、DiffKV 这类方法的区别，在于它不是把量化当成独立模块，也不是像 ShadowKV 那样主要围绕 offloading/access pattern 优化，而是把“哪些 token 值得高精度、哪些 token 值得低延迟”作为统一决策问题。它隐含的经验判断是：时间近的 token 更像工作集，时间远的 token 只有少量会被再次强访问，因此适合低精度、低带宽存储。这一判断在多数长上下文生成任务里通常成立，但如果任务强依赖远距离精确拷贝或跨文档定位，时间分层的收益会更依赖具体稀疏/量化策略是否足够保真。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-32B、DeepSeek-R1-14B 和 LLaMA-3.1-70B，说明作者希望证明方法不依赖单一模型族。场景重点是长上下文推理，尤其 128K context。与 KIVI、KVQuant、DiffKV、ShadowKV 对比时，论文报告 TTKV 在 128K 任务上可把 cross-tier traffic 最多降低 5.94×，带来最高 76% 的延迟下降，以及约 2× 的吞吐提升，同时保持模型精度基本不变。

这些结果里最值得注意的不是单个最好数字，而是收益链条比较完整：先减少慢层访问体积，再通过流式重叠把剩余访问的代价进一步摊薄，最后体现在 decode latency 和 throughput 上。论文摘要和正文前部都强调“maintaining model accuracy”，说明作者至少做了质量守恒验证，而不是单纯系统 benchmark。若按系统论文标准看，关键消融应当包括：只做 tier layout、不做异构精度；只做量化、不做 streaming；不同 fast-tier 容量；不同上下文长度下的收益曲线；以及不同模型规模下 HBM 溢出点变化。就已给出的正文信息，最核心的实验结论是：当 KV 已经大到必须 offload 时，单纯压缩或单纯 offload 都不够，联合设计才有明显端到端收益。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着系统问题去读。先看 Introduction 和 Design Principle，抓住作者真正优化的对象是 cross-tier traffic，而不是抽象的 KV size。然后重点看三部分：Tier Layout、Tier Content、Tier Interaction。读 Tier Content 时要留意作者如何决定哪些 token 留在 fast tier、哪些 token 进入 slow tier，以及量化和稀疏化是否按 head/layer/token 区分；这决定方法是否只是启发式工程，还是有较稳的访问统计依据。读 Tier Interaction 时重点看 streaming attention 的流水线细节，因为这部分决定 latency 改善是否来自真实重叠，而不是 benchmark 设置。实验部分建议先看 128K 主结果，再看消融：fast/slow tier 容量、量化位宽、稀疏率、不同模型规模。预计 25-35 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你做 serving 或长上下文系统，值得把实现细节和带宽模型再深挖一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in long-context LLM inference: KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, and once it no longer fits in HBM, decode latency becomes dominated by host-to-GPU transfers from DRAM. Prior work usually emphasizes either KV reduction or KV offloading, but neither alone is sufficient, and naive combinations often create a poor trade-off among compression ratio, transfer volume, latency, and accuracy. The core problem here is how to jointly design KV compression and memory-tier placement so that long-context decoding reduces cross-tier traffic and end-to-end latency without noticeably hurting model quality.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly on the systems side rather than pretraining itself, but the abstraction is useful for foundation-model researchers working on long-context serving. The main contribution is to treat KV states as temporally heterogeneous instead of uniformly important. That shift matters because the real bottleneck in long-context inference is often not raw KV size, but the effective cost of accessing KV across HBM and DRAM. The paper also shows that precision allocation, sparsification, and streaming attention should be co-designed rather than optimized in isolation. For pretraining researchers, this is relevant as a systems prior for memory-aware architectures, long-context adaptation, and learned attention-budget allocation. It is a solid inference paper, not a change in language modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Temporal-Tiered KV Cache, or TTKV. It has three components. First, Tier Layout: KV cache is split into a fast tier in HBM and a slow tier in DRAM, corresponding to short-term and long-term memory. The design assumption is that recent tokens are more latency-sensitive and should remain in high-bandwidth, high-precision storage. Second, Tier Content: different temporal regions of the cache are stored with different fidelity. Recent and frequently accessed tokens stay in full precision, while older tokens moved to the slow tier are further compressed using differential quantization and sparsification. The key point is that time is the organizing principle for both storage placement and compression budget. Third, Tier Interaction: to avoid decode-time stalls from DRAM access, the paper uses streaming attention so that transfer from the slow tier overlaps with computation. Instead of fetching all remote KV first and then computing attention, the system pipelines communication and computation to hide PCIe costs.

Relative to methods such as KIVI, KVQuant, and DiffKV, TTKV is not just a standalone quantization scheme. Relative to ShadowKV-style offloading, it is not only an access-pattern optimization. Its main distinction is that it jointly decides which tokens deserve low latency and which tokens deserve high precision. The underlying empirical claim is that recent tokens form the active working set, while only a small subset of distant tokens remains highly relevant. That assumption is often reasonable in long-context generation, though tasks requiring exact long-range copying or retrieval may stress the design more heavily.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-32B, DeepSeek-R1-14B, and LLaMA-3.1-70B, which suggests the authors are aiming for model-family robustness rather than a single-model result. The main setting is long-context inference, especially 128K context. Against KIVI, KVQuant, DiffKV, and ShadowKV, TTKV reportedly reduces cross-tier traffic by up to 5.94x on 128K tasks, leading to as much as 76% lower latency and around 2x higher throughput while preserving accuracy.

The most important point is not the best single number, but the full causal chain: less slow-tier traffic, better overlap of the remaining traffic with compute, and then lower decode latency and higher throughput. The paper also emphasizes accuracy preservation, so this is not just a systems benchmark with quality ignored. The most informative ablations to inspect are likely: tiering without heterogeneous precision, compression without streaming, different fast-tier capacities, scaling with context length, and behavior across model sizes as the HBM overflow point changes. Based on the provided content, the central empirical message is clear: once KV must be offloaded, compression-only and offloading-only approaches leave substantial end-to-end performance on the table.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this as a systems paper with a clear optimization target. Start with the introduction and design principle sections to see that the real objective is cross-tier traffic, not abstract KV size. Then focus on the three design pieces: Tier Layout, Tier Content, and Tier Interaction. In Tier Content, pay attention to how the method decides which tokens stay in the fast tier and how quantization and sparsification are applied across layers, heads, or tokens. That determines whether the method is just a heuristic or grounded in stable access statistics. In Tier Interaction, inspect the streaming-attention pipeline carefully, because the latency gains depend on real communication-computation overlap. In experiments, start from the 128K headline results, then move to ablations on fast-tier size, bit width, sparsity, and model scale. A useful skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. If you work on serving or long-context systems, the implementation details and bandwidth model are worth a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型“系统想法可能对、论文证据未必够”的 KV 分层工作；先看内存层次设计和质量-带宽权衡曲线，没有硬件实测就别太当真。
recommendation.en: This looks like a plausible systems idea with evidence that may or may not be sufficient; read the memory-tier design and quality-vs-bandwidth tradeoff first, and don’t over-trust it without solid hardware measurements.

paper.title: The Illusion of Equivalence: Systematic FP16 Divergence in KV-Cached Autoregressive Inference
paper.abstract: KV caching is a ubiquitous optimization in autoregressive transformer inference, long presumed to be numerically equivalent to cache-free computation. This assumption fails under standard FP16 precision: cache-ON and cache-OFF execution paths employ different floating-point accumulation orderings which, due to FP16 non-associativity, produce a deterministic divergence in decoded token sequences. Across three open-weight models (LLaMA-2-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Gemma-2-2B) evaluated on GSM8K, we obse

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是一个长期被默认成立、但实际上并不成立的工程假设：自回归 Transformer 在开启 KV cache 和关闭 KV cache 时，推理结果应当数值等价。作者证明，在标准 FP16 推理下，这个假设系统性失效。原因不是采样随机性，也不是偶发数值噪声，而是两条执行路径的浮点累加顺序不同，FP16 又不满足结合律，于是会把微小误差稳定地写入 KV 状态，并在后续解码中逐步放大，最终导致输出 token 序列确定性分叉。论文真正回答的不是“会不会有差异”这么浅的问题，而是沿着因果链把现象、根因、传播路径、何时影响行为、以及误差位于模型哪里，逐步做清楚。
summary.importance: 对高效推理和模型系统研究，这篇论文的重要性高于它表面上的“数值分析小问题”。KV cache 是几乎所有生产推理系统的默认配置，很多优化工作都把 cache-ON 与 cache-OFF 当作数学上和工程上都等价的基线。本文说明，在 FP16 下这种等价性不能直接假定。其影响至少有三层。第一，评测复现层面：同一模型、同一输入、同一硬件，仅因是否启用 cache 就可能得到不同输出，连 greedy decoding 也不例外。第二，系统设计层面：如果 serving、benchmark、debug、interpretability 或安全分析在 cache 配置上不一致，结论可能被执行路径偏差污染。第三，机制研究层面：论文把 divergence 明确定位到 stateful KV cache，而不是常被分析的 residual stream，这对后续做可解释性、数值鲁棒性和 kernel 设计都很关键。对基座研究员而言，它提醒一个常被忽略的事实：推理路径本身就是模型行为的一部分，不能把实现细节完全视为透明。
summary.technical_approach:
论文的方法设计很工整，基本按“现象确认—根因排查—行为解释—因果定位”四步展开。

第一步是行为确认。作者在 LLaMA-2-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Gemma-2-2B 三个开源模型上，用 GSM8K 测试 greedy、top-k、top-p 三种解码策略，比较 cache-ON 与 cache-OFF 的输出。结果显示三类模型、三类采样条件下 token divergence rate 都是 100%。这一步的关键不是“差异存在”，而是排除了采样噪声：连 greedy 都分叉，说明问题来自执行路径本身。

第二步是根因识别。作者指出 cache-ON 与 cache-OFF 在 kernel 结构、内存布局和累加顺序上不同，而 FP16 加法非结合，因此同样的数学表达式会得到不同舍入结果。为了把“相关性”推进到“因果性”，他们做了受控 FP32 falsification：把相关计算切到 FP32 后，KV divergence 降到 2.5×10^-8 的噪声地板，相比 FP16 的 full-model accumulated KL divergence 下降超过 8 个数量级。这个实验很有说服力，因为它不是简单比较不同精度精度高低，而是利用更高精度消除“累加顺序差异被舍入放大”的机制。

第三步是解释一个表面矛盾。论文观察到：越早发生 token flip 的样本，KL divergence 往往越高，看起来像是在说“早翻转不是因为误差积累，而是因为误差本来就大”。作者进一步分析 decision boundary，指出早翻转和高 KL 的共同原因是模型本身更不确定，而不是 divergence 累积机制失效。也就是说，误差是逐步积累的，但只有当 logits 靠近决策边界时，较小的数值偏移才会更早转化为离散 token 差异。这个解释把“数值误差大小”和“行为可见性”区分开了。

第四步是因果定位。作者使用 activation patching 尝试通过替换 residual stream hidden states 来恢复 cache-ON/cache-OFF 的一致性，结果中位恢复率不到 1%，而且同时 patch 所有层时平均恢复甚至为负。这是一个很强的负结果：说明 divergence 主要不在 residual stream，而在 KV cache 状态本身。换句话说，后续层即便拿到“更正确”的 residual，也无法抹掉已经写入缓存并在后续 attention 中反复使用的误差。论文还讨论了 GQA 的放大效应：一个共享 key/value 头上的 FP16 舍入误差会被广播到多个 query heads，因此误差是相关放大，而不是独立平均掉。这解释了为什么某些现代架构可能比标准 MHA 更敏感。

整体上，这篇论文的技术贡献不在提出新算法，而在把一个工程默认假设拆开验证，并给出足够细的机制证据。相比只报告“cache 会导致输出不同”，它更进一步回答了为什么不同、差异如何传播、什么时候会影响最终 token、以及应该去哪里修。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三种模型：LLaMA-2-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Gemma-2-2B；任务是 GSM8K；解码策略包括 greedy、top-k、top-p。最醒目的结果是：在全部 9 个模型×策略条件下，cache-ON 与 cache-OFF 的 token divergence rate 都达到 100%。这说明差异不是偶发，而是系统性的。

准确率方面，cache-ON 在 9 个条件中的 8 个条件下高于 cache-OFF，且经 McNemar test、Bonferroni 校正后 p<0.05。作者很谨慎，没有把这解释成“cache-ON 更强”，而是把它视为 execution-path bias 的证据：既然两条路径本应等价，却稳定朝一个方向偏移，说明差异有系统性方向，而非纯随机扰动。

根因实验里，切换到 FP32 后，KV divergence 降到 2.5×10^-8；相对 FP16 的 full-model accumulated KL divergence，下降超过 8 个数量级。作者还报告 per-step accumulation ratio 在不同模型上约为 150–270×，而 mean relative accumulation error 基本不随序列长度变化，约为 0.036%。这组结果说明：单步误差规模主要由架构和数值路径决定，而不是输入长度本身决定；长度更多影响的是误差被写入和复用的次数。

关于“早翻转 vs 高 KL”的分析，作者在 9 个条件中的 8 个条件下用 t-test 得到 p<0.05，支持“模型不确定性”这一共同原因解释。因果定位实验中，activation patching residual stream 的中位恢复率低于 1%，而全层同时 patch 的平均恢复为负，说明 residual patching 不但不能修复 divergence，反而常常加剧不一致。这是全文最有机制分量的结果之一。

如果从实验质量看，这篇论文的优点是：1）跨模型、跨采样策略一致；2）有 falsification，而不是只做相关性观察；3）有负结果，且负结果本身有解释力。局限也很明确：模型规模仍偏中小，任务主要是 GSM8K，尚未覆盖更大模型、长上下文和更复杂 serving kernel，但作为问题定性与机制定位已经足够扎实。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你做推理系统、数值稳定性、可解释性或 benchmark 复现，建议认真看。阅读顺序可以按因果链来：
1. Introduction + Background：先明确论文挑战的默认假设是什么，以及 cache-ON/cache-OFF 在实现层面为何会有不同累加顺序。
2. 行为实验部分：重点看 100% divergence 和 greedy decoding 的结果，这是整篇论文成立的地基。
3. FP32 falsification：这是最关键的根因证据。要看清作者如何把“FP16 非结合 + 不同累加顺序”从猜测变成可检验机制。
4. decision boundary 分析：这部分解释为什么有些样本很早就 token flip，不要误读成“误差没有积累”。
5. activation patching / localization：这是最值得深挖的部分，因为它直接告诉你问题不在 residual stream，而在 KV state。
6. GQA 讨论：如果你关心现代架构设计，这里提供了一个很具体的放大机制。

预计阅读时间 30 分钟左右。若时间有限，至少看主结果图、FP32 对照实验、以及 residual patching 的表或图。后续可深挖的问题包括：BF16 是否同样存在但程度不同；不同 attention kernel、flash attention 实现、paged KV cache 是否改变误差模式；更大模型和长上下文下 divergence 是否更早显性化；以及是否可以通过 direct KV patching、mixed-precision policy 或 kernel 重排来恢复更强的一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines a widely assumed but rarely tested engineering premise: autoregressive transformer inference with KV cache enabled should be numerically equivalent to inference without KV cache. The authors show that this premise fails systematically under standard FP16 inference. The issue is not sampling randomness and not incidental numerical noise. Cache-ON and cache-OFF use different floating-point accumulation orders, FP16 addition is non-associative, and the resulting rounding differences are written into the KV state and then amplified across decoding steps. The paper’s real contribution is not merely to show that outputs differ, but to trace the full causal chain: the behavioral divergence, the numerical root cause, the conditions under which it becomes behaviorally visible, and the internal locus of the effect.
summary_en.importance: For inference and systems research, this matters more than it first appears. KV caching is the default in nearly all production LLM serving stacks, and many optimization papers implicitly treat cache-ON and cache-OFF as interchangeable baselines. This paper shows that such equivalence cannot be assumed in FP16. The implications are at least threefold. First, reproducibility: the same model, prompt, and hardware can produce different outputs solely because cache usage differs, even under greedy decoding. Second, systems methodology: if serving, benchmarking, debugging, interpretability, or safety analysis are performed under mismatched cache settings, conclusions may be confounded by execution-path bias. Third, mechanistic analysis: the paper localizes the divergence to the stateful KV cache rather than the residual stream, which is where much interpretability work tends to focus. For foundation-model researchers, the broader lesson is that the inference path is part of model behavior; implementation details are not always behaviorally transparent.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is structured as a clean causal investigation.

First, it establishes the phenomenon behaviorally. The authors compare cache-ON and cache-OFF decoding on three open-weight models—LLaMA-2-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Gemma-2-2B—using GSM8K under greedy, top-k, and top-p decoding. Across all model and decoding conditions, token divergence occurs in 100% of cases. The key point is that greedy decoding also diverges, which rules out sampling randomness and ties the effect directly to the execution path.

Second, it identifies the numerical root cause. Cache-ON and cache-OFF differ in kernel structure, memory layout, and accumulation ordering. Because FP16 arithmetic is non-associative, mathematically equivalent computations can round differently. To move beyond correlation, the paper performs a controlled FP32 falsification. When the relevant computation is moved to FP32, KV divergence drops to a noise floor of 2.5×10^-8, more than eight orders of magnitude below the FP16 full-model accumulated KL divergence. This is strong evidence that the mechanism is accumulation-order sensitivity amplified by FP16 rounding.

Third, the paper resolves an apparent contradiction in the behavioral data. Early token flips are associated with higher KL divergence, which might seem to contradict an accumulation story. The authors analyze decision-boundary proximity and show that both early flips and higher KL are jointly explained by model uncertainty. The divergence still accumulates over time, but it becomes behaviorally visible earlier when logits are already close to a decision boundary. This separates numerical accumulation from behavioral threshold crossing.

Fourth, the paper localizes the effect causally. Using activation patching on residual-stream hidden states, the authors attempt to recover equivalence between cache-ON and cache-OFF. Recovery is negligible: median recovery is below 1%, and patching all layers simultaneously yields negative mean recovery. This is a strong null result. It implies that the divergence is not primarily a residual-stream phenomenon; it lives in the KV cache state itself. Once rounding error is written into the cache and repeatedly reused by later attention operations, downstream residual interventions cannot undo it. The paper also argues that grouped-query attention amplifies the effect because one shared key/value rounding error is broadcast to multiple query heads, producing correlated rather than independent errors.

The technical contribution is therefore diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper takes an unexamined systems assumption, tests it rigorously, and provides mechanistic evidence for where the discrepancy comes from, how it propagates, and why standard residual-stream interventions fail to fix it.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover three models—LLaMA-2-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Gemma-2-2B—on GSM8K with greedy, top-k, and top-p decoding. The headline result is that token divergence between cache-ON and cache-OFF reaches 100% in all nine model-by-decoding conditions. This establishes that the effect is systematic rather than occasional.

On accuracy, cache-ON outperforms cache-OFF in 8 of 9 conditions, with significance under McNemar tests after Bonferroni correction at p<0.05. The paper is careful not to interpret this as a claim that cache-ON is intrinsically better. Instead, the asymmetry is treated as evidence of systematic execution-path bias: if two paths are supposed to be equivalent but one consistently shifts outcomes in one direction, the divergence is structured rather than random.

The root-cause experiment is especially important. Switching to FP32 reduces KV divergence to 2.5×10^-8, more than eight orders of magnitude below the FP16 full-model accumulated KL divergence. The reported per-step accumulation ratio is roughly 150–270× across models, while the mean relative accumulation error stays approximately flat at about 0.036% regardless of sequence length. This suggests that the per-step error scale is largely architecture- and implementation-determined, while sequence length mainly controls how often the error is written and reused.

For the early-flip versus high-KL question, the uncertainty-based explanation is supported in 8 of 9 conditions using t-tests with p<0.05. In the localization experiment, residual-stream activation patching yields less than 1% median recovery, and patching all layers together produces negative mean recovery. That is one of the paper’s strongest mechanistic results: residual correction does not repair the divergence and can even worsen it.

Methodologically, the paper is strong in three ways: it shows consistency across models and decoding strategies, it includes a falsification experiment rather than relying on correlation, and it reports an informative negative result. The limitations are also clear: the models are still moderate in size, the task suite is narrow, and the study does not yet cover larger models, long-context settings, or a broader range of serving kernels. But for establishing the phenomenon and its mechanism, the evidence is already quite solid.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Although labeled skim, this paper deserves careful reading if you work on inference systems, numerical stability, interpretability, or benchmark reproducibility. A good reading order follows the causal chain.

Start with the introduction and background to understand the exact assumption being challenged and why cache-ON and cache-OFF differ at the implementation level despite mathematical equivalence. Then read the behavioral results section closely, especially the 100% divergence finding and the greedy-decoding case, because that is the foundation of the whole argument. Next, read the FP32 falsification experiment in detail; this is the strongest root-cause evidence in the paper. After that, read the decision-boundary analysis, which explains why some examples flip early without contradicting the accumulation story. Finally, read the activation-patching and localization section carefully, since it is the part that most directly changes how one should think about the source of the divergence.

Expected reading time is around 30 minutes. If time is limited, prioritize the main results figure, the FP32 comparison, and the residual-patching results. The most useful follow-up questions are whether BF16 shows the same effect at a different magnitude, how different attention kernels or paged-KV implementations change the error pattern, whether larger models and longer contexts make the divergence behaviorally visible earlier, and whether direct KV patching or precision-aware kernel design can restore stronger equivalence.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对“KV cache 只是等价加速”的默认认知；先看实验设定和 FP32 反证，若 setup 干净，内部评测链路应立刻补一条 cache-consistency 检查。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior that KV cache is a semantics-preserving speedup; read the setup and FP32 falsification first, and add a cache-consistency check to your internal eval stack if it holds.

paper.title: Ragged Paged Attention: A High-Performance and Flexible LLM Inference Kernel for TPU
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) deployment is increasingly shifting to cost-efficient accelerators like Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), prioritizing both performance and total cost of ownership (TCO). However, existing LLM inference kernels and serving systems remain largely GPU-centric, and there is no well-established approach for efficiently mapping LLM workloads onto TPU architectures--particularly under the dynamic and ragged execution patterns common in modern serving. In this paper, w

summary.core_problem: 在 TPU 上做高性能 LLM 推理时，服务端工作负载往往是动态且“ragged”的（prefill/decode 混合、序列长度不齐、KV cache 频繁更新）。XLA 更偏静态图优化，TPU 的 tiled/packed 内存布局也让细粒度切片与 KV 写入变得昂贵。论文要解决的是：在 JAX/XLA 生态里，给出一个能稳定处理 ragged 批次、同时接近硬件上限的 TPU 原生 attention 推理 kernel。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理系统与 kernel 工程，对预训练方法本身影响有限；但对“训练-推理一体化栈”与研究复现很现实：TPU 作为性价比部署平台越来越常见，而推理端的吞吐/延迟会反过来影响评测与迭代速度。论文的价值在于把 GPU 侧 paged attention / flash-attn 的一些关键思想，按 TPU 的内存层级、DMA 粒度、XLA 编译约束重新落地，并给出可集成到 vLLM/SGLang 的实现路径。
summary.technical_approach:
Ragged Paged Attention (RPA) 用 Pallas（JAX kernel language）+ Mosaic 编译器绕开部分 XLA 黑盒路径，显式控制 DMA/RDMA 与寄存器级计算，核心有三点：
1) Fine-Grained Tiling for Raggedness：强制 XLA 选择更小的 tiling，使得对 ragged buffer 的动态 slicing 更高效。这里的关键是顺着 TPU 的 tiled layout 与 512B DMA 粒度做块设计，减少因不对齐导致的额外搬运与 padding。
2) KV-update-fused Pipeline：把 KV cache 更新与 attention 计算做流水重叠，隐藏 KV 写入延迟，避免常规 JAX/XLA 路径里 scatter/gather 或 TensorCore scatter 带来的开销。
3) Distribution-Aware Compilation：按序列长度区间分发不同的专用 kernel（类似多版本编译），让短序列/长序列分别接近各自的最优形态，避免“一套 kernel 吃所有”导致的利用率损失。

实现上强调“灵活性”：支持 MHA/MQA/GQA，不同 sharding、量化方案；跨 TPU v4–v7 主要靠调 block size 适配。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的代表性数字是在 Llama 3 8B 上：
- decode 阶段（更偏 memory-bound）：最高约 86% 的 memory bandwidth utilization (MBU)。
- prefill 阶段（更偏 compute-bound）：最高约 73% 的 model FLOPs utilization (MFU)。

更重要的是覆盖多种 workload：decode、prefill、以及混合 batch（ragged）。如果要评估是否“真有用”，建议重点看：与现有 TPU attention 路径/基线 kernel 的端到端吞吐与延迟对比、以及不同 seqlen 分布下的稳定性（抖动）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议以“TPU 约束 → kernel 设计选择”串起来：
- 先看 Background 里对 TPU MXU、tiled/packed 内存布局、DMA 粒度的解释（理解为什么 ragged slicing/kv update 会贵）。
- 再看三项创新各自解决的瓶颈：tiling 如何影响动态切片；KV-update 融合如何做流水；按 seqlen 分发 kernel 的策略与阈值如何定。
- 最后看性能评测图表：MBU/MFU 的测量方式、不同模型/注意力变体/TPU 代际的敏感性。

预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可把设计动机与主要结果看明白；若要改 kernel 或迁移到自家 serving，需要精读实现细节与开源代码。

summary_en.core_problem: TPU LLM serving is dominated by dynamic, ragged execution (mixed prefill/decode, variable sequence lengths, frequent KV-cache updates). XLA is optimized for static workloads, and TPU’s tiled/packed memory layout makes fine-grained slicing and KV writes expensive. The paper addresses how to build a TPU-native attention inference kernel that handles ragged batches efficiently while achieving high hardware utilization.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-kernel/system paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its practical relevance is that TPU deployment is increasingly common, and inference throughput/latency affects evaluation and iteration speed. The work translates paged-attention style ideas into the TPU/JAX/XLA world with explicit control over memory movement and compilation, and it is positioned as a production-oriented backend integrated into vLLM/SGLang.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Ragged Paged Attention (RPA) is implemented in Pallas (a JAX kernel language) compiled by Mosaic, giving low-level control over DMA/RDMA and register-level compute. The design centers on:
1) Fine-grained tiling to better support ragged buffers and dynamic slicing under TPU tiled layouts and coarse DMA granularity.
2) A KV-update-fused pipeline that overlaps KV-cache updates with attention computation to hide update latency and avoid expensive scatter/gather patterns in the default JAX/XLA path.
3) Distribution-aware compilation: multiple specialized kernels are dispatched based on sequence-length regimes, preventing a single kernel from underutilizing MXU or wasting bandwidth across diverse workloads.

The kernel aims to be flexible across attention variants (MHA/MQA/GQA), sharding strategies, quantization schemes, and TPU generations (v4–v7) with mostly block-size retuning.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported headline utilization on Llama 3 8B:
- Up to ~86% memory bandwidth utilization (MBU) in decode (memory-bound).
- Up to ~73% model FLOPs utilization (MFU) in prefill (compute-bound) on TPU7x.

The evaluation emphasizes robustness across decode/prefill/mixed ragged batches. For adoption decisions, the most informative results are end-to-end throughput/latency versus baseline TPU attention paths and stability across different seq-length distributions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim order:
- Background: TPU MXU shape sensitivity, tiled/packed memory layout, and DMA granularity—this explains why ragged slicing and KV updates are hard.
- Core design: the three optimizations (tiling, KV-update fusion, seqlen-based kernel dispatch) and what bottleneck each targets.
- Evaluation: how MBU/MFU are measured, and how performance varies across models, attention variants, and TPU generations.

Time budget: ~20–30 minutes for the main ideas; longer if you plan to modify kernels or integrate into a serving stack (read the open-source code paths).

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 TPU 上的大模型 serving，这篇该看；重点读 kernel 设计和 workload specialization，别把它误读成算法创新，价值主要在系统约束下把 paged attention 做对。
recommendation.en: Read this if TPU-based LLM serving matters to you; focus on the kernel design and workload specialization, not on algorithmic novelty—the value is in getting paged attention right under TPU constraints.

paper.title: Sequential KV Cache Compression via Probabilistic Language Tries: Beyond the Per-Vector Shannon Limit
paper.abstract: Recent work on KV cache quantization, culminating in TurboQuant, has approached the Shannon entropy limit for per-vector compression of transformer key-value caches. We observe that this limit applies to a strictly weaker problem than the one that actually matters: compressing the KV cache as a sequence. The tokens stored in a KV cache are not arbitrary floating-point data -- they are samples from the exact formal language the model was trained on, and the model is by construction a near-optimal

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 KV cache 压缩的一个更根本问题：现有方法大多把每个 key/value 向量当成独立样本来压缩，因此它们逼近的是“逐向量压缩极限”，而不是实际推理场景里更重要的“整段序列压缩极限”。作者的核心论点是，KV cache 不是任意浮点数组，而是模型在语言序列上逐步生成的内部状态；既然 token 序列本身高度可预测，那么给定前文后，下一个 KV 向量的条件熵也应远小于其边际熵。论文试图把这个观察形式化，并据此提出 sequential KV compression。
summary.importance: 从研究意义看，这篇工作最有价值的地方不是立刻给出可落地系统，而是把 KV 压缩问题的目标函数改写了。过去很多工作默认 Shannon 下界已经逼近，因而继续优化空间有限；这篇论文指出那个下界只适用于“孤立向量编码”，并不适用于“按序列编码 KV cache”。如果这个论证成立，那么推理侧的压缩上限会被重新打开：压缩率不再主要受 head dimension 限制，而可能受语言建模 surprisal 限制。对基座研究员来说，这个视角有两层启发。第一，模型内部状态的冗余与外部 token 分布强相关，推理优化不一定要停留在数值量化层。第二，训练出的 next-token predictor 本身就可以反过来作为内部状态编码器，这是一种“用模型自己的先验压缩模型自己的中间表示”的思路。它和预训练中的 predictive coding、representation redundancy、state-space compressibility 有直接联系。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，论文提出一个两层式 sequential KV compression 框架。

第一层是 probabilistic prefix deduplication。传统 prefix sharing 只在多个请求拥有完全相同前缀时复用 cache；作者想做得更激进：即使两个 session 的 token 前缀不完全相同，只要它们在模型概率空间里足够接近，也可以视作“语义等价前缀”，共享一个前缀表示，再只存各自相对共享中心的增量。这里用到 PLT（Probabilistic Language Trie）中的 trie metric，形式上是 d_T(s,s') = -log P(common-prefix relation / probabilistic overlap) 一类的概率距离。关键不是字符串相等，而是“在模型先验下，这两个前缀是否落在相近的预测状态里”。这比 exact prefix matching 更强，因为它试图消除跨 session 的近似冗余。

第二层是 predictive delta coding。对单个 session 内的每个 KV 向量，不直接存原向量，而是先用模型基于历史前缀预测当前位置的 KV，再只编码真实 KV 与预测 KV 的残差。作者给出的理论主张是：这个残差的熵上界由 token-level surprisal 控制，而不是由每个向量各维度的独立熵控制。换句话说，如果模型对下一个 token 很有把握，那么它对下一个内部状态也应有较强可预测性，剩余需要编码的信息会更少。

论文还强调这两层与 TurboQuant 一类 per-vector quantization 是正交的。也就是说，先做 sequential compression，再对残差做量化，或者反过来组合，理论上都可叠加。作者进一步声称其渐近行为更好：上下文越长，模型条件分布越尖锐，预测越准，序列式压缩的收益越大；而逐向量量化的压缩率通常不随上下文长度改善。

从方法判断看，这篇论文的亮点主要在理论 framing，而不是工程细节已经闭环。它把“KV 是语言模型状态序列”这个事实推到了压缩目标的中心位置，这是对现有量化文献的一个有力反问。但也要看到，文中很多关键步骤依赖较强假设：例如模型能否稳定预测下一位置所有层的 KV，近似语义前缀共享是否会引入检索和误差控制成本，PLT 距离在真实 serving 系统里如何高效维护。这些问题决定了它更像一篇方向性论文，而不是已经成熟的部署方案。
summary.experiments:
从当前提供的全文内容看，论文主体主要展开在理论分析、框架设计和实现讨论上，尚未看到完整实验章节与具体数值表格，因此不能安全编造压缩率、吞吐或 perplexity 损失等数字。可以确认的实验/分析主线有三条。第一，作者给出 sequential entropy bound（Theorem 1），论证给定先前 cache 后，当前 KV 的条件熵上界受模型每 token surprisal 约束。第二，Section 4 和 Section 5 分别分析 probabilistic prefix deduplication 与 predictive delta coding 的收益来源，并在 Section 6 讨论与现有 quantization 方法的可组合性。第三，论文在 Section 7 讨论 practical implementation，在 Section 9 讨论 open problems，说明作者知道真正难点在系统落地，而不只是信息论表述。
